title: Enforcing Axioms for AI Alignment under Loss-Based Rules
comment: Published in the Proceedings of ICLR 2026
summary: Many alignment methods, most notably reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), train reward models by minimizing a loss on pairwise comparisons of model responses. Inspired by principle-guided methods such as Constitutional AI, we treat each principle as a voter that compares responses according to that principle, for example, preferring the more helpful or less toxic response. We represent these voters as linear directions in a fixed embedding space, a simplifying assumption motivated by the Linear Representation Hypothesis. In this linear social choice model, Ge et al. (2024) showed that an optimal linear reward model can violate Pareto optimality (PO): From the principles-as-voters lens, this means a response A can be less helpful and more toxic than B, yet still receive a higher reward. We ask whether richer reward models or changes to comparison data can recover PO within loss-based training. We show that PO can still fail for polynomials of any fixed degree and one-hidden-layer ReLU multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) of any fixed width $ d\ge 2 $ with suitable finite parameter bounds. We then recover PO for loss-based training of linear rewards under suitable assumptions in an idealized setting with uniform comparison directions and equal comparison lengths. These results motivate dataset design as an approach to recovering PO in constitutional-style alignment while retaining loss-based training.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究原则引导对齐中线性奖励模型可能违反帕累托最优(PO)的问题，证明多项式与单隐层ReLU MLP仍会失败，但在均匀比较方向等理想假设下可通过数据设计恢复PO。
AI.motivation: 现有RLHF等方法通过成对比较损失训练奖励模型，而在"原则即投票者"的线性社会选择模型中，最优线性奖励模型可能违反帕累托最优——即某一回答在各项原则上都更差却获得更高奖励。作者希望探究更丰富的奖励模型或改变比较数据能否在基于损失的训练中恢复PO。
AI.method: 将每一个原则视为嵌入空间中的一个线性投票方向（基于线性表示假设），构建线性社会选择模型；分析多项式（任意固定次数）与任意固定宽度d≥2的单隐层ReLU MLP在有限参数界下是否仍违反PO；并在均匀比较方向、等长比较的理想化设定下，从理论推导恢复线性奖励PO所需假设，进而提出以数据集设计为手段的方法。
AI.result: 证明对任意固定次数的多项式和任意固定宽度d≥2的一隐层ReLU MLP（在适当的有限参数界下），PO仍可能失败，即更复杂的模型无法自动保证PO；但在比较方向均匀、比较长度相等的理想设定及适当假设下，可以为线性奖励的损失式训练恢复PO。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠增强奖励模型表达能力不足以保证帕累托最优；相反，应通过数据集设计来恢复PO，从而在保留基于损失训练的同时实现宪法式对齐中的帕累托一致性。

title: Adversarial risk analysis with fully probabilistic designs
summary: Adversarial risk analysis (ARA) informs decision-makers when facing intelligent opponents and uncertain outcomes, enabling an analyst to model beliefs about the opponents' preferences, capabilities, beliefs, and the strategic calculations that opponents employ. Major applications cover reliability and risk analysis of critical infrastructures in presence of adversarial threats. In such domains, ARA mitigates typical common knowledge assumptions of standard game-theoretic approaches. However, ARA entails complex modelling and computations. To alleviate these, we explore its combination with fully probabilistic design (FPD), a control theory methodology supporting an agent in choosing the decision distribution that achieves the outcomes with a distribution closest to its ideal. We use FPD to model and forecast the opponent's decisions within an ARA setting and present how to handle security games within this ARA-FPD framework, covering both single and multiple stage problems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将对抗风险分析（ARA）与全概率设计（FPD）结合，用FPD建模并预测对手决策，以缓解ARA建模与计算的复杂性，并应用于安全博弈（单阶段与多阶段）。
AI.motivation: ARA可用于关键基础设施的可靠性与风险分析，能规避标准博弈论的共同知识假设，但其建模与计算负担重，需要更简便的方法支持对手决策建模。
AI.method: 引入控制理论中的全概率设计（FPD）——让智能体选择使其结果分布最接近理想分布的决定分布——在ARA框架内对对手决策进行建模与预测，并给出安全博弈在该ARA-FPD框架下的处理方式，涵盖单阶段与多阶段问题。
AI.result: 展示了FPD可嵌入ARA用于对手决策的建模与预测，并说明了该方法如何在单阶段和多阶段安全博弈场景中实施。
AI.conclusion: ARA与FPD的组合为对抗性安全决策提供了一种降低建模与计算复杂度的可行途径，适用于单阶段与多阶段安全博弈问题。

title: Second-Best Trade Is Half Efficient in Multidimensional Markets
summary:
We prove that at least half of the first-best gains from trade can always be achieved in multidimensional two-sided markets with additive values and costs and arbitrary downward-closed feasibility constraints. The guarantee is achieved by a mechanism satisfying Bayesian incentive compatibility, interim individual rationality, and strong budget balance, and is tight already in single-item bilateral trade. Types are independent across agents, while the coordinates of each agent's type may be arbitrarily correlated. Feasibility constraints may couple trades across items and agents. This extends the known tight one-half guarantee for single-item bilateral trade.
  Our proof develops a new application of the Cai--Devanur--Weinberg duality framework. We show that the objective of every feasible dual is at least half of the first best. Strong duality then yields the guarantee without characterizing an optimal mechanism or dual. The key observation is that every feasible dual induces continuous-time Markov chains that, when stopped by exponential clocks, recover true types as expectations of virtual types. The dual constraints control the rate at which these chains change the prior distributions. We establish our bound by combining this control with a coupling of the agents' clocks.

AI.tldr: 论文证明：在带可加估值/成本和任意下闭可行性约束的多维双边市场中，总能至少实现最优交易收益（first-best gains from trade）的一半，且该保证可由满足贝叶斯激励相容、临时个体理性和强预算平衡的机制达成；在单物品双边贸易中该界是紧的。
AI.motivation: 单物品双边贸易已有紧的1/2保证，但多维、多物品、复杂可行性约束下的最优交易收益近似问题尚未解决。本文旨在将该1/2保证推广到一般多维双边市场。
AI.method: 采用Cai–Devanur–Weinberg对偶框架的新应用：证明每个可行对偶的目标值至少为first-best的一半，再由强对偶得到保证，而无需刻画最优机制或对偶。关键观察是每个可行对偶诱导连续时间马尔可夫链，用指数时钟停止后可把真实类型表示为虚拟类型的期望；对偶约束控制这些链改变先验分布的速率，再结合各智能体时钟的耦合建立界。
AI.result: 证明在所有上述模型中至少实现一半first-best收益，机制满足BIC、临时IR和强预算平衡；该界在单物品双边贸易中已紧。类型跨智能体独立，但单个智能体各坐标可任意相关，可行性约束可跨物品和智能体耦合。
AI.conclusion: 多维双边市场中对最优交易收益的1/2近似是普遍可达且紧的，将单物品结论推广到一般设定，并提供了一种基于对偶与连续时间马尔可夫链的证明工具。

title: Artificial Currency and Separate Selling: A 3-Approximation for Consumer Surplus
summary: We study the allocation of indivisible items to buyers with additive values drawn from independent distributions. The objective is consumer surplus net of burnt payments. We consider artificial-currency mechanisms: buyers receive personalized budgets of a currency worthless outside the mechanism and use them to bid across items. The better of separate selling and artificial-currency mechanisms provides a 3-approximation to optimal consumer surplus. The guarantee holds at every Bayes--Nash equilibrium, without equilibrium selection. Both branches are necessary: either alone may capture only a vanishing share of the optimum. The proof decomposes benchmark surplus into a stable part captured by artificial currency and a variation covered by separate selling.

AI.tldr: 研究不可分商品分配给加性独立估值的买家、以净消费者剩余为目标；证明分别销售与人工货币机制中较优者可达到最优净消费者剩余的3倍近似，且对任意贝叶斯-纳什均衡成立。
AI.motivation: 最优净消费者剩余机制难以实现，需寻找简单且稳健的机制；单一机制（分别销售或人工货币）都可能在最优值中只拿到趋于零的比例，故需要二者结合并保证无需均衡选择。
AI.method: 考虑人工货币机制：买家获得机制外无价值的个性化预算，用于跨商品出价；将基准剩余分解为可由人工货币捕获的“稳定部分”与被分别销售覆盖的“变动部分”，据此构造两种机制的较优者。
AI.result: 较优机制达到最优消费者剩余（扣除烧钱支付）的3倍近似，且在每一个贝叶斯-纳什均衡上均成立；并证明两条分支缺一不可，各自单独可能只捕获消失比例的最优值。
AI.conclusion: 简单机制的组合足以稳健逼近最优净消费者剩余，但必须组合使用；剩余分解为机制设计提供了构造性分析框架。

title: A Functional Preservation Score for Auditing Connectome Operations: Compression, Alignment, Transport, and Local-Rule Writing
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Code, data loaders, and all result artifacts at https://github.com/Praveg432/functional-preservation-score
summary: We introduce the Functional Preservation Score (FPS), a null-normalised, behaviourally grounded measure of how much of a neural network's input-output function survives a structural operation, and use it to audit the operations underlying speculative "mind-migration" pipelines on public data that runs on a single laptop. Across five pre-registered studies on the C. elegans connectome, whole-brain calcium activity, and hippocampal replay, FPS yields two positive characterisations and a three-part negative. Low-bit quantisation of a real connectome exhibits a structure-dependent sparsity floor: uniform int4/ternary quantisation is forced to roughly 73%/98% effective sparsity because heavy-tailed integer synaptic weights round to zero, while mixed-precision protection of hub neurons lowers these floors to about 27%/32%. Decoded hippocampal replay sequences compress heavily yet remain identifiable at a cross-validated top-1 accuracy of 0.69 (95% CI [0.63, 0.74]; chance 0.125; permutation p < 1e-3) from latents of order 10-50 bits per event, and a bounded incremental store shows a graceful-versus-cliff capacity trade-off. The migration pipeline fails in simulation at each stage for largely independent reasons: the putative "identity payload" is not a functionally separable module (p >= 0.16 at every tested size); cross-individual functional transport via Gromov-Wasserstein collapses once the target's wiring is respected (fidelity 1.00 to 0.40, [0.31, 0.49], p < 1e-3) or alignment is imperfect (0.06, [0.00, 0.13]); and biologically plausible local plasticity cannot reach the function the target topology provably admits (gap 0.45, [0.27, 0.64], p < 1e-3, d = 2.0). We release FPS, the data loaders, and all operations as a toolkit. All results are at nematode / small-network scale and concern coherence in simulation, not the feasibility of reading or writing a living brain.

AI.tldr: 作者提出功能保留分数（FPS）这一零基线归一化、行为导向的度量，用于审计"心智迁移"流程中结构操作的可靠性；在秀丽隐杆线虫连接组、全脑钙活动与海马回放的五项预注册研究中，得到两个正面结果与三部分否定结论。
AI.motivation: 现有"心智迁移"类流程缺乏统一的、可量化"结构操作后网络输入输出功能保留多少"的评估标准，尤其缺少在公共数据、单机可复现条件下的系统审计。
AI.method: 提出 FPS 度量（对结构操作前后的功能保真度做零假设归一化），并应用于五组预注册研究：真实线虫连接组的低位/三值量化、海马回放序列解码与有界增量存储、身份载荷可分性检验、基于 Gromov-Wasserstein 的跨个体功能迁移、以及生物合理性局部可塑性对照目标拓扑可达上限。
AI.result: (1) 均匀 int4/三值量化存在约 73%/98% 的稀疏度地板，混合精度保护枢纽神经元可降至约 27%/32%；(2) 海马回放序列可重度压缩，事件潜变量约 10-50 bit 下交叉验证 top-1 准确率 0.69（95% CI [0.63,0.74]，随机 0.125，置换 p<1e-3），有界增量存储呈"平缓-断崖"容量权衡；(3) 迁移流程各阶段独立失败：身份载荷不可功能分离（各规模 p≥0.16）；尊重目标接线后 Gromov-Wasserstein 迁移保真度由 1.00 降至 0.40（[0.31,0.49]），对齐不完美时仅 0.06（[0.00,0.13]）；局部可塑性无法达到目标拓扑可达功能（差距 0.45，[0.27,0.64]，p<1e-3，d=2.0）。
AI.conclusion: 在心智迁移模拟管线中，三个关键环节因各自独立的原因失败；研究仅限线虫/小网络尺度，讨论的是模拟中的功能一致性，而非读写活体大脑的可行性。FPS、数据加载器与所有操作以工具包形式公开。

title: DocFS: File Systems as Agentic Reasoning Environments for Complex Multimodal Document Question Answering
summary: VLM-based agents solve complex tasks by iteratively interacting with environments, and their effectiveness depends heavily on how the environment exposes information and provides tools for acting on it. However, constructing an effective environment for complex multimodal document question answering remains challenging: documents usually span many pages, with multimodal contents distributed across hierarchical sections and linked by cross-modal associations, while existing methods organize documents into structured representations that address only the information side of the environment and lack tools aligned with the structure, limiting agents' ability to fully exploit it. We observe that file systems naturally combine structure organization with aligned tools: directories and files encode document structure, while file operations provide rich tools to access file contents. Building on this insight, we propose DocFS, a file-system-based agentic framework that reorganizes raw documents as file systems, where directories mirror the section hierarchy and explicit links connect text with figures, tables, and equations. Based on well-established file system tools such as navigation, search, and reading, agents can iteratively explore the document structure, locate relevant evidence, and understand fine-grained local information. Paired with Qwen3.5-Plus, DocFS achieves state-of-the-art performance on MMLongBench-Doc and FinRAGBench-V, outperforming the strongest baselines by 2.9 and 4.3 percentage points, respectively, and is up to 10.3x faster with up to 10.1x fewer tokens than the strongest baseline during reasoning.

AI.tldr: DocFS将原始多模态文档重组为文件系统（目录对应章节层级，显式链接连接文本与图表/表格/公式），借助导航、搜索、读取等文件操作工具，让VLM智能体迭代探索文档结构并定位证据。
AI.motivation: 复杂多模态文档问答中，文档跨多页、内容分布于层级章节且存在跨模态关联。现有方法只构建结构化表示（仅解决"信息"层面），缺乏与结构对齐的工具，限制智能体充分利用结构。
AI.method: 受"文件系统天然结合结构组织与对齐工具"的观察启发，提出DocFS框架：把原始文档重组织为文件系统，目录镜像章节层级，显式链接连接文本与图、表、公式；智能体基于导航、搜索、读取等文件系统工具迭代探索结构、定位证据、理解细粒度局部信息。
AI.result: 配合Qwen3.5-Plus，DocFS在MMLongBench-Doc和FinRAGBench-V上分别超出最强基线2.9和4.3个百分点，达SOTA；推理时最高快10.3倍，token用量最多减少10.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 文件系统是面向多模态文档问答的有效环境范式，结构组织与对齐工具的结合可显著提升智能体的效率与效果。

title: Large-area Spatially Aligned Anchors
summary: Extended Reality (XR) technologies, including Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR), offer immersive experiences merging digital content with the real world. Achieving precise spatial tracking over large areas is a critical challenge in XR development. This paper addresses the drift issue, caused by small errors accumulating over time leading to a discrepancy between the real and virtual worlds. Tackling this issue is crucial for co-located XR experiences where virtual and physical elements interact seamlessly. Building upon the locally accurate spatial anchors, we propose a solution that extends this accuracy to larger areas by exploiting an external, drift-corrected tracking method as a ground truth. During the preparation stage, anchors are placed inside the headset and inside the external tracking method simultaneously, yielding 3D-3D correspondences. Both anchor clouds, and thus tracking methods, are aligned using a suitable cloud registration method during the operational stage. Our method enhances user comfort and mobility by leveraging the headset's built-in tracking capabilities during the operational stage, allowing standalone functionality. Additionally, this method can be used with any XR headset that supports spatial anchors and with any drift-free external tracking method. Empirical evaluation demonstrates the system's effectiveness in aligning virtual content with the real world and expanding the accurate tracking area. In addition, the alignment is evaluated by comparing the camera poses of both tracking methods. This approach may benefit a wide range of industries and applications, including manufacturing and construction, education, and entertainment.

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用外部无漂移跟踪方法作为真值、通过空间锚点云配准将头显局部精确追踪扩展到大面积的方法，解决XR中的漂移问题。
AI.motivation: XR（VR/AR）在大范围空间精确追踪是核心挑战，小误差随时间累积产生漂移，导致真实世界与虚拟世界错位，严重影响共址XR体验中虚实融合交互。
AI.method: 基于头显本地精确的空间锚点，引入外部漂移校正的跟踪方法作为真值。准备阶段在头显内和外部追踪系统中同时放置锚点，得到3D-3D对应关系；运行阶段用点云配准对齐两组锚点云，从而对齐两种跟踪方法。运行阶段利用头显内置追踪，实现独立运行。
AI.result: 实证评估显示系统能有效将虚拟内容与真实世界对齐并扩展精确追踪范围；并通过比较两种追踪方法的相机位姿来评估对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提升用户舒适度与移动性，适用于任何支持空间锚点的XR头显及任何无漂移外部追踪方法，可应用于制造、建筑、教育和娱乐等领域。

title: We Used It Anyway: Low Trust and High Adoption of Large Language Models in Requirements Engineering Education
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) are reshaping how students approach Software Engineering activities, particularly those centered on textual artifacts. This paper reports on the experience of integrating a non-restrictive LLM use within a first-year Master's course in Software Engineering, in which students completed a semester-long Software Engineering project divided in a Requirements Engineering (RE) phase and a software testing phase. Following the completion of the RE phase of the project, we administered a 12-question survey to 43 students to investigate which LLM tools they used, for which activities, how they evaluated AI-generated outputs, and how they envisioned the role of LLMs in future SE curricula. Our findings show that LLM use was nearly universal among respondents and concentrated primarily on text-intensive activities such as use-case narratives, consistency checking, brainstorming, and refinement of existing artifacts. Despite this widespread adoption, most students perceived AI-generated outputs as inferior to their own work, frequently reporting issues related to incorrect or incomplete content, mismatches with course-specific conventions, over-engineering, and limitations in diagram generation. Nevertheless, students continued to rely extensively on LLM as a reviewer, critic, and productivity aid rather than as a fully autonomous artifact generator. We also observe that students' choice of models was strongly influenced by access to premium subscriptions available for free for student accounts, highlighting the role of economic accessibility in shaping educational AI ecosystems. The results suggest that the most significant challenge in the adoption of LLMs within Requirements Engineering education is not whether students use these tools, but whether they possess the skills required to critically evaluate, contextualize, and correct its outputs.

AI.tldr: 在软件工程硕士一年级课程中非限制性引入LLM，通过43名学生的12题问卷发现LLM使用近乎普遍、集中于文本密集型需求工程任务，但学生普遍认为AI输出不如自身作品，仍将其作为评审与效率工具而非自主生成器，模型选择受免费高级订阅影响，核心挑战在于批判性评估与修正能力。
AI.motivation: LLM正改变学生开展软件工程活动（尤其是文本类工件）的方式，但教育场景中如何在课程内合理引入LLM、学生如何使用与评估其输出尚缺乏实证经验。
AI.method: 在一门为期一学期、分为需求工程（RE）阶段与软件测试阶段的硕士级软件工程项目中，采用非限制性LLM使用政策；在RE阶段结束后对43名学生开展12题问卷调查，考察所用工具、用途、对AI输出的评估方式及对未来SE课程中LLM角色的设想。
AI.result: LLM使用近乎普遍，集中于用例叙述、一致性检查、头脑风暴与工件精炼等文本密集活动；多数学生认为AI输出逊于自身成果，常见问题包括内容错误或不完整、与课程特定规范不符、过度工程化及图表生成能力有限；学生更多把LLM当作评审者、批评者和效率工具；模型选择明显受面向学生免费的高级订阅影响。
AI.conclusion: RE教育中引入LLM的主要挑战不在于学生是否使用，而在于其是否具备批判性评估、情境化理解与修正LLM输出的能力；经济可及性也在塑造教育AI生态。

title: An ensemble of graph generative models for assisted history matching of the Brugge field case
summary: Assisted history matching remains non-unique because many geological realisations can reproduce equivalent production responses with substantial differences between individual well matches. This ambiguity increases when a field comprises several depositional settings and modelling strategies. The paper applied a graph autoencoder approach to history matching of a benchmark Brugge field that comprises different depositional zones. Each stratigraphic zone is modelled with its dedicated generative model that comprises a joint latent space for optimisation history matching loops. Graph-based generators operate directly on the active cells of the corner-point grid, so its irregular geometry is handled without conversion to a regular lattice. The optimisation search in the 160-dimensional joint latent space is done with the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy. The multi-component objective function includes static well data mismatch, dynamic production mismatch, and a geological realism penalty based on the Decoder induced latent metric. Latent space diagnostics with topological data analysis are applied prior to history matching to test whether one generator is sufficient or whether a multiple generator formulation is required. The results show that the zone-based formulation gives coherent latent spaces, preserves the main porosity and permeability relations that vary from one zone to another, and supports history matching while keeping the solutions within the learned geological manifold. The matched models reproduce field oil and water production within the prior uncertainty range and provide a comparable well-level match to previously published Brugge studies based on Ensemble Kalman Filter, Particle Swarm Optimisation with principal component analysis of parameterisation, and Multiple Kernel Learning with Particle Swarm Optimisation.

AI.tldr: 提出分区图自编码器方法对Brugge油田进行辅助历史拟合，各沉积带用独立生成模型并共享联合潜空间，用CMA-ES在160维潜空间优化，配以TDA诊断，匹配效果可与已发表方法相当。
AI.motivation: 辅助历史拟合存在非唯一性：多个地质实现可复现相同生产响应但单井匹配差异大；当油田包含多种沉积环境与建模策略时，这种模糊性进一步加剧，需要一种能兼顾地质真实性与多区带差异的方法。
AI.method: 采用图自编码器直接在角点网格活跃网格单元上生成，避免转换为规则网格；每个地层带用专门的生成模型，并构建联合潜空间用于优化；在160维联合潜空间用协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）搜索；目标函数含静态井数据失配、动态生产失配与基于Decoder诱导潜度量的地质真实性惩罚；历史拟合前用拓扑数据分析（TDA）诊断潜空间，判断单生成器是否足够。
AI.result: 基于区带的建模给出连贯潜空间，保持各区带间不同的主要孔渗关系，并使解保持在学到的地质流形内；匹配模型在先验不确定范围内复现油田油、水产量，井级匹配与已有Brugge研究（EnKF、PCA参数化+PSO、多核学习+PSO）相当。
AI.conclusion: 分区图自编码器+联合潜空间优化可有效处理非规则网格与多沉积带的历史拟合，在保持地质合理性的同时达到与主流方法相当的匹配质量；TDA诊断有助于决定单/多生成器方案。

title: Auditable Human-Agent Teams for Autonomous X-ray Experimentation
summary: Closed-loop autonomous experimentation can accelerate scientific discovery, but implementation effort limits accessibility. Agentic systems may lower this barrier, although sustained operation on physical instruments remains largely unexplored. Here, using coding-agent infrastructure grounded in validated scientific methods, we demonstrate autonomous synchrotron X-ray experiments on nanoparticle superlattices under evolving, human-defined objectives. Complete human-agent and agent-agent transcripts enable an audit that reconstructs decision provenance and characterizes the division of cognitive labor. Across three experiments, 61-67% of messages involved interpretation or judgment, while the share of methodological and scientific contributions increased from 46% in the setup-focused first experiment to 56-61% in later experiments. Provenance showed that 59-68% of error corrections involved multiple participants and that about half of all decisions incorporated the input of another participant. These results may guide design principles for multi-agent scientific systems and inform future agent harnesses, model training, and accessible autonomous experimentation.

AI.tldr: 该文展示编码智能体基础设施驱动的自主同步辐射X射线实验，并通过完整的人类-智能体对话记录审计决策来源与认知分工。
AI.motivation: 闭环自主实验能加速科学发现，但实现门槛高。智能体系统有望降低门槛，但长期在物理仪器上持续运行仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 基于已验证科学方法构建编码智能体基础设施，在纳米颗粒超晶格上开展三轮自主同步辐射X射线实验，目标由人类动态定义；利用完整人-智能体及智能体-智能体对话记录重建决策来源，量化认知劳动分工。
AI.result: 三轮实验中61-67%的消息涉及解释或判断；方法与科学贡献占比由首轮（以搭建为主）的46%升至后续的56-61%；59-68%的错误纠正涉及多方参与者，约半数决策纳入他人输入。
AI.conclusion: 结果可为多智能体科学系统设计原则、智能体框架与模型训练、以及可及的自主实验提供指导。

title: Uncovering the Blind Spots of OKS-mAP: A Unified Protocol for Occlusion, Joint-Angle, and Temporal Evaluation of 2D Pose Estimators
summary: The dominant metric for 2D human pose estimation, OKS-mAP, has three blind spots: it does not distinguish visible from occluded keypoints, does not measure joint-angle error, and is silent on the temporal stability of tracking-free per-frame inference. We propose a supplementary protocol with three modules: (M1) OKS-mAP stratified by ground-truth visibility, with Delta_occ = mAP(v=1) - mAP(full), quantifying how much the aggregate metric masks occlusion-specific differences; (M2) joint-angle error (RMSE/MAE/P95) plus knee-valgus detection consistency; (M3) frame-to-frame displacement, median-filter residual jitter, and jump rate, before and after OneEuro smoothing. We ran it on four datasets (COCO val2017, CrowdPose, OCHuman, PoseTrack18) and four models from two architecture families (YOLO11s-pose, an occlusion-domain fine-tuned variant, ViTPose-B/L), under a common detector-free oracle protocol and an open-source harness. Delta_occ is negative in every combination (-0.19 to -0.47): aggregate mAP overestimates occluded-scene performance in every tested combination. Joint-angle error is amplified in occluded layers; angle metrics reveal differences mAP cannot localize, e.g., the smaller occlusion-trained model significantly outperforming a larger transformer in occluded elbows. On PoseTrack18 val, raw jitter matched between the two YOLO models; pixel-domain OneEuro smoothing cut jump rates 9-10% at no matched-scope AP cost; residual jitter persists after detector removal; the transformer pair's jump rate is significantly lower; smoothing benefits replicate across architectures. Stratified mAP tracks full mAP closely (sign-consistency 1.0, 12/12), serving magnitude diagnosis rather than re-ranking; angle-metric difference vectors (especially knee) partially diverge, suggesting independent information. The protocol and harness are open-sourced, complementing rather than replacing OKS-mAP.

AI.tldr: 提出补充OKS-mAP的三模块评估协议（可见性分层mAP、关节角误差、时序抖动/平滑），在4数据集4模型上验证其能揭示被聚合指标掩盖的遮挡、角度与时序问题。
AI.motivation: 2D人体姿态估计的主流量化指标OKS-mAP存在三个盲点：不区分可见与遮挡关键点、不测量关节角度误差、也不反映无跟踪逐帧推理的时序稳定性，导致聚合分数掩盖了遮挡场景、角度质量和时序抖动上的真实差异。
AI.method: 设计三模块补充协议：M1按真值可见性分层计算OKS-mAP并用Δ_occ=mAP(v=1)-mAP(full)量化聚合指标对遮挡差异的掩盖；M2计算关节角RMSE/MAE/P95及膝外翻检测一致性；M3测量帧间位移、中值滤波残差抖动与跳变率，并对比OneEuro滤波前后。统一在无检测器的oracle协议与开源harness下，测试COCO val2017、CrowdPose、OCHuman、PoseTrack18四数据集及YOLO11s-pose（含遮挡域微调变体）、ViTPose-B/L四种模型。
AI.result: 所有组合中Δ_occ均为负（-0.19至-0.47），说明聚合mAP普遍高估遮挡场景性能；关节角误差在遮挡层被放大，角指标能揭示mAP无法定位的差异（如较小的遮挡训练模型在遮挡肘部显著优于更大的Transformer）；PoseTrack18上像素域OneEuro平滑将跳变率降低9-10%且匹配范围内无AP损失，残差抖动在去除检测器后仍存在，Transformer成对模型跳变率显著更低；分层mAP与完整mAP高度一致（符号一致性1.0，12/12），角指标差异向量（尤其膝部）部分发散，表明其含独立信息。
AI.conclusion: 该协议定位于对OKS-mAP的补充而非替代：分层mAP用于量级诊断而非重新排序，角与时序指标提供独立信息。协议与harness已开源，为遮挡、角度与稳定性提供可复现的多维评估。

title: From Relevant Posts to Attributable Spans: Explicit Symptom Evidence for Depression Questionnaire Inference
summary: Longitudinal social-media histories offer an opportunity to assess depression, potentially supporting the inference of standardized depression questionnaire responses. However, this task requires evidence that is semantically relevant to a symptom and attributable to the user, while being sufficiently specific to support an individual questionnaire item. Existing approaches rely on semantic similarity to retrieve posts, which can introduce misleading or non-attributable evidence, particularly in multi-symptom posts and discussions of others' experiences. We propose SREE (Symptom Retrieval and Evidence-Grounded InfErence), an evidence-grounded pipeline that extracts first-person and symptom-specific text spans, selects a representative subset using a Facility Location-inspired objective, and performs Evidence-Gated Inference over the selected evidence. We evaluate evidence retrieval on BDI-Sen and evidence-conditioned questionnaire inference on eRisk 2019-2021. Compared with state-of-the-art retrieval approaches, SREE achieves relative improvements of 70% in post-level precision and 59% in F1, while retaining at least 30% fewer posts. On multi-symptom sentences, it also outperforms dense retrieval in precision and F1 even with twice the retrieval budget. Across all three eRisk collections, SREE achieves the highest exact item-level agreement while remaining competitive on ordinal and aggregate metrics. These results highlight the importance of localizing attributable evidence and controlling its composition before inferring depression questionnaire responses.

AI.tldr: SREE 提出一个证据接地流程：抽取第一人称、症状特定的文本片段，用设施选址目标挑代表性子集，再做证据门控推断，从而由社交媒体历史推断抑郁问卷条目。
AI.motivation: 用纵向社交媒体记录推断标准化抑郁问卷(如BDI)条目，需要与症状语义相关、可归属到用户本人、且足够具体到单个条目的证据；现有基于语义相似度的检索会引入误导性或不可归属的证据（多症状帖、谈论他人经历）。
AI.method: SREE 三步：(1) 抽取第一人称且症状特定的文本跨度；(2) 用受 Facility Location 启发的目标函数选取代表性子集；(3) 对选中证据执行 Evidence-Gated Inference（证据门控推断）。
AI.result: 在 BDI-Sen 上评估证据检索、eRisk 2019–2021 上评估证据条件下的问卷推断：相比 SOTA 检索，帖子级 precision 相对提升 70%、F1 提升 59%，且保留帖子数至少少 30%；多症状句子上即使检索预算翻倍也优于稠密检索；三个 eRisk 集合上条目级完全一致率最高，序数和聚合指标具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 在推断抑郁问卷作答前，定位可归属证据并控制其构成是关键；SREE 验证了证据接地流程的有效性。

title: Elicitation of the parameters of a multi-criteria sorting model
comment: PhD Thesis defended at University of Mons, Belgium, July 07 2023. 216 pages https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12907/57144
summary: Multiple-criteria decision aiding (MCDA) proposes models and methods for different types of decision problems such as choice, ranking or sorting. Such models involve various parameters that must be elicited. In the elicitation process, all necessary information has to be taken from the decision-maker. For this, several direct and indirect elicitation methods are suggested in the literature. In this work, we concentrate on direct elicitation: we aim at providing a rigorous elicitation procedure for the parameters of the Non-Compensatory Sorting model (NCS), which has been characterized by an axiomatic analysis. A basic version of the NCS model is considered, i.e., a model with two categories and no vetoes. The parameters are the set of sufficient coalitions of criteria and the profile separating the two categories. Regarding the sufficient coalitions, we propose several questioning algorithms that engraft questions on classical graph exploration algorithms such as depth-first search. Such algorithms are implemented and evaluated by simulation. For eliciting the limit profile, we design a questioning algorithm using dichotomy. Questioning algorithms can be optimal in the worst case or on average. An optimal algorithm in the worst case has been proposed by Hansel in the framework of monotone Boolean functions. We implement and evaluate this algorithm as a variant of the depth-first search approaches. Regarding optimal questioning strategies on average, we evaluate decision trees for up to four criteria. On the other hand, we assess how more general is NCS as compared to MR-Sort, a particular case of the NCS model in which sufficient coalitions can be represented by additive weights.

AI.tldr: 本文为非补偿排序模型（NCS，两类别、无否决）提出严格的直接参数诱导（启发式提问）流程：对"充分准则联盟"用基于深度优先搜索的提问算法，对分界轮廓用二分法提问，并结合Hansel的最坏情况最优算法与平均最优决策树进行比较评估。
AI.motivation: MCDA模型含有大量参数需从决策者处诱导获得，而NCS模型的参数（充分联盟集合、分界轮廓）虽有公理化刻画，却缺乏严格、系统的直接诱导程序，因此需要设计并评估高效提问算法以尽量减少向决策者提问的数量。
AI.method: 1) 针对充分准则联盟，将提问嵌入经典图搜索算法（如深度优先搜索）构造多种提问算法；2) 针对分界轮廓，设计基于二分法的提问算法；3) 将Hansel在单调布尔函数框架下的最坏情况最优算法实现为DFS方法的变体；4) 对平均最优提问策略，在至多4个准则的情形下评估决策树；5) 通过仿真实现与评估各算法，并分析NCS相对MR-Sort（充分联盟可由加性权重表示的NCS特例）的推广程度。
AI.result: 基于DFS的提问算法与Hansel最坏情况最优算法均被实现并通过仿真评估；平均最优策略以决策树形式在至多4个准则下得到评估；同时刻画了NCS相对MR-Sort的推广程度。
AI.conclusion: 本文为NCS模型提供了一套完整的直接诱导提问方法（DFS类算法、Hansel最坏情况最优算法、二分法轮廓诱导及平均最优决策树），并通过仿真验证其效果，同时明确了NCS相较MR-Sort的一般性。

title: Oscillatory Processing Units as a computing substrate for biomimetic intelligence
comment: 39 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary Information included. Ancillary files: Supplementary Video 1 and source data
summary: Biological intelligence emerges from neural activity that connects sensation, memory and action. Synaptic plasticity, neuronal assemblies and oscillations provide principles for biomimetic computing, but translating them into reusable operations requires a defined computational unit. We introduce Oscillatory Processing Units (OPUs), groups of synthetic neurons sharing a rhythm. Their directed interactions transform incoming activity and prior receiving state into an Oscillatory Occupancy Space (OOS), which becomes available to subsequent computation. We show that source--receiver conditions and oscillatory organization shape these transformations, including their geometry, persistence and historical accessibility. An Atlas of measured relationships supports prospective composition with predicted response classes. Configured circuits perform logical and numerical operations, express associative recall and generate closed-loop decisions with fixed synaptic weights. OPUs and OOS establish a computing substrate for biomimetic intelligence in which experience remains part of the state through which new input becomes action.

AI.tldr: 提出振荡处理单元（OPUs）作为可复用的仿生计算单元，其定向相互作用将输入与接收状态映射为"振荡占据空间"（OOS），支持逻辑、数值运算、联想回忆与闭环决策。
AI.motivation: 生物智能源于连接感知、记忆与动作的神经活动，突触可塑性、神经元集群与振荡提供了仿生计算原理，但要将其转化为可复用操作，需要一个明确定义的计算单元。
AI.method: 引入OPUs——共享同一节律的合成神经元群。其定向相互作用把传入活动与先前的接收状态变换为振荡占据空间（OOS），供后续计算使用；分析源-接收条件与振荡组织对变换的几何、持续性和历史可及性的影响，并构建测量关系图谱（Atlas）以支持带预测响应类的前瞻性组合。
AI.result: 配置后的电路以固定突触权重完成逻辑与数值运算、表达联想回忆，并生成闭环决策；Atlas中的测量关系可预测组合后的响应类别。
AI.conclusion: OPUs与OOS构成面向仿生智能的计算基底，使经验成为状态的一部分，新输入经由该状态转化为动作。

title: Exploiting Feature-invariant Scaling Laws for Efficient A/B Experimentation in Recommendation Systems
summary: Researchers and engineers improve recommendation systems by performing A/B experiments with new model architectures, optimization methods, and data features. However, running full-scale experiments (e.g., full-model training with online data) for every feature change is prohibitively computationally intensive, while the result from a single small-scale experiment is often misleading. To address this challenge, we show that modern recommendation models exhibit feature-invariant scaling: the change of a model's performance follows a predictable scaling-law even when different feature changes are applied to the baseline model. We introduce an efficient method that exploits scaling-laws and uses statistical inference to predict (with confidence intervals) the full-scale effect of an A/B experiment in recommendation systems. This enables practitioners to efficiently filter out neutral or regressive feature changes with only small-scale experimentation. We validate our method on three distinct recommendation model families---Wukong, HSTU, and LLM-based recommendation models---across more than 40 architectural, optimization, and data changes. Our method accurately distinguishes beneficial feature changes from neutral and regressive ones while using only a fraction of the compute required for full-scale evaluation. It also identifies several changes that improve HSTU's state-of-the-art performance on MovieLens-20M. Our results demonstrate that scaling laws can be practically exploited to make compute-efficient decisions for improving industrial-scale recommendation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文发现现代推荐模型具有"特征不变的缩放律"，并提出一种结合统计推断的方法，仅用小规模A/B实验即可预测全尺度效果（带置信区间），从而高效过滤中性或退化的特征改动。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统中评估新特征（架构、优化、数据）需要全尺度A/B实验，计算开销巨大；而单次小规模实验的结果往往有误导性，缺少可靠的从小规模推广到全尺度的预测手段。
AI.method: 观察到推荐模型呈现"特征不变缩放律"：即使对基线模型施加不同特征改动，性能变化仍遵循可预测的缩放规律。基于此，利用缩放律加统计推断，从小规模实验结果预测全尺度A/B实验效果并给出置信区间。
AI.result: 在Wukong、HSTU和基于LLM的推荐模型三大模型族、40余种架构/优化/数据改动上验证，方法仅需全尺度评估所需算力的一小部分，即可准确区分有益、中性和退化的特征改动，并在MovieLens-20M上找到进一步超越HSTU SOTA性能的改动。
AI.conclusion: 缩放律可被实际利用，为工业级推荐系统的改进提供高算力效率的决策依据。

title: Möbius Interaction Filtering: Order-Selective Spectral Regularization for Multimodal Humor Detection
summary: Multimodal humor detection requires interpreting language, vocal delivery, and visual behavior jointly. Expressive fusion must also regulate how interactions of different orders enter the final judgment. We propose Möbius Interaction Filtering (MoIF), which learns a modality-subset prediction function and imposes order-selective spectral regularization through its aggregation structure. Private temporal encoders and balanced reciprocal interaction construct supervised unimodal, bimodal, and trimodal predictors. Their uniform aggregate is exactly a Möbius-domain filter with a geometrically decreasing interaction-order response. This formulation retains higher-order representations while regulating their contribution to prediction. Controlled UR-FUNNY perturbations reveal a pronounced decline in label-aligned signal-to-noise ratio across interaction orders. The induced filter improves the final ratio by 1.62-2.79 times relative to the co-trained trimodal predictor while preserving its own clean class-aligned signal under perturbation. Five-seed experiments achieve 70.6% accuracy and weighted F1 on UR-FUNNY, exceeding thirteen reproduced methods on these detection metrics. CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI evaluations establish applicability to sentiment prediction, and cross-seed analyses show more stable estimates on all three datasets. MoIF connects the organization of multimodal interactions to their statistical reliability through an executable spectral constraint. Code is available at https://github.com/D-ST-Sword/MoIF.

AI.tldr: 提出 Möbius 交互滤波（MoIF），用几何递减的交互阶响应正则化多模态幽默检测中的高阶交互贡献，在 UR-FUNNY 达 70.6% 准确率。
AI.motivation: 多模态幽默检测需联合语言、语音与视觉，但高阶模态交互未必可靠；需在保留高阶表示的同时调控其对最终判断的贡献。受控扰动实验显示阶数越高，标签对齐信噪比衰减越明显。
AI.method: 私有时间编码器 + 平衡互反交互构建有监督的单模态/双模态/三模态预测器；其均匀聚合在数学上等价于 Möbius 域滤波器，对交互阶呈几何递减响应，从而以可执行的谱约束实现阶选择性正则化。
AI.result: UR-FUNNY 上扰动条件下信噪比相对共训练三模态预测器提升 1.62–2.79 倍；五种子实验准确率与加权 F1 均 70.6%，超过 13 种复现方法；CMU-MOSI/MOSEI 上验证情感预测适用性，三数据集跨种子估计更稳定。
AI.conclusion: MoIF 将多模态交互的组织结构与统计可靠性联系起来，提供了可执行的频谱约束框架。

title: Specializing Meta Multi-Objectivization as Baseline for Software Engineering Optimization
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering (TSE)
summary: Given the discrete nature of many software engineering (SE) optimization problems, trapping at local optima remains a crucial issue in the optimizer designs. Meta Multi-Objectivization (MMO) is an optimization model for overcoming local optima by introducing an extra, auxiliary objective. Yet, MMO is originally designed only for configuration tuning, leaving its suitability for other SE problems in doubt, particularly regarding the choice of the auxiliary objective. In this paper, we study the possibility and resolution for specializing MMO as a general baseline across a range of SE optimization problems, making it a fundamental counterpart for future SE optimizers that seek to mitigate the issue of local optima. We do so by providing both theoretical remit and empirical evidence: we analytically show how the choice of the auxiliary objective is crucial while demonstrating the effectiveness of MMO under nine SE optimization problems comprising 212 cases when the right one can be chosen, i.e., MMO is able to outperform the other state-of-the-art and general-purpose optimizers in 79% and 94% of the cases, respectively. Drawing on the theoretical understanding and empirical findings, we then propose L2RAC, a tool that automatically recommends the best auxiliary objective choice for a given SE problem/case, hence helping to specialize MMO therein. Through extensive experiments, we reveal that, in general, L2RAC can more accurately rank the choice of auxiliary objective for MMO under a case than other guesses by up to 60%, saving as much as 99% of the cost that would otherwise be required to conduct trial-and-error when using MMO.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何将Meta Multi-Objectivization（MMO）从仅用于配置调优扩展为通用SE优化基线，理论证明辅助目标选择的关键性，实验验证MMO在9个SE问题212个案例中的有效性，并提出L2RAC工具自动推荐最佳辅助目标。
AI.motivation: SE优化问题具有离散性，易陷入局部最优。MMO通过引入辅助目标帮助跳出局部最优，但原设计仅针对配置调优，其适用性和辅助目标选择方式存疑。
AI.method: 同时提供理论论证与实证：分析辅助目标选择的重要性；在9个SE优化问题共212个案例上评估MMO；基于理论与实验发现提出L2RAC工具，自动为给定SE问题/案例推荐最佳辅助目标。
AI.result: 当选择合适辅助目标时，MMO在79%的案例中优于其他最先进优化器，在94%的案例中优于通用优化器。L2RAC相比其他猜测方法提升辅助目标排序准确率最多60%，节省试错成本最多99%。
AI.conclusion: MMO可被专门化为跨SE优化问题的通用基线，关键在于辅助目标的选择；L2RAC能有效自动推荐辅助目标，大幅降低试错成本，为未来缓解局部最优问题的SE优化器提供基础参照。

title: Predictive Surprise as Self-Grounding Concept Bottleneck for Interpretable Time Series
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Main Track, Poster
summary: Time-series classifiers deployed in risk-sensitive domains must be (1) accurate, (2) interpretable, and (3) able to abstain when evidence is weak. Existing methods do not deliver all 3 at once, and the obstacle is structural, rather than logistical. Meaningful temporal patterns cannot be defined without knowing segment boundaries, yet meaningful boundaries cannot be placed without knowing which patterns to expect. Existing approaches break this circularity by using fixed windows or expert-annotated vocabularies, thereby sacrificing at least one of the 3 properties. We introduce ConceptTime, which closes the loop through a single self-supervised signal. A frozen probabilistic forecaster predicts a distribution over the next observation at every timestep of the sequence. We call the mismatch between its prediction and the realized signal the predictive surprise. This signal both locates segment boundaries and characterizes each resulting segment through the forecaster. Segments are thus grounded by how they behaved relative to expectation, not by what they look like. These summaries cluster into a vocabulary of dynamical regimes that we call concepts. A lightweight head classifies from the concept sequence, and the distance to the nearest concept yields reliability by design. Across 17 public benchmarks, ConceptTime is competitive with state-of-the-art black-box accuracy, beats every interpretable baseline, and retains near-98% accuracy on Epilepsy with 1% of labels. It further remains competitive with softmax, prototype-distance, and SHAP/TimeX/TimeX++ on OOD detection and deletion faithfulness, without a single annotation, language model call, or domain expert. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sachithx/ConceptTime.git.

AI.tldr: ConceptTime 用「预测惊喜」这一自监督信号同时完成时间序列的分段与概念发现，从而在一次框架内兼顾准确性、可解释性与弃权能力，无需标注、语言模型或领域专家。
AI.motivation: 风险敏感领域的时间序列分类器需同时满足三点：准确、可解释、证据弱时能弃权。现有方法无法三者兼顾，且障碍是结构性的：定义有意义的时间模式需要知道分段边界，而放置有意义的边界又需知道预期有哪些模式（循环依赖）；固定窗口或专家标注词表等做法打破了循环，却牺牲了至少一项性质。
AI.method: 用冻结的概率预测器在每个时间步预测下一观测的分布，将预测与实际信号的失配称为「预测惊喜」；该信号既用于定位分段边界，又通过预测器刻画各片段的动力学行为（依据「相对预期的表现」而非「外观形态」）。这些摘要聚类成动力学模式的词表即「概念」；轻量分类头基于概念序列做分类，并以到最近概念的距离天然给出可靠性（弃权）。
AI.result: 在 17 个公开基准上，ConceptTime 的黑盒准确率与 SOTA 相当，优于所有可解释基线；在 Epilepsy 上仅用 1% 标签仍保持近 98% 准确率；在 OOD 检测与删除忠实性上与 softmax、原型距离及 SHAP/TimeX/TimeX++ 相当，且无需任何标注、语言模型调用或领域专家。
AI.conclusion: 通过在单一自监督信号中闭合「分段—模式」循环，ConceptTime 首次在无监督条件下统一了准确、可解释与可弃权三项要求，为风险敏感场景提供了实用的时间序列分类框架。

title: EarthRecord: From Pixels to Land Change with Multimodal Agents over Four Decades of Satellite Imagery
summary: While multimodal agents now carry out complex data analysis with tools, their ability to turn decades of satellite imagery into reliable land-change analysis, crucial for Earth observation science, remains unmeasured. Existing benchmarks fall short: they pose questions on curated images or give agents preprocessed inputs, leaving out the raw multi-sensor archives where such analysis begins. We introduce EarthRecord, a benchmark built on the raw record of 56 sites: four decades of Landsat, MODIS, VIIRS, and Sentinel-2 data, with cloud masking and cross-sensor harmonization left to the agent. It poses 238 land-change questions across ten analysis tasks, scored against withheld references from global products, agreement among methods, and visual interpretation. Two controls test what answers rest on: the closed book removes the record, and instrument pairs alter one satellite's data while nothing changes on the ground. Evaluations of twelve multimodal agents reveal that leading agents complete most analyses end to end but falter when an answer requires mapping from imagery. Further analysis shows that the record moves answers from prior knowledge to the pixels but not yet to the real change on the ground: when one satellite's data are altered, half of the right answers follow the alteration. EarthRecord thus provides a principled platform for measuring and advancing agents from pixels to land change.

AI.tldr: 提出 EarthRecord 基准，用 56 个站点四十年原始多传感器卫星影像评估多模态智能体的地表变化分析能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准用精选图像或预处理输入提问，无法衡量智能体从原始多传感器档案做可靠地表变化分析的能力（对地球观测科学至关重要）。
AI.method: 基于 Landsat、MODIS、VIIRS、Sentinel-2 四十年原始数据构建 56 站点基准，云掩膜与跨传感器协调交由智能体完成；设 238 道题、十类分析任务，参考答案来自全球产品、方法一致性与目视解译；并设"闭卷"（移除记录）与"仪器配对"（篡改单卫星数据而地面不变）两组对照。
AI.result: 十二个多模态智能体中，领先者可端到端完成多数分析，但在需要从影像映射出答案时失效；记录使答案从先验知识转向像素，却未真正落到地面变化——篡改单卫星数据后，一半正确答案随之改变。
AI.conclusion: EarthRecord 为衡量并推动智能体"从像素到地表变化"提供有原则的平台。

title: URL-Sim: Unified and Regulated LiDAR Simulation for High-Fidelity Reconstruction of Dynamic Driving Scenes
summary: Reconstructing high-fidelity LiDAR simulation scenes from real-world driving logs is essential for cost-effective safety validation of autonomous driving systems. While simulators based on Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) achieve realistic scene reconstruction, their large-scale adoption is limited by slow rendering speeds. Recent 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) approaches have improved rendering efficiency through explicit primitive representation and differentiable rasterization. However, existing 3DGS-based methods remain largely restricted to rigid vehicles and produce redundant primitives through unconstrained densification. To address these limitations, we propose URL-Sim, a unified and regulated dynamic LiDAR simulation framework. URL-Sim constructs a dynamic Gaussian scene graph that decouples the modeling of traffic participants, including vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists, enabling accurate reconstruction of heterogeneous dynamic objects within a single framework. It further introduces a regulated Gaussian densification strategy that ranks primitives with multi-dimensional importance scores and allocates Gaussians to the most critical regions while keeping the total primitive count bounded. Experiments on the Waymo and KITTI-360 datasets demonstrate that URL-Sim achieves higher quantitative accuracy and visual quality than existing baselines under comparable primitive budgets, and accurately recovers the geometry and poses of diverse dynamic traffic participants.

AI.tldr: URL-Sim是一个统一且受调控的动态LiDAR仿真框架，基于3D高斯泼溅构建动态高斯场景图并引入规范化稠密化策略，在Waymo和KITTI-360上以有限图元预算实现更高精度和视觉质量的重建。
AI.motivation: 从真实驾驶日志重建高保真LiDAR场景对自动驾驶低成本安全验证至关重要。NeRF类仿真器渲染慢，现有3DGS方法多局限于刚性车辆，且无约束稠密化产生冗余图元。
AI.method: 提出URL-Sim：构建动态高斯场景图，解耦车辆、行人、骑行者等交通参与者的建模，在单一框架内重建异构动态物体；并引入规范化高斯稠密化策略，用多维重要性分数对图元排序，将高斯分配到最关键区域并约束图元总数。
AI.result: 在Waymo和KITTI-360数据集上，相比现有基线，在相近图元预算下取得更高的定量精度与视觉质量，并能准确恢复多种动态交通参与者的几何与位姿。
AI.conclusion: URL-Sim为动态LiDAR仿真提供了统一、高效的解决方案，兼顾异构动态目标建模与图元预算控制，具备良好的实用价值。

title: Rethinking in Spikes: Mitigating Hallucinations in MDLMs with Step-Aware Decoding
summary: Recent advancements in multimodal diffusion language models (MDLMs) have exhibited strong global modeling capabilities through iterative refinement. We observe that mask uncertainty follows an overall downward trend during iterative denoising, while a few denoising steps exhibit localized entropy spikes closely associated with hallucinations. We argue that anomalous steps can be identified by measuring the entropy deviation of each denoising step from its neighboring temporal window. We hypothesize that discrete token commitment discards the distributional information at masked positions, limiting the continued interaction between candidate semantics and the context during entropy spikes. With this goal, we present StepRefine, a plug-and-play decoding strategy that leverages semantic context to achieve reliable denoising. The core of our method lies in a step-aware switch between discrete denoising and latent refinement. The model employs probability-weighted embeddings at entropy spike steps to preserve diverse reasoning hypotheses and performs multiple rounds of continuous refinement. Meanwhile, a refinement controller monitors distributional stability to reduce unnecessary loops and switch the model back to standard discrete denoising. Through extensive experiments, StepRefine demonstrates significant hallucination mitigation across different MDLMs on multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: StepRefine：一种即插即用的解码策略，在多模态扩散语言模型去噪过程中，于熵突增的异常步骤切换到概率加权嵌入的连续隐空间精炼，从而缓解幻觉。
AI.motivation: 观察到掩码不确定性在迭代去噪中整体下降，但少数步骤出现局部熵尖峰，且与幻觉高度相关；作者认为离散token提交丢弃了掩码位置的分布信息，阻碍了候选语义与上下文的持续交互。
AI.method: 通过测量每一步熵相对邻近时间窗口的偏差来识别异常步骤；核心是步骤感知的开关：在熵尖峰步骤采用概率加权嵌入保留多样推理假设，并进行多轮连续精炼，同时用精炼控制器监测分布稳定性，减少不必要循环并切回标准离散去噪。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准与不同MDLM上进行大量实验，显著缓解了幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 将离散去噪与潜在精炼按步自适应切换，可作为通用的解码插件有效降低多模态扩散语言模型的幻觉，且无需修改模型本身。

title: Tailoring Optimization Approaches with Domain Knowledge in Industry Process for Meta-heuristic Development
summary: The paper presents an Industry Process for Meta-heuristic Development (IPMD) schema, a systematic methodology for applying meta- and hyper-heuristic applications to optimization problems. In this context, we present a case study of Balancing Non-dominated Tournament Genetic Programming (BNTGP) applied to solve two NP-hard multi-objective optimization problems: routing (Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows) and scheduling (Multi-Skill Resource Constrained Project Scheduling Problem). The BNTGP method is based on a metaheuristic design. Its genetic programming-based representation makes BNTGP a hyper-heuristic, as it enables the exploration of a search space of heuristics for solving problems in general. The resulting heuristic can then be applied across a set of problem instances.

AI.tldr: 提出IPMD框架（工业级元启发式开发流程），并以平衡非支配锦标赛遗传规划BNTGP为案例，求解VRPTW与MS-RCPSP两个NP难多目标问题。
AI.motivation: 元启发式与超启发式的应用开发缺乏系统化方法，难以将算法有效迁移到实际工业优化问题中。
AI.method: 提出IPMD（Industry Process for Meta-heuristic Development）模式作为系统化方法论；以BNTGP为例，其基于遗传规划的表示方式在元启发式设计之上构成超启发式，可搜索启发式空间并生成可跨实例复用的启发式。
AI.result: 在路径规划（带时间窗的容量车辆路径问题）与调度（多技能资源受限项目调度问题）两个NP难多目标问题上完成了案例验证。
AI.conclusion: IPMD为元/超启发式开发提供可复用的工业流程，BNTGP展示了超启发式生成可泛化启发式并在多类问题实例上应用的可行性。

title: Auditing LLM Pseudo-Label Distillation for Review Informativeness at E-Commerce Scale
summary: We study hard-label distillation from Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite to compact encoders on 5.34 million Turkish marketplace reviews. A strict new-SKU temporal test measures teacher fidelity; a separate, teacher-label-blind audit by one company annotator measures editorial agreement. An H3 category prefix slightly improves teacher fidelity on the full new-SKU test. On the 16,000-review chronological audit subset, it instead reduces agreement with both Gemini and the annotator, with a clearer paired difference for CORN than for cross entropy. Thus the context effect depends on the evaluation population, and teacher fidelity alone does not establish editorial alignment. Under the measured offline configurations, a single-L4 student pipeline processes reviews 50.2 times faster than the teacher pipeline.

AI.tldr: 研究从 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 到紧凑编码器的硬标签蒸馏，发现 H3 类别前缀的效果依赖评测人群：在全量新SKU测试集上略微提升教师保真度，但在16,000条按时间排序的人工审计子集上反而降低与 Gemini 及标注员的一致性，说明教师保真度不等于编辑对齐。
AI.motivation: 探究在土耳其电商评论场景下蒸馏小型模型的可行性，并检验"教师保真度"能否作为对齐质量的可靠代理指标；同时考察上下文（H3 类别前缀）对蒸馏效果的影响。
AI.method: 在 534 万条土耳其市场评论上做从 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 到紧凑编码器的硬标签蒸馏。采用严格的新SKU时间切分测试集衡量教师保真度；另设由单一公司标注员完成、对教师标签盲的审计（16,000 条按时间排序）衡量编辑一致性。比较 H3 类别前缀的有无，并对比 CORN 与交叉熵损失。
AI.result: H3 前缀在全量新SKU测试上略提升教师保真度；但在16,000条审计子集上同时降低与 Gemini 和标注员的一致性，且 CORN 的配对差异比交叉熵更明显。单张 L4 的学生流水线处理速度约为教师流水线的 50.2 倍。
AI.conclusion: 上下文效应取决于评测人群，教师保真度单独无法确立编辑对齐，需引入独立盲审计评估；在测得的离线配置下，学生流水线可获得约50倍加速。

title: One Rater to Score Them All: Frozen Large Language Model Anchoring for Video Quality of Experience
summary: Quality of Experience results for video streaming cannot be compared across studies, because public databases share neither test material nor subjects. This work introduces a common reference rater: an open-weights large language models with a fixed rubric and greedy decoding that scores the delivery events of every session and supplies the shared items that score equating requires. The rater is used without training, and it reads only the playback event log of startup delay, stalls and quality switches, which most delivery databases retain even when they share nothing else. A monotonic curve then maps each study's native scale onto the common scale. On 3{,}552 sessions from four studies covering four rating scales, the rater attains a Spearman correlation of 0.809 on VL04 of the ITU-T P.1203 collection, exceeding P.1203 mode~0 on the same sessions, with a Krippendorff alpha of 0.974 over repeated scoring and 0.951 across three serving providers. Sessions from three further laboratories give correlations from 0.756 to 0.787. After calibration, the four studies are placed on a single 0 to 100 scale with a held-out error between 7.8 and 13.3 points, and a mean VMAF of 60 corresponds to positions 17 points apart in two of the studies.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用一个开放权重的LLM作为“共同参照评分者”，只读取回放事件日志为会话打分，从而把不同研究的QoE结果通过分数等化映射到统一0–100量表，实现跨研究可比。
AI.motivation: 视频流QoE结果难以跨研究比较：公开数据库既不共享测试素材也不共享被试，缺乏共同锚点或共同条目来进行分数等化。
AI.method: 采用固定评分细则(greedy decoding)的开放权重LLM，不经训练，仅输入启动延迟、卡顿和清晰度切换等播放事件日志，为每个会话打分，提供分数等化所需的共同条目；再用单调曲线将各研究原生量表映射到公共量表。在4项研究共3,552个会话、4种量表上评估，另用3个实验室的数据检验泛化。
AI.result: 在ITU-T P.1203集合的VL04上Spearman相关0.809，超过P.1203 mode 0；重复评分Krippendorff alpha=0.974，跨3个服务商alpha=0.951；另外三实验室相关0.756–0.787；校准后保留集误差7.8–13.3分，平均VMAF=60在两研究中位置相差17分。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭普遍留存的事件日志，LLM参照评分者可作为跨数据库的共同锚点，通过校准实现QoE的跨研究可比。

title: Just AI Governance and the Forbidden-Boundary Principle
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly shapes consequential decisions, yet predictive accuracy is not a sufficient justification for delegated authority. This conceptual study develops an integrated framework for assessing just AI across normative, data, model, and governance layers. Drawing on plural theories of justice, sociotechnical fairness research, and publicly available governance standards, it maps six justice requirements to observable evidence, decision rights, and remedies. It proposes a two-stage evaluation rule: exclude uses that fail independently justified minimum rights constraints, then compare eligible alternatives across multiple performance and governance criteria. As an explicitly limited normative analogy, Genesis chapter 2 motivates a Forbidden-Boundary Principle (FBP), under which an AI agent must not execute externally consequential actions outside pre-authorized boundaries. The resulting First-Principle Safe-Stop Protocol (FPSSP) comprises an independently governed policy monitor, a mandatory execution gate, a restricted or alternative safe-state controller, immutable-oriented audit trails, and accountable human authorization for recovery. We distinguish this normative and traceability contribution from existing Simplex and runtime assurance architectures; we do not claim a novel safety switch or formal proof of universal ethical compliance. A policy schema, threat model, test matrix, outcome definitions, and a prospective comparison design make the proposal falsifiable. No FPSSP implementation, experimental dataset, numerical improvement, or verified latency bound is reported. The framework supports future evaluation rather than constituting evidence of operational safety.

AI.tldr: 该概念性研究提出一个跨规范、数据、模型与治理四层的"公正AI"评估框架，把六项正义要求映射到可观测证据、决策权与救济措施，并提出两阶段评估规则；同时以《创世纪》第2章为有限类比，提出"禁界原则"(FBP)与"第一性原理安全停机协议"(FPSSP)，作为可被检验的规范与可追溯性贡献。
AI.motivation: AI日益参与高后果决策，但预测准确性不足以为其被授予的决策权提供正当性；现有公平性/技术社会研究与治理标准相互分散，缺少将规范正义要求与可观测证据、治理机制整合起来的评估框架，也缺少对AI代理越界行动的边界约束与安全停机机制的规范性论述。
AI.method: 概念性研究。综合多元正义理论、社会技术公平研究与公开治理标准，构建四层（规范/数据/模型/治理）整合框架，将六项正义要求映射到证据、决策权与救济；提出两阶段评估规则：先剔除违反独立证成的最低权利约束的用途，再在合格方案间按多维度性能与治理标准比较。借助《创世纪》第2章作为明确受限的规范类比，导出禁界原则(FBP)，并据此设计FPSSP，包括独立治理的策略监视器、强制执行闸门、受限/替代安全状态控制器、不可篡改导向的审计轨迹与可问责的人类授权恢复；并给出策略模式、威胁模型、测试矩阵、结果定义与前瞻性比较设计。
AI.result: 形成了一套可被证伪的框架与协议设计：明确区分于既有Simplex与运行时保证架构，作者不主张新颖的安全开关或普适伦理合规的形式化证明；文中未报告任何FPSSP实现、实验数据集、数值改进或经验证的时延界，故其成果是支持未来评估的方法论，而非运行安全的证据。
AI.conclusion: 该框架的价值在于规范性与可追溯性贡献及可检验的设计方案，可作为后续实证评估的起点；但在获得实现、实验数据、时延与安全验证之前，不能作为AI系统运行安全的证据。

title: ADIndex: Layer-Adaptive Sparse Attention Indexing via Group-Level Distillation
summary: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) reduces the computational cost of attention through token-level selection. However, its indexer still scores the entire causal prefix for each query, making indexing a dominant source of latency in long-context inference. Notably, the indexer alone can account for more than 50% of total prefill GPU time at long context lengths. To address this bottleneck, we propose ADIndex, an Adaptive and Distillation-driven Indexing method for token-level sparse attention. ADIndex integrates three key components: (i) a layer-wise calibration strategy that adaptively accommodates cross-query retrieval overlap, motivated by our observation of pronounced inter-layer heterogeneity; (ii) a group-level distillation scheme that leverages this heterogeneity to efficiently train adaptive layer-wise group indexers, capturing salient retrieval signals from individual queries; and (iii) a low-latency inference strategy that reduces repeated full-prefix scans through token bank sharing within query groups while retaining query-specific refinement. Experiments on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1 demonstrate that ADIndex preserves near-lossless task performance on LongBench, LongBench v2, and RULER while delivering substantial efficiency gains over standard DSA, including prefill and decoding kernel speedups of up to 6.22x and 3.40x, respectively, at a context length of 256K across the layer-wise reuse configurations, as well as an end-to-end serving speedup of 1.54x at a context length of 128K.

AI.tldr: ADIndex 针对 DeepSeek Sparse Attention 的索引器在全前缀打分上的瓶颈，提出自适应、蒸馏驱动的分层索引方法，在保持性能近无损的同时大幅提升长上下文推理效率。
AI.motivation: DSA 的索引器对每个 query 仍需扫描整个因果前缀，导致索引成为长上下文推理的主要延迟来源，长文本下索引器可占 prefill GPU 时间 50% 以上。
AI.method: 三个组件：(i) 分层校准策略，基于观察到的明显层间异质性自适应处理跨查询检索重叠；(ii) 组级蒸馏方案，训练自适应的分层组索引器，捕捉单查询的显著检索信号；(iii) 低延迟推理策略，通过查询组内 token bank 共享减少重复全前缀扫描，同时保留查询级细化。
AI.result: 在 DeepSeek-V3.2 与 GLM-5.1 上，LongBench、LongBench v2、RULER 任务性能近无损；256K 上下文下 prefill 与 decoding 内核最高加速 6.22x 和 3.40x；128K 下端到端服务加速 1.54x。
AI.conclusion: ADIndex 有效缓解了 token 级稀疏注意力的索引瓶颈，在保持任务表现的同时实现显著的长上下文推理与部署效率提升。

title: Train on prefill, monitor at decode: Using sparse autoencoders for topic monitoring
summary: Topic monitoring is the task of labelling the topic of each token in a model's response during generation. Activation-based monitors that run at generation time have so far been trained to detect harmful content and are limited to two or three classes. We introduce TopicScope, a framework for training causal topic classifiers on SAE features that assign a topic to every token, so that the label can change partway through a response. We train three detector architectures on synthetic multi-topic conversations covering seven topics. Across Gemma-3 1B and 4B, monitors trained on features extracted from prefill hidden states were able to generalise to decoding. We also found that the classifiers are robust to perturbations, losing at most 5 macro-F1 points when off-topic asides are inserted, topics are removed or sections are reordered. Ablations conducted to understand the contribution of the SAE revealed that classifiers reaching baseline performance without it were several times larger. Our findings show that compact topic monitors can be trained inexpensively in prefill and deployed during generation. More broadly, our work shows where SAEs are useful beyond safety classification. Our code, dataset and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mercity-AI/SAE-Guardrails and https://huggingface.co/collections/Mercity/online-guardrails-using-sparse-autoencoders-6ac602940468c62fefb2b9e8

AI.tldr: 提出 TopicScope 框架，在 SAE 特征上训练因果（逐 token）主题分类器，实现生成时的多类别主题监控，并证明其可在 prefill 阶段训练、解码阶段部署。
AI.motivation: 现有生成时激活监控器只针对有害内容、类别仅2-3类，且为句子级标签；缺乏细粒度、多类别、可随生成过程变化的主题监控能力。
AI.method: 构建合成多主题对话数据集（7个主题），从 SAE 特征中提取表示，训练三种检测器架构进行逐 token 主题分类；在 Gemma-3 1B 与 4B 上对比 prefill 与 decoding 隐藏状态，并做扰动鲁棒性测试与 SAE 消融实验。
AI.result: 基于 prefill 隐藏状态的监控器能泛化到解码阶段；扰动下最多损失5个 macro-F1；无 SAE 达到同等性能所需模型规模大数倍。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的主题监控器可低成本在 prefill 训练并部署于生成时；扩展了 SAE 除安全分类之外的用途。

title: Evaluation protocols for historical script classification: the cost of manuscript-level leakage and the role of soft labels
summary: A paleographer applies a script type classifier to unseen manuscripts. We measure how much testing on other pages of training manuscripts inflates accuracy. On VML-HP-ext (715 pages, 171 Hebrew manuscripts, 14 script classes) we compare page-level and manuscript-level splits. Page-level accuracy drops from 97% to 54% (59% at manuscript level), and is 39% on the official blind test set. The gap of 40 to 47 percentage points (pp) at patch, page and manuscript level is statistically significant and reproduces with ResNet18; on binarized patches (ink and background only) it is 34 to 42 pp, also significant. On unseen manuscripts the model is overconfident: mean confidence 70% against 54% correct pages; patch-level expected calibration error (ECE, mean gap between confidence and accuracy) rises from 0.065 to 0.444. Binarization leaves patch-level overconfidence but cuts it markedly at page level. Confidence still helps triage: in the more confident half of pages 67% are correct, 41% in the rest. Training on expert soft labels showed no evidence of an accuracy difference, though a small page-level loss cannot be ruled out. The predicted distributions are closer to the expert's assessment. ECE is lower at patch level (0.21 to 0.31) and in most runs at page level, but not significantly at manuscript level. Label smoothing (blurring the label, no expert input) also lowers ECE but comes no closer to the expert. Temperature scaling (post-training confidence correction) helps significantly only at patch level. On 97 pages of 16 manuscripts with mixed expert assessment, soft labels cut divergence from the expert by 22 to 30% (significant in four of five runs); the point estimate of accuracy is 16.5 to 23.7 pp below hard labels, but with 16 manuscripts the loss can neither be confirmed nor ruled out. We propose recommendations for the evaluation protocol; code will be released with the paper

AI.tldr: 古文字学手稿分类中，页级划分严重高估准确率（97%→54%），模型在未见手稿上过度自信，专家软标签可改善校准但准确性存疑。
AI.motivation: 作者想量化一个实际问题：在训练手稿的其他页面（同一手稿）上测试会高估古文字分类器准确率，并考察模型在未见手稿上的校准与置信度问题，进而检验专家软标签能否改善。
AI.method: 在 VML-HP-ext（715页、171份希伯来手稿、14种书写类型）上对比页面级与手稿级划分；分别测量批次/页面/手稿级准确率差距并复现于 ResNet18 与二值化图像；用 ECE 评估校准；对比专家软标签、标签平滑、温度缩放三类方法。
AI.result: 页面级准确率 97%→54%（手稿级 59%），官方盲测 39%；各层级差距 40–47pp 且显著，二值化下 34–42pp 仍显著。未见手稿上过度自信（置信 70% vs 正确 54%，批次级 ECE 0.065→0.444）。专家软标签无准确率差异证据但预测分布更接近专家（在 97 页混合评估样本上差异降低 22–30%），冷样本批次级 ECE 降至 0.21–0.31；标签平滑亦降 ECE 但不更接近专家；温度缩放仅批次级显著有效。<!-- confidence still helps triage：置信高的半数页 67% 正确 -->
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了手稿分类评估中的严重划分泄露与校准问题，提出更严格的评估协议建议，并认为专家软标签在校准与贴近专家判断上占优，但其准确性代价因样本量不足尚不能定论。

title: TimeOmni-o1: Bidirectionally Coupling Time Series Foundation Models and LLMs for Multimodal Reasoning and Forecasting
summary: Time series from real-world systems are often accompanied by text, such as a report on an event that affects them. Two common tasks on these series are understanding, e.g., answering questions about a series, and forecasting its future values. Both tasks require reasoning over the series and the text together. Moreover, understanding outputs text while forecasting outputs a time series, so serving both requires a model that reads and generates both modalities. Large language models (LLMs) read time series as digit tokens and handle long series poorly. Time series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast well from large-scale pretraining but typically neither read nor generate text. Time series language models add a time series modality to the LLM but forecast on the LLM side, leaving the TSFM's pretrained forecasting ability unused. We present TimeOmni-o1, which couples a pretrained TSFM and an LLM bidirectionally. In one direction, the TSFM encodes the series in compressed form for the LLM, which reasons over it together with the text. In the other, the LLM's reasoning is fed back into the TSFM, which produces the forecast conditioned on it. One model architecture thus reads and generates both series and text, reasons in text, and draws on the TSFM's pretrained forecasting ability. To train it, we build MMTR, a multimodal time series reasoning dataset with annotated reasoning traces, covering both tasks across 12 domains with 500k+ samples. On MMTR, TimeOmni-o1 outperforms existing models on both understanding and forecasting across most domains, as well as the LLM and the TSFM inside it when used individually. The gains carry over to three open benchmarks, where it outperforms the dedicated time series models.

AI.tldr: TimeOmni-o1 将预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）与 LLM 双向耦合：TSFM 压缩编码序列供 LLM 推理，LLM 的推理结果再反馈给 TSFM 进行条件预测，并用 50 万+ 样本的 MMTR 多模态推理数据集训练，在理解与预测任务上多数领域超越现有模型。
AI.motivation: 真实系统的时间序列常配有文本（如事件报告），理解（问答）与预测两类任务都需要对序列和文本联合推理，且分别输出文本与序列。LLM 将序列读作数字 token，难以处理长序列；TSFM 预测强但既不能读也不能生成文本；现有时间序列语言模型虽加入序列模态，却在 LLM 侧预测，浪费了 TSFM 的预训练预测能力。
AI.method: 提出 TimeOmni-o1，双向耦合预训练 TSFM 与 LLM：TSFM 将序列编码为压缩表示供 LLM 与文本联合推理；LLM 的推理再反馈给 TSFM，作为条件生成预测。单一架构即可读写序列与文本、以文本推理，并利用 TSFM 预训练预测能力。同时构建 MMTR 数据集（含标注推理轨迹，覆盖 12 个领域、两类任务、50 万+ 样本）。
AI.result: 在 MMTR 上，TimeOmni-o1 在大多数领域的理解与预测任务上优于现有模型，也优于其内部单独使用的 LLM 与 TSFM；在三个公开基准上同样超越专用时间序列模型。
AI.conclusion: 双向耦合 TSFM 与 LLM 能在保留预训练预测能力的同时实现跨模态推理，是一种兼顾理解与预测的有效统一架构。

title: Controlled Knowledge Engineering for Taxonomy Induction with Tool-Grounded LLM Agents and Runtime-Adaptive Policies
comment: Submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems. Code: https://github.com/bschaarmann/TIGA
summary: Taxonomies are structured knowledge representations that support semantic search, recommendation, product catalog organization, and retrieval-augmented generation. Their automated construction from a fixed set of candidate entities requires more than plausible text generation: the resulting hierarchy must be complete, structurally valid, and semantically coherent. Large Language Models (LLMs) are promising for this task, but iterative free-form generation remains vulnerable to omitted or hallucinated entities, invalid hierarchical relations, and inconsistent organizational principles. We introduce TIGA (Taxonomy Induction with Tool-Grounded Agents), a knowledge-engineering architecture that formulates taxonomy induction as an iterative decision process over an explicit state and constrained action space. TIGA combines executable taxonomy-editing tools, an memory that records tool calls, rationales, and outcomes, and a runtime-adaptive organizational policy that the agent revises during inference. An optional global reviewer evaluates the constructed taxonomy against the candidate set and the active policy. We evaluate TIGA on four benchmark taxonomies using two LLM backbones and compare it with single-shot and iterative prompting-based baselines. TIGA achieves the strongest structural-quality results in most evaluated configurations, but does not dominate on every precision measure. The gains are accompanied by substantially higher token consumption, API-call volume, and inference time. Ablation results show consistent benefits from the policy and interaction-memory components, whereas the effect of global review depends on the dataset and the available revision budget. These findings characterize tool grounding and runtime policy adaptation as promising but costly mechanisms for improving the controlled construction of structured knowledge representations.

AI.tldr: TIGA 将分类体系归纳建模为对显式状态与受限动作空间的迭代决策过程，结合可执行编辑工具、交互记忆与运行时自适应组织策略，在多数配置下取得最优结构质量，但代价是更高的 token、API 调用与推理时间。
AI.motivation: 从固定候选实体自动构建分类体系不能只靠"看起来合理的文本生成"：结果必须完整、结构合法、语义连贯；而 LLM 的迭代自由生成易出现实体遗漏或幻觉、非法层级关系和前后不一致的组织原则。
AI.method: 提出 TIGA（Taxonomy Induction with Tool-Grounded Agents）：用可执行的分类体系编辑工具、记录工具调用/理由/结果的交互记忆、推理过程中自我修订的运行时自适应组织策略，并可选引入全局 reviewer 依据候选集与当前策略审查结果；在 4 个基准分类体系、2 个 LLM 骨干上，与单轮和迭代提示基线对比，并做消融实验。
AI.result: 在大多数评测配置中取得最强结构质量，但并非在所有精确率指标上都占优；增益伴随显著更高的 token 消耗、API 调用量和推理时间。消融显示策略与交互记忆带来稳定收益，全局审查的效果依赖数据集和可用修订预算。
AI.conclusion: 工具接地与运行时策略自适应是提升结构化知识受控构建的有前景但成本较高的机制。

title: YTShorts-92K: An Interpretable Multimodal Dataset of YouTube Shorts
summary: Short-form video has become one of the dominant formats of online content, yet large-scale datasets enabling the analysis of what makes these videos successful remain limited. Existing resources often focus on post-publication popularity signals or rely on non-interpretable representations such as high-dimensional embeddings. Here, we introduce YTShorts-92K, a dataset of 92,654 YouTube Shorts collected from 345 creators and spanning 12 manually defined content categories. Each video is enriched with an interpretable multimodal feature set covering metadata, textual information, visual characteristics from frames and thumbnails, and cross-modal consistency measures. We describe the collection methodology, data cleaning process, and feature extraction pipeline, followed by descriptive analyses of the diversity of creators, topics, and extracted features. This dataset offers a reusable resource for studying short-form video content, online attention, and multimodal content analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出YTShorts-92K数据集，包含92,654个来自345位创作者的YouTube Shorts，覆盖12个内容类别，并为每个视频提供可解释的多模态特征集，用于短视频内容分析与在线注意力研究。
AI.motivation: 短视频已成为主流在线内容形式，但支持大规模分析"何种视频成功"的数据集仍然有限。现有资源多聚焦于发布后的流行度信号，或依赖高维嵌入等不可解释的表征，缺乏可解释的多模态特征资源。
AI.method: 构建YTShorts-92K数据集：从345位创作者采集92,654个YouTube Shorts，人工划分12个内容类别；为每个视频提取可解释的多模态特征，涵盖元数据、文本信息、帧与封面图片的视觉特征，以及跨模态一致性度量。文中描述了采集方法、数据清洗流程和特征提取管线，并对创作者、主题及特征的多样性进行描述性分析。
AI.result: 提供一个覆盖多创作者、多主题、具备可解释多模态特征的大规模短视频数据集，并通过描述性分析展示其在创作者、主题和特征层面的多样性。
AI.conclusion: YTShorts-92K可作为可复用资源，用于研究短视频内容、在线注意力及多模态内容分析。

title: Compile-Gated Lean Proof Refactoring with Enterprise Agent Practices: A Model per Step under a US\$3 Cap, Followed by Programmatic Rewrite Rules
comment: 20 pages. Technical report of team Vexorium-Agent for the closed track of the Lean Refactor Arena, a competition at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding
summary: Our closed-track entry (Arena username Vexorium-Agent) scored 86.31 points on the final board (L = 77.07, H = 81.86, Z = 100) over the 60 final problems, against 33.33 for the reference proofs, 8th at the deadline (top: 92.57), for US\$166.33 at list prices with every call counted (per problem: mean US\$2.772, at most US\$2.874; US\$3 cap). Three practices carry the entry. First, each paid stage runs the model that measured best per dollar for it among the 9 we tested in our own harness: GPT-6.1 Sol the early sessions, GPT-6.1 Terra the later ones and the tail at 70% of Sol's cost per turn, and Gemini 4 Argon the review and repair; Sol also runs the style rewrite. Second, what our development and research runs learned ships as compiler-checked programmatic rewrite rules rather than prompt text (+0.93 points from rules fixed before the release; +0.26 and +0.30, in sample, from passes built or switched on after the release). Third, every call is recorded and reviewed before each change (all 9 board scores came within -0.063 to +0.015 points of our meter's prediction). The harness, gate and many of these rules also serve our open-track entry. We report the full bill and the spread of three runs.

AI.tldr: Vexorium-Agent 在形式化数学基准的封闭赛道最终榜获 86.31 分（L=77.07, H=81.86, Z=100），60 题共花费 166.33 美元，排名第 8（榜首 92.57）。其核心是三件事：按"每美元表现"为每个付费阶段挑选不同模型、将研发中学到的经验固化为编译器可校验的程序化重写规则而非提示词，以及对每次调用做记录与审计以实现可预测的分数。
AI.motivation: 在受限预算（每题 3 美元上限）下取得高形式化数学证明成绩，同时避免依赖脆弱、不可复现的提示词调优；需要一个成本可控、分数可预测、经验可沉淀复用的智能体流水线。
AI.method: 1) 分阶段模型路由：在自建测试台评测 9 个模型，按性价比分配——早期用 GPT-6.1 Sol、后期与尾部用成本为 Sol 每轮 70% 的 GPT-6.1 Terra、审查与修复用 Gemini 4 Argon，Sol 另负责风格重写；2) 将开发与研究中的发现写成编译器检查的程序化重写规则（而非提示文本）；3) 对每次调用记录并在每次改动前复盘，用自建计分器预测分数。
AI.result: 最终榜 86.31 分（L=77.07, H=81.86, Z=100），参考证明为 33.33 分，截止时排名第 8（榜首 92.57）。60 题总花费 166.33 美元（按标价、计全部调用），每题均值 2.772 美元、最高 2.874 美元，未超 3 美元上限。规则贡献：发布前修复的规则 +0.93 分；发布后构建或启用的两轮 pass 分别为样本内 +0.26 与 +0.30 分。可预测性：9 次榜单成绩与计分器预测偏差在 -0.063 至 +0.015 分之间。另报告三次运行的分数离散度。
AI.conclusion: 在严格成本约束下，性价比导向的按阶段模型路由、编译器校验的程序化重写规则、以及全量调用审计与分数预测，构成了一套低成本、高可预测性的形式化数学智能体方案；同一测试台、门控与规则也复用于其公开赛道参赛作品。

title: Exploration via Exploitation: The Blessing of Reward Diversity in Personalized Federated RL
summary: While federated reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally guaranteed high efficiency in homogeneous environments, collaboration is often hindered when agents possess distinct goals. In this paper, we flip this paradigm, framing reward heterogeneity not as a hurdle to consensus, but as a structural asset that catalyzes exploration. We first propose Personalized Federated Upper Confidence Bound Value Iteration (PF-UCBVI), which achieves optimal linear speedup by decoupling shared dynamics from personalized objectives. To eliminate the risks of explicit exploration, we then introduce Personalized Federated Exploration-Free Value Iteration (PF-EFVI), a purely greedy algorithm that leverages reward diversity to ensure state-action coverage. We prove that PF-EFVI attains logarithmic regret without explicit exploration bonuses under sufficient reward diversity. Our results reveal that agent disagreement shifts the exploration burden from temporal complexity to spatial diversity, enabling efficient collective learning without explicit exploration.

AI.tldr: 该论文把联邦强化学习中智能体奖励异质性从"共识障碍"重新解读为"探索资源"，提出PF-UCBVI（解耦共享动态与个性化目标，达到最优线性加速）与PF-EFVI（纯贪心、无显式探索）两种算法，并在奖励多样性充分时证明PF-EFVI无需探索奖励即可获得对数级遗憾。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦强化学习在异构环境（智能体目标不同）中协作受阻，通常视奖励异质性为负面因素。作者希望反转这一视角：将奖励异质性视为能促进探索的结构性资产，从而在无显式探索的情况下实现高效集体学习。
AI.method: 先提出个性化联邦上置信界值迭代（PF-UCBVI），将共享动态与个性化目标解耦；再提出个性化联邦无探索值迭代（PF-EFVI），一种纯贪心算法，依靠奖励多样性保证状态-动作覆盖，不使用显式探索奖励。
AI.result: PF-UCBVI实现最优线性加速；PF-EFVI在奖励多样性充分条件下，无需显式探索奖励即达到对数级遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 智能体间的目标分歧把探索负担从时间维度转移到空间多样性上，使得无需显式探索也能实现高效的集体学习。

title: LandslideFM: A Foundation Model Towards Unified Landslide Perception and Understanding
summary: Intelligent landslide detection is essential for disaster prevention. However, existing models primarily focus on isolated visual tasks, require extensive labeled data, and lack deep analytical and scene-understanding capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose LandslideFM, the first unified foundation model that connects visual perception tasks with contextual interpretation of landslides. Specifically, LandslideFM adapts to multiple visual tasks via a Source-Agreement Graduated Trust semi-supervised learning framework that leverages limited labeled data alongside abundant unlabeled data. Furthermore, predicted landslide regions provide explicit spatial guidance to a Vision-Language Model adapted through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, enabling comprehensive landslide reasoning. To support training and evaluation in this domain, we also present LandslideVL, the first benchmark for intelligent landslide analysis, combining visual imagery and newly introduced textual prompts. Comprehensive experiments across public datasets and LandslideVL demonstrate that LandslideFM achieves superior quantitative and qualitative performance. Most importantly, LandslideFM surpasses general-purpose VLMs in specialized landslide reasoning and scene analysis. Our code is released at https://github.com/wangshanwen001/LandslideFM.

AI.tldr: 提出LandslideFM，首个将滑坡视觉感知与上下文推理统一的滑坡基础模型，并发布首个滑坡智能分析基准LandslideVL。
AI.motivation: 现有滑坡检测模型局限于孤立视觉任务、依赖大量标注数据，且缺乏深入分析与场景理解能力，无法满足灾害防治的综合需求。
AI.method: 1) 采用Source-Agreement Graduated Trust半监督学习框架，利用少量标注与大量未标注数据适配多种视觉任务；2) 将预测的滑坡区域作为显式空间引导，输入经参数高效微调的视觉语言模型，实现综合滑坡推理；3) 构建LandslideVL基准，融合图像与新引入的文本提示。
AI.result: 在公开数据集和LandslideVL上的实验显示，LandslideFM在定量与定性上均表现优越，且在专业滑坡推理与场景分析上超越通用视觉语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 统一视觉感知与语言推理的滑坡基础模型可行且有效，LandslideFM与LandslideVL为该领域提供了模型与评测基础，代码已开源。

title: Attribute-Evidence Learning with Multimodal Prompt for Generalized Category Discovery
comment: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
summary: Generalized category discovery (GCD) aims to discover novel categories from unlabeled data by leveraging limited labeled samples from old classes. Existing methods that rely solely on visual cues often neglect the multimodal nature of human perception, prompting recent approaches to incorporate textual information such as category tags and attributes. However, these approaches typically entangle global tags and local attributes within a shared global image representation, rendering attributes unreliable and potentially providing misleading cues that can drive the model toward incorrect predictions. To this end, we propose AptM-GCD, a novel multimodal framework that exploits apt textual guidance through attribute evidence learning and multimodal prompt reasoning. Specifically, we design an Attribute-Evidence Learning (AEL) mechanism that treats attributes as localized visual evidence rather than global category descriptors. By interacting attribute embeddings with patch-level visual tokens, AEL identifies reliable attribute-related regions and extracts discriminative local evidence, thereby reducing the impact of noisy or irrelevant attribute cues. Building upon the extracted evidence, we further develop a Multimodal Prompt Learning (MPL) mechanism to bridge local attribute semantics and global visual understanding. MPL converts fine-grained textual evidence into visual prompts and injects them into a multimodal prompt transformer, enabling attribute information to enhance category discrimination through contextual reasoning without enforcing direct global alignment between modalities. Extensive experiments on six datasets demonstrate that AptM-GCD consistently achieves SoTA performance across both fine-grained and generic benchmarks. Moreover, the proposed framework exhibits strong generalization ability, delivering consistent gains under unimodal and class-imbalanced GCD settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 AptM-GCD 多模态框架，通过属性证据学习（AEL）和多模态提示学习（MPL），把属性当作局部视觉证据而非全局类别描述，实现广义类别发现（GCD）的 SoTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 GCD 方法多依赖单一视觉线索，忽略人类感知的多模态特性；引入文本（类别标签、属性）的方法又把全局标签与局部属性纠缠在统一的全局图像表示中，导致属性不可靠，甚至提供误导线索引发错误预测。
AI.method: 1) 属性证据学习（AEL）：将属性视为局部视觉证据，让属性嵌入与 patch 级视觉 token 交互，定位可靠属性相关区域并提取判别性局部证据，抑制噪声属性；2) 多模态提示学习（MPL）：把细粒度文本证据转化为视觉提示注入多模态提示 Transformer，借上下文推理增强类别判别，而不强制模态间全局对齐。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上，细粒度与通用基准均持续取得 SoTA；在单模态及类别不平衡 GCD 设置下也表现出一致增益，泛化能力强。
AI.conclusion: 将属性作为局部证据并与提示式多模态推理结合，是一种有效且可泛化的 GCD 范式，缓解了全局对齐带来的属性噪声问题。

title: SELD: Detecting Silent Evidence Loss in Context Compression beyond the Answer
summary: Context compression is now routine for language models with long inputs, but a compressed context is useful only if it keeps the evidence for the answer. Existing checks compare the reader model's answer or its most likely words, and thus miss a frequent failure, silent evidence loss: key evidence is removed while the answer stays the same, leaving the answer unsupported and risky for other models that reuse the context. To address this challenge, we propose SELD (Silent Evidence Loss Detector), which needs no training and no labels. Its principle is that when evidence is lost, a reader model's preferences among the answers it leaves unsaid shift even if its answer does not, so comparing these preferences before and after compression reveals losses that answer checks cannot see. We also build SEL-Pairs, a benchmark of length-matched evidence and control deletions from three question-answering datasets. Quantitative and qualitative experiments with five reader models on it show that SELD consistently outperforms strong and recent baselines across compressors, compression rates and models, identifying the evidence-removing edit in 83% of matched pairs with unchanged answers, against 70% for the strongest baseline. These results show that evidence loss in compressed contexts can be detected even when the answer is unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无需训练和标签的 SELD 方法，通过比较压缩前后读者模型对"未说出的答案"的偏好分布偏移，检测上下文压缩中答案不变但证据被删除的"静默证据丢失"，并构建 SEL-Pairs 基准，在 5 个读者模型上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 长输入上下文压缩已很常见，但压缩上下文只有在保留答案证据时才有用。现有检测方法只比较读者模型的答案或其最可能词，因而漏掉一种常见失败——静默证据丢失：关键证据被删而答案不变，使答案失去支撑，并对复用该上下文的其他模型构成风险。
AI.method: 提出 SELD（Silent Evidence Loss Detector），无需训练、无需标签。核心原理：证据丢失时，即使读者模型的最终答案不变，其对"未说出答案"的偏好也会发生偏移；通过比较压缩前后这些偏好来揭示答案检查看不到的损失。同时构建 SEL-Pairs 基准，从三个问答数据集中构造长度匹配的证据删除与控制删除对。
AI.result: 在 SEL-Pairs 上，用 5 个读者模型做定量和定性实验，SELD 在不同压缩器、压缩率和模型下均稳定优于强基线及近期方法；在答案不变的匹配对中，识别出删证据编辑的比例达 83%，最强基线为 70%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，即使答案保持不变，压缩上下文中的证据丢失也可以被检测出来。

title: Making Strides in Symbolic Imitation Learning: Offline Demonstrations, Online Tuning
comment: 16 pages + 17 pages of supplementary, 9 tables, 7 figures
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods have been the dominant paradigm in continuous control tasks due to their efficacy in function approximation, while interpretable evolutionary methods have lagged largely behind for the opposite reason. In this work, we introduce Symbolic Imitation Learning, a framework for distilling an oracle policy through an offline dataset into a decision list with linear model motion primitives. We show that this, in conjunction, with online Augmented-Random Search (ARS) tuning of the constants and motion primitives approximates the performance of the oracle across 20 benchmark RL tasks and exceeds the oracle in 11 of those 20 tasks while simultaneously producing parsimonious, interpretable policies that domain experts can better understand.

AI.tldr: 提出 Symbolic Imitation Learning 框架，用离线数据将 oracle 策略蒸馏为带线性运动原语的决策列表，再用在线 ARS 调优常量与原语，在20个基准任务上逼近甚至超越 oracle 且保持可解释性。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习在连续控制任务中因函数逼近能力强而占主导，但可解释性差；可解释的进化方法则因相反原因长期落后。作者希望兼顾性能与可解释性。
AI.method: Symbolic Imitation Learning：利用离线数据集把 oracle 策略蒸馏成决策列表（decision list），每个分支使用线性模型作为运动原语；随后在线使用 Augmented-Random Search (ARS) 对常量和运动原语进行调优。
AI.result: 在20个基准 RL 任务上接近 oracle 性能，其中11个任务上超过 oracle，同时生成简洁、可解释、便于领域专家理解的策略。
AI.conclusion: 符号化模仿学习结合在线调优可在连续控制中实现与 DRL 相当甚至更优的性能，并提供可解释性，为可解释强化学习提供可行路径。

title: Data Quality Challenges in Multimodal Tourism Recommender Systems
comment: 4 pages. Presented at the DaQuaMRec Workshop, co-located with ACM RecSys 2025
summary: Modern recommender systems increasingly consider diverse data modalities to enhance model performance. However, the quality of the underlying multimodal data (e.g. data from social media platforms) has received limited attention so far. Focusing on tourism recommendation, we examine real-world challenges encountered when using datasets from Yelp and Instagram.
