Issues include noise from fake reviews, hallucinated content from LLMs, modality contradictions, and demographic bias. We outline future directions such as quality-aware fusion, structured and controlled LLM-based content generation to reduce hallucinations, and user group differentiation to improve the robustness and reliability of multimodal recommendation systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出多模态推荐系统忽视底层多模态数据质量问题，以旅游推荐为例揭示Yelp与Instagram数据中的噪声与偏差，并提出未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐系统越来越多地利用多模态数据提升性能，但多模态数据本身（如社交媒体数据）的质量问题关注不足。
AI.method: 聚焦旅游推荐场景，实证考察来自Yelp和Instagram的真实数据集中遇到的挑战，归纳四类问题：虚假评论带来的噪声、LLM生成内容的幻觉、模态间矛盾、以及人口统计偏差。
AI.result: 识别出四类关键数据质量问题（虚假评论噪声、LLM幻觉内容、模态矛盾、人群偏差），并给出相应示例与影响分析。
AI.conclusion: 提出未来方向：质量感知的融合、结构化且受控的LLM内容生成以减少幻觉、用户群体差异化，从而提升多模态推荐系统的鲁棒性与可靠性。

title: DASWeave: Weaving Evidence across Speaking Conditions for Multimodal Depression, Anxiety, and Stress Screening
summary: Multimodal screening for depression, anxiety, and stress in children and adolescents uses verbal and nonverbal behaviour. Most existing multimodal methods learn from a single recording or interview. Yet a participant's behaviour changes with the speaking condition, and these changes hold evidence that is invisible in a single recording. We propose DASWeave to bring this evidence into a neural network that encodes each response and then combines all responses of a participant. We train supervised trees to find which behavioural statistics matter for screening, both within each response and in how they change across conditions. We feed the tree outputs into the network both before and after this combination. We fine-tune a large language model to relate what a participant says to how they say it across conditions, and feed its representation into the network after the combination. The language model reads behaviour as text descriptions. We therefore derive additional training targets for the network from a multimodal large language model that takes in the audio-visual features directly. On the official hidden test set of the ACM Multimedia 2026 AdoDAS Grand Challenge (Track 1), DASWeave ranks second among 95 eligible teams. Its mean F1 is 27.1% higher than that of the official audio-visual baseline. It also has the highest mean AUROC among the top five teams. Ablation studies on the validation set show that the supervised trees and the fine-tuned language model contribute most to mean F1.

AI.tldr: DASWeave 通过对同一被试多轮/多条件下的回答进行编码与融合，并结合监督树筛选行为统计量、微调大语言模型以及多模态大模型生成的辅助训练目标，实现儿童青少年抑郁、焦虑与压力的多模态筛查，在 AdoDAS 挑战赛 Track 1 隐藏测试集上排名第二。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态筛查方法大多只依据单次录音或单次访谈学习，但被试行为会随说话条件变化，而这些跨条件的变化中蕴含单次记录无法体现的判别证据，因此需要一种能显式利用"条件间变化"信息的方法。
AI.method: 提出 DASWeave：先对每个回答单独编码，再融合被试所有回答。(1) 训练监督树从各回答内部及跨条件变化中挖掘关键行为统计量，并将其输出在融合前后两处注入网络；(2) 微调大语言模型，将行为转为文本描述，建模"说什么"与"怎么说"的跨条件关系，其表示在融合后输入网络；(3) 利用直接接收音视频特征的多模态大模型生成额外训练目标。
AI.result: 在 ACM Multimedia 2026 AdoDAS Grand Challenge（Track 1）官方隐藏测试集上，DASWeave 在 95 支合格队伍中排名第二，平均 F1 比官方音视频基线高 27.1%，并在前五名队伍中取得最高平均 AUROC。验证集消融实验表明，监督树与微调语言模型对平均 F1 贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 跨条件行为变化的建模对多模态心理筛查具有显著价值；监督树与微调 LLM 是性能提升的核心组件，方法在挑战赛中验证了有效性。

title: Repository-Context-Guided Image Understanding for Agentic Software Development
summary: Coding agents increasingly receive UI screenshots as part of bug reports, yet degraded image quality - caused by low resolution, compression artifacts, or small rendered text - can prevent them from identifying the relevant UI elements and source files. Vision-language models become less reliable as image quality deteriorates, while OCR-assisted approaches may propagate recognition errors from degraded inputs. Both approaches are limited when the visual evidence required for localization is no longer clearly observable in the query screenshot. We propose augmenting coding agents with repository-rendered reference images: crisp screenshots generated from the same codebase that the agent is tasked with modifying. These references provide readable visual evidence of the application's UI while preserving the current, potentially bug-containing implementation state. Because they are generated from the available repository rather than requiring a known bug-free version, they can be produced automatically for reproducible application states without manual image annotation. We evaluate the approach on a controlled benchmark derived from SWE-bench Multimodal by injecting visual UI bugs into a real web application. We vary screenshot degradation and reference-image provision and measure whether the coding agent identifies the correct source file. The results show that reference images improve file localization especially for degraded image quality, increasing the gold file match rate under fourfold downsampling with JPEG compression. We confirmed with further analysis that the proposed approach recognizes text approximately 12 percentage points better than language biased OCR under the same degradation.

AI.tldr: 为编码智能体补充"由仓库渲染的参考截图"，可在截图质量退化时显著提升UI缺陷的源文件定位准确率。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体常需从bug报告中的UI截图定位相关元素与源文件，但低分辨率、压缩伪影、细小文字等导致图像质量退化，使视觉语言模型不可靠、OCR方案又会传播识别错误；当查询截图中定位所需的视觉证据已不可辨识时，两类方法都受限。
AI.method: 提出用同一代码库自动渲染出清晰的参考截图（repository-rendered reference images），保留当前（可能含bug）的实现状态，无需已知无bug版本或人工标注，从而提供可读的视觉证据。在基于SWE-bench Multimodal、向真实Web应用注入视觉UI bug构建的受控基准上，变化截图退化程度与是否提供参考图，衡量智能体能否定位正确源文件。
AI.result: 参考图能提升文件定位，尤其在图像退化情况下：在四倍下采样加JPEG压缩条件下提高了gold file匹配率；在同等退化下，该方法识别文本的能力比语言偏置的OCR高约12个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 用仓库自身渲染的参考图像作为视觉证据补充，是一种可自动生成、无需标注的实用手段，可增强编码智能体在低质量截图下的UI bug定位能力。

title: StatPrompt-LLM: A Lightweight Statistical Refinement for Foundation-Style Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Time-series forecasting has recently seen a paradigm shift with the introduction of foundation-style models that adapt large pretrained language architectures to sequential data. However, effectively exposing fundamental temporal structures, such as trend, scale, and temporal dependence, to these models remains an open challenge, particularly when the available observations are limited. In this paper, we conduct an exploratory empirical study across different generations of forecasting architectures and propose StatPrompt-LLM, a lightweight statistical refinement of Time-LLM. StatPrompt-LLM augments the existing Time-LLM prompting mechanism with dataset-level statistical information and introduces a zero-initialised autoregressive bypass as a complementary linear forecasting pathway. We evaluate our framework on electricity and meteorological time-series benchmarks, including ETTh1, ETTh2, and Weather, under full-prefix and reduced-prefix configurations. Under the 10% reduced-prefix configuration, StatPrompt-LLM achieved lower in-sample prediction errors than Time-LLM, with unweighted average relative reductions across datasets of 40.2% in MSE and 21.4% in MAE. Full-prefix results were more dataset-dependent. Ablation analyses revealed relatively modest and dataset-dependent changes when selected additional statistical descriptor groups were masked within the combined architecture. Computational profiling indicated additional model parameters and runtime overhead relative to Time-LLM.

AI.tldr: 提出 StatPrompt-LLM，在 Time-LLM 提示机制中注入数据集级统计信息并加入零初始化自回归旁路，在少前缀场景下显著降低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的时间序列基础模型难以有效感知趋势、尺度、时序依赖等基本时间结构，尤其在观测数据有限（少前缀）时问题突出。
AI.method: 先跨多代预测架构做探索性实证研究；再提出 StatPrompt-LLM：在 Time-LLM 的 prompt 中加入数据集级统计描述子，并引入零初始化的自回归旁路作为线性预测补充通路。
AI.result: 在 ETTh1、ETTh2、Weather 数据集上，10% 缩减前缀设置下样本内误差低于 Time-LLM，MSE 平均相对下降 40.2%、MAE 下降 21.4%；全前缀结果依赖数据集。消融显示掩蔽部分统计描述子组影响较小且随数据集变化；计算开销（参数量与运行时间）高于 Time-LLM。
AI.conclusion: 统计信息注入与线性旁路在数据受限场景有效，但收益不稳定、存在额外计算成本，需权衡使用。

title: Tracing Psychometric Inference in Large Language Models
summary: Do large language models represent psychological constructs internally, or do they only generate outputs that resemble psychometric structure? We address this question using a cross-persona paradigm across 14 model variants from two families (Llama 3 and Qwen 2.5, 0.5B-14B, base and instruct). Given responses on one psychological scale from real individuals (N = 272 Taiwanese university students), models predict responses on six other scales. At the behavioral level, larger variants reproduce and amplify human cross-scale correlations; amplification persists after correcting the seven-scale human correlations for measurement attenuation. We then examine whether this structure is reflected internally. Contrastive direction analysis finds geometry aligned with the human matrix in larger instruct variants, but little alignment in base variants under this assay. Across models, geometry strength is associated with behavioral amplification (r = 0.68, p = 0.008; partial r = 0.69 controlling for log size). To relate internal structure to output behavior, a matched activation-probing paradigm shows that probe slopes vary less than behavioral slopes (1.38-1.77 vs 0.52-1.53). A synthetic control shows that ridge probing can inflate these slopes; after subtracting a baseline based on a reliability proxy from another analysis, adjusted slopes remain associated with behavior (r = 0.88). We term the measured probe-behavior gap readout attenuation. These results establish decodability and geometric alignment under the tested assays, without showing that the measured directions mediate the cross-persona answers.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型在跨人格条件下不仅行为上复现并放大人类跨量表相关结构，其内部激活几何也与人类矩阵对齐，但探针-行为斜率存在"读出衰减"；研究仅证明可解码性与几何对齐，未证明这些方向中介输出。
AI.motivation: 核心问题：LLM是真正在内部表征心理构念，还是仅生成看似具有心理测量结构的输出？需区分行为层面的结构与内部表征层面的结构。
AI.method: 跨人格范式，覆盖Llama 3与Qwen 2.5两族共14个变体（0.5B–14B，base与instruct）。以272名台湾大学生在一个心理量表上的真实作答为条件，让模型预测其余六个量表的作答。采用对比方向分析考察内部几何与人类相关矩阵的对齐，并用匹配激活探针范式将内部结构与输出行为关联，辅以合成对照检验岭回归探针的斜率膨胀。
AI.result: 行为层面：较大模型复现并放大人类跨量表相关，且在测量衰减校正后放大仍存在。内部层面：较大instruct变体的对比方向几何与人类矩阵对齐，base变体几乎不对齐；几何强度与行为放大相关（r=0.68, p=0.008；控制log规模后偏相关r=0.69）。探针斜率变化小于行为斜率（1.38–1.77 vs 0.52–1.53）；扣除基于信度代理的基线后，校正斜率仍与行为相关（r=0.88）。
AI.conclusion: 在所用测定方法下，模型表现出可解码性与几何对齐，但探针-行为差距（"读出衰减"）表明测得的方向并未被证明中介跨人格作答，故不能断言模型真正内部表征心理构念。

title: Partition, Refine, and Detect: Preserving Novel Category Capacity in Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) expects the model trained on base classes to recognize both base and novel classes at inference. Typical methods rely on CLIP-style vision-language embeddings, yet the learned space is often biased toward base categories, with limited effective capacity preserved for novel concepts. Such a base-dominated representation can compress novel semantics, leading to semantic collapse and mis-calibrated confidence at inference. To address this issue, we present PR-OVD, a partition-and-refine framework that explicitly reserves capacity for novel categories and strengthens category separation, while being seamlessly integrated into different detector architectures. Specifically, PR-OVD first performs coarse partitioning to build global divisions for base, novel, and an explicit background partition in both visual and textual modalities, preventing object-irrelevant embeddings from leaking into category-specific representations. It then applies category-level refinement within each partition to sharpen decision boundaries and alleviate the lack of fine-grained region-level pretraining in CLIP. To further provide reliable visual anchors for novel categories, we design a cognitively inspired Structure Prompt (SP) that encodes both egocentric attributes and allocentric context, facilitating stable partition-and-refine learning. Extensive experiments on two OVD benchmarks show that PR-OVD delivers an average 6.5\% proportional improvement on novel categories over the state-of-the-art methods. Notably, PR-OVD also benefits other open-vocabulary tasks, including segmentation and classification, further confirming its effectiveness and generality.

AI.tldr: 提出PR-OVD框架，通过"分区-精化"机制为novel类别显式保留表示容量，缓解base主导导致的语义塌缩，在OVD基准上novel类别平均提升6.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有OVD依赖CLIP式视觉-语言嵌入，但学到的空间偏向base类别，对novel概念的有效容量有限，导致novel语义被压缩（语义塌缩）与置信度校准失准。
AI.method: PR-OVD：①粗粒度分区，在视觉与文本模态中构建base/novel/显式背景的全局划分，防止无关嵌入泄漏进类别表示；②分区内类别级精化，锐化决策边界，弥补CLIP缺乏细粒度区域级预训练；③认知启发的Structure Prompt(SP)，编码自我中心属性与他中心上下文，为novel类别提供可靠视觉锚点；可无缝集成到不同检测器架构。
AI.result: 在两个OVD基准上，novel类别相对SOTA平均比例提升6.5%；并泛化到开放词汇分割与分类任务。
AI.conclusion: 为novel类别显式保留容量并强化类间分离可有效缓解base偏置，方法具备有效性与通用性。

title: Actionable Feedback: Improving Model Capabilities from User Edit Data on Clinical Documentation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed in clinical documentation workflows, where clinicians review and edit their outputs before use. In principle, these clinician edits represent a scalable source of supervision for model training. In practice, not all edits represent actionable feedback: for instance, on data drawn from real-world deployment of an AI clinical documentation product, our review suggests that over 45% of edited outputs contain user-added information that is not directly supported by the inputs to the model. Naively fine-tuning on such edits risks teaching the model to hallucinate. In this paper, we develop a method to address this challenge. Given that real clinician edits on deployed documentation tools are not publicly available, we first develop a taxonomy of clinician-editing behaviors, informed by data from a deployed AI clinical documentation product. Then, we develop a method for generating semi-synthetic clinician-edit data, informed by our taxonomy, on a discharge-summary generation task based on MIMIC-III, a public dataset. Finally, we introduce simple filtering methods for identifying actionable edits, with accuracy evaluated by expert review. We show empirically, on our semi-synthetic dataset, that naive fine-tuning on raw edited output increases ungrounded content, while our approach of progressively filtering toward grounded edits enables improvement on clinician-alignment metrics while retaining faithfulness to the input context.

AI.tldr: 临床文档场景中，医生对LLM输出的编辑并非都是可用监督信号（超45%含输入不支持的新增信息），本文提出医生编辑行为分类体系、基于MIMIC-III的出院小结半合成编辑数据生成方法，以及过滤"可操作编辑"的简单方法，实验证明先过滤再微调可提升临床对齐度同时保持对输入的忠实性。
AI.motivation: 在临床文档工作流中，医生编辑LLM输出本可作为可扩展的监督信号，但真实部署数据显示超过45%的被编辑输出包含模型输入无法直接支撑的用户新增信息；直接在这些编辑上朴素微调会教会模型幻觉，因此需要区分"可操作反馈"与不可用编辑。
AI.method: 1) 基于已部署AI临床文档产品的数据，构建医生编辑行为分类体系（taxonomy）；2) 依据该分类体系，在基于公开数据集MIMIC-III的出院小结生成任务上生成半合成的医生编辑数据；3) 提出简单的过滤方法以识别可操作的编辑，并通过专家评审评估其准确性；4) 与朴素微调进行对比实验。
AI.result: 在半合成数据集上的实证结果显示：直接在原始编辑输出上朴素微调会增加无依据（ungrounded）内容；而作者提出的逐步向有依据编辑过滤的方法，能够在提升医生对齐指标的同时保持对输入上下文的忠实性。
AI.conclusion: 医生编辑并非天然可靠的监督信号，需先过滤出有依据的可操作编辑再用于训练；本文的分类体系、半合成数据生成流程与简单过滤方法为利用临床编辑进行模型改进提供了可行路径。

title: Reconstructing Boundary Layer Wind Profiles with Machine Learning: A Comparative Study on IGRA Radiosonde Data
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on AI-Ready Data for Science Discovery (ADSD), IEEE ICDM 2026
summary: Wind profiles in the atmospheric boundary layer (ABL) drive short-range forecasting and wind-energy siting, yet sparse radiosonde coverage forces practitioners to interpolate them from a handful of physical predictors. We benchmark modern tabular learners against analytical parameterizations on 158,097 IGRA soundings. CatBoost, TabM, and FT-Transformer reduce RMSE to 1.3-1.6 m/s, against approximately 3 m/s for power-law and Monin-Obukhov fits; once the predictor set is fixed the three architectures differ by less than 0.05 m/s, so accuracy is driven by predictors rather than architecture. A cohort analysis of within-bin profile dispersion places an empirical floor of approximately 1.77 m/s on any point-wise predictor that uses standard radiosonde features, consistent with prior eddy-viscosity inversions. A one-dimensional Fourier Neural Operator applied as a post-hoc corrector to frozen tabular predictions reduces near-surface RMSE on U.S. stations from 1.5 to 1.2 m/s, while leaving upper-layer error unchanged. Further gains should come from new predictors rather than larger models.

AI.tldr: 在158,097条IGRA探空上，现代表格学习器（CatBoost、TabM、FT-Transformer）将风廓线RMSE降至1.3–1.6 m/s，远优于幂律与Monin-Obukhov约3 m/s；固定预测变量后三种架构差异<0.05 m/s，说明精度由预测因子而非模型结构决定。经验误差下界约1.77 m/s，一维FNO作为后处理修正可在美国站点将近地面RMSE从1.5降至1.2 m/s。
AI.motivation: 大气边界层风廓线对短期预报和风能选址至关重要，但无线电探空覆盖稀疏，从业者只能依赖少量物理预测因子进行插值；作者希望厘清精度瓶颈究竟来自模型架构还是预测变量。
AI.method: 以158,097条IGRA探空为基准，对比CatBoost、TabM、FT-Transformer三类表格学习器与幂律、Monin-Obukhov解析参数化；进行同仓内廓线离散度的队列分析以估计点式预测器的经验误差下界；并将一维Fourier Neural Operator（FNO）作为冻结表格预测的后处理修正器。
AI.result: 表格学习器RMSE为1.3–1.6 m/s，解析拟合约3 m/s；固定预测因子集后三架构差异小于0.05 m/s；基于标准探空特征的点式预测经验下界约1.77 m/s，与既往涡黏度反演结果一致；FNO修正器使美国站点近地面RMSE由1.5降至1.2 m/s，高层误差不变。
AI.conclusion: 风廓线插值精度主要由预测变量而非模型架构决定，现有特征下已接近经验误差下界；未来提升应依靠引入新预测因子（及后处理结构修正），而非更大规模的模型。

title: LUMIR: Decoupled Multimodal Representation Learning from Heterogeneous Data for Next-POI Recommendation
comment: 16 pages. Accepted at the DaQuaMRec Workshop, co-located with ACM RecSys 2026
summary: As multimodal tourism-related information collected from heterogeneous data sources has become increasingly available, learning effective representations has attracted attention for improving recommendation performance. Existing approaches often tightly couple multimodal fusion with the architecture and optimization objective of a specific downstream model, which limits the generality and reusability of the learned representations. To address these limitations, we propose LUMIR, a decoupled multimodal representation learning framework based on contrastive learning. Multimodal information collected from heterogeneous data sources is first semantically unified into a shared textual representation space using large language models (LLMs). An interaction-aware fusion mechanism is then designed to model cross-modal interactions, while sequential signals are incorporated as a structural constraint to guide representation learning. To evaluate the learned representations, experiments are conducted on a multimodal point-of-interest (POI) dataset under the next-POI recommendation setting across multiple sequential recommendation backbones. The results show that LUMIR consistently outperforms existing multimodal fusion baselines in both accuracy-oriented and beyond-accuracy metrics, demonstrating that decoupling representation learning from downstream optimization provides an effective paradigm for learning reusable multimodal representations. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/wzehui/LUMIR.

AI.tldr: 提出LUMIR——一个解耦的、基于对比学习的多模态表示学习框架，用LLM把异构多模态信息统一到文本空间，并用交互感知融合与序列信号约束学习可复用的表示。
AI.motivation: 多模态旅游信息来自异构数据源，已有方法把多模态融合与特定下游模型的架构和优化目标紧耦合，导致表示缺乏通用性和可复用性。
AI.method: 用LLM将异构多源多模态信息语义统一到共享文本表示空间；设计交互感知融合机制建模跨模态交互；把序列信号作为结构约束引导（对比学习下的）表示学习；将表示学习与下游优化解耦。
AI.result: 在多模态POI数据集的下一POI推荐设置下，跨多个序列推荐骨干网络实验，LUMIR在准确性和非准确性指标上均稳定优于现有多模态融合基线。
AI.conclusion: 把表示学习与下游优化解耦是学习可复用多模态表示的有效范式；代码已开源。

title: Textual Response-Aware Guidance for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Existing adversarial fine-tuning methods often use pre-trained model guidance to preserve image--text alignment while improving robustness. Our analysis of visual representation drift reveals complementary limitations of two representative forms of guidance. Matching visual features constrains all directions equally, providing broad coverage without semantic emphasis. Matching prediction distributions prioritizes semantically relevant directions, but remains limited by the candidate texts and prediction probabilities. These limitations can hinder preservation of pre-trained image--text relationships and degrade zero-shot performance. We therefore propose Textual Response-Aware Guidance (TRAG), which constrains visual representation drift using the pre-trained text encoder's responses to local variations in input embeddings. TRAG constructs anchor-level constraints from the response directions and magnitudes around semantic anchors, then aggregates them using pre-trained image--anchor relevance, yielding an image-adaptive constraint. Extensive experiments across architectures and tasks demonstrate state-of-the-art clean and robust performance. Further analysis shows that TRAG helps preserve pre-trained image--text relationships.

AI.tldr: 提出Textual Response-Aware Guidance (TRAG)，利用预训练文本编码器对输入嵌入局部变化的响应方向与幅度构造锚点级约束，并按图像-锚点相关性聚合为图像自适应约束，缓解对抗微调中的视觉表示漂移，在保持零样本能力的同时实现SOTA的干净与鲁棒性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型(VLM)零样本泛化强但易受对抗攻击；现有对抗微调依赖预训练模型引导以维持图文对齐，但两类代表性引导各有缺陷：匹配视觉特征对所有方向等权约束，覆盖广但缺乏语义重点；匹配预测分布侧重语义相关方向，却受候选文本与预测概率限制。二者均可能损害预训练图文关系并降低零样本性能。
AI.method: 分析视觉表示漂移揭示两类引导的互补局限，进而提出TRAG：以预训练文本编码器对输入嵌入局部扰动的响应（方向与幅度）在语义锚点周围构建锚点级约束，再用预训练图像-锚点相关性聚合，得到图像自适应约束用于对抗微调。
AI.result: 在多种架构与任务上的大量实验表明，TRAG取得SOTA的干净精度与鲁棒精度；进一步分析显示其有助于保持预训练图文关系。
AI.conclusion: 利用文本编码器的响应信号可提供比特征匹配和分布匹配更优的语义感知约束，TRAG是兼顾VLM鲁棒性与零样本泛化的有效对抗微调方案。

title: Code-Grounded Agentic Explanations for Static Analysis Vulnerability Findings
summary: Static application security testing (SAST) tools surface vulnerabilities early and their verdicts are rule-based and auditable. Yet developers routinely dismiss findings they cannot interpret. Large language models can supply the missing explanation, but designs that also hand the model the detection give up the auditability that makes static analysis defensible. We keep detection with the analyser and give the model only the explaining. A preliminary user study with 20 participants and a workshop with 19 practitioners yielded five requirements. Guided by these we redesigned SAFE, an open-source IntelliJ IDEA plugin that explains findings from any analyser reporting in the Static Analysis Results Interchange Format. It tiers explanations by demand, ties them to the reported data flow, and replaces the single-prompt backend with an agent that must consult the repository and the rule that fired before answering. A within-subjects crossover experiment with 24 participants compared the redesign against its predecessor. Perceived usability rose from 77.3 to 85.0 on the System Usability Scale. Actionability gained most among the explanation-quality items, the aspect both earlier studies flagged as weakest, and the odds of a correct remediation were 2.6 times higher. Triage accuracy and time per finding were indistinguishable, which we read as uninformative rather than as equivalence. Trust was the one measure that did not move, and the closing interviews indicate that grounding made findings easier to understand rather than easier to believe. Participants also drew a boundary no requirement anticipated, wanting the tool to find and explain while they judge and apply.

AI.tldr: SAFE 插件将检测交给静态分析器、只让 LLM 负责解释，并引入按需分层解释、绑定数据流与"先查仓库与触发规则再作答"的智能体后端；24 人交叉实验显示可用性（SUS 77.3→85.0）与可操作性显著提升，修复正确率翻 2.6 倍，但信任度未变。
AI.motivation: SAST 工具判定基于规则、可审计，但开发者常因看不懂而忽略告警；若把检测也交给 LLM，就会丧失静态分析赖以立身的可审计性。因此需要保留分析器检测、仅由 LLM 补足解释，且解释须贴合真实告警与数据流。
AI.method: 先通过 20 人初步用户研究与 19 位从业者工作坊提炼五项需求；据此重构开源 IntelliJ IDEA 插件 SAFE（支持任意输出 SARIF 的分析器）：按需求分层给出解释、与实际报告的数据流绑定、用须先查阅代码仓库和触发规则的智能体替代单提示后端。再用 24 人被试内交叉实验对比新旧版本。
AI.result: SUS 由 77.3 升至 85.0；解释质量各项中"可操作性"提升最大（正是此前两项研究指出的最弱项）；给出正确修复方案的几率高 2.6 倍；分诊准确率与单条耗时无差异（作者视为结果不敏感而非等价）；信任度是唯一未改善的指标，访谈表明接地使告警更易理解而非更易相信。
AI.conclusion: 将检测与解释分离、并用仓库与规则接地解释，可提升可用性与可操作性而不牺牲可审计性；但信任不会因解释更清晰而自动提升。用户还提出未被需求预设的边界：工具负责发现与解释，人来判断与修复。

title: MADSNet: A Multi-Scale Axial-Attentive Dense Spiking Network for Spike Camera Image Reconstruction
summary: Spike cameras encode dynamic scenes into high-temporal-resolution binary spike streams for efficient high-speed vision. Although spiking neural networks (SNNs) can process such signals with sparse and accumulate-only computation, existing SNN-based reconstruction methods are typically shallow and still lag behind ANN-based models in reconstruction fidelity. This paper proposes MADSNet, a Multi-scale Axial-attentive Dense Spiking Network for spike camera image reconstruction. MADSNet adopts a hierarchical spiking encoder--decoder, where a multi-scale spike stem extracts early features, axial spike attention captures long-range dependencies, a dense spiking bottleneck enhances feature reuse, and a spike-to-continuous decoder reconstructs continuous intensity images from spike-domain representations. Experiments on gray-scale and color spike reconstruction show that MADSNet outperforms SSIR by 4.3 dB PSNR and Spk2ImgNet by 1.94 dB on SREDS. Compared with Spk2ImgNet, it achieves about 15$\times$ lower latency and uses only about 1/40 of the estimated energy, demonstrating that carefully designed SNN architectures can improve reconstruction quality while preserving computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出MADSNet，一种多尺度轴向注意力密集脉冲网络，用于脉冲相机图像重建，在提升重建保真度的同时保持低延迟与低能耗。
AI.motivation: 现有基于SNN的脉冲相机重建方法通常较浅，重建保真度仍落后于ANN模型；需设计更优SNN架构以兼顾质量与效率。
AI.method: 采用分层脉冲编码器-解码器结构：多尺度脉冲stem提取早期特征，轴向脉冲注意力捕获长程依赖，密集脉冲瓶颈增强特征复用，脉冲到连续域解码器重建连续强度图像。
AI.result: 在SREDS上较SSIR提升4.3 dB PSNR、较Spk2ImgNet提升1.94 dB；相比Spk2ImgNet延迟约降低15倍，估计能耗仅约1/40。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的SNN架构可在保持计算效率的同时提升脉冲相机重建质量。

title: Graph Visualizations in Prompts for Knowledge Graph Question Answering
summary: We study when and how multimodal input improves knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) in large vision--language models. Using a controlled evaluation over 1,500 WebQSP and CWQ questions and six VLMs within a fixed KGQA pipeline, we compare text-only prompting against text-plus-graph visualization at the per-question level and analyze performance changes as a function of reasoning complexity, model size, and image layout. Adding a graph image yields an average gain of 1.85 F1 points, driven by strong precision improvements on low-complexity questions (+4.65 F1). Mixed-effects and regression analyses show that these multimodal gains do not depend strongly on model scale, but are highly sensitive to graph layout: image-only settings sharply degrade performance, hierarchical Graphviz layouts outperform less organized renderings, and decomposing large subgraphs into separated paths yields the largest improvements. Taken together, the results indicate that visual prompting primarily aids KGQA by enhancing prediction precision in low-complexity contexts, provided that visual design respects cognitive and perceptual constraints. To optimize both accuracy and inference efficiency, we argue for adaptive visual prompting policies that selectively append diagrams to small, visually sparse subgraphs with well-structured layouts, avoiding unnecessary visual clutter and token overhead on complex queries. We conclude by relating these findings to a visual notation design theory, outlining how principled diagram encoding can guide future multimodal VLM prompting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过1500条WebQSP/CWQ问题、六种VLM与固定KGQA流程的受控实验，发现加入图可视化平均提升1.85 F1，增益主要来自低复杂度问题的精度提升，且高度依赖图布局结构，而非模型规模。
AI.motivation: 探究多模态输入在何种条件、以何种方式改善大视觉-语言模型的知识图谱问答（KGQA）表现，明确其增益来源与边界。
AI.method: 在固定KGQA管线中，对1500条WebQSP与CWQ问题进行逐题级受控评估，比较纯文本提示与文本+图谱可视化提示；考察推理复杂度、模型规模、图像布局的影响，并使用混合效应模型与回归分析。
AI.result: 加入图图像平均提升1.85 F1，低复杂度问题精度显著提升（+4.65 F1）；增益与模型规模关系不大，但对布局高度敏感：纯图像设置性能骤降，层次化Graphviz布局优于杂乱渲染，将大子图拆分为分离路径提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 视觉提示主要通过提升低复杂度情境下的预测精度来辅助KGQA，前提是视觉设计符合认知与感知约束；应提出自适应视觉提示策略，仅在结构良好、视觉稀疏的小子图上附加图示，以避免复杂查询中的视觉杂乱与token开销，并将结论关联到视觉符号设计理论。

title: Selective Surgical Action-Center Localization:Retaining Localization Gains through Supervised Scoring
summary: Surgical action-center localization requires both an accurate reference point and a decision about whether to report it. When frames with and without a reportable center are mixed, the benefit of improved localization depends on which correct candidates survive selection. We present a selective localization pipeline combining heatmap and coordinate supervision with a logistic-regression scorer. The scorer learns to identify predictions with a reportable center and a localization error within a specified tolerance. The internal evaluation uses 5,000 frames from 50 surgical sources, five source-grouped folds and two random seeds. Matched locator and scoring comparisons track correct candidates and their rejection. At an 80% acceptance quota per source and a tolerance of 0.10 times the image diagonal, our method retains 46.08 correct outputs per 100 inputs. The baseline locator with the same scoring approach retains 44.20. The gain is 1.88 (descriptive 95% source-paired bootstrap interval, 0.94 to 2.79). Under entropy-based selection, increased rejection of correct predictions offsets the higher supply of correct predictions on average. For the coordinate-supervised locator, supervised scoring reduces these rejections from 6.15 to 2.99 per 100 inputs. Evaluating retained correct outputs reveals whether a selection rule preserves or erodes an improvement in localization.

AI.tldr: 提出选择式定位流水线（热图+坐标监督+逻辑回归打分器），在含可报告与不可报告中心的混合帧中联合优化定位精度与"是否上报"的决策，用"每100输入保留的正确输出数"衡量选择规则是否真正保留定位改进。
AI.motivation: 手术动作中心定位不仅需要准确参考点，还需判断是否上报。当可报告与不可报告中心的帧混合时，定位精度的提升能否转化为实际收益，取决于哪些正确候选能通过筛选而存活；现有评估未跟踪正确候选的被拒情况。
AI.method: 热图与坐标联合监督的定位器 + 逻辑回归打分器，学习识别"存在可报告中心且定位误差在容差内"的预测。内部评估：50个手术来源的5000帧，5折按来源分组，2个随机种子；匹配定位器与打分方案对比，追踪正确候选及其被拒比例。
AI.result: 在每来源80%接受配额、容差为图像对角线0.10条件下，方法每100输入保留46.08个正确输出，基线44.20，增益1.88（95%来源配对bootstrap区间0.94–2.79）。基于熵的选择中，正确预测被拒增加抵消了正确预测供给的提升；对坐标监督定位器，监督打分将每100输入的正确预测被拒数从6.15降至2.99。
AI.conclusion: 评估保留的正确输出可揭示选择规则是保留还是侵蚀定位改进；监督打分在减少正确候选被误拒方面明显优于熵式选择。

title: Brasilidade: Measuring Brazilian Identity for Large Language Models
summary: This work presents a new benchmark that aims to address the limitations of current methods for evaluating LLMs in Brazilian Portuguese. We introduced Brasilidade, an assessment methodology comprised of standardized tasks distributed across four different domains, and we are making available the tasks from its first domain, which address nuances of the language, grammar, and variations of Brazilian Portuguese. The results show that model size, by itself, does not determine performance; several medium-sized models outperformed larger models in the protocols evaluated. Specific models for Portuguese, in general, did not perform above average, despite their targeted training. Different task levels revealed significant nuances: while some tasks proved easy for most models, others posed extreme challenges, and some yielded mixed results, with wide variations in performance. This clearly illustrates the need for benchmarks that address the limitations of the models in Brazilian Portuguese, allowing future training cycles to seek to overcome them. Project repository https://github.com/soberania-oficial/brasilidade

AI.tldr: 该文提出巴西葡语LLM评测基准Brasilidade，并公开首个领域的任务，发现模型规模不是性能决定因素。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以充分评估LLM在巴西葡语上的表现，缺乏覆盖语言细微差别的标准化基准。
AI.method: 构建Brasilidade评测方法论，包含跨四个领域的标准化任务；首版公开其中聚焦巴西葡语语言、语法及变体细微差别的任务。
AI.result: 模型规模本身不决定性能，多个中等规模模型超过大模型；专门的葡语模型整体未达平均水平；不同任务难度差异显著，部分极易、部分极难、部分结果混杂。
AI.conclusion: 需要针对巴西葡语局限性的基准，以指导未来训练周期改进模型。

title: Recurrent Modular Structure in Spiking Neural Network Reinforcement Learning
summary: Biological neural circuits are both modular and recurrent, with dense communities sparsely linked to one another. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) for reinforcement learning are usually feed-forward, and it is unclear how to obtain functional modules in a recurrent SNN or what they buy. In this work, we introduce a class of spiking networks, called Community Recurrent SNNs (CoRe SNNs): recurrent networks partitioned into communities with fixed roles. A controller community receives the stimulus, each action has its own community, and latent communities carry internal state. Spiking activity is then a walk between communities, and the action is the community the walk reaches. All learning is local and three-factor, and the recurrent communities are closer to cortical microcircuits than a feed-forward actor. We compare three regimes for obtaining the communities: dynamic modularity, in which a new learning rule we introduce, Map-STDP, encourages modular structure during learning; partial modularity, in which a stochastic block model (SBM) initialization enforces it partly; and full modularity, in which sealing enforces it fully. On CartPole, across three spiking neuron models, Map-STDP improves learning over the same network without it matches full modularity (sealed communities) on two of the three models, and makes the observed spike walk more compressible. Replacing the feed-forward actor of a TD-STDP actor-critic with recurrent action communities improves on the feed-forward network on CartPole and LunarLander, and matches it on Acrobot. How strongly to enforce modularity depends on the task: full modularity helps most on Acrobot, while on LunarLander the dynamic, partial and full regimes perform alike. Overall, these recurrent modular networks can match or even improve upon feed-forward approaches, with improvements in bio-plausibility and energy efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Community Recurrent SNN（CoRe SNN），将循环脉冲网络划分为具有固定角色的社区（控制器、各动作社区、隐状态社区），冲动活动表现为社区间行走，所到达社区即动作；全部学习为局部三因子规则，并比较动态模块化（新规则Map-STDP）、部分模块化（SBM初始化）与完全模块化（封sealed）。
AI.motivation: 生物神经回路既模块化又递归，而用于强化学习的脉冲网络多为前馈结构，如何在循环SNN中获得功能模块、模块带来什么收益尚不清楚。
AI.method: 将循环SNN划分为固定角色的社区：控制器社区接收刺激，每个动作一个社区，潜社区承载内部状态；动作即行走到达的社区。学习为局部三因子规则。三种获取模块的方式：动态模块化（提出Map-STDP在训练中鼓励模块结构）、部分模块化（SBM初始化）、完全模块化（sealing强制）。并将TD-STDP actor-critic的前馈actor替换为循环动作社区。
AI.result: CartPole上跨三种脉冲神经元模型：Map-STDP相比无该规则的同一网络提升学习，在其中两个模型上比肩完全模块化，并使脉冲行走更可压缩。用循环动作社区替换前馈actor后在CartPole与LunarLander上优于前馈网络，在Acrobot上持平。模块化强度依任务而定：完全模块化在Acrobot上最有益，LunarLander上三种机制表现相近。
AI.conclusion: 此类循环模块化网络可匹配甚至超越前馈方法，同时提升生物合理性与能效。

title: From Show Programs to Linked Data
summary: Many heritage institutions hold extensive collections of show programs. Too numerous to be cataloged individually, they remain difficult to access and are still largely undigitized. This paper presents a workflow for transforming such documents into structured, interoperable data by combining vision-language models (VLMs), a custom extension of the Linked Art ontology for the performing arts, and different approaches for automatic semantic data annotation. Using the Festival d'Avignon programs (1947--present), preserved at the Biblioth{è}que nationale de France, as a case study, we demonstrate how VLMs achieve more than 98% text transcription accuracy from heterogeneous heritage document images and how constraining large language model generation through a knowledge graph significantly reduces hallucinations in semantic annotation. We argue that this workflow opens new possibilities for large-scale, interoperable performing arts historiography, including the creation of catalogues raisonn{é}s for performing artists, a form of scholarship common in visual arts but absent in performing arts studies.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一套工作流，将大量未编目的演出节目单通过视觉-语言模型、Linked Art本体扩展与自动语义标注，转化为结构化、可互操作的数据，并以阿维尼翁戏剧节节目单为案例验证。
AI.motivation: 文化遗产机构收藏了大量演出节目单，数量过多难以逐一编目，且大多尚未数字化，导致难以访问和利用；表演艺术研究缺乏类似视觉艺术中"作品全集目录"（catalogue raisonné）的系统性史料基础。
AI.method: 以法国国家图书馆藏阿维尼翁戏剧节节目单（1947年至今）为案例，结合三类技术：视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行文本转录；针对表演艺术定制的Linked Art本体扩展；以及多种自动语义数据标注方法，其中通过知识图谱约束大语言模型生成以抑制幻觉。
AI.result: VLM在异构遗产文档图像上实现超过98%的文本转录准确率；用知识图谱约束LLM生成可显著减少语义标注中的幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流为大规模、可互操作的表演艺术史研究开辟新可能，包括为表演艺术家构建"作品全集目录"，填补表演艺术研究中的空白。

title: TIB: Sample-wise Tempered Information Bottleneck for Multimodal Attribution beyond Alignment Assumption
summary: Multimodal (e.g. vision-language, in this work) attribution aims to interpret the models without access to ground-truth explanatory supervision. Existing multimodal attribution methods typically rely on paired modalities as proxy supervision, implicitly assuming that image-text pairs are semantically aligned. Information bottleneck (IB)-based attribution methods follow this general paradigm and instantiate it through a global sufficiency-compression objective. In realistic multimodal datasets, however, this assumption is frequently violated due to partial semantic misalignment and unreliable cross-modal correspondences. Through theoretical analysis, we show that, under such misalignment, information-bottleneck-based attribution objectives exhibit a structural limitation: by assuming equal reliability across all proxy supervision signals, they induce posterior over-contraction and forced explanations. To address this issue, we propose TIB, a sample-wise Tempered Information Bottleneck framework that adaptively modulates attribution strength according to cross-modal reliability, without assuming semantic alignment. Extensive experiments on controlled benchmarks and large-scale datasets show the effectiveness of the proposed approach, while also validating the identified failure mode.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有多模态归因方法（尤其基于信息瓶颈IB的方法）隐含假设图文语义对齐，导致在部分错配数据上出现"后验过度收缩"和"强制解释"的结构性缺陷，并提出样本级温度化信息瓶颈框架TIB，按跨模态可靠性自适应调节归因强度。
AI.motivation: 现实多模态数据集中普遍存在部分语义错配与不可靠跨模态对应，而现有IB类归因方法将各配对模态都当作同等可靠的代理监督，违背了该前提，因此需要一个不假设语义对齐的归因框架。
AI.method: 先做理论分析，证明在错配条件下全局充分性-压缩目标因"等可靠性假设"引发后验过度收缩与强制解释；再提出TIB：在样本级别引入温度化（tempered）信息瓶颈，依据跨模态可靠性自适应地调节每个样本的归因强度。
AI.result: 在受控基准和若干大规模数据集上取得有效性能，同时实验验证了所识别的失败模式确实存在。
AI.conclusion: 多模态归因不应建立在语义对齐假设之上；以样本级可靠性为条件调节IB目标是可行且有效的方向，为错配鲁棒的多模态可解释性提供了理论与实践依据。

title: The Gene Is Not the Gate: Conceptualizing the Semantic Genome of Quantum Software
summary:
Quantum software spans applications, program representations, compilers, runtimes, and hardware-facing control. Existing abstractions describe these artifacts and layers, but they do not capture the semantic responsibilities that must remain valid as a computation is transformed across the stack. This limits systematic reasoning about cross-layer correctness, evolution, and reuse.
  We present QGenome, a semantic foundation for quantum software genomics. We define a quantum software gene as a typed, reusable responsibility characterized by an explicit contract, execution context, concrete expressions, and supporting evidence. QGenome organizes genes across five software strata and ten responsibility families grouped into computational semantics, coordination, realization, and assurance. Typed genes compose into pathways and genomes through dependency, refinement, provenance, and phenotype relations, enabling responsibilities to be traced across alternative implementations and execution contexts.
  We illustrate the taxonomy using representative public artifacts across the quantum software stack and define principles for contextual validity, genome evolution, environmental adaptation, and capability expression. Rather than presenting a complete taxonomy or an automated extraction technique, QGenome establishes a falsifiable framework and a concrete research agenda for gene mining, lineage recovery, cross-layer regression testing and repair, and evidence-grounded quantum software agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 QGenome 量子软件基因组学语义框架，以"基因"为单位刻画跨层语义责任，支持跨栈正确性、演化与复用推理。
AI.motivation: 现有量子软件抽象仅描述构件与分层，未捕捉计算在跨栈变换中必须保持的语义责任，导致跨层正确性、演化与复用难以系统化推理。
AI.method: 定义"量子软件基因"为带类型、可复用、具显式契约、执行上下文、具体表达与证据的责任单元；将基因组织于五个软件层与十个责任族（计算语义、协调、实现、保障四组），并通过依赖、精化、溯源与表型关系组合为通路与基因组。
AI.result: 用公开代表性量子软件栈制品示范该分类体系，提出上下文有效性、基因组演化、环境适配与能力表达的原则；明确其为可证伪框架而非完整分类或自动化抽取方法。
AI.conclusion: QGenome 为量子软件基因组学奠定语义基础，并给出基因挖掘、谱系恢复、跨层回归测试与修复、证据驱动智能体等研究议程。

title: Third Eye: Beyond Immediate Gains in Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Does a useful self-update remain useful after the model updates again? Third Eye separates immediate performance from the outcome of a further native update. We evaluate five 3-8B backbones on math and code: 64 fresh runs, three candidates per run, and three continuations per candidate. Selection and final scoring use disjoint items. In the balanced Qwen3-4B/Llama-3.2-3B comparison, immediate-selected utility is near zero, but continuation reduces it by 1.78 percentage points (simultaneous 95% interval [0.68, 2.88]). Candidate-averaged immediate utility is already negative: selection partly accounts for the apparently neutral first step. Continuation also lowers utility for SmolLM3-3B and Llama-3.1-8B; Qwen3-8B remains inconclusive. Target and out-of-distribution losses dominate retention changes. Matched recipe and recipient-donor controls identify neither a reliable mitigation nor a single mechanism. The results support evaluating persistent self-updates as adaptation transitions, with independent scoring and a no-update baseline, rather than interpreting immediate performance as their full value.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"第三眼"（Third Eye）评估框架，将自我更新（self-update）的即时收益与后续再更新后的持久收益分开衡量，发现即时表现近乎为零甚至为负，再次更新后效用进一步下降。
AI.motivation: 现有评估只看模型自我更新后的即时表现，但一个"有用"的更新可能在下一次原生更新后失效，甚至造成损害。因此需要把自我更新视为"适应转移"过程来评估其持久价值。
AI.method: 在数学与代码任务上评估五个3–8B基座（Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B、SmolLM3-3B）：64次全新运行，每次3个候选，每个候选3次续训；选择用与最终评分用互不相交的数据项；并设置无更新基线，以及匹配配方与"接收者-捐赠者"对照实验来探究机制与缓解手段。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B/Llama-3.2-3B平衡比较中，即时选中的效用接近零，续训后进一步降低1.78个百分点（同期95%区间[0.68, 2.88]）。候选平均的即时效用本身已为负，说明选择过程部分掩盖了第一步的中性表现。SmolLM3-3B与Llama-3.1-8B同样在续训后效用下降；Qwen3-8B结论不确定。保留性变化主要由目标分布与分布外损失驱动。
AI.conclusion: 应把持久性自我更新作为"适应转移"来评估，配合独立评分与无更新基线，而不能把即时表现当作其全部价值。现有控制实验既未找到可靠缓解方法，也未识别出单一机制。

title: Reinforcement Learning based control of Cancer Chemotherapy treatments
comment: Masters thesis at the National Taipei University. Received the IEEE Taipei Section, Best Masters thesis award in 2021
summary:
Reinforcement Learning has achieved tremendous success in recent years. Extending its scope from the traditional complex games such as Atari, Go, Pokeman, and Chess, reinforcement learning has caught researchers' attention on modelling real-life scenarios. Personalized medicine and the dynamic treatment regimen are two such preliminary research fields; researchers are focusing their mindsets currently. Estimating the optimal dynamic treatment regimens from the observational real clinical data is being popularized among the researchers, widening its scope towards more advanced versions of reinforcement learning algorithms.
  This research is about a research study that focused on reinforcement learning techniques that have been approached in the context of cancer chemotherapy treatments. Primarily this thesis addresses the result of the study by means of the state-of-the-art on reinforcement learning techniques used in generating the optimal policy for sequential treatments, including the existing online reinforcement learning approaches. Thereby a simulation for cancer chemotherapy via traditional Q-learning would be presented. Secondly, the study will extend towards using offline reinforcement learning in the optimal policy generation. Thus, the proposed solution follows a data-driven approach, which works on the real human colon cancer clinical data.
  The novelty of the proposed solution resides in the implementation of an offline reinforcement learning approach by means of a model-based architecture using the conservative Q-learning and the model-based offline policy optimization algorithm. As per the experimental results and the evaluations, it was revealed that the proposed Chemo RL model caters well the problem of cancer chemotherapy treatment scheduling and serves as a supportive model for the junior oncologists in deciding their treatment decisions.

AI.tldr: 该研究将强化学习应用于癌症化疗的序贯治疗方案优化，先构建传统Q-learning的化疗仿真，再基于真实人类结肠癌临床数据，提出结合保守Q学习（CQL）与基于模型的离线策略优化（MOReL）的离线强化学习框架以生成最优治疗策略。
AI.motivation: 强化学习已从Atari、围棋、国际象棋等复杂游戏拓展到真实场景建模，个性化医疗与动态治疗方案（dynamic treatment regimen）是备受关注的初步研究方向。从观察性真实临床数据中估计最优动态治疗方案正日益流行，并推动强化学习算法向更高级版本发展。癌症化疗的给药调度正是一个典型的序贯决策问题，亟需合适的方法加以解决。
AI.method: 首先综述用于生成序贯治疗最优策略的强化学习技术现状，包括现有在线强化学习方法；随后通过传统Q-learning构建癌症化疗仿真实验。在此基础上，转向离线强化学习生成最优策略，采用数据驱动的方式，基于真实人类结肠癌临床数据，构建结合保守Q学习（conservative Q-learning）与基于模型的离线策略优化算法的模型化离线强化学习架构。
AI.result: 实验与评估结果表明，所提出的Chemo RL模型能够较好地处理癌症化疗治疗调度问题，并可作为辅助初级肿瘤科医生进行治疗决策的支持性模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究的创新点在于采用基于模型的架构（CQL + 基于模型的离线策略优化）实现离线强化学习，并成功应用于真实结肠癌临床数据的化疗方案优化；验证了离线强化学习在动态治疗方案制定中的可行性，为临床决策支持提供了新思路。

title: Trajectory-Regularized Distribution Distillation for One-Step Generation
summary: Distilling flow matching models for one-step generation generally follows two paradigms. Trajectory alignment supervises the student with the teacher's probability flow ODE, but its performance degrades under very small sampling budgets. Distribution matching directly optimizes the generated distribution, but estimating its reverse Kullback-Leibler gradient typically requires a separate network to track the evolving student score. We propose trajectory-regularized distribution distillation (TRD), which combines distribution-level and trajectory-level supervision through a momentum-mixture policy predicted in a single student forward pass. This policy serves simultaneously as a one-step generator, an estimator of the student's marginal velocity that removes the need for a second trainable network in distribution matching, and a closed-form time-dependent velocity field supervised along the teacher ODE trajectory. Experiments on SANA-1.6B and Stable Diffusion 3.5 show that TRD outperforms representative consistency and distribution matching baselines in generation quality and training efficiency for both one-step and few-step generation, with a trade-off in sample diversity.

AI.tldr: TRD（轨迹正则化分布蒸馏）通过一次前向预测的动量混合策略，同时实现分布级与轨迹级监督，无需额外网络即可蒸馏流匹配模型为一步生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配一步蒸馏的两类范式各有缺陷：轨迹对齐在极小采样预算下性能下降；分布匹配估计反向KL梯度需额外网络跟踪学生score。
AI.method: 提出动量混合策略，单次学生前向即预测：既作一步生成器，又作学生边缘速度估计器（消除分布匹配中的第二训练网络），并作为沿教师ODE轨迹监督的闭式时变速度场，融合分布级与轨迹级监督。
AI.result: 在SANA-1.6B和Stable Diffusion 3.5上，TRD在一步与少步生成的生成质量和训练效率上均优于代表性一致性蒸馏与分布匹配基线，但在样本多样性上存在权衡。
AI.conclusion: 统一分布匹配与轨迹对齐可有效蒸馏流匹配模型，兼具质量与效率，代价是多样性略有下降。

title: IntentTwin: Deconfounding Candidate Support and the Oracle-to-Deployment Gap in Offline Web Behavior Prediction
summary: Offline web-behavior benchmarks frequently insert the demonstrated action into a finite candidate set and then measure reranking. We show that this protocol can create a candidate-support confound: when the target is outside training support while all distractors are sampled from that support, support membership identifies the gold action without modeling behavior. We formalize this effect with support-identifiability rate (SIR), construct support-balanced candidate sets, and evaluate a target-free dual-path proposer that combines support retrieval with open-vocabulary DOM/LM proposals. On filtered OPeRA (4,282/469/992 train/dev/test steps), the original protocol has SIR 1.0000 on target-OOV rows and a support-only rule reaches 1.0000 OOV Exact@1. Support balancing reduces SIR to 0.0000; the strongest conditional reranker obtains 0.7214 overall Exact@1, 0.7988 on IV rows, and 0.5668 on OOV rows. The target-free dual-path system reaches Proposal Recall@16 0.6915 and end-to-end Exact@1 0.5212, compared with oracle conditional Exact@1 0.7450. On Mind2Web, the same audit yields SIR 0.2380 and an oracle-to-proposal gap of 0.2125. A 200-row semantic audit labels 0.7150 of exact-key OOV targets as semantically novel, 0.2450 as locator/string variation, and 0.0400 as ambiguous (Cohen's $κ=0.8173$). These measurements show why support composition must be controlled alongside candidate accuracy when offline results are used to reason about deployment.

AI.tldr: 离线网页行为基准在有限候选集中做重排评测，会产生"候选支持度混淆"（candidate-support confound）：当目标动作在训练支持集之外、而干扰项都来自支持集时，仅凭"是否属于支持集"就能识别正确答案。作者用支持可识别率（SIR）量化该效应，构建支持度平衡候选集，并评测一个无目标信息的双路径提议器（支持检索+开放词表 DOM/LM 提议）。
AI.motivation: 现有离线网页行为基准多采用"给定有限候选集+重排"协议，但该协议未控制候选集的支持度构成，导致模型可能不靠行为建模而靠支持度线索"作弊"，从而夸大离线性能、误导对部署效果的推断。
AI.method: 1) 形式化候选支持度混淆效应，提出支持可识别率（SIR）指标；2) 构造支持度平衡的候选集以消除该混淆；3) 提出目标无关的双路径提议器，结合支持集检索与开放词表 DOM/LM 提议；4) 在过滤后的 OPeRA（4,282/469/992 步）与 Mind2Web 上进行审计与对照实验；5) 进行 200 行语义审计，区分语义新颖、定位/字符串变体和歧义三类 OOV 目标。
AI.result: OPeRA 原协议在目标 OOV 行上 SIR 高达 1.0000，仅用支持度规则即可达 1.0000 OOV Exact@1；支持度平衡后 SIR 降为 0.0000。最强条件重排在全体上 Exact@1 为 0.7214，IV 行 0.7988，OOV 行 0.5668。无目标双路径系统 Proposal Recall@16 为 0.6915，端到端 Exact@1 为 0.5212，而 oracle 条件上限为 0.7450。Mind2Web 上 SIR 为 0.2380，oracle 与提议器差距 0.2125。语义审计中 0.7150 的精确键 OOV 目标属语义新颖，0.2450 为定位/字符串变体，0.0400 为歧义（Cohen's κ=0.8173）。
AI.conclusion: 离线评测中必须同时控制候选集的支持度构成与候选准确率，否则容易高估模型能力；SIR 与支持度平衡候选集提供了可用的审计手段，而无目标双路径提议器与开放词表提议是更贴近部署场景的可行方向。

title: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction and Robust Evidence Retrieval for Indian Knowledge Systems
summary: Retrieving evidence from Indian Knowledge Systems is complicated by transliteration variants, ambiguous names, and relations distributed across passages. We present an ontology-guided knowledge graph (KG) pipeline that links typed entities and relations extracted with Qwen3-32B to original textual evidence. Retrieval combines sense-aware grounding, bounded graph traversal, lexical anchors, relationship-vector search, and passage reranking. We evaluate KG alone, single-vector retrieval (SV), and KG unions with SV and Entity Notes on 320 questions from Dhara Bench, matching the per-question candidate count across internal systems under BGE and Qwen rerankers. Standalone KG has the highest Precision@5 under both rerankers and the highest MRR@20 in Counting, Composite, and Multi-hop among the evaluated internal configurations. With Qwen, KG achieves Multi-hop MRR@20 of 0.8722, compared with 0.7622 for the fully reranked KG + SV union. The KG + SV + Entity Notes union instead provides the highest overall Recall@20 (0.5134), compared with 0.4347 for KG. On the 15 Multi-hop questions, Qwen KG achieves complete-evidence MRR@20 of 0.4651 versus 0.3372 for SV, while both full unions complete ten questions within twenty results compared with nine for KG. Gemini 3.7 Flash, evaluated through manually reviewed source mappings, re mains stronger on overall MRR and nDCG, while internal systems have category-specific advantages. All comparisons are descriptive. A separate deployment timing study measures mean retrieval times of 20.374 s for KG and 0.646 s for SV. The findings support selecting KG or its unions according to the required balance of early relevance, evidence completeness, and retrieval cost.

AI.tldr: 提出一种本体引导的知识图谱(KG)检索流程，用于印地知识系统证据检索，并比较KG独立检索与单向量(SV)及其联合方案的效果。
AI.motivation: 从印度知识系统检索证据面临音译变体、名称歧义及跨段落关系分散等困难，需要更可靠的检索方式。
AI.method: 用Qwen3-32B抽取带类型的实体与关系并链接到原文证据，构建KG；检索融合语义感知接地、有界图遍历、词汇锚点、关系向量搜索与段落重排。在Dhara Bench的320题上，对齐各系统候选数，比较KG、SV及KG+SV(+Entity Notes)联合；用BGE与Qwen重排器评估，并与Gemini 3.7 Flash对比；另做部署时延测试。
AI.result: KG独立方案在两种重排器下P@5最高，Counting/Composite/Multi-hop的MRR@20最高；Qwen下Multi-hop MRR@20为0.8722（全重排KG+SV为0.7622）。联合方案Recall@20最高0.5134（KG为0.4347）。15道Multi-hop题上Qwen KG完整证据MRR@20为0.4651（SV为0.3372）；KG召回0.4651、联合十题在前20条内凑齐证据（KG为九题）。Gemini 3.7 Flash在总体MRR与nDCG上更强，内部系统有类别优势。检索时延：KG均值20.374s，SV 0.646s。
AI.conclusion: KG利于早期相关性与多跳精度，联合方案利于证据完整性与召回，但代价是时延大幅增加；应按精度、完整性与成本的权衡选用KG或其联合方案。所有比较均为描述性。

title: Multimodal Judges Flag, Humans Decide: A Review-and-Edit Framework for AI-Generated Product Video Ads
comment: Accepted at the WVAQ workshop at WACV 2027
summary: Generative pipelines can now turn every product page of an e-commerce catalog into a short video ad, but deciding whether such an ad is usable is not one good-or-bad call. We describe how we operationalized the review and editing of these ads so that both can keep pace with generation: reviewers go through each ad scene by scene and answer six questions, on the product, scene quality, pronunciation, script, sound and captions; judges built from vision-language, speech and language models file each finding under the matching question, and reviewers accept or reject each finding and add what the judges missed. Each confirmed issue then opens an edit tool matched to it. The questions and the routing from a finding to its fix do not depend on the models that generate the ad. Across 120 ads from our pipeline, reviewed with judge findings on screen, reviewers marked the product wrong on 60% of scenes, and script, caption or sound problems on under 10% each. On 60 of these ads, they marked the product wrong on 58% of scenes, far more than the 26% marked by two reviewers who later saw the ads with the judges hidden; one reviewer who saw the ads both ways marked 57% with judge findings and 19% without. On 120 blind-labeled scenes, a product judge that watches the clip with the catalog photos reached AUC 0.84, while video-quality and photo-similarity scores were close to chance. We tune the judges for recall: the product judge catches nearly all defects but also flags many clean scenes, so reviewers decide; together, the judges widen what reviewers mark and reviewers add what the judges miss. Without judge findings, one reviewer's marking faded over a session. We release a review-portal template and our review data (120 ads and 562 scenes with judge findings and human marks, plus 120 blind-labeled scenes with baseline scores) at https://github.com/anoubhav/ad-review-and-edit.

AI.tldr: 本文展示如何将电商产品页生成的短视频广告的审核与编辑流程操作化：评审逐场景回答六类问题，VLM/语音/语言模型裁判将发现归入对应问题，确认的问题直接打开匹配的编辑工具；产品裁判AUC达0.84，裁判+人工互补显著提升缺陷检出。
AI.motivation: 生成管线已能把每个电商产品页变成短视频广告，但"可用与否"不是单一的好/坏判断；审核与编辑需跟得上生成速度，需要结构化、模型无关的流程。
AI.method: 六问题逐场景审核（产品、场景质量、发音、脚本、声音、字幕）；由视觉语言、语音、语言模型构建裁判，将发现归入对应问题，评审接受/拒绝并补充遗漏；每个确认问题打开对应编辑工具；问题设计与"发现→修复"路由独立于生成模型。裁判按召回率调优。
AI.result: 120条广告中，评审在60%的场景标记产品错误，脚本/字幕/声音问题各低于10%；60条对照中带裁判显示时产品错误58%，隐藏裁判时为26%，同一评审两种条件下为57% vs 19%。120个盲标场景上产品裁判AUC为0.84，视频质量与照片相似度接近随机。无裁判发现时评审标记会随会话衰减。
AI.conclusion: 裁判与人工互补：裁判拓宽评审标记范围，评审补充裁判遗漏；发布审核门户模板与数据（120条广告、562场景、120盲标场景）以支持复现与后续研究。

title: Beyond the Document: Compiled Context and Governed Agents for Any Work Product
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 4-package held-out evaluation; 12,000 evaluated responses
summary: A document preserves the visible result of professional work but often discards the research, calculations, assumptions, evidence, and authorization boundaries behind it. We study a different unit of delivery: a Portable Agent Format (PAF) package that carries a work product together with compiled context, evidence, provenance, and rules for subsequent interaction. To test whether this context remains useful beyond the process that produced it, we evaluate four new packages, created after the hosted and offline readers were fixed: an investment proposal, fund research, financial-statement analysis, and an engineering incident review. Two packages were produced by specialized agents and two through a general-purpose assistant's packaging skill. Across 400 frozen questions and 12,000 evaluated responses, a hosted governed reader succeeds on 96% of questions versus 86% with instructions plus raw-file retrieval (Holm-adjusted p < 10^-7). On the 260 answerable questions per condition, success is 94% versus 79%; the gap varies by package. Source-material chat and instructions alone reach 48% and 74% overall. A separate 0.8-billion-parameter offline reader succeeds on 69% overall, but 54% on answerable questions. Its -1 response rate is 2.9%, combining materially wrong and unauthorized answers, versus 56% with the source and instructions alone. Ablations suggest advantages for the integrated selector and package-adapted writer, without isolating representation from training effects. The same run exposes a failure: offline retrieval resolves none of the 40 historical-record questions in one financial-data package. These findings support treating compiled knowledge as part of the delivered work product, while leaving independent standards interoperability and end-to-end governance conformance unproven.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"可移植智能体格式"(PAF)包，将工作成果与编译后的上下文、证据、溯源及交互规则一同交付；在4个新包、400道冻结问题、12,000次响应上验证其效用。
AI.motivation: 传统文档只保留专业工作的可见结果，却丢失了背后的研究、计算、假设、证据与授权边界，导致后续交互无法复用这些上下文。
AI.method: 提出PAF包作为新的交付单元，内置编译上下文、证据、溯源与交互规则。用4个新包（投资提案、基金研究、财报分析、工程事故复盘；2个由专用智能体生成、2个由通用助手的打包技能生成）与400道冻结问题开展对比评测，对比"托管式受控阅读器"与"指令+原始文件检索"、"仅源材料对话"、"仅指令"等基线；并评测0.8B参数离线阅读器，另做消融分析。
AI.result: 托管阅读器整体成功率96% vs 基线86%（Holm校正p<10^-7）；260道可答题上94% vs 79%，差距因包而异。仅源材料对话48%、仅指令74%。0.8B离线阅读器整体69%、可答题54%，"-1"（错误或越权）率2.9% vs 基线56%。离线检索在某金融数据包的40道历史记录题上全部失败。
AI.conclusion: 支持将编译知识视为交付工作成果的一部分；但独立标准互操作性与端到端治理合规性尚未得到证明。

title: Multimodal Graph Learning: A Survey of Models, Benchmarks, and Frontiers
summary: Multimodal attributed graphs (MAGs), in which nodes carry text, images, and other modalities while edges encode relations among entities, underlie e-commerce, social media, content platforms, and creative applications. Learning on MAGs has developed along two complementary lines: graph-centric methods redesign how modalities are fused, propagated, and connected within message passing, while foundation-model-centric methods pretrain transferable multimodal graph encoders or bring graph context into multimodal large language models for prediction and generation. In parallel, several benchmarks have appeared with different datasets and evaluation protocols. This survey takes an algorithm-centric and evaluation-grounded view of the field and makes three contributions. Modeling: we introduce a unified message-passing formulation and organize methods into five integration levels (feature, propagation, topology, learning, and foundation model), covering discriminative and graph-conditioned generative models; within this formulation we derive representative methods as special cases, compare their assumptions, expressiveness, and cost, and identify cross-modal sensitivity as a property that separates otherwise similar architectures. Datasets and evaluation: we review recent benchmarks, summarize their datasets and metrics, define model-independent descriptors (label homophily, average degree, clustering, and edge provenance), and map each evaluation protocol to the baselines it uses. Frontiers: we connect multimodal graph learning to AI agents, covering the multimodal graphs that agents perceive and remember and graph engineering, the practice of organizing agent workflows as explicit graphs; we then discuss open problems, concrete efforts for the community, and research directions, including when graph structure helps in the presence of strong multimodal foundation models.

AI.tldr: 该综述以算法为中心、以评测为依托系统梳理多模态属性图（MAG）学习：提出统一消息传递公式并将方法归为五个集成层次，同时整理基准、数据集、指标与协议，并展望与AI智能体的结合。
AI.motivation: MAG广泛存在于电商、社交媒体、内容平台与创意应用中，但研究沿图中心与基础模型中心两条路线并行发展，基准的数据集与评测协议各自为政，缺乏统一的形式化框架与评测视角来比较方法与结果。
AI.method: 提出统一的消息传递公式，把代表性方法推导为该公式的特例；按特征、传播、拓扑、学习、基础模型五个集成层级组织方法，涵盖判别式与图条件生成模型，并比较其假设、表达力与开销，提出"跨模态敏感性"作为区分相似架构的性质；综述近期基准，定义模型无关描述子（标签同质性、平均度、聚类系数、边来源）并将评测协议映射到所用基线；最后连接AI智能体（智能体感知与记忆的多模态图、图工程）。
AI.result: 给出一个可统一容纳图中心与基础模型中心方法的消息传递框架，明确各方法的假设、表达力与计算成本差异；形成基准数据集、指标与协议的对照表，并识别出跨模态敏感性这一关键区分性质；还梳理了面向智能体场景的多模态图与图工程实践。
AI.conclusion: 多模态图学习需要统一的算法表述与标准化评测；未来应关注智能体环境下的多模态图、社区层面的具体推进举措，以及"在强大多模态基础模型存在时图结构何时真正有益"等开放问题。

title: AI Governance Should Prioritize Control and Knowledge Boundaries Over Limiting Intelligence
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Position Paper Track
summary: The rapid proliferation of autonomously acting AI agents makes the governance of agentic systems urgent. We propose the competence circuit, summarized as IKC + KC + C, that decomposes an agent's real-world impact into three pathways: intelligence-mediated discovery, procedural know-how, and direct control. Using the canonical fast-takeoff debate as a stress test, we formalize the conditions for intelligence-mediated fast takeoff as a conjunction jointly sufficient for fast catastrophic supremacy, showing that most rely on rapid knowledge acquisition or control attainment rather than intelligence alone. We operationalize epistemic intelligence as hypothesis-selection efficiency and validate this framework via stochastic simulation on NK fitness landscapes across six scenarios spanning the conjunctive chain. An analytic bound supported by the simulations shows that intelligence-driven speedup is capped by the ratio of competing intelligence levels regardless of task difficulty. The simulations also expose a fast-takeoff dilemma: a large intelligence-driven speedup multiplier materializes only when the hypothesis space is noisy, but the absolute timescale remains constrained by the time required for capability-critical tests, so a large multiplier need not imply rapid progress. Simulations also indicate that institutional chokepoints disproportionately slow down superintelligent agents when mandatory authorization delays are large relative to the negligible time these agents spend on unproductive search. We argue that the dominant safety levers are restricting control and enforcing knowledge boundaries rather than limiting intelligence alone, and this applies to agentic systems at any capability level. Purely digital domains weaken these bottlenecks, strengthening the case for architectures that intentionally "put physics in the loop."

AI.tldr: 论文提出"能力回路"(IKC+KC+C)框架，将AI智能体的现实影响分解为智能介导的发现、程序性知识、直接控制三条路径，并用NK适应度景观模拟检验智能是否能单独导致"快速起飞"。
AI.motivation: 自主AI智能体迅速普及使治理迫在眉睫；既有"快速起飞"争论常把智能等同于影响力来源，需澄清何种条件下智能才真正驱动快速且灾难性的能力跃升。
AI.method: 将经典fast-takeoff论证作为压力测试，形式化"智能介导快速起飞"为若干条件之合取；把认知智能操作化为假设选择效率，在六种情境下用NK适应度景观做随机模拟，并给出解析上界。
AI.result: 解析上界与模拟一致：智能驱动的加速被竞争智能水平之比所封顶，与任务难度无关；模拟揭示"快速起飞两难"——大的加速倍数只在假设空间嘈杂时出现，但绝对时间尺度受关键能力测试耗时约束；当强制授权延迟相对智能体无效搜索时间足够大时，制度性关卡不成比例地拖慢超级智能体。
AI.conclusion: 主导的安全杠杆是限制控制权与设定知识边界，而非单纯限制智能，且对任意能力水平的智能体系统均适用；纯数字域会削弱这些瓶颈，故应支持"把物理放进回路"的架构设计。

title: Evidence-Grounded Iterative Reasoning for the Diagnosis of Diffuse Cystic Lung Diseases
summary: Overlapping imaging manifestations complicate the differential diagnosis of Diffuse Cystic Lung Diseases (DCLDs), while limited annotated data constrain supervised model development. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can integrate imaging and clinical information, but their diagnostic reasoning remains limited by incomplete volumetric perception and insufficient grounding in disease-specific evidence. We propose DCLDs-EIR, an evidence-grounded iterative reasoning framework coupling diagnostic hypothesis refinement with multimodal evidence acquisition and verification. Multiview renderings of predicted lung and cyst segmentations characterize global cyst distributions and initialize the differential diagnosis. Competing hypotheses guide axial CT inspection to identify local findings that, together with clinical context, inform retrieval from a disease-specific knowledge graph. Accumulated patient observations and retrieved knowledge are jointly assessed for diagnostic support and refutation to revise the diagnostic state. Updated hypotheses and unresolved distinctions guide subsequent inspection, forming a feedback loop between evidence acquisition and hypothesis verification. Multicenter evaluation demonstrates that DCLDs-EIR consistently improves diagnostic accuracy over baselines and enables traceable differential diagnosis through explicit links between diagnostic hypotheses, patient observations, and disease-specific knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出DCLDs-EIR，一个证据驱动的迭代推理框架，将诊断假设修正与多模态证据获取和验证耦合，用于弥漫性囊性肺疾病（DCLDs）的鉴别诊断，在多中心评估中稳定优于基线并实现可追溯诊断。
AI.motivation: DCLDs影像表现重叠，鉴别诊断困难；标注数据有限制约监督模型开发。多模态大模型（MLLMs）虽能整合影像与临床信息，但存在体视感知不完整、缺乏疾病特异性证据支撑等推理局限。
AI.method: 1）基于预测的肺与囊肿分割生成多视角渲染，刻画全局囊腔分布并初始化鉴别诊断；2）由竞争性假设引导轴向CT逐层检查以发现局部征象，结合临床上下文从疾病特异性知识图谱检索证据；3）联合评估累积的患者观察与检索知识，进行支持与反驳判断以更新诊断状态；4）以更新后的假设和未解决的鉴别点引导后续检查，形成证据获取与假设验证的反馈闭环。
AI.result: 多中心评估显示，DCLDs-EIR在诊断准确率上持续优于基线方法，并可通过诊断假设、患者观察与疾病特异性知识之间的显式链接实现可追溯的鉴别诊断。
AI.conclusion: 将分割/渲染的全局感知、假设引导的局部影像检查与知识图谱证据检索结合为迭代反馈推理，可有效提升MLLM在DCLDs鉴别诊断中的准确性与可解释性。

title: Capacity Allocation at the Source: Sparse Target Optimization for LLM Knowledge Editing
summary: Knowledge editing has emerged as a promising approach for efficiently updating embedded knowledge in large language models (LLMs). It first computes an ideal target hidden state that steers the LLM toward the new output, and then edits the model parameters so that the original hidden state is mapped to this target. While most existing methods focus on the second stage of parameter editing in preserving other knowledge, we find that the upstream construction of the target hidden state also plays an important role in allocating the model's limited capacity space. We first establish a theoretical connection between interference in the parameter space and interference between target hidden states, showing that the two are positively correlated. Building on this insight, we propose a simple yet effective $\ell_1$ regularization method that prunes away unnecessary ``tentacles'' of each knowledge vector, retaining only the essential components. With fewer extraneous tentacles, each edit affects less other knowledge, enabling better coexistence. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmark datasets verify the effectiveness of our method. Code: https://github.com/wintersdragon-c/STO.

AI.tldr: 论文发现知识编辑中目标隐状态构建会通过隐状态间干扰影响参数空间干扰，并提出 ℓ1 正则剪枝冗余分量的方法减少编辑干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑方法多聚焦于第二阶段参数编辑以保留其他知识，但作者发现上游的目标隐状态构建同样影响模型有限容量空间的分配，需要解决这一问题。
AI.method: 首先建立参数空间干扰与目标隐状态之间干扰正相关的理论联系；据此提出简单的 ℓ1 正则方法，剪除每个知识向量不必要的"触手"(tentacles)，仅保留关键分量。
AI.result: 在多个大语言模型和基准数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性（代码已开源）。
AI.conclusion: 减少知识向量的冗余分量可使每次编辑影响更少其他知识，实现更好的知识共存，表明优化目标隐状态构建是提升知识编辑效果的重要途径。

title: From Search to Decision: How Post-Training Shapes Information-Seeking Capabilities in Large Language Models
summary: Information seeking in large language model (LLM) systems increasingly involves decisions about when to acquire information, where to search, and how to evaluate and use evidence. Recent post-training methods have improved several such behaviors, but their objectives and evaluations span different tasks and system settings. This paper organizes research around six interrelated information-seeking capabilities and examines the learning signals, optimization methods, update loci, and credit-assignment mechanisms used to develop them. We synthesize empirical progress in targeted behaviors, end-to-end performance, search control, and generalization. Existing studies report gains in retrieval routing, query refinement, multi-tool exploration, evidence-grounded reasoning, and resource-aware search, although the scope of behavioral evidence varies across capabilities. We identify open challenges in estimating prospective retrieval utility, coordinating information-seeking decisions, and adapting to unfamiliar retrieval environments, and discuss evaluation practices for interpreting future progress.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇综述：围绕LLM信息寻求的六项核心能力，梳理学习信号、优化方法、更新位置与信用分配机制，并总结实证进展与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: LLM系统的信息寻求日益涉及"何时获取信息、去哪检索、如何评估与使用证据"等决策；近期后训练方法虽改善了部分行为，但目标与评测分散在不同任务和系统设定中，缺乏统一整理。
AI.method: 综述性工作：将研究组织为六项相互关联的信息寻求能力，按学习信号、优化方法、模型更新位置（update loci）与信用分配机制四个维度进行比较分析，并归纳评测实践。
AI.result: 综合了在定向行为、端到端性能、搜索控制与泛化方面的实证进展；已有研究报告在检索路由、查询改写、多工具探索、证据支撑推理与资源感知搜索上均有提升，但各能力的行为证据范围不一致。
AI.conclusion: 指出三大开放挑战——预估检索的前瞻效用、协调多项信息寻求决策、适应陌生检索环境；并讨论未来进展解读所需的评测规范。

title: ABRR: Transforming Temporal Sentence Grounding with Wasserstein-Adaptive Refinement and Precision Ranking
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
summary: Temporal Sentence Grounding (TSG) aims to localize temporal segments in untrimmed videos that correspond to natural language queries, a critical task for video understanding with applications in video retrieval, summarization, and human-computer interaction. Despite significant progress driven by transformer-based models, existing TSG methods suffer from two key limitations: quantization errors due to temporal downsampling, which misalign segment boundaries, and suboptimal ranking of predictions based on semantic matching rather than localization precision. To address these challenges, we propose the Adaptive Boundary Refinement and Ranking (ABRR) framework, a novel, model-agnostic post-processing approach that enhances the performance of any TSG model without retraining. ABRR integrates three innovative components: (1) Temporal Distribution Smoothing, which mitigates noise in predicted score distributions using Gaussian kernel convolution; (2) Boundary Refinement via Optimal Transport, which leverages the 2-Wasserstein distance and Sinkhorn iterations to align coarse segment boundaries with true temporal moments, grounded in Monge-Kantorovich optimal transport theory; and (3) Quality-Driven Re-Ranking, which reorders predictions using a composite score balancing localization precision and semantic relevance. By correcting quantization errors and prioritizing accurately localized segments, ABRR achieves substantial improvements over state-of-the-art TSG models. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets, including Charades-STA, ActivityNet Captions, and QVHighlights, demonstrate consistent gains at stringent IoU thresholds (e.g., IoU=0.7), alongside enhanced ranking performance. The framework's computational efficiency and compatibility with existing models make it a versatile and impactful solution for real-world TSG applications.

AI.tldr: 提出模型无关的后处理框架ABRR，通过时间分布平滑、基于最优传输的边界精修与质量驱动重排序，无需重训练即可提升任意TSG模型的定位精度与排序质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的TSG方法存在两大缺陷：时间下采样带来的量化误差导致片段边界错位；预测排序主要依据语义匹配而非定位精度，排序次优。
AI.method: ABRR包含三个组件：(1) 时间分布平滑，用高斯核卷积抑制预测分数分布中的噪声；(2) 基于最优传输的边界精修，利用2-Wasserstein距离与Sinkhorn迭代（基于Monge-Kantorovich理论）将粗粒度边界对齐到真实时间位置；(3) 质量驱动重排序，用兼顾定位精度与语义相关性的复合分数重排预测。整体为模型无关的后处理，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在Charades-STA、ActivityNet Captions、QVHighlights等基准上，严格IoU阈值（如IoU=0.7）下取得一致提升，并改善排序性能；框架计算高效、兼容现有模型。
AI.conclusion: ABRR通过纠正量化误差并优先准确局部化的片段，可作为通用、高效、即插即用的方案提升现有TSG系统性能，适用于实际应用。

title: MiniZoo: An Evolving Dataset of Mini Apps for the Research Community
summary: Mini apps run within host applications (apps) such as WeChat, Alipay, Baidu, and Telegram, providing services without requiring users to install separate native apps. Their growing ecosystem has attracted research on software quality, security, and privacy, creating a need for reusable datasets. However, building and maintaining such datasets is challenging, requiring platform-specific collection infrastructure and mechanisms to handle incomplete packages, changing availability, and heterogeneous metadata. A shared, continuously maintained collection is still lacking, therefore motivating the development of a common research resource, whose value has been demonstrated by the experience of AndroZoo in the Android ecosystem. In this paper, we present MiniZoo, an evolving corpus of mini apps and associated metadata. The initial release comprises 16,273 mini-app packages, with multiple versions of the same mini apps. The dataset is managed and distributed through AndroZoo under its existing access conditions. To facilitate its reuse, we describe the collection process, data organization, provenance, and limitations, and explain how researchers can select and access the data. MiniZoo is designed to grow continuously through the addition of newly discovered mini apps, the inclusion of further host ecosystems, and the collection of successive versions of previously collected apps. This ongoing expansion will enable both comparisons across ecosystems and longitudinal studies of how mini apps evolve over time.

AI.tldr: MiniZoo是一个持续演进的迷你应用（mini apps）语料库，首个版本包含16,273个应用包及多版本，通过AndroZoo分发，旨在为跨生态和纵向研究提供可复用资源。
AI.motivation: 迷你应用生态日益壮大，软件质量、安全和隐私研究需要可复用数据集，但构建与维护数据集面临平台特定的采集基础设施、不完整包、可用性变化和异构元数据等挑战，目前缺乏共享且持续维护的采集资源；AndroZoo在Android生态中的成功经验证明了此类公共研究资源的价值。
AI.method: 构建MiniZoo语料库，收集运行于微信、支付宝、百度、Telegram等宿主应用中的迷你应用包及其元数据；描述采集流程、数据组织、来源溯源与局限性，并通过AndroZoo现有的访问条件管理和分发数据。
AI.result: 初始版本包含16,273个迷你应用包，并含同一应用的多个版本；提供数据选择与访问方式的说明。
AI.conclusion: MiniZoo将持续扩展——加入新发现的迷你应用、纳入更多宿主生态、采集已收集应用的后续版本，从而支持跨生态比较与迷你应用演化的纵向研究。

title: Linear Probes to Bayesian Manifolds: Geometry of Arithmetic in Large Language Models
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 20 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027
summary: Linear probes are a standard method to study geometric structures, such as helices and circles, from the activations of large language models (LLMs), and such structure is often taken as evidence that the model computes with it. Probe accuracy alone cannot establish this, because it conflates four separate claims. These are (1) that the concept is decodable from the activations, (2) that they form a specific shape, (3) that the shape belongs to the probed concept rather than to a related concept the model also represents, and (4) that the output of the model depends on the shape. We call these claims decodability, shape, ownership, and causal use, and we test them separately with a four-stage Bayesian pipeline. Stage 2 compares candidate shapes and selects the best one only when its evidence passes a predefined threshold. Stage 3 removes a set of related concepts, specified in advance, and tests whether the shape is owned or inherited. Stage 4 intervenes on the shape to test whether the output of the model depends on it. We apply the pipeline to two-digit addition and multiplication in GPT-J 6B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Pythia 6.9B. Nearly every concept is decodable, but the decoded directions overlap substantially across concepts. Every strongly supported comparison selects a ribbon, which is a helix whose radius changes with the value, or a torus. Of 1,330 cells with an ownership verdict, 19% of shapes are owned and 81% are inherited. Owned and inherited shapes move the output about equally often. Intervening on the shape retains approximately 61% of the effect of intervening on the full probe while using at most five dimensions, against a median of nine for the probe. Our results indicate that a probe verdict alone overstates what a model computes with, and we propose that probe results be reported as verdicts on all four claims rather than as a single accuracy.

AI.tldr: 线性探针无法单独证明LLM内部计算的几何结构；本文将"探针成功"拆为可解码性、形状、归属、因果四主张，用四阶段贝叶斯流程在GPT-J 6B、Llama 3.1 8B、Pythia 6.9B的双位数加减乘任务上检验，发现多数形状为继承而非专属，且探针结论被高估。
AI.motivation: 线性探针常被用来说明LLM激活中存在螺旋、圆等几何结构，并据此推断模型用该结构计算。但探针准确率混淆了多个独立主张，无法区分"能解码""形状存在""形状属于该概念"以及"输出依赖该形状"，因此需要分别检验这些主张。
AI.method: 提出四阶段贝叶斯流程：阶段1检验可解码性；阶段2比较候选形状，仅当证据超过预设阈值才选择最佳形状；阶段3剔除预先指定的相关概念，判断形状是专属(owned)还是继承(inherited)；阶段4对形状进行干预，检验模型输出是否依赖该形状。应用于GPT-J 6B、Llama 3.1 8B、Pythia 6.9B的双位数加法与乘法任务。
AI.result: 几乎所有概念都可解码，但不同概念的解码方向高度重叠。所有强支持的比较都选出ribbon（半径随数值变化的螺旋）或环面。在1,330个有归属判定的单元中，19%形状为专属，81%为继承；专属与继承形状影响输出的频率大致相当。对形状干预可保留约61%的完整探针干预效应，且最多只用五个维度，而探针中位数为九个。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭探针结果会高估模型实际用于计算的结构。作者建议将探针结果报告为对四个主张的判定，而非单一准确率。

title: Tabular Foundation Models vs Tuned Gradient Boosting for Telecom Churn: A Profit- and Calibration-Aware Evaluation
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 14 tables. Code, per-split predictions and reproducibility audit: https://github.com/ihpolash/tfm-churn-profit-audit (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24015719)
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) predict from a labelled context in a single forward pass. A recent benchmark reported that they decisively outperform tree ensembles for customer churn, but it compared them with untuned gradient-boosted trees (GBDTs) and scored only ranking metrics, while a retention campaign is judged in money. We re-evaluate TabPFN-2.5, TabPFN-3.5, TabPFN-3.5-Fast and TabICL v2 against Optuna-tuned GBDTs on five public telecom churn datasets over 10 seeded splits. We separate three questions: whether a model ranks churners well, whether that ranking earns more expected maximum profit (EMP), and whether its probabilities can drive a threshold policy. With a split-aware test and Holm correction over 20 pre-declared comparisons, TabPFN-3.5 earns significantly more EMP than the best tuned GBDT on Cell2Cell (1.9%) and Iranian (7.6%), and these two gains also hold against each of the three tuned GBDTs separately. On Orange it is ahead in all 10 splits (14.3%), but the gain is not significant after correction (Holm p = 0.155). The splits resample the same datasets, so these results do not stand for independent operators. TabICL v2, the earlier benchmark's leader, beats the best tuned GBDT only on Iranian, not all three of them, and underpredicts Orange churn by 2.1 points on a 7.3% base rate. On the datasets and splits where we tested them, a substantially larger tuning budget and a duplicate-aware split leave the main conclusions unchanged. Retuning the baseline cuts the earlier headline gap from 6.1 to 4.0 PR-AUC points without closing it. The licence of the TabPFN-3.5 weights we used (License v1.0), not scoring cost, is what stands between its gains and production use.

AI.tldr: 在五个电信流失数据集、10 个种子划分上，用 Optuna 调优的 GBDT 重新对照 TabPFN-2.5/3.5/3.5-Fast 与 TabICL v2，并同时看排序、期望最大利润（EMP）和阈值策略；TabPFN-3.5 在 EMP 上显著优于最佳调优 GBDT（Cell2Cell +1.9%，Iranian +7.6%），Orange 虽 10/10 领先但不显著。
AI.motivation: 先前基准宣称表格基础模型（TFM）在客户流失预测上"决定性"优于树集成，但其对比对象是未调优的 GBDT，且只报告排序指标，而留存活动的真实评价标准是金钱收益。
AI.method: 将 TabPFN-2.5/3.5/3.5-Fast、TabICL v2 与 Optuna 调优的 GBDT 在五个公开电信流失数据集、10 个种子划分上对比；分离三类问题（排序质量、EMP 收益、概率能否支撑阈值决策）；采用考虑划分结构的检验 + Holm 校正，覆盖 20 个预声明比较；并做更大调参预算与去重感知划分的稳健性检验。
AI.result: TabPFN-3.5 在 Cell2Cell（+1.9%）和 Iranian（+7.6%）上显著获得更高 EMP，且对三个调优 GBDT 分别成立；Orange 上 10/10 划分领先（+14.3%）但 Holm 校正后不显著（p=0.155）。TabICL v2 仅在 Iranian 上胜出，且在 Orange 上把 7.3% 的基础流失率低估 2.1 个百分点。重调基线把原有 PR-AUC 差距从 6.1 分缩小到 4.0 分但未消除。
AI.conclusion: TFM 的利润优势在部分数据集上真实存在，但并非普遍显著；划分重采样同一数据集，结论不能外推到独立运营商；阻碍 TabPFN-3.5 落地的关键不是评分成本，而是其权重许可（License v1.0）。

title: khammoon: From a Linguistic Guideline to a Thai Morpheme Segmenter
comment: Technical Report. Code, models, and data are available at https://github.com/warit-s/khammoon-segmenter
summary: Thai is written without spaces between words, making segmentation a foundational step in most Thai NLP pipelines. Existing tools primarily reproduce the word-level conventions of corpora such as BEST; however, because the notion of a "word" in Thai lacks a unified linguistic consensus, these conventions struggle with productive compounding, leading to arbitrary boundaries and ambiguity in downstream representations. Instead, we propose operating at the morphological level, focusing on khammoon, the smallest atomic unit that carries meaning. Segmenting at the morphemic level provides an explicit, consistent morphological representation that eliminates compounding ambiguity. Crucially, this representation benefits downstream learning: models trained on morphemes perform on par with or exceed word-level baselines across part-of-speech tagging, named-entity recognition, and sentiment classification, demonstrating that linguistic consistency improves representation quality without downstream performance penalty. To operationalize this representation, we translate linguistic principles into a formal decision guideline with near-perfect human agreement ($κ\approx 0.99$), scale annotation with an LLM, and correct systematic errors with human labels. Finally, we train khammoon, a lightweight 1M-parameter convolutional BiLSTM segmenter designed for efficient CPU inference, achieving a boundary F1 of 0.992 on out-of-domain text. The guideline, datasets, model, and library are all publicly released.

AI.tldr: 泰文无空格，分词是基础步骤。本文提出在形态层（khammoon，最小意义原子单位）进行切分，以消除复合词歧义，并证明该表示在下游任务中不劣于词级基线。
AI.motivation: 现有泰文分词工具沿用BEST等语料的"词"级约定，但泰语"词"缺乏统一语言学共识，面对能产性复合词时边界任意、表示歧义，影响下游任务。
AI.method: 将语言学原则形式化为决策指南（人工一致性κ≈0.99），用LLM扩展标注并用人工标签纠正系统错误；训练khammoon——1M参数的卷积BiLSTM轻量分词器，面向CPU高效推理。
AI.result: 在域外文本上边界F1达0.992；基于形态素的模型在词性标注、命名实体识别、情感分类上与词级基线持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: 形态层切分提供显式一致的形态表示，消除复合词歧义，提升表示质量且不损害下游性能；指南、数据、模型与库均开源发布。

title: SHARP: Semantic Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for Next POI Prediction with Dynamic Memory
summary: Next point-of-interest (POI) prediction supports personalized location services by anticipating users' next destinations. Recent methods leverage large language models (LLMs) for semantic reasoning and graphs for collective mobility modeling, improving POI prediction. However, three challenges still remain. Bridging LLMs' semantic reasoning and specific POI prediction remains challenging. User mobility also evolves over time, making it necessary to retain and update historical knowledge within limited LLM contexts. Meanwhile, global transition graphs smooth out time-specific category transition patterns. To address these challenges, we propose Semantic Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for Next POI Prediction with Dynamic Memory (SHARP), an agentic hierarchical framework in which category-level reasoning guides specific POI prediction. A trajectory memory agent maintains a dynamic trajectory memory bank that preserves earlier mobility patterns and tracks behavioral changes with limited context growth.
