We construct multi-granularity time-aware category transition graphs with global and time-conditioned views to preserve temporal regularities obscured by global aggregation. A category predict agent combines these graphs with trajectory memory to predict likely next categories. SHARP learns semantic IDs (SIDs) through a residual-quantized variational autoencoder (RQ-VAE) to construct semantic POI representations, which are jointly optimized with a category-guided POI predictor end-to-end. On three real-world datasets, SHARP improves Acc@5 and Acc@10 by an average of 5.29 and 4.52 percentage points, respectively, over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: SHARP是一个层次化智能体框架，用类别级推理引导具体POI预测，结合轨迹记忆库、多粒度时间感知类别转移图与RQ-VAE语义ID，在三个真实数据集的Acc@5/Acc@10上平均提升5.29/4.52个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有结合LLM语义推理与图模型的方法存在三方面挑战：(1) LLM语义推理与具体POI预测之间难以桥接；(2) 用户移动性随时间演化，需在有限LLM上下文内保留并更新历史知识；(3) 全局转移图会抹平特定时段的类别转移模式。
AI.method: 提出SHARP：①轨迹记忆智能体维护动态轨迹记忆库，在上下文受限增长下保留早期模式并追踪行为变化；②构建含全局与时间条件视图的多粒度时间感知类别转移图；③类别预测智能体融合图与记忆预测下一类别，再由类别引导的POI预测器输出具体POI；④用RQ-VAE学习语义ID构建POI语义表示，与预测器端到端联合优化。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界数据集上，相比最强基线，Acc@5与Acc@10平均分别提升5.29和4.52个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以类别级推理为中介、结合动态记忆与时间感知图的分层智能体设计，可有效缓解LLM语义与POI预测之间的鸿沟并捕捉时序规律，显著提升下一POI预测性能。

title: AgentScript-Eval: Benchmarking LLMs and Agents for Code Generation in an Enterprise DSL
comment: Accepted to 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET), NeurIPS 2026
summary: Domain-specific languages (DSLs) are widely used in enterprise software, giving a compact interface to complex tasks, from data access to infrastructure automation. Platforms increasingly extend them to agents, where a developer declares the topics, permitted actions, and guardrails of an agent rather than writing general-purpose code. Large language models (LLMs) write general-purpose code well, but that ability has been measured almost entirely on languages abundant in public pretraining data, and enterprise DSLs are neither abundant nor public. We introduce AgentScript-Eval, an execution-graded benchmark of 100 real tasks for AgentScript, the declarative DSL that Salesforce uses in Agentforce to build conversational agents. Tasks span authoring an agent from a specification, debugging a broken definition, and optimizing a working one. Evaluating five models zero-shot, we find that the regime is hard: the best model reaches only 25.0% pass@3, and every model scores 0% on authoring from scratch. We further find that model scale and price are weak predictors of success -- a 31B open-weight model attains the highest compilation rate of any model tested (48.0%) and matches the strongest frontier model on partial-credit accuracy at the lowest token cost. Adding an agentic compile-and-edit loop is the single largest lever, roughly doubling partial-credit accuracy. Beyond that gain, the wording of domain guidance matters more than its packaging. The same skill pack scores 28% as plain documentation but only 14% as a live plugin. Rewriting one skill inside that plugin then raises it to 37%, our best result, with catalog and tooling untouched. Larger models did not reliably outperform smaller ones; what mattered was the harness surrounding the model and the guidance supplied to it.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentScript-Eval，一个针对企业级 DSL（Salesforce AgentScript）的 100 任务执行评测基准，发现当前 LLM 在该领域零样本表现极差（最佳 pass@3 仅 25%，从零编写全部 0%）。
AI.motivation: LLM 编写通用代码的能力几乎只在预训练数据丰富的公开语言上被评测过，而企业 DSL 既不公开也不丰富。随着平台将 DSL 扩展到 agent 构建（声明话题、允许动作与护栏），亟需衡量模型在这类稀缺语言上的真实能力。
AI.method: 构建 AgentScript-Eval：100 个真实任务，覆盖从规格编写 agent、调试损坏定义、优化可用定义三类；采用执行级评分为主的零样本评测，测试五个模型，并对比 agentic compile-and-edit 循环、领域指导的不同呈现形式（文档 / 插件 / 改写技能）等干预。
AI.result: 最佳模型 pass@3 仅 25.0%，所有模型从零编写均 0%；模型规模与价格对成功的预测力弱——31B 开源模型编译率最高（48.0%），并在最低 token 成本下达到与最强前沿模型相当的部分得分精度；加入 agentic 编译-编辑循环约使部分得分翻倍；同一技能包作为文档得分 28%、作为 live plugin 仅 14%，改写插件内单个技能后升至 37%（最佳）。
AI.conclusion: 企业 DSL 对 LLM 是困难且非规模驱动的设定；决定成败的是模型外围的 harness 与所提供的指导，其措辞比打包形式更重要，而非模型大小。

title: One Table, Many Queries: Benchmarking Generalist Tabular Models Across Generation, Imputation, and Prediction
summary: Generation, imputation, and prediction query different aspects of the same tabular distribution, but are usually evaluated separately. This leaves unclear which capabilities they share, how their training objectives interact, and whether one model can perform all three well. We introduce the One Table Benchmark (\ours{}), spanning 56 datasets, 46 registered methods, and 20 capability axes under aligned data splits and explicit task contracts. We compare task ranks on aligned support, train five backbones under all seven non-empty objective combinations on five datasets with three seeds, and contrast fixed-model profiles with specialist portfolios. Rank comparisons connect imputation and prediction through numerical recovery and dependence preservation, and link generation to both through predictive utility; distributional fidelity follows different, sometimes opposing, rankings. Objective interventions show the largest pooled gains from including the recipient's own objective. Generation has the broadest coverage of positive pooled auxiliary effects, while prediction shows potential to improve imputation and synthetic-data utility, with responses that vary across backbones. Cross-addition effects reveal that objective benefits need not add and depend on the objectives already present. Fixed-model comparisons expose corresponding utility--fidelity trade-offs: some generalists surpass specialist portfolios on utility, while fidelity continues to favor specialization. Frozen foundation models show strong prediction and numerical point imputation, together with promising synthetic-data utility, highlighting their potential across all three tasks. These findings motivate unified tabular models that share useful conditional information while improving categorical reconstruction and faithful joint sampling.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 One Table Benchmark（ours{}=OTB?），用 56 个数据集、46 种注册方法与 20 个能力轴在统一数据划分和显式任务契约下比较生成、插补、预测三类表格任务；通过任务排序对比、五种骨干在 7 种非空目标组合下的训练实验，以及固定模型与专家组合的对照，揭示三者共享与差异化的能力结构及目标间交互效应。
AI.motivation: 生成、插补与预测是同一表格分布的不同查询侧面，但以往分开评测，导致不清楚它们共享哪些能力、训练目标如何相互作用、以及单一模型能否同时胜任三者。因此需要统一的评测框架与受控的目标组合实验。
AI.method: 构建 OTB 基准：56 数据集、46 方法、20 能力轴，对齐数据划分并给出显式任务契约。方法包括：(1) 在对齐支撑集上比较任务排名；(2) 在 5 个数据集、3 个随机种子上，用 5 种骨干训练全部 7 种非空目标组合，做目标干预与交叉叠加分析；(3) 对比固定模型画像与专家组合（specialist portfolio）；(4) 评测冻结的基座模型。
AI.result: 排名比较表明，插补与预测通过数值恢复和依赖保持相关联，生成通过预测效用与二者相连；分布保真度的排名不同、甚至与效用相反。目标干预显示：纳入接收任务自身目标带来的汇总增益最大；生成的正向辅助效应覆盖最广，预测有潜力提升插补与合成数据效用，且响应随骨干不同；目标收益不必然可加。固定模型上存在效用—保真度权衡：部分通才在效用上超过专家组合，保真度仍依靠专精。冻结基座模型在预测与数值点插补上强，合成数据效用亦有前景。
AI.conclusion: 三类任务共享有用的条件信息但保真度需求各异；应发展统一的表格模型，在共享条件信息的同时改进类别重建与忠实的联合采样，并关注目标组合的可加性问题与骨干依赖性。

title: SetPrint: Black-Box LLM Fingerprinting via Setwise Correspondence of Response Changes
summary: Black-box LLM fingerprinting aims to determine whether a target model was derived from a source model when only the output responses to input queries are observable. One way to reveal this relationship is to perturb each query and observe the resulting responses of both models, yielding two corresponding sets of response variations. These sets provide two complementary sources of information: the relations among response changes within each set, and the correspondence of response changes between the two sets. Existing approaches, however, have not fully exploited both. We introduce \textbf{SetPrint}, a training-free method that jointly captures both within-set relations and between-set correspondence. SetPrint expresses each response change relative to the mean change of its own set, and then compares changes from the two models that were induced by the same perturbation. On LeaFBench, SetPrint consistently outperforms existing training-free black-box fingerprinting methods. Further analyses attribute these gains to both within-set relations and between-set correspondence.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的黑盒LLM指纹方法SetPrint，同时利用扰动响应变化集合的"集内关系"与"集间对应关系"判断目标模型是否派生自源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有黑盒指纹方法对每个查询施加扰动、观察两模型响应变化形成的两组集合，但未同时充分利用两组信息：集内（响应变化之间的关系）与集间（两集合响应变化的对应）。
AI.method: SetPrint为免训练方法：将每个响应变化表示为其相对所属集合平均变化的偏差，再比较两模型在同一扰动下产生的相应变化，从而联合刻画集内关系与集间对应。
AI.result: 在LeaFBench上，SetPrint持续优于现有免训练黑盒指纹方法；消融分析表明收益同时来自集内关系与集间对应两部分。
AI.conclusion: 联合利用集内与集间信息能有效提升黑盒指纹判别性能，且无需训练即可实现。

title: PhysMoE: Fast Spatial Grounding with Single-Token Coordinate Representation in Modality-Decoupled VLMs
summary: Embodied Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are backbones for robotic planning and manipulation. However, for coordinate prediction in grounding tasks, existing architectures suffer from two distinct bottlenecks: discrete tokenization disrupts spatial continuity with high decoding latency, while standard point regression fails on multi-contact affordances and irregularly shaped targets. To resolve these challenges, we propose PhysMoE, introducing three core contributions: (1) sharing lower layers for multimodal context while routing upper layers to specialized spatial (pixel) and linguistic (text) experts by physical modality, eliminating gradient interference; (2) encoding each coordinate as a single token by reusing the visual encoder's learned positional embeddings, injecting 2D spatial priors to natively align coordinates with visual features and ease training; and (3) differentiable Signed Distance Field (SDF) supervision on pointing, accommodating affordances and irregular geometries without costly mask decoders. Compared to the base model, PhysMoE achieves a 15.7% average gain and an 8.31x throughput speedup across 9 coordinate-based grounding benchmarks (trajectory, affordance, and localization), while preserving multimodal understanding and reasoning across 11 text-based embodied benchmarks.

AI.tldr: PhysMoE：模态路由 + 单Token坐标编码 + 可微SDF监督，兼顾精度、速度与多模态理解。
AI.motivation: 具身VLM在grounding任务中坐标预测存在双瓶颈：离散token化破坏空间连续性且解码延迟高；标准点回归难以处理多接触affordance和不规则目标形状。
AI.method: 三点贡献：(1) 底层共享多模态上下文，上层按物理模态路由到空间(像素)专家与语言(文本)专家，消除梯度干扰；(2) 复用视觉编码器学到的位置嵌入，将每个坐标编码为单token，注入2D空间先验使坐标与视觉特征原生对齐；(3) 对pointing施加可微SDF监督，无需昂贵mask解码器即可适配affordance与不规则几何。
AI.result: 相比基座模型，在9个基于坐标的grounding基准（轨迹、affordance、定位）上平均提升15.7%，吞吐加速8.31倍，同时在11个文本具身基准上保持多模态理解与推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过专家路由解耦模态、位置嵌入复用实现高效坐标token化、SDF监督适配复杂几何，PhysMoE在精度与效率上同时获益，且不牺牲通用具身推理能力。

title: The Indic Token Tax in 2026: Measuring Tokenizer. Disparity and Its Cost for the Languages of India
summary: Commercial language model APIs bill per token, so a tokenizer that needs more tokens for the same content in one language makes that language more expensive, slower, and able to fit less text in a fixed context window. We measure this disparity for nine public tokenizers, including those of GPT-4, GPT-4o, Qwen2.5, DeepSeek-V3, Mistral-Nemo and four Sarvam models, on all 25 languages of India available in FLORES-200 (2,009 professionally translated sentences aligned with English) and on 13,732 human-translated Hinglish-English social media pairs from PHINC. On GPT-4o's tokenizer the same content needs between 1.57 times (Hindi) and 5.01 times (Odia) the tokens of English, and 13.7 times for Santali in Ol Chiki script; GPT-4's tokenizer needs up to 12.8 times. Sarvam-30B/105B is the only third-party tokenizer that stays below 2.6 times on every language (median 1.53). In an illustrative scenario using official list prices accessed on 5 November 2026 and stated assumptions, a support bot handling 100,000 chats a month on GPT-4o would cost about INR 56,640 in English and INR 102,829 in Marathi; these are estimates, not measured production costs. Against an openly licensed Hindi and Marathi morphological segmentation set, no tokenizer places more than 35% of its word-internal boundaries on morpheme boundaries (boundary F1 at most 0.48). In a companion paper we present a tokenizer that reduces this tax. Code, pinned artifacts and raw token counts are available at https://github.com/HavonAI/indic-token-tax.

AI.tldr: 论文测量了9个公开分词器在印度25种语言及Hinglish数据上的"token税"：GPT-4o对同一内容的token数是英语的1.57–5.01倍（Santali达13.7倍），GPT-4高达12.8倍；仅Sarvam模型在所有语言低于2.6倍。成本示例中GPT-4o客服机器人印地/马拉地语月成本显著高于英语，且各分词器词内边界与形态素边界对齐度低（F1≤0.48）。
AI.motivation: 商业LLM API按token计费，同一内容在某语言需要更多token会导致该语言更贵、更慢、固定上下文窗口内可容纳文本更少。论文旨在量化这种跨语言（尤其印度语言）的不公平性。
AI.method: 在FLORES-200全部25种印度语言（2,009句专业翻译，与英语对齐）及PHINC中13,732对人工翻译的Hinglish-英语社交媒体句对上，评测9个公开分词器（GPT-4、GPT-4o、Qwen2.5、DeepSeek-V3、Mistral-Nemo及4个Sarvam模型）的token膨胀比；并用公开授权的印地语/马拉地语形态切分集评估词内边界与形态素边界的一致性（边界F1）；结合官方价格构造成本示例。
AI.result: GPT-4o分词器：同一内容token数为英语的1.57倍（印地语）至5.01倍（奥里亚语），Ol Chiki文字的Santali达13.7倍；GPT-4最高12.8倍。Sarvam-30B/105B是唯一在所有语言低于2.6倍（中位1.53）的第三方分词器。成本示例（2026年11月5日官方价格、含假设）：GPT-4o客服机器人每月10万次对话，英语约INR 56,640，马拉地语约INR 102,829（估算非实测）。所有分词器词内边界落在形态素边界上的比例不超过35%，边界F1最高0.48。
AI.conclusion: 印度语言在当前主流分词器下面临显著"token税"，推高成本、降低速度并压缩有效上下文；分词器对形态结构利用不足。作者在配套论文中提出可降低该税的分词器，并公开代码、固定工件与原始token计数。

title: FERN: Cross-Benchmark Table Retrieval for Text-to-SQL with Frozen Retrievers and Learned Ranking
summary: Text-to-SQL systems over large pooled catalogs must first retrieve the tables a question needs. We compare against the published table recall of RASL, which uses Claude 3.5 models to extract keywords and select tables, on pooled BIRD, Spider, and Fiben catalogs. FERN (Feature-Engineered Ranking with No generative LLM) instead fuses three frozen retrievers into 100 candidates, describes each with up to 120 features, and reorders them with LightGBM rankers fitted once on BIRD's training questions. On Spider, where it was not fitted, its candidate pool alone reaches RASL's published recall at fifteen tables (98.0), and the ranker raises the share of questions with every gold table in the top five (complete@5) from 83.9% to 95.6%. At five tables, FERN's recall is within one point of RASL's on Spider (96.7 vs 97.0) and on BIRD with its evidence hints (96.6 vs 97.5), and 8.2 points below on BIRD without them (89.3). On 121 real BEAVER questions, without BEAVER fitting, its recall at fifteen (82.1) falls between two BEAVER-trained retrievers (80.8, 84.5), but its complete@15 is below both (49.6 vs 54.5 and 62.0). On Fiben, it falls far short at fifteen tables (54.2 vs 69.2, different question sets), although its recall at fifty is numerically close to RASL's question-only retrieval result (80.7 vs 79.4). On BIRD dev with evidence, non-retrieval features raise complete@5 by 7.7 points over retrieval signals alone. On BIRD dev, median latency is 208 ms per question on one A100, without hosted model calls.

AI.tldr: FERN，一个不使用生成式LLM的表格检索方法，融合三种冻结检索器的100个候选，用至多120个特征描述并用LightGBM重排序；在Spider上零样本达到RASL召回水平，但在BIRD无提示与Fiben上明显落后，且complete@15不及BEAVER训练的检索器。
AI.motivation: 大规模汇总目录上的Text-to-SQL需先检索问题所需表格。已有方法（如RASL）依赖Claude 3.5等生成式LLM做关键词抽取与选表，成本高且需托管调用。作者希望验证仅靠特征工程与排序学习、不含生成式LLM的方案能否达到相当的表召回。
AI.method: FERN（Feature-Engineered Ranking with No generative LLM）：融合三个冻结检索器得到100个候选表；为每个候选构造至多120个特征；用LightGBM排序器在BIRD训练问题上一次性拟合后重排序。对比对象为RASL已发表的表召回结果，评测集包括汇总的BIRD、Spider、Fiben目录及121个真实BEAVER问题。
AI.result: Spider（未拟合）：候选池在15表处已达RASL召回98.0，排序器将complete@5从83.9%提升至95.6%。5表处：Spider 96.7 vs 97.0，BIRD带证据提示96.6 vs 97.5，BIRD无提示89.3（低8.2点）。BEAVER 121题（未拟合）：15表召回82.1，介于两个BEAVER训练检索器之间（80.8、84.5），但complete@15低（49.6 vs 54.5、62.0）。Fiben：15表54.2 vs 69.2（题目集不同），50表80.7 vs 79.4 接近。BIRD dev带证据时，非检索特征使complete@5较仅检索信号提升7.7点。单张A100中位延迟208ms/题，无需托管模型调用。
AI.conclusion: FERN表明无生成式LLM的特征工程排序可在部分场景（Spider零样本、BIRD带证据）逼近RASL，且延迟低、无外部调用；但在缺少证据提示的BIRD、Fiben和多表全覆盖指标（complete@k）上仍明显弱于LLM方法或领域内训练的检索器。非检索特征对排序贡献显著，是提升complete@5的关键。

title: FlowPlan: Reducing the Token Cost of Coding Agents with Abstraction-Guided Planning and Verification
summary:
LLM-based coding agents such as Claude Code can resolve real-world repository issues, but their iterative interaction loop can be expensive. Existing approaches reduce this cost primarily by limiting, compressing, or selectively avoiding information and actions within the repair process. We investigate a complementary question: Can an agent reason about a repair at an abstract program level, rather than repeatedly operating over raw source code, to reduce both the exploration needed to identify a repair and the repeated checking needed to verify it afterward?
  We present FlowPlan, an abstraction-guided repair approach that structures localization, planning, and verification around per-function control-flow or data-flow graphs. The agent first localizes the candidate fault location on the program abstraction and expresses the intended repair as explicit graph deltas before modifying the concrete source. After the edit, FlowPlan reconstructs the same abstraction and compares the observed structural change with the planned one. Then, a verification checks the complete repair before termination.
  Across all six benchmark-model settings, FlowPlan does not significantly change resolution rate relative to the vanilla agent while reducing token consumption in every setting, significantly in five of six settings. With Claude Haiku 4.5, it uses only 0.46-0.47x the baseline tokens on SWE-bench Pro, 0.32-0.35x on SWE-bench Verified, and 0.68-0.74x on SecBench; with Sonnet 5, it uses 0.72-0.76x, 0.73-0.74x, and 0.92-0.94x, respectively. Overall, FlowPlan achieves the largest token reduction among the compared methods in three of the six settings and ties the strongest compared method in a fourth. Trajectory analysis shows that FlowPlan saves tokens by replacing much of the costly post-edit re-reading and testing with explicit verification and reducing per-call context.

AI.tldr: FlowPlan 用逐函数的控制流/数据流图作为抽象，引导 LLM 编码代理先定位故障、以图增量形式表达修复后再改源码，并通过重建图对比验证修复，从而在不显著影响解决率的前提下大幅降低 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM 编码代理（如 Claude Code）能修复真实仓库问题，但迭代交互昂贵。现有方法主要靠限制、压缩或选择性跳过信息与动作来省成本。作者探索互补思路：能否让代理在抽象程序层面推理修复，而非反复操作原始源码，以减少定位所需探索和事后重复验证。
AI.method: FlowPlan 以逐函数的控制流图或数据流图为核心，将定位、规划、验证结构化：先在抽象图上定位候选故障位置，把预期修复显式表示为图增量，然后才修改具体源码；编辑后重建同一抽象图，比较实际结构变化与计划是否一致；最后做完整修复的验证检查再终止。
AI.result: 六个基准-模型组合中，FlowPlan 相比原始代理解决率无显著变化，但每个设置 token 都下降，其中五个显著。Claude Haiku 4.5 下：SWE-bench Pro 0.46-0.47x、SWE-bench Verified 0.32-0.35x、SecBench 0.68-0.74x；Sonnet 5 下分别为 0.72-0.76x、0.73-0.74x、0.92-0.94x。六个设置中有三个 token 降幅为对比方法中最大，第四个并列最强。轨迹分析显示节省来自用显式验证替代昂贵的编辑后重读与测试，并减少每次调用上下文。
AI.conclusion: 在抽象程序层（控制流/数据流图）上规划与验证修复，是降低编码代理成本的有效互补方向，可在保持解决率的同时显著减少 token 消耗。

title: Branch-and-Commit for Frozen RL Agents: When and Where to Spend Test-Time Compute
summary: Reinforcement learning agents are often deployed with policies that cannot be retrained or modified. In digital environments whose states can be copied and resumed, an operator has another option: sample several continuations from the current state, evaluate them, and continue from the endpoint of the selected branch. We call this procedure branch-and-commit. We study when it improves return, what produces the improvement, and where its computational budget should be spent. Across four environments, two frozen policies, five continuation verifiers, and a model-free selection rule, we find that the benefit of branching depends on dispersion: the difference between the best candidate return and the mean candidate return. Branching provides no benefit in low-dispersion settings, while increasing return by 12.8% in our main Craftax-Medium setting. Most of this gain comes not from selecting better actions, but from selecting among different stochastic realizations of the same action. Several competent verifiers achieve similar episode returns, suggesting that verifier quality is not the main constraint at our operating budget. Instead, computation is better allocated to states where useful dispersion is likely. On held-out seeds, gating branching using predicted dispersion retains 69% of the improvement from uniform branching while using 48% as many branching calls. These results characterize when branch-and-commit is useful and clarify what its gains represent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 branch-and-commit 方法：对冻结策略的当前状态采样多条后续轨迹，评估后选择最优分支继续；实验表明其收益取决于候选间"离散度"，且主要来自同一动作的不同随机实现而非选动作。
AI.motivation: 已部署的 RL 策略往往无法重训或修改，但在状态可复制与恢复的数字环境中，操作者仍可通过采样多条后续并择优继续来提升回报；作者想弄清这种做法的收益来源、适用条件与计算预算应如何分配。
AI.method: 在 4 个环境、2 个冻结策略、5 种续写验证器下，采用无模型的选择规则做分支-提交实验；定义"离散度"为最佳候选回报与平均候选回报之差，并分析收益来源及按预测离散度进行门控（gating）的预算分配策略。
AI.result: 分枝收益依赖离散度：低离散度下无收益，主实验 Craftax-Medium 中回报提升 12.8%；增益主要来自在相同动作的不同随机实现间选择，而非选择更优动作；多种验证器表现相近，说明验证器质量并非主要瓶颈；用预测离散度门控分枝，在留出种子上保留 69% 的改善，仅用 48% 的分枝调用。
AI.conclusion: branch-and-commit 在状态可复制的环境中是一种有效但不普遍的增益手段，其价值由离散度决定，主要体现为对随机性的择优；计算资源宜投向易产生有用离散度的状态。

title: Agent Architecture Cost-Success Trade-offs: A Controlled Evaluation across Enterprise-Style SOPs
summary: Enterprises increasingly use large language model agents to execute standard operating procedures (SOPs): long, branching, tool-intensive workflows. Yet there is little controlled evidence for choosing among competing agentic architectures. Holding the model, tasks, and tools fixed and varying only the architecture, we compare four designs (a function-calling single agent, a skill-augmented agent, centralized multi-agent orchestration, and a triage swarm; eight arms) across 13 enterprise SOPs, and introduce a skill-definition quality rubric to build matched high and low-quality skill corpora. Three takeaways emerge. (1)~\textbf{There is no universal best architecture; the right choice is SOP-dependent.} On a given SOP, task success ranges from under $10\%$ on the hardest to near $100\%$ on the easiest; no architecture is statistically separable in aggregate, and added structure only plausibly pays off on complex, branching SOPs (a directional, not yet significant, trend). (2)~\textbf{Added architecture cost must be justified by a task-success gain.} Every coordinated arm (multi-agent or skill-augmented) spends $1.4$--$4.7\times$ the tokens and $2.6$--$5.8\times$ the latency of the single agent for gains that are usually small and rarely significant, making the single agent the efficient default; high-quality skills do lift success (to $73.1\%$ from $67.4\%$) while degraded skills fall below it. (3)~\textbf{Implementation quality outweighs the single- versus multi-agent choice.} A plausible multi-agent implementation loses to the single agent, yet a targeted redesign of it becomes the only arm to significantly beat the baseline ($75.6\%$ vs.\ $67.4\%$).

AI.tldr: 在模型、任务、工具固定下比较四种（八臂）LLM 智能体架构于 13 个企业 SOP：无普适最优架构，架构开销须由任务成功率提升来证明，实现质量比单/多智能体选择更重要。
AI.motivation: 企业越来越多地用 LLM 智能体执行标准作业流程（SOP，长流程、多分支、强工具依赖），但缺乏受控证据来指导架构选型，因此作者在控制模型、任务与工具的前提下比较不同架构。
AI.method: 控制变量法：固定模型、任务与工具，仅改变架构，比较四种设计（函数调用单智能体、技能增强智能体、集中式多智能体编排、triage swarm）共八个实验臂，覆盖 13 个企业 SOP；并提出技能定义质量评分表，构建高质量与低质量技能语料库以做匹配对照。
AI.result: (1) 无普适最优架构，效果随 SOP 而异（最难低于 10%，最易接近 100%），总体上各架构差异不显著；(2) 协调型架构消耗 1.4–4.7 倍 token、2.6–5.8 倍延迟，收益通常小而少显著，单智能体是高效默认；高质量技能将成功率从 67.4% 提升至 73.1%，低质量技能降到基线以下；(3) 一个合理的多智能体实现反而不如单智能体，但经针对性重构后成为唯一显著优于基线的实验臂（75.6% vs 67.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 架构选择应视 SOP 而定，附加的结构只有在复杂、多分支流程上才可能值得，且需以任务成功率提升来论证成本；实践上宜从单智能体起步，并优先投入实现质量与技能质量，而非单纯追求多智能体。

title: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
summary: Discrete autoregressive models offer a scalable framework for image generation. However, they face a fundamental trade-off: long token sequences preserve representation quality but slow generation, while aggressive spatial compression reduces representation capacity. Based on product quantization, we show that, under a fixed nominal information budget, group size should scale quadratically with the per-axis spatial compression factor. Building on this principle, we propose GSTAR, a spatial--group co-scaling framework that enables \(32\times\) and even effective \(64\times\) compression while preserving strong reconstruction, understanding, and generation performance. Since larger groups introduce intra-group dependencies that must be modeled efficiently, we analyze their impact on inference latency and generation quality and introduce a semi-autoregressive decoder that combines parallel feature computation with lightweight causal modeling. With these designs, our highly compressed models perform competitively with leading models across five representative text-to-image benchmarks (GenEval, DPG-Bench, PRISM, LongText-Bench, and Qwen-Image-Bench). At \(1024\times1024\) resolution, our model delivers a \(20\times\) speedup over prior discrete autoregressive models, generating each image in 2.5 seconds on a single NVIDIA H200. Together, these results show that highly compressed discrete representations can enable high-quality autoregressive generation at low latency.

AI.tldr: 提出GSTAR空间-组协同缩放框架，揭示组大小应随每轴空间压缩因子二次方缩放的原则，实现32×乃至64×有效压缩，并配以半自回归解码器，在1024×1024下比以往离散自回归模型快20×（单卡H200约2.5秒/图）。
AI.motivation: 离散自回归图像生成存在根本性权衡：长token序列保真度高但生成慢，激进空间压缩提速却损失表征容量。本文希望找到在固定名义信息预算下合理分配空间压缩与组大小的方法，从而同时获得高压缩率与生成质量。
AI.method: 基于乘积量化分析，推导出在固定信息预算下组大小应随每轴空间压缩因子呈二次方增长（group size ∝ f²）；据此设计GSTAR空间-组协同缩放框架；针对大组带来的组内依赖，分析其对推理延迟与生成质量的影响，并引入半自回归解码器，将并行特征计算与轻量因果建模相结合。
AI.result: 实现32×及有效64×压缩，同时保持较强的重建、理解与生成性能；在GenEval、DPG-Bench、PRISM、LongText-Bench、Qwen-Image-Bench五个文生图基准上与领先模型表现相当；1024×1024分辨率下单张H200约2.5秒出图，较先前离散自回归模型提速20×。
AI.conclusion: 高度压缩的离散表征可在低延迟下实现高质量自回归生成，说明空间压缩与组大小协同缩放是提升离散AR图像生成效率-质量权衡的有效途径。

title: A Multi-Word Tokenizer for 204 Languages That Needs Fewer Tokens Than GPT-4o's, Including on English
summary: Languages of India need 1.6 to 14 times as many tokens as English on GPT-4o's tokenizer for the same content, which makes them more expensive and slower to serve. We train tokenizers from scratch on human-written text in about 200 languages. Havon v3 is a byte-level BPE tokenizer with 262,144 tokens and a pre-tokenizer that keeps combining marks with their letters and chunks scripts written without spaces. On FLORES-200 devtest it needs fewer tokens than GPT-4o's o200k_base on all 25 languages of India (median 0.74 of GPT-4o's count) and on 172 of 204 languages, but 7% more on English. Havon v4 adds a second, multi-word training stage (SuperBPE) to v3. At exactly GPT-4o's vocabulary size of 200,019 tokens, v4 needs 6.1% fewer tokens than GPT-4o on English and fewer on 161 of 204 languages and all 25 languages of India (median 0.74); at the same size, v3 needs 9.4% more on English and wins on 133. With 262,144 tokens, v4 needs 9.6% fewer tokens on English and fewer on 182 of 204 languages, and with 524,288 tokens it needs fewer on 203 of 204. The gains are largest for English, Hindi and the Romance languages; scripts without spaces, such as Khmer, Burmese and Tibetan, gain little and lose subword merges. Havon v5 replaces v4's Python-only code sample with permissively licensed code in 15 languages: on code it needs 1.03 to 1.22 times GPT-4o's tokens, against 1.11 to 1.29 for v4, while keeping all 25 languages of India (median 0.74, all significant under a sentence-level bootstrap) and English (0.94). These are compression results only: we have not yet evaluated a model trained with v4 or v5.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对印度语言在GPT-4o分词器下token数过多的问题，训练了多语言字节级BPE分词器Havon v3/v4/v5，显著降低印度语言及英语的token数，但仅报告压缩率、未验证下游模型效果。
AI.motivation: 印度语言在GPT-4o的o200k_base分词器上，同样内容需比英语多1.6至14倍token，导致服务更贵、更慢。需要从零训练面向约200种语言（尤其是印度语言和英语）更高效的分词器。
AI.method: 在约200种语言的人写文本上从零训练分词器。v3为262,144词表的字节级BPE，预分词器保持组合符号与字母在一起、并按无空格书写的文字分块；v4在v3基础上加入SuperBPE式第二阶段的跨词训练；v5将v4仅含Python的代码样本替换为15种语言的宽松许可代码。
AI.result: FLORES-200 devtest上，v3在全部25种印度语言（中位数0.74）及204种语言中的172种少于GPT-4o，英语多7%。200,019词表下v4英语少6.1%、204种语言中161种及全部印度语言更少（中位数0.74），同规模v3英语多9.4%、仅133种更优。262,144词表下v4英语少9.6%、182/204更优；524,288词表下203/204更优。增益最大者为英语、印地语和罗曼语；高棉语、缅甸语、藏语等无空格文字增益小且子词合并减少。v5在代码上需GPT-4o的1.03–1.22倍token（v4为1.11–1.29倍），同时保持印度语言中位数0.74与英语0.94。
AI.conclusion: Havon系列通过预分词规则、两阶段训练和更丰富的多语言代码数据，在多数语言上实现优于GPT-4o的压缩率，印度语言与英语收益显著，但无空格文字收益有限。这些仅为压缩结果，尚未评估使用v4或v5训练的模型性能。

title: Using Proof Dependencies to Manage Verification Projects
summary:
Verification technology now scales to sizable projects, but techniques for managing such projects fall short. There are no effective ways to assess the progress made so far and to determine which verification tasks to perform next. A key issue is that the successful run of a verification tool provides little indication about what has actually been achieved. The guarantees provided depend on the specifications of the verified code as well as any unverified assumptions made in the proofs, e.g., about the behavior of unverified libraries. Manual inspection of specifications and assumptions to determine progress is error-prone and prohibitively expensive.
  In this paper, we present automated techniques to assess and guide verification projects. All of these techniques employ an automatic proof dependency analysis that computes, for each proof obligation in a project, the specifications, statements, and assumptions that are needed to prove it. We show that this analysis enables effective proof audits by determining all assumptions a proof depends on. We also use it to determine which statements in a program are constrained by the provided specifications, which indicates how strong a specification is. Based on these two insights, we propose a novel progress metric for verification projects and show how to use it to guide verification projects to maximize progress.
  We implement our approach in the symbolic execution backend of Viper and lift it to the Go verifier Gobra. Our evaluation on real-world benchmarks, including a verified Internet router, shows that the dependency analysis is sound and sufficiently precise, that our progress metric accurately reflects the state of a verification project over time, and that our guidance outperforms standard bottom-up and top-down verification strategies.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于自动证明依赖分析的技术，用于审计验证项目的假设、评估规范强度，并定义进度度量以指导验证任务安排；在Viper/Gobra上实现，实验表明分析可靠精确、度量反映真实进度、指导策略优于传统自底向上/自顶向下方法。
AI.motivation: 验证技术已能扩展到大型项目，但缺少有效手段评估已取得的验证进展、决定下一步应验证哪些任务。工具成功运行并不能说明实际达成了什么保证，因为保证依赖于规范以及证明中未验证的假设（如未验证库的行为）；人工检查规范与假设既易错又代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出自动证明依赖分析：对项目中每个证明义务计算其所需依赖的规范、语句与假设。基于该分析实现两种能力：(1)证明审计——确定证明依赖的所有假设；(2)确定程序中哪些语句被给定规范所约束，从而衡量规范强度。据此提出新的验证项目进度度量，并用于指导验证任务的选取顺序。方法实现于Viper的符号执行后端，并提升至Go验证器Gobra。
AI.result: 在真实基准（含一个经过验证的互联网路由器）上的评估显示：依赖分析是可靠的且足够精确；进度度量能准确反映验证项目随时间变化的状态；基于度量得到的指导策略优于标准的自底向上与自顶向下验证策略。
AI.conclusion: 自动证明依赖分析可作为验证项目管理的核心基础，支持可靠的证明审计、规范强度评估与进度量化，并能有效指导验证工作的推进，弥补当前大规模验证项目管理手段的不足。

title: The Shape of a Program: Path Signatures for Trace-to-Program Induction
summary: Synthesizing programs from execution traces is a fundamental challenge in algorithmic interpretability and the reverse engineering of complex systems. We bring a rough-path-theoretic perspective to program induction, treating execution traces as high-dimensional rough paths and encoding them with the path signature transform, a tool from stochastic analysis whose expectation provably characterizes the distribution of traces a program induces. On three program-induction domains, Karel, List, and RASP, our log-signature trace encoder outperforms LSTM, Transformer, and Fourier baselines in almost every setting, with its largest margins when training data is scarce. We further observe that the trace-to-program pipeline is naturally contractive: it often produces valid programs that are shorter than the ground truth. We turn this into a bootstrapping procedure that exposes redundancy in the ground-truth supervision without any external oracle, which we demonstrate on redundancy-injected versions of our datasets. Finally, the log-signature encoder induces a markedly more interpretable latent geometry than the baselines, in which the nearest neighbors of every state lie on its own execution trace.

AI.tldr: 该论文从粗糙路径理论出发，用路径签名（尤其对数签名）编码执行轨迹来做程序归纳，在Karel、List、RASP三个域上优于LSTM/Transformer/Fourier基线，并利用管道天然的收缩性实现无外部Oracle的自举，同时获得可解释的潜空间几何。
AI.motivation: 从执行轨迹合成程序是算法可解释性与复杂系统逆向工程的核心难题；已有序列模型（LSTM、Transformer、Fourier）对轨迹的编码未必能刻画程序所诱导轨迹的分布，且在数据稀缺时表现受限。
AI.method: 将执行轨迹视为高维粗糙路径，用随机分析中的路径签名变换编码（其期望可证明刻画程序诱导轨迹的分布），提出对数签名轨迹编码器；观察到trace-to-program管道具有收缩性，据此设计无Oracle的自举流程以暴露真值监督中的冗余。
AI.result: 在Karel、List、RASP三个程序归纳域上，对数签名编码器几乎在所有设置下超过LSTM、Transformer、Fourier基线，数据稀缺时优势最大；管道常产出比真值更短的有效程序；在注入冗余的数据集上验证了自举发现冗余的能力；其潜空间中每个状态的最近邻都位于自身执行轨迹上，几何显著更可解释。
AI.conclusion: 路径签名/对数签名是程序归纳中一种有理论依据且高效的轨迹表示，兼具性能优势、可利用的收缩性以及可解释的潜几何，为逆向工程与可解释性研究提供了新视角。

title: Physics2Weight: Direct Neural Network Architecture and Weight Generation from Physical Laws Using Large Language Models
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled weight-space programming (WSP), which directly generates neural network weights without gradient-based optimization. However, extending WSP to physical problems remains challenging, particularly in achieving both solution accuracy and physical consistency. In this paper, we propose Physics2Weight (PtW), a framework that extends WSP to solving partial differential equations by directly generating neural network weights and editing architectures based on governing equations and initial and boundary conditions. PtW introduces physics-constrained prompting and physics-guided architecture editing, combined with iterative weight refinement from WSP, to improve solution accuracy and physical consistency without gradient-based optimization. Experiments on four PDEs, namely the heat, advection, Burgers', and Allen--Cahn equations, demonstrate lower solution errors than conventional physics-informed neural networks, while revealing limitations in satisfying the governing equations for nonlinear PDEs.

AI.tldr: 提出Physics2Weight (PtW)框架，将权重空间编程(WSP)扩展用于求解偏微分方程，直接生成网络权重并编辑架构，无需梯度优化。
AI.motivation: WSP能从LLM直接生成网络权重而免于梯度优化，但扩展到物理问题难以兼顾解的精度与物理一致性。
AI.method: 基于控制方程与初边值条件，引入物理约束提示(physics-constrained prompting)、物理引导架构编辑(physics-guided architecture editing)，并结合WSP迭代式权重精炼。
AI.result: 在热传导、对流、Burgers、Allen–Cahn四个PDE上，解误差低于传统PINN；但非线性PDE在满足控制方程方面存在局限。
AI.conclusion: PtW证明WSP可免梯度求解PDE并提升精度，但物理一致性（尤其非线性PDE）仍是待解难题。

title: Instance-preserving graded semantic reporting for surgical action triplets
summary: Complete-or-reject reporting of surgical action triplets can discard a correctly identified instrument and action when the target is uncertain. We introduce instance-preserving graded semantic reporting, which separates instance selection from the choice of semantic detail. Each selected instance retains its predicted mask and labels while hierarchical correctness scores guide instrument (I), instrument-verb (IV), or complete instrument-verb-target (IVT) reporting. The utility-increment rule DELTA weighs the expected gain from finer reporting against its error cost. We compare three decision rules on 5,641 test frames from eight surgical videos using fixed predictions and scores. At the 10% development calibration target, DELTA retains correct partial reports for 80.0% of candidates rejected by a matched complete-or-reject baseline (5,329/6,662). Adding IV increases source-normalized weighted correct-report yield by 19.13 to 23.13 per 100 frames across all three rules relative to separately recalibrated I/IVT controls. Weighted reporting risk changes by -0.77 to +1.01 percentage points, with complete correct-triplet counts unchanged or reduced. Graded reporting makes partial surgical predictions available as localized descriptions, with an explicit trade-off between report utility and completeness.

AI.tldr: 提出实例保留的分级语义报告方法，将实例选择与语义细节分离，用层次化正确性分数和 DELTA 效用增量规则决定报告 I、IV 还是完整 IVT。
AI.motivation: 传统"完整报告或拒绝"策略在目标不确定时会丢弃已正确识别的器械和动作，损失可用信息。
AI.method: 每个入选实例保留预测掩码与标签，由层次化正确性分数引导报告 I/IV/IVT 三级；DELTA 规则权衡更细报告的预期收益与错误代价。在 8 个手术视频 5,641 帧测试集上，用固定预测与分数比较三种决策规则。
AI.result: 在 10% 校准目标下，DELTA 保留了基线拒绝候选中 80.0%（5,329/6,662）的正确部分报告；加入 IV 使源归一化加权正确报告产出提升 19.13–23.13/100 帧，加权风险变化 -0.77 至 +1.01 个百分点，完整正确三元组数量不变或减少。
AI.conclusion: 分级报告可将部分手术预测作为定位描述输出，但需在报告效用与完整性之间显式权衡。

title: Catch It Where It Happens: Real Time Error Correction During LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trusted with mathematical, scientific and engineering work, yet their mistakes are often confidently written and hard to spot. A single wrong step tends to propagate, making the model waste inference tokens following a false premise. Existing safeguards either check only the final answer and restart from scratch, or rely on a verifier LLM that competes for GPU capacity and slows down response time. We propose online, deterministic verification: many kinds of reasoning steps can be validated by code, so a step can be verified in real time, as it is written, without any model call or GPU use. Whenever a check fails, we point out the mistake and let the model continue from the same spot. We demonstrate this approach on symbolic mathematics, where derivations already contain explicit expressions that a computer algebra system can check in milliseconds. Tested on the ASyMoB benchmark with three open-weights models, our online validation improves accuracy by 1.4-5.6 percentage points, corresponding to a 1.8-14.9% net reduction in incorrect answers, while increasing token usage by only 6-7%. Because the verifier is independent of the model, the approach complements progress in LLMs rather than competing with it: every new model can benefit immediately, and the benefit grows as deterministic checkers extend to more kinds of reasoning steps.

AI.tldr: 提出"在线确定性验证"方法：用代码（如计算机代数系统）在推理步骤生成的瞬间实时校验每一步，失败即提示并让模型就地继续，无需额外模型或GPU。在ASyMoB上用三个开源模型测试，准确率提升1.4–5.6个百分点，错误答案净减少1.8–14.9%，token仅增6–7%。
AI.motivation: LLM在高价值数学/科学任务中错误常被自信地写出且难以察觉，单步错误会级联放大、浪费推理token。现有防护要么只校验最终答案并全部重来，要么依赖验证器LLM占用GPU、拖慢响应。
AI.method: 在线、确定性验证：识别可被代码校验的推理步骤类型，在模型书写过程中实时检查（无模型调用、无GPU开销）；检查失败时指出错误位置，让模型从同一处继续，而非重新生成。
AI.result: 在符号数学上实现（派生式含显式表达式，CAS毫秒级校验）；ASyMoB基准+3个开源权重模型：准确率+1.4~5.6pp，错误答案净减少1.8~14.9%，token开销仅增6~7%。
AI.conclusion: 验证器与模型解耦，可与LLM进步互补：新模型即可直接受益，且随着确定性检查器覆盖更多推理步骤类型，收益将持续增大。

title: DEPUTYBENCH: Evaluating Contextual Safety in Enterprise Agents
summary: Enterprise agents must determine whether ordinary requests are permitted by organizational records and policies while continuing legitimate work. We introduce DEPUTYBENCH, an executable benchmark with 79 base items, 375 instances, paired permission contexts, and graded evidence requirements. Across 12 models, revised audits give 88.0% pooled safety and 79.1% paired success. A controlled study of 28 derived tasks and six models tests authorization-fact flips, evidence masking, and irrelevant rewrites. Outcomes track backend permissions, yet restricted execution is more frequent with missing evidence than explicit non-permission: 10.3% versus 3.5% on 27 matched tasks, a 6.8-percentage-point difference (95% interval: 1.9-13.0; secondary analysis). A post-hoc analysis locates 61 of 100 masked-condition executions in four privacy tasks requiring complete cumulative counts or person-specific consent. The difference persists when the most error-prone model or the largest contributing task is excluded, but is much smaller outside those four tasks. Thus high safety with available evidence does not establish reliable stopping when permission cannot be verified. Mean paired success is equivalent within a prespecified five-point margin under irrelevant rewrites, while strong-model safety remains near ceiling. Scorer validation improves from 178 to 266 correctly scored cases out of 284 held-out counterexamples. Two security experts manually verified task ground truth over a two-week period; stage labels remain LLM-generated. The concentration analysis describes task structure and audited outcomes, not an identified internal mechanism.

AI.tldr: 提出 DEPUTYBENCH 可执行基准，评估企业Agent在权限未验证时能否正确停止；发现缺少证据时受限执行率(10.3%)反而高于明确非许可(3.5%)。
AI.motivation: 企业Agent需在继续合法工作的同时判断请求是否被组织记录与政策允许；即使有证据时安全性很高，也不代表在无法验证权限时能可靠停止。
AI.method: 构建 DEPUTYBENCH（79基础项、375实例、配对权限上下文、分级证据要求），测试12个模型；对28个衍生任务与6个模型做受控研究，操纵授权事实翻转、证据遮蔽与无关改写；进行评分器验证（284例留出反例）及两名安全专家两周人工核验。
AI.result: 12个模型修订审计后汇总安全率88.0%、配对成功率79.1%；27个匹配任务中，证据缺失下受限执行10.3% vs 明确非许可3.5%，差6.8个百分点(95%区间1.9–13.0)；100次遮蔽执行中61次集中于4个隐私任务；排除最易错模型或最大贡献任务后差异仍存在，但在4个任务外明显变小；无关改写下配对成功率在预设5点边际内等效；评分器正确率从178提升至266/284。
AI.conclusion: 高安全率不能代表权限不可验证时的可靠停止能力；差异集中于特定隐私任务结构，属描述性审计而非内部机制识别；阶段标签仍为LLM生成。

title: FaST: Factored Synthesis of Transitions for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Synthetic data augmentation promises to scale offline reinforcement learning beyond fixed logged datasets, but leading diffusion-based generators model the transition tuple (state, action, next state, reward, terminal) as a monolith: no single factor can be natively redrawn in isolation. We present FaST (Factored Synthesis of Transitions), which factors transitions via the chain rule into state, action, dynamics, reward, and terminal stages, fitting each with an estimator matched to its statistical properties. Across twelve D4RL locomotion and maze benchmarks, TD3+BC and IQL agents trained on FaST transitions match the SynthER diffusion baseline while generating transitions over 90x faster. The explicit action-given-state conditional can also be re-queried for a fixed state, enabling targeted action synthesis: drawing N candidate actions per generated state and keeping the highest-advantage one under a value function fit to the same data, thereby synthesizing improved behavior during generation rather than filtering for it post-hoc. Best-of-10 synthesis beats training on real data on 11 of 12 medium and medium-replay settings (+8.9 D4RL points on average, up to +28.4), and is competitive with advantage-filtered SynthER at a fraction of its generation cost. On expert mixtures both mechanisms degrade identically, tracing the failure to the advantage estimate itself rather than to either targeting mechanism.

AI.tldr: FaST将转移动元组按链式法则分解为状态、动作、动力学、奖励、终止五个阶段分别建模，生成速度比扩散基线SynthER快90倍以上，并支持在固定状态下多次采样动作以筛选高优势动作。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的合成数据生成器把(st, at, st+1, rt, done)整体建模，无法单独重绘某一因子，难以实现针对性动作合成。
AI.method: 按链式法则分解转移：状态、动作、动力学、奖励、终止各阶段分别用匹配其统计特性的估计器拟合；利用显式的"动作给定状态"条件，在生成状态上采样N个候选动作，用同一数据拟合的价值函数保留最高优势动作。
AI.result: 在12个D4RL运动与迷宫基准上，TD3+BC与IQL用FaST合成转移训练的效果与SynthER持平，生成速度提升90倍以上；Best-of-10合成在12个medium/medium-replay设置中11个超过真实数据训练（平均+8.9，最高+28.4），且成本远低于advantage-filtered SynthER。专家混合数据下两种机制同等退化，说明问题源于优势估计本身。
AI.conclusion: 因子化分解在保持生成质量的同时大幅提升效率，并解锁生成期主动优化行为的能力；但该类方法的性能受限于优势估计的准确性。

title: Embodied Science Agents: Making Embodied Experimental Design Learnable
summary: Recent advances in large models have accelerated AI for Science toward agentic science, where AI agents autonomously conduct scientific discovery. Realising this vision requires closing the loop between computational reasoning and physical experimentation, positioning self-driving laboratories (SDLs) as critical enablers. However, existing SDLs exhibit a fundamental paradox: foundation model integration has increased linguistic sophistication while severing physical grounding. By treating models as disembodied planners that output symbolic workflows for separate robotic systems, current architectures inherently block the development of embodied experimental intuition. We argue that overcoming this paradox requires embedding \emph{learnability} along three interdependent axes: cognitive learnability (learning what to investigate), experimental learnability (learning where to search), and embodied learnability (learning how to act). Building on this view, we introduce the Embodied Science Agent (ESA), which unifies digital intelligence with physical embodiment through three synergistic components: a Digital Agent that provides cognitive and experimental learnability via memory-based reasoning and Bayesian optimisation, an Embodied Agent that provides embodied learnability via generalisable instrument control, and an Embodied Unified Interface for seamless coordination. We validated ESA in autonomous wastewater treatment experiments, navigating over 200 million possible conditions. Through 15 continuous rounds, ESA raised the final solution transmittance from 82\% to 99.7\%, corresponding to a 98.5\% reduction in residual dye concentration and near-complete decolourisation, while its learned visuomotor policies generalised across varying instrument placements, a promising step toward next-generation SDLs for autonomous scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"具身科学智能体"(ESA)，通过数字智能与物理具身的统一，解决自驱动实验室中基础模型"语言精细但物理脱节"的悖论，并在废水处理实验中验证其自主科学发现能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自驱动实验室(SDL)存在根本悖论：集成大模型提升了语言能力，却切断了物理接地——模型被当作无身体的规划器输出符号化流程交给独立机器人，阻碍了具身实验直觉的形成。作者认为需在认知、实验、具身三条相互依赖的维度上嵌入"可学习性"。
AI.method: 提出ESA架构，包含三个协同组件：数字智能体(基于记忆的推理与贝叶斯优化，提供认知与实验可学习性)、具身智能体(通用化仪器控制，提供具身可学习性)、以及具身统一接口(实现无缝协同)。
AI.result: 在自主废水处理实验中，ESA在超过2亿种可能条件中导航，经15轮连续实验将最终溶液透光率从82%提升至99.7%，残余染料浓度降低98.5%，接近完全脱色；其学习到的视觉运动策略可泛化到不同仪器摆放位置。
AI.conclusion: ESA是迈向下一代自驱动实验室与自主科学发现的重要一步，表明将认知、实验与具身可学习性统一是突破现有SDL悖论的有效路径。

title: Preserving Cultural Records: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Visual-Prior Routing Network for Ancient Book Image Restoration
summary: Ancient books preserve invaluable cultural heritage, yet their images often suffer from complex degradations caused by long-term ageing, environmental exposure, and physical damage. Existing ancient book image restoration benchmarks are limited in scale and rely on simplified degradation simulations, which cannot fully represent real-world degradation patterns and restrict the generalization ability of restoration models. To address these challenges, we introduce AncBench, a large-scale synthetic paired benchmark containing 100K aligned clean-degraded image pairs. AncBench models realistic composite degradations through a comprehensive degradation pipeline that considers material ageing, paper texture variation, blur, staining, water-induced geometric distortion, and local occlusion. Furthermore, we propose AncRestore, a degradation-aware visual-prior routing network for ancient book image restoration. AncRestore first learns degradation representations from degraded images and then dynamically selects and integrates suitable visual priors according to different degradation characteristics. Guided by these degradation cues, a dynamic routing mechanism combines expert-wise and region-wise routing strategies adaptively adjusts the contribution of these priors across different regions, enabling the model to recover both global appearance and local text details. Extensive experiments show that AncRestore effectively suppresses composite degradations while preserving text structures and enhancing restoration quality against other methods, highlighting its application potential for intelligent ancient book image restoration in cultural heritage preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出大规模古籍图像复原基准AncBench（10万对合成配对图像）与退化感知视觉先验路由网络AncRestore，通过动态路由整合多种视觉先验，有效抑制复合退化并保留文字结构。
AI.motivation: 古籍图像因长期老化、环境暴露和物理损伤存在复杂退化，但现有基准规模小、退化模拟简化，难以反映真实退化模式，限制了复原模型的泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建AncBench：含10万对齐的清晰-退化图像对，通过涵盖材料老化、纸张纹理变化、模糊、污渍、水致几何畸变和局部遮挡的综合退化管线模拟真实复合退化。提出AncRestore：先从退化图像学习退化表征，再依据退化特征动态选择并整合合适视觉先验；采用专家级与区域级相结合的动态路由机制，自适应调整各区域先验贡献，同时恢复全局外观与局部文字细节。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，AncRestore能有效抑制复合退化，保留文字结构，相较其他方法提升复原质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为古籍图像智能复原提供了更贴近真实的基准与有效的退化感知先验路由方案，在文化遗产保护中具有应用潜力。

title: HiCAP: Hierarchical Cultural Adaptation via Personality for Dialogue Generation
summary: Cultural adaptation in dialogue systems refers to the ability to generate responses that conform to linguistic norms and social expectations across different cultures. However, existing dialogue generation approaches pay limited attention to the role of personality in shaping cultural expression and communication style. We therefore propose HiCAP, a novel framework that integrates personality traits into culturally adaptive dialogue generation. HiCAP employs a personality-conditioned control mechanism that hierarchically modulates response style by first aligning it with the cultural tone and then refining linguistic expression and content according to individual personality attributes. To embed these factors, the model combines supervised fine-tuning and instruction-based tuning, supported by dynamic instruction templates and multi-agent demonstrations to capture diverse combinations of culture and personality. Experiments on CulturalPersonas and CPED show that HiCAP achieves the strongest overall performance across various dialogue generation metrics, demonstrating effective cultural adaptability and personality modelling.

AI.tldr: 提出HiCAP框架，将人格特质引入文化自适应对话生成，通过人格条件控制机制分层调节响应风格，在CulturalPersonas和CPED数据集上取得最佳综合性能。
AI.motivation: 现有对话生成方法较少关注人格在塑造文化表达与沟通风格中的作用，而文化适配与个体人格密切相关。
AI.method: 人格条件控制机制：先对齐文化语调，再按人格属性细化语言表达与内容；结合监督微调与指令微调，辅以动态指令模板和多智能体示范以覆盖多样的文化与人格组合。
AI.result: 在CulturalPersonas和CPED数据集上，HiCAP在多项对话生成指标上取得最强的整体表现，体现有效的文化适配性与人格建模能力。
AI.conclusion: 将人格特质显式融入文化自适应对话生成可有效提升对话质量与跨文化适应性。

title: INTENT: Out-of-Sample, Out-of-Time, and Cold-Start Evaluation on User Event Sequences
comment: 4 pages + references and appendix. Accepted at the MFMB workshop at ACM ICAIF '26 (non-archival). Code: https://github.com/kthaisociety/intent
summary: Banks now train foundation models on ordered sequences of customer events such as transactions, app sessions, and authorizations. Deployed, such a model predicts forward in time, often for customers and merchants absent from training, yet each is evaluated on private data, so no two can be compared. Public benchmarks for such sequences rarely test a period the model has not seen; recommendation studies usually hold out each user's last events instead. We present INTENT (INTEraction, Novelty, and Transfer evaluation for next-action prediction), a public benchmark that scores a model in seven cells defined by whether the user, the period, and the target item appeared in training. An audit of 59 public dataset families retains five datasets; the most common defect is the lack of a calendar timestamp that orders events. No date lies within the time span of all five datasets, so each is split at its own cutoff, chosen by one rule fixed before any model is evaluated. Summed over the datasets, every cell holds at least 111,769 users. In reference results the cell determines the best model: a transformer leads on seen items after the cutoff but scores zero on new items, a variant that embeds item metadata helps mainly on MicroLens, and repeating the user's last item leads on new items in four of five datasets. This parameter-free control also shows that on three datasets most of the score lost after the cutoff reflects changed behavior rather than the model. The pipeline, the cutoff rule, and the per-cell user counts are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出INTENT公开基准，按用户、时间段、目标物品是否在训练中出现将下一动作预测划分为七个单元，审计59个数据集族并保留5个，在各自时间切点上评估模型，发现最优模型随单元而变，且参数无关的"重复上一物品"基线在新物品上常领先。
AI.motivation: 银行等场景训练的基础模型需做前向时间预测，常涉及训练中未见的客户与商户，但因各机构私有数据无法横向比较。现有公开序列基准很少测试模型未见过的时段，推荐研究通常只留出每个用户的最后事件，缺乏检验泛化性的统一标准。
AI.method: 构建INTENT基准（交互、新颖性、迁移的下一动作预测评估），按用户、时间段、目标物品是否出现于训练划分七个评估单元；审计59个公共数据集族，以是否存在可排序事件的日历时间戳为主要筛选标准，保留5个数据集；因无跨全部数据集的共同时间跨度，用事先固定的单一规则为每个数据集确定切点分别划分；汇总各数据集使每个单元至少含111,769名用户，并给出参考模型结果。
AI.result: 评估单元决定最优模型：transformer在切点后已见物品上领先，但在新物品上得分为零；嵌入物品元数据的变体主要在MicroLens上有效；重复用户上一物品的参数无关基线在五个数据集中的四个于新物品上领先。该基线还表明，在三个数据集上切点后损失的大部分分数源于行为变化而非模型本身。
AI.conclusion: 单一总体分数掩盖了模型在不同泛化单元上的差异，应按单元分别评估；时间切点需严格固定且公开；参数无关基线可作为必要对照。流水线、切点规则及各单元用户数均已公开，便于可复现比较。

title: A Taxonomy of Failing Bug Reproduction Tests on SWT-Bench
comment: To be published in CASCON 2026 proceedings
summary:
Automatic Program Repair (APR) tools require high-quality test generation models to validate candidate patches. Despite the advancements of automated bug reproduction testing tools, they continue to struggle with issues of higher complexity. These struggles may be caused by a framework's lack of problem-specific context. We address the unclassified nature of these framework failures by providing a taxonomy of bug reproduction tests. This study uses the AssertFlip and OpenHands frameworks, the two highest-scoring open-source tools on SWT-Bench Verified. The significance of model selection on the causes of failure is also explored by utilizing GPT-5-mini and GPT-4o-mini on both tools. The error traces of these frameworks are categorized to determine granular modes of failure. Through this process, mechanical and implementation failures were the most common failure classes.
  Overall, a tool's generation approach has a significant impact on precision and coverage, while the selection of the model alters the quality and quantity of generated tests. Specifically, more powerful models with higher reasoning capability tended to present fewer failures due to a lack of technical or problem-specific context. Our experiment also shows evidence that our taxonomy can be used as concrete guidance to augment the issue description to improve the generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文对AssertFlip与OpenHands两个bug复现测试框架的失败原因进行系统分类，发现机械性与实现性失败最普遍，且工具设计影响precision/coverage、模型能力影响测试质量与数量。
AI.motivation: APR工具需要高质量测试生成模型来验证候选补丁，但自动bug复现测试工具在复杂问题上仍频繁失败，且这些框架失败缺乏系统分类、原因不明，推测与框架缺少问题特定上下文有关。
AI.method: 选取SWT-Bench Verified上得分最高的两个开源工具AssertFlip与OpenHands，分别搭配GPT-5-mini和GPT-4o-mini，基于其错误轨迹构建bug复现测试失败的分类法，并归类到细粒度失败模式，同时考察模型选择对失败原因的影响。
AI.result: 机械性失败与实现性失败是最常见的失败类别；工具的生成方式显著影响precision和覆盖率，模型选择则改变生成测试的质量与数量；推理能力更强的模型因缺少技术或问题特定上下文而导致的失败更少。
AI.conclusion: 该分类法不仅解释了框架失败模式，还可作为具体指导用于增强issue描述，从而提升测试生成质量。

title: Permutation-Based Pre-trained Model Merging via Reciprocal Orthogonality
summary: Ito et al. (2026) showed that sufficiently wide, independently trained neural networks can exhibit linear mode connectivity (LMC) with softmax temperature calibration, even without permutation. LMC means that a low-loss linear path connects the models' parameters. This behavior is explained by layerwise exponentially weighted connectivity (LEWC), whereby each merged layer outputs an exponentially weighted sum of the original models' corresponding representations, yielding ensemble-like predictions. However, prior work observed LEWC with substantial widening, such as 8192 units per hidden layer for MLPs and $16\times$ width for VGG-11, raising the question of whether such widths are necessary. We therefore search for permutations that encourage reciprocal orthogonality (RO), which suppresses interference between each model's weights and the other model's representations. This allows both models' computations to coexist in the merged network, promoting LEWC at smaller widths. We formulate the search as independent layerwise quadratic assignment problems and approximately solve their continuous relaxations using Frank--Wolfe. Experiments show that our method facilitates LMC with less width expansion. It also merges models trained on different data distributions, where weight matching, which maximizes weight similarity through permutations, struggles. The merged predictions approximate those of a logit ensemble of the original models.

AI.tldr: 通过在层间搜索鼓励"互正交(RO)"的置换，使两个模型的表示在合并后互不干扰，从而在较小宽度扩张下实现线性模式连通(LMC)，并能合并不同数据分布训练的模型。
AI.motivation: Ito等人(2026)表明足够宽的独立训练网络经softmax温度校准即可出现LMC，机制为LEWC；但之前观察到LEWC需要大幅加宽(MLP每隐层8192单元、VGG-11 16倍宽度)。本文质疑这种宽度是否必要。
AI.method: 寻找能促进互正交(RO)的置换，抑制每个模型权重与另一模型表示间的干扰，使两模型计算可在合并网络中并存，从而在更小宽度下促进LEWC。将搜索建模为独立的逐层二次分配问题，并用Frank–Wolfe近似求解其连续松弛。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在更少宽度扩张下即可促成LMC；还能合并在不同数据分布上训练的模型(此情形下最大化权重相似度的weight matching失效)；合并后的预测近似原始模型的logit集成。
AI.conclusion: 互正交置换搜索可替代大幅加宽来获得LMC，并扩展到跨分布模型合并，效果接近logit集成。

title: Monitoring One Channel Is Not Communication Control: Causal Evidence for Adaptive Reallocation of Joint Message--Route Codes
comment: 23 pages total: 8-page main paper plus 15-page supplementary material; 1 main-paper figure and 3 main-paper tables. Equal contribution. Code available at: https://github.com/SummerRainET2008/DRCB
summary: Monitoring a visible channel can change how learned agents communicate without removing why communication is useful. We test this distinction in an end-to-end game where a sender and receiver learn a discrete protocol and route policy without communication supervision. In two independent 20-seed batches, 20/20 and 19/20 protocols form. Online partial coverage increases shadow-route share over no monitoring by .701 [.574,.826] and .575 [.412,.737], while task accuracy remains .905/.913 and signed frozen message contribution remains .592/.563. Complete coverage removes most selective migration without removing communication. Frozen interventions, including a fresh pre-outcome confirmation, show that route is semantic: joint message--route shuffling changes .668 of receiver predictions and route alone retains .388 accuracy versus .25 chance. A corrected explicit-silence cost makes 18/20 policies fully silent and lowers mean sending to .050, but its strict complete-suppression gate fails because two seeds retain communication. Failed semantic-evasion and operational gates further bound the result. The evidence supports adaptive reallocation of a joint message--route code under partial monitoring, not open-world route discovery, emergent encryption, or a universal defense.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在部分监控下，学习型智能体的通信协议不消失，而是通过"消息-路由"联合编码进行语义再分配，实现迁回路由以规避观测。
AI.motivation: 作者希望厘清"监控可见信道是否改变通信方式"与"监控是否消除通信有用性"这两件常被混为一谈的事，判断监控下智能体是真正学会逃避监控，还是仅做适应性再分配。
AI.method: 构建端到端的发送方-接收方博弈，双方在无通信监督下学习离散协议与路由策略；设置在线部分覆盖与完全覆盖两种监控条件，使用两个独立20种子批次，并采用冻结干预（如前置结果确认、消息-路由联合打乱、修正的显式沉默成本）来检验路由的语义性及各类防御门槛。
AI.result: 两批中分别20/20与19/20形成协议；部分覆盖使影子路由占比相对无监控提升.701［.574,.826］与.575［.412,.737］，任务准确率保持.905/.913，冻结消息贡献保持.592/.563。完全覆盖未消除通信，仅减少选择性迁移。联合消息-路由打乱改变.668的接收方预测，单凭路由仍有.388准确率（随机为.25）。修正的沉默成本使18/20策略完全沉默、平均发送降至.050，但严格的完全抑制门槛因两种子仍有通信而失败。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持部分监控下"消息-路由"联合编码的自适应再分配，而非开放世界中的路由发现、涌现加密或通用防御；语义规避与操作性门槛均未被通过，结果边界明确。

title: GTAGym: Real AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning
summary: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. However, evaluating whether agents can complete tasks in AAA games is challenging and often human-annotated because task outcomes are often difficult to verify automatically, let alone applying it for Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce GTAGym, an environment and framework for evaluation and RL on GTA V tasks. Its evaluation benchmark, GTAVBench, derived from GTA V main-story missions, contains 103 online tasks reconstructed across nine task families, alongside 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks using GTA V imagery. A web server provides access to the online environment and evaluation interface, supporting parallel testing through screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic engine-state outcome checks. We evaluate six frontier LLMs on GTAVBench with textual task instructions and on its GTAVBench-AGI branch, where instructions appear only in the first screenshot and a harness automatically compresses interaction history. The best configuration achieves 70.9% overall accuracy in GTAVBench-AGI, yet aerial navigation, evasion and interception remain difficult. GTAGym also provides a scalable generator that samples task parameters within user-specified ranges and option sets under fixed templates, creating batches of 3D and image-based shooting environments for RL with automatic reward and termination signals. LoRA RL of Qwen3.8-27B on generated on-foot navigation tasks improves the in-domain performance and transfers to out-of-domain task categories, and native GTA V tasks from 15% to 23%.

AI.tldr: 提出GTAGym——基于GTA V的评测与强化学习环境框架，含103个线上任务与47个图像射击任务的GTAVBench基准，并提供可自动生成3D/图像任务的生成器用于RL。
AI.motivation: AAA游戏是评测智能体感知、推理与控制的理想测试床，但任务结果难以自动验证，通常依赖人工标注，难以用于RL，缺乏可自动判定的评测与训练平台。
AI.method: 构建GTAGym环境与框架：GTAVBench含9个任务家族的103个在线任务（源自主线剧情重建）及47个基于GTA V图像的射击/狙击任务；通过Web服务器提供并行测试，支持截图+键鼠操作接口与引擎状态自动结果判定。另设GTAVBench-AGI分支（指令仅出现在首帧截图、历史自动压缩）。提供按用户指定参数范围与选项集采样的可扩展任务生成器，生成批量3D与图像射击环境并给出自动奖励与终止信号，用于LoRA RL训练。
AI.result: 六个前沿LLM评测：GTAVBench-AGI最佳配置总体准确率70.9%，但空中导航、逃逸与拦截仍困难。对Qwen3.8-27B做LoRA RL后，域内步行导航性能提升，并能迁移到域外任务类别，在原版GTA V任务上从15%提升至23%。
AI.conclusion: GTAGym将AAA游戏任务转化为可自动验证的评测与RL平台，验证了自动奖励信号下的RL训练与跨任务迁移可行性，同时揭示空中导航、逃逸、拦截等能力仍是瓶颈。

title: Deletion Sensitivity Is a Property of the Model: A Three-Condition Measurement across Seven Open Reasoning Models
summary: Reasoning models write a reasoning trace at every turn of a multi-turn tool session, and later turns read this history. Across 94k ShareGPT conversations, 73 percent of user interactions span multiple turns. Upstream providers bind each trace to its issuer, so a request forwarded across issuers arrives with its history deleted, and the task cost of this stripping remains unmeasured. To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents the first direct, blind, multi-seed measurement of full reasoning-history deletion in multi-turn tool calling, through three rendering conditions, seven open-weight reasoning models, three seeds, 794 tasks, and the official checker. The same deletion spans -4.4 to +51.3 points with both ends excluding zero, and for the one model re-dosed from 0 to 100 percent deletion, the reading varies by at most 1.5 points. Deletion sensitivity is a model-level property. The reading follows the model itself and stays constant across deployments, and a retrained or re-released model is a new model that a two-cell screen, one retention run and one deletion run, re-reads for the cost of two runs. Deletion sensitivity is thus a measurable property of the model, and the reading must enter routing and aggregation as prior information rather than persist as an invisible default cost.

AI.tldr: 首次对多轮工具调用中“推理历史被完全删除”进行直接、盲测、多随机种子的量化测量，发现删除敏感度是模型级属性，且影响可达-4.4至+51.3分。
AI.motivation: 多轮工具会话中，推理轨迹会被后续轮次读取；但上游提供方将轨迹绑定到签发方，跨签发方转发时历史被删除，这一“剥离”的任务代价此前从未被测量。
AI.method: 采用三种渲染条件、7个开源权重推理模型、3个随机种子、794个任务，并使用官方检查器（checker），进行直接、盲测、多随机种子的测量；另对单一模型将删除比例从0到100%重新剂量测试。
AI.result: 同一删除操作在不同模型上得分变化从-4.4到+51.3分，两端均排除零；对重新给药的模型，删除比例0至100%变化时读数最多波动1.5分，说明敏感度稳定属于模型本身。
AI.conclusion: 删除敏感度是模型的可测属性，读数随模型本身在不同部署间保持一致；重训或重发布模型可视为新模型，用“一次保留+一次删除”两单元筛选即可低成本重测。该读书应作为先验信息进入路由与聚合，而非作为隐形默认代价。

title: Activation-Guided Graph Retrieval for Cognitive Memory Reconstruction in Language Model Systems
comment: Architecture and analysis preprint; no benchmark measurements. Companion research essay and revision notes: https://achiral.ai/research/activation-guided-graph-retrieval
summary: Retrieval-augmented language model systems generally select context by query-conditioned relevance. We argue that long-lived AI systems require a second operator: activation-conditioned memory availability. We specify an architecture in which request and goal cues seed an authorized memory graph, activation and fan attenuation allocate a bounded traversal frontier, retrieved entities recursively emit cues, and a typed evidence graph is reconstructed before generation. The specification yields five architectural consequences about candidate selection, traversal control, graph regularization, evidence reconstruction, and reinforcement. We derive implementation-level cost estimates and define ablations, failure conditions, and a reproducible evaluation protocol. The central claim is narrowed or falsified if a simpler graph reranker matches full traversal on causal and temporal recovery under equal budgets. This architecture-and-analysis preprint reports no benchmark measurements. If the claim holds, retrieval returns the evidence path that makes a memory available, not only a ranked list.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇架构与分析型预印本，提出在检索增强语言模型中于"查询相关性"之外引入"激活条件下的记忆可用性"这一第二算子，给出可实现的激活扩散式记忆图架构、成本估计、消融与可证伪条件，但不报告基准测量。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强系统仅按查询条件化的相关性选择上下文，无法支撑长期存活的AI系统对记忆的动态可用性管理；作者认为需要第二个选择算子来刻画"哪些记忆在当前被激活、可被使用"。
AI.method: 给出架构规范：(1) 请求与目标线索播种一个已授权记忆图；(2) 通过激活与扇出衰减分配有界遍历前沿；(3) 检索到的实体递归发出新线索；(4) 生成前重建类型化证据图。据此推导五条架构后果（候选选择、遍历控制、图正则化、证据重建、强化），并给出实现级成本估计、消融设计、失败条件与可复现评估协议。
AI.result: 无数值/基准结果；分析性产出为五条架构后果与实现成本估计，并设定可证伪点：在同等预算下，若更简单的图重排序器在因果与时间恢复上达到完整遍历的水平，则核心主张被削弱或证伪。
AI.conclusion: 若主张成立，检索的产物将不只是排序列表，而是"使某条记忆变得可用的证据路径"；作为架构与分析型预印本，其价值在于提供可检验的设计与评估框架，而非经验性能证据。

title: The AI Era's Lines of Code? A Case Study on What an Engineer's Token Spend Measures
summary: Organizations use engineers' token spend to monitor AI adoption, set budgets, and measure productivity, but the metric's relationship with engineering output is unclear. We link five weeks of token usage in coding agents to the commits of 404 engineers at JetBrains, and analyze a company survey of 412 employees. We find that token spend varied mostly between engineers, and which engineers spent the most stayed largely the same over the five weeks. Among weeks with similar commit counts, the 90th percentile of spend was 39 to 240 times the 10th. Within an engineer, doubling spend was associated with about 10% more commits. Available work metrics explained 38% of the variation in spend between engineers and 13% of the week-to-week variation within an engineer. In the survey, respondents in technical roles reported in nearly nine of ten agent evaluations using agents for tasks beyond coding, such as analysis, research, and planning. Token spend therefore measures how much engineers use agents across many kinds of work and not the outcome and value of that work. We recommend using token spend at most for resource accounting, and evaluating agent-assisted work with evidence about tasks and outcomes.

AI.tldr: JetBrains 将 404 名工程师五周的编程智能体 token 消耗与其提交记录关联，并分析 412 人的公司问卷，发现 token 消耗主要反映工程师使用智能体的强度与工作广度，而非产出价值。
AI.motivation: 组织用 token 消耗来监控 AI 采用度、制定预算和衡量生产力，但该指标与工程产出的关系并不清楚，需要实证检验。
AI.method: 将 5 周内编程智能体的 token 使用与 404 名 JetBrains 工程师的 commit 数据相链接，并辅以 412 名员工的问卷调查；分析 token 消耗在工程师之间与工程师内部周际的变异，以及可用工作指标对消耗变异的解释力。
AI.result: 消耗差异主要存在于工程师之间且个人排名稳定；在 commit 数相近的周中，消耗 90 分位是 10 分位的 39–240 倍；同一工程师内消耗翻倍仅对应约 10% 的 commit 增加；工作指标仅解释跨工程师变异的 38% 和周际变异的 13%；技术岗位受访者近九成的智能体评估中用于编码以外任务（分析、调研、规划）。
AI.conclusion: token 消耗衡量的是工程师在多种工作中使用智能体的程度，而非工作的成果与价值；建议最多将其用于资源核算，并以任务与成果证据来评估智能体辅助工作。

title: Explanation-Aware Fairness Beyond Output Parity: Joint Output-Attribution Regularization for Medical Image Classification
comment: Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027. Under review
summary: Output-level fairness does not constrain whether demographic groups rely on similar predictive contributions in representation space. For a nonlinear encoder with a linear head, we show that outcome-conditioned output score disparity equals the signed sum of feature attribution differences across subgroups by allowing small prediction gaps to arise through cancellation effect. We test whether an attribution disparity penalty complements output-level equalized odds based fairness surrogates. Across 960 DINOv2-LoRA models on HAM10000 and Harvard-GF datasets for gender and race fairness, attribution augmentation increases utility-fairness trade-off performance for hypervolume in six different settings with paired 95% confidence intervals and relative gains of 1.49-10.57%. Under a predefined utility constraint, augmented model families also achieve 9.0-38.7% lower equalized odds difference, lower attribution disparity, and reduced cancellation ratio while preserving predictive utility. These results support attribution fairness as a complementary explanation-aware constraint on output fairness.

AI.tldr: 提出归因公平性惩罚项，与输出级均等机会约束互补，在960个DINOv2-LoRA模型上验证其提升效用-公平权衡。
AI.motivation: 输出层面的公平性（equalized odds）无法约束不同人口群体在表示空间中是否依赖相似的预测贡献；由于抵消效应，小的预测差距可能掩盖较大的特征归因差异，因此需要解释层面的互补约束。
AI.method: 对"非线性编码器+线性头"结构，证明结果条件化的输出分数差异等于各子群特征归因差异的有符号求和。基于此提出归因差异惩罚项，与输出级均等机会公平代理（surrogates）结合，在HAM10000与Harvard-GF数据集上、针对性别与种族公平性，训练960个DINOv2-LoRA模型进行对比。
AI.result: 在6种设置中，加入归因增强均提升了超体积（hypervolume）的效用-公平权衡，配对95%置信区间下相对增益为1.49–10.57%。在预设效用约束下，增强模型族的均等机会差降低9.0–38.7%，归因差异与抵消比亦下降，同时保持预测效用。
AI.conclusion: 归因公平性可作为输出公平性的互补、解释感知型约束；仅看输出公平会遗漏表示空间中的群体归因差异，应联合优化两者。

title: IIT Patna at "ICPR 2026 TVRID Competition on Privacy-Preserving Person Re-Identification from Top-View RGB-Depth Camera"
summary: Privacy-aware person re-identification (Re-ID) from top-view cameras replaces frontal appearance with anthropometric shape, while depth sensing further reduces color-based identity cues. The ICPR 2026 TVRID competition evaluates this setting using 86 identities captured by four synchronized Intel RealSense D455 cameras with RGB and Depth streams across flat, ascent, descent, and oblique viewpoints. Performance is measured using mAP and CMC@1 across within-camera in/out, ascent-descent, and flat-oblique scenarios. The competition had 147 registered participants and 33 final submissions. Three teams from IIT Patna participated: 'abhinavkumar03' and 'sjkdgfhl_' ranked 5th and 7th among 31 ranked participants, and 'vivek katuri' reached 77.67% CMC@1 / 85.20% mAP on the RGB track. This paper presents the methods of the two top-10 teams. Methodology 1 (abhinavkumar03) achieves 93.51% mAP and 90.42% CMC@1 on Depth, ranking 4th of 28, while Methodology 2 (sjkdgfhl_) reaches 99.63%/99.35% on RGB and 86.26%/80.34% on Depth. Both substantially outperform the 57.19% track-average Depth mAP, with Methodology 1 yielding a 7.3-point gain over Methodology 2. These results demonstrate the importance of depth representation and supervision for privacy-preserving Re-ID.

AI.tldr: 本文报告 ICPR 2026 TVRID 竞赛中两支 IIT Patna 前十队伍的隐私保护俯视图行人重识别方法，基于深度与 RGB 数据取得显著优于赛题平均的成绩。
AI.motivation: 隐私保护需求下需用俯视相机的人体形态替代正面外观，并用深度感知进一步去除颜色等身份线索；竞赛旨在系统评估该设定下的可行性。
AI.method: 基于四台同步 Intel RealSense D455 采集的 86 个身份 RGB/Depth 数据（平地、上行、下行、斜视视角），以 mAP 与 CMC@1 评测；提出两套方法：Methodology 1（abhinavkumar03）侧重深度表征与监督，Methodology 2（sjkdgfhl_）在 RGB 与 Depth 上分别建模。
AI.result: Methodology 1 在 Depth 上达 93.51% mAP / 90.42% CMC@1（28 队中第4）；Methodology 2 在 RGB 达 99.63%/99.35%，Depth 达 86.26%/80.34%；均远超赛道平均 57.19% Depth mAP，Methodology 1 较 Methodology 2 高 7.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 深度表征与监督对隐私保护重识别至关重要，能在无颜色线索条件下实现高精度俯视 Re-ID。

title: MICRO: A Surgery-Phase Retinal Image Rigid Registration Benchmark and One-Step Frequency-Structure Similarity Registration Learning
summary: Precise multimodal retinal image rigid registration (MRIRG) is essential for aligning cross-modal vessel structures, offering critical guidance for ophthalmic surgery. Despite its significance, the advancement of MRIRG is hindered by the lack of publicly available multimodal retinal image rigid registration datasets spanning various ophthalmic surgery phases (e.g., preoperative, intraoperative, and postoperative). To address this issue, we introduce the MICRO dataset, a large-scale MRIRG benchmark, comprising 1,365 cross-modal retinal image pairs with standardized annotations across all ophthalmic surgery phases. Moreover, existing deep registration methods achieve competitive MRIRG results via a two-step segmentation-then-detection framework, but segmentation quality heavily constrains their performance. We argue that this dependency stems from an implicit need for keypoint topology constraints, which have not been exploited for MRIRG through a one-step registration framework. Inspired by the above analysis, we propose a novel One-step Frequency-Structure Similarity Registration (OFS2Reg) learning framework for MRIRG that leverages the potential of cross-modal vessel structure similarities to construct keypoint topology constraints under a shared detection network. To be specific, OFS2Reg applies a well-designed frequency-guided structure preservation descriptor to construct coarse keypoint topology constraints in descriptors by highlighting significant vessel structures. Additionally, we develop a new cross-modal vessel structure similarity learning method that refines cross-modal keypoint topology constraints to precisely align pixel-level cross-modal vessel structures by leveraging cross-modal vessel structure similarity priors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MICRO大规模多模态视网膜图像刚性配准数据集，并设计一步式频率-结构相似性配准框架OFS2Reg，利用跨模态血管结构相似性构建关键点拓扑约束，实现精准配准。
AI.motivation: 多模态视网膜图像刚性配准对眼科手术至关重要，但缺乏覆盖术前、术中、术后各阶段的公开数据集；现有两阶段"先分割后检测"方法严重受分割质量制约，作者认为其根源在于隐含需要关键点拓扑约束，而该约束尚未在一阶段框架中被利用。
AI.method: 构建MICRO数据集（1,365对跨模态图像、标准化标注、覆盖全手术阶段）；提出OFS2Reg一步式学习框架：在共享检测网络下，用频率引导的结构保持描述子突出血管结构以构建粗粒度关键点拓扑约束，再用跨模态血管结构相似性学习方法细化约束，实现像素级血管对齐。
AI.result: 在MICRO基准上，OFS2Reg通过一阶段配准避免了分割质量依赖，实现精准的跨模态血管结构对齐（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了多模态视网膜刚性配准数据集空白，并证明以拓扑约束为核心的一步式配准框架可有效替代分割-检测范式，为眼科手术导航提供可靠配准支持。

title: What drives the emergence of symbolic mechanisms in large language models?
comment: 25 pages, 15 figures, 5 appendices. To appear at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Recent work has identified a set of emergent symbolic mechanisms that support abstract reasoning in large language models, but it remains unclear what factors drive the emergence of these mechanisms. To address this question, we trained neural networks from scratch on abstract sequence tasks, varying both architectural and data distributional factors, and investigated the effects of these factors on the emergence of symbolic mechanisms. Using representational, attentional, and causal mediation analyses, we first confirmed that transformer-based language models trained from scratch on our task developed symbolic mechanisms. We then found that, across multiple axes of data diversity, greater diversity produced stronger symbolic signatures. Surprisingly, the same signatures emerged in modified transformer architectures and even multilayer perceptrons, indicating that architectural inductive biases are not necessary for the development of symbolic mechanisms. We also observed consistent patterns in an entity-attribute binding task. Together, these findings identify data diversity, not architecture, as the primary driver of emergent symbolic computation in neural networks.

AI.tldr: 论文通过从头训练神经网络并操纵架构与数据分布因素，发现数据多样性而非架构归纳偏置是符号机制涌现的主要驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 已有研究在大语言模型中发现支持抽象推理的涌现符号机制，但这些机制由何种因素驱动仍不清楚，需要明确架构与数据分布的作用。
AI.method: 在抽象序列任务上从头训练神经网络，改变架构因素与数据分布因素；采用表征分析、注意力分析和因果中介分析检验符号机制的出现。
AI.result: 从头训练的Transformer语言模型确实发展出符号机制；在多个数据多样性维度上，多样性越高符号特征越强；相同特征在改造后的Transformer架构乃至多层感知机中也会出现，而架构归纳偏置并非必要条件；实体-属性绑定任务上呈现一致模式。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络中涌现符号计算的主要驱动因素是数据多样性，而非架构。

title: A Technique to Model Product Information and User Reviews (MPIUR)
summary: Modern e-commerce platforms naturally provide three complementary modalities: textual item descriptions, item images, and user reviews. However, existing multimodal recommendation methods often omit reviews or do not integrate all three modalities within a unified framework. In this paper, we propose MPIUR, a multimodal graph-based recommendation model that encodes reviews in heterogeneous graphs, aligns image and text representations, and adapts collaborative--semantic alignment to item interaction density. Experiments on the Amazon Reviews 2023 Musical Instruments and Baby categories show that MPIUR achieves the best global nDCG@10 and Recall@10 among the evaluated methods on both datasets. It also obtains the best nDCG@10 and Recall@10 on sparse items, indicating that jointly exploiting reviews and multimodal item content is particularly useful when interaction histories are limited.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态图推荐模型MPIUR，统一融合物品文本描述、图片与用户评论三种模态，在Amazon Reviews 2023两个类目上取得最佳整体及稀疏物品的nDCG@10与Recall@10。
AI.motivation: 现有电商多模态推荐方法往往忽略评论，或未能在统一框架中整合文本、图像、评论三种互补模态。
AI.method: 构建基于图的框架：在异构图编码用户评论，对图像与文本表示进行对齐，并依据物品交互密度自适应调整协同—语义对齐。
AI.result: 在Amazon Reviews 2023的Musical Instruments与Baby两个类目上，MPIUR在整体nDCG@10和Recall@10上优于所评估基线；在稀疏物品上同样取得最佳表现。
AI.conclusion: 联合利用评论与多模态物品内容，在交互历史有限时尤为有效，为数据稀疏推荐提供增益。

title: SPARK: Semantic-preserving Prompt Mutation for Code Generation using Consensus-based Verification Framework
summary: Automated code generation with large language models (LLMs) has improved in recent years. With the lack of test cases in real-world usages, generated code is not automatically verifiable and often requires manual validation. Previous studies have leveraged consensus verification, where code solutions and corresponding test cases are generated and evaluated based on functional consistency. Building on this, SPARK incorporates semantic-preserving mutations to problem descriptions such as paraphrasing, grammatical adjustments, function renaming, and other alterations to enhance the robustness and correctness of LLM-generated code. For each mutated description, SPARK generates a set of code solutions and test cases. These candidate solutions are evaluated using consensus-based verification, where the solutions' quality is measured by how consistently they pass generated tests. We assess the effectiveness of SPARK on three benchmarks (LiveCodeBench, BigCodeBench, and DLBench) across three LLMs (o4-mini, DeepSeek-R1-Basic, and Gemini-2.5-Pro). Our evaluation demonstrates that SPARK outperforms state-of-the-art consensus-based verification approaches by up to 4.1%. Our generalization experiment highlights the practical potential of SPARK as an effective strategy for enhancing the reliability and correctness of LLM-based code generation systems in scenarios where traditional validation resources are scarce, while our qualitative analysis shows insight into how SPARK's mutation helps LLMs generate better code solutions.

AI.tldr: SPARK 通过在问题描述上施加语义保持的变异（改述、语法调整、函数重命名等）生成多组代码与测试，再用一致性验证打分，在三个基准和三个 LLM 上比现有共识验证方法最高提升 4.1%。
AI.motivation: 真实场景缺乏测试用例，LLM 生成的代码无法自动验证、常需人工检查；已有共识验证依赖单一问题描述，鲁棒性与正确性仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 对原始问题描述做语义保持变异（改述、语法调整、函数重命名等），每个变异描述各生成一组候选解与测试用例；随后对候选解进行基于共识的验证，以其通过所生成测试的一致性衡量解的质量。
AI.result: 在 LiveCodeBench、BigCodeBench、DLBench 三个基准及 o4-mini、DeepSeek-R1-Basic、Gemini-2.5-Pro 三个模型上，SPARK 较现有最优共识验证方法最高提升 4.1%；泛化实验显示其在验证资源稀缺场景下具有实用潜力，定性分析揭示了变异促进更好代码生成的原因。
AI.conclusion: 语义保持的提示变异结合一致性验证是一种有效策略，可提升 LLM 代码生成的可靠性与正确性，适用于缺少传统验证资源的场景。

title: Continuous-Time Set-Transformers for Asynchronous WiFi-IMU Indoor Localization
summary: Indoor localization commonly combines WiFi received signal strength indicator (RSSI) fingerprints with inertial measurements. However, these sensor streams are sampled asynchronously at different rates; therefore, observations rarely align in time and may be missing or stale. Most existing methods resample the data onto a shared clock and process each modality using a separate branch. We instead present a continuous-time transformer that represents observations as an unordered set of timestamped tokens. Each token encodes its measurement, modality, and elapsed time since acquisition. A single attention block jointly fuses information across modalities and time, avoiding both resampling and modality-specific branches while remaining invariant to token order. During training, we randomly mask entire modalities and individual observations, enabling the model to operate under missing or outdated inputs. We validate the modality-specific encoders on their respective benchmarks and evaluate the fused model on both simulated and real datasets, including a crosssession dataset collected on unseen days. The proposed approach improves upon an open WiFi fingerprinting baseline under cross-session drift, remains competitive with learned fusion and dead-reckoning baselines, and degrades gracefully as observations become missing or stale. These results suggest that a single continuoustime transformer provides a practical framework for indoor localization from asynchronous sensors.

AI.tldr: 提出连续时间Transformer处理室内定位中异步、缺失或过时的WiFi RSSI与惯性测量数据。
AI.motivation: 室内定位中WiFi RSSI指纹与惯性测量异步采样、速率不同，时间难对齐且常有缺失或陈旧数据；现有方法多发到统一时钟并分模态分支处理。
AI.method: 将观测表示为无序的时间戳token集合，每个token编码测量值、模态及距采集的时间间隔；单一注意力块跨模态与时间联合融合，避免重采样与模态专用分支且对token顺序不变；训练时随机屏蔽整个模态和单个观测以增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 各模态编码器在其基准上验证；融合模型在仿真与真实数据集（含未见日期采集的跨会话数据）上评估。在跨会话漂移下优于开源WiFi指纹基线，与学习融合及航位推算基线相当，并在观测缺失或陈旧时优雅退化。
AI.conclusion: 单一连续时间Transformer可作为异步传感器室内定位的实用框架。

title: RBLA+: Efficient Rank-Specific LoRA Adapter Extraction for Federated Fine-Tuning with Heterogeneous Clients
summary: Federated fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces communication and computational overhead by training and exchanging compact trainable LoRA factors. Clients may use different LoRA ranks to meet adapter communication budgets and accommodate different local adaptation needs. The server must process these differences during aggregation and construct adapters at each client's rank for local training. We distinguish pre-aggregation alignment, which handles factor dimensions and scaling conventions before aggregation and rank-specific LoRA adapter extraction, which constructs client-sized pairs from the aggregated global model. Two common approaches to rank-specific extraction are direct rank truncation and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) of the dense update.
