Direct prefix truncation keeps the leading columns of one aggregated factor and the corresponding rows of the other. It is cheap but can increase reconstruction error. The dense SVD approach first forms the product of aggregated LoRA factors. It then decomposes this matrix and retains the leading singular components to construct adapters at the target rank. This gives the optimal rank-constrained approximation in Frobenius norm but incurs significant computational overhead. To address this trade-off, we propose RBLA+ as an extension of RBLA. It uses established compact QR/core-SVD decomposition to minimize Frobenius error for the extracted LoRA update without forming the dense update. It also accounts for client and server scaling conventions during upload and broadcast. Across vision and language tasks, RBLA+ improves accuracy over RBLA in multiple heterogeneous settings. In CPU benchmarks with synthetic adapters, RBLA+ has lower extraction time than the dense partial-SVD baseline. RBLA+ preserves each client's prescribed adapter size and per-round communication payload.

AI.tldr: RBLA+ 用紧凑 QR/core-SVD 分解从聚合后的 LoRA 因子中提取各客户端特定秩的适配器，在不构造稠密更新的前提下最小化 Frobenius 误差，并统一客户端/服务器的缩放约定。
AI.motivation: 联邦 LoRA 微调中各客户端使用不同秩，服务器聚合后需为每个客户端构造其秩大小的适配器。直接前缀截断虽然便宜但重构误差大，稠密 SVD 虽最优但计算开销高，需在精度与效率间取得平衡。
AI.method: 区分预聚合对齐（处理因子维度与缩放约定）与秩特定提取两步；RBLA+ 作为 RBLA 的扩展，采用紧凑 QR + core-SVD 分解，直接作用于聚合后的 LoRA 因子，避免形成稠密更新矩阵，同时处理上下行广播中的客户端与服务器缩放约定。
AI.result: 在视觉与语言任务的多种异构设置中，RBLA+ 的精度优于 RBLA；在 CPU 合成适配器基准上，其提取时间低于稠密部分 SVD 基线。
AI.conclusion: RBLA+ 在保持各客户端指定适配器大小与每轮通信负载不变的同时，兼顾了低重构误差与低计算开销，是秩异构联邦 LoRA 聚合的有效秩特定提取方案。

title: SpatialSR: Spatial Resolution-Centric Pipeline for Arbitrary-Scale Remote Sensing Super-Resolution
summary: Although remote sensing image arbitrary-scale super-resolution (RSI-ASSR) methods support reconstruction at arbitrary or continuous scales, they predominantly condition on the relative scale factor and have not sufficiently investigated the absolute spatial resolution itself as a reconstruction prior, thereby disregarding the inherent spatial context of objects, which frequently leads to spatial-related distortions and compromised performance in downstream remote sensing applications. To address these challenges, we introduce SpatialSR, a SRe-centric arbitrary-scale RSISR method that leverages the spatial resolution (SRe) of remote sensing images (RSI) as an essential prior for super-resolution reconstruction. Distinct from existing SR methods, SpatialSR aims to restore high-resolution remote sensing images with a target SRe (typically set to 0.1m/pixel to align with the metadata of commonly used downstream task datasets). Specifically, we design a Spatial Resolution Estimation Module (SREM) to estimate the SRe of low-resolution (LR) images, thereby dynamically determining the required arbitrary scaling factor. Next, we employ a pretrained SRe-to-image diffusion model to extract SRe-specified texture-style codes, which are further incorporated into a carefully designed Resolution-aware Style Consistency Module (RSCM) to constrain the SRe-aware texture consistency of reconstructed images. Furthermore, to overcome the high computational expense inherent in diffusion-based SR methods, we wrap the iterative diffusion process as a Trajectory Consistency (TC) loss, which enables comparable reconstructed texture quality of the generative model in SpatialSR within a single step. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed SpatialSR achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on commonly used RSISR and downstream (image classification and segmentation tasks) datasets.

AI.tldr: SpatialSR以绝对空间分辨率(SRe)为核心先验进行遥感图像任意尺度超分，通过SRe估计、SRe指定纹理风格约束与扩散轨迹一致性损失，实现单步高质重建并提升下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有RSI-ASSR方法主要依赖相对尺度因子，未充分利用绝对空间分辨率这一先验，忽略了对象固有的空间上下文，导致空间相关失真并影响下游遥感应用性能。
AI.method: 1) 设计空间分辨率估计模块SREM估计LR图像SRe，动态确定所需任意缩放因子；2) 用预训练SRe-to-image扩散模型提取SRe指定的纹理风格码，经分辨率感知风格一致性模块RSCM约束重建图像的SRe感知纹理一致性；3) 将迭代扩散过程包装为轨迹一致性TC损失，实现单步生成即达到接近扩散模型的重建纹理质量。目标是重建指定SRe（如0.1m/pixel，对齐下游数据集元数据）的HR图像。
AI.result: 在常用RSISR数据集及下游图像分类、分割任务数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 以绝对空间分辨率为先验的SRe中心范式可有效缓解空间失真，且通过TC损失在单步内兼顾生成质量与计算效率，验证了SRe先验对遥感超分及下游任务的价值。

title: Measuring Definition Sensitivity in LLM Annotation of Social Science Concepts
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE: Can We Trust AI Evaluation? Robustness, Causality, and Risk in Modern AI Assessment
summary: In social science research, text annotation is a fundamental task that is traditionally a costly, hard-to-scale manual process. Researchers have used large language models (LLMs) to perform annotation by writing a definition of a concept into a prompt - a rule that determines whether a label should be attributed to a text depending on its content. However, concepts such as hate speech, fake news, and terrorism typically have several theoretically defensible competing definitions. It is also unknown whether the model actually applied the definition to provide the label or the label was based on the model's pretrained notion of the concept. To test this, we have the model annotate the same texts twice, each time with a different definition. We call the disagreement between the two sets of annotations definition sensitivity. As a control, we paraphrase one definition but leave its requirements unchanged - the disagreement between the annotations with the two wordings becomes the paraphrase floor. Across six concepts and three LLMs, a swap of competing definitions always changes more annotations, on average, than a paraphrase. This shows that the annotations depend on the prompted definition, so any set of annotations should be interpreted together with the definition that produced it. The LLM annotator's definition sensitivity and its paraphrase floor should both be reported in such work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"定义敏感性"（definition sensitivity）指标，通过让LLM用不同竞争性定义两次标注同一批文本，度量标注随定义变化而改变的程度，并以"改写底线"（paraphrase floor）为对照，证明LLM标注确实依赖所给定义。
AI.motivation: 社会科学中的文本标注传统上昂贵且难扩展，研究者用LLM将概念定义写入提示词来标注。但仇恨言论、假新闻、恐怖主义等概念本身存在多种理论上都站得住脚的竞争性定义，且无法确定模型究竟是根据提示中的定义给出标签，还是依据其预训练中对该概念的固有理解——这关系到LLM标注的有效性与可解释性。
AI.method: 对同一批文本用两个不同定义分别标注一次，两次标注间的分歧称为"定义敏感性"；作为对照，对其中一个定义做不改要求的改写，两种措辞标注间的分歧称为"改写底线"。在6个概念、3个LLM上进行实验比较。
AI.result: 在所有6个概念和3个LLM上，交换竞争性定义所引起的标注变化平均而言总是大于改写所带来的变化，即定义敏感度稳定高于改写底线。
AI.conclusion: LLM的标注确实依赖于所提示的定义，因此任何标注结果都应与产生它的定义一并解读；相关研究应同时报告标注者的定义敏感性和改写底线。

title: IFRS Compliance Verification: An Open Multi-LLM Benchmark and Content-Conditioned Ensemble Classifier
summary: Verifying corporate financial disclosures against the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) is a core auditing task in which experts cross-reference disclosures with hundreds of fine-grained regulatory paragraphs: a laborious, costly, and error-prone process that motivates growing interest in large language models (LLMs) as compliance assistants. Yet single-model accuracy remains insufficient for high-stakes use, and naive ensembling is vulnerable to systematic per-model biases that can drag aggregate accuracy below that of the strongest individual annotator. This gap is addressed with a multi-stage framework, supported by a new benchmark of 19,998 IFRS regulation-disclosure pairs comprising 11,161 unanimous multi-LLM labels and 8,837 human annotations on items where the LLMs disagreed. The framework couples a three-stage domain-adapted sentence embedding pipeline (BERT masked language modeling on SEC EDGAR filings, unsupervised TSDAE and SimCSE adaptation, and supervised contrastive alignment) with a learned ensemble classifier that fuses frozen embeddings and LLM probability features from GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4, and Gemini 2.5 Pro via Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) optimized gradient-boosted trees. On the disagreement set, the ensemble achieves 81.7% weighted F1, exceeding the strongest single LLM by 10.4 points and majority voting by 14.6 points, and outperforms eleven unsupervised aggregation baselines; the retrieval pipeline attains Recall@15 of 45.3% on unseen regulations. The dataset, model checkpoints, annotation platform, and classifier implementation will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出多阶段框架，用领域自适应句嵌入+TPE优化梯度提升树融合GPT-4.1、Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro的概率特征，验证企业财报披露是否符合IFRS，并发布19,998条IFRS法规-披露配对基准。
AI.motivation: IFRS合规审计需将披露与数百条细粒度法规逐条对照，人工成本高、易出错；单模型LLM准确率不足，而朴素集成易被各模型系统性偏差拖累，甚至低于最强单一标注者。
AI.method: 构建19,998对IFRS法规-披露基准（11,161条多LLM一致标签，8,837条人工标注分歧项）；三阶段领域自适应句嵌入（SEC EDGAR财报BERT MLM、无监督TSDAE与SimCSE、监督对比对齐）；学习型集成分类器融合冻结嵌入与三模型概率特征，用TPE优化梯度提升树。
AI.result: 分歧集上加权F1达81.7%，比最强单LLM高10.4点、比多数投票高14.6点，优于11种无监督聚合基线；检索管线在未见法规上Recall@15为45.3%。
AI.conclusion: 学习型多阶段集成可有效抑制单模型偏差，为高风险IFRS合规审计提供可靠LLM辅助；数据集、模型检查点、标注平台与分类器实现将公开。

title: An Empirical Study on Improving LLM-Based Issue Classification through Domain-Informed Analysis
summary: Issue reports that describe Intrinsic Bugs, Extrinsic Bugs, and Not a Bug cases often use similar language, but they might point to different causes and require different maintenance actions. This makes three-way issue classification difficult for Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly when prompt-based refinements begin to plateau. We study whether domain-informed analysis of LLM outputs can improve classification beyond prompt modification alone. Using 428 manually labeled issue reports, we evaluate six LLMs across 18 prompt configurations and analyze 7,704 model-generated rationales to identify recurring failure patterns in how models justify predictions, use evidence, and handle conflicting information. We translate these findings into a multi-stage pipeline that separates bug validity from bug origin. The pipeline improves macro F1 and Extrinsic Bug recall for five of the six models. The strongest pipeline configuration reaches 0.827 accuracy and 0.757 Extrinsic Bug recall, improving over the best-accuracy prompt-only baseline by +1.2 and +7.5 pp, respectively. The decomposition further reveals that bug origin classification is more reliable than validity, indicating that the bug-validity decision accounts for most of the remaining error. These results show that expert failure analysis can support more reliable LLM-based software engineering classifiers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究通过领域知识驱动的LLM输出失败分析，超越单纯提示工程来提升Intrinsic/Extrinsic/Not a Bug三元问题报告分类，并提出将“缺陷有效性”与“缺陷来源”分离的多阶段流水线。
AI.motivation: 三类问题报告（Intrinsic Bug、Extrinsic Bug、Not a Bug）用词相似但成因与维护动作不同，导致LLM三分类困难，且仅靠提示词改进已进入平台期。
AI.method: 基于428条人工标注报告，在18种提示配置下评估6个LLM，分析7704条模型生成的推理理由，识别模型在论证、证据使用与冲突信息处理上的反复失败模式，并据此构建分离缺陷有效性与缺陷来源的多阶段流水线。
AI.result: 6个模型中有5个的宏F1与Extrinsic Bug召回得到提升；最佳流水线达到0.827准确率与0.757 Extrinsic召回，较最佳纯提示基线分别+1.2和+7.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 缺陷来源分类比有效性判断更可靠，剩余误差主要来自有效性判定；专家式失败分析可支撑更可靠的LLM软件工程分类器。

title: BuySideFlow: A Point-in-Time Benchmark for LLM Agents in Investment Research
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate SQL and SQL--Python workflows for investment research, but ensuring point-in-time (PIT) validity remains challenging. Agents must enforce disclosure cutoffs and select the appropriate historical states and record versions throughout data retrieval and financial analysis. We introduce \textsc{BuySideFlow}, a benchmark of 408 practitioner-derived Chinese-language tasks spanning equities, funds, fixed income, and macroeconomics over a fixed snapshot from a licensed production financial database. We provide executable references and a taxonomy of temporal errors, pairing result checks with expert audits of executed workflows. We evaluate nine agent configurations on all tasks, with result accuracy ranging from 16.2\% to 36.8\%. An audit of 900 runs on 100 shared tasks confirms PIT violations in 193 of the 380 runs that pass result checks (50.8\%), showing that output agreement alone does not establish temporal validity.

AI.tldr: 提出 BuySideFlow，一个含408个中文买方投研任务的基准，检验LLM智能体在SQL/Python工作流中的时点(PIT)有效性；九个智能体配置结果准确率仅16.2%–36.8%，且通过结果校验的运行中约半数存在时点违规。
AI.motivation: LLM可生成SQL与SQL-Python投研工作流，但在数据检索与分析全过程中难以保证时点有效性（须遵守信息披露截止日、选取正确的历史状态与记录版本），现有评测缺乏对此的检验。
AI.method: 构建408个由从业者提炼的中文任务，覆盖股票、基金、固定收益与宏观，基于授权生产数据库的固定快照；提供可执行参考答案和时点错误分类体系，将结果校验与对已执行工作流的专家审计相结合；评测九种智能体配置，并对100个共有任务上的900次运行做审计。
AI.result: 结果准确率区间为16.2%至36.8%；380次通过结果校验的运行中有193次(50.8%)被确认存在PIT违规，说明仅靠输出一致无法确立时间有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结果正确性不等于时间有效性，需将PIT审计纳入智能体评测；BuySideFlow为买方投研工作流的时点合规提供了可执行基准与诊断工具。

title: Just Image Transformers with Late-Stage Pixel Refinement
summary: Recent work on latent-free diffusion transformers has demonstrated the feasibility of training image generators without a latent VAE. This avoids compression artifacts from the VAE and simplifies the training pipeline. In particular, JiT showed that even a standard transformer can be trained to generate images when the model is trained to predict the final image ($x$-prediction). Even though JiT unlocks training efficiency comparable to latent models, it still suffers from reduced image quality likely arising from modeling the image as a collection of large patches. In this work, we revisit JiT and show that adding simple convolutional pixel-pathway layers in a post-training phase significantly improves generation quality. Moreover, we show that the added pixel-pathway does not need to be active in the early denoising stages, and can be activated as late as in the last $20\%$ of the denoising process. Our experiments on ImageNet@256 show improvements compared to the original JiT results, achieving an FID of $1.78$ (from $2.34$ with corrected sampling), without using additional losses.

AI.tldr: 在JiT（无潜变量的扩散Transformer）训练完成后，加入简单的卷积"像素通路"并在去噪后20%阶段激活，可在ImageNet@256上将FID从2.34降至1.78，且无需额外损失。
AI.motivation: 无VAE的潜变量-free扩散Transformer（如JiT）虽避免了VAE压缩伪影并简化训练管线，但因将图像建模为较大的patch集合，生成质量偏低。作者希望在不牺牲效率、不引入额外损失的前提下提升图像质量。
AI.method: 重新审视JiT：在训练后（post-training）阶段为其增加简单的卷积像素通路（pixel-pathway）层。进一步发现该像素通路无需在去噪早期激活，可延迟到去噪过程的最后20%才启用。
AI.result: 在ImageNet@256上，相比原始JiT结果（修正采样后FID为2.34），FID提升至1.78，且未使用任何额外损失函数。
AI.conclusion: 简单的卷积像素通路后训练微调即可显著改善无潜变量扩散Transformer的生成质量，且其仅需在后期去噪阶段生效，是一种低成本、易实现的质量提升方案。

title: Understanding Students' Rationales for AI-Mediated Cheating: An Instructor Perspective from Online Forums Analysis
comment: 3 pages, 1 table, 0 figures. Poster paper published in ICLS 2026
summary: The extensive adoption of AI has precipitated a crisis in academic integrity. While studies attempt to quantify cheating, less is known about the motivations instructors believe students have for using AI in prohibited ways. We analyze 2.01 million posts on r/Professors to understand how instructors perceive students' justifications for AI-mediated cheating. Our qualitative analyses reveal four primary themes: (1) Academic System Gaming, (2) Digital-Academic Literacy Gap, (3) Performance Anxiety, and (4) Normalization of Dishonesty.

AI.tldr: 通过对 r/Professors 论坛 201 万条帖子的定性分析，研究揭示了教师所感知的学生使用 AI 作弊的四大动机：钻学术制度空子、数字-学术素养差距、成绩焦虑、以及不诚信行为的常态化。
AI.motivation: AI 的广泛使用引发学术诚信危机。已有研究多关注作弊行为的量化，但对教师认为学生为何违规使用 AI 的动机了解不足。
AI.method: 对 Reddit 平台 r/Professors 版块的 201 万条帖子进行定性分析，考察教师对学生为 AI 作弊所提出理由的认知与解读。
AI.result: 归纳出四个主要主题：(1) 学术制度博弈；(2) 数字与学术素养差距；(3) 成绩焦虑；(4) 不诚信的常态化。
AI.conclusion: 教师将学生 AI 作弊视为制度、素养、心理与规范多重因素交织的结果，为理解 AI 时代学术诚信问题提供了动机层面的视角，对教学干预与诚信政策设计具有启示意义。

title: From Counterfactual Edits to Human Narratives: LLM-Driven Interpretations for Recommender System Explanations
summary: Recommender systems increasingly influence what users discover and consume online, yet the decision logic behind their outputs often remains opaque. Counterfactual explanation (CFX) methods provide an effective way to show which changes to a user's interaction history would alter a recommendation. In recommendation settings, however, CFXs often require many edits, producing long, low-level lists that are hard for users to interpret. Moreover, most evaluations emphasize edit counts while largely overlooking whether the resulting CFXs are coherent and actionable for users. We argue that this gap between generating valid CFXs and communicating model behavior stems from the lack of user-centered abstraction and limited qualitative evaluation. To bridge this gap, we investigate large language models as mediators that summarize raw CFX interaction edit lists into concise natural language explanations describing higher-level preference patterns. We optimize these mediators for correctness, informativeness, and linguistic quality through preference optimization, and evaluate the resulting explanations with human-calibrated metrics derived from separate human-labeled datasets. On the MovieLens-1M dataset, across multiple counterfactual generators and language models, the resulting summaries achieve high overall linguistic quality, while the strongest semantic results are obtained with high-success CFX methods such as ACCENT and SPINRec. Direct Preference Optimization improves the semantic metrics in almost all evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 论文将大型语言模型作为"中介者"，把反事实解释（CFX）生成的原始交互编辑列表总结为简洁的自然语言高层偏好模式解释，并用偏好优化提升其正确性、信息量与语言质量，在MovieLens-1M上通过人工校准指标评估。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统决策逻辑不透明，CFX虽能说明改变哪些历史交互会改变推荐，但往往需要大量编辑、生成冗长低层次的列表，用户难以理解；现有评估偏重编辑数量，忽视解释的连贯性与可操作性。这一差距源于缺乏以用户为中心的抽象以及定性评估不足。
AI.method: 提出以LLM为中介，将原始CFX交互编辑列表总结为描述高层偏好模式的自然语言解释；通过偏好优化（DPO）针对正确性、信息量和语言质量进行优化；并使用由独立人工标注数据集衍生的人工校准指标进行评估，覆盖多种反事实生成器与多种语言模型。
AI.result: 在MovieLens-1M上，生成的摘要整体语言质量较高；语义效果最强的是高成功率的CFX方法（如ACCENT和SPINRec）；直接偏好优化（DPO）在几乎所有实验设置下都提升了语义指标。
AI.conclusion: LLM中介加偏好优化能有效把低层次CFX编辑列表转化为连贯、可操作的高层偏好解释，弥合"生成有效CFX"与"传达模型行为"之间的差距，表明以用户为中心的抽象与定性评估对可解释推荐具有重要价值。

title: Do They Do as They Are Told? Investigating Coding Agents' Adherence to Explicit Instructions in Context Files
summary: Developers increasingly rely on agent context files (ACFs), persistent, project-scoped artifacts such as AGENTS.md, to steer the behavior of autonomous coding agents without renegotiating expectations at every interaction. Yet this governance mechanism rests on an untested assumption: that instructions written into an ACF are actually carried out, rather than ignored or loosely followed. Existing studies describe what ACFs contain, but not whether individual instructions are followed, leaving open which guidance can be trusted. We address this gap through an empirical study of real-world ACF snapshots and their linked agent-generated commits: characterizing the explicit, actionable instructions ACFs encode, operationalizing them into executable measurement scripts, and using these scripts to assess instruction-level compliance. We find that most observable instructions can be operationalized and that agents follow ACF guidance more often than not, but adherence splits sharply between instructions followed consistently and those never respected, with differences across instruction categories and coding agents. This split shows where ACF guidance works and where it does not, pointing to instruction types that may need rewriting and to agents that may need enforcement beyond the ACF. These findings lay the groundwork for systematic approaches to specifying, verifying, and enforcing project-specific instructions in autonomous software development.

AI.tldr: 本文实证检验了项目级智能体上下文文件（ACF，如 AGENTS.md）中的指令是否被编码智能体真正执行，发现多数指令可被操作化衡量，智能体总体遵循率较高但呈两极分化，且依指令类别与智能体而异。
AI.motivation: 开发者依赖 ACF 免去逐次协商来引导智能体行为，但"写入即执行"的假设从未被检验；已有研究只描述 ACF 内容，未评估单条指令是否被遵循，导致无法判断哪些指导可信。
AI.method: 收集真实世界 ACF 快照及其关联的智能体生成提交；提取其中显式、可执行的指令并操作化为可执行测量脚本，据此进行指令级遵循度评估。
AI.result: 大多数可观察指令可被操作化；智能体总体遵循率高于不遵循，但遵循情况呈明显两极——部分指令始终被遵守，部分从未被遵守；不同指令类别与不同编码智能体之间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 该分化揭示了 ACF 指导有效与失效的边界，指出需重写的指令类型及需在 ACF 之外强制约束的智能体，为项目特定指令的规范、验证与强制执行奠定基础。

authors: for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
title: IC-GNN: Modeling Individualized Brain Community Organization for Disease Prediction
summary: Brain networks exhibit modular organization, where community structures vary substantially across individuals and diseases. Understanding these individual differences is crucial for advancing both basic neuroscience research and precision medicine. However, widely used predefined group-level brain atlases often overlook this heterogeneity. While individualized functional parcellations capture subject-specific variability in community boundaries, they often require lengthy scan times to achieve fine-grained resolution and complicate cross-subject comparisons. To address this trade-off and investigate how individualized community organization captures disease-associated changes across individuals, we propose IC-GNN, an atlas-anchored model that forms distinct, individualized functional communities directly over atlas-defined brain regions. IC-GNN derives discrete, individualized multiscale communities from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data, refines community-guided connections, and adapts shared regional weights to each subject's community context to enable both individualized modeling and group-level comparisons. Across more than 30,000 participants from ABIDE (autism spectrum disorder), ADNI (Alzheimer's disease), and the UK Biobank (depression), IC-GNN achieves the highest performance compared with 15 baseline methods. We further demonstrate that these individualized communities are reproducible within scans and across sessions, and carry predictive power on their own. Furthermore, IC-GNN identifies disease-related shifts in community organization that align with established literature, highlighting a promising approach for modeling individualized community structure for disease prediction and biomarker discovery.

AI.tldr: IC-GNN是一个"atlas锚定"模型，直接在预定义脑图谱区域上生成个体化的离散多尺度功能社区，兼顾个体建模与跨被试比较；在ABIDE、ADNI、UK Biobank超3万人数据上优于15个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 脑网络的模块（社区）结构在个体与疾病间差异显著，但常用的大样本组水平脑图谱忽略了这种异质性；个体化功能分区虽能刻画变异，却需要长扫描时间、且难以进行跨被试比较。论文旨在解决这一权衡，并研究个体化社区组织如何反映疾病相关变化。
AI.method: 提出IC-GNN：从静息态fMRI数据中，在atlas定义的脑区之上推导出离散的、个体化的多尺度社区；细化社区引导的连接；并依据每个被试的社区背景自适应调整共享区域权重，从而实现个体化建模与组水平比较并存。
AI.result: 在ABIDE（自闭症）、ADNI（阿尔茨海默病）、UK Biobank（抑郁）共3万余名被试上，性能优于15个基线方法；个体化社区在单次扫描内及跨session可复现，且本身具有预测能力；模型识别出与文献一致的疾病相关社区组织改变。
AI.conclusion: IC-GNN提供了一种兼顾个体化与可比性的脑社区建模方案，在疾病预测与生物标志物发现方面具有潜力。

title: TrustMod-SM: A Multi-Axis Benchmark for Evaluating Trustworthiness of LLMs in Social Media Content Moderation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong potential for social media content moderation, but their trustworthiness beyond overall accuracy remains underexplored. We introduce TrustMod-SM, a benchmark of roughly 29,000 instances across eight datasets, to evaluate LLM moderators on five dimensions: trustfulness, fairness, safety, robustness, and context integrity. Evaluating 16 open-weight models (0.5B-284B parameters, spanning text-only and vision-language architectures) and one closed frontier model, we find persistent trustworthiness gaps. Higher detection accuracy often coincides with greater demographic disparity, and models frequently comply with concealment or exaggeration prompts, assign high confidence to wrong predictions, rarely escalate ambiguous cases, and struggle to separate hate speech from counter-speech or reclaimed language (especially below 8B parameters). Scaling does not uniformly resolve these issues, and no single model excels across all five dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出 TrustMod-SM 基准（约 2.9 万实例、8 个数据集），从可信、公平、安全、鲁棒、语境完整性五维度评估 17 个 LLM 审核模型，发现准确率与可信度存在系统性冲突。
AI.motivation: LLM 在社交媒体内容审核上潜力大，但已有研究多关注整体准确率，忽视其可信度（公平性、安全性、鲁棒性、语境理解等）的系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建 TrustMod-SM 基准，涵盖约 29,000 个实例、8 个数据集，定义五个评估维度；评测 16 个开放权重模型（0.5B–284B，含纯文本与视觉语言架构）及 1 个闭源前沿模型。
AI.result: 检测准确率越高常伴随更大的人口群体差异；模型易服从隐瞒或夸大指令；对错误预测给出高置信度；极少上报模糊案例；难以区分仇恨言论与反击言论/再赋权用语（尤其 8B 以下）；模型规模扩大并不能统一解决这些问题；无单一模型在五维度上全面领先。
AI.conclusion: LLM 内容审核存在持续的可信度缺口，准确率不等于可信；需从多维度综合评估并针对性改进，而非仅依赖规模扩展。

title: VIGOR: Benchmarking Visual Rationale Correctness in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are typically evaluated by whether they produce correct answers, but correctness alone does not reveal whether their outputs are supported by the right visual evidence. We introduce VIGOR, a benchmark for evaluating VIsually GrOunded Rationales in MLLMs. VIGOR represents visual rationales as explicit concepts paired with pixel-level groundings, covering multiple abstraction levels including low-level visual properties, intermediate structures, objects, parts and high-level motion, relations. To construct VIGOR at scale, we develop an automatic annotation framework that reuses existing dense supervision when available and generates missing concept groundings through proposal-based annotation followed by conservative multimodal verification. Using VIGOR, we evaluate whether MLLMs "look at what they say" by comparing model-derived visual evidence for each expressed concept against annotated ground-truth rationales. Our results show that current MLLMs exhibit limited visual rationale correctness and reveal distinct grounding failures across concept levels. VIGOR provides a benchmark and scalable data construction pipeline for studying whether MLLM outputs are supported by appropriate visual evidence. Code is available at https://github.com/deep-real/VIGOR

AI.tldr: 提出VIGOR基准，用显式概念+像素级定位评估MLLM的视觉推理依据是否真正有视觉证据支撑。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM评估只看答案是否正确，无法揭示输出是否由正确的视觉证据支持，"答对"可能是捷径或幻觉。
AI.method: 将视觉推理依据表示为概念与像素级grounding配对，覆盖低层视觉属性、中间结构、物体、部件、高层动作与关系；构建自动标注框架：复用已有稠密监督，缺失部分用proposal-based标注+保守多模态验证生成；评估时将模型对每个概念所依据的视觉证据与GT理由比对。
AI.result: 当前MLLM的视觉推理依据正确性有限，且在不同概念层级上呈现各自不同的grounding失败模式。
AI.conclusion: VIGOR提供了可扩展的基准与数据构建流程，用于研究MLLM输出是否有恰当视觉证据支撑。

title: Mapping Instructors' Attitudes Towards Cheating with AI: An Exploratory Analysis Using Forum Analysis
comment: 5 pages, 1 table, 0 figures. Short paper published in ICLS 2026
summary: In teaching and learning environments, cheating and the violation of academic integrity have always been one of the challenges, involving different levels of concerns such as administrative, personal knowledge, learning, and equity. The introduction of large language models has brought cheating in dialogue to the forefront, given the apparent capabilities of these models to complete students' academic assignments. This study aims to leverage recent dialogues among university professors about cheating with Generative AI to better understand their beliefs about academic honesty. In doing so, we analyze a corpus of 2.01 million posts (threads and comments) in the r/Professors subreddit discussing cheating after the release of ChatGPT, providing a better understanding of teachers' motivations to discourage cheating and the strategies they use to do so. We synthesize the why and how of addressing cheating to identify caveats about the future of AI and academic integration.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析r/Professors子版块中201万条讨论帖，探究ChatGPT发布后大学教授对学术作弊的信念、反对作弊的动机及应对策略。
AI.motivation: LLM出现使对话式作弊成为焦点，学生可用其完成作业，威胁学术诚信，涉及管理、知识、学习与公平等多层面关切，但教师对此的真实信念尚缺乏系统理解。
AI.method: 收集并分析r/Professors子版块在ChatGPT发布后讨论作弊的2.01百万条帖子（主题帖与评论）语料，归纳教师劝阻作弊的动机与所用策略，并综合梳理"为何"与"如何"应对作弊。
AI.result: 从大规模真实对话中识别出教师反作弊的动机与应对策略，并据此总结出关于AI与学术融合未来走向的警示（caveats）。
AI.conclusion: 教师的信念与策略为理解AI时代学术诚信治理提供实证依据，并对AI融入教育的未来发展提出需谨慎对待的启示。

title: StaRSE: Compact Russian Sentence Embeddings with a Sign-Coded Static Encoder
summary: Transformer sentence encoders provide strong retrieval quality, but their inference cost becomes a bottleneck when embeddings must be produced on CPUs or refreshed frequently. We introduce StaRSE, a compact Russian static sentence encoder that removes Transformer inference at deployment time: token directions are stored as sign bits, token norms are stored separately, and sentences are encoded by mean pooling over norm-scaled sign directions. StaRSE is initialized from ruBERT-base, fine-tuned on Russian adjacent-sentence and task-shaped pairs, and post-trained with a contrastive stage that directly optimizes the sign-projected token table. On RuMTEB, StaRSE reaches a task mean of $51.16$, $7.98$ points above the strongest included static baseline. The packaged model occupies $11.3$ MiB and has a mean CPU latency of $0.08$ ms per sentence, compared with an estimated $55.7$ MiB 16-bit parameter footprint and $1.43$ ms mean CPU latency for the closest-quality contextual encoder. Ablations examine adjacent-sentence supervision, token norms, and direct sign-projected post-training.

AI.tldr: 提出 StaRSE,一个紧凑的俄语静态句子编码器,通过符号位存储词向量并以均值池化生成句向量,在 RuMTEB 上大幅优于静态基线,且体积小、CPU 延迟极低。
AI.motivation: Transformer 句编码器检索质量高,但在 CPU 上推理或需频繁刷新嵌入时成本成为瓶颈,因此需要无 Transformer 推理的紧凑静态编码器。
AI.method: 从 ruBERT-base 初始化,词方向以符号位存储、词范数单独存储,句向量为范数缩放符号方向的均值池化;先在俄语相邻句与任务形配对数据上微调,再用对比学习直接优化符号投影后的词表。
AI.result: RuMTEB 任务均值 51.16,比最强静态基线高 7.98;模型 11.3 MiB,平均 CPU 延迟 0.08 ms/句;相比之下最接近质量的上下文编码器约 55.7 MiB(16 位)与 1.43 ms。
AI.conclusion: 静态符号化编码器可在显著降低体积与延迟的同时保持较强检索质量;消融验证了相邻句监督、词范数与符号投影后训练的有效性。

title: OpenRE-Bench: A Benchmark Harness for Multi-Agent Requirements Engineering with Mined GitHub Issues
summary: OpenRE-Bench is an open-source benchmarking infrastructure for large language model (LLM) based multi-agent requirements-engineering (RE) frameworks. Such frameworks are increasingly common, but they use different agent roles, negotiation policies, and output shapes, and are typically evaluated on their own runtimes, metrics, and small sets of curated system descriptions, which makes fair, reproducible comparison difficult. OpenRE-Bench addresses this with four reusable pieces: a shared run harness with one input, phase-artifact, and metric contract; an adapter mechanism through which a framework joins by implementing a single adapter, leaving cases, metrics, and other adapters untouched; a reproducible GitHub issue-mining pipeline that grows the corpus from real feature requests; and a versioned case suite. As a demonstration, we mine 3,000 fetched issues across five projects (three languages, five domains) into five cases, package them with five hand-built cases as the compact v1.0 suite, and run three heterogeneous frameworks (MARE and iReDev as paper-faithful reimplementations, plus QUARE) under one protocol. OpenRE-Bench originated as the evaluation back-end of our QUARE study and has since been reused by two further studies of our group. It is released with a pinned environment, a Docker image, frozen API snapshots, a 651-test suite, and the full pool of 1,396 filtered issues behind the mined cases.

AI.tldr: OpenRE-Bench 是一个开源基准测试基础设施，用统一运行协议公平可复现地比较基于 LLM 的多智能体需求工程（RE）框架。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体 RE 框架在智能体角色、协商策略、输出形式、运行时、指标及小规模精选系统描述上各不相同，导致公平、可复现的横向比较困难。
AI.method: 提出四类可复用组件：统一的运行框架（一致输入、阶段产物与指标契约）；仅需实现单一适配器的接入机制；可复现的 GitHub issue 挖掘流水线以扩充语料；版本化案例套件。
AI.result: 示范中从五个项目（三种语言、五个领域）挖掘 3,000 条 issue 生成五个案例，与五个手工构建案例组成 v1.0 紧凑套件；在同一协议下运行三个异构框架（MARE、iReDev 为忠实复现，及 QUARE）。
AI.conclusion: OpenRE-Bench 源自 QUARE 研究的评估后端，已被本组另外两项研究复用；发布内容含固定环境、Docker 镜像、冻结 API 快照、651 个测试及挖掘案例背后的 1,396 条筛选 issue 全池。

title: One Temperature to Rule Them All?
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 82 pages, 45 figures, 6 tables. Code: https://github.com/avivorly/one-temperature
summary: Inference-time sampling is a central mechanism for improving large language models, with temperature controlling the tradeoff between reliability and diversity. While recent work suggests that varying temperature across samples can improve multi-sample inference, simple fixed-temperature schemes remain the standard in practice. We investigate this discrepancy in the canonical pass@K setting, asking when temperature diversity is useful, and when a single tuned temperature suffices. To this end, we analyze per-question success probabilities across multiple models and datasets, tracking how they vary with sampling temperature. We identify several consistent properties of these profiles, including that harder questions are less likely to share efficient sampling temperatures, although this trend is only logarithmic in hardness. We then derive an efficient method for evaluating the theoretically optimal multi-temperature allocation scheme, and show that although such a scheme improves performance, its gains over single-temperature baselines are typically modest when temperature is tuned as a function of the sampling budget K. We explain this phenomenon through mathematical mechanisms that we call dulling effects, and show how they ensure the robustness of temperature choices across different question distributions. Our results clarify when multi-temperature sampling is useful, and how temperatures should ideally be chosen.

AI.tldr: 论文研究 pass@K 采样中温度多样性是否有用。作者分析多模型多数据集的逐题成功率-温度曲线，并提出评估理论上最优多温度分配方案的高效方法，发现相比按采样预算 K 调优的单一温度基线，多温度方案提升通常有限，并用"钝化效应"解释其稳健性。
AI.motivation: 近期工作表明跨样本变化温度可提升多采样推理，但实践中仍普遍使用简单固定温度。作者想厘清这一矛盾：何时温度多样性有益，何时单一调优温度已足够。
AI.method: 在标准 pass@K 设定下，分析多个模型与数据集上逐题成功概率随采样温度的变化曲线（profile），总结其一致性质（如越难的题越不易共享高效采样温度，但该趋势仅为对数级）；进而推导出高效计算理论最优多温度分配方案的方法。
AI.result: 多温度分配方案确实优于单温度基线，但当温度随采样预算 K 联合调优时，增益通常很小；论文通过"钝化效应"（dulling effects）等数学机制解释该现象，并说明温度选择对题目分布具有稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 论文澄清了多温度采样的适用条件及温度应如何理想选择：在按 K 调优的预算下，单温度往往已接近最优，多温度带来的收益有限。

title: ZeroPoint: Lightweight Energy-Based Decision Model
summary: Energy-based models (EBMs) assign a scalar energy to every joint value of the observed and predicted variables. In decision models, the prediction is chosen from a finite list of options provided with each input. Inference then reduces to comparing the energies of the options, and training lowers the energy of the correct option relative to the others. A complete decision must also account for the possibility that no option is acceptable. However, the energies learned by a standard EBM define only relative compatibility: adding the same input-dependent quantity to all energies leaves the predictions, the Gibbs distribution, and the usual training losses unchanged. The model therefore has no learned reference level against which to decide whether any option fits. We propose ZeroPoint, an EBM that makes the empty answer a state of the model with energy zero for every input. This fixed state provides an explicit reference for the energies of all listed options, whose non-negative depths measure their compatibility with the input relative to the empty answer. The options and the empty answer share one distribution, in which an option at zero depth receives no probability. The decision to select an option or to abstain is thus part of ordinary inference, trained with the negative log-likelihood loss, rather than a separate rejection rule. The energy function is a small multilingual encoder that reads the input together with all the options and is invariant to their order. Ablations show that most of the benefit comes from training with examples in which no option fits. With the same encoder and data, the fixed zero separates inputs with and without an acceptable option slightly better than a learned rejection class and clearly better than a thresholded softmax, while leaving the choice among options unchanged.

AI.tldr: 提出 ZeroPoint 能量模型，将"空答案"设为能量恒为零的状态，为各选项能量提供显式参照，使"选选项还是弃权"成为常规推断的一部分而非单独拒绝规则。
AI.motivation: 标准 EBM 只学习相对兼容性：给所有能量加上同一输入相关量不改变预测、Gibbs 分布与训练损失，因此模型缺乏判断"是否存在任何可接受选项"的绝对参照水平。
AI.method: 把空答案作为模型的一个状态，其能量对任意输入恒为 0，各选项能量的非负"深度"衡量其相对空答案的兼容度；选项与空答案共享同一分布（零深度选项概率为 0），以负对数似然训练。能量函数为小型多语言编码器，同时读取输入与全部选项并对选项顺序不变。
AI.result: 消融显示收益主要来自包含"无选项适配"样本的训练；相同编码器与数据下，固定零点在区分有无可接受选项的输入上略优于可学习的拒绝类，并明显优于阈值化 softmax，同时不改变选项间的选择结果。
AI.conclusion: 以固定的零能量空答案作为参照，可让弃权决策自然融入 EBM 的推断与训练，效果优于学习式拒绝类与阈值 softmax。

title: Continuous Angular Control in Text-to-Image Generation via Geometric Token Encoding
summary:
Text-to-image diffusion models can render a photorealistic analog clock but cannot control the time it displays. Across four pretrained models, fewer than 1% of generated clocks place both hands within 6 degrees of the requested time; the models instead collapse onto visually dominant configurations such as the canonical 10:10 pose. The same failure appears when a specific fraction of a circular object is requested, where models return complete or conventionally sliced objects. We observe that these two failures share a geometric structure: both target quantities can be parameterized by angular variables.
  We introduce a geometric token encoding framework that conditions generation directly on these angles. Each angular component is encoded as a periodic sine-cosine feature and projected into a role-specific token embedding that is injected into the prompt before a frozen text encoder. To spatially ground these tokens without requiring localization input at inference, we introduce Stochastic Localization Relaxation (SLR), which stochastically relaxes attention supervision from component-level to object-level to unconstrained localization during training. For clocks, we additionally introduce a hand-swap preference objective that discourages assigning the correct angles to the wrong hand roles. On analog clocks our method reaches 63-78% Acc@6 degrees across evaluation methods, compared with below 1% for the baselines. On circular-fraction generation, it achieves 89.5% Acc@0.10, while maintaining 88.8% on unseen object categories and 84.9% on unseen target values, compared with roughly 20% for pretrained baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出几何token编码框架，将角度量以正余弦周期特征编码注入提示，配合SLR定位松弛与指针交换偏好目标，使扩散模型能精确控制时钟时间与圆形分割比例（Acc@6°达63-78%，圆形分数Acc@0.10达89.5%）。
AI.motivation: 文生图扩散模型能生成逼真时钟却无法控制所显示时间（<1%样本双手落在6°内，塌缩到10:10等视觉主导姿态）；请求圆形物体特定比例时也返回完整或常规切片物体。作者观察到两类失败具有共同几何结构：目标量都可由角度参数化。
AI.method: 几何token编码框架：将每个角度分量编码为周期正弦-余弦特征，投影为角色专属token嵌入，在冻结文本编码器前注入提示。提出随机定位松弛SLR，训练时把注意力监督从组件级逐步随机松弛到物体级再到无约束定位，推理时无需定位输入。针对时钟额外引入指针交换偏好目标，避免将正确角度分配给错误指针角色。
AI.result: 模拟时钟在各评估方法下Acc@6°达63-78%，基线<1%；圆形分数生成Acc@0.10达89.5%，未见物体类别88.8%、未见目标值84.9%，而预训练基线约20%。
AI.conclusion: 将角度目标显式编码为周期token并辅以定位松弛监督与角色偏好约束，可有效解决扩散模型在角度可控生成上的系统性失败，并具备跨物体类别与目标值的良好泛化。

title: BioMem: Agentic Memory for Biomedical LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable potential in biomedical applications, while agentic memory systems have emerged as a promising approach to preserving and utilizing information across tasks and interactions. However, a fundamental question remains: how effectively and reliably do these systems retain, retrieve, update, and utilize biomedical information? In this study, we systematically investigate agentic memory in the biomedical domain, focusing on task effectiveness, retrieval quality, information fidelity, and long-term robustness. We evaluate five memory approaches across four LLMs in three representative settings: biomedical knowledge reasoning, clinical prediction, and long-term conversational memory. Our analyses reveal how memory construction, evidence relevance, and conversational history shape downstream biomedical performance, highlighting the distinct challenges of retrieving relevant information, preserving its fidelity, and effectively utilizing it for reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce Hybrid Memory Retrieval and Utilization (HMRU), a training-free framework that jointly enhances evidence accessibility and task-aware utilization to improve biomedical reasoning and long-term conversational memory. HMRU achieves an average relative improvement of 8.6% across biomedical question-answering and conversational memory benchmarks, with additional gains in selected clinical prediction tasks. It further reduces conversational answer errors by 24.9% and closes 48.0% of the performance gap to full-context inference. Our findings provide a systematic characterization of biomedical agentic memory and practical insights into developing more effective and reliable memory-augmented LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 系统评估智能体记忆系统在生物医学领域的构建、检索、保真与鲁棒性，并提出免训练框架HMRU提升生物医学推理与长期对话记忆表现。
AI.motivation: LLM在生物医学应用潜力大，智能体记忆系统被用于跨任务保留利用信息，但其在生物医学信息上的有效性与可靠性（保留、检索、更新、利用）尚缺乏系统认识。
AI.method: 在生物医学知识推理、临床预测、长期对话记忆三类设置下，用4个LLM评估5种记忆方法，分析记忆构建、证据相关性与对话历史对下游性能的影响；据此提出免训练的混合记忆检索与利用框架HMRU，同时增强证据可及性与任务感知利用。
AI.result: HMRU在生物医学问答与对话记忆基准上平均相对提升8.6%，部分临床预测任务亦有增益；对话回答错误减少24.9%，弥补了与全上下文推理差距的48.0%。
AI.conclusion: 论文系统刻画了生物医学智能体记忆的挑战（检索相关性、信息保真、有效利用），并为构建更有效可靠的记忆增强LLM系统提供实践启示。

title: Point-in-Time Encoders for Earnings Calls
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the 3rd IEEE International Workshop on Large Language Models for Finance, IEEE BigData 2026. Code: https://github.com/Alessiobrini/point-in-time-encoders-for-earnings-calls
summary: Text encoders turn earnings calls into vectors for search, for language models that answer from retrieved passages, and for forecasting models. A live retriever can use an encoder trained once on all available text, as finance retrievers are, but a backtest needs an encoder that read no text written after the date of each vector. To address this look-ahead bias, from 412,248 calls we train vintages under four pretraining recipes, with yearly cutoffs from 2010 to 2024, and each vintage reads only text dated on or before its cutoff. We then fine-tune each vintage on the question-answer pairs of the calls themselves. The vintages we train on calls alone, with 33.8M parameters, retrieve answers on held-out calls better than the general retrievers we tested in every test quarter. Their vectors also raise by about half the rank correlation between next-day returns and forecasts built from past returns and firm size. When each vintage continues the previous one, a later vintage retrieves better on earlier quarters than the vintage available at the time, and a point-in-time language model that answers from the passages the later vintage retrieves inherits the gain. The 2024 vintage of our families also forecasts earnings surprises better, although the interval of this gain includes zero on calls that no vintage read. It forecasts returns no better, so point-in-time vintages matter most for retrieval and little for forecasts of returns.

AI.tldr: 该文针对金融文本检索中的前视偏差问题，用412,248份财报电话会议构建按年份截止（2010–2024）的编码器"年份版本"，在自身问答对上微调，验证其检索与下游预测表现。
AI.motivation: 现有金融文本编码器通常用全部可用文本一次性训练，实盘可行，但回测中会读到未来文本，产生前视偏差；需要只读截止日期之前文本的编码器来保证时点一致的回测。
AI.method: 基于412,248份电话会议，按四种预训练配方、2010–2024逐年截止训练多个年份版本（每版仅读截止日及之前文本），并在会议自身问答对上微调；以3300万参数的仅用电话会议训练版本与通用检索器对比，检验检索效果及其对收益预测、点对点时语言模型问答的影响。
AI.result: 仅用电话会议训练的版本在每一个测试季度上检索效果均优于所测通用检索器；其向量使"基于过去收益与公司规模的预测"与次日收益之间的秩相关提升约一半。后续版本续训自前一版本时，在更早季度上的检索反而优于当时实际可用的版本，且基于其检索段落的点对点语言模型也继承该增益。2024版本对盈余意外的预测更好（但在无任何版本读过的会议上置信区间含零），对收益预测无改善。
AI.conclusion: 时点一致的年份版本对检索有实质价值（并能传导至下游问答与盈余意外预测），但对收益预测作用甚微；提示金融文本建模应区分任务，谨慎对待回测中的前视偏差。

title: Software Refactoring Research with Large Language Models: A Systematic Literature Review
summary: Background: Code refactoring is the improvement of code internally without changing the external functionalities of the program. Due to its exhaustive nature, developers often avoid manually refactoring code. Researchers have since looked into utilizing LLMs to automate the task of refactoring. Aim and Method: Despite the promising results, there is a lack of clear un- derstanding of LLMs' effectiveness in automated refactoring. Result: From our literature review we found that: (i) there are various tools that different studies use to enhance and study LLM-driving refactoring, with tools that were used to detect code smells, generate code bases, and compare refactoring outcomes. (ii) Various datasets were collected from multiple open- source projects in multiple programming languages for analysis. These platforms included GitHub, Apache, and F-Droid, with the most popular language collec- ted and analyzed being Java. (iii) One-Shot, Few-Shot, Context-Specific, and Chain-of-Thought prompting methods have been shown to be the most effective depending on the language used. In some instances, being capable of reducing code smell by up to 89%. (iv) The definition of "accuracy" varies significantly across the literature surveyed, as this depends on the context of the study, thus calling for a need to have a standardized measurement for Accuracy. (v) The most often mentioned code smells were Large Class and Long Method, with a lot of studies also not specifying, while the most often applied refactoring type is Extract Method, showing promising results in using LLM to perform this refactoring type. (vi) When working with LLMs, they often generate erroneous code, struggle with more complex refactoring, and often misunderstand the developers' requests and miss refactoring requests.

AI.tldr: 该文通过文献综述考察LLM在自动化代码重构中的有效性，总结所用工具、数据集、提示方法、准确性定义与常见代码异味，并指出LLM在复杂重构上的局限。
AI.motivation: 手工重构耗时费力，开发者常回避；LLM自动化重构虽有初步成果，但其有效性缺乏系统性认识，故需综述梳理。
AI.method: 文献综述（literature review），归纳分析现有研究中使用的工具、数据集、提示方法、准确度定义、代码异味类型与重构类型。
AI.result: (i) 多种工具用于代码异味检测、代码库生成与重构结果比较；(ii) 数据集来自GitHub、Apache、F-Droid等多语言开源项目，Java最常用；(iii) One-Shot、Few-Shot、Context-Specific、Chain-of-Thought提示最有效，视语言而定，代码异味最多可降低89%；(iv) “准确性”定义差异大，需标准化度量；(v) 最常见异味为Large Class与Long Method，最常用重构类型为Extract Method；(vi) LLM常生成错误代码、难以处理复杂重构、误解或遗漏重构请求。
AI.conclusion: LLM重构具潜力但可靠性不足，需统一准确性度量并提升对复杂重构与请求理解的能力。

title: Which Successes Make Good References? Action-Sequence Alignment for Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-inference distribution mismatch by supervising a student on its own trajectories. For multi-turn tool-use agents, conditioning the teacher on a validated same-task successful trajectory as a reference can provide useful hindsight, but different successes may reach incompatible interaction states and offer misleading supervision. We cast successful-reference selection as a free-target optimal transport problem, which reduces to assigning each failed trajectory its most compatible successful reference. Because latent state paths are hidden, we use action-sequence alignment as an observable proxy for compatibility and instantiate it with longest common subsequence (LCS), which identifies a shared ordered backbone of actions while allowing recoverable detours. This perspective makes trajectory compatibility the central criterion for reference selection in multi-turn OPD. Experiments on ALFWorld and the airline domain of $τ^3$-bench show that LCS is the only evaluated reference selector to improve over reference-free OPD on both ALFWorld overall scores and all three airline metrics. Without further optimization, the airline-trained models also transfer to the retail domain, where LCS improves all three metrics.

AI.tldr: 将多轮工具使用智能体的在线策略蒸馏中"成功参考轨迹"的选择问题建模为自由目标最优传输，用动作序列的LCS作为可观测兼容性代理，实验显示LCS是唯一在两个基准上均优于无参考OPD的参考选择器。
AI.motivation: OPD中教师以同任务成功轨迹为参考可提供后见信息，但不同成功轨迹可能处于不相容的交互状态，导致误导性监督，因此需要合适的参考选择准则。
AI.method: 把成功参考选择表述为自由目标最优传输问题，退化为为每条失败轨迹分配最兼容的成功参考；因隐状态路径不可见，采用动作序列对齐（最长公共子序列LCS）作为兼容性的可观测代理，兼顾有序公共骨架与可恢复的绕行。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与τ³-bench的airline域上，LCS是唯一在ALFWorld总分和airline全部三项指标上均优于无参考OPD的参考选择器；无需额外优化，airline训练模型迁移到retail域时LCS也提升全部三项指标。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹兼容性应成为多轮OPD中参考选择的核心准则，基于LCS的选择是一种简单有效的实现。

title: Seeing Is Not Believing: Counterfactual Lesion Erasure Teaches a Small Medical Vision-Language Agent to Report Only What the Image Shows
comment: 28 pages, 1 figure, 13 tables. Preprint v1.0; reader study in progress. Code, data recipes, pre-registrations and per-view outputs: https://github.com/bhaskargurram-ai/medscope
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) often report a finding because the question names it; standard benchmarks miss this. From public segmentation datasets we build counterfactual views without manual annotation: the lesion erased by inpainting, a same-shape control edit elsewhere, and unedited lesion-free images. The evidence sensitivity gap (ESG) is the rate of absent-or-refer answers after erasure minus the rate after the control edit; it is zero for a model that ignores the image or reacts to both edits alike. MedScope-4B (Qwen3.5-4B, LoRA, image tools) was trained on label-derived trajectories, selected by a pre-registered rule and tested once against nine frontier and six open VLMs; four pre-registered checks then probed the mechanism. On 507 internal cases across five imaging types, MedScope-4B reached ESG 0.758 and claimed an erased lesion in 9.6% of cases, against 0.27-0.47 and 41-62% for the frontier models (all p<0.001), without significant loss of accuracy on real lesions. Without counterfactual views ESG fell to 0.279+-0.107 (three seeds); the effect replicated on MedGemma 1.5 4B and two unseen inpainting tools. At four external centres the advantage held but frontier models detected more real lesions; on a fresh external test MedScope-4B detected 0 of 48 pneumothorax films, with net utility below gemini-4-argon's (-0.36 [-0.50, -0.23]). Matching the control edit was not shown to matter; over three seeds no fresh-external ESG advantage over removal-based DPO was established; a paired-view consistency objective did not beat a matched-compute control, while that continuation alone cut erased-lesion claims on unseen tools at every seed, at a cost in sensitivity at one. Training on erased and edited images gives a small model an evidence-gated disposition that prompting does not give frontier models; it does not improve perception, and rare critical findings need coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出"证据敏感性差距"(ESG)指标，用无需人工标注的反事实图像(病灶擦除/等形状对照编辑/无病灶原图)检验医学VLM是否真的"看图"而非"因问题提到而报告发现"；训练MedScope-4B后在内部数据上ESG远超前沿模型，但在罕见病变的外部泛化上表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型常因问题里提到某发现就直接回答"存在"，而非依赖图像证据；标准基准无法暴露这一问题，且缺乏可扩展的标注方式来检验模型对证据的敏感性。
AI.method: 从公开分割数据集自动构建反事实视图(修补擦除病灶、同形状对照编辑、未编辑无病灶图)，定义证据敏感性差距ESG=擦除后"缺失/指代"回答率−对照编辑后该率。MedScope-4B(Qwen3.5-4B + LoRA + 图像工具)在标签派生轨迹上训练，按预注册规则选型并只测试一次，对比9个前沿与6个开源VLM，另做四项预注册机制检验(含消融、三随机种子、MedGemma复现、未见工具复现)。
AI.result: 507例内部测试(5种影像类型)：MedScope-4B ESG 0.758、擦除病灶仍声称存在仅9.6%，前沿模型为0.27–0.47与41–62%(均p<0.001)，真实病灶准确率无显著下降。去掉反事实视图后ESG降至0.279±0.107(三种子)。效果在MedGemma 1.5 4B和两种未见修补工具上复现。外部四中心仍保持优势但前沿模型检出更多真实病灶；全新外部测试中MedScope-4B对48例气胸片检出0例，净效用低于gemini-4-argon(-0.36[-0.50,-0.23])。对照编辑匹配未证明显著作用；三随机种子下相对基于移除的DPO未确立外部ESG优势；配对视图一致性目标未超过等算力对照。
AI.conclusion: 用擦除与编辑图像训练可让小模型获得"证据门控"倾向，而提示词无法让前沿模型获得这一性质；但这不提升感知能力，且在罕见关键病变(如气胸)上严重缺乏覆盖，需要针对性补足。

title: GroundCascade: Selective Second Opinions for GUI Grounding
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) grounding maps a screenshot and a natural-language instruction to the screen location where an agent should act. Zoomed views can reveal small targets but may lose the context needed to identify them. We introduce GroundCascade, a training-free controller that uses agreement between a grounder's full-screen and zoomed predictions to decide when to consult a complementary model. It selects between zoomed predictions while preserving corroborated full-screen locations. An optional Finalizer predicts from an unmarked joint crop when disagreement remains (Full); omitting it yields the two-stage Selective variant. GroundCascade reaches 85.33% on ScreenSpot-Pro with Indeed-UI-32B/8B/32B and 88.43% on the visible-target OSWorld-G-Refined subset with Qwen3.6-27B/3.8-27B/3.8-27B, gains of 2.66 and 2.35 percentage points over the stronger standalone two-pass grounder. On UI-Vision, GroundCascade reaches 72.20% category-balanced accuracy, with Selective slightly higher at 72.28%. Across these three evaluations, GroundCascade in Full mode uses 2.42-2.73 calls per request, 31-39% fewer than unconditionally acquiring both models' two-pass predictions. At matched second-model call budgets, selective acquisition gains 1.52-2.56 points over standalone Two-pass, compared with 0.22-0.69 points from stratified random acquisition. GroundCascade leads the official ScreenSpot-Pro leaderboard and exceeds reported GUI-specialist comparisons on OSWorld-G-Refined and UI-Vision, subject to differences in external evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: GroundCascade 是一种免训练控制器，通过全屏与缩放预测的一致性来决定何时调用辅助模型，在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上达到 85.33%，并在降低调用成本的同时超越单模型两遍推理。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding 需要将截图与自然语言指令映射到操作位置。放大视图能揭示小目标却会丢失识别所需上下文，现有方法在"看细节"与"保上下文"之间存在取舍，且无条件多模型/多遍推理成本高。
AI.method: 提出免训练的 GroundCascade：利用同一 grounder 在全屏与缩放视图下的预测一致性，仅当两者不一致时才调用互补模型以获取补充预测；保留经佐证的全屏位置，优先采用缩放结果。可选 Finalizer 在仍存在分歧时基于无标注联合裁剪图重新预测（Full 模式），省略则得两阶段 Selective 变体。
AI.result: ScreenSpot-Pro 85.33%（Indeed-UI-32B/8B/32B），OSWorld-G-Refined 可见目标子集 88.43%（Qwen3.6-27B/3.8-27B/3.8-27B），分别较更强的独立两遍 grounder 提升 2.66 与 2.35 个百分点；UI-Vision 类别均衡准确率 72.20%（Selective 72.28%）。Full 模式每请求 2.42–2.73 次调用，比无条件获取两模型两遍预测少 31–39%；同等第二模型调用预算下选择性获取提升 1.52–2.56 点，而分层随机获取仅 0.22–0.69 点。
AI.conclusion: GroundCascade 以一致性驱动的选择性调用在准确率与调用成本间取得更优平衡，位居 ScreenSpot-Pro 官方榜单首位，并在 OSWorld-G-Refined 与 UI-Vision 上超过已报告的 GUI 专用模型对比结果（需注意外部评测协议差异）。

title: Inherited Weights: Measuring the Tokenization Premium and the Sovereignty Cost of Language Models for the Global South
comment: 6 pages, 2 tables. Data and measurement code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22899767
summary: Most language models deployed outside the United States and China are fine-tuned descendants of a small number of pretrained families. We argue that fine-tuning leaves the decisive properties of a model inherited from its base: vocabulary, knowledge, cultural alignment, memorized data and license. We contribute (i) an updated, reproducible measurement of the tokenization premium across 31 languages and 7 tokenizers released in 2023-2024, on 27 articles of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, with explicit correction for unknown-token collapse. Premiums reach 10x for Amharic in older tokenizers and remain at 6.8x in the newest commercial one; Indigenous South American languages pay between 1.6x and 2.7x under global tokenizers. A vocabulary built from Portuguese lowers the premium for 11 of 13 Latin-script Global South languages relative to every global tokenizer tested, by about 24% for Guarani and Quechua. (ii) An eight-test black-box sovereignty audit that a buyer can run without access to weights. (iii) A regime argument: under energy and liability constraints, accuracy per joule, calibration and selective risk should replace raw accuracy as design objectives, with metrics that abstention cannot inflate. We close with preliminary internal measurements from a proprietary architecture built around these objectives, reported with their limitations. Data and measurement code are included.

AI.tldr: 论文量化了分词溢价（31种语言×7个2023–2024年发布的tokenizer），发现阿姆哈拉语最高达10倍、最新商业tokenizer仍为6.8倍；并主张以"每焦耳准确率、校准与选择性风险"替代裸准确率作为设计目标。
AI.motivation: 美国与中国之外部署的语言模型多是少数预训练家族的微调后代，而微调无法改变由底座继承的决定性属性：词表、知识、文化对齐、记忆数据与许可证。作者希望为"模型主权"提供可测量、可复现的证据与买方可用工具。
AI.method: (i) 基于《世界人权宣言》27篇文章，对31种语言和7个tokenizer测量tokenization premium，并对未知token坍缩做显式校正；(ii) 设计无需权重访问的八项黑盒主权审计；(iii) 提出能源与责任约束下的制度论证与不可被弃权抬高的指标。
AI.result: 旧tokenizer上阿姆哈拉语溢价达10倍，最新商业tokenizer仍为6.8倍；南美原住民语言在全球tokenizer下为1.6–2.7倍；基于葡萄牙语构建的词表相对所有全球tokenizer降低了13种拉丁字母全球南方语言中11种的溢价，瓜拉尼语与克丘亚语约降24%。
AI.conclusion: 分词溢价是结构性且可通过本地语料词表显著缓解；作者呼吁以每焦耳准确率、校准与选择性风险为设计目标，并附初步内部测量及其局限，公开数据与测量代码。

title: DEIA: Evidence-Grounded Crash Repair with Change-Aware Test Design for HarmonyOS ArkTS
summary:
Mobile crash repair requires more than identifying a source edit. Developers must establish how the edit relates to the reported failure and whether the modified application can be built, launched, and exercised without disrupting valid behavior. In HarmonyOS applications, this assessment also depends on platform-specific packaging and runtime execution.
  To address this need, we present DEIA, an evidence-grounded workflow for HarmonyOS crash repair. DEIA constructs a bounded source-evidence package, uses a large language model to propose content-anchored edits, and relies on a deterministic writer to materialize and check the patch. It derives fail-to-pass (F2P) obligations from the reported fault and pass-to-pass (P2P) obligations from the potential impact of the patch. A stage-level ledger links the patch, test obligations, runtime observations, and candidate-generation cost.
  We evaluate DEIA on 30 repair tasks from 24 HarmonyOS applications and compare it with an OpenHands-based workflow on 29 matched tasks. DEIA's first-added-line location exactly matches the curated reference in 25/29 tasks (86.2%), compared with 19/29 (65.5%) for OpenHands, a difference of 20.7 percentage points. DEIA also uses 81.5% fewer tokens, makes 60.8% fewer model calls, and takes 34.9% less candidate-generation time on average. Only two of the 58 behavior-specific P2P obligations were executed, both for one repair pattern; comprehensive behavior preservation therefore remains unestablished.

AI.tldr: DEIA 是一个面向 HarmonyOS 崩溃修复的、基于证据包与 LLM 的修复工作流，通过内容锚定编辑、确定性写入器与 F2P/P2P 测试义务来验证补丁。在 29 个匹配任务上首个新增行位置精确匹配率达 86.2%（对比 OpenHands 65.5%），token 减少 81.5%、模型调用减少 60.8%、耗时减少 34.9%，但行为保持（P2P）验证仍不充分。
AI.motivation: 移动端崩溃修复不止于定位源码编辑，还需判断编辑与故障的关联、以及修改后应用能否构建、启动并运行而不破坏原有行为；HarmonyOS 还额外涉及平台特有的打包与运行时执行，现有方法对此支持不足。
AI.method: DEIA 构建有界的源码证据包，用大语言模型提出内容锚定的编辑建议，再由确定性写入器落盘并检查补丁；从报告的故障推导 fail-to-pass（F2P）义务，从补丁潜在影响推导 pass-to-pass（P2P）义务；并用阶段级账本关联补丁、测试义务、运行时观测与候选生成成本。
AI.result: 在 24 个 HarmonyOS 应用的 30 个修复任务上评估，并与基于 OpenHands 的工作流在 29 个匹配任务上对比：首个新增行位置精确匹配 25/29（86.2%）vs 19/29（65.5%），高 20.7 个百分点；平均 token 减少 81.5%、模型调用减少 60.8%、候选生成时间减少 34.9%。58 条行为相关 P2P 义务中仅执行了 2 条（同属一种修复模式）。
AI.conclusion: DEIA 在 HarmonyOS 崩溃修复的编辑定位准确性与生成效率上明显优于 OpenHands 基线，但其对行为保持的验证仍不完整，全面的行为保持性尚未得到证实。

title: Byzantine-Robust Muon: Resilient Momentum Orthogonalization for Distributed Learning
summary: Optimization methods, including the Muon optimizer based on the Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO) and momentum orthogonalization, have shown strong empirical performance in large-scale and distributed learning, yet their robustness to adversarial behavior and data heterogeneity is not well understood. We study these methods within a unified first-order trust-region framework and analyze Muon-based updates with robust aggregation for Byzantine-robust distributed and federated learning. Our analysis does not rely on the i.i.d. assumption and introduces a non-Euclidean notion of heterogeneity consistent with the trust-region geometry. Under this framework, we establish convergence guarantees for both general non-convex and star-convex objectives. Our results provide a theoretical characterization of Byzantine-robust Muon-based optimization, with an additive heterogeneity error floor consistent with known impossibility results, under explicit aggregation assumptions. Under an explicit additive oracle-error condition, the guarantees also cover inexact orthogonalization, with the non-convex Byzantine terms in the bound's numerator unchanged but a smaller progress denominator. In simulated federated training with ResNet-18 and ViT-Tiny on CIFAR-10, additional image benchmarks, and a 38M-parameter byte-level language model on TinyStories, the tested Muon configuration attains higher attacked accuracy (lower perplexity) than the tested SGD and normalized-SGD configurations, and than sign updates on CIFAR-10. Fixed-honest controls further show a substantial RFA advantage over averaging under a bounded RFA-query attack, higher attacked accuracy for Muon-NS than tensorwise Euclidean normalization from shared checkpoints, and lower held-out TinyStories perplexity than a tuned AdamW baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一的一阶信赖域框架下分析基于Muon（LMO+动量正交化）的优化方法，并给出其在拜占庭鲁棒分布式/联邦学习中的收敛保证，实验显示其抗攻击精度优于SGD等基线。
AI.motivation: Muon类优化器在大规模与分布式学习中经验表现强，但其对对抗行为和异构数据的鲁棒性缺乏理论理解；现有分析多依赖i.i.d.假设，与信赖域几何不匹配。
AI.method: 将Muon类更新纳入统一一阶信赖域框架，结合鲁棒聚合分析拜占庭鲁棒联邦学习；不依赖i.i.d.假设，提出与非欧几里得信赖域几何一致的异构性度量；在显式聚合假设与显式加性oracle误差条件下推导收敛性，覆盖非凸与星凸目标及不精确正交化。
AI.result: 在一般非凸与星凸目标下建立收敛保证，界中包含与已知不可能性结果一致的加性异构误差下限；不精确正交化时非凸拜占庭项分子不变但进展分母变小。实验中，在ResNet-18/ViT-Tiny的CIFAR-10等联邦训练及38M字节级语言模型上，Muon配置受攻击精度更高（困惑度更低），优于SGD、归一化SGD与AdamW基线；固定诚实设置下RFA优于平均聚合，Muon-NS优于逐张量欧氏归一化。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次从理论上刻画了拜占庭鲁棒Muon类优化，并辅以实验验证，表明其在异构与对抗环境下相较SGD类与AdamW基线具有更好鲁棒性与性能。

title: From Questions to Decisions: Benchmarking How LLM Agents Acquire Decision-Relevant Information from Human Beings
summary: LLM agents are increasingly asked to make plans for people, such as scheduling drivers or assigning nurses. However, people's requests are often incomplete, and the supporting information for decision-making may be outdated, requiring agents to ask for clarification. Existing benchmarks typically provide fully specified problems or rely on uncalibrated LLM-simulated users, leaving this ability insufficiently tested. We introduce Ask2Decide, a benchmark of 43 planning tasks that evaluates whether agents ask for missing information that matters for their decisions. An operator holds facts absent from the agent's request and records, and optimization solvers determine which facts change the optimal plan. We also include similarly worded facts that leave the optimal plan unchanged to test whether agents distinguish useful information from irrelevant details. We collect 79 interaction sessions from 19 participants and find that, after an incorrect plan, human replies omit the correcting fact far more often than replies from an uncalibrated simulated user (43% versus 7%). Using these interactions, we calibrate a simulated operator that more closely matches human reply patterns. Evaluating four frontier LLMs, we find that their initial plans are infeasible on 58-98% of tasks when information is missing, compared with 5-28% when all facts are provided upfront. Agents uncover facts that change the optimal plan only slightly more often than facts that leave it unchanged (39-52% versus 32-41%). These results show that obtaining decision-relevant information through interaction remains a major bottleneck for LLM planning. This is ongoing work and will be updated. The date of this version is shown on the first page.

AI.tldr: 提出Ask2Decide基准（43个规划任务），评估LLM智能体能否通过提问获取决策关键信息；发现人机交互中人类回复常遗漏关键事实，且前沿LLM区分有用/无用信息的能力很弱，交互获取决策相关信息仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现实中的规划请求往往信息不完整，支撑决策的信息也可能过时，因此智能体需要主动澄清提问。但现有基准要么提供完整信息，要么依赖未经校准的LLM模拟用户，无法充分测试这一能力。
AI.method: 构建Ask2Decide基准：43个规划任务，由操作员掌握智能体请求与记录中缺失的事实，用优化求解器判定哪些事实会改变最优方案；同时加入措辞相似但对最优方案无影响的事实以测试区分能力。收集19名参与者的79段交互会话，发现人类在被指出错误方案后遗漏纠正性事实的比例（43%）远高于未校准模拟用户（7%），据此校准出更贴近人类回复模式的模拟操作员；随后评估4个前沿LLM。
AI.result: 信息缺失时，四个前沿LLM初始方案不可行的比例为58-98%，而信息完整时仅为5-28%；智能体发现"改变最优方案"事实的比例（39-52%）仅略高于发现无关事实的比例（32-41%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过交互获取决策相关信息仍是LLM规划的主要瓶颈；未来需提升智能体的信息甄别与主动提问能力，并采用经人类校准的模拟用户进行评估。

title: Mobile AI Factory: Building Specialized Language Models for Your Mobile Device
summary: Small language models (SLMs) running on mobile devices can keep user data private and work without connectivity. But they perform well only when fine-tuned for the target task and sized for the target device, a process that today requires repeated expert tuning. We present {\it Mobile AI Factory}, an agentic system that builds a fine-tuned, quantized SLM for a given task and phone. Given a task specification and a target phone, an orchestrator LLM chooses whether to tune hyperparameters, mine real data, or generate synthetic examples, while fixed rules roll back changes that hurt accuracy. The factory searches from small to large models across base models and quantizations, adapts its accuracy goal as it searches, and uses real measurements of the target phone across inference engines and backends. We evaluate Mobile AI Factory on ten tasks and four Android phones. On an unseen testset, its on-device models outperform two five-shot frontier models on five tasks, by up to 0.34, and match them on three more. Its search comes within 0.03 of exhaustively training all 27 model variants on an entity extraction task, while using 19$\times$ less GPU time. Phone measurements also matter: the best configuration changes across phones. Without phone measurements, Claude Opus 5.5, given the full hardware and model specifications, misses the app's requirements in 25\% of easy and moderate cases and in 60\% of hard ones. Code is available at: https://github.com/evanly-gh/SLM_Factory.

AI.tldr: Mobile AI Factory 是一个智能体系统，可自动为指定任务和目标手机构建经过微调与量化的端侧小模型（SLM），无需人工反复调参。
AI.motivation: 端侧小模型能保护隐私并离线可用，但需针对任务微调、针对设备选型量化，目前依赖专家反复调优成本高。
AI.method: 由编排器 LLM 在“调超参、挖掘真实数据、生成合成数据”间决策，用固定规则回滚损害精度的改动；从大到小搜索基座模型与量化方案，自适应调整精度目标，并在推理引擎/后端上对目标手机做真实测量。
AI.result: 在 10 个任务、4 款安卓手机上评测：5 个任务超越两个五样本前沿模型（最高 +0.34），另 3 个持平；实体抽取任务搜索精度距穷举训练 27 个变体仅差 0.03，GPU 时间减少 19 倍；不加手机实测时 Claude Opus 5.5 在简单/中等场景 25%、困难场景 60% 未达要求。
AI.conclusion: 自动化智能体流水线可构建高质量端侧 SLM，接近穷举效果且大幅省算力；真实设备测量对配置选择至关重要。

title: ProofCoder: Continuous Reasoning for Automated Software Verification
summary: Formal verification using proof assistants provides strong correctness guarantees for software, but constructing proofs remains labor-intensive and requires significant expertise. Recent approaches based on large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating proof synthesis. However, these approaches typically constrain the model to a rigid tactic-generation loop, in which the surrounding system controls premise retrieval, proof-state management, and backtracking. We introduce ProofCoder, an agentic proof-synthesis system for Rocq that approaches theorem proving from a coding-agent perspective. Rather than generating tactics within a fixed loop, ProofCoder reasons continuously throughout proof search and uses proof-assistant feedback to decide when to gather additional information, inspect proof states, revise previously generated proof fragments, or backtrack to an earlier point in the proof. This allows it to iteratively construct, repair, and refine proofs, at either tactic-level or whole-proof granularity. We evaluate ProofCoder on 280 challenging verification tasks from the AutoRocq Benchmark. On the best-performing configurations, ProofCoder increases proof success from 47% to 60% over the state-of-theart AutoRocq system, corresponding to a 27.7% relative improvement at approximately half the cost. Our ablations identify continuous reasoning as a key design choice: without it, the agent solves fewer lemmas at substantially higher cost, backtracks four to six times more often, and more frequently discards its own revisions. Whole-proof and tactic-level generation achieve similar success rates but follow distinct search and repair strategies. These results suggest that effective automated software verification requires more than improved tactic selection: continuous reasoning and feedback-guided proof revision are critical ingredients for robust proof synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出ProofCoder，一个面向Rocq的智能体验证系统，以"编码智能体"视角做定理证明：在搜索全程持续推理，依据证明助手反馈决定检索信息、查看证明状态、修订片段或回溯，从而在战术级或整证明粒度上迭代构造与修复证明。
AI.motivation: 形式化验证依赖证明助手能提供强正确性保证，但写证明耗时且门槛高。现有基于LLM的方法把模型限制在刚性的"战术生成循环"中，由外层系统控制前提检索、证明状态管理与回溯，限制了模型的自主性与修复能力。
AI.method: ProofCoder是一个面向Rocq的证明合成智能体。它不采用固定的生成循环，而是让模型在整个证明搜索过程中持续推理，并根据证明助手反馈自主决策：何时补充信息、检查证明状态、修订已生成证明片段、或回溯到更早位置；支持战术级与整证明两种粒度的迭代构造、修复与精化。在AutoRocq Benchmark的280个困难验证任务上评测，并做消融分析。
AI.result: 最优配置下证明成功率从AutoRocq系统的47%提升至60%，相对提升27.7%，成本约为原来的一半。消融显示"持续推理"是关键：去掉后解题更少、成本更高、回溯频率增加4–6倍、更常丢弃自己的修订。整证明与战术级生成的最终成功率相近，但搜索与修复策略不同。
AI.conclusion: 有效的自动化软件验证不能仅靠改进战术选择，持续推理与反馈引导的证明修订是稳健证明合成的关键要素。

title: High Probability Risk Control for Online Policy Learning
summary: We study risk control for online policy learning, where an agent adaptively collects data and aims to learn a new policy whose risk stays below a tolerance threshold at every round with high probability. Such policy updates and data collection induce feedback covariate shift (FCS): observed data depend on history through evolving policies and the data-collection process. FCS brings two substantive problems for risk control: 1) efficient risk evaluation for each candidate policy and 2) valid policy selection with high-probability risk control. To address these, we propose a permutation-based weighted risk evaluator with weights efficiently approximated by the Sinkhorn algorithm and select policies whose estimated risk upper confidence bounds (UCB) fall below the target threshold, with the UCB obtained through a proposed Gaussian bootstrap method. Theoretically, we prove that our risk evaluator has a no-larger variance upper bound than that of the standard importance-weighted evaluator. Our policy control method also yields an asymptotically valid simultaneous risk bound and provides asymptotic high-probability risk control for the selected policy. Empirically, we evaluate our method on the online contextual bandit problem, safe question answering benchmark, and Medical Claim Filtering tasks. Our method maintains the target risk level, achieves lower risk than baseline methods, has lower variance in risk estimation, and achieves reliable policy selection with high-probability risk control. Further ablation studies support our theoretical claims.

AI.tldr: 研究在线策略学习中的风险控制问题，提出基于置换加权的风险评估器（Sinkhorn 近似权重）与高斯 bootstrap 得到的 UCB 进行策略选择，实现每轮高概率风险控制，并在多任务上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 在线策略学习时，策略更新与数据采集导致反馈协变量偏移（FCS），使风险控制面临两大难题：候选策略风险的高效评估，以及高概率有效风险约束下的策略选择。
AI.method: 提出基于置换的加权风险评估器，用 Sinkhorn 算法高效近似权重；通过高斯 bootstrap 构造估计风险的置信上界（UCB），仅选择 UCB 低于容忍阈值的策略。
AI.result: 理论上证明该评估器方差上界不大于标准重要性加权评估器；策略控制方法给出渐近有效的同步风险界，并为所选策略提供渐近高概率风险控制。实验在在线 contextual bandit、安全问答基准与医疗理赔过滤任务上保持目标风险水平，风险低于基线、估计方差更小，策略选择可靠。
AI.conclusion: 置换加权评估与高斯 bootstrap UCB 结合可在 FCS 下实现高效且高概率的在线风险控制，消融实验进一步支持理论结论。

title: Multi-Future Drafting: Mixture Block Drafters for Tree-Verified Speculative Decoding
summary: Block drafters such as DFlash draft a block of future tokens in one forward pass, and draft trees such as DDTree verify the prefixes ranked highest by the product of the drafter's per-position distributions. Under tree verification, the expected number of accepted tokens is the probability mass the tree covers. We show that a product misallocates it: when the continuation can follow several futures, it splices them into chimeras, prefixes stitched together from different futures that the target never produces, and gives them as much budget as the futures themselves. Barring ties, no product-ranked tree can hold two futures that disagree in $m$ positions without $2^{m-1}-1$ chimeras, however well the drafter is trained, and in practice chimeras make up 27-33% of a 64-node tree. We propose Multi-Future Drafting (MFD), which restores the coupling with a latent variable instead of the chain rule: $K$ learned mode embeddings at the drafter's input draft $K$ coherent blocks in the same pass, and a mixture DDTree lets the verifier pick the future the target takes, losslessly and with $K+1$ extra vectors. On four Qwen targets from 4B to 27B parameters, at batch size 1, MFD reaches up to 7.8$\times$ speedup, 5-8% faster than the best single-mode tree trained identically and, on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, 9-16% faster than the released DARTree trained on the same prompts.

AI.tldr: 块式投机解码（如DFlash）和树式草稿（如DDTree）用逐位置分布乘积排序前缀，本文指出该乘积会把多个可能的未来"拼接"成目标模型从不产生的"嵌合体"前缀并占用同等预算，理论上无法通过训练消除。作者提出多未来草稿（MFD），用潜变量恢复耦合，K个模式嵌入一次前向生成K个连贯块，配合混合DDTree由验证器选择目标实际采取的未来。在4B–27B的四个Qwen模型上达到最高7.8倍加速，比同训练的最佳单模式树快5–8%，比同提示训练的DARTree快9–16%。
AI.motivation: 树验证下的期望接受长度等于树覆盖的概率质量，但逐位置分布乘积排序会错误分配这部分质量：当续写存在多个可能未来时，乘积会把不同未来的前缀拼接成目标模型永远不会产生的"嵌合体"，并给它们与真实未来相同的预算。作者指出这是结构性问题——除并列情况外，任何乘积排序的树只要包含两个在m个位置不一致的未来，就必然含有2^{m-1}-1个嵌合体，与草稿模型训练得多好无关；实测中嵌合体占64节点树的27–33%。因此需要一种从根本上恢复未来之间耦合的草稿机制。
AI.method: MFD放弃链式法则的逐位置乘积，改用潜变量（模式嵌入）建模未来间的耦合：草稿器输入端有K个可学习的模式嵌入，一次前向即可产出K个彼此连贯的候选块；验证阶段使用混合DDTree，让目标模型自行挑选它实际走的那个未来，从而在无损的前提下完成验证，额外开销仅为K+1个向量。
AI.result: 在四个Qwen目标模型（4B到27B参数）上，batch size为1时MFD最高可达7.8倍加速；相比用相同方式训练的最佳单模式树快5–8%；在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上，相比在相同提示上训练的已发布DARTree快9–16%。
AI.conclusion: 乘积式排序在树验证中存在固有的"嵌合体"质量浪费问题，无法靠更强草稿器解决；MFD以潜变量模式嵌入加混合DDTree的方式显式建模多未来耦合，在几乎不增加开销的情况下实现无损验证，并在多个规模的Qwen模型上取得显著且稳定的加速，优于同条件训练的单模式树与DARTree基线。

title: X Marks the Spot: Diffusion for Image Geolocalization with Location Representations
summary: Image geolocalization predicts the location at which a photo was taken. Accurate geolocalization requires discriminating between both physically and semantically adjacent areas on Earth. However, prior diffusion-based approaches predict locations by generating coordinates, which are semantically unstable over space. We avoid this limitation by learning geolocalization behavior in the pretrained representation spaces of location encoders, which provide both positional and semantic understanding. To make this space usable for coordinate prediction, we introduce a Location Autoencoder (LAE), which pairs a frozen location encoder with a learned decoder mapping embeddings back to coordinates with kilometer-level accuracy worldwide. In the LAE space, we train DIG, a latent diffusion model that transports noise to location embeddings conditioned on image features. DIG consistently outperforms coordinate-based generative models and sets a new state of the art for parametric geolocalization on three benchmarks: OSV-5M, Im2GPS3k, and YFCC4k. Notably, DIG is the first generative model to outperform retrieval-based methods, and further improves retrieve-and-rerank systems when used as a prior. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出位置自编码器LAE与潜在扩散模型DIG，在预训练位置编码器的语义稳定表征空间中完成图像地理定位，刷新三项基准SOTA，并首次让生成式方法超越检索式方法。
AI.motivation: 图像地理定位需要区分物理与语义上相邻的区域。已有基于扩散的方法直接生成坐标，而坐标在空间上语义不稳定，限制了定位精度。
AI.method: 先构建Location Autoencoder (LAE)：冻结预训练位置编码器，学习一个解码器将嵌入映射回坐标，实现全球公里级精度，从而使该表征空间可用于坐标预测。再在LAE空间中训练DIG——一个以图像特征为条件、将噪声输运到位置嵌入的潜在扩散模型。
AI.result: DIG在OSV-5M、Im2GPS3k、YFCC4k三个基准上持续优于基于坐标的生成模型，创下参数化地理定位新SOTA；为首个超越检索式方法的生成模型，作为先验还能进一步提升retrieve-and-rerank系统。
AI.conclusion: 在语义稳定的位置编码表征空间中进行潜在扩散，是优于坐标生成范式的有效地理定位方案，并与检索式方法具备互补性。代码与模型将开源。

title: Framing-Induced Vulnerability in Large Language Models: Evidence from Chinese News Headlines
summary: Large language models increasingly evaluate, route, and moderate news, so a model's judgment of a headline has become a gatekeeping decision. We ask whether that judgment follows the fact being reported or the way the fact is framed. We combine an ecological audit of 63,926 Chinese news headlines with a controlled experiment. The experiment covers 30 real events, 30 synthetic events, and 29 natural headline pairs, tested on four Chinese models. Changing only the headline frame shifted both perceived misleadingness and event severity, and the direction and ordering of the shifts were the same for DeepSeek, MiMo, Dots, and LongCat. Emotionally intensified headlines raised severity ratings by 0.65 to 0.88 points, whereas positively reframed headlines lowered them by 0.34 to 0.52 points. Supplying the article body reduced this severity bias by 54 to 80 percent, and all four reductions were significant at p < .01. A small human reference study showed the same direction of effect. Headline-only LLM evaluation therefore carries a measurable robustness gap, and framing sensitivity belongs among the reliability properties that deployment and governance check.

AI.tldr: 研究检验大模型对新闻标题的判断是跟随事实本身还是被标题框架左右：仅改变标题框架即可显著改变模型对"误导性"与"事件严重性"的判断，且四个中文模型方向一致；提供正文可将严重性偏差降低54%–80%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多参与新闻评估、分发与审核，模型对标题的判断实际上成了"把关"决策，因此需要知道这种判断是否稳健，还是会被报道方式（框架）而非事实本身所左右。
AI.method: 结合两部分：一是对63,926条中文新闻标题的生态学审计；二是控制实验，涵盖30个真实事件、30个合成事件和29组自然标题对，在DeepSeek、MiMo、Dots、LongCat四个中文模型上测试，并辅以一个小规模人类参照研究。
AI.result: 仅改变标题框架即可同时改变感知误导性和事件严重性评分，四个模型的偏移方向与排序一致。情绪强化型标题使严重性评分升高0.65–0.88分，正面重构型标题使其降低0.34–0.52分。提供文章正文后该严重性偏差降低54%–80%，四项降幅均在p<.01水平显著。人类参照研究呈同一方向。
AI.conclusion: 仅在标题层面进行LLM评估存在可测量的稳健性缺口；框架敏感性应被纳入部署与治理所检查的可靠性属性之一。

title: Reliable and explainable analysis of AVS/RS by Statistical Model Checking and Process Mining
comment: 40 pages, 12 figures. Original manuscript submitted before peer review. A revised version has been accepted for publication in Expert Systems with Applications
summary: Automated Vehicle Storage and Retrieval Systems (AVS/RS) are increasingly adopted to boost warehouse throughput while containing operational costs. We present an integrated analysis framework that couples discrete-event simulation with Statistical Model Checking (SMC) and Process Mining (PM) to quantify and explain AVS/RS performance. SMC, implemented through the MultiVeStA tool, delivers statistically reliable estimates of key indicators, such as cycle times, throughput, and storage utilization, across alternative stocking and picking policies with user-specified confidence levels. MultiVeStA orchestrates multiple independent simulations in a black-box manner, enabling automated verification. PM ingests the resulting event logs to uncover the behavioral patterns and bottlenecks that drive those indicators, closing the interpretability gap typical of simulation studies. We instantiate the framework on a new open-source AVS/RS simulator configured according to recent industrial guidelines and evaluate multiple control strategies. Results show that the joint use of SMC and PM enables both predictive what-if analyses and post-hoc diagnostics, providing the first combined SMC+PM assessment of AVS/RS operations and a reusable toolchain for automated warehousing research.

AI.tldr: 提出将离散事件仿真、统计模型检验（SMC）与过程挖掘（PM）结合的集成框架，用于量化并解释自动仓储存取系统（AVS/RS）的性能，并基于新开源仿真器进行多控制策略评估。
AI.motivation: AVS/RS 被广泛用于提升仓储吞吐并控制成本，但仿真研究缺乏统计可靠性保证，且仿真结果难以解释其背后的行为模式与瓶颈，存在可解释性缺口。
AI.method: 以离散事件仿真为核心，用 MultiVeStA 实现黑盒式 SMC，对周期时间、吞吐量、存储利用率等指标在用户指定置信水平下给出统计可靠估计；再将生成的事件日志输入过程挖掘，揭示驱动这些指标的行为模式与瓶颈。
AI.result: 在新开源 AVS/RS 仿真器上（按近期工业准则配置）评估多种存储/拣选与控制策略，表明 SMC 与 PM 联用可同时支持预测性 what-if 分析与事后诊断。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个 SMC+PM 相结合的 AVS/RS 运营评估，兼具统计可靠性与可解释性，并提供可复用的自动化仓储研究工具链。

title: RadRef: A Reference-Free Metric for Radiology Report Generation
summary: AI-generated radiology reports are usually evaluated by comparison with a radiologist-authored reference, leaving no way to score them when no reference exists. We introduce RadRef, a reference-free metric that scores report claims against image-derived beliefs over a clinical finding vocabulary, weighted by relevance to the clinical indication. On ReXVal, RadRef achieves 73.1% agreement on non-tied same-radiograph report pairs with radiologist rankings, comparable to leading reference-based metrics overall. It is also competitive on false findings and has its clearest relative result on omissions (missed findings). We further evaluate 100 model-generated and 100 radiologist-authored reports from 100 MIMIC-CXR studies, all independently annotated by two board-certified radiologists. On omissions, RadRef attains Kendall's tau-b = 0.295, against 0.386 between the two readers themselves, and no compared metric differs significantly from RadRef on this target. The same image-grounded representation provides a false-finding readout, RadRef-FF, with tau-b = 0.32 on ReXVal and 0.29 in the reader study, without requiring a reference. Controlled perturbations confirm that RadRef depends on the radiograph, report, and clinical indication. RadRef enables image-grounded evaluation before a radiologist-authored reference exists, supporting quality monitoring of report-generation systems in clinical settings, and complements reference-based metrics when one is available.

AI.tldr: 提出无参考指标 RadRef，用图像导出的信念对影像报告陈述打分并按临床指征相关性加权，在遗漏检出上接近两名放射科医生之间的一致性。
AI.motivation: AI 生成的放射学报告通常需与放射科医生撰写的参考报告对比评测，无参考报告时无法评分，限制了临床场景下的质量监控。
AI.method: RadRef 为无参考指标：将报告中的临床陈述与基于图像推断出的、关于临床发现词表的信念分布进行比对打分，并以与临床指征的相关性加权；同一图像 grounded 表示还派生假发现读出 RadRef-FF。评测包括 ReXVal 上与放射科医生排序的一致性、100 份模型生成与 100 份医生撰写 MIMIC-CXR 报告的雙读者独立标注研究（含 100 项检查），以及受控扰动实验。
AI.result: ReXVal 上非平局同影像报告对的排序一致率 73.1%，总体可比肩主流有参考指标；在假发现上具竞争力，在遗漏（漏诊发现）上相对优势最明显。读者研究中遗漏目标 Kendall tau-b=0.295（两名读者之间为 0.386），且无对比指标显著优于 RadRef；RadRef-FF 在 ReXVal 上 tau-b=0.32、读者研究中 0.29。扰动实验证实其依赖影像、报告与临床指征。
AI.conclusion: RadRef 支持在尚无放射科医生参考报告时进行图像 grounded 的评测，可用于临床报告生成系统的质量监控，并在有参考指标时作为补充。

title: ChipOmni: A General-Purpose AI Agent for Electronic Design Automation
summary: Electronic design automation (EDA) workflows remain highly fragmented, requiring engineers to coordinate heterogeneous representations, specialised software tools, and iterative verification across multiple design stages. Although large language models have brought more general reasoning and code-generation capabilities to EDA, many existing approaches remain focused on isolated tasks and struggle to plan, verify, and repair designs autonomously within executable engineering environments. Here we introduce ChipOmni, a knowledge-enhanced, context-evolving AI agent framework for EDA. ChipOmni integrates multimodal understanding, dynamic planning, multi-agent collaboration, and verification-driven tool interaction into a unified autonomous system. By continually incorporating feedback from external engineering tools, the framework maintains an evolving task context, integrates domain knowledge, and iteratively refines intermediate designs.
