Across benchmarks for analog circuit, RTL, testbench, and formal-assertion generation, ChipOmni improves multiple task-specific measures over the evaluated baselines and solves all 30 AnalogCoder-Pro tasks. In a long-horizon case study, ChipOmni advances a natural-language RISC-V specification through three design levels to a micro-SoC GDSII layout that passes physical sign-off, without human intervention after initialization. Together, these results show that ChipOmni can coordinate verification-driven design across heterogeneous tasks and sustain long-horizon engineering workflows, advancing a shift from fragmented, tool-centred processes towards agent-centred, closed-loop systems.

AI.tldr: 提出ChipOmni——知识增强、上下文演化的EDA智能体框架，统一多模态理解、动态规划、多智能体协作与验证驱动工具交互，在模拟电路、RTL、测试平台与形式断言生成任务上超越基线，并无人工干预完成从RISC-V规格到通过签核的微SoC GDSII全流程。
AI.motivation: EDA工作流高度碎片化，工程师需在多个设计阶段协调异构表示、专用工具与迭代验证；现有LLM方法多聚焦孤立任务，难以在可执行工程环境中自主规划、验证与修复设计。
AI.method: ChipOmni将多模态理解、动态规划、多智能体协作和验证驱动的工具交互整合为统一自主系统；通过持续吸收外部工程工具反馈来维护演化中的任务上下文、融合领域知识并迭代精化中间设计。
AI.result: 在模拟电路、RTL、测试平台和形式断言四类基准上，多项任务指标优于所评估基线，并完成AnalogCoder-Pro全部30项任务；长篇案例中，仅初始化后无人工干预，将自然语言RISC-V规格经三级设计推进至通过物理签核的微SoC GDSII版图。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明ChipOmni能在异构任务间协调验证驱动的设计并支撑长周期工程流程，推动EDA从碎片化、以工具为中心转向以智能体为中心的闭环系统。

title: Comparative Evaluation of Deep Learning Models for Geographic Atrophy Segmentation in En Face OCT Images
summary: Background: Geographic atrophy (GA) is an advanced form of age-related macular degeneration (AMD). It causes irreversible vision loss due to progressive degeneration of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and photoreceptors. Accurate segmentation of GA in en-face image is crucial for early diagnosis, monitoring disease progression, and developing personalized treatment strategies. However, existing deep learning approaches are typically evaluated using single architectures and single-device datasets, limiting insight into relative performance and cross-device robustness. Methods: We trained and systematically compared five deep learning architectures for GA segmentation: Nested U-Net, ResU-Net, nnUnet, Swin-Unet and MedSegDiff model, together with a thresholding based classical baseline. The models were trained on a dataset of en-face OCT images derived from 269 OCT volumes from two different devices, following a three-step preprocessing technique involving normalization and inpainting to enhance the quality of the en-face images. Results: On the fixed held-out validation set comprising OCT scans from both Cirrus (R) (Carl Zeiss Meditec, Inc., USA) and Spectralis (R) (Heidelberg Engineering, Germany) devices, nnUnet achieved the highest mean Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) of 0.8882 +/- 0.0033. The other models yielded the following Dice scores: Nested U-Net (0.7932 +/- 0.0423), ResU-Net (0.8453 +/- 0.0074), Swin-Unet (0.6886 +/- 0.0294), and Diffusion model (0.7959 +/- 0.0242). Conclusions: nnUnet framework, demonstrated most reliable performance for GA segmentation in en-face OCT under limited data conditions. It offers the best balance of accuracy, stability, and efficiency for GA quantification.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统比较五种深度学习架构（Nested U-Net、ResU-Net、nnUnet、Swin-Unet、MedSegDiff）及阈值法基线在en-face OCT图像上分割地图样萎缩（GA）的性能；nnUnet表现最佳，Dice达0.8882，在有限数据下最准确、稳定且高效。
AI.motivation: GA是晚期AMD的不可逆致盲表现，en-face图像中精准分割对早期诊断、病程监测和个性化治疗至关重要；但现有深度学习方法多在单一架构和单一设备数据集上评估，缺乏架构间相对性能与跨设备鲁棒性的比较。
AI.method: 基于269个OCT体积（来自Cirrus与Spectralis两种设备）生成en-face OCT图像，经归一化与inpainting三步预处理；训练并对比五种架构（Nested U-Net、ResU-Net、nnUnet、Swin-Unet、MedSegDiff）及阈值法基线，在同时包含两种设备的固定留出验证集上评估。
AI.result: nnUnet取得最高平均DSC 0.8882±0.0033；ResU-Net 0.8453±0.0074，MedSegDiff 0.7959±0.0242，Nested U-Net 0.7932±0.0423，Swin-Unet最低为0.6886±0.0294。
AI.conclusion: 在有限数据条件下，nnUnet框架对en-face OCT的GA分割表现最可靠，在准确性、稳定性与效率间取得最佳平衡，适合用于GA量化。

title: How Post-Training Influences Verbalized Algorithmic Computation in Language Models
summary: Post-training improves language-model reasoning, but how it changes the use of internal information and verbalized chain of thought (CoT) remains unclear. We study successive SFT, DPO, and RLVR checkpoints of Olmo-3-7B-Instruct on multi-digit addition, using carry values as known intermediate state. Probes recover carry information from internal activations with similar accuracy in SFT and RLVR, although manipulating this information does not reliably control model outputs. In contrast, the usefulness of verbalized reasoning differs: CoTs produced by RLVR yield higher accuracy across receiving checkpoints than those produced by SFT or DPO. We also show that carry-related statements receive higher importance scores after RLVR than matched random controls. DPO shows similar sensitivity to carry-related statements but without comparable accuracy gains. These results suggest that post-training changes the usefulness of written reasoning and sensitivity to its content in meaningful ways, although greater sensitivity does not necessarily coincide with better problem performance.

AI.tldr: 论文研究SFT、DPO、RLVR三类后训练对Olmo-3-7B-Instruct在多位加法任务中内部信息利用与显式CoT的影响，发现内部进位信息在SFT与RLVR中均可被探针恢复但难以操控输出，而RLVR产出的CoT更具可用性且进位相关语句重要性更高；敏感性提升不等于性能更好。
AI.motivation: 后训练能提升语言模型推理能力，但其如何改变模型对内部信息的利用以及显式思维链（CoT）的作用仍不清楚，作者希望厘清不同后训练阶段（SFT、DPO、RLVR）在这两方面的差异。
AI.method: 以多位加法为任务，利用已知的进位（carry）作为中间状态；对Olmo-3-7B-Instruct在SFT、DPO、RLVR各检查点做激活探针恢复进位信息并进行干预实验；同时跨接收检查点评估不同来源CoT的可用性，以及对进位相关语句与随机对照语句的重要性打分。
AI.result: 探针在SFT与RLVR中恢复进位信息的准确率相近，但操纵该信息不能可靠控制输出；RLVR生成的CoT在不同接收检查点上带来更高准确率，优于SFT与DPO的CoT；RLVR后进位相关语句的重要性分数高于匹配的随机对照；DPO对进位语句同样敏感，但没有相应的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 后训练显著改变了书面推理的有用性及模型对其内容的敏感性，但更高的敏感性并不必然对应更好的问题表现，提示内部信息可解码性与CoT可用性、输出可控性之间存在解耦。

title: Understanding-First AI Engineering: Purposes, Reference Architecture, and Architectural Patterns for Human Understanding
summary: AI systems can produce reliable results without developing human understanding. However, human understanding remains valuable for shaping subsequent AI-supported work, forming preferences, governing collective choices and satisfying curiosity, even when human participation is unnecessary for correcting errors. We propose understanding-first AI engineering, which treats purpose-specific human understanding as a first-class design principle guiding requirements, design and operation. The purposes of understanding are organised into four complementary rationales: reflective agency, effective action, collective governance and epistemic value. A reference architecture connects production, verification, use, and learning and exploration through shared records, supporting understanding through explanation and participation. Five candidate architectural patterns guide choices about parallel learning, explanatory models, goal exploration, audience-specific views and distributed expertise. Qualitative scenario analysis of two hypothetical use cases demonstrates how the purpose classification, reference architecture and selected patterns guide investigation, participation and decision processes while retaining operational controls. The cases illustrate design consequences and limitations rather than establish empirical effectiveness. The approach makes human understanding an explicit engineering commitment whose justification need not depend on improving the original AI task.

AI.tldr: 提出“理解优先的AI工程”，将特定目的人类理解作为一等设计原则，并给出四类理解理由、参考架构与五种候选架构模式。
AI.motivation: AI可在缺乏人类理解的情况下产出可靠结果，但人类理解对于塑造后续工作、形成偏好、治理集体选择与满足好奇心仍有价值，即使人类参与并非纠错所必需。
AI.method: 将理解目的组织为四类互补理由（反思性能动、有效行动、集体治理、认识论价值）；构建连接生产、验证、使用、学习与探索的参考架构，通过共享记录并以解释与参与支撑理解；提出五种候选架构模式：并行学习、解释性模型、目标探索、面向受众的视图、分布式专业能力。
AI.result: 通过对两个假设用例的定性情景分析，展示目的分类、参考架构与所选模式如何引导调查、参与和决策过程，同时保留运行控制。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使人类理解成为明确的工程承诺，其正当性无需依赖提升原AI任务性能；案例仅说明设计后果与局限，不构成实证有效性证明。

title: Multimodal Road Closure Mapping via Cross-Modal Graph Attention
comment: Published at ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026. 11 pages, 4 figures
summary: Accurate and timely identification of road closures is critical for large-scale navigation and logistics systems, yet remains challenging due to the need to jointly reason over visual evidence, spatial context, and road network topology. Existing approaches either rely on manual map updates or focus on detecting closure-related objects without resolving which road segment is affected. In this work, we introduce a unified multimodal and multitask framework that jointly performs road closure classification (no, partial, complete) and road segment association within a single learning architecture. Our model integrates graph-structured map data, satellite imagery augmented with projected street-level detections, and street-view images using modality-specific encoders and cross-modal transformer attention, enabling explicit reasoning over visual cues and network topology. Evaluated on nearly 20K real-world scenarios collected from a large-scale commercial vehicle fleet, our approach achieves 72.7% closure classification accuracy and 60% road segment association accuracy, outperforming frontier vision-language models by over 28 percentage points on closure classification while being over 4,000x smaller and 100x faster at inference. Extensive ablations demonstrate the importance of cross-modal attention, edge-aware pooling, and graph message passing for accurate geospatial reasoning. This work establishes the first benchmark for joint road closure classification and segment-level attribution, and shows that task-specific architectural inductive biases substantially outperform general-purpose multimodal models for structured geospatial understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出统一多模态多任务框架，联合进行道路封闭分类（无/部分/完全）与受影响路段关联，融合路网图、卫星影像（含投影街景检测）与街景图像，在近2万真实场景上达72.7%分类准确率与60%路段关联准确率。
AI.motivation: 道路封闭的准确及时识别对导航与物流至关重要，但需同时推理视觉证据、空间上下文与路网拓扑；现有方法依赖人工地图更新，或仅检测封闭相关物体而无法确定受影响路段。
AI.method: 构建单一学习架构，使用模态专属编码器与跨模态Transformer注意力，整合图结构地图数据、投影街景检测的卫星影像和街景图像；通过边感知池化与图消息传递显式推理视觉线索与网络拓扑。
AI.result: 在约2万个来自大型商用车队的真实场景上，封闭分类准确率72.7%、路段关联准确率60%；分类上超越前沿视觉语言模型逾28个百分点，同时模型小4000倍以上、推理快100倍。消融实验证实跨模态注意力、边感知池化和图消息传递的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 建立了联合道路封闭分类与路段级归因的首个基准，表明针对任务设计的架构归纳偏置在结构化地理空间理解上显著优于通用多模态模型。

title: Are Dense Rewards Worth Their Tokens in GRPO?
comment: 59 pages (10 pages of main text), 18 figures, 27 tables. Code: https://github.com/vicky157/grpo-validation
summary: RLVR trains language models to reason by rewarding correct final answers. A widely used algorithm, group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), gives every token of a solution the same credit, so dense process rewards have been proposed to credit intermediate steps, for example with a Monte-Carlo reward that scores each step by sampling continuations from it. Comparing such a reward with GRPO per training update, or vetting it with a gradient test on a single batch, leaves out what it costs: in our setting, the continuations alone take 91% of all generated tokens. We introduce a matched-compute protocol that gives every training intervention the same budget, measured in generated tokens and training GPU-hours, and tests it in preregistered studies with controls for side effects. Across 1,668 runs on six models, matching compute reverses the ranking. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, the Monte-Carlo reward leads standard GRPO per update, yet ends 14.3 percentage points lower at equal tokens and 7.8 points lower at equal training time, and none of four dense-reward variants outperforms GRPO even with as much training time. A per-token gradient test orders these rewards as training does but overestimates each by one to two points, as much as the gains it is meant to detect. In contrast, training on the prompts whose predicted success is nearest 1/2 improves accuracy at matched compute, by 1.7 points on Qwen3-0.6B and 0.8 on Qwen2.5-1.5B. These gains replicate on fresh seeds and unseen problems, and a simple rule, that the candidate prompts are predicted to fail more often than not, predicted where they appear in five of six preregistered tests. Both gains come early in training, and standard GRPO with twice the initial learning rate comes within half a point of them. We argue that training interventions should be validated at matched compute, which overturns some apparent gains and confirms others.

AI.tldr: 在等算力（生成token数、GPU小时）匹配协议下，蒙特卡洛稠密过程奖励反而不如标准GRPO；而按预测成功率接近1/2挑选提示词训练可获得稳健提升，但增益多出现在训练早期且被更高学习率的GRPO接近追平。
AI.motivation: 稠密过程奖励（如按步骤采样续写的蒙特卡洛奖励）看起来优于GRPO，但现有评估只比较单次更新或单batch梯度，忽略了续写采样带来的巨大开销（占生成token的91%），导致收益被高估、方法排序可能被颠倒。
AI.method: 提出等算力匹配协议：所有训练干预（稠密奖励、GRPO、提示词筛选）给予相同预算（生成token数与训练GPU小时），并采用预注册研究、副作用对照和全新随机种子/未见问题的复现。共在六模型上运行1,668次实验。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-1.5B上蒙特卡洛奖励单次更新优于GRPO，但等token下低14.3个百分点、等训练时间下低7.8个百分点，四种稠密奖励变体均不及GRPO。逐token梯度测试的排序与训练一致，但每条高估1–2个百分点。提示词筛选在等算力下提升Qwen3-0.6B 1.7点、Qwen2.5-1.5B 0.8点，可在新种子与未见问题上复现，且“预测失败多于成功”的简单规则在六项预注册测试中五项命中。两类增益均出现在训练早期，双倍初始学习率的GRPO差距不到0.5点。
AI.conclusion: 训练干预应在等算力下验证，这既推翻了稠密过程奖励的表观增益，也确认了提示词筛选的部分增益；同时提示增益可能源于学习率等简单因素，需谨慎归因。

title: Prediction-Powered LLM Ranking with Adaptively Collected Human Feedback
summary: Ranking large language models (LLMs) through human evaluations is essential for downstream decision-making. Because human feedback is expensive, evaluation platforms often collect it adaptively, prioritizing informative model comparisons using previously observed feedback. To further improve precision with limited human feedback, evaluators can draw on abundant unrated responses and relatively inexpensive LLM judges; however, judge bias and adaptive dependence challenge standard i.i.d. inference frameworks. We propose Prediction-Powered Ranking (PP-Rank), a framework that combines LLM-judge predictions with human feedback to improve precision while providing valid inference under adaptive sampling. Data-driven prediction weights minimize the asymptotic covariance trace within the proposed class. In theory, we establish asymptotic normality for general evaluation targets and simultaneous ranking inference. A joint martingale analysis handles dependence between adaptive human feedback and auxiliary data. We further derive a rule for reducing exploration that prioritizes lower-cost comparisons while matching a conservative variance bound, and characterize allocation limits for regular $\sqrt{T}$-rate estimation of pairwise means. Semi-synthetic experiments on UltraFeedback-Extended show improvements over human-only baselines in score estimation, confidence interval width, and ranking certification. Synthetic experiments demonstrate robustness to judge quality and adaptive allocation, while showing that PP-Rank can substantially reduce evaluation costs without sacrificing precision.

AI.tldr: PP-Rank结合LLM评审预测与人类反馈，在自适应采样下实现有效的模型排名推断与精度提升。
AI.motivation: 人类反馈昂贵，评估平台采用自适应采样；未评级响应和低成本LLM评审丰富但存在评审偏差与自适应依赖，标准i.i.d.推断框架失效。
AI.method: 提出PP-Rank框架，融合LLM评审预测与人类反馈；用数据驱动预测权重最小化渐近协方差迹；用联合鞅分析处理自适应反馈与辅助数据的依赖，建立渐近正态性与同时排名推断；给出减少探索的分配规则并刻画sqrt(T)速率估计的分配极限。
AI.result: 在UltraFeedback-Extended半合成实验中，分数估计、置信区间宽度与排名认证均优于仅人类反馈基线；合成实验显示对评审质量与自适应分配具鲁棒性，并能大幅降低评估成本而不牺牲精度。
AI.conclusion: PP-Rank为自适应人类评估中的模型排名提供有效统计推断，可借助廉价LLM评审显著降低评估成本并提升精度。

title: GRAP: Gender Rubric-Aware Probing for Analyzing Gender Bias in LLMs
comment: 3 pages. Accepted at the ECML-PKDD 2026 Workshop on Bias and Fairness in AI
summary: As LLMs increasingly mediate everyday interactions, subtle gender biases in open-ended responses pose growing societal risks. Existing probing methods have two key limitations: they rely on fixed-format tasks, such as pronoun resolution or occupation association, that alignment-tuned models can easily handle; and they compare raw group-level rubric scores, ignoring per-dimension variance and obscuring which bias dimensions reliably distinguish gender groups. We introduce GRAP (Gender Rubric-Aware Probing), a framework that uses a lightweight logistic probe to identify the most discriminative bias dimensions from responses scored across 10 rubric dimensions, operating task-agnostically on open-ended instruction following.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAP框架，用轻量逻辑回归探针从10个评分维度中识别最能区分性别群体的偏见维度，实现任务无关的开放式指令跟随性别偏见探测。
AI.motivation: LLM在开放交互中潜藏性别偏见，但现有探针方法依赖固定格式任务（代词消解、职业联想），对齐微调后的模型容易应付；同时仅比较群体层面的原始评分，忽略各维度方差，难以识别哪些偏见维度真正可靠地区分性别群体。
AI.method: GRAP（Gender Rubric-Aware Probing）：对开放式指令跟随的回答按10个评分维度打分，再用轻量逻辑回归探针筛选出最具判别力的偏见维度。任务无关，不依赖固定格式。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果，仅提出框架设计。
AI.conclusion: GRAP通过评分维度级探针弥补固定任务与群体均值比较的缺陷，为开放式生成中的性别偏见提供更可靠、可解释的维度级诊断。

title: Image Quality and the Reliability of Fabric-Density Measurement: Counting Threads from Smartphone Photos Through a Pick Glass
comment: Accepted at the WVAQ workshop at WACV 2027
summary: Thread density, the threads per inch along and across a woven fabric, is a basic specification that buyers check whenever fabric is sold. Without laboratory instruments, inspectors count it slowly, by eye, through a pick glass, a folding 10$\times$ magnifier with a one-inch window. A smartphone photo through that glass could make the check faster and leave a record. We judge such a photo by what it is used for, as in task-based image quality: it is good if the thread count from it is within $\pm$5% of the true count, a common tolerance in fabric specifications. We introduce PickGlass-TPI: 76 factory scenes of 44 fabric patches, each counted in an open annotation tool by a textile-trained annotator, whose counts are the reference. On it we benchmark frontier and open vision-language models, CNNs, counting specialists and a training-free spectral counter (PG-Lattice). No method agrees with the reference within the tolerance. The best methods are off by about a quarter: a small open model that we tuned only on synthetic images (Molmo2-4B, 25%) is level with the best frontier model, GPT-6.1-sol (27% when asked directly, 25% given four magnified close-ups of the window). Both err less than a non-expert annotator (37%), but only the tuned model also beats, on both error measures, a baseline that guesses each scene's density as the average of the others. PG-Lattice most often repeats its count within 5% across two photos of the same patch, but its misses, like GPT-6.1-sol's errors, are often a factor of two. Even the reference repeats a count across such re-shoots only to a median 9%, so one photo cannot yet be shown to meet $\pm$5%; the image quality that matters is reliability across re-shoots. Generic no-reference quality scores chosen before labeling do not rank PG-Lattice's error, and generative enhancement raises perceptual scores but does not reliably improve the count.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PickGlass-TPI 基准（76 个工厂场景、44 块织物），以"数线误差在真实计数 ±5% 内"这一任务导向标准评估手机照片直接数经纬密度的可行性，发现所有方法（前沿/开源 VLM、CNN、计数专用模型、免训练谱方法 PG-Lattice）均未达标，最佳误差约 25%。
AI.motivation: 织物经纬密度（thread density, TPI）是买卖双方必检的基本指标，但现有检验依赖放大镜（pick glass）人工目视慢速计数，缺乏自动化与可留档手段；而评价照片质量应回到用途本身——能否给出误差 ±5% 内的计数。
AI.method: 构建 PickGlass-TPI 数据集：76 个工厂场景、44 块织物，由受过纺织训练的标注者用开源标注工具计数作为参考真值。在该基准上评测前沿与开源视觉语言模型（GPT-6.1-sol、Molmo2-4B）、CNN、计数专用方法，以及免训练的谱域计数法 PG-Lattice；并采用任务导向指标（±5% 容忍度、重拍一致性、与非专家标注者及"取他图均值"猜测基线的对比）。
AI.result: 无方法达到 ±5%。最佳者误差约四分之一：仅用合成图微调的小开源模型 Molmo2-4B 为 25%，与最佳前沿模型 GPT-6.1-sol 相当（直接提问 27%，给四张放大特写 25%）；二者均优于非专家标注者（37%），但仅微调模型在两种误差度量上都还胜过"取其余场景均值"的基线。PG-Lattice 重拍重复性最好（两次拍摄计数差多在 5% 内），但其失误与 GPT-6.1-sol 一样常为 2 倍级；参考标注本身重拍重复性中位数也仅 9%，说明单张照片尚无法证明满足 ±5%。预选的通用无参考质量分数无法对 PG-Lattice 的误差排序；生成式增强可提升感知分数，却不能可靠改善计数。
AI.conclusion: 单张手机照片目前不足以可靠达到 ±5% 的密度检验要求；真正有意义的"图像质量"是跨重拍的可靠性。机器计数已可超过非专家人工，但需借助重拍一致性或多图融合来界定可用性，而非依赖通用图像质量分数或生成式增强。

title: An evidence-traceable benchmark of clinical reasoning in large language models
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Zhiqun Zhao, Xiaodong Yang and Bruce Gu contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Zheng Wang, Haiquan Lu and Xiaoming Wu
summary: Benchmark scores for medical large language models (LLMs) are difficult to interpret when scoring criteria cannot be traced to clinical evidence. Here we developed Med Evidence Bench (MEB; https://www.medevidencebench.org.cn/), comprising 1,536 physician-constructed items across three levels: guideline knowledge, standardized clinical scenarios and real-world laboratory scenarios. Each criterion stating a medical claim is linked to a versioned source-text span. Across ten LLMs, the Evidence Trace Score (ETS) was 0.975-0.997 for guideline knowledge, 0.292-0.658 for standardized scenarios and 0.182-0.447 for real-world scenarios, and rankings varied across levels. For real-world scenarios, scores for identifying clinical information (mean, 0.770) exceeded those for matching evidence (0.165) or formulating recommendations (0.160). On 1,296 criterion-level judgments, automated grading agreed with the majority vote of three physicians (macro-F1, 0.930; 95% confidence interval, 0.915-0.945), although agreement was lower for evidence application. These findings from Chinese-language materials indicate that guideline recall does not ensure patient-specific evidence use and do not establish clinical effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Med Evidence Bench (MEB)医学大模型基准，将每条评分标准链接到可溯源的版本化文献片段，并用证据溯源分数(ETS)评估10个LLM，发现模型指南记忆强但真实场景证据应用弱。
AI.motivation: 医学LLM的基准分数难以解释，因为评分标准无法追溯到临床证据，无法判断模型输出是否有依据。
AI.method: 构建MEB基准，含1,536道医师编写的题目，分三个层级：指南知识、标准化临床场景、真实世界实验室场景；每条陈述医学主张的评分标准均链接到带版本号的源文本片段。对10个LLM计算证据溯源分数(ETS)，并用三位医师多数投票对1,296条标准级判定进行自动评分一致性验证。
AI.result: ETS在指南知识层为0.975–0.997，标准化场景为0.292–0.658，真实场景为0.182–0.447，不同层级排名不一致。真实场景中，识别临床信息得分(均值0.770)高于匹配证据(0.165)与形成建议(0.160)。自动评分与三位医师多数投票的macro-F1为0.930 (95% CI 0.915–0.945)，但证据应用方面一致性较低。
AI.conclusion: 中文材料结果表明，指南记忆并不保证患者特异性证据的使用；该结果不构成对临床有效性的证明。

title: ExpertCrowd-SWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Expert-Authored Engineering Tasks in Unfamiliar Codebases
summary: ExpertCrowd-SWE (EC-SWE) is a benchmark of 100 expert-authored, multi-file software engineering tasks for evaluating autonomous coding agents in large, unfamiliar codebases. Each task is a change request written by a practising engineer against a pinned commit of a real repository, paired with a sealed reference solution and a task-specific grader whose weighted, mostly executable criteria award partial credit; must-pass blockers and pass/fail gates encode what a maintainer would refuse to merge. The tasks span 87 open-source projects and 11 languages. The median ticket is 148 words, while the median reference solution changes 471 lines. Every task image is calibrated before release so that the reference solution scores 1.0 and both the untouched repository and an inert change score 0; nearly half of the tasks also ship alternative, lazy and adversarial control patches that the grader must classify correctly. The final 100 tasks were selected for difficulty against current frontier models. We evaluate seven frontier models, five runs each (3,495 scored runs), in a single platform harness that gives each model its provider-native tool interface. Claude Opus 5.5 (67.3%) and GPT-6 Astra (63.7%) lead without a statistically significant gap, followed by Claude Fable 5.1 (46.5%), Gemini 3.8 Flash (40.0%), and a statistically indistinguishable group of Qwen 3.8 Max, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Grok 4.6 (32-34%). No task is fully solved by every model, and on 80 tasks no model earns full credit on all five runs. Scores span 35 points. Depending on the model, agents take a median of 33 to 166 steps per run, with little relation to score. We release 24 tasks with their environments, graders and results, and hold out 76 to limit contamination.

AI.tldr: EC-SWE 是包含 100 个专家撰写的多文件软件工程任务基准，用于评测自主编码智能体。任务来自 87 个开源项目、11 种语言，配有密封参考解与加权部分给分的可执行评分器。7 个前沿模型各跑 5 次（共 3,495 次），Opus 5.5（67.3%）与 GPT-6 Astra（63.7%）领先且差距不显著，分数跨度达 35 分，无任一任务被所有模型完全解出。公开 24 个任务、保留 76 个以防污染。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体评测缺少贴近真实维护场景的、专家撰写且经过严格校准的难题基准：需在庞大陌生代码库中做多文件改动，并区分"看起来对"的改动与真正可合并的修复。
AI.method: 构建 100 个人工专家任务（针对真实仓库固定 commit 的变更请求，中位 148 词；参考解中位改 471 行），配密封参考解与任务专属评分器（加权、多为可执行判据、部分给分，含 must-pass 阻塞项与 pass/fail 门槛）；每任务发布前校准：参考解得 1.0，未改动仓库与惰性改动得 0；近半数附带替代/偷懒/对抗性控制补丁用于检验评分器判别力；最终选题依据对前沿模型的难度筛选。7 个模型、每个 5 次运行、统一平台并使用各家原生工具接口，共 3,495 次计分运行。
AI.result: Opus 5.5（67.3%）与 GPT-6 Astra（63.7%）领先且差距不显著；其后为 Claude Fable 5.1（46.5%）、Gemini 3.8 Flash（40.0%）；Qwen 3.8 Max、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Grok 4.6 三者相互无显著差异（32–34%）。无任务被全部模型解出，80 个任务上无模型 5 次全得分；分数跨度 35 分；各模型中位步数 33–166，与得分关系很弱。
AI.conclusion: EC-SWE 提供了高难度、抗污染、强校准的智能体基准，显示当前前沿模型在多文件真实仓库改动上仍与"可合并"标准有明显差距，且推理步数不预测能力；公开 24 个任务及环境与结果，保留 76 个以限制污染。

title: Structured Kernel Surrogate Models for Multimodal Attribution
summary: We study the problem of cross-sample modality attribution, which involves measuring how one modality in one sample affects the learning outcome in other multimodal samples. This problem is crucial in a multimodal system because a data modality (such as a text description) may be redundant for one sample (a self-explanatory image), but the same data modality would otherwise be uniquely informative for another sample, or informative when combined with other modalities. Prior work focuses on influence estimation at the level of one sample, and it remains an open question how one should capture the interactions across both samples and modalities. To capture scenarios like the above, we propose structured kernel surrogate models, which are surrogate mappings from both samples and modalities to the prediction outcome when they are trained together. We design an algorithm, SKS, which applies kernel ridge regression with a structured, compositional kernel on the selection states of individual samples and modalities. Specifically, the kernel function multiplies kernel-based similarity scores between every pair of data modalities for one sample and a pair of two samples. Additionally, we design a gradient-based estimation algorithm to efficiently estimate the structured kernel surrogate model. We evaluate our approach on two multimodal benchmarks, spanning a range of data modalities including satellite images, road networks, text, audio, and tabular data. We find that SKS achieves $57.8$% higher correlation with the true prediction outcomes than existing methods. In downstream data selection, SKS improves the average accuracy by $1.93$% over baselines. Models with data selected by SKS have lower Hessian traces, indicating a flatter loss surface. Using SKS to select satellite images identifies road segments, where accident scenes commonly occur, as opposed to background images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨样本模态归因问题，并设计结构化核代理模型 SKS 来刻画样本与模态间交互影响。
AI.motivation: 在多模态系统中，某样本的某模态可能冗余，但在另一样本中却唯一关键，且与其他模态组合时才具信息量。已有工作只做单样本层面的影响估计，无法捕捉跨样本、跨模态的交互作用。
AI.method: 提出结构化核代理模型，将样本与模态的联合选择状态映射到预测结果；设计 SKS 算法，在各样本与各模态选择状态上使用结构化组合核做核岭回归，核函数由样本内模态对相似度与样本对相似度相乘构成；并给出基于梯度的估计算法以高效求解该代理模型。
AI.result: 在两个多模态基准（卫星图像、路网、文本、音频、表格数据）上，SKS 与真实预测结果的相关性比现有方法高 57.8%；下游数据选择任务平均准确率提升 1.93%；所选数据训练的模型 Hessian 迹更低，损失面更平坦；用于选卫星图像时可定位事故常发的路段而非背景图像。
AI.conclusion: SKS 能有效刻画跨样本与跨模态的交互影响，在归因准确性与下游数据选择上均优于现有方法，并带来更平坦的优化损失面和可解释的选择结果。

title: APS-VLA: Action-Guided and Future-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet processing dense visual tokens often incurs high inference latency. Visual token pruning offers a practical way to reduce this cost, but identifying a compact set of tokens that preserves reliable action generation remains challenging. Existing methods largely rely on static or immediate heuristic cues to estimate token importance. We introduce APS-VLA, a framework that learns visual token selection from robot demonstrations while keeping the pretrained VLA backbone frozen. A lightweight Decision Influence Estimator scores tokens conditioned on current visual observations, language instructions, and robot proprioception. Its training combines two complementary signals: action supervision matches both the full-input policy predictions and demonstrated actions, while an auxiliary visual transition objective uses demonstrated actions to predict subsequent visual features from the selected representation. At deployment, the estimator performs a single hard selection and packing step before the policy's native action-generation procedure; the auxiliary predictor is removed. Experiments with OpenVLA-OFT on LIBERO and with $π_{0.5}$ and XR-1 on RoboCasa365 demonstrate inference acceleration with modest changes in task success. Across five real-world tasks on two dual-arm platforms, APS-VLA reduces mean policy inference latency from 137.25 to 93.25 ms, achieving a $1.47\times$ speedup with an average success rate of 61%, compared with 60% for the unpruned baseline. Together, these results support APS-VLA as a modular, plug-in framework for efficient robotic control across VLA architectures, preserving the underlying policy parameters and native action-generation procedure.

AI.tldr: APS-VLA 提出一种可插拔的视觉token选择框架：在冻结预训练VLA主干的前提下，用轻量决策影响估计器基于视觉、语言和本体感受评分并选择token，兼顾动作监督与视觉转移目标，实现推理加速且成功率基本无损。
AI.motivation: VLA策略泛化能力强，但密集视觉token带来高昂推理延迟。现有视觉token剪枝方法依赖静态或即时启发式线索估计token重要性，难以选出既紧凑又保证可靠动作生成的token子集。
AI.method: 保持预训练VLA主干冻结，学习视觉token选择。轻量Decision Influence Estimator以当前视觉观测、语言指令和机器人本体感受为条件打分；训练时融合两种信号：(1) 动作监督，同时对齐全输入策略预测与示范动作；(2) 辅助视觉转移目标，用示范动作从选中表示预测后续视觉特征。部署时仅做一次硬选择与打包，移除辅助预测器，保留策略原有动作生成流程。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上用OpenVLA-OFT、在RoboCasa365上用π0.5与XR-1，均实现推理加速且任务成功率变化不大。两个双臂平台五个真实任务上，平均推理延迟由137.25 ms降至93.25 ms（1.47倍加速），平均成功率61% vs 未剪枝基线60%。
AI.conclusion: APS-VLA是模块化、可插拔的高效机器人控制框架，可跨多种VLA架构使用，在不改变底层策略参数和原生动作生成流程的情况下实现加速。

title: Before Words, Beyond Speech: Evaluating Nonverbal Social Reasoning in Early Childhood
comment: Accepted as NeurIPS 2026 Spotlight paper. Project page at \hyperlink{https://laubravo.github.io/nest_website/}{this URL}
summary: Children's earliest years are a period of intense social learning, during which meaning is built through gaze, gesture, and physical contact. Yet, this critical aspect of social interaction remains under-evaluated in multimodal video understanding, as existing benchmarks prioritize the conversation-driven interactions of adults. We address this gap with \bench ($\textbf{N}$aturalistic $\textbf{E}$arly-childhood $\textbf{S}$ocial in$\textbf{T}$eractions), the first child-centric benchmark for nonverbal social reasoning. \bench comprises \totalvids manually annotated clips ($\sim$12s) curated for diversity across naturalistic settings, cultural contexts, and developmental stages. Beyond a lack of data, targeted model improvement in this domain is hindered by coarse evaluation schemas that conflate basic perception with higher-order reasoning. To resolve this, \bench introduces a compositional schema that builds atomic interaction cues into progressive levels of social reasoning: contextual, behavioral, interpersonal, and open-ended descriptions. Extensive analysis of state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models (VLMs) reveals a stark performance collapse: despite strong contextual recognition, models exhibit substantial gaps in decoding precise behavioral and interpersonal cues. We trace these failures to specific biases, including poor consequence grounding and temporal sensitivity. Finally, we ground \bench in real-world applications by evaluating VLMs using domain adaptation strategies. Ultimately, \bench provides a rigorous testbed for advancing socially grounded artificial intelligence in early childhood. Project page: https://laubravo.github.io/nest_website/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出首个以幼儿为中心的非言语社交推理多模态基准NEST，含手工标注短视频片段，并按从感知到推理的分层模式评测，揭示当前VLM在行为与人际线索解码上的显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 幼儿早期是密集的社会学习期，意义通过注视、手势与身体接触建构，但现有多模态视频理解基准偏重成人对话驱动交互，使这一关键社会互动维度长期缺乏评测。现有评价方案又过于粗糙，混淆基础感知与高阶推理，阻碍针对性模型改进。
AI.method: 构建NEST基准：收录人工标注的约12秒片段，覆盖自然场景、文化背景和发展阶段的多样性；设计组合式评价框架，将原子交互线索逐级组织为上下文、行为、人际与开放式描述四级社交推理任务；并对先进VLM开展广泛分析，结合领域自适应策略评估真实应用。
AI.result: 实验显示VLM性能明显崩塌：尽管上下文识别较强，但在精确行为与人际线索解码上存在巨大差距；失败可归因于后果接地薄弱与时间敏感度不足等特定偏差。
AI.conclusion: NEST为推进早期幼儿社会性人工智能提供严格测试平台，强调以分层评价区分感知与推理，并指出未来需改进模型的因果接地与时间建模能力。

title: A Concept-Based Interpretable Framework for Clinical Text-based Prediction via Token-Concept Attention without Concept Supervision
summary: Objective: Concept-based interpretation has emerged as a promising approach for explaining blackbox models using human-understandable, high-level concepts. However, most existing methods require annotated concept labels to train the model to identify concepts in the input, and obtaining such annotations in clinical text is often expensive. This study aims to enable concept-based interpretation for language models without concept supervision on clinical prediction tasks. Methods: We propose a novel framework that enables concept-based interpretation without concept supervision through a tailored cross-attention bottleneck. Clinical text and the text descriptions of medical concepts are first tokenized and embedded by a pretrained language model. A cross-attention module then estimates the presence of each concept for each text token, producing concept relevance scores that capture how concepts are involved throughout the note. These scores are pooled and used in a linear prediction layer to model clinical outcomes in an interpretable manner. Results: The performance of the proposed framework was compared against blackbox models across two tasks: chest trauma severity stratification using a private dataset and an in-hospital mortality prediction task using the publicly available MIMIC-III dataset. The proposed framework achieved AUROC values within 0.02 of the corresponding blackbox models. The framework also enabled cohort- and patient-level interpretation, capturing the overall concept importance across the cohort and patient-specific concept contributions. Conclusion: Our proposed framework realizes concept-based interpretation without requiring ground-truth concept presence labels. It improves the transparency of clinical text predictions while maintaining strong performance in clinical prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需概念标注的、基于cross-attention瓶颈的概念可解释框架，用于临床文本预测，性能接近黑盒模型并支持队列与个体层面解释。
AI.motivation: 概念级可解释性依赖人工标注的概念标签来训练概念识别，而临床文本中获取此类标注成本高昂，因此希望在没有概念监督的情况下实现基于概念的解释。
AI.method: 临床文本与医学概念文本描述先经预训练语言模型分词嵌入；用cross-attention模块估计每个文本token上各概念的存在程度，得到概念相关性分数；分数池化后输入线性预测层进行可解释的临床结局建模。
AI.result: 在两个任务（私有胸部创伤严重度分层、MIMIC-III院内死亡预测）上，AUROC与对应黑盒模型差距在0.02以内；并实现队列级（整体概念重要性）与患者级（个体概念贡献）解释。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需真实概念存在标签即可实现概念级解释，在保持临床预测性能的同时提升文本预测的透明度。

title: Deterministic, Reproducible Inference in Exact Integer Arithmetic, and Verifiable Distributed Inference as Its Consequence
summary: Optimized floating-point inference is not reproducible across environments: the same model on different hardware, compilers or thread counts can produce different bits. We present tritify, an open-source runtime that executes the forward pass of real models -- decoder-only language models, Mixture-of-Experts decoders, and the Segment Anything 2.1 image/video stack -- with the entire run-time path in exact integer arithmetic; floating point is confined to offline quantization and the float reference used for verification. We make three separate claims and verify each. (1) Cross-hardware reproducibility: the integer path produces bit-identical output run to run, across CPU instruction-set architectures, and across CPU/GPU, carried by a reproducing SHA-256 of the output. (2) Decision fidelity: the integer path reproduces the float reference's decision on the models and inputs tested, with the numeric exceptions measured; per-layer fidelity through sixteen layers of OLMoE-1B-7B and of a 106-billion-parameter MoE shows no fidelity cliff. (3) Location independence: a model's computation can be split across instruction sets, CPU and GPU, and networked machines with zero effect on the output bits. GLM-4.5-Air (106,852,251,264 parameters, 427 GB of integer codes) generated its answer across three machines, none of which can hold its integer codes in RAM, bit-identically to a single-host reference. The consequence is verifiable distributed inference: an untrusted server or a fleet of devices runs the model while an open scalar oracle re-derives the exact bytes; a guarantee against a dishonest server is future work. We do not claim a per-device speed-up, bit-equality of floating-valued intermediates, or confidentiality. Code: https://github.com/pelloran-inc/tritify

AI.tldr: tritify 是一个开源推理运行时，将模型前向传播全部放到精确整数运算上（浮点只用于离线量化和校验参考），实现跨硬件、跨设备、跨机器的比特一致可复现推理，并在 1068 亿参数 MoE 上跨三台机器验证。
AI.motivation: 优化后的浮点推理在不同硬件、编译器、线程数下会产生不同比特结果，无法复现，这使得推理结果无法被独立验证，也阻碍分布式可信部署。
AI.method: 把 decoder-only LLM、MoE 解码器、SAM 2.1 图像/视频栈的前向路径整体改为精确整数算术，浮点仅限离线量化与 float 参考校验；用输出 SHA-256 做复现校验；支持将计算切分到不同指令集、CPU/GPU 和联网机器。
AI.result: (1) 整数路径逐次运行、跨 CPU 指令集、跨 CPU/GPU 输出比特一致；(2) 在测试模型与输入上复现浮点参考的决策，度量了数值例外，OLMoE-1B-7B 与 106B MoE 的十六层逐层保真无断崖；(3) GLM-4.5-Air（1068.5 亿参数、427 GB 整数码）跨三台均无法在内存中容纳其整数码的机器生成答案，与单机参考比特一致。
AI.conclusion: 实现可验证的分布式推理：不可信服务器或设备群运行模型，开放的标量 oracle 可重新推导精确字节；但不保证单设备加速、浮点中间值比特相等或机密性，防恶意服务器的保证留待未来工作。

title: XAI-Driven Confidence Estimation for OOD-Resilient Runtime Prediction
summary: Machine learning-based resource management (RM) models degrade under out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs at runtime, yet existing approaches in the literature rely on a single global error margin that is overly conservative and fails to distinguish reliablepredictions from catastrophic failures. We propose Lightweight Runtime EXplainability (LEX), the first post-hoc XAI framework for input-specific runtime confidence estimation in ML-based RM. LEX clusters the embeddings of the training input space using a Gaussian Mixture Model and associates per-cluster prediction error bounds to input samples, enabling fine-grained runtime confidence signals without retraining. Evaluated on a state-of-the-art LSTM-based IPS forecasting model on Intel Alder Lake, across 34 benchmark applications, LEX achieves ~94% containment on unseen workloads and produces ~17% tighter per-input confidence bounds than global baselines. With its negligible runtime overhead, LEX advances the field by providing explainable and reliable input-specific confidence signals of ML predictions, thereby making ML-based resource management resilient to OOD at runtime.

AI.tldr: 提出首个事后XAI框架LEX，用GMM对训练embedding聚类并为每类分配误差界，实现ML资源管理的输入级运行时置信度估计。
AI.motivation: ML资源管理模型在运行时遇到分布外(OOD)输入会性能退化，现有方法仅用单一全局误差裕度，过于保守且无法区分可靠预测与灾难性失败。
AI.method: LEX为post-hoc、无需重训练框架：对训练输入空间embedding用高斯混合模型(GMM)聚类，并将每簇预测误差界关联到对应输入样本，输出细粒度运行时置信信号。
AI.result: 在Intel Alder Lake上基于SOTA LSTM IPS预测模型、34个基准应用评估：未见负载上约94%误差包含率，置信界比全局基线紧约17%，运行时开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: LEX提供可解释、可靠的输入级置信信号，使ML资源管理在运行时对OOD更具韧性。

title: Trust, but verify, audit and attribute: a human-in-the-loop framework for checking AI-produced research results
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Skill files and run record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24051280
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems now produce research results in bulk: in October 2026 a single laboratory released more than 700 AI-generated mathematics manuscripts, only part of them with machine-checked proofs. Such volumes will be checked mostly by AI agents that call specialised software. A passing check certifies only the artefact that was checked. For proofs translated into the proof assistant Lean, it has been shown that this artefact may state something other than the author's text, and that deciding whether a translation is faithful is undecidable in general. The human researcher therefore stays in the loop, and human and AI contributions must be recorded. We propose a domain-independent, human-in-the-loop framework for checking AI-produced results. Validated, agent-usable tools with different grounds of trust check the results; a fidelity audit asks whether each check addressed the claim as stated; the human decides at fixed points; and a dialog report attributes the work to the human and to the AI. We describe two automatic implementations of the tool layer, for mathematics (Wolfram Language, MATLAB, Lean) and statistics (Python and R), and run the mathematical one on a two-claim example. An ambiguous claim was split into two readings, one refuted and one proved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个领域无关的人在环（human-in-the-loop）框架，用于核查AI生成的研究成果：由可信工具层做验证、由保真审计确认检查是否针对作者原意、由人类在固定节点决策，并由对话报告归属人机贡献。
AI.motivation: AI已能批量产出研究结果（如单一实验室发布700多篇AI数学手稿），而自动检查只认证被检查的工件本身；Lean翻译可能偏离作者原文，且判断翻译是否忠实一般不可判定。因此人类必须留在环中，人机贡献也须被记录。
AI.method: 提出领域无关的人在环核查框架，包含四部分：(1) 经过验证、可由智能体调用且具不同信任基础的工具层；(2) 保真审计，判断每项检查是否针对所陈述的命题；(3) 人类在固定检查点做决策；(4) 对话式报告，归属人类与AI的贡献。并给出工具层的两个自动实现：数学（Wolfram Language、MATLAB、Lean）与统计（Python、R）。
AI.result: 在数学实现上运行了一个含两项命题的示例：一个歧义命题被拆为两种解读，其中一种被反驳，另一种被证明。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将工具验证、保真审计、人类决策与贡献归属结合，可在数学与统计场景下自动实现，并能处理歧义命题，为AI批量产出结果的可靠核查提供可操作路径。

title: Rethinking Evaluation for Video Capsule Endoscopy: Validation Protocol, Source-Video Diversity, and Cross-Dataset Shift
summary: Automated video capsule endoscopy (VCE) classification remains challenging due to severe class imbalance, limited source-video diversity, and variations in image appearance across datasets. Although deep learning models have demonstrated promising performance on established benchmarks, their reliability under different validation protocols and external dataset shift remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce DMSNet, a deformable adaptive multi-scale edge-guided attention network integrating adaptive multi-scale feature fusion, deformable lesion refinement, edge-guided attention, and sparse feature selection. We benchmark DMSNet against 18 representative convolutional, transformer-based, and pretrained vision architectures on Kvasir-Capsule under random frame-level and source-video-disjoint validation protocols. We further identify source-video overlap between the original training and test splits and evaluate model performance on both the complete test set and a source-video-disjoint subset. Under random frame-level validation, DMSNet achieves an MCC of 0.442 $\pm$ 0.020 on complete test set and 0.456 $\pm$ 0.037 on the source-video-disjoint subset. On the external CV2024 dataset, ConvNeXt-Tiny achieves the highest MCC of 0.207, while performance degrades substantially across architectures relative to in-domain evaluation. We further investigate source-video diversity using a per-class cap of 200 training frames. With the total training-set size held fixed, increasing the maximum source-video coverage from four to eight improves MCC for 17 of 19 evaluated architectures. Overall, these findings demonstrate that model rankings and classification performance depend substantially on evaluation protocol, training-source diversity, and cross-dataset shift, emphasizing the need for source-aware validation and rigorous external evaluation of VCE classification systems.

AI.tldr: 提出DMSNet（可变形自适应多尺度边缘引导注意力网络），并在Kvasir-Capsule上以随机帧级与源视频不相交协议基准测试19种架构，揭示评估协议、源视频多样性与跨数据集偏移对VCE分类性能及模型排名的影响。
AI.motivation: 自动化视频胶囊内镜（VCE）分类面临严重类别不平衡、源视频多样性有限、跨数据集图像外观差异等问题；现有深度学习模型虽在公开基准上表现良好，但其在不同验证协议和外部数据集偏移下的可靠性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出DMSNet，集成自适应多尺度特征融合、可变形病灶细化、边缘引导注意力和稀疏特征选择；与18种代表性卷积、Transformer及预训练视觉架构在Kvasir-Capsule上对比，采用随机帧级与源视频不相交两种验证协议；识别原始训练/测试划分间的源视频重叠，在完整测试集与源视频不相交子集上分别评估；用每类200帧上限的设定研究源视频多样性（最大覆盖从4增至8）。
AI.result: 随机帧级验证下DMSNet的MCC为0.442±0.020（完整测试集）和0.456±0.037（源视频不相交子集）；外部CV2024数据集上ConvNeXt-Tiny取得最高MCC 0.207，各架构相对域内评估性能显著下降；训练集总规模固定时，最大源视频覆盖从4增至8使19种架构中17种的MCC提升。
AI.conclusion: 模型排名与分类性能显著依赖评估协议、训练源视频多样性和跨数据集偏移，强调VCE分类系统需要源感知验证与严格的外部评估。

title: Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents
comment: Accepted to KDD 2026, Jeju, Korea. 9 pages, 3 figures
summary: Deploying LLM-based analytics agents in enterprise settings requires evaluation frameworks that can reliably detect failures across complex, multi-tool workflows. We present a three-phase comparative study of three evaluation frameworks, each representing a distinct evaluation paradigm (trace-based LLM judging, text-only LLM judging with red-teaming, and deterministic heuristics), applied to two analytics agents in a controlled research setting using frozen execution traces. Phase 1 quantifies evaluation harness stability through repeated measurements, finding that 97% of configurations meet the stability threshold and that stability patterns are agent-independent. Phase 2 measures known risk detection on 72 ground-truth test cases, where the trace-based framework achieves the best precision-recall balance (F1=0.90) while text-only evaluation matches on recall but generates 5x more false alarms. Phase 3 evaluates unknown risk discovery, uncovering 24 novel failures with zero overlap between functional testing and security red-teaming. Our results demonstrate that (1) the information available to the evaluation harness determines evaluation quality, (2) functional and security evaluation are complementary, and (3) LLM-based evaluation harnesses surface subtle errors that human reviewers miss. We recommend a two-framework strategy: trace-based evaluation for functional assessment and adversarial red-teaming for security validation.

AI.tldr: 本文对三种LLM分析代理评测框架（基于轨迹的LLM评判、文本-only红队评测、确定性启发式）进行三阶段对比研究，发现轨迹评测F1=0.90最优，并提出功能评测+安全红队的双框架策略。
AI.motivation: 企业部署LLM分析代理需要能可靠检测复杂多工具工作流失败的评测框架，但不同评测范式孰优孰劣缺乏系统对比。
AI.method: 在受控研究环境中，使用冻结执行轨迹，对两个分析代理应用三种评测框架（各代表一种范式），分三阶段：1）重复测量量化评测框架稳定性；2）在72个真实标注测试用例上测已知风险检测（精确率/召回率）；3）评估未知风险发现能力（功能测试与安全红队的覆盖差异）。
AI.result: 97%配置满足稳定性阈值且稳定性与代理无关；轨迹框架F1=0.90最佳，文本评测召回相同但误报多5倍；第三阶段发现24个新失败，功能测试与安全红队零重叠。
AI.conclusion: 评测框架可获取的信息决定评测质量；功能评测与安全评测互补；LLM评测框架能发现人类审查者遗漏的细微错误。建议采用双框架策略：轨迹评测做功能评估，对抗性红队做安全验证。

title: Audited Gradients, Anchored Policies: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Flow Control
comment: 46 pages, 16 figures, 12 tables. Code and result files: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/joint_mbrl-D1EC/
summary: Feedback controllers for flows are expensive to design, since each candidate must be evaluated with a high-fidelity solver. Differentiable surrogates reduce that cost, but they also introduce a failure mode that prediction error cannot detect. Policy optimization uses the derivative of the objective with respect to the action, which we call the action gradient and which can be computed either through the surrogate or through the high-fidelity solver. Optimization through the surrogate uses only its action gradient, and a surrogate can follow the flow trajectory closely while misestimating this derivative. The surrogate action gradient is compared against a central finite-difference estimate from the high-fidelity solver on held-out states, under acceptance criteria fixed before the comparison, and we call that comparison an audit. A low-dimensional feedback law is then fitted to the surrogate action gradient when the surrogate passes the audit, and to the solver estimate when it does not. This law initializes a neural policy, and a quadratic penalty holds the policy near it during optimization. The proposed approach is validated on four test cases. The resulting controllers outperform or match a model-free baseline, while using 3 to 156 times fewer high-fidelity solver interactions across the four test cases. One surrogate predicts the objective at correlation 0.9996 but its action gradient at only 0.459, so prediction accuracy does not identify a usable surrogate. Another surrogate, whose action gradient agrees with the solver estimate at correlation 0.996, makes the objective 0.52% worse when the policy is optimized through it without the anchor penalty, so an accurate gradient alone does not provide a working controller. Finally, a surrogate that passes the audit at one fixed action fails it around the actions the deployed controller applies, so a pass is local.

AI.tldr: 提出"审计"机制：用高保真中心差分估计检验代理模型的action gradient，通过则拟合低维反馈律并作为神经策略锚点，显著降低高保真求解器调用次数。
AI.motivation: 流场反馈控制器设计昂贵，每次候选都需高保真求解器评估；可微代理模型虽降本，但存在预测误差无法察觉的失效模式——代理能贴合轨迹却错误估计目标对动作的导数(action gradient)。
AI.method: 在留出状态上，按预先固定的验收标准，将代理的action gradient与高保真求解器的中心有限差分估计做对比(即"审计")。审计通过则用代理梯度拟合低维反馈律，不通过则用求解器估计拟合；该反馈律初始化神经策略，并在优化中用二次惩罚将策略约束在其附近。
AI.result: 四个测试案例中，所得控制器优于或匹配无模型基线，高保真求解器交互减少3–156倍。一代理目标预测相关性0.9996但梯度相关性仅0.459；另一梯度相关性0.996的代理若不加锚定惩罚直接优化，目标反而变差0.52%；某代理在单一固定动作上通过审计，却在部署控制器的实际动作附近未通过。
AI.conclusion: 预测精度不能识别可用代理，梯度准确也不足以得到可用控制器；审计必须覆盖部署动作区域，且审计结果具有局部性。反馈律锚定+二次惩罚的组合是保证策略优化可靠性的关键。

title: Adaptive Residual Quantization for Memory-Efficient Temporal Action Segmentation
summary: Temporal action segmentation (TAS) is commonly trained on large banks of pre-extracted frame features, but storing and replaying those features becomes a practical bottleneck for long-form video, especially in incremental TAS where past-task data must remain available to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Recent TAS replay and condensation methods reduce this burden, but they rely on dense frame-wise annotations and allocate storage through fixed segment-level structures, limiting their flexibility for long procedural videos whose frame complexity varies substantially over time. We introduce Adaptive Residual-Quantized Variational AutoEncoder (ARQ-VAE), a compact and label-free memory representation for TAS features that learns a discrete residual quantization of frame-level video features and then adaptively truncates the residual chain on a per-frame basis, retaining only the residual prefix that best reconstructs each frame feature. This yields a practical compact feature memory that does not depend on frame-wise labels and can therefore support multiple TAS settings with the same stored representation, while a lightweight fine-tuning stage further improves reconstruction quality for the truncated codes that are actually retained. Across standard TAS benchmarks, ARQ-VAE achieves a substantially improved storage-performance trade-off over prior replay and condensation baselines. On Breakfast, our final representation reduces training-set storage from 28 GB for the original I3D feature bank to 10 MB while retaining strong downstream segmentation performance; with ASFormer, it achieves 71.5 Edit and 51.2 F1@50 in the supervised setting. We further show that the same label-free memory remains effective for incremental and unsupervised TAS. We position ARQ-VAE as a practical memory representation for TAS and a promising direction for broader dataset condensation applications.

AI.tldr: 提出ARQ-VAE，一种无标签、紧凑的时序动作分割特征记忆表示：对帧级特征做离散残差量化并按帧自适应截断残差链，在Breakfast上把训练集存储从28GB降到10MB，仍保持强分割性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频TAS中存储/回放大量预提取帧特征成为瓶颈，增量TAS尤甚（需保留旧任务数据以防灾难性遗忘）。现有replay与condensation方法依赖稠密帧级标注，且用固定段级结构分配存储，难以适应帧复杂度随时间变化的长过程视频。
AI.method: ARQ-VAE学习帧级特征的离散残差量化，再逐帧自适应截断残差链，仅保留能最好重建该帧特征的残差前缀，从而得到不依赖帧级标签的紧凑特征记忆（同一表示可服务多种TAS设定）；并加入轻量微调阶段，提升实际保留的截断码的重建质量。
AI.result: 在标准TAS基准上，存储-性能权衡显著优于既有replay与condensation基线。Breakfast上训练集存储由原始I3D特征库28GB降至10MB仍保持强下游性能；配合ASFormer在监督设定下达到71.5 Edit、51.2 F1@50。同一无标签记忆在增量与无监督TAS中同样有效。
AI.conclusion: ARQ-VAE可作为TAS的实用记忆表示，并为更广泛的数据集condensation应用提供有前景的方向。

title: Compute the Interactions, Not the Attributes: What a Fact Layer Must Supply in the Chinese Sexagenary System
summary: Language-model systems in rule-governed domains often pair the model with a deterministic fact layer, but which facts that layer should supply is rarely measured. We measure it in the Chinese sexagenary system underlying BaZi chart analysis, where every fact has one table-checkable value: 682 items over twelve fact categories and 160 transit--natal collision items, posed closed-book, with the reference table, and with computed facts at increasing levels. In eleven open-weight models answering directly, errors concentrate where attributes must be combined: none gets more than 4\% of sexagenary days or 1\% of collisions right. Static attributes have no consistent effect, and the complete relation list leaves most direct-answering models near zero although it contains the answer. A query-filtered layer (exploratory) raises Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B to 78--92\% and four further models to 96--100\%. Three proprietary reasoning models compute 68--95\% of collisions unaided. On chess positions, under predictions locked in advance, attributes again do not substitute for relations and listed distractors are misattributed. The fact layer must supply computed interactions; how they are presented depends on the model and the domain.

AI.tldr: 该文系统测量了规则化领域（干支/BaZi与chess）中"事实层"应向语言模型提供哪些事实：需提供计算出的交互关系，而非静态属性或完整关系列表；呈现方式取决于模型与领域。
AI.motivation: 规则化领域的语言模型系统常搭配确定性事实层，但应提供哪些事实很少被测量，导致事实层设计缺乏依据。
AI.method: 以干支体系为基准构建682项、12类事实与160项transit–natal碰撞题，采用闭卷、附参考表、以及逐级提供计算事实三种设置测试11个开放权重模型；并在预先锁定预测的条件下于chess局面复现考察属性与关系的作用。
AI.result: 直接作答的11个开放模型中，无模型在干支日上超过4%、碰撞题上超过1%正确；静态属性无一致作用，完整关系列表仍使多数模型接近零分。查询过滤式事实层（探索性）将Qwen3-8B/32B提升至78–92%，另四个模型达96–100%；三个专有推理模型单独计算碰撞达68–95%。chess上属性不能替代关系，列出的干扰项被错误归因。
AI.conclusion: 事实层必须提供计算出的交互结果；呈现方式需按模型与领域适配，静态属性与原始关系列表不足以支撑推理。

title: Wrong the Same Way: Cross-Prompt Sharing Both Suppresses and Amplifies Reward Hacking in RLVR
comment: Accepted at the Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Two accounts of how reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) interacts with an imperfect verifier coexist: in one, reward hacking is inherited from the base model; in the other, RL amplifies it. We study both in a controlled environment small enough to compute the entire response distribution exactly. We vary the universality of a leak, or the fraction of prompts that accept the same wrong response, and the verifier's static false-positive rate. At its KL-regularized optimum, RLVR acts as a filter that reweights the accepted set without altering its composition, so the hack rate is inherited exactly. Taking that as a null model, a known decomposition writes the drift from it as a sum over prompts of covariances between reward and the empirical tangent kernel. The terms from other prompts vanish without parameter sharing. With sharing, every prompt that accepts a wrong answer pushes it up and every prompt that rejects it pushes it down through the baseline, in proportion to the model's probability of producing it there. A shared-parameter policy thus drives a leak that few prompts accept below the base rate and amplifies one that most prompts accept. At every convergent learning rate under Adam, SGD, and sampled GRPO, hacking ends higher at high universality than at low, but whether either end crosses the base rate depends on the step size. Independent per-prompt copies remove the dependence. The direction of this push depends on neither the verifier's error rate nor universality alone, but on how much of the model's kernel-weighted probability of a wrong answer falls on prompts that accept it, which frozen base model controls support. Verifier fixes should target the mistakes the model repeats across prompts: two patches that remove equally many errors differ by up to 38 points of true accuracy. We propose this alignment as a hypothesis for why earlier studies disagree.

AI.tldr: 该论文在可控小环境中精确计算全部响应分布，研究RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）与不完美验证器的交互。发现KL正则最优下RLVR只是对接受集合重加权的过滤器，hack率继承自基座模型；但参数共享使跨提示词耦合，导致高普遍性泄漏被放大、低普遍性泄漏被压低。
AI.motivation: 文献中关于RLVR与不完美验证器交互存在两种并存观点：一种认为reward hacking继承自基座模型，另一种认为RL会放大它。作者希望用可控、可精确计算的环境调和这一分歧，并为验证器修复提供指导。
AI.method: 构建小到可精确计算整个响应分布的环境，改变泄漏的普遍性（接受同一错误响应的提示词比例）和验证器静态假阳性率。以KL正则最优作为零模型，用奖励与经验切线核协方差的分解刻画漂移；对比无参数共享与有参数共享情形，并在Adam、SGD、采样GRPO下测试不同学习率与步长。
AI.result: 无参数共享时无关提示词项消失，hack率精确继承。有参数共享时，接受错误答案的提示词通过baseline将其推高、拒绝的推低，按模型在该处产出概率加权：共享参数策略把少数提示词接受的泄漏压到基率以下、把多数提示词接受的泄漏放大。在Adam/SGD/采样GRPO下各收敛学习率上，高普遍性最终hack率高于低普遍性，但是否越过基率取决于步长；独立逐提示词副本可消除该依赖。推动方向取决于模型错误答案的核加权概率落在接受提示词上的比例（由冻结基座模型决定），而非仅取决于验证器错误率或普遍性。两个移除同等错误数的补丁最多相差38个百分点的真实准确率。
AI.conclusion: 提出该"对齐"机制作为解释既往研究结论分歧的假设：验证器修复应针对模型跨提示词重复犯的错误，而非仅减少错误数量；泄漏的放大或抑制取决于参数共享下核加权概率在接受提示词上的分布。

title: Building World Models from Intrinsic Motivation
summary: In the absence of extrinsic rewards or task supervision, human behavior is guided by intrinsic motivation---neural signals that drive curiosity, creativity, play, and other essential facets of intelligence. Intrinsic motivation plays an important developmental role in building robust world models that enable generalization and adaptation. Yet existing studies leave open how a broad range of intrinsic motivations interacts with world-model representation learning to support downstream control. This limits our understanding of which intrinsically collected experiences build reusable models. To address these gaps, we integrate 24 intrinsic objectives, including established methods and explicit variants spanning curiosity, entropy, and competency, into a common model-based reinforcement learning framework. We evaluate the world models they build through zero-shot, few-shot, and multi-task control in locomotion, manipulation, and open-ended gaming environments, using three representation-learning strategies: observation reconstruction, latent prediction, and redundancy reduction. Curiosity-driven exploration with observation reconstruction yields the strongest aggregate family profile, although the best individual pairing depends on the experiment. In compositional vision-based tasks, intrinsic motivation derived from both episodic and lifelong novelty---providing a complementary memory to the world model's generic recurrent state---achieves the best zero-shot transfer and few-shot adaptation. These findings motivate designing intrinsic motivation and representation learning jointly. Our results demonstrate world models as a powerful tool for measuring the quality of intrinsically motivated experience, and positions intrinsic motivation as a key ingredient for building world models autonomously.

AI.tldr: 该文将24种内在动机目标统一集成到基于模型的强化学习框架中，系统研究不同内在动机与世界模型表示学习策略的交互作用，发现好奇心驱动结合观测重建整体表现最佳，且结合片段级与终身新颖性的内在动机能带来最好的零样本迁移和少样本适应。
AI.motivation: 缺乏外部奖励与任务监督时，人类行为由好奇心、创造力、游戏等内在动机驱动，内在动机对构建可泛化、可适应的世界模型至关重要。然而现有研究尚未厘清：广泛的内在动机如何与世界模型表示学习交互以支持下游控制，以及哪些内在动机收集的经验能构建可复用模型。
AI.method: 作者在统一的基于模型的强化学习框架中集成24种内在动机目标（涵盖已确立方法及显式变体，涉及好奇心、熵、胜任力三类），并结合三种表示学习策略（观测重建、潜空间预测、冗余消减）构建世界模型。
AI.result: 通过零样本、少样本和多任务控制在移动、操作、开放式游戏环境中评估：好奇心驱动探索+观测重建在整体家族层面表现最佳，但最佳个体组合依实验而定；在组合式视觉任务中，同时利用片段级和终身新颖性的内在动机（为世界模型通用循环状态提供互补记忆）取得最佳零样本迁移与少样本适应。
AI.conclusion: 研究呼吁联合设计内在动机与表示学习；世界模型可用于衡量内在动机经验的质量，并将内在动机定位为自主构建世界模型的关键要素。

title: RetinexGS: Retinex-Inspired Gaussian Splatting for Low-Light RAW Reconstruction
summary: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipelines struggle with severely underexposed images, producing unstable colors, floating artifacts, and incomplete reconstructions in dark regions. To better account for noise in these low-light observations, RAW images offer a natural basis for noise-aware reconstruction by preserving linear sensor measurements and providing access to noise metadata. We present RetinexGS, a RAW-domain 3DGS framework that combines Retinex-inspired appearance modeling with sensor-informed optimization for low-light novel-view synthesis. We factorize each Gaussian's color into a view-independent base color and a shared, position- and view-dependent modulation field, regularizing the two components separately to constrain appearance learning from noisy observations. We use DNG noise metadata to weight the reconstruction loss for signal-dependent noise, while distortion-aware rendering avoids spatially resampling RAW targets. To address sparse geometry in dark regions, we introduce depth-guided initialization. We evaluate RetinexGS on three public RawNeRF scenes and two custom-captured low-light RAW scenes. With all methods trained on the same RAW inputs for each scene, RetinexGS outperforms LE3D and RawNeRF in mean sRGB PSNR by 2.18 dB and 2.71 dB respectively, across the five scenes, while supporting real-time novel-view rendering.

AI.tldr: RetinexGS：面向RAW域低光照新视角合成的3DGS框架，结合Retinex式外观分解与传感器噪声感知优化，在5个场景上以sRGB PSNR较LE3D/RawNeRF提升2.18/2.71 dB并保持实时渲染。
AI.motivation: 标准3DGS在严重欠曝图像下表现不佳，产生颜色不稳定、漂浮伪影和暗区重建不完整；RAW图像保留线性传感器测量并提供噪声元数据，更适合噪声感知重建。
AI.method: 将每个高斯颜色分解为视角无关基色与共享的位置/视角相关调制场，分别正则化；利用DNG噪声元数据为信号相关噪声加权重建损失；采用畸变感知渲染避免对RAW目标做空间重采样；并用深度引导初始化缓解暗区几何稀疏。
AI.result: 在3个公开RawNeRF场景和2个自采集低光RAW场景上（所有方法使用相同RAW输入训练），RetinexGS的sRGB PSNR平均超越LE3D 2.18 dB、超越RawNeRF 2.71 dB，并支持实时新视角渲染。
AI.conclusion: RAW域结合Retinex式外观建模与传感器噪声建模可显著提升低光新视角合成的稳定性与质量，同时保持实时性。

title: One Byte, One Token: Byteifying a 27B Hybrid-Attention LLM with Self-Generated Data
comment: Full text in English followed by the full text in Chinese. 39 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code and task suite: https://huggingface.co/datasets/leiwhere/ld3-byte-eval
summary: Byte-level BPE fragments Chinese text (for Qwen3.8 on Chinese Wikipedia, 3.84 bytes per token on average; 64% of tokens are single characters) and hides spelling from the model. We ask whether an already-trained 27B subword model can be converted directly into a pure byte-level model (one byte, one token), without a patching structure or a local encoder, while keeping most of its ability. Starting from Qwen3.8-27B (48 Gated DeltaNet layers + 16 full-attention layers), we shrink the vocabulary from 248,320 to 384 entries (the 256 byte symbols already in the BPE vocabulary plus special ids), leave every other weight untouched, and continue training in a two-stage curriculum (encoding first, then reading) on 4.77 GB of supervised bytes: all dialogue/behavioral supervision is generated on-policy by the original model itself (character dictionary, word dictionary, general dialogue, coding sessions), and knowledge reading uses encyclopedia text (54% of supervised bytes). Training takes 178.6 h on 8xH200. On the same GPU and serving stack, the byte model's gap to the original falls within the paired bootstrap interval on MATH-500, HumanEval+, MMLU-Pro and non-thinking GSM8K, and it loses 4-6 points on C-Eval, thinking-mode GSM8K and non-thinking IFEval. Without thinking it leads on every character-level task (CUTE 75.2 -> 84.0, EXECUTE-zho 81.6 -> 93.9, our Chinese character suite 54.4 -> 64.0), but lookup knowledge about Chinese characters such as pronunciation and stroke count drops, and thinking does not recover it. The cost is throughput: per-step speed is identical, but each step yields 3-5x less output; Chinese characters per second is about 1/4 of the original, and prefill at 64K bytes is 6.5x slower. We also document four byte-model failure modes (greedy runaway, sampling breaking UTF-8, ineffective penalty terms on a small vocabulary, repetition) and their fixes.

AI.tldr: 将一个已训练的 27B 子词模型（Qwen3.8-27B）通过缩减词表到 384 项并两阶段继续训练，直接转换为纯字节级模型，保留大部分能力但吞吐大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 字节级 BPE 会切碎中文（Qwen3.8 在中文维基上平均 3.84 字节/token，64% 的 token 是单字符），使模型看不到拼写信息。作者想验证已训练好的大规模子词模型能否不经补丁结构或局部编码器，直接转成"一字节一 token"的纯字节模型并保住大部分能力。
AI.method: 从 Qwen3.8-27B（48 层 Gated DeltaNet + 16 层全注意力）出发，把词表从 248,320 缩到 384（256 个字节符号加特殊 id），其余权重不变，在 4.77 GB 监督字节上做两阶段课程（先编码后阅读）继续训练。数据中对话/行为监督全部由原模型 on-policy 生成（字词典、词词典、通用对话、编码会话），知识阅读用百科文本（占监督字节 54%）。8×H200 训练 178.6 小时。
AI.result: 同等 GPU 与 serving 栈下，字节模型在 MATH-500、HumanEval+、MMLU-Pro、非思考 GSM8K 上与原始模型的差距落在配对 bootstrap 区间内；在 C-Eval、思考模式 GSM8K、非思考 IFEval 上掉 4–6 分。无思考时所有字符级任务领先（CUTE 75.2→84.0，EXECUTE-zho 81.6→93.9，自建中文字符套件 54.4→64.0），但汉字读音、笔画数等查表知识下降且思考模式无法恢复。吞吐代价大：每步速度相同但每步输出少 3–5 倍，中文字符/秒约原来的 1/4，64K 字节 prefill 慢 6.5 倍。另记录四种字节模型失效模式（贪婪失控、采样破坏 UTF-8、小词表惩罚项失效、重复）及修复方法。
AI.conclusion: 纯字节化改造在保留通用能力上基本可行，且显著提升字符级任务表现，但存在汉字字形/读音查表知识损失和严重吞吐代价；该工作还给出四类失效模式及其修复方案。

title: GigaEdge Spench: An SDK for Practical Streaming Speech Enhancement
summary: We present GigaEdge Spench, an open-source SDK for streaming speech enhancement on CPU servers, mobile devices, and in browsers. Applications can build enhancement channels from neural denoising, normalization and dynamics blocks, sample-rate conversion, and acoustic echo cancellation where supported. These stages can be combined, while normalization can also run without a neural model. The release includes an 8 kHz INT8 denoiser and discriminative and hybrid 48 kHz FP32 models. A shared C++ core supports ONNX Runtime and TensorFlow Lite through native interfaces, Android and iOS SDKs, and WebAssembly integration. Independent stream contexts share model resources, and consecutive frames from one stream can be processed in a single inference call. We evaluate the released models on EARS-WHAM v2 and compare their quality and processing costs with RNNoise and DPDFNet2. All tested native and Web configurations process files faster than real time, although larger chunks require more time to collect input. We also measure how many streams a shared model can process on a CPU. Our contribution is a configurable deployment system and an experimental study of how model choice, chunk size, and execution environment affect its use. All reported SDK timing uses ONNX Runtime. Index Terms: speech enhancement, streaming inference, cross-platform deployment, temporal frame grouping, computational efficiency

AI.tldr: GigaEdge Spench：一个开源流式语音增强SDK，可在CPU服务器、移动端和浏览器上部署，由神经降噪、归一化、动态处理、重采样和回声消除等模块组合成增强通道，并附实验研究比较模型、分块大小与运行环境的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有语音增强模型多为研究导向，缺乏跨平台（服务器/移动/浏览器）可配置的流式部署系统；同时部署中模型选择、分块大小、执行环境如何影响质量与计算成本缺少系统性的实证研究。
AI.method: 提出开源SDK GigaEdge Spench：可由神经降噪、归一化和动态处理模块、采样率转换、声学回声消除（若支持）构建增强通道，归一化也可不依赖神经模型运行。发布8 kHz INT8降噪器与48 kHz FP32判别式/混合模型；共享C++核心通过原生接口支持ONNX Runtime和TensorFlow Lite，并提供Android/iOS SDK与WebAssembly集成；独立流上下文共享模型资源，同一流的连续帧可在单次推理中处理。在EARS-WHAM v2上与RNNoise、DPDFNet2对比质量与处理成本，并测量单CPU上共享模型可处理的并发流数。
AI.result: 所有测试的原生与Web配置处理文件均快于实时，但较大分块需要更长时间收集输入；给出了在EARS-WHAM v2上相对RNNoise和DPDFNet2的质量与计算成本比较，并测得单CPU共享模型可承载的并发流数。所有SDK计时均基于ONNX Runtime。
AI.conclusion: 贡献是一个可配置的部署系统及其实验研究，揭示模型选择、分块大小与执行环境对实际使用的影响，为跨平台流式语音增强部署提供实践参考。

title: Domain adaptation of a video Foundation model for Heart Failure Diagnosis from Echocardiography
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, accepted and presented at Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC 2026)
summary: The rapid advancement of foundation models has transformed computer vision, yet their adaptation to medical imaging, particularly purpose built foundation models for spatio temporal echocardiography videos, remains limited. In this work, we explore the feasibility of fine tuning a pretrained foundation model for video (TimeSformer) for automated diagnosis of reduced ejection fraction heart failure (HFrEF) from apical four chamber videos. The model is finetuned on the publicly available RVENet A4C dataset with a phase aware clip generation strategy that captures complementary systolic and diastolic dynamics. We employ divided space time attention, layer wise learning rate decay, and multi clip inference to enhance robustness under limited data. Experimental results show that full fine tuning of the proposed model outperforms classifier only tuning and a 3D CNN baseline. These findings highlight the potential of leveraging foundation video models for echocardiography based heart failure diagnosis and motivates further domain adaptation studies in medical imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文探索将视频基础模型TimeSformer微调用于超声心动图（A4C视频）自动诊断射血分数降低型心力衰竭（HFrEF），实验表明全量微调优于仅分类头微调和3D CNN基线。
AI.motivation: 基础模型虽推动了计算机视觉发展，但在医学影像尤其是针对时空超声心动图视频的专用基础模型仍然有限，因此需要验证能否借助通用视频基础模型完成心脏病自动诊断。
AI.method: 在公开的RVENet A4C数据集上微调预训练TimeSformer：采用相位感知的片段生成策略以同时捕捉收缩期与舒张期动态；使用分离时空注意力、逐层学习率衰减和多片段推理以提升小数据下的鲁棒性；并与仅分类头微调、3D CNN基线对比。
AI.result: 全量微调所提模型在实验中的表现优于仅分类头微调和3D CNN基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明利用视频基础模型进行基于超声心动图的心衰诊断具有潜力，并有必要进一步开展医学影像领域的域适应研究。

title: Post-OCR Correction of Mixed-Script Uzbek Text: Byte-Level ByT5 with an Empirical Homoglyph Noise Matrix
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the 10th International Conference on Future Networks and Distributed Systems (ICFNDS 2026), ACM ICPS. Code: https://github.com/OybekNarzullaev/byt5-uzbek-postocr
summary: In Uzbek official and technical documents, a large share of OCR errors is caused not by poor image quality but by characters that are visually identical across the two alphabets in use. Because the script transition is still under way, Cyrillic and Latin appear on the same page and often within a single sentence, and in our measurements the density of homoglyph errors on such pages is close to five times higher than in single-script text. We study this problem in a setting where the corpus of engineering-geological and ICT infrastructure reports may not leave the organisation, so every stage was executed on local hardware. The proposed system combines a byte-level ByT5 model with a noise generator whose sampling weights are estimated from 359 manually classified error events, together with a Levenshtein-bounded conservative decoding rule. On a Gold set of 5,204 line pairs it lowers the character error rate from 0.0578 to 0.0369, restores 91.3% of the homoglyphs and introduces only 84 new errors.

AI.tldr: 提出本地部署的ByT5纠错系统，针对乌兹别克语西里尔/拉丁混排中的同形字OCR错误，将CER从0.0578降至0.0369。
AI.motivation: 乌兹别克语正处文字转写期，官方与技术文档中常同页甚至同句混用西里尔与拉丁字母，二者存在大量视觉相同的字符，导致同形字OCR错误密度约为单文种文本的5倍；且工程地质与ICT报告语料不得外传，需全流程本地化处理。
AI.method: 构建字节级ByT5纠错模型，配合基于359个人工标注错误事件估计采样权重的噪声生成器，并采用Levenshtein距离约束的保守解码规则，所有环节在本地硬件上完成。
AI.result: 在5,204对文本行的Gold集上，字符错误率由0.0578降至0.0369，恢复91.3%的同形字错误，仅引入84个新错误。
AI.conclusion: 针对多文种同形字的建模与保守解码可在保护数据隐私的本地环境中显著降低乌兹别克语技术文档的OCR错误，并保持较低的过纠正风险。

title: Domain-Routed Delta Optimization for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation assigns each sample a domain teacher but typically updates shared student parameters. We introduce Domain-Routed Delta Optimization (DRD-MOPD), which specifies which parameter components each domain's samples update. The student is the sum of a frozen base and trainable components initialized from expert-minus-base weights. All components participate in every forward pass; four update modes define the correspondence between sample domains and components, each with independent optimizer states. We analyze these update rules and measure retention of the original expert geometry through angles, projection coefficients, and energy. Prior work such as Open-MOPD distills directly from the base model; 97.02% of its released final checkpoint's increment energy lies outside the span of the original expert directions. In comparison, our Own checkpoint after 20 updates retains coefficients near one along each component's original direction and pairwise angles ranging from 88.04 to 92.41 degrees; its exported BF16 student's increment has 4.90% outside energy, versus 10.52% for the sum of saved FP32 components. The same checkpoint achieves a 32.72% macro score across six benchmarks, compared with 32.44% for its initial task-arithmetic merge. These measurements describe geometry and capability at the evaluated training stages and settings.

AI.tldr: 提出DRD-MOPD，让不同领域样本按规则更新指定参数组件，以保持专家几何并维持性能。
AI.motivation: 多教师on-policy蒸馏通常只更新共享学生参数，忽略了"哪些参数组件由哪些领域样本更新"的对应关系，导致专家几何难以保留。
AI.method: 学生=冻结基座+若干可训练组件（由专家减基座权重初始化）；所有组件参与每次前向；定义四种更新模式规定样本领域与组件的对应，各组件有独立优化器状态。
AI.result: 通过角度、投影系数和能量指标衡量几何保持。Open-MOPD最终检查点增量能量97.02%落在原专家方向span之外；本文检查点经20次更新后各组件原方向系数接近1、两两夹角88.04–92.41°；导出BF16学生外部能量4.90%（FP32组件和为10.52%）；六基准宏平均32.72% vs 初始任务算术合并32.44%。
AI.conclusion: 领域路由的增量优化可更好保持专家几何并在评估设置下略优性能，结论限于所评估的训练阶段与设置。

title: Agreeing on the Answer but Not the Reason: Measurement Limits of LLM Reasoning Failure Taxonomies
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at IEEE CogMI 2026 (regular paper)
summary: Failure taxonomies for LLM reasoning are increasingly reported as measurements: papers state what fraction of a model's errors fall into named categories, then compare those fractions across models. We show that for one such category the reported fraction is largely a property of the measurement procedure. We defined Compositional Collapse (a model notices a required sub-part of a problem, then drops or misapplies it) and measured it across twelve models and eleven languages on a public multilingual math benchmark (2,316 graded records). First, 50.1% of failures carry evidence for more than one category, so the reported plurality depends on the order in which the classifier tests them: reversing two tests moves it in eleven of twelve models, and across all six orderings Collapse's share spans 26.4% to 76.4%. Second, agreement collapses for the category but not for the task. Native speakers of all eleven languages judged 179 transcripts, agreeing with our inspector at kappa = 0.932 on answer correctness but only kappa = 0.093 on Collapse. A second native speaker per language re-rated 142 items; on 121 determinate pairs the two humans agree with each other at kappa = 0.659, while each agrees with the inspector at kappa <= 0.094. Re-running the same inspector model with the human instructions verbatim raises kappa against Human 2 from 0.147 to 0.636, so the gap is largely attributable to the prompt, not the model. Third, the inspector labels Collapse 1.81 times as often as native speakers, but only 1.17 times once a defective benchmark item (a deleted clause in the Bengali and Chinese translations) is excluded. We recommend four cheap checks before comparing failure-mode rates across models: report label co-occurrence, permute the tie-break, validate on a shared independent sample, and audit systematic disagreements.

AI.tldr: LLM推理失败分类法的测量分数在很大程度上是测量过程的产物；作者以"组合塌陷"为例证明，分类顺序、标注一致性、基准缺陷都会显著改变报告比例，并提出四项低成本检查。
AI.motivation: 近年论文常把LLM失败模式的占比当作可比较的测量结果，但作者怀疑某一类别的占比可能主要是测量程序本身决定的，而非模型的稳定属性。
AI.method: 定义"Compositional Collapse（组合塌陷）"类别，在公开多语言数学基准上测12个模型、11种语言共2316条评分记录；进行三类实验：(1) 标签共现与六种分类顺序排列对占比的影响；(2) 11种语言母语者共179条转写的人工校验，及每语言第二名母语者对142条二次评级；(3) 排除孟加拉语与中文译文中删除分句的缺陷题目后重算比例。
AI.result: 50.1%的失败同时具备多个类别的证据，反转两项测试在12个模型中11个改变"占比最高"类别，六种顺序下Collapse占比在26.4%–76.4%间波动；判分者在答案正确性上与母语者κ=0.932，但在Collapse上仅κ=0.093；两名人类之间κ=0.659，而各自与判分者κ≤0.094；用人类指令原文重跑判分模型后κ由0.147升至0.636；判分者标记Collapse频率为人类1.81倍，剔除缺陷题后降至1.17倍。
AI.conclusion: 失败模式比例不可直接跨模型比较；建议报告前做四项检查：报告标签共现、置换平局规则、在共享独立样本上验证、审计系统性分歧。

title: DUO: Dual Readouts of Diffusion Models for OOD Detection
summary: Diffusion models are powerful generative methods for learning and sampling from complex data distributions. Safely deploying these models requires detecting inputs that fall outside their training distribution. Because diffusion models recover clean samples from noisy inputs, reconstruction error is often used for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. This approach assumes that in-distribution (ID) inputs are reconstructed more accurately than OOD inputs. However, OOD inputs may be reconstructed equally well or even better, making this score unreliable. We therefore propose the leading sensitivity spectrum of intermediate denoising features as a complementary OOD signal and demonstrate that it remains informative when reconstruction error is misleading. We introduce DUal-readout of diffusion models for OOD detection (DUO), a fully unsupervised, training-free OOD detector that combines reconstruction error and feature sensitivity. DUO improves average AUROC by approximately 6% points over the strongest baselines while substantially reducing inference cost, and achieves SOTA on near-OOD and high-resolution benchmarks.

AI.tldr: DUO是一种基于扩散模型的无监督、免训练OOD检测器，结合重建误差与去噪特征敏感性信号，显著提升检测性能并降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型部署需检测分布外输入。常用重建误差作OOD信号，但OOD输入可能被重建得同样好甚至更好，导致该分数不可靠。
AI.method: 提出中间去噪特征的主导敏感性谱（leading sensitivity spectrum）作为补充OOD信号，设计DUO——融合重建误差与特征敏感性的双读出、完全无监督免训练检测器。
AI.result: 相比最强基线平均AUROC提升约6个百分点，大幅降低推理成本，在近OOD与高分辨率基准上达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 重建误差单独不可靠，引入特征敏感性谱可互补，DUO实现高效且更强的OOD检测。

title: Synapse-Control: Making Agent Experience Actionable with Lightweight Runtime Control
summary: Large language model agents reuse execution experience to improve reliability on complex tool-based tasks. Systems such as Sentry call large models to generate failure diagnoses before retrieving advice, adding inference cost to experience reuse. We present Synapse-Control, an agent runtime whose lightweight control plane selects advice and determines when to send it to the task-executing model. Rules shortlist relevant advice, and a lightweight 1.7B classifier fine-tuned on teacher-labeled state-suggestion pairs scores those candidates instead of generating a diagnosis. Micro-contracts encode reusable interface checks, such as required arguments or valid options, without prescribing complete task programs. A Prompt Value Table records earlier guidance and feedback to limit repeated suggestions through cooldown and token-budget checks. Across 1,308 attempts per method in AppWorld and WebShop, Synapse-Control achieves 270 successes (29.8% more than Base), replaces 4,987 generative diagnosis calls, and reduces auxiliary control time relative to Sentry by 50.2% and 51.0%, respectively.

AI.tldr: Synapse-Control 用轻量控制平面替代大模型生成失败诊断，通过规则筛选+1.7B分类器打分选择建议，在降低推理成本的同时提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有系统（如 Sentry）在检索经验建议前需调用大模型生成失败诊断，带来额外推理开销，经验复用成本高。
AI.method: 构建轻量控制平面：规则对相关建议做初筛；经教师标注训练的小型 1.7B 分类器对状态-建议对打分（而非生成诊断）；微契约编码可复用接口检查（如必填参数、合法选项）；Prompt Value Table 记录先前指导与反馈，通过冷却与token预算检查抑制重复建议。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 与 WebShop 各 1,308 次尝试中取得 270 次成功（比 Base 多 29.8%），替代 4,987 次生成式诊断调用，辅助控制时间相比 Sentry 分别减少 50.2% 与 51.0%。
AI.conclusion: 以判别式小模型控件替代生成式诊断，可在显著降低成本和时间的同时提升工具型任务可靠性，实现更经济高效的经验复用。

title: Off-policy Learning with Excursion Policies
summary: Off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) tries to learn the value of a target policy while data comes from a different behavior policy. This often requires trading off bias for variance or stability. One way to trade these off is to linearly interpolate between the behavior and target policies, but this represents only one point in a broader space of interpolation mechanisms. We introduce excursion policies--a structured alternative where the agent follows the target policy for a multi-step "excursion" before reverting to the behavior policy. We derive dynamic programming results for these policies, establishing the theoretical basis for their use in RL. We further develop provably sound off-policy temporal-difference (TD) algorithms for excursion value estimation. We find that excursion policies provide an efficiency-stability trade-off comparable to mixture policies in continuous control benchmarks, and our analysis illustrates conceptual differences in their behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"excursion policies"（游走策略）：智能体先执行目标策略若干步形成一次"游走"，随后回退到行为策略。作者给出其动态规划推导，设计可靠的离策略TD算法用于价值估计，并在连续控制基准上取得与混合策略相当的高效性-稳定性权衡。
AI.motivation: 离策略RL需从行为策略数据评估目标策略，常在偏差、方差与稳定性之间权衡。常见的线性插值（混合策略）只覆盖插值机制中的单一取点，缺乏更广泛的结构化替代方案。
AI.method: 构造结构化替代：目标策略连续执行多步后回退到行为策略的excursion策略；为其推导动态规划结果，奠定理论基础，并开发可证明收敛/无偏的离策略时序差分（TD）算法进行excursion价值估计。
AI.result: 在连续控制基准上，excursion策略提供与混合策略相当的高效性-稳定性权衡；理论分析揭示两类策略行为的本质概念差异。
AI.conclusion: excursion策略为离策略价值估计提供了有效且理论可靠的新插值机制，扩展了偏差-方差-稳定性权衡的设计空间。

title: Teaching the Harness: Student-Aware Skill Transfer for LLM Agents
summary: Effective teaching requires reasoning about the learner as well as the task, a capacity that Theory of Mind describes as inferring another agent's latent state from its behavior. We ask whether a stronger LLM teaches a fixed student better when it applies this principle. The student is an LLM agent acting through a harness that fixes its tools, context, and action budget, so a procedure that helps one model can exhaust the budget of another. We introduce Student-Aware Teaching (SAT). The teacher builds a learner model that pairs an empirical profile with hypotheses about the student's limitations, tests these hypotheses with diagnostic probes, and writes reusable skills for the diagnosed failures. A skill enters the library only after it raises success on matched development tasks. With Claude-Sonnet-5 teaching DeepSeek-V4-Flash, SAT reaches 86.46% task success across four primary runs, leading both a profile-free teacher with the same framework (81.04%) and the untaught student (75.00%) in each run. Removing the analytical learner model lowers both prediction and success, and under misleading learner profiles none of the 48 candidate skills passes admission. When DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Gemini-3.8-Flash exchange libraries, each performs better with its own. Saved libraries keep average gains of up to 11.1 points after the teacher leaves. The benefit depends on a student that can follow instructions and a deployment route that delivers them.

AI.tldr: 提出 Student-Aware Teaching (SAT)：强 LLM 教师借助心智理论为受限的学生 LLM 建模，通过诊断性探测定位其局限并生成可复用技能，使 Claude-Sonnet-5 教 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的任务成功率从 75.00% 提升到 86.46%。
AI.motivation: 有效教学不仅要理解任务，还要理解学习者；作者想验证：若更强的 LLM 教师像心智理论那样从行为推断学生潜在状态，是否能更有效地教一个固定学生。学生的工具、上下文与动作预算被 harness 固定，因此对某个模型有效的流程可能耗尽另一个模型的预算，需要因材施教。
