AI.method: SAT 教师构建学习者模型：经验画像 + 关于学生局限的假设；用诊断性探测检验假设；针对诊断出的失败编写可复用技能；技能只有提升匹配开发任务的成功率后才进入技能库。实验对比无画像教师、未受教学生，并做消融（去掉分析式学习者模型）、误导性画像、跨模型技能库交换，以及教师离开后的留存测试。
AI.result: Claude-Sonnet-5 教 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 在四次主要运行中平均任务成功率达 86.46%，优于同框架无画像教师（81.04%）和未受教学生（75.00%），且每次运行均领先；去掉分析式学习者模型会同时降低预测准确率与成功率；在误导性学习者画像下，48 个候选技能无一通过准入；DeepSeek-V4-Flash 与 Gemini-3.8-Flash 交换技能库时各自用自有库表现更好；教师离开后，已保存的技能库平均增益最高达 11.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 学生建模式教学对 LLM 教学有效且增益可持续，但前提是学生能遵循指令、且有能把指令送达学生的部署路径。

title: Domain-Adversarial Adaptation from MURA to In-House Radiographs for Improved Adult Elbow Fracture Classification
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, Accepted and presented on SPIE Medical Imaging 2026
summary: We studied domain shift in adult elbow fracture classification from radiographs when training on a large public dataset and deploying on a small, institution-specific dataset (UofL). We implemented a domain-adversarial neural network (DANN) to align feature distributions across source (MURA) and target (UofL) domains while optimizing fracture classification. A pretrained convolutional backbone was adapted to grayscale inputs; the task head predicts fracture presence, and a gradient-reversal-based domain head encourages domain-invariant features via adversarial learning. We compared four settings: (1) Source-only, (2) Target-only (limited labels), (3) Naive merge (pooled training), and (4) DANN (MURA to UofL). Evaluation on UofL test data uses AUC-ROC, and accuracy. DANN outperformed Source-only and Naive merge baselines by reducing domain bias without overfitting to the small target set. Ablations showed that progressive adversarial weight, dataset-size-aware domain loss, and domain-balanced sampling improved stability and target performance. Results demonstrated that domain alignment is a practical path to robust clinical generalization from public to local data.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对成人肘部骨折X线分类的域偏移问题，在大型公开数据集(MURA)上训练并部署到小型机构特定数据集(UofL)，采用领域对抗神经网络(DANN)对齐特征分布，DANN优于仅源域、仅目标和朴素合并基线，消融显示渐进对抗权重、数据集规模感知域损失和域平衡采样提升了稳定性与目标域性能。
AI.motivation: 公开数据集训练的模型部署到本地机构数据时存在域偏移，导致临床泛化性能下降；小型目标数据集标签有限，直接训练易过拟合，因此需要一种实用的域对齐方法来提升从公开数据到本地数据的鲁棒泛化能力。
AI.method: 实现DANN：将预训练卷积骨干网络适配灰度输入，任务头预测是否骨折，基于梯度反转层的域头通过对抗学习促使特征域不变，从而对齐源域(MURA)与目标域(UofL)的特征分布并同时优化骨折分类。比较四种设置：仅源域、仅目标域(标签有限)、朴素合并(池化训练)、DANN。消融引入渐进对抗权重、数据集规模感知域损失和域平衡采样。
AI.result: 在UofL测试数据上以AUC-ROC和准确率评估，DANN通过降低域偏置且不过拟合小型目标集，优于仅源域和朴素合并基线；消融表明三项改进提升了训练稳定性和目标域性能。
AI.conclusion: 域对齐是从公开数据到本地数据实现鲁棒临床泛化的实用路径，DANN可作为成人肘部骨折X线分类跨域部署的有效方案。

title: An Interpretable Stylometric Framework for Early Chinese Buddhist Translator Styles: A Case Study on the Attribution of Disputed Works of An Shigao
comment: Presented as a long paper at Digital Humanities 2026 (DH2026) in Daejeon, Republic of Korea. The abstract appears DH2026 Book of Abstracts, pp. 545-549, available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22656106
summary: Attributing early Chinese Buddhist translations requires evidence that scholars can trace back to the texts. We develop an interpretable stylometric framework that uses features defined or reviewed by Buddhist philologists, including function characters, sentence formulas, sentence-final characters, sentence length, and part-of-speech n-grams. We construct stylistic profiles from 31 authenticated translations by seven translators from the Eastern Han through the Western Jin, then compare eight disputed texts with An Shigao's profile. Two texts, T1557 and T0101, show the strongest stylistic similarity to the authenticated An Shigao corpus, with scores of 0.783 and 0.687, respectively. The attributions agree with those reported by a published BERT-based approach on the same set of disputed texts. The framework requires no task-specific training and allows scholars to inspect which linguistic features support each proposed attribution.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可解释的文体计量学框架，用佛教学者定义的语言特征比对中国早期佛经译本，判定两部疑伪经最接近安世高的风格。
AI.motivation: 早期汉译佛经的作者归属需要可追溯、可检验的证据，而黑箱式深度学习方法难以让学者核查依据。
AI.method: 采用经佛教语文学专家定义或审定的特征（功能字、句式套语、句末字、句长、词性n-gram），基于东汉至西晋七位译者的31部确认译本构建风格画像，再将8部存疑文本与安世高画像比对。
AI.result: T1557与T0101与安世高确认语料风格最相似，得分分别为0.783和0.687；该归属结果与已发表的BERT方法在同一批存疑文本上的一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需任务特定训练，且可让学者检视支持每项归属判定的具体语言特征，兼顾准确性与可解释性。

title: An Analytical Model of Compute-limited Multistage Training Pipelines
summary: Modern foundation models are trained through multiple stages, yet how these stages interact and how compute should be allocated across them remain poorly understood. We introduce an analytically tractable high-dimensional model combining unsupervised pretraining with a linear autoencoder, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with noisy stepwise labels, and reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse episodic rewards. Using random matrix theory and an operator-projection closure, we derive approximate low-dimensional learning dynamics that closely match simulations. We show that finite pretraining data imposes a representation-dependent performance limit, with Bayes classification error scaling as the inverse square root of the pretraining sample ratio, and observe the same exponent in asymptotic SFT and RL errors. Better pretraining also reduces sensitivity to noisy supervision. SFT initialization shortens the initial RL plateau induced by sparse rewards, an effect we also observe in OLMo-2 1B on GSM8K. Longer SFT warm starts additionally improve asymptotic RL performance. Optimizing compute across all three stages reveals that the optimal allocation depends on supervision quality and total budget, with a non-monotonic dependence of the RL compute share on budget. Finally, a complementary compositional model shows how RL selectively strengthens task-relevant pretrained skills while largely preserving unused skills. Together, these results identify mechanisms linking representation quality, feedback structure, and compute allocation in multistage training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个解析可处理的高维模型，统一刻画无监督预训练、监督微调(SFT)与强化学习(RL)三阶段训练，用随机矩阵理论和算子投影闭包推导出低维学习动力学，揭示预训练数据量、监督噪声、SFT热启动与计算分配之间的作用机制。
AI.motivation: 现代基础模型经过多阶段训练，但各阶段如何交互、计算应如何分配仍缺乏清晰理解，作者希望建立可解析的理论框架来定量解释这些机制。
AI.method: 构建高维可解析模型：预训练用线性自编码器，SFT用带噪逐步标签，RL用稀疏回合奖励；借助随机矩阵理论与算子投影闭包，推导出与仿真吻合的低维学习动力学；并在OLMo-2 1B/GSM8K上做实证验证，另用组合式模型分析RL对技能的选择性增强。
AI.result: 有限预训练数据带来依赖表示的性能上限，贝叶斯分类误差按预训练样本比的平方根反比缩放，SFT与RL误差渐近也有相同指数；预训练越好对噪声监督越不敏感；SFT初始化缩短稀疏奖励导致的RL初始平台期（OLMo-2 1B/GSM8K亦有此现象），更长SFT热启动还提升RL渐近性能；最优计算分配依赖监督质量和总预算，RL计算占比对预算呈非单调依赖；RL选择性增强任务相关预训练技能而基本保留未用技能。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别了连接表示质量、反馈结构与多阶段训练计算分配的关键机制，为多阶段训练的设计与算力调度提供理论指导。

title: Cognitive Multi-Agent Search and Rescue: Language-Grounded Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Collaborative Robotics
summary: Effective search and rescue (SAR) operations require autonomous systems capable of coordinating multiple heterogeneous agents, adapting to dynamic hazards, and aligning with human mission intent. Existing language-guided reinforcement learning (RL) methods primarily focus on single-agent instruction following and lack mechanisms for team-level coordination in complex, partially observable environments. This paper presents a Cognitive Multi-Agent Framework based on Language-Grounded Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (LG-HRL) that integrates natural-language understanding, hierarchical policy decomposition, and a shared cognitive workspace to achieve cohesive multi-agent behavior in SAR scenarios. Human instructions are interpreted by a large language model (LLM) and transformed into structured semantic cues that guide high-level strategy selection and role assignment across UAV and UGV agents. A formal Language-Grounded Multi-Agent Hierarchical Decision Process (LG-MAHDP) is introduced to model the interplay between semantic grounding, hierarchical control, and distributed coordination. Comprehensive experiments in a simulated disaster environment show that LG-HRL improves learning speed by 2.3 times, increases coordination coherence by 37%, and enhances subgoal accuracy and hazard avoidance by 46% and 31%, respectively. The system achieves 20-30% higher victim rescue rates, demonstrates emergent role specialization, and adapts immediately to human verbal updates. Ablation studies confirm that both the shared cognitive workspace and language grounding are critical to overall system performance. Overall, this work establishes a new paradigm for language-guided multi-agent SAR robotics, demonstrating that semantic grounding combined with hierarchical reasoning enables safer, more efficient, and more interpretable autonomous rescue operations.

AI.tldr: 提出LG-HRL认知多智能体框架，用LLM将人类指令转为语义线索，结合层级强化学习与共享认知工作区，实现UAV/UGV协同搜救。
AI.motivation: 搜救需多异构智能体协同、应对动态危险并符合人类意图，但现有语言引导RL多面向单智能体指令跟随，缺乏部分可观测环境下的团队级协调机制。
AI.method: 集成自然语言理解、层级策略分解与共享认知工作区；LLM解析指令生成结构化语义线索，指导高层策略选择与角色分配；形式化提出LG-MAHDP建模语义接地、层级控制与分布式协调的交互。
AI.result: 仿真灾害环境中学习速度提升2.3倍，协调一致性+37%，子目标准确率+46%，避障+31%，救援成功率提高20-30%；出现角色专门化并能即时响应口头指令更新；消融证实共享工作区与语言接地均关键。
AI.conclusion: 确立语言引导多智能体搜救机器人新范式，表明语义接地与层级推理可实现更安全、高效、可解释的自主救援。

title: OpticalRAG: Pixel-Space Compression for Token-Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is bottlenecked by the token budget of large language models: feeding long documents into the context window is expensive, while aggressive textual compression discards fine-grained information that is irreversibly lost in a one-dimensional token sequence. We argue that this bottleneck is not fundamental to information density but to the choice of compression \emph{modality}. Modern visual encoders can pack the contents of a rendered text page into roughly a hundred visual tokens with little semantic loss, opening a new compression-fidelity tradeoff that purely textual methods cannot reach. We present \textbf{OpticalRAG}, a framework that renders documents as page images, encodes them with a frozen vision encoder, and distills the retrieved visual tokens into as few as $16$ injected tokens before passing them to the LLM. Two ingredients make this work without expensive cross-modal training: (i) \emph{Encoder-Bridged Retrieval}, which projects text-query states into the visual feature space of the frozen encoder, through a projection shared with the compressor, to retrieve visual tokens from a text query, with no contrastive training; and (ii) \emph{Query-Driven Distillation}, a lightweight cross-attention compressor that condenses the retrieved visual tokens into a small set of query-conditioned prefix tokens. On LongBench-v2, BAMBOO, and LooGLE-v2, OpticalRAG achieves the best compression-aware accuracy (CAP) on all three benchmarks while injecting only $16$ tokens, and improves the closed-book Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct backbone by $5.17$ points on LongBench-v2.Code is available at https://github.com/brighterr/OpticalRAG.

AI.tldr: OpticalRAG将文档渲染为图像，用冻结视觉编码器编码，并通过"编码器桥接检索"和"查询驱动蒸馏"把长文档压缩为仅16个视觉 tokens 注入 LLM，在多个长上下文基准上取得最佳压缩感知准确率。
AI.motivation: RAG 受限于 LLM 的 token 预算：长文档直接输入代价高，而文本压缩会不可逆地丢失细粒度信息。作者认为瓶颈不在信息密度，而在压缩模态的选择——视觉编码器可将一页文本压成约百个视觉 token 而语义损失很小，这是纯文本方法无法达到的压缩-保真折中。
AI.method: 框架包含三步：将文档渲染为页面图像并用冻结视觉编码器编码；(i) Encoder-Bridged Retrieval——通过一个与压缩器共享的投影，将文本查询状态投影到冻结编码器的视觉特征空间，从而用文本查询检索视觉 token，无需对比训练；(ii) Query-Driven Distillation——轻量交叉注意力压缩器把检索到的视觉 token 压缩成少量查询条件的 prefix tokens（可少至16个），再送入 LLM。整个流程无需昂贵的跨模态训练。
AI.result: 在 LongBench-v2、BAMBOO 和 LooGLE-v2 三个基准上，仅注入16个 token 即取得最佳压缩感知准确率（CAP）；在 LongBench-v2 上相比闭卷 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 骨干提升5.17分。
AI.conclusion: 视觉模态压缩为 RAG 的 token 瓶颈提供了新的压缩-保真前沿，且通过共享投影和轻量蒸馏即可低成本落地，显著优于纯文本压缩方案。

title: Neural Network-Assisted CLEAN for Efficient Multipath Parameter Estimation in MIMO Systems
summary: High-resolution multipath estimation in wideband multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) channels requires repeated searches over angle of arrival, angle of departure, and propagation distance. This paper presents neural network-assisted CLEAN (NN-CLEAN), which replaces the multidimensional search at each extraction step with a multi-head classifier while retaining least-squares (LS) estimation of the complex path gain, parametric reconstruction, and residual cancellation. The same classifier is applied to successive residuals, allowing the extraction depth to vary without changing its output structure. With the number of iterations prescribed by the reference multipath-component (MPC) count, off-grid synthetic tests show that NN-CLEAN slightly exceeds grid-search CLEAN (GS-CLEAN) in path accuracy for one and two MPCs, although its accuracy declines more rapidly at larger path counts. For complete three-MPC extraction at a batch size of eight, NN-CLEAN achieves an approximately $27\times$ speedup and a $52$-fold reduction in peak GPU memory relative to GS-CLEAN. Applied without retraining to two-MPC line-of-sight (LOS) and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) Sionna ray-tracing channels within a coded MIMO link, NN-CLEAN substantially reduces channel-reconstruction mean-squared error (MSE) and bit error rate (BER) relative to interpolated LS channel estimation. GS-CLEAN retains an accuracy advantage on these channels, indicating the estimation cost associated with the computational savings.

AI.tldr: 提出神经网络辅助的CLEAN算法（NN-CLEAN），用多头分类器替代宽带MIMO信道多径估计中每一步的角度/时延多维搜索，同时保留最小二乘增益估计、参数化重构与残差消除，大幅提速并降低显存。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率宽带MIMO多径估计需要对到达角、离开角和传播距离反复进行多维搜索，计算与内存开销大，难以在实际链路中高效部署。
AI.method: 将GS-CLEAN每次提取中的多维网格搜索替换为多头分类器以直接预测参数，再沿用LS估计复增益、参数化重构与残差消去；同一分类器作用于逐次残差，支持灵活改变提取深度；在Sionna射线追踪的LOS/NLOS信道上不作重训练直接使用。
AI.result: 离网格合成测试中，NN-CLEAN在1–2个MPC时路径精度略优于GS-CLEAN，但多径数增大时精度下降更快；三MPC、批大小8时约27倍加速、峰值GPU显存降低约52倍；真实射线追踪链路中相比插值LS显著降低重构MSE与BER，但精度仍不及GS-CLEAN。
AI.conclusion: NN-CLEAN以多头分类替代多维搜索，在保持CLEAN框架的同时实现了显著的算力与显存节省，适合低多径、大吞吐场景；其精度随多径数增加而下降，与GS-CLEAN之间仍存在计算换精度的权衡。

title: AI Alignment Is Neither Solvable nor Sufficient
summary: Humans and AI systems increasingly act within the same social and economic environments. Alignment, the goal of ensuring that AI systems act in accordance with human values, is widely regarded as a central challenge for ensuring that AI benefits society while avoiding harm. We argue that this endeavor is misguided. First, alignment is not well defined, as it presumes a sufficiently stable and identifiable set of human intentions or values. Second, where a concrete notion of alignment can be specified, it is not solvable. Third, where alignment appears solvable, solving it would not necessarily mitigate the negative consequences of AI. A key reason is that alignment is typically framed as a property of individual AI systems, while the resulting hybrid societies of humans and machines are complex systems shaped by interactions and feedback loops. Emergent risks, and not only those posed by individual misaligned systems, are therefore likely to become a major source of harm. We conclude that AI safety is an ongoing challenge and not a problem that can be solved once and for all by verifying a particular model property.

AI.tldr: 本文主张"对齐"（alignment）作为AI安全核心目标存在根本性误区：它定义不清、在具体化后不可解、且即使可解也未必能减轻AI的负面后果；人类-机器混合社会是复杂系统，涌现风险才是主要危害来源，AI安全是持续性挑战而非一劳永逸的模型属性验证问题。
AI.motivation: 人类与AI系统日益在同一社会与经济环境中行动，主流观点将对齐视为确保AI造福社会的核心挑战。作者认为这一努力方向本身存在误导，需要重新审视对齐框架的可行性与有效性。
AI.method: 概念性/论证性分析，通过对"对齐"的三层递进反驳展开：(1)对齐缺乏良定义，因其预设了足够稳定且可识别的人类意图或价值集合；(2)在可具体刻画的场景中，对齐问题不可解；(3)即便看似可解，也未必能减轻AI负面后果。核心论证依托对个体系统属性视角与人类-机器混合社会复杂系统（交互与反馈回路）视角的对比。
AI.result: 论证指出对齐在定义层面、可解性层面、以及有效性层面均存在问题；关键在于对齐通常被框定为单个AI系统的属性，而实际后果产生于由交互和反馈塑造的混合复杂社会系统，因此涌现风险（而非仅个体系统失准）将成为主要危害来源。
AI.conclusion: AI安全是持续性的挑战，而非通过验证某一特定模型属性即可一次性解决的问题；需从个体系统对齐转向对混合社会系统中涌现风险的关注。

title: Uni-Loc: Weakly Supervised 3D CT Pathology Localization via Spatially Grounded Vision-Language Classification
summary: Accurate localization of abnormalities in three-dimensional (3D) CT scans is essential for linking automated predictions with clinically relevant pathological findings. We propose Uni-Loc, a vision-language framework that unifies pathology classification and 3D localization using scan-level supervision. Uni-Loc derives both predictions and localization maps from spatial similarities between pathology-conditioned queries and image features. A token-to-voxel upsampling module enables high-resolution localization, while gradient-guided thresholding identifies pathology regions without additional learned parameters. Evaluated on five localization tasks comprising 355 annotated CT scans, Uni-Loc achieves macro-averaged voxel-level AUROC/AUPR of 96.1\%/34.5\%, outperforming relevance propagation (80.7%/13.9%) and gradient saliency (88.7%/8.1%). Uni-Loc also achieves classification AUROC of 88.39% on CT-RATE and 78.03% on RAD-ChestCT, improving over a matched baseline. These results demonstrate effective 3D pathology localization without requiring pathology-specific voxel-level supervision.

AI.tldr: Uni-Loc：一个视觉-语言框架，仅用扫描级监督统一病理分类与3D CT病灶定位，通过病理条件查询与图像特征的空间相似度生成定位图，无需体素级标注。
AI.motivation: 3D CT中异常的准确定位对将自动预测与临床病理发现关联至关重要，但现有方法缺乏病理特异的体素级监督。
AI.method: 预测与定位图均由病理条件查询和图像特征的空间相似度推导；token-to-voxel上采样模块实现高分辨率定位；梯度引导阈值化无需额外可学习参数即可识别病灶区域。
AI.result: 在5个定位任务（355例标注CT）上，宏平均体素级AUROC/AUPR达96.1%/34.5%，优于相关性传播（80.7%/13.9%）和梯度显著性（88.7%/8.1%）；分类AUROC在CT-RATE为88.39%、RAD-ChestCT为78.03%，优于匹配基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明无需病理特异的体素级监督即可有效实现3D病理定位。

title: You Are What You Read: Indian Political News Media Bias Dataset for Hindi Language
summary: Media bias understanding and detection remains an under-researched problem for Indian context, specifically for Indic languages, such as, Hindi, which is widely spoken in India. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive, multi-annotator, explainable dataset consisting of 448 unique articles from four leading Indian news agencies publishing in Hindi. We focus on Hindi, the most spoken and an official language of India. The study of media bias is particularly relevant in the Indian context due to the country's linguistic diversity and large population, where the same event is often reported by multiple news agencies in different languages, thereby introducing scope for bias. The dataset comprises Hindi political news articles annotated by 14 experts and classified into four bias categories - selection bias, framing bias, clickbait bias and omission bias - when an article is identified as biased or unbiased. For each biased article, annotators also provide a textual explanation, enabling future semi-automated approaches to incorporate explainability when language models reason over the dataset. Cohen's Kappa scores were 0.81 for simple bias/no-bias classification reflecting strong inter-annotator agreement. For the multi-label task, the Cohen's Kappa values are 0.89, 0.75, 0.81, and 0.79 for clickbait, selection, framing, and omission biases, respectively, resulting in an average Kappa of 0.80, which also reflects strong agreement.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了首个面向印地语政治新闻的可解释媒体偏见数据集，包含448篇来自印度四大新闻机构的文章，由14位专家标注为四类偏见并附文本解释，标注一致性高（Cohen's Kappa约0.80）。
AI.motivation: 印度语境下（尤其印地语等印度语言）的媒体偏见理解与检测研究不足；印度语言多样、人口庞大，同一事件常由多家机构以不同语言报道，易引入偏见，因此研究意义突出。
AI.method: 构建多标注者、可解释的数据集：采集4家领先印度新闻机构的448篇印地语政治新闻；14位专家标注是否为偏见文章，并细分四类（选择偏见、框架偏见、标题党偏见、遗漏偏见）；对每篇偏见文章提供文本解释，以支持后续半自动可解释推理。
AI.result: 二分类（有偏见/无偏见）Cohen's Kappa为0.81；多标签任务中标题党、选择、框架、遗漏偏见的Kappa分别为0.89、0.75、0.81、0.79，平均0.80，均体现较强标注者一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了印地语媒体偏见数据的空白，提供了高一致性、带解释标签的资源，可用于偏见检测及可解释性建模研究。

title: Train High, Ship Low: Efficient LoRA Synchronization for Distributed On-Policy Post-Training
summary: Transmitting LoRA adapters to rollout workers can bottleneck distributed on-policy post-training over bandwidth-constrained networks. Lowering the training rank may limit the capacity a workload needs, while adaptive optimizer updates are difficult to compress. Rollout workers can instead reconstruct updates from gradients by maintaining replicated optimizer states. We introduce HiLo, a compressor-agnostic framework that replaces parameter transmission with compressed gradient dissemination and local optimizer replay. By applying the same decoded gradients, the learner and workers maintain consistent policy states at the same version under reproducible execution. We further develop Spar, a budget-aware gradient compressor that combines spectral truncation, adaptive rank allocation and error feedback to decouple training rank from communication cost. Experiments across on-policy distillation and reward-guided post-training show that HiLo with Spar maintains learning quality close to full synchronization while transmitting as little as 1.6% of the adapter bytes, and accelerates end-to-end updates by up to $2.2\times$ under bandwidth constraints.

AI.tldr: HiLo：用压缩梯度传输+本地优化器重放替代LoRA参数传输，配合预算感知压缩器Spar，仅传1.6%字节即可接近全同步效果，端到端提速至多2.2倍。
AI.motivation: 带宽受限网络中向rollout worker传输LoRA适配器成为分布式on-policy后训练的瓶颈；降低训练秩会限制模型容量，而自适应优化器更新本身难以压缩。
AI.method: HiLo为压缩器无关框架：worker维护复制的优化器状态，用接收到的压缩梯度本地重放优化器更新，从而以梯度压缩分发替代参数传输；在可复现执行下，learner与worker消费相同解码梯度，保持同版本策略一致。并设计Spar压缩器，结合谱截断、自适应秩分配与误差反馈，将训练秩与通信开销解耦。
AI.result: 在on-policy蒸馏与奖励引导后训练任务上，HiLo+Spar学习质量接近全同步，仅传输约1.6%的适配器字节，带宽受限下端到端更新加速最高2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 将通信对象从参数切换为压缩梯度并本地重放优化器，可在保真度与带宽之间取得良好权衡；Spar证明训练秩与通信成本可被有效解耦，为带宽受限的分布式后训练提供通用方案。

title: From Process Models to Composable Agentic Workflows: Combining BPMN, Agents and Enterprise Knowledge
summary:
LLM-based agents can reason, use tools and collaborate. However, coordinating increasingly complex agentic applications becomes difficult to understand, monitor and improve. Decisions distributed across prompts, tool calls and application logic make workflows implicit. We introduce **Recursive Capability Composition**, enabling agents to execute business processes and expose them as reusable Agentic Tools.
  This paper presents a BPMN-based approach to Agentic Workflows, combining explicit orchestration with autonomous reasoning. SemTalk BPMN models are transformed into executable workflows using a LangGraph/Pregel runtime. Agentic Tasks introduce LLM reasoning at selected activities, while conventional BPMN controls process flows, deterministic decisions, system interactions and human approvals. Agentic Participants provide reusable interfaces for agent behavior or other executable processes.
  BPMN orchestration makes multi-agent systems more understandable and manageable. Explicit process models provide developers and operators with a shared view of workflow structures and execution progress, facilitating debugging, monitoring and optimization.
  Enterprise agents also need organization-specific context. Process Models and Knowledge Graphs describe activities, participants, information objects, decisions and relationships between processes. They provide structured knowledge of how an organization operates, supporting informed agent decisions and actions.
  Our contributions are threefold: 1. **Model-Driven Execution:** Transforming BPMN models into executable Agentic Workflows. 2. **Recursive Capability Composition:** Exposing agents and executable business processes as reusable tools for other agents. 3. **Enterprise Context:** Using Process Models and Ontologies to provide organization-specific knowledge for agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于BPMN的Agentic Workflow方法，将SemTalk BPMN模型通过LangGraph/Pregel运行时转为可执行工作流，并支持递归能力组合与企业知识上下文。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体可推理、用工具、协作，但复杂agentic应用的决策分散在提示、工具调用和应用逻辑中，工作流变得隐式，难以理解、监控和改进。
AI.method: 用显式BPMN编排结合自主推理：SemTalk BPMN模型转换为LangGraph/Pregel可执行工作流；Agentic Task在选定活动引入LLM推理，常规BPMN控制流程、确定性决策、系统交互与人工审批；Agentic Participant提供可复用的agent行为/可执行流程接口；并用流程模型与知识图谱/本体提供组织特定上下文。
AI.result: 提出三项贡献：1) 模型驱动执行（BPMN转可执行Agentic Workflow）；2) 递归能力组合（将agent与可执行业务流程暴露为其他agent可复用的工具）；3) 企业上下文（用流程模型与本体为agent推理提供组织知识）。显式流程模型为开发者与运维提供共享视图，便于调试、监控与优化。
AI.conclusion: BPMN编排使多智能体系统更可理解、可管理，递归能力组合支持业务流程复用，企业流程模型与本体可为agent提供组织特定知识，从而提升复杂agentic应用的可解释性与可维护性。

title: How Hyperbolic Are Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models?
summary: Hyperbolic vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a rapidly growing area of research, reporting strong zero-shot performance alongside an interpretable embedding space in which radius orders representations by generality. But how hyperbolic are hyperbolic VLMs in practice? We investigate this at the exponential map, the single operation through which curvature enters an otherwise Euclidean network. We show that across MERU, HyCoCLIP, ARGENT, and PHyCLIP, the exponential map is well approximated by the identity function, i.e., pairwise distances and angles in the pre-map Euclidean space barely change under projection, and removing the map at inference leaves evaluation scores unchanged. Motivated by this observation, we train Euclidean VLMs on CC3M from scratch under the same hierarchy losses. Over roughly the final 90% of the training steps, the training statistics are nearly indistinguishable from those of their hyperbolic counterparts, and the resulting models match the evaluation scores and recover the same radial distributions. Our findings establish Euclidean space as a sufficient substrate for hierarchical vision-language learning as it is currently practiced, and motivate new paradigms in which hyperbolic geometry can deliver on its theoretical promise. Code is available at https://github.com/fbyrman/hyperbolic-vlms.

AI.tldr: 本文检验现有双曲视觉-语言模型（VLM）中指数映射的实际作用，发现该映射近似恒等变换，去掉后评估分数几乎不变；用同款层级损失从零训练欧氏VLM即可复现双曲模型的表现，说明当前双曲VLM并未真正利用双曲几何，欧氏空间已足够。
AI.motivation: 双曲VLM宣称具有强零样本性能和可解释的径向嵌入结构（半径编码泛化性），但作者质疑这些模型在实践中究竟有多"双曲"，即曲率几何是否真正起作用。
AI.method: 聚焦曲率进入网络的唯一位置——指数映射，分析MERU、HyCoCLIP、ARGENT、PHyCLIP四个模型；检验映射前后成对距离与夹角的变化，并在推理时移除该映射；随后在CC3M上用相同的层级损失从头训练纯欧氏VLM，与双曲对应模型比较训练统计、评估分数及径向分布。
AI.result: 指数映射可被恒等函数很好地近似（映射前后距离和角度几乎不变，推理时移除映射不改变评分）；训练最后约90%步数中欧氏模型的训练统计与双曲版本几乎无法区分，评估分数与径向分布也一致。
AI.conclusion: 就当前实践而言，欧氏空间已足以支撑层级化视觉-语言学习，双曲几何的理论优势尚未被真正发挥，需探索能兑现其潜力的新范式。代码已开源。

title: Do Language Models Feel the Sentiment? Investigating Emotion Vectors
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at ExplAI-2026: 2nd Workshop on Advanced AI in Explainability and Ethics for the Sustainable Development Goals
summary: Emotion vectors are directions in a language model's internal representations that are associated with emotional concepts. Prior work shows that these vectors can influence model behavior, but their role in sentiment classification remains unclear. This study investigates emotion directions in Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. Eight directions extracted from GoEmotions are evaluated through sentiment probing, activation interventions, and supervised correction. Emotion-only probes achieve 88.66% and 90.70% accuracy on binary TweetEval. In exploratory matched-ablation experiments, raw emotion-space removal causes 2.39 and 1.10 percentage points more accuracy loss than matched isotropic random-subspace removal for 0.5B and 3B, respectively. All four TweetEval raw and denoised effects are significant after Holm adjustment across eight comparisons. An exploratory SST-2 extension shows smaller raw excess losses of 0.66 and 0.57 points, with no effects surviving Holm adjustment. Frozen sentiment-correction classifiers are also tested on 20,000 Amazon Polarity reviews. Emotion-based correction improves accuracy over uncorrected Qwen, but does not consistently outperform margin-only baselines. These results distinguish sentiment information available in model representations, the effects of changing those representations, and their practical value for classification. They do not establish a uniquely emotional mechanism.

AI.tldr: 研究 Qwen2.5-0.5B/3B-Instruct 中与情感概念相关的"情绪方向"，通过探针、激活干预和监督校正评估其在情感分类中的作用，发现情绪方向携带显著情感信息，但不能确立唯一的情感机制。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明大模型内部表示中的情绪向量能影响模型行为，但它们在情感分类任务中的具体角色仍不清楚，作者希望厘清"表示中可利用的信息""改变表示带来的因果效应"与"实际分类价值"三者的区别。
AI.method: 从 GoEmotions 中提取八个情绪方向，在 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 与 3B-Instruct 上进行：（1）仅用情绪的线性探针；（2）匹配消融实验（对比各向同性随机子空间消融）；（3）冻结的情感校正分类器，在 TweetEval、SST-2 及 20,000 条 Amazon Polarity 评论上测试。
AI.result: 情绪探针在 TweetEval 二分类上达 88.66%/90.70%；原始情绪空间消融比匹配随机子空间消融多损失 2.39/1.10 个百分点，且经 Holm 校正的四个 TweetEval 效应均显著；SST-2 扩展的额外损失为 0.66/0.57 点但无显著效应；基于情绪的校正优于未校正 Qwen，但不稳定优于仅用 margin 的基线。
AI.conclusion: 情绪方向确实包含可用的情感信息并具有因果影响，但其分类价值有限，未能证明存在独特的情感机制；研究主张区分信息可用性、干预效应与实用价值。

title: One Trajectory, Two Requirements: Accuracy and Local Stability in Euler Sampling for Flow Matching Policies
summary: Flow matching robot policies commonly use a fixed Euler step count selected from offline accuracy sweeps. At inference time, however, each policy input (visual observation, robot state, and language instruction) together with a source-noise draw defines a different ODE trajectory and sequence of local Jacobians. We ask whether a step count that accurately follows the nominal noise-to-action trajectory can still be too coarse for strongly contracting directions around it. An exact two-coordinate system and a controlled augmentation of six trained flow models show that trajectory accuracy and local Euler stability can impose different step requirements even when the original learned transport is unchanged. We then study a frozen $π_{0.5}$-LIBERO checkpoint without modifying its weights or action dynamics. Across 30 policy inputs from 10 LIBERO-10 tasks, the Jacobian exhibits strong contracting directions near the action endpoint, yet no sampled mode violates the Euler non-expansion condition. On five of those inputs, accuracy sweeps require 4--9 Euler steps at 5% terminal error and 87--112 at 1%. These five paired cases are therefore consistent with accuracy-limited rather than stability-limited sampling under this local criterion, while the controlled experiments show why endpoint accuracy alone cannot rule out a separate stability requirement.

AI.tldr: 该论文质疑流匹配（flow matching）机器人策略中固定Euler步数的做法，指出轨迹精度与局部Euler稳定性可能对步数提出不同要求，并用理论双坐标系统、受控实验及冻结π0.5-LIBERO检查点实验进行分析。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配机器人策略通常从离线精度扫描中选定固定的Euler步数，但每次推理时不同输入（视觉、状态、语言）与源噪声共同定义不同的ODE轨迹和局部Jacobian序列，因此需要考察：满足标称轨迹精度的步数是否对局部强收缩方向仍过粗。
AI.method: 构建精确的双坐标解析系统，并对六个已训练流模型做受控增强实验；随后在冻结的π0.5-LIBERO检查点上（不修改权重或动作动力学），对10个LIBERO-10任务的30个策略输入计算Jacobian并检查Euler非扩张条件，并对其中5个输入做精度扫描。
AI.result: Jacobian在动作终点附近表现出强收缩方向，但所有采样模式均未违反Euler非扩张条件；5个输入在5%终端误差下需4–9步，1%下需87–112步，呈精度受限而非稳定性受限；然而受控实验表明仅靠终点精度无法排除存在独立稳定性需求。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹精度与局部Euler稳定性可对步数提出不同要求；在所考察的π0.5-LIBERO案例中采样受精度限制，但该局部判据下的结论不能推广为"精度足够即稳定足够"，需同时评估两者。

title: Counting Under Disagreement: Dollar-Weighted Measurement, Selective Machine Labelling and Budgeted Human Review from Disagreeing AI Readers of Administrative Text
comment: 61 pages, 8 figures, 46 tables. Replication record (calibration sample, population aggregates, prompts and analysis code): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23285230
summary: We study AI-assisted measurement when one text label applies to many administrative records, the target is a monetary total, and the human readings that anchor the machines disagree. The testbed is 121,070 grant-purpose texts from US tax filings (799,675 records, \$126.4B), labelled by a rule-based classifier and three language models, with a designed sample of 651 texts read independently by three people under one codebook. We state exact conditions for a fixed-predictor difference estimator and for a cross-fitted predictor whose folds are assigned to the whole frame before sampling, under Poisson sampling, and assess the implemented fixed-size procedures by simulation: 8 predictors whose own totals span \$11.2-15.0B agree to within \$0.4B once rectified. Two rules that accept machine labels at a stated dollar-weighted error, weighted conformal p-values under a dollar measure and Learn-then-Test on the design estimate of the error, are evaluated on nested held-out folds and on re-draws of the design with synthetic truths; their error control in deployment is not established, and the count-based rule accepts no text under a dollar-drawn sample. In a replay that charges every human label, a two-phase review policy whose calibrator is fitted on its own first phase reduces the RMSE of the total by 28% at a budget of 100 texts relative to dollar-proportional sampling, while pure Neyman allocation fails with an uncalibrated predictor. Independent readers shift the estimated total by \$3.93B, 2.2 times the within-reader sampling interval, and institution-level intervals under-cover at every size. Every headline result is re-run under each reader. The results identify both the benefits and the limits of using learned predictions to decide what a person should verify.

AI.tldr: 研究在"一个文本标签对应多条行政记录、目标为金额总量、且人类读数不一致"的情形下，AI辅助测量能否用于决定"让人去核实什么"。以美国税务申报中12.1万条拨款用途文本为测试平台，给出固定预测与交叉拟合预测的差分估计量条件，评估两类机器标签接受规则，并提出两阶段复核策略。
AI.motivation: 在行政记录中，一个文本标签对应多条记录、目标是货币总额，而用于校准机器的人类读数彼此不一致。此类设定下，用学习到的预测去决定人工核实对象是否有益、边界何在，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 测试平台为美国税务申报中121,070条拨款用途文本（799,675条记录，1264亿美元），由规则分类器和三个语言模型标注，并设计651条文本由三人依同一编码手册独立阅读。在泊松抽样下给出固定预测差分估计量与"折叠在抽样前分配至整个抽样框"的交叉拟合预测估计量的精确条件，并通过模拟评估固定规模程序；在嵌套留出折与设计重抽（含合成真值）上评估美元加权误差下的加权共形p值与基于设计误差估计的Learn-then-Test两种接受规则；用带自校准第一阶段的两阶段复核策略回放。
AI.result: 8个自身总量在112–150亿美元间的预测器经校正后一致到4亿美元以内。两种接受规则在部署中的误差控制尚未确立，且基于计数的规则在按美元抽样下不接受任何文本。回放中两阶段策略在100条文本预算下将总量RMSE较美元比例抽样降低28%，而纯Neyman分配在预测器未校准下失败。独立读者使估计总量相差39.3亿美元，为读者内抽样区间的2.2倍，机构层区间在所有规模下均覆盖不足。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了用学习预测来指导人工核实对象的益处与局限：校正后多预测器可达成一致总量，两阶段校准复核能显著降误，但读者间差异与区间覆盖不足构成部署风险，误差控制在实践中尚未确立。

title: Prompt2Echo (P2Echo): Text-Prompted Multi-View Echocardiography Segmentation with One Model
summary: Automated segmentation in multi-view echocardiography is essential for comprehensive cardiac assessment, yet remains challenging due to substantial anatomical and appearance variability across standard acoustic windows. In this paper, we present P2Echo, a unified framework capable of segmenting diverse cardiac structures across multiple standard echocardiographic views using a single model controlled by structured view-aware text prompts. Unlike recent foundation model adaptations that rely on implicit latent priors, P2Echo explicitly conditions the segmentation process via a novel Dynamic Image-Text Alignment (DyITA) module. DyITA integrates a differentiable routing mechanism and token differential operators to dynamically modulate decoder features according to the requested view and target structure. This allows the network to adaptively switch its processing pathways for different views without architectural changes. Extensive experiments on a large-scale internal dataset (seen during training) and held-out evaluation on three external datasets demonstrate that P2Echo matches or exceeds both view-specific specialists and state-of-the-art universal models at a fraction of their computational cost, offering an efficient, controllable solution for multi-plane cardiac analysis. Code is available at: https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/P2Echo.

AI.tldr: P2Echo是一个统一的超声心动图多切面分割框架，用结构化视图感知文本提示控制单一模型，通过动态图文对齐模块实现跨切面多结构分割。
AI.motivation: 多视图超声心动图分割对完整心脏评估至关重要，但不同标准声窗间解剖结构和外观差异大，现有方法难以兼顾多切面；近期基础模型依赖隐式潜先验，缺乏显式可控性。
AI.method: 提出统一框架P2Echo，以结构化视图感知文本提示驱动单一模型。核心是动态图文对齐模块DyITA，包含可微路由机制与token微分算子，依据请求的视图和目标结构动态调制解码器特征，使网络无需改变架构即可切换处理路径。
AI.result: 在大型内部数据集（训练可见）及三个外部数据集上评估，P2Echo匹配或超越视图专用专家模型和先进通用模型，且计算成本仅为其一小部分。
AI.conclusion: P2Echo提供了一种高效、可控的多平面心脏分析方案，验证了显式图文条件在统一多视图分割中的有效性。

title: Word-Level Alignment of OCR and Ground Truth under Zoning and Reading-Order Errors
comment: 19 pages. Submitted to IJDAR (ICDAR 2027 Journal Track). Code: https://github.com/SniperJF/zone-robust-ocr-align
summary: OCR post-processing needs OCR text aligned word by word with its ground truth. Data sets rarely provide that mapping, and a monotone aligner can lose its place when zoning errors permute the reading order. We revisit this problem, the Zoning Problem of our 2019 paper, with a protocol that tests correctness under such permutations. We apply OCR-side reading-order permutations with construction-time word-level gold and score correct-match F1, cascade length and recovery. We compare the 2019 location-aware aligner, a re-anchoring extension of it, a RETAS-style baseline (RETAS-lite), a multi-region aligner that combines unique-word and unique n-gram anchors with chunk-to-window assignment, genalog's RETAS and the original Java RETAS. Experiments use synthetic character noise with block moves, paragraph swaps and column interleaving, historical newspaper reading-order permutations, geometry-derived gold for Tesseract OCR, and a small word-box set. Synthetic tests show where local tracking fails after large displacements and where unique-anchor methods collapse when unique anchors are scarce. On our synthetic boilerplate page the 2019 method had the highest F1 among those tested. Historical newspaper and geometry-derived evaluations carry the limitations of approximate gold and the article-order convention. The first multi-region version has a quadratic scaling cost. Local tracking remains fragile under large reading-order changes; the tested anchor-based methods handle many of those cases but fail when unique anchors are scarce. Approximate gold, the article-order convention, missing residual annotation, and the lack of modern multi-column word-level ground truth remain limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文延续2019年提出的"分区问题"(Zoning Problem)，在新协议下评测OCR词级对齐器在阅读顺序被置换时能否保持正确匹配，并比较多种对齐方法。
AI.motivation: OCR后处理需要词级对齐的OCR文本与金标准，但数据集很少提供该映射；且分区/zoning错误会打乱阅读顺序，使单调对齐器"失位"。因此需要一个在阅读顺序置换下检验对齐正确性的评测协议。
AI.method: 构建带构造期词级金标准的OCR侧重排数据，以correct-match F1、级联长度和恢复能力为指标；比较2019定位感知对齐器、其重锚定扩展、RETAS-lite基线、结合唯一词与唯一n-gram锚点及块-窗口分配的多区域对齐器、genalog的RETAS和原始Java RETAS。数据含合成字符噪声(块移动、段落交换、列交错)、历史报纸重排、Tesseract的几何推导金标准及小型词框集。
AI.result: 合成测试显示：大位移后局部追踪会失效，唯一锚点稀缺时基于锚点的方法崩溃；在合成模板页上2019方法F1最高。历史报纸与几何推导评估受近似金标准和文章顺序惯例限制；首个多区域版本为二次复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 局部追踪在阅读顺序大幅变化时仍脆弱；基于锚点的方法可处理多数此类情况，但唯一锚点稀缺时失效。近似金标准、文章顺序惯例、残差标注缺失以及缺少现代多栏词级金标准仍是主要局限。

title: MicroLens: Read, Trace, and Rewire the Residual Stream with Two Lenses
summary: Lenses that decode hidden states into words are a popular way to look inside language models, but a heatmap of decoded words only shows what a vector reads as and cannot distinguish whether, or how much, the model uses the information. We present an interactive viewer that puts reading, tracing and editing on the same layers-by-tokens grid of the residual stream. In the viewer, every cell can be decoded with two lenses, the logit lens and the Jacobian lens (J-lens), traced back to the tokens it drew from, and edited, with the rest of the model rerun on the spot. We demonstrate three usage scenarios on Gemma-3-4B-it, backed by sweeps over a few hundred prompts, to show what this tool can discover. First, the two lenses give different directions to write with, each suiting a different edit: the logit lens's word direction sets what a token outputs, while the J-lens's direction changes what later tokens read. Second, in two-hop trivia questions (the capital of the state or country containing a given city), the state or country is readable at the city token from as early as layer 7, and swapping it there can redirect the answer 92-98% of the time; however, at the answer position, the state or country information is not used. Third, when a chat model answers questions with a step-by-step reasoning prompt, the correct answer is often already the top word in the residual stream before any reasoning is written: for 89-92% of retrieval questions and 39-63% of multi-hop and serial ones, far above their respective distractors (at most 5%). However, ordering puzzles are an exception, as the model works them out only once it writes its final reasoning steps. Furthermore, for answers that are visible in the residual stream, the J-lens reads them a layer or two earlier than the logit lens across the different types of question.

AI.tldr: 提出一个交互式可视化工具，在残差流的“层×token”网格上统一实现解码（logit lens与Jacobian lens）、溯源与编辑，用于分析语言模型内部隐藏状态如何被使用。
AI.motivation: 现有解码词的热力图只能显示向量“读起来像什么”，无法区分模型是否、以及在多大程度上使用了这些信息；需要同时支持读取、追踪和编辑的工具。
AI.method: 构建交互式viewer：每个网格单元格可用两种lens（logit lens与J-lens）解码，回溯其来源token，并可就地编辑后立刻重跑模型。在Gemma-3-4B-it上以数百条prompt的扫描为支撑，展示三个使用场景。
AI.result: (1) 两种lens给出不同写入方向：logit lens的词方向设定token输出，J-lens方向改变后续token的读取。(2) 两跳问答题中，州/国家信息最早在第7层即可在城市token处读出，替换后可92-98%改变答案；但在答案位置该信息未被使用。(3) 分步推理提示下，检索题89-92%、多跳与串行题39-63%的正确答案在写出推理前已是残差流首位词，远高于干扰项（≤5%）；排序谜题例外，需写出最终步骤才解出。此外，J-lens比logit lens早一到两层读出可见答案。
AI.conclusion: 将读取、溯源与编辑整合于同一网格的可视化工具，能揭示单靠解码热力图无法发现的模型内部信息使用机制，并对比两种lens在方向性与读取时机上的差异。

title: Reliability of Claude Code as an Agentic AI Grading System for Handwritten University Exams
summary: This study examines the reliability of Claude Code, an agentic deployment of the Claude Opus 4.6 large language model, as a grading system for handwritten university exams. Four research questions addressed agreement with expert human grading on total scores (RQ1), agreement across five question types from multiple choice to evaluative judgement (RQ2), consistency across two independent grading sessions one week apart (RQ3), and the accuracy of AI-generated feedback (RQ4). Claude Code graded the 20-mark mid-term papers of 60 consenting students in a Saudi computer graphics course in a single agentic session, guided by three rubric files. Reliability was estimated on disjoint samples: 20 papers for RQ1, RQ2 and RQ4, and 15 papers for RQ3. Analyses used Pearson correlation, mean absolute error, Bland-Altman analysis, weighted Cohen kappa, intraclass correlation, and a four-category coding scheme separating diagnostic from confirmation feedback. The author, as the sole subject-matter expert for the course, provided the human benchmark, so the design assesses agreement with a domain-expert reference rather than inter-rater reliability. AI grading agreed strongly with human grading on totals (r = 0.97; MAE = 0.85 marks) with a small but significant AI-positive bias of 0.68 marks, showed excellent test-retest consistency (ICC = 0.96), and produced accurate feedback (92.8% diagnostic; 97.8% confirmation). Drawing items were the outlier on three of four measures. Three failure modes recurred: keyword matching without conceptual depth, selection-state ambiguity on corrected multiple-choice answers, and region-of-attention drift on hand-drawn diagrams. The findings suggest that AI grading at this capability level can assist instructors on objective and short-form items under structural safeguards but is not yet ready to replace instructor judgement at boundary cases or on drawing items.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估 Claude Code（Claude Opus 4.6 智能体部署）批改手写大学考卷的可靠性，与专家人工评分在总分、五类题型、跨会话一致性和反馈准确性上高度吻合，但绘画题是明显短板，尚不宜取代教师判断。
AI.motivation: AI 自动评分在教育场景需求增长，但手写试卷、尤其是含绘图题的批改可靠性缺乏实证检验，需明确其是否可替代或辅助教师评分。
AI.method: Claude Code 依据三份评分规则文件，一次性智能体会话批改 60 名学生 20 分制期中卷；RQ1、RQ2、RQ4 用 20 份，RQ3 用 15 份。采用 Pearson 相关、MAE、Bland-Altman、加权 Cohen kappa、ICC，以及区分诊断性与确认性反馈的四类编码方案；由课程唯一专家作为人工基准。
AI.result: 总分一致性 r=0.97、MAE=0.85，但存在 0.68 分的显著 AI 偏高偏差；重测一致性 ICC=0.96；反馈准确率 92.8%（诊断）与 97.8%（确认）；绘画题在四项指标中的三项表现异常。
AI.conclusion: 该能力水平的 AI 在结构保障下可辅助教师批改客观题与短答题，但在边界情形及绘画题上尚不能取代教师判断；需注意关键词匹配、选项状态歧义和注意力漂移三类失效模式。

title: Camera3R: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Heterogeneous Camera Models
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction (3R) from unconstrained multi-view images has recently emerged as a prominent research direction in 3D computer vision. Various foundational reconstruction models have been proposed with different architectures and reconstruction paradigms. Despite being trained on large-scale perspective datasets with substantial computational resources, these models generally struggle to generalize to non-perspective images. This limitation hinders their deployment in applications involving arbitrary, unknown, and potentially heterogeneous camera models. To build on the capabilities of existing reconstruction models with minimal retraining, we propose Camera3R, a low-rank adaptation framework that efficiently extends perspective-pretrained 3R networks to any other camera models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, with only 0.5% additional parameters and less than a day of training, Camera3R adapts a foundational 3D reconstruction model to non-perspective cameras while fully preserving its original performance on perspective inputs. Code is available at https://github.com/android-xr/camera3r.

AI.tldr: Camera3R：一种低秩适配框架，用极少参数将透视预训练的3D重建网络高效扩展到任意相机模型。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3D重建基础模型虽在大规模透视数据集上训练充分，但难以泛化到非透视图像，阻碍其在任意、未知甚至异构相机模型场景中的部署。
AI.method: 提出Camera3R低秩适配框架，在最小重训练代价下将透视预训练的3R网络扩展到其他相机模型，同时保持原有透视输入性能。
AI.result: 仅需0.5%额外参数、训练不到一天，即可将基础3D重建模型适配到非透视相机，且完全保留原始透视输入性能。
AI.conclusion: Camera3R提供了一种低成本、高保真的适配方案，显著提升前馈3R模型对非透视相机的泛化能力，便于实际部署。

title: LLM Validation Makes Minimal-Pair Benchmarks Easier for Language Models
summary: Minimal-pair benchmarks are only as good as their labels, and LLMs are an obvious substitute for costly human validation. We test it on BLiMP (English) and QFrBLiMP (Quebec French), the two public minimal-pair datasets releasing every forced-choice human judgment. Three LLMs validate by forced choice, by rating, and as a panel, scored against human panels of one, three and five judges in two pre-registered phases. On BLiMP, forced-choice validators agree with held-out human majorities more often than five-judge panels, yet catch far fewer pairs whose label humans reject than one judge does. By point estimate, no validator is worth more than one judge. The errors are not random. On both datasets, across 10 open LMs, human-supported pairs that the pre-registered LLM filter flags are 18.9 points harder than those it accepts, in all 70 LM-validator combinations, and harder than pairs a single human judge flags. Filtering thus removes items on which LMs fail but humans do not, raising accuracy more than random removal. A protocol frozen before any output replicates the gap and the lift on Dutch BLiMP-NL. LLM validation makes minimal-pair benchmarks easier for the models they are meant to test; we release code, validator outputs and item-level scores.

AI.tldr: 该论文测试用LLM替代人工校验最小配对基准数据集标签的可行性，发现LLM校验会系统性地删除"人类支持但LLM失败"的难样本，使基准对被测模型变得更简单。
AI.motivation: 最小配对基准（如BLiMP、QFrBLiMP）的质量取决于其标签的准确性，而人工校验成本高昂。LLM看似是人工校验的廉价替代品，但其可靠性尚未被系统评估，尤其是与人类评审团对照时的表现及其引入的偏差。
AI.method: 在BLiMP（英语）和QFrBLiMP（魁北克法语）上，采用强制选择、打分和评审团三种LLM校验方式，与1、3、5人的人类评审团对照，分两个预注册阶段评估。并分析了在10个开源LM、70个LM-校验器组合下方差与难度差异，另用预注册协议在荷兰语BLiMP-NL上复现。
AI.result: 在BLiMP上，强制选择校验器与留出人类多数意见的一致率高于五人评审团，但漏检人类拒绝的标签的比例远高于单人评审；点估计下没有校验器优于单个评委。错误非随机：人类支持的配对中，被LLM过滤器标记的样本比被接受的难18.9个百分点，全部70个组合均如此，且比单人评委标记的更难。过滤提升了准确率（超过随机删除），预注册协议在BLiMP-NL上复现了该差距与提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM校验会使最小配对基准在系统性上变得更简单，恰好删去了模型本应被测试的困难样本，因此不能简单替代人工校验；作者公开了代码、校验器输出和条目级分数。

title: Robust Flow Matching under Target Corruption and Label Noise
summary: Flow Matching (FM) is a strong framework for generative modeling due to its stable training and efficient sampling. However, FM assumes clean target data and labels, an assumption often violated in practice. We formulate FM training as a time-dependent regression problem over conditional vector fields and analyze how the two corruption types affect the objective: i) target corruption adds a time-dependent residual term that grows with time, ii) label noise causes updates to the wrong class-conditional vector field. Based on this analysis, we propose to improve FM robustness by mapping corruption-specific residual scores to sample weights. For target corruption, we propose the Temporal Residual Score (TRS), which emphasizes residual magnitudes at intermediate-to-late FM times, where clean and corrupted samples are more separable. For label noise, we propose the Comparative Conditional Score (CCS), which compares the residual of the observed class-conditional vector field against alternative class-conditional vector fields for the same trajectory and velocity target. Experiments across controlled corruption settings and real-world noisy labels show that the proposed methods improve robustness over standard FM and robust-training baselines, supporting corruption-specific residual structure as a practical basis for robust FM.

AI.tldr: 该论文将流匹配(FM)训练视为条件向量场上的时间相关回归问题，分析目标损坏与标签噪声两类污染对目标函数的影响，并提出基于污染特定残差分数的样本加权方法(TRS与CCS)来提升FM的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: FM训练假设目标数据与标签是干净的，但实际中常被违反；作者希望理解两类污染如何影响FM目标，并据此设计更鲁棒的训练方法。
AI.method: 将FM训练形式化为时间相关回归问题：分析出目标损坏会引入随时间增长的残差项，标签噪声会导致更新到错误的类条件向量场。基于此，用污染特定残差分数映射为样本权重：针对目标损坏提出Temporal Residual Score (TRS)，在FM中后期强调残差幅度（干净与损坏样本更易区分）；针对标签噪声提出Comparative Conditional Score (CCS)，同一轨迹与速度目标下比较观测类条件向量场残差与替代类条件向量场残差。
AI.result: 在受控污染设置与真实含噪标签实验中，所提方法相较标准FM和鲁棒训练基线均提升了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 污染特定的残差结构可作为实现鲁棒FM的实用基础。

title: W-ISA: Transactional Execution of Weight-Space Intervention Programs
summary: We present W-ISA, a software instruction set and transactional runtime for executing weight-space intervention programs on pretrained language models. Shape-checked instructions express parameter updates, projections, ablations, and rank-one transformations. The runtime applies these programs within request-scoped execution contexts and restores saved parameters after completion or interruption. Activation-based match-action rules connect measured model states to intervention selection. We evaluate restoration and replay on SmolLM-135M-Instruct and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, and compare materialized rank-one updates with equivalent PyTorch hooks on the latter. In 45 timed requests, both intervention implementations produce identical greedy sequences at 32, 128, and 512 tokens; their maximum prompt-logit difference is 0.000184. On the complete WikiText-2 raw test split, the combined SmolLM attention-head ablation and MLP projection changes perplexity from 22.2353 to 22.3188, a relative increase of 0.3754%. W-ISA separates intervention specification, execution, and measurement, making parameter-level experiments reproducible and composable.

AI.tldr: W-ISA是一个用于在预训练语言模型上执行权重空间干预程序的软件指令集与事务型运行时，支持形状检查的参数更新、投影、消融和秩一变换，并保证执行后参数恢复与回放。
AI.motivation: 现有权重空间干预实验（消融、投影、秩一更新）缺乏统一的规格、执行与测量分离机制，难以复现和组合；需要一种能在请求作用域内安全应用并自动恢复参数的事务化框架。
AI.method: 提出W-ISA：形状检查指令表达参数更新/投影/消融/秩一变换；运行时在请求级执行上下文中应用程序并在完成或中断后恢复参数；基于激活的匹配-动作规则将模型状态与干预选择关联。在SmolLM-135M-Instruct和Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上评估恢复与回放，并在后者上比较物化秩一更新与等价PyTorch hooks。
AI.result: 45次计时请求中，两种干预实现在32/128/512 token下产生完全相同的贪心序列，最大prompt-logit差异0.000184。WikiText-2 raw完整测试集上，SmolLM注意力头消融+MLP投影使困惑度从22.2353变为22.3188，相对上升0.3754%。
AI.conclusion: W-ISA将干预规格、执行与测量分离，使参数级实验可复现、可组合，且物化权重更新的数值效果与hook实现等价。

title: Hand-Object Contact Transition Detection in Egocentric Video
summary: This paper tackles the task of hand-object contact transition detection in egocentric video, which aims to localize the two temporal boundaries of a contact episode: the moment a hand first establishes contact with an object (touch) and the moment contact is released (release). We propose a unified framework that jointly models the interacting hand and object to accurately localize both transition types. The proposed framework augments hand-centric spatiotemporal representations with object-aware features learned directly from the video and introduces a transition-aware event spotting formulation tailored to contact transitions, without relying on external object or hand-object interaction detectors during inference. To support this task, we present ContactTransition, a dataset comprising 4,021 egocentric videos with 8,498 touch and 8,077 release annotations, together with object-of-interest supervision. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms strong two-stage and end-to-end event-spotting baselines on both transition types. Finally, we show that detected contact transitions provide effective temporal anchors for downstream egocentric hand-object reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架检测第一人称视频中手-物接触起始(touch)与结束(release)两个时间边界，并构建ContactTransition数据集，性能优于两阶段与端到端基线，且可作为下游手物推理的时间锚点。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注手物交互识别或检测，但接触事件的两个时间边界（首次接触与释放）定位尚缺专门任务与数据支持；依赖外部手/物体检测器也带来误差累积。
AI.method: 统一联合建模手与物：在以手为中心的时空表征上融合直接从视频学习的物体感知特征；引入面向接触转移的transition-aware event spotting（事件定位）公式；推理阶段不依赖外部物体或手物交互检测器。同时发布ContactTransition数据集（4,021段第一人称视频，8,498个touch与8,077个release标注，含目标物体监督）。
AI.result: 在两类转移（touch、release）上均稳定优于强两阶段与端到端event-spotting基线；检测到的接触转移可作为下游第一人称手物推理的有效时间锚点。
AI.conclusion: 联合手-物建模与转移感知的事件定位可有效检测接触转移，配套数据集填补任务空白，并证明其对下游时间定位任务的实用价值。

title: Antalia-2 Mini: A 7.6-million-parameter Turkish text-to-speech model trained entirely on synthetic speech
comment: 38 pages, 22 figures, 9 tables. Weights, inference code and benchmark harness: https://huggingface.co/cloud0day3/antalia-mini
summary: Antalia-2 Mini is a single-voice Turkish text-to-speech model with 7,620,931 parameters. It reads characters and produces 48 kHz audio at 41 times real time on an Apple M5 laptop CPU (2 threads). Its training audio came only from VoxCPM2 (the teacher), about 300 times larger, cloning one synthetic clip; automatic checks kept about 1,790 h. Fine-tuning the vocoder on the acoustic model's own mel spectrograms cut the word error rate (WER) of Whisper's transcripts from a mean of 3.89% to 1.75% at adjacent pre-release checkpoints. The teacher corrupts the start of a clip when the first word begins with ö, the student learned this, and a spoken prefix we cut from the output hides it. On the 495-sentence Freya-TR-Eval benchmark, where we tuned settings, version 1.0.1 has WER 1.09% and character error rate 0.22% on our public harness. A paired bootstrap cannot distinguish these from EMA Lightning, an 8.6M Turkish model, which scores higher on full-band UTMOS, an English-trained quality proxy. No human listening test exists. Weights, inference code and the benchmark harness are public under Apache-2.0; training code and data are not.

AI.tldr: Antalia-2 Mini 是一个仅 7.62M 参数的土耳其语单说话人 TTS 模型，完全以 VoxCPM2 合成音频蒸馏训练，在 MacBook CPU 上达到 41 倍实时，基准 WER 1.09%。
AI.motivation: 以极小参数量实现高效、高质量的土耳其语 TTS，并探索纯合成（教师蒸馏）数据训练路线的可行性与局限。
AI.method: 字符级输入、输出 48 kHz 音频；训练数据仅来自大 ~300 倍的教师模型 VoxCPM2，克隆约 300 条合成片段、自动筛选后保留约 1790 小时；在声学模型自身 mel 频谱上微调声码器；对教师首词以 ö 开头时的句首损坏，用截去语音前缀的方式规避。
AI.result: 声码器微调使 Whisper 转录 WER 从 3.89% 降至 1.75%（相邻预发布检查点）；Freya-TR-Eval 495 句上 v1.0.1 的 WER 1.09%、CER 0.22%，配对 bootstrap 无法与 8.6M 参数的 EMA Lightning 区分，后者在全频带 UTMOS（英语训练的质量代理指标）上更高。
AI.conclusion: 小型蒸馏 TTS 可达到与同类模型相当的识别可懂度，但缺少主观听测、质量评价依赖英语指标，且训练代码与数据未公开（仅权重、推理代码和基准以 Apache-2.0 发布）。

title: Stochastic Projections and Rank-Aware Learning Rates for Federated LoRA
summary: Fine-tuning large-scale foundation models across resource-constrained, distributed clients presents significant computational and communication challenges. While merging Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with Federated Learning (FL) enables rank-based flexibility, the interdependence of the adaptation matrices ($\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$) often complicates optimization. In this work, we theoretically demonstrate that LoRA fine-tuning with Gaussian initialization and a frozen $\mathbf{A}$ matrix acts as a stochastic approximation of full fine-tuning, where batch gradients are subject to a random, rank-dependent perturbation. Motivated by this insight, we propose freezing and periodically resampling $\mathbf{A}$ matrices at the client level. This strategy decouples the $\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$ gradients, diminishes LoRA low-rank constraints and reduces both computational and uplink communication overheads by 50\%, allowing for the reallocation of resources toward higher adaptation ranks. Furthermore, we show that in this frozen-$\mathbf{A}$ regime, the adaptation rank $r$ directly governs the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the perturbed gradients. Specifically, we find that the SNR increases linearly with $r$, implying that clients' learning rates must be dynamically scaled with their adaptation ranks for higher utility. Building on these foundations, we introduce SPRA-LoRA (Stochastic Projection Rank-Aware LoRA), a federated rank-aware fine-tuning strategy that utilizes frozen, resampled $\mathbf{A}$ matrices and rank-dependent learning rates for clients. We also prove its convergence with heterogeneous client resources. Our experiments across benchmark datasets demonstrate that SPRA-LoRA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with half the overhead on clients.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SPRA-LoRA：在联邦学习中对LoRA的A矩阵进行冻结并周期性重采样，理论证明该做法等价于带秩相关扰动的全量微调的随机近似，且SNR随秩r线性增长，据此设计秩相关学习率，可在降低50%计算与上行通信开销的同时提升性能。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的分布式客户端上微调大模型面临计算与通信瓶颈。LoRA与联邦学习结合虽提供秩级灵活性，但A、B矩阵相互依赖导致优化困难，且上传两个矩阵带来高昂通信成本。
AI.method: 理论上证明：高斯初始化且冻结A的LoRA微调是全量微调的随机近似，批次梯度带有随秩变化的随机扰动。基于此，在客户端层面冻结并周期性重采样A矩阵，解耦A、B梯度、削弱低秩约束、节省50%计算与上行通信，并将资源转投向更高适应秩。进一步证明冻结A下SNR随秩r线性增长，因此客户端学习率需按秩动态缩放。据此提出SPRA-LoRA，并证明其在客户端资源异构下的收敛性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，SPRA-LoRA持续优于现有SOTA基线，且客户端开销仅为一半。
AI.conclusion: 冻结并重采样A结合秩相关学习率是一种高效、可收敛的联邦LoRA微调方案，兼顾低开销与高性能。

title: Decisions by Discrimination: Differential Evidence for Medical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly studied for clinical decision support, and medical question answering provides a testbed for evaluating this capability. In particular, medical multiple-choice questions (MCQs) reflect a core challenge in clinical decision-making: plausible options often share overlapping evidence, while only a few decisive factors distinguish the correct option from incorrect ones. However, existing retrieval-based and reasoning-oriented methods mainly focus on supplying broadly relevant knowledge or eliciting reasoning paths, rather than identifying the compact differential evidence that separates confusing alternatives. In this work, we present a retrieval-grounded differential evidence framework for medical MCQs. Our method extracts option-specific pieces of differential evidence and organizes them into concise evidence prompts for answer selection. This design better aligns external knowledge with differential reasoning while reducing irrelevant context. Experiments show consistent accuracy gains across multiple datasets and target LLMs. Ablation studies further show that our framework outperforms both directly using retrieved evidence chunks and closed-source LLM-generated general hints, and that its improvements are not solely explained by answer-proximal guidance, but are consistent with differential evidence serving as a compact aid for reasoning over competing alternatives. Our findings also offer insights for medical reasoning and other decision-making settings with multiple possible choices.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于检索的"差异性证据"框架，为医学多选题抽取选项相关的判别性证据并组织成简洁提示，以区分易混淆选项，在多个数据集和目标LLM上取得稳定准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 医学多选题反映临床决策的核心难点：合理选项常共享重叠证据，仅少数决定性因素区分正误。现有检索式与推理式方法只提供宽泛相关知识或引出推理路径，未识别能区分易混淆选项的紧凑差异性证据。
AI.method: 抽取针对每个选项的差异性证据片段，并组织为简洁的证据提示用于答案选择，使外部知识与差异性推理对齐、减少无关上下文。
AI.result: 在多数据集和多目标LLM上准确率一致提升；消融显示优于直接使用检索证据块及闭源LLM生成的通用提示，且改进不能仅由答案邻近线索解释。
AI.conclusion: 差异性证据作为支持竞争选项推理的紧凑辅助有效，对医学推理及其他多选项决策场景具有启示。

title: When Reconstruction Helps Event-Camera Person Triggers
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, ancillary score tables and recomputation script
summary: Event cameras record asynchronous changes in brightness. To use a general visual model as a recording trigger, a system must represent these measurements in a form the model can interpret. We compare direct grayscale accumulation, two temporal encodings, and two intensity reconstructors on paired real event data. On 192 windows from four held-out DSEC recordings, thresholds calibrated only on development data yielded 40 of 52 person detections and 12 of 140 background positives with E2VID. The strongest direct temporal encoding at an admissible fixed cutoff yielded 14 detections and seven background positives. A retrospective comparison at a common 10% background-positive cap yielded 40 detections for E2VID and at most 19 for any direct encoding. FireNet+ had lower preparation cost and produced 21 detections with zero observed background positives at its frozen cutoff. On the same 192 windows, Qwen3-VL-4B yielded 33/52, 2/140 with E2VID and 9/52, 9/140 with the highest-recall direct rendering, the three-bin image (person detections, background positives). A 96-second exploratory replay illustrates the sensitivity of episode capture and recording starts to cutoff selection. The experiments identify a detection benefit from reconstruction under controlled input history and distinguish it from the cost and false starts of continuous triggering.

AI.tldr: 该论文在真实事件相机数据上比较了直接灰度累积、两种时间编码和两种强度重建方法作为"记录触发器"输入时的检测性能，发现重建方法（E2VID）在受控条件下检测收益最高但准备成本高、易产生误启动，FireNet+成本低但召回较低，探索性回放还显示触发阈值选择对事件捕获和录制起点很敏感。
AI.motivation: 事件相机异步记录亮度变化，若要用通用视觉模型作为记录触发器，需将事件测量表示为模型可解释的形式。论文旨在弄清不同表示方式（直接编码 vs. 强度重建）对触发检测能力的影响，并把检测收益与连续触发的成本和误启动区分开。
AI.method: 在配对的真实事件数据（四个留出DSEC录制中的192个窗口）上，比较两类表示：直接灰度累积与两种时间编码，以及两种强度重建器（E2VID、FireNet+）。阈值仅在开发数据上标定；以人物检测数和背景正例数作为指标，并采用统一的10%背景正例上限做回溯比较；另用Qwen3-VL-4B作为下游视觉模型测试；并进行96秒探索性回放考察阈值对片段捕获和录制起点的影响。
AI.result: E2VID在标定阈值下获40/52人物检测、12/140背景正例；最强直接时间编码在可接受固定阈值下仅14检测、7背景正例；在10%背景正例上限下E2VID达40检测，任何直接编码最多19；FireNet+准备成本更低，冻结阈值下21检测、零背景正例；Qwen3-VL-4B下E2VID为33/52、2/140，最高召回直接渲染（三箱图像）为9/52、9/140。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，在受控输入历史下强度重建带来明确的检测收益，但也伴随更高的准备成本和连续触发中的误启动；直接编码成本低但召回受限，阈值选择显著影响事件捕获与录制起点。

title: PolyRoute: A Twelve-Language and Code-Mixed Benchmark for Typed-Decision Routing, with Baselines and a Leaderboard
summary: Typed-decision encoders answer a question about a text in one forward pass, but their behaviour outside English is rarely measured on a fixed yardstick. We release PolyRoute: 322 native-language support messages in 12 languages and 9 writing systems, 156 code-mixed or romanised messages (Hinglish, Spanglish, Arabizi), 967 optional native training rows, and a protocol for a three-way department-routing decision. Labels come from Qwen3.8-27B with a blind second pass (91% of candidates kept); an independent model, gemma4-31b, agrees on 97.2% of test items, and the largest character 5-gram similarity between any test text and any training text is 0.33. A leaderboard of 13 systems gives 61.2% for the English-root checkpoint, 77.3% for the shipped multilingual one and 96.6% for the best fine-tune; TF-IDF with logistic regression reaches 91.9%. On four withheld languages the three multilingual systems score 77%, 90% and 93%. On code-mixed text the English root (85%) is nominally ahead of the shipped multilingual checkpoint (79%; p=0.134). The split resolves differences only above about 4 points. All texts and labels are LLM-generated.

AI.tldr: 提出多语言路由评测基准PolyRoute，用统一协议衡量typed-decision编码器在12种语言、9种文字系统及混合/罗马化文本上的表现，揭示英语根模型与多语模型的取舍及基准的区分度边界。
AI.motivation: typed-decision编码器（单次前向即可回答文本问题的模型）在英语之外的行为缺乏统一标尺的测量，尤其缺少对非英语、混合语码与罗马化输入的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建PolyRoute：322条12语言9文字系统的母语支持消息、156条混合语码/罗马化消息（Hinglish、Spanglish、Arabizi）、967条可选母语训练样本，并设计三路部门路由决策协议。标签由Qwen3.8-27B生成并做盲二次校验（保留91%候选），独立模型gemma4-31b在97.2%测试项上一致，测试与训练文本最大字符5-gram相似度仅0.33。对13个系统进行排行榜比较，含TF-IDF+逻辑回归基线，并做四个留出语言与混合语码分析。
AI.result: 13系统榜单：英语根检查点61.2%，随发布的多语检查点77.3%，最佳微调96.6%，TF-IDF+LR达91.9%。四个留出语言上三个多语系统分别为77%、90%、93%。混合语码上英语根85%名义上领先多语检查点79%（p=0.134）。该测试集仅能区分约4个百分点以上的差异。
AI.conclusion: PolyRoute提供了可复现的多语路由基准，表明英语根模型在本题上明显弱于多语模型、而简单TF-IDF基线竞争力强；但基准统计功效有限（约4点阈值），且全部文本与标签为LLM生成，结论需谨慎外推。

title: Advancing Mass-Conserving Deep Learning for Distributed Hydrologic Modeling: A Case Study in a Snow-Dominated Watershed
summary: Recent progress in physics-aware deep learning (DL) has embedded mass conservation within Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture for hydrologic modeling, improving physical consistency and enabling diagnostics of internal states. However, existing mass-conserving neural networks are primarily developed in lumped formulations. Consequently, previous studies provide only fragmented and often indirect evidence of when and why imposed physical constraints may lead to unrealistic hydrologic behavior. To address this limitation, we propose Physics-Enhanced Conservation-Augmented Net (PECAN), a mass-conserving convolutional LSTM-based framework for distributed hydrologic modeling and diagnosing structural limitations of physics-aware DL models. PECAN is implemented in two variants: (1) PECAN-MC with a strict precipitation-based conservation constraint and (2) PECAN-MCR with a relaxed conservation constraint allowing additional water inputs beyond precipitation. Both variants are trained solely on gauge streamflow and evaluated in a snow-dominated watershed in Colorado. We benchmark PECAN against lumped DL baselines and the distributed process-based Variable Infiltration Capacity (VIC) model. Results show that PECAN achieves competitive outlet streamflow simulation accuracy while producing spatially explicit latent states for interpretation. Comparisons with reference soil moisture indicate that PECAN cell states resemble meaningful temporal soil moisture dynamics. However, analyses also reveal that PECAN misrepresents snow processes by prematurely removing winter snow water storage from the system rather than retaining it for spring release. PECAN demonstrates accurate streamflow simulation at gauges and shows diagnostic potential to expose structural limitations in hydrologic process representation, thereby informing future physics-aware neural network development for hydrology.

AI.tldr: 提出分布式质量守恒卷积LSTM框架PECAN（MC/MCR两变体），在雪主导流域验证：径流模拟具竞争力且隐状态有物理意义，但雪过程表征错误（过早释放冬季雪储）。
AI.motivation: 现有质量守恒神经网络多为集总式，只能提供零散、间接的证据说明物理约束何时、为何导致不合理水文行为，缺乏分布式框架下的直接诊断能力。
AI.method: 构建基于卷积LSTM的分布式质量守恒框架PECAN，分两变体：PECAN-MC采用严格的降水驱动守恒约束，PECAN-MCR允许降水之外额外水分输入的松弛约束；仅用测站径流训练，在科罗拉多雪主导流域与集总DL基线及分布式过程模型VIC对比。
AI.result: 出口径流精度具竞争力，可输出空间显式隐状态；单元状态与参考土壤湿度的时间动态相似，具可解释性；但雪过程失真——冬季雪水当量被过早移出系统而非滞留至春季释放。
AI.conclusion: PECAN在测站径流模拟准确，并具备诊断潜力，可揭示水文过程表征的结构性局限，为未来物理感知神经网络开发提供指导。

title: NCP: Verifier-Guided Optimization of Weight-Space Control Policies
summary: We present the Neural Control Plane (NCP), a closed-loop system that observes language-model execution, synthesizes candidate weight-space intervention rules, evaluates them, and maintains a versioned table of admitted policies. NCP separates a pretrained model's inference data plane from the control policy that selects temporary parameter interventions. W-ISA supplies transactional execution and parameter restoration; NCP supplies telemetry, candidate synthesis, admission criteria, priorities, and rule lifetime management. The optimization state consists of active rules and an archive of evaluated candidates, while base-model parameters are restored after each request. In a local SmolLM-135M-Instruct experiment, NCP generated three candidates from development telemetry and evaluated them on separate task examples and a 4,095-target WikiText-2 slice. One projection reduced validation token repetition from 0.4133 to 0.2191, with a perplexity change of -0.0574%. All candidates produced zero newly correct exact answers, so the configured admission gate archived all three and retained the original active policy. Fresh-process repetition and saved-table resumption reproduced the measured outcomes. NCP provides an executable framework for studying recursive self-improvement at the control-policy level through explicit synthesis, verification, and state transitions.

AI.tldr: 提出神经控制平面（NCP），将模型推理的数据平面与控制策略分离，通过闭环的规则合成—评估—准入流程在权重空间实施可撤销的临时干预。
AI.motivation: 探索递归自我改进，但需在控制策略层面而非参数层面进行，要求明确的候选合成、验证与状态转移机制。
AI.method: NCP 观测语言模型执行，合成候选权重干预规则并评估，维护版本化已准入策略表；W-ISA 提供事务化执行与参数复原，NCP 提供遥测、候选合成、准入标准、优先级与规则生命周期管理；优化状态仅含活跃规则与候选档案，每次请求后恢复基座参数。
AI.result: 在 SmolLM-135M-Instruct 本地实验中，从开发遥测生成3个候选，在独立任务样例与4095目标 WikiText-2 切片上评估：一个投影将验证集 token 重复从0.4133降至0.2191，困惑度变化 −0.0574%；但所有候选均未产生新正确精确答案，准入门归档全部3个候选并保留原策略；新进程复现与保存表恢复均重现结果。
AI.conclusion: NCP 为在控制策略层面研究递归自我改进提供了可执行框架，验证了显式合成、验证与状态转移的可行性，其准入门有效阻止无收益干预。

title: Reasoning-Aware Relational Representation Learning for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026, codes are available at project page https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/RaRe
summary: Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation (OV-SGG) requires models to recognize visual relationships beyond the training vocabulary, yet existing methods often rely on dataset-specific object--predicate co-occurrence patterns. Under long-tailed distributions and noisy object localization, such reliance leads to biased, entangled relation representations, limiting both rare-relation recognition and generalization to unseen predicates. To address these challenges, we propose RaRe, a reasoning-aware relational representation learning framework that transforms MLLM-generated chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales into structured relation embeddings. Rather than using CoT only as an intermediate reasoning trace for final prediction, RaRe directly optimizes the rationale-derived representation space to improve inter-relation discriminability. Specifically, RaRe first aligns rationale embeddings with textualized relation descriptions through self-supervised contrastive learning, and then refines rationale generation with a specificity-oriented reinforcement learning objective that encourages semantically object-pair-specific relational evidence. Experiments on VG150 and PSG demonstrate improved category-balanced recognition over existing baselines, while the additional gains from learning vary across datasets and proposal settings. Code available at: https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/RaRe.

AI.tldr: RaRe 将 MLLM 生成的思维链（CoT）理由转化为结构化关系嵌入，并直接优化该理由表示空间以提升开放词汇场景图生成的关系判别性。
AI.motivation: 现有 OV-SGG 方法依赖数据集特定的物体—谓词共现模式，在长尾分布与噪声定位下导致关系表示有偏且纠缠，限制稀有关系识别与未见谓词泛化。
AI.method: 两阶段：先用自监督对比学习将理由嵌入与文本化关系描述对齐；再用面向特异性的强化学习目标精炼理由生成，促使模型产出针对具体物体对的关系证据。
AI.result: 在 VG150 与 PSG 上相比基线取得更好的类别均衡识别效果；但学习带来的额外增益因数据集与 proposal 设置不同而有差异。
AI.conclusion: 将 CoT 理由用于直接监督表示空间（而非仅作中间推理）可缓解共现偏置、提升关系可分性，但收益存在设置依赖性。

title: Alania-2: Turkish text-to-speech with instant and fine-tuned voice cloning
comment: 21 pages, 11 figures, 10 tables. Evaluation harness and results: https://huggingface.co/datasets/PatientdeskAI/freya-tr-eval-rerun
summary: We present Alania-2, a Turkish text-to-speech (TTS) system with two built-in voices, voice design from text descriptions, and two kinds of voice cloning. Alania-2 is a 488M-parameter model with the VoxCPM architecture, which generates continuous audio latents with a diffusion head on top of a language-model backbone. We train it from scratch on 18,195 hours of Turkish speech, 90% of which is synthetic speech produced by a larger teacher model and filtered automatically. A text normalizer rewrites numbers, abbreviations and foreign names into the words a Turkish speaker would say; without it, none of 96 test sentences with digits kept all its critical parts, such as an amount or a date, through synthesis and speech recognition, against 86 with it. On Freya-TR-Eval, a public benchmark of 495 Turkish sentences scored with automatic speech recognition, Alania-2 reaches a word error rate of 1.44%, compared with 5.99% for our previous system. On its built-in voices, it comes within half a point of character error rate of a 2.3B-parameter model at under a quarter of the size, and a 7.6M-parameter single-voice model trained with the same recipe matches the most intelligible systems we measured, which suggests that training data matters more for intelligibility than model size. We also report practical findings on voice cloning: conditioning on the reference audio alone, rather than continuing it, cuts skipped words from 21.9% to 1.7%; 20-30 seconds of reference audio works best; and a low-rank adapter trained in about two minutes raises speaker similarity well above instant cloning. Finally, we describe inference-engine changes that bring first audio down to 32 ms for a single stream. We release our evaluation harness and three Turkish speech and text datasets.

AI.tldr: Alania-2 是一个 488M 参数、基于 VoxCPM 架构的土耳其语 TTS 系统，含两个内置音色、文本描述设计音色与两种声音克隆；在 18,195 小时土耳其语语音上从零训练，Freya-TR-Eval 词错率 1.44%（前系统 5.99%），并指出数据比模型规模更影响可懂度。
AI.motivation: 土耳其语缺乏高质量 TTS 系统，且现有系统在数字/缩写/外来语等文本处理与声音克隆稳定性上存在问题，作者希望以较小模型规模达到接近大模型的可懂度，并总结训练数据与克隆策略的实践经验。
AI.method: 采用 VoxCPM 架构（语言模型骨干 + 扩散头生成连续音频 latent），488M 参数，从零在 18,195 小时土耳其语语音上训练，其中 90% 为更大教师模型合成并由自动流程过滤的语音；加入文本归一化器处理数字、缩写和外来人名；支持文本描述音色设计与两种声音克隆（含约两分钟训练的低秩适配器）；并优化推理引擎。
AI.result: Freya-TR-Eval（495 句）词错率 1.44%，前系统为 5.99%；含数字的 96 句测试中，有归一化时 86 句保留关键信息，无归一化时为零。内置音色字符错率与 2.3B 模型相差不到半个百分点而规模不到其四分之一；7.6M 单音色模型以同配方训练可匹配最可懂系统。克隆方面：仅以参考音频为条件（而非续接）使漏词率从 21.9% 降至 1.7%；20–30 秒参考音频效果最佳；低秩适配器显著提升相似度。推理首包音频延迟降至 32 ms。
AI.conclusion: Alania-2 以较小参数规模实现了土耳其语高可懂度 TTS，表明训练数据质量比模型规模更决定可懂度，并给出克隆条件方式、参考音频长度与适配器微调等实用结论；同时开源评测工具与三个土耳其语语音/文本数据集。

title: When Are Predictions Enough? An Evaluation Protocol for Frozen Expert Composition
summary: Practitioners often combine independently trained models while keeping their weights frozen. These experts are commonly combined through their final predictions, although their internal features may retain useful information that those predictions omit. We ask when combining features improves on combining predictions, and how to make that comparison fair. We introduce a reusable evaluation protocol, apply it to 21 frozen deepfake detectors from DF40 (Yan et al., 2024), and audit how evaluation choices change the conclusions. The protocol uses strong prediction baselines, compares simple and larger feature combiners, varies architecture and training data separately, and reports results by held-out generator with train/test overlap controls. Under leave-one-generator-out evaluation, logistic regression on the features of six architecture-diverse experts improves macro AUROC by 0.081 over the best tested prediction combiner in each fold, with gains on seven of eight generators. The larger network shows no clear improvement over the linear model (approximately 3.5M versus 10K parameters), suggesting that access to richer information matters more than additional combiner capacity on this pool. Features may help when they retain information that the predictions omit and that transfers to new generators. Predictions may be enough when the strongest prediction baseline already performs well, while neither approach reliably compensates for poor expert transfer. Weakening prediction baselines on the overlap-affected standard split inflates the apparent feature advantage by up to 0.172 AUROC. Overlap-aware evaluation also changes the estimated gain, though the contrast does not isolate overlap. Results by generator and expert pool show where the advantage holds, weakens, or reverses. Without these controls, the same benchmark can support different conclusions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一套可复用的评估协议，系统比较"融合特征"与"融合预测"两种组合冻结模型的方式，并在21个DF40深度伪造检测器上进行审计。
AI.motivation: 实践中常把独立训练的专家模型通过最终预测组合，但其内部特征可能保留预测所遗漏的有用信息；同时已有比较往往因评估选择不当而不公平，需要回答"何时融合特征优于融合预测"以及"如何公平比较"。
AI.method: 提出可复用评估协议：使用强预测基线，比较简单与更大的特征融合器，分别改变架构与训练数据，按留出生成器报告并控制训练/测试重叠；在21个DF40冻结检测器上应用，采用留一生成器（LOGO）评估与逻辑回归特征融合。
AI.result: LOGO评估下，对6个架构多样专家特征做逻辑回归，宏AUROC比最佳预测融合器每折提升0.081，8个生成器中7个有增益；更大网络（约3.5M参数）相比线性模型（约10K）无明显提升；削弱预测基线可使表面特征优势虚高至0.172 AUROC；重叠感知评估会改变估计增益。
AI.conclusion: 当特征保留了预测所遗漏且能迁移到新生成器的信息时，特征融合更有益；当最强预测基线已表现良好时预测融合可能足够；两者都无法弥补专家迁移不佳。评估选择会显著改变结论，需重叠控制与分生成器报告。

title: Dark Matters: VAE-Aware HDR Encoding for SDR-to-HDR Video Reconstruction
summary: SDR-to-HDR reconstruction is an ill-posed problem in which clipped highlights, crushed shadows, and quantization artifacts must be recovered while preserving the original content. Latent diffusion models provide powerful generative priors for restoring missing detail, but their effectiveness is constrained by how HDR signals pass through the pretrained VAE. We find that common log-like encodings suppress low-luminance chromatic differences before generation, producing a dark-side collapse in the frozen-VAE latent. We introduce EquivFlow, a compact, invertible exposure-equivariant encoding that maps exposure changes to additive shifts while retaining a scale-independent chromatic component, without modifying the VAE. Encoding-level tests across pretrained image and video VAEs show that its exposure structure and deep-dark chroma transport persist across the tested hosts. Integrated into SDR-to-HDR video diffusion, EquivFlow delivers consistent chromatic-fidelity gains across the tested settings while retaining competitive reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出EquivFlow，一种紧凑可逆的曝光等变编码，将曝光变化映射为加性平移并保留尺度无关的色度分量，无需修改预训练VAE，即可改善SDR-to-HDR扩散重建中的暗部色度坍缩问题。
AI.motivation: SDR-to-HDR重建是不适定问题，需恢复过曝高光、压暗阴影和量化伪影。潜扩散模型虽有强生成先验，但其效果受限于HDR信号如何通过预训练VAE：常见的对数类编码会在生成前压低低亮度色度差异，导致冻结VAE潜空间出现"暗侧坍缩"。
AI.method: 提出EquivFlow：紧凑、可逆、曝光等变的编码方案，把曝光变化转化为加性平移，同时保留一个尺度无关的色度分量，且不修改VAE本身。在多个预训练图像与视频VAE上做编码层测试，并将其集成进SDR-to-HDR视频扩散流程。
AI.result: 编码层测试表明其曝光结构与深层暗部色度传输在所测宿主VAE上均能保持；集成到视频扩散后，在测试设置下获得一致的色度保真度提升，同时保持有竞争力的重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: 无需改动冻结VAE，仅通过改进HDR信号进入潜空间前的编码方式（曝光等变、保留色度），即可有效缓解暗部色度坍缩，并提升SDR-to-HDR视频重建的色度保真度。

title: Beyond Passive Imitation: On-Policy Mid-Training Distillation for Language Models
summary: Continual pre-training (CPT) adapts large language models (LLMs) to specialized domains, yet its standard next-token prediction (NTP) objective treats every corpus token as a fixed target, regardless of its utility to the current model. In a controlled study on the same 1B-token mathematical corpus, we observe sharply different outcomes across base models: NTP improves Llama-3.2-3B's performance on mathematical benchmarks but substantially degrades Qwen3-1.7B-Base's performance, indicating that, under a fixed training recipe, the same training sequences can have model-dependent effects. To address this problem, we introduce On-Policy Mid-Training Distillation (OPMD), which reformulates mid-training from offline text imitation into active, query-driven knowledge acquisition. At selected anchor positions, OPMD samples trajectories from the evolving student policy and applies dense token-level reverse-KL rewards from a frozen teacher, training the model on states it actually visits rather than only on ground-truth prefixes. This on-policy objective reduces the training-generation mismatch of teacher-forced NTP. On MATH-500 and Minerva, OPMD improves the Qwen student over its base performance and outperforms the evaluated NTP baseline, which degrades on both benchmarks. OPMD integrates into CPT pipelines without added inference-time overhead and offers a model-aware alternative to passive domain adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出持续预训练(CPT)的下一词预测(NTP)目标对每个token一视同仁，会导致同一训练配方在不同基座模型上效果迥异，并提出On-Policy Mid-Training Distillation (OPMD)，将中期训练重构为on-policy、查询驱动的知识获取，在选定锚点位置采样学生自身轨迹并用冻结教师给出密集token级reverse-KL奖励进行蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 标准NTP把语料中每个token都当作固定目标，不区分其对当前模型的效用。作者在同一1B token数学语料的对照实验中发现：NTP提升了Llama-3.2-3B的数学基准表现，却显著损害了Qwen3-1.7B-Base，说明相同训练序列在固定配方下会因模型而异，需要一种模型感知的适应方法。
AI.method: 提出OPMD：在选定的锚点位置从不断演化的学生策略中采样轨迹，并由冻结教师给出密集token级reverse-KL奖励，使模型在实际访问到的状态上训练，而非仅依赖真实前缀；该on-policy目标缓解了教师强制NTP带来的训练-生成不匹配，可无缝集成到CPT流程中，且不增加推理时开销。
AI.result: 在MATH-500与Minerva上，OPMD使Qwen学生模型相较其基座表现有所提升，并优于所评估的NTP基线——后者在两个基准上均出现退化。
AI.conclusion: 以on-policy蒸馏替代被动式离线文本模仿，是面向领域持续预训练的一种模型感知替代方案，能在避免性能退化的情况下提升下游数学能力。

title: Dependable Long-Horizon LLM Agents: A Trajectory-Centered Empirical Study of Where Errors Enter and Which Controls Reach Them
summary: When an LLM agent fails part-way through a long task, the usual analysis records a symptom: a failure-mode label, or the agent and step judged responsible. It does not say where the error entered, which state carried it to the symptom, whether anything in the trajectory contradicted it, or which control could have caught it. We define an episode record that ties a candidate fault to its origin, propagation, detection, response and consequence, located by operational phase and state domain, and that names the control families whose observation and reach cover it. We turned the record into a written annotation protocol and applied it to 95 failed runs of six multi-agent systems from the public Who&When and MAD corpora, reading each trajectory in full. Faults enter early (median at 0.18 of the run), mostly as wrong decisions or fabrications over task state, and in 37 of 88 Who&When runs before the step the corpus' human labels mark as decisive. In 72% of failed runs the trajectory already contained evidence against the error before the failure; in 88% of those no agent acted on it. Something flagged a deviation in 31% of runs, but no response removed the deviated state. Independent judges reading the unused evidence, task contracts fixed at admission, and re-checking beliefs against the environment reach most episodes; restoring the agent's own state would have sufficed in 35 of 95 runs.
