A text scan of the raw corpus also shows that 45% of the hand-crafted Who&When failures ended with a provider content-filter crash after which the harness emitted a final answer no agent produced, a failure class that neither symptom taxonomies nor responsible-agent labels represent. Protocol, records and scripts are included.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"情节记录"（episode record）标注协议，把故障的起源、传播、检测、响应与后果串联起来，并对95个多智能体系统失败轨迹做人工细读分析，揭示现有失败标签忽略的关键结构信息。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体失败分析只记录症状（失败模式标签或归责的agent/步骤），无法回答错误从何进入、经由什么状态传播到症状、轨迹中是否有矛盾证据、哪种控制手段能捕获它。因此需要一种更细粒度的失败记录范式。
AI.method: 定义以运行阶段和状态域定位的情节记录，关联候选故障的起源、传播、检测、响应与后果，并指明覆盖它的控制族。将其转为书面标注协议，应用于6个多智能体系统、来自公开Who&When与MAD语料的95次失败运行，逐条通读轨迹。另对原始语料做文本扫描。
AI.result: 故障普遍出现较早（中位位置为运行的0.18处），多为针对任务状态的错误决策或捏造；88个Who&When运行中37个早于人工标注的关键步骤。72%失败运行在失败前轨迹已含反对该错误的证据，其中88%无agent据此行动；31%运行有偏离信号但无响应消除偏离状态。独立裁判读未用证据、准入时固定任务契约、用环境复检信念可覆盖多数情节；恢复agent自身状态即可修好95次中的35次。文本扫描还发现45%手工构造的Who&When失败以provider内容过滤崩溃结束，随后harness输出无agent生成的最终答案，此类失败不被现有分类学或归责标签表征。
AI.conclusion: 基于症状的失败标签漏掉了大量可操作信息；应从起源—传播—检测—响应的过程视角记录失败，并将证据复核、任务契约与环境信念校验纳入控制设计。文中协议、记录与脚本已公开。

title: Distribution Shift Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery using Machine Learning Models
comment: Accepted as a short paper at the 4th Workshop on Computer Vision for Earth Observation (CV4EO), held in conjunction with WACV 2027
summary: Remote sensing imagery acquired by Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) supports wide range of applications; however, deploying machine learning (ML) models on resource-constrained aerial platforms introduces challenges beyond predictive accuracy, particularly when deployment data differ from the distributions observed during training. Such shifts are common in remote sensing due to geographic, sensor, seasonal, and other visual variations. A practical solution is to equip deployed models with mechanisms that detect emerging distribution shifts and support subsequent responsive actions. This paper presents an empirical case study of three open-source detection tools: (i) Alibi-Detect; (ii) NannyML; and (iii) PyTorch-OOD. Using cross-dataset remote-sensing shifts, we evaluate both detection effectiveness and computational latency of these tools. Our results reveal differences in detection behavior and processing cost across methods and implementations, highlighting trade-offs between detection capability and response-time. These findings motivate further work toward lightweight, and latency-aware monitoring mechanisms for resource-constrained systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过跨数据集遥感分布偏移场景，实证对比 Alibi-Detect、NannyML 和 PyTorch-OOD 三种开源漂移/OOD检测工具，分析其检测效果与计算延迟的权衡。
AI.motivation: UAV遥感平台资源受限，且部署数据常因地理、传感器、季节等因素偏离训练分布；仅关注预测精度不足，需要能检测分布偏移并触发响应的轻量机制，但现有工具在此场景下的表现与开销尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建跨数据集的遥感分布偏移实验，在统一设置下对三种开源检测工具（Alibi-Detect、NannyML、PyTorch-OOD）同时评估检测有效性与推理延迟。
AI.result: 不同方法与实现之间存在检测行为和计算开销的明显差异，呈现出检测能力与响应时间之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 现有工具难以直接满足资源受限平台需求，需进一步研究轻量化、延迟感知的监控机制。

title: Beyond Fluent Responses: Finding User Dissatisfaction in Human-AI Interactions
summary: As large language models generate increasingly high-quality responses, recent work on response evaluation has moved beyond response-centered criteria, such as correctness and coherence, toward user-centered criteria, including user preferences and perceived usefulness. This shift is fundamentally important for developing technologies that are truly useful to real-world users. While conventional response evaluation quantifies the quality of the response itself, users' satisfaction in real conversations also depends on their subjective preferences and perceptions of usefulness, which do not necessarily align with response quality. This study investigates whether such user-centered signals can be detected from conversational text. Specifically, we analyze user utterances with self-reported dissatisfaction labels to examine whether user dissatisfaction in text can be detected. In English interaction, models using user utterances exceeded the 17.8% dissatisfaction label prevalence in AUPRC by up to 15 percentage points. These results suggest that user utterances reveal cues to implicit dissatisfaction. Furthermore, changes from the immediately preceding user utterance may improve dissatisfaction detection, with anomaly detection methods appearing particularly effective.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验能否从对话文本（尤其是用户话语）中检测用户自报的不满，英文交互中基于用户话语的模型AUPRC超过17.8%的不满标签基线最高15个百分点，且使用相对前一轮用户话语的变化并结合异常检测方法可进一步提升效果。
AI.motivation: 响应评估正从以响应为中心（正确性、连贯性）转向以用户为中心（偏好、感知有用性），但用户满意度受主观偏好影响，不一定与响应质量一致，因此需要探究用户中心信号能否从对话文本中被检测出来。
AI.method: 使用带自报不满标签的用户话语进行分析，构建基于用户话语的不满检测模型，并考察用户话语相对紧邻上一轮话语的变化，采用异常检测方法进行检测。
AI.result: 英文交互中，使用用户话语的模型在AUPRC上超过17.8%的不满标签流行率基线，最高提升15个百分点；用户话语相对前一轮的变化可改善不满检测，异常检测方法尤为有效。
AI.conclusion: 用户话语中蕴含隐含不满的线索，可作为用户中心评估的有效信号；结合话语变化与异常检测能提升检测性能。

title: Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache: Recurrent Depth for Causal Encoder-Decoders
comment: 23 pages (11 pages main text), 10 figures, 14 tables
summary: Looped language models deepen computation without adding parameters, yet caching full-context key-value (KV) states across layers and rounds severely bounds serving batch size. We design a looped causal encoder-decoder (CED) that achieves recurrent depth with zero round-wise KV growth, addressing where and how to loop an asymmetric stack in which only sparse encoder layers generate global KV. We find that recurrence must be placed in the encoder to iteratively refine global KV representations rather than re-reading static decoder projections, which both drives language-modeling gains and preserves long-context scaling. Furthermore, training the encoder loop under stochastic recurrence depth induces a fixed-point equilibrium where every round losslessly shares the last round's KV cache. Compounding cross-layer and cross-round KV sharing, the resulting Looped CED matches an unlooped CED's minimal memory footprint and recovers 86-93% of a looped Transformer's gain with 1/6 of its global KV. To test serving at production scale, we loop the 552B-parameter DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash for 8 rounds on one 4xGB200 node: with per-layer and per-round KV the loop cannot fit a single 128K-token request, whereas Looped CED holds 36.8x less KV per token, fits 38 such requests (as many as the unlooped model), and serves 3.6x higher throughput on 8K-token prompts.

AI.tldr: 提出Looped CED架构，将循环深度放在编码器以迭代精炼全局KV，配合随机深度训练实现跨轮KV无损复用，从而在零轮次KV增长下获得循环模型的收益，并在552B模型上显著提升服务容量与吞吐。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型能在不增加参数的情况下加深计算，但跨层跨轮缓存全上下文KV状态会严重限制服务批大小。现有非对称编码器-解码器栈中，何处以及如何循环尚不清楚。
AI.method: 设计循环因果编码器-解码器（CED）：仅稀疏编码器层生成全局KV，循环置于编码器以迭代精炼全局KV；在随机循环深度下训练编码器循环，使其收敛到定点均衡，各轮可无损共享最后一轮的KV缓存；叠加跨层与跨轮KV共享。
AI.result: Looped CED内存占用与无循环CED相当，以1/6的全局KV恢复循环Transformer收益的86–93%。在552B参数DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上循环8轮，单4xGB200节点：逐层逐轮KV连一个128K请求都放不下，而Looped CED每token KV少36.8倍，可容纳38个此类请求，8K提示吞吐提升3.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 在非对称栈中循环应放在编码器侧以精炼全局KV；随机深度训练带来的定点性质使跨轮KV共享成为可能，从而在大规模服务场景下兼得循环计算的表达力与实用内存/吞吐。

title: Towards Scalable Network-Based Interventions for HIV Treatment and Prevention via R2C-Agent
summary: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) remains a pressing public health challenge worldwide. Targeting limited HIV prevention and treatment resources effectively with network-based algorithms is a long-standing problem with a rich history at AAMAS and other computational venues. However, optimizing targeted biomedical interventions for minimizing spread of HIV often requires observability of the contact network of HIV transmission risk behavior among individuals, which is prohibitively expensive to collect at scale. Peer referral networks, i.e., networks collected through a recursive peer referral process, are an alternative network class often used to study HIV in hidden populations that can be collected digitally at scale, but they deviate from the underlying contact network: referrals can follow non-risk social ties and participants accept only one referral, hiding contacts among already-recruited individuals. In this work, we first formalize the novel problem of planning network-based interventions to minimize HIV spread in the hidden contact network while observing only the peer referral network. Second, we implement R2C-Agent, a decision making agent for interventions that is designed around our new conditional graph diffusion model called Referral-to-Contact Diffusion (R2C-Diff). R2C-Diff positions the peer referral process as incremental corruption of the underlying contact network and learns to reverse it. R2C-Agent plans its interventions over contact networks sampled from R2C-Diff, so its decisions account for uncertainty about the hidden contact network. Finally, we conduct simulated experiments using real-world HIV network data that demonstrate that R2C-Agent empirically plans more effective interventions than baselines from interdisciplinary literature and highlight key tradeoffs and assumptions driving performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在只能观测到同伴推荐网络（peer referral network）的情况下，对隐藏的HIV传播接触网络进行干预规划的新问题，并给出R2C-Agent决策代理与R2C-Diff条件图扩散模型，仿真实验表明其干预效果优于跨学科基线方法。
AI.motivation: HIV仍是全球重大公共卫生挑战，用网络算法高效分配有限的预防与治疗资源是AAMAS等领域长期关注的问题。但优化靶向生物医学干预通常需要个体间HIV风险行为接触网络的可观测性，而大规模采集该网络成本极高。同伴推荐网络可在隐藏人群中数字化、规模化地收集，但它与真实接触网络存在偏差：推荐可能沿非风险的社会关系传播，且参与者只接受一次推荐，导致已被招募者之间的联系被隐藏。
AI.method: 首先形式化"仅观测同伴推荐网络、却要在隐藏接触网络上规划干预以最小化HIV传播"的新问题。其次实现R2C-Agent决策代理，其核心是条件图扩散模型Referral-to-Contact Diffusion（R2C-Diff）：将同伴推荐过程建模为对底层接触网络的增量式破坏（corruption），并学习其逆向过程以从推荐网络推断接触网络。R2C-Agent在由R2C-Diff采样得到的接触网络上规划干预，从而在决策中考虑隐藏接触网络的不确定性。
AI.result: 在使用真实HIV网络数据的仿真实验中，R2C-Agent规划出的干预比来自跨学科文献的基线方法更有效，并揭示了驱动性能的关键权衡与假设。
AI.conclusion: 在仅有同伴推荐网络可观测的现实约束下，通过图扩散模型刻画推荐过程对接触网络的破坏并采样多种可能的隐藏接触网络，可使网络干预规划兼顾不确定性与有效性，为HIV等隐蔽人群的公共卫生资源分配提供可行方案。

title: TMAL: Topology-preserving Multi-offset Affinity Learning for Curvilinear Structure Segmentation
summary: Curvilinear structures such as retinal vessels and surface cracks need both pixel-level accuracy and structural continuity. Pixel-wise supervision does not model the connections between pixels, and topology-based losses still produce ordinary masks. Connectivity-based methods predict these connections directly, but they use binary connectivity targets over a fixed local range. Such labels give the same value to thin segments and to thick regions, and they cannot describe connections at larger offsets. To address these limitations, we propose Topology-preserving Multi-offset Affinity Learning (TMAL). TMAL uses soft affinities that emphasize thin regions near the boundary, and it predicts directional affinities at several offsets to reach further. It then combines these affinities with weights that come from the decoder features, so local continuity and wider context are used together. An auxiliary segmentation branch adds region-level supervision and keeps the overlap accuracy high. On the retinal vessel dataset DRIVE and the crack inspection dataset DeepCrack, TMAL reaches the highest Dice, IoU, and clDice scores, and it greatly reduces the connected-component error $Δβ_0$. Code is available at https://github.com/suho-han/TMAL.

AI.tldr: TMAL提出软亲和力+多偏移方向亲和力学习，结合解码器加权的区域监督，提升曲线结构分割的像素精度与拓扑连通性。
AI.motivation: 曲线结构（血管、裂缝）需兼顾像素精度与结构连续性。逐像素监督不建模像素间连接，拓扑损失仍输出普通掩码；基于连通性的方法使用固定局部范围的二值连接标签，对细段与粗区域等值，且无法描述更大偏移处的连接。
AI.method: 软亲和力强调边界附近细区域；在多个偏移处预测方向性亲和力以覆盖更远连接；用解码器特征生成权重将亲和力融合，兼顾局部连续性与更广上下文；辅以分割分支提供区域级监督。
AI.result: 在DRIVE与DeepCrack上Dice、IoU、clDice均为最高，且大幅降低连通分量误差Δβ0。
AI.conclusion: TMAL通过对细结构敏感的多偏移软亲和力学习有效提升曲线结构分割的像素精度与拓扑/连通性质量，代码已开源。

title: AVCC: Audio-Visual Conversation Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction with a Human Benchmark
summary: } Predicting who will speak next, and when, is a prerequisite for conversational agents and social robots that take turns without waiting for silence. Multiparty next-speaker prediction (NSP) has been studied on corpora with per-speaker sensors, each with its own event definitions. No public benchmark covers the single camera and microphone a robot has, and no model has been compared against how well people perform the same prediction. We turn AVCC, a 31-hour audio-visual corpus of two- and three-speaker online conversation recorded with a single static camera and microphone, into a public NSP benchmark. We add a speaker-disjoint seven-video test partition with 865 hold and 865 shift events at mutual-silence gaps, word-level forced-aligned transcripts for the whole corpus, and a human reference benchmark collected at the same events. We score an audio-only Role-Relative VAP model (RoleVAP) and the multimodal MuVAP model. Labels, transcripts, per-response human data, and the scripts that reproduce every number are released.

AI.tldr: 本文把 AVCC 语料库改造为首个基于单摄像头+单麦克风的公开多人下一说话人预测(NSP)基准，并加入人工参照与两个模型基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 NSP 研究依赖每人各自传感设备且事件定义不一，缺乏机器人实际可用的单摄像头/单麦克风公开基准，也没有模型与人类表现的对比。
AI.method: 将 31 小时双人/三人线上对话的 AVCC 语料转为 NSP 基准：新增说话人分离的 7 视频测试集（865 个 hold、865 个 shift 事件，定义于互静默间隙），提供全语料词级强制对齐转写，采集同一事件上的人类参照结果；评测音频单模态 RoleVAP 与多模态 MuVAP。
AI.result: 发布了带标签、转写、逐响应人类数据及可复现所有数值的脚本的公开基准，并给出 RoleVAP 与 MuVAP 的基线分数。
AI.conclusion: AVCC-NSP 为单传感器真实场景的下一说话人预测提供可复现、含人类上界的公开评测平台。

title: Settling the Burn-in Gap: Sharp Risk Bounds for Tail-Averaged SGD in Linear Regression
summary: We study the excess risk of constant-stepsize online stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with tail-averaging for high-dimensional linear regression. Building on the instance-dependent spectral framework of Zou et al. (2021), we establish matching initialization-explicit upper and lower bounds on the total excess risk of tail-averaged SGD in terms of the population covariance spectrum $\mathbf{H}$ and initialization $\mathbf{w}_0-\mathbf{w}^*$ whenever a trajectory spectral feedback condition holds. Existing analyses exhibit a fundamental gap in the effective variance: the upper bound of Zou et al. (2021) retains an undamped contribution from the initial error in the head eigenspace $\mathbf{I}_{0:k^\dagger}$, whereas their lower bound omits the variance induced by the head initialization altogether. We show that both the existing upper and lower bounds are loose: the single-hop fast-mode variance contribution from the head initialization is exponentially damped during the burn-in phase, whereas fourth-moment energy scattered from the head initialization into slow spectral modes during the early burn-in steps survives undamped into the averaging window. We prove that our spectral feedback condition is satisfied in two concrete constant-stepsize regimes: (i) for arbitrary covariance spectra $\mathbf{H}$ and any finite horizon, under an explicit horizon-dependent stepsize chosen prior to execution; and (ii) for polynomially decaying spectra $λ_i\asymp i^{-a}$ ($a>1$), under a single horizon-independent positive stepsize. Finally, we complement these positive results with explicit one- and two-dimensional separation constructions proving an exponential-versus-polynomial gap in the lower bound of Zou et al. (2021) and showing why fourth-moment assumptions alone cannot determine the asymptotic exponential decay rate without additional structural conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了高维线性回归中常数步长、尾部平均SGD的超额风险，给出在谱反馈条件下的紧致（含初始化显式依赖）上下界，修正了Zou等(2021)偏松的界：头部初始化快模态方差在burn-in阶段指数衰减，而经由四阶矩散射到慢模态的能量则无衰减地进入平均窗口；并给出两个常数步长满足该条件的实例及分离构造。
AI.motivation: 现有分析在有效方差上存在根本性缺口：Zou等(2021)的上界在头部特征空间保留了未衰减的初始化误差贡献，而其下界完全忽略了头部初始化引入的方差，导致上下界均不紧，无法刻画初始化的真实影响。
AI.method: 基于Zou等(2021)的实例相关谱框架，引入"轨迹谱反馈条件"，推导以总体协方差谱H和初始化w0−w*表示的尾部平均SGD总超额风险的吻合上下界；证明该条件在两个常数步长情形下成立：(i)任意谱、任意有限时域下预先选取的时域相关步长；(ii)多项式衰减谱λ_i≍i^{-a}(a>1)下单一与时域无关的正步长；并用一维、二维分离构造加以刻画。
AI.result: 证明Zou等(2021)的上、下界均偏松：头部初始化的单步快模态方差在burn-in阶段被指数抑制，而早期burn-in经四阶矩散射到慢谱模态的能量无衰减地保留至平均窗口，是其真实贡献来源；分离构造证明其下界存在指数与多项式量级差距，并表明仅凭四阶矩假设无法确定渐近指数衰减率。
AI.conclusion: 在轨迹谱反馈条件下建立了初始化显式且相互匹配的SGD超额风险界，揭示了初始化的真实传播机制（经四阶矩散射进入慢模态而非快模态直接残留），并明确了步长选择可保证条件成立；同时指出仅靠四阶矩假设不足以刻画指数衰减率，需附加结构条件。

title: F3-AGI v4.0: Bioenergetically-Gated Active Inference, Metaplastic Preconditioning, and Residual Program Synthesis for Sample-Efficient Abstract Reasoning
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/henrique-polybee/f3-agi-v4
summary: Few-shot abstract reasoning on ARC-AGI requires inducing algorithmic transformations from 2 to 5 demonstration pairs without task-specific pretraining. Because few-shot demonstrations under-constrain the hypothesis space, program synthesis suffers from the Rashomon effect (predictive multiplicity): heuristic search finds spurious programs with low training error that fail on test inputs, while unconstrained library growth degrades latency. We introduce F3-AGI v4.0, a CPU-native neuro-symbolic and active inference architecture comprising three mechanisms: (1) F3-Metabolic-Optim, combining mistake-gated plasticity, Fisher-EMA preconditioning, and virtual ATP gating; (2) Adaptive Complexity-Guided Program Synthesis (AACR) with a Cycle-3 ResidualPatchSynthesizer and smallest-pair early rejection; and (3) a 512D L2-normalized random projection driving Expected Free Energy (EFE) exploration with dead-signature pruning. Across three empirical studies: (i) on a synthetic 5-task class-incremental stream without replay, F3-Metabolic-Optim achieves 91.67% final accuracy with 9.17% forgetting, skipping 93.47% of updates, cutting L1 plasticity cost by 65.7%, and running 2.19x faster than EWC; (ii) on the 400-task ARC-AGI-1 public evaluation set (offline CPU, zero LLM calls), F3-AGI v4.0 solves 57/400 tasks (14.25% pass@2; 56/400 pass@1) with a mean latency of 1.62 s/task, decomposed into 19/50 (38.00%, 1.19 s/task, a 42.5x paired speedup over Horizon 2) on the 50-task calibration slice and 38/350 (10.86%) on the 350 strictly uninspected hold-out tasks (with 7 autonomous Cycle-3 patch solutions); and (iii) in a local 5-game (15-level) ARC-AGI-3-inspired interactive suite, our agent completes 15/15 levels with 89.44% level-weighted RHAE (90.72% unweighted).

AI.tldr: F3-AGI v4.0 是 CPU 原生神经符号+主动推理架构，用代谢式优化、复杂度引导的程序合成与 EFE 探索，在 ARC-AGI-1 上解出 57/400（14.25% pass@2，1.62s/任务，零 LLM 调用）。
AI.motivation: 少样本 ARC 任务中 2–5 个示例不足以约束假设空间，程序合成易受 Rashomon 效应影响：启发式搜索会找到训练误差低但在测试集失效的伪程序；而无限增长的程序库又会拖慢推理。需在无任务专用预训练、CPU 离线条件下兼顾精度与延迟。
AI.method: 三机制组合：(1) F3-Metabolic-Optim——错误门控可塑性 + Fisher-EMA 预条件 + 虚拟 ATP 门控；(2) AACR 自适应复杂度引导程序合成，含 Cycle-3 ResidualPatchSynthesizer 与最小配对早期拒绝；(3) 512 维 L2 归一化随机投影驱动的期望自由能（EFE）探索，配合 dead-signature 剪枝。整体为神经符号 + 主动推理架构。
AI.result: (i) 无回放 5 任务类增量流：终准确率 91.67%，遗忘 9.17%，跳过 93.47% 更新，L1 可塑性代价降 65.7%，比 EWC 快 2.19x；(ii) ARC-AGI-1 400 任务（离线 CPU、零 LLM）：57/400（pass@2 14.25%，pass@1 56/400），均值 1.62s/任务；其中 50 任务校准切片 19/50（38.00%，1.19s/任务，较 Horizon 2 有 42.5x 配对加速），350 严格未检视留出集 38/350（10.86%，含 7 个 Cycle-3 自主补丁解）；(iii) 本地 5 游戏 15 关交互套件：15/15 通关，加权 RHAE 89.44%，未加权 90.72%。
AI.conclusion: 通过代谢式增量优化、复杂度引导合成与 EFE 探索的组合，F3-AGI v4.0 在纯 CPU、无 LLM 条件下实现了低延迟的 ARC 少样本抽象推理，并显示校准切片与留出集间存在明显泛化落差（38.00% vs 10.86%），提示过拟合与难度分布差异仍是主要瓶颈。

title: Evidential Deep Learning with conditional entropy for glaucoma detection
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. To appear in TAAI 2026
summary: We propose a novel conditional entropy function as a basis for quantifying predictive uncertainty in Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) for glaucoma detection from retinal fundus images. Using the EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 and RIM-ONE-DL datasets for validation, we found that our proposed EDL model regularized by conditional entropy function produced uncertainty estimates with substantially lower calibration errors than Deep Ensembles, MC Dropout, post-hoc calibration and the conventional EDL framework based on Dempster uncertainty. To further probe our models' interpretability, we analyzed Grad-CAM heatmaps using a focus index representing spatial concentration. Compared with the other uncertainty quantification methods, EDL models exhibited greater separation between the index distributions of correctly and incorrectly classified fundus images. In particular, false negatives were associated with localized Grad-CAM activations that were displaced from the optic disc, consistent with its established clinical importance in glaucoma assessment. Overall, our findings suggest that our proposed EDL framework for glaucoma detection provides not only enhanced uncertainty calibration but also admits a more physiologically consistent interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出一种条件熵正则化的证据深度学习(EDL)框架用于青光眼检测，在不确定性校准与可解释性上均优于Deep Ensembles、MC Dropout等方法。
AI.motivation: 视网膜眼底图像青光眼检测中，预测不确定性量化的可靠性不足，传统EDL基于Dempster不确定性的正则化在不确定性校准上存在局限，且模型可解释性与临床生理意义的一致性缺乏检验。
AI.method: 提出新的条件熵函数作为EDL的正则化项，用于量化预测不确定性；在EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2与RIM-ONE-DL数据集上验证；并以Focus Index（Grad-CAM空间集中度）分析热图可解释性。
AI.result: 所提EDL模型的校准误差显著低于Deep Ensembles、MC Dropout、事后校准及基于Dempster不确定性的常规EDL；EDL在正确/错误分类图像间的Focus Index分布分离度更大；假阴性样本的Grad-CAM激活偏离视盘，与青光眼临床评估中视盘的重要性一致。
AI.conclusion: 该EDL框架不仅提升不确定性校准，还具备更符合生理机制的可解释性，适用于青光眼检测。

title: On the information rate of phones, syllables and words
summary: Which linguistic units minimise the bitrate required to encode speech content: phones, syllables, words, maybe larger units, or something in between? This question has implications for the development of speech and language systems and theories of human language processing. Using a transcribed corpus of 960 hours of English audiobooks, I compare the information rates of phones, syllables, words, multi-word combinations and intermediate tokenisations. While all units are equivalent under a perfect language model, it makes sense to compare these under limited modelling budgets; I use $n$-gram and transformer language models. The lowest bitrates are achieved using words, with slightly longer units sometimes performing best. The results show that, when modelling capacity is limited, units larger than syllables but smaller than long multi-word phrases provide the most efficient representation in terms of information rate.

AI.tldr: 作者比较音素、音节、词、多词组合及中间分词单元的信息率，发现在有限建模预算（n-gram与transformer）下，词（及略长的单元）比特率最低，最有效的表征单位介于音节与多词短语之间。
AI.motivation: 探究哪种语言单元能以最少比特编码语音内容，这一问题关系到语音与语言系统的发展以及人类语言加工理论。
AI.method: 使用960小时英语有声书转写语料，在有限建模预算下（n-gram与transformer语言模型）比较音素、音节、词、多词组合及中间分词的信息率。
AI.result: 在完美语言模型下各单元等价；但在有限容量下，词可取得最低比特率，略长于词的单元有时表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 建模能力受限时，比音节大但比长多词短语小的单元提供最有效的信息率表征。

title: AdjointFlow: Accelerating Scientific Inverse Problems with Physics-Based Transport
summary: Inverse problems are ubiquitous across scientific applications ranging from seismic imaging to astrophysics to nondestructive testing, yet classical solvers often struggle with nonconvexity and repeated evaluations of expensive physical models. Diffusion models can amortize this computation offline, but largely data-driven conditional models underutilize known physics and suffer from ill-conditioned transport maps when the target distribution is concentrated. Plug-and-play (PnP) methods explicitly leverage the physical model to guide a learned prior, improving data consistency but reintroducing costly iterative computations. We instead propose AdjointFlow, a framework built on stochastic interpolants that injects the known physics into the generative transport itself. We design a data-dependent, adjoint-based initialization to reduce transport distance to the target, modify the transport velocity to remain regular as the endpoint distributions concentrate, and parameterize the network to build the initialization directly into the learned velocity. Together, these enable accurate reconstruction at substantially lower cost than generative models starting from Gaussian noise. Experiments on inverse scattering, seismic imaging, and black hole imaging show that AdjointFlow consistently produces more accurate reconstructions than conditional diffusion models while being up to five orders of magnitude faster at inference than PnP methods. Optional inference-time refinement that queries the physical model can further improve data consistency, matching or exceeding the accuracy of PnP methods without retraining.

AI.tldr: AdjointFlow 将已知物理模型注入随机插值生成传输过程，实现逆问题重建，精度优于条件扩散模型，推理比 PnP 快五个数量级。
AI.motivation: 经典逆问题求解器受困于非凸性和昂贵物理模型反复求值；条件扩散模型偏纯数据驱动、未利用已知物理，目标分布集中时传输映射病态；PnP 方法虽用物理模型但重新引入高成本迭代计算。
AI.method: 基于随机插值（stochastic interpolants）框架：1) 设计依赖数据的、基于伴随（adjoint）的初始化以缩短到目标的传输距离；2) 修改传输速度，使端点分布集中时仍保持正则；3) 将初始化直接内嵌进所学速度的网络参数化；可选推理时用物理模型做精化。
AI.result: 在逆散射、地震成像、黑洞成像实验中，重建精度一致优于条件扩散模型，推理比 PnP 快达五个数量级；可选推理精化可匹敌或超越 PnP 精度且无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: 将物理先验融入生成传输本身，可在保证精度的同时大幅降低逆问题求解成本，兼得数据驱动与物理驱动的优势。

title: Agent-Guided Discovery of Exchange-Correlation Functionals with Physics-based Validation
summary: Accurate, compact exchange--correlation functionals are central to predictive density functional theory. Symbolic search and language-model agents can propose new functional forms, but it remains unclear whether their gains survive self-consistency and external evaluation, whether the new terms carry physical content, whether agents outperform evolutionary search, and how language-model backbones compare. We connect frontier LLM agents to a GPU evaluator through the Model Context Protocol, with training-only fitting, persistent memory, and self-consistent and external evaluation. Opus-5.5 agents passed the screening gate with about 40-fold fewer tokens than Codex (GPT-6-Astra) agents and found a candidate with lower validation and held-out errors; only this candidate advanced to self-consistent evaluation. The resulting 13-parameter functional, O159, multiplies same-spin correlation by a smooth density window. Refitted controls favor a window that scales the entire same-spin factor, reducing it by 15--30\% at its peak, and that acts on reaction energies mainly in near-iso-orbital regions; against a refitted no-window control, it lowers heavy-atom total-energy errors on GSCDB137 by 29\%. With about 400 fits each, SyFES evolution did not improve on its GAS22 seed, whereas the agents found forms 0.10--0.13 \kcal\ lower in validation error by adding an explicit density scale. Self-consistent O159 lowers the held-out MGCDB84 test error of $ω$B97M-V by 11.7\%, and its mean normalized error ratio on 36 GSCDB137 datasets (1.139) is comparable to $ω$B97M-V (1.144) and below GAS22 (1.190). Frontier-LLM agents thus produced O159, a compact functional whose improvement over $ω$B97M-V survives self-consistent, physics-based validation.

AI.tldr: 将前沿LLM智能体通过MCP接入GPU评测器，在仅训练集拟合、持久记忆与自洽/外部评测下搜索交换-相关泛函，得到13参数的O159泛函。
AI.motivation: 符号搜索与语言模型智能体虽能提出新泛函形式，但其增益能否经受自洽计算与外部评测、新项是否具物理含义、是否优于进化搜索、不同LLM骨干如何比较，均不清楚。
AI.method: 用Model Context Protocol把前沿LLM智能体连到GPU评测器，采用仅训练集拟合、持久记忆、自洽与外部评测；对比Opus-5.5与Codex(GPT-6-Astra)智能体及SyFES进化搜索，并用重拟合对照与物理分析检验窗口项。
AI.result: Opus-5.5以约40倍更少token通过筛选门并找到验证/留出误差更低的候选；所得13参数O159将同自旋相关乘以平滑密度窗口。相对无窗口重拟合对照，GSCDB137重原子总能误差降低29%；自洽O159使ωB97M-V的MGCDB84留出误差降11.7%，GSCDB137 36数据集平均归一化误差比1.139，优于GAS22(1.190)，与ωB97M-V(1.144)相当。SyFES约400次拟合未超越GAS22种子。
AI.conclusion: 前沿LLM智能体产出的紧凑泛函O159相对ωB97M-V的改进可经受自洽、基于物理的验证。

title: Seeing the Small: Deformable Duality Mamba for Retinal Lesion Segmentation
summary: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) lesions vary widely in shape, and microaneurysms (MAs) span only a few pixels. We hypothesize that modeling the spatial organization of lesion regions, with global context and shape-adaptive scanning, improves the segmentation of such small and irregular lesions. To test this, we propose D$^2$Mamba, which couples non-causal state space duality with deformable Mamba scanning. We evaluate it with five-fold cross-validation on the DDR dataset, comparing against representative segmentation baselines under an identical training protocol, and conduct ablations on each component. D$^2$Mamba achieved the best overall performance, with 33.87% mIoU, 2.99 percentage points above the strongest baseline. The largest gain appeared on MAs, the smallest and most easily missed lesions, where Dice improved by 10.06 percentage points. These results confirm our hypothesis that spatially adaptive state space modeling benefits tiny-lesion segmentation. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/PUREPANEL1/D2Mamba.

AI.tldr: 提出D²Mamba，将非因果状态空间对偶与可变形Mamba扫描结合，用于糖尿病视网膜病变（尤其微小、不规则病灶）的分割。
AI.motivation: 糖尿病视网膜病变病灶形状差异大，微动脉瘤（MAs）仅占几个像素，现有分割方法难以捕捉此类微小且不规则病灶的空间组织关系。
AI.method: D²Mamba耦合并非因果状态空间对偶（non-causal state space duality）与可变形Mamba扫描（deformable Mamba scanning），引入全局上下文与形状自适应扫描以建模病灶区域的空间组织；在DDR数据集上采用五折交叉验证，与代表性分割基线在相同训练协议下对比，并对各组件进行消融实验。
AI.result: 总体表现最佳，mIoU达33.87%，比最强基线高2.99个百分点；在最小且最易漏检的MAs上增益最大，Dice提升10.06个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了空间自适应状态空间建模有益于微小病灶分割的假设。代码与预训练权重已开源。

title: One Sequence Is Enough: Fingerprinting Language Models from Fixed-Length Integer Sequences
summary: Users of model APIs and third-party platforms often rely on the declared model name to identify the model responding to their requests. However, the actual model may differ from the declared one, motivating identity verification based on observable outputs. Previous studies have shown that preferences in simple numerical-choice tasks can serve as model fingerprints. We investigate whether a single fixed-length integer sequence can combine multiple numerical observations to identify its source model. For this task, we introduce NumPrint, a benchmark of 5,036 answers from 51 models, collected using Chinese, Japanese, and English prompts that request 294 integers between 1 and 355 in one response. We propose the Shallow MLP and Causal Transformer (SMCT) to capture aggregate numerical preferences and behavioral patterns in generated sequences. In 51-class closed-set evaluation, SMCT achieves 92.72% accuracy from a single sequence, outperforming all methods compared in this study. Using two and four answers increases accuracy to 96.06% and 97.12%, respectively. These results show that a single integer sequence contains useful model fingerprints and that additional answers further improve identification.

AI.tldr: 提出NumPrint基准与SMCT方法，利用单个定长整数序列中的数值偏好指纹来识别模型API背后的真实模型，51类闭集准确率达92.72%。
AI.motivation: 用户依赖模型API或第三方平台声明的模型名称，但实际响应模型可能与声明不符，因此需要通过可观测输出来验证模型身份。已有研究表明简单数值选择任务中的偏好可作模型指纹，但能否用单条定长整数序列融合多种数值观测来识别来源模型尚待验证。
AI.method: 构建NumPrint基准：用中、日、英三种语言提示，要求模型在一次回答中输出1至355之间的294个整数，采集51个模型的5,036条答案。提出Shallow MLP与Causal Transformer组合的SMCT模型，捕捉生成序列中的聚合数值偏好与行为模式。
AI.result: 51类闭集评估中，SMCT单条序列即达92.72%准确率，优于所有对比方法；使用两条和四条回答时准确率分别提升至96.06%和97.12%。
AI.conclusion: 单条整数序列包含有效的模型指纹信息，且增加回答数量可进一步提升模型识别准确率。

title: Free Lunch Uncertainty: Sequence-Level Rényi Entropy from Particle Decoding for Adaptive LLM Reasoning
summary: Quantifying uncertainty over an entire LLM completion is critical for selective prediction and adaptive compute. Zero-cost signals such as mean token entropy and log-probability are local to tokens or to one completion, and self-consistency needs many extra completions. We show that Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding for power sampling already estimates the normalizing constant of the power distribution, which gives the sequence-level R'enyi entropy (SRE) of the model's completion distribution at zero marginal cost, with a guarantee at every particle budget. A R'enyi chain rule extends this readout to a family of stepwise entropies of any order. We prove that orders above one are tied to the most likely token of each step, which explains why they track log-probability, while the order-1/2 member accumulates the log of per-step search effort. This member is the best zero-cost selective-prediction signal in 10 of 13 settings. On MATH500 its AUROC is 0.022 to 0.044 above log-probability with all four models and within length quartiles, and the same order is selected when each setting is held out. An 8-particle probe identifies the problems that benefit from more particles, and a two-pass policy matches 64-particle accuracy on MATH500 with 34.2% fewer particles over three seeds.

AI.tldr: 论文指出 SMC 幂采样解码天然估计归一化常数，可零边际成本得到序列级 Rényi 熵（SRE），并据此构造零成本选择性预测信号。
AI.motivation: 整段补全的不确定性量化对选择性预测和自适应计算很关键，但现有零成本信号（平均 token 熵、对数概率）只关注局部 token 或单条补全，而自一致性需要额外多次采样。
AI.method: 利用 SMC 幂采样已估计的幂分布归一化常数读出序列级 Rényi 熵；用 Rényi 链式法则扩展到任意阶的逐步熵；证明阶数>1 与每步最可能 token 相关（故追踪对数概率），阶 1/2 累积每步搜索努力的对数。
AI.result: 阶 1/2 成员在 13 个设置中 10 个为最佳零成本选择性预测信号；MATH500 上 AUROC 比对数概率高 0.022–0.044（四个模型、各长度四分位内均成立），且留一设置时仍选中同一阶数；8 粒子探针可识别受益于更多粒子的问题，两遍策略在三种子下以少 34.2% 粒子达到 64 粒子精度。
AI.conclusion: SMC 解码的归一化常数可免费转化为序列级不确定性信号，其中阶 1/2 的 Rényi 熵是强零成本选择性预测信号，并可用于自适应粒子分配。

title: Do AI Agents need Preventive Care? An Epidemiologic Cohort Design for Agentic AI
summary: As AI agents increasingly perform tasks autonomously across sectors, including healthcare and biomedical research, understanding how their behaviors develop and influence outcomes over time becomes increasingly important. Existing evaluations largely focus on model capabilities and performance on predefined tasks. Here, we propose an epidemiologic cohort design for studying agentic AI, drawing on principles established in human population studies. The framework treats individual agents as members of a cohort, their underlying model as genetic makeup, accumulated work as their time scale, and naturally occurring behaviors as exposures that may influence subsequent outcomes. By following agents longitudinally, this approach enables investigation of behavioral determinants of adverse events, estimation of their potential preventable burden under causal assumptions, and characterization of behavioral changes over an agent's work life. We illustrate the design through two prospective observational cohorts examining curiosity and probing as a safety question, and data checking and analytical accuracy as a reliability question. Together, the framework and illustrative studies provide a generalizable blueprint for designing epidemiologic cohorts of AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种流行病学队列设计框架来纵向研究AI智能体的行为发展及其对结果的影响，并以两个前瞻性观察队列（好奇心/探测性的安全性问题、数据核查/分析准确性的可靠性问题）进行示例。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多聚焦于模型在预设任务上的能力与表现，缺乏对智能体自主执行任务时行为如何随时间发展并影响结果的纵向理解，尤其在医疗与生物医学研究等高风险领域这一需求尤为迫切。
AI.method: 借鉴人类人群研究的队列设计原则：将单个智能体视为队列成员，底层模型类比为基因型，累积工作量作为其时间尺度，自然发生的行为作为暴露；通过纵向跟踪智能体，在因果假设下分析不良事件的行为决定因素、可预防负担及行为随"工作生命周期"的变化。并以两个前瞻性观察队列作为示例。
AI.result: 通过两个示例队列展示该设计的可用性：一是将好奇心与探测性行为作为安全性问题研究；二是将数据核查与分析准确性作为可靠性问题研究。
AI.conclusion: 该框架与示例研究共同提供了一个可推广的蓝图，可用于设计AI智能体的流行病学队列，支持对智能体行为的纵向、因果导向研究。

title: UniWeaver: Harnessing Unified Multimodal Models for Interleaved Text-Image Generation
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have opened up new possibilities for generating rich interleaved text-image content. However, they generally lack native support for coordinating the two modalities, and translating coarse user requests into coherent multimodal compositions also requires explicit planning. We propose UniWeaver, a structured, model-agnostic harness framework that integrates multimodal planning, generation, and visual feedback to produce coherent interleaved outputs. To train UMMs for this task, we construct UniWeaver-10K, a dataset of 10,000 tasks across 20 task families, paired with execution trajectories guided by UniWeaver. We also introduce UniWeaver-Bench, a task-oriented benchmark systematically assessing text coverage, writing quality, visual coverage, and image-text alignment. Experiments show that UniWeaver achieves state-of-the-art performance and improves interleaved text-image generation across multiple UMM backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniWeaver，一个结构化、模型无关的编排框架，整合多模态规划、生成与视觉反馈，实现连贯的文图交错内容生成；并构建 UniWeaver-10K 数据集与 UniWeaver-Bench 基准，取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）虽能生成丰富的文图交错内容，但缺乏对文本与图像两种模态的原生协调能力；将粗略的用户请求转化为连贯的多模态组合仍需显式规划。
AI.method: 提出 UniWeaver 框架：一个结构化、模型无关的 harness，集成多模态规划、生成和视觉反馈三个环节来产出连贯的交错输出。为训练 UMMs，构建 UniWeaver-10K 数据集（覆盖 20 类任务族的 1 万条任务，配以由 UniWeaver 引导的执行轨迹）。同时提出 UniWeaver-Bench，从文本覆盖度、写作质量、视觉覆盖度和图文对齐四个维度系统评估。
AI.result: 实验表明 UniWeaver 达到 SOTA 性能，并在多个 UMM 骨干模型上提升了文图交错生成效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式规划与视觉反馈的结构化框架，可有效弥补 UMMs 在模态协调上的不足，且框架模型无关、具备良好通用性。

title: Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution
summary: Agent skills have emerged as an effective means of enabling LLM agents to solve complex, interactive tasks by encoding reusable knowledge without modifying model parameters. Recent approaches further improve skill adaptation by distilling reusable experience from agent execution trajectories and evolving skills based on downstream task feedback. However, existing methods primarily represent skills as natural language documents, intertwining procedural logic with descriptive knowledge and making skills difficult to maintain and evolve. To address this limitation, we propose PASE (Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution), a program-aided framework that iteratively evolves skills by associating them with executable programs. Unlike prior approaches that encode trajectory-derived experience primarily in natural language, PASE separates reusable procedural logic into editable programs, enabling targeted updates to executable components while reducing the need to repeatedly revise natural language skills. Extensive experiments across diverse models and benchmarks demonstrate that PASE consistently outperforms all baselines, by achieving over 2.8% improvements. Further analyses show that PASE exhibits greater evolutionary stability and generalisation capability, highlighting the critical role of programmatic knowledge in skill evolution. We will release all data and code via GitHub.

AI.tldr: PASE 是一个程序辅助的可补丁式技能演化框架，将可复用的过程逻辑从自然语言技能中分离为可编辑程序，通过轨迹蒸馏与下游反馈迭代演化技能，在多种模型与基准上超过所有基线 2.8% 以上。
AI.motivation: 现有让 LLM 智能体复用经验的技能演化方法主要将技能表示为自然语言文档，把过程逻辑与描述性知识混在一起，导致技能难以维护和演化。
AI.method: 提出 PASE 框架：为技能关联可执行程序，将轨迹中蒸馏出的可复用过程逻辑放入可编辑程序，从而可对可执行组件做定向更新（补丁），减少对自然语言技能的反覆改写，并基于下游任务反馈迭代演化。
AI.result: 在多模型、多基准上持续优于全部基线，提升超过 2.8%；分析显示 PASE 具有更好的演化稳定性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 程序化知识在技能演化中起关键作用，将技能以程序形式组织可显著提升可维护性、稳定性与泛化性；作者将开源数据与代码。

title: You Don't Need Feature Learning to Do In-Context Learning
summary:
How should we understand memorization vs. generalization in in-context learning (ICL) tasks, and when does one happen vs. the other? To investigate, we study how rotation-invariant kernel machines learn the ICL linear regression task proposed by Raventos et al. (2023). By decomposing the task in the kernel eigenbasis, we obtain a spectral picture of learning in this ICL setting. This picture reveals that as sample size grows, kernel machines learn successively-higher-degree components of the memorizing solution, which depend upon successively-higher-degree statistics of the training task set. The generalizing solution is approximately a low-degree truncation of the memorizing solution, and so the model first generalizes, then degrades into memorization as training proceeds.
  The takeaways are threefold. First, if this case is indicative, learning a "generalizing" solution on an ICL task is really just underfitting the memorizing solution! Second, the fact that kernel machines can generalize on this task means that feature learning is inessential to ICL. Third, transformers empirically trained to do ICL are shown to memorize tasks through the higher-order statistics of the training tasks that the kernel-based theory predicts, suggesting it applies even to models capable of feature learning.

AI.tldr: 通过谱分解分析旋转不变核机在ICL线性回归任务上的学习过程，揭示"泛化解只是记忆解的低阶截断"，模型先泛化后过拟合为记忆，并指出特征学习对ICL并非必要。
AI.motivation: 现有工作对ICL中的记忆（memorization）与泛化（generalization）缺乏清晰理论刻画，不清楚两者何时发生、如何转换。作者希望用可分析的理论模型（核机）机制性地厘清这一现象。
AI.method: 研究旋转不变核机在Raventos等(2023)提出的ICL线性回归任务上的学习。将任务在核特征基（kernel eigenbasis）中分解，得到学习的谱图景，分析随样本量增长各阶（degree）分量的学习顺序，并将其与训练任务集的高阶统计量联系起来。
AI.result: 随样本量增大，核机依次学习记忆解中越来越高阶的分量，这些分量依赖训练任务集越来越高阶的统计量；泛化解近似为记忆解的低阶截断。因此模型先泛化，随训练推进退化为记忆。实证上，经ICL训练的Transformer也通过核理论预测的高阶统计量记忆任务。
AI.conclusion: 三点结论：(1) 在ICL任务上学习"泛化解"本质上只是对记忆解欠拟合；(2) 核机能在此任务上泛化，说明特征学习对ICL并非必需；(3) 实际训练的Transformer通过高阶统计量记忆任务，与核理论预测一致，表明该理论甚至适用于能进行特征学习的模型。

title: Disentangling Multimodal Rotary Positional Embedding in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models widely adopt Multimodal Rotary Position Embedding (MRoPE), an extension of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) that incorporates temporal, height, and width axes to encode the spatial structure of visual tokens. However, MRoPE also assigns height and width coordinates to text tokens that lack inherent spatial structure, introducing spatial positional effects into text-vision attention. Existing MRoPE variants explore different frequency allocations and coordinate layouts, with their designs suggesting different intuitions about these cross-modal effects: they may provide useful spatial references for associating language with visual regions, or introduce unnecessary positional preferences that hinder text-vision interactions. In this work, we disentangle intra-visual spatial structure from cross-modal spatial effects to investigate this question. We identify a constraint of shared coordinate layouts that prevents eliminating cross-modal spatial effects while preserving intra-visual spatial encoding, and develop controlled experiments to isolate their respective contributions. Our results across multiple model scales, MRoPE variants, and benchmarks show that cross-modal spatial effects provide little additional benefit as spatial references and can even impair model performance, while intra-visual spatial encoding remains useful for fine-grained grounding.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过解耦视觉内部空间结构与跨模态空间效应，证明给文本token赋予高宽坐标带来的跨模态空间效应收益甚微甚至有害，而保留视觉内部空间编码对细粒度定位仍有用。
AI.motivation: MRoPE被广泛用于视觉语言模型，但它同时给本无空间结构的文本token分配高宽坐标，导致文本-视觉注意力中引入空间位置效应。现有各变体对此直觉不一：有人认为这是有用的空间参考，有人认为是有害的位置偏好，但此前无法厘清。
AI.method: 作者将视觉内部空间结构（intra-visual）与跨模态空间效应（cross-modal）解耦。指出共享坐标布局这一约束使得难以在保留视觉内部空间编码的同时消除跨模态效应，并设计受控实验分别隔离二者贡献，覆盖多种模型规模、MRoPE变体与基准。
AI.result: 实验表明跨模态空间效应作为空间参考几乎无额外收益，甚至会损害模型性能；而视觉内部空间编码对细粒度grounding仍有帮助。
AI.conclusion: MRoPE中给文本token附加的空间坐标价值有限，未来设计可考虑去除跨模态空间效应、仅保留视觉内部空间编码，以兼顾简洁性与细粒度定位能力。

title: AgenticConflictLens: From Long Traffic Videos to Verifiable Conflict Evidence
summary: Traffic cameras continuously record urban road-user behavior, providing proactive safety evidence beyond crash reports. Yet safety-critical events - conflicts, near misses, unsafe turns, sudden braking, and crosswalk interactions - are rare and brief, buried in hours of routine footage. Existing traffic-video pipelines extract detections, trajectories, and risk scores but process footage uniformly, without adapting to an analyst's query. Vision-language methods improve scene understanding but often lack traffic-specific verification of participant-level conflicts. We introduce AgenticConflictLens, an agentic, query-conditioned framework for efficient, auditable conflict extraction from long fixed-camera traffic videos. Given a natural-language safety query, a Traffic-Aware Controller combines structured traffic memory with specialized conflict-analysis tools to choose where to search, which road users to examine, and which evidence to verify or reject. A coarse-to-fine search retrieves candidate intervals and applies detailed verification selectively. The framework produces conflict records with refined time intervals, participant pairs, semantic regions, trajectories, motion evidence, uncertainty, rejection reasons, and supporting clips. On 96 annotated hours from Bellevue and NYC DOT, AgenticConflictLens achieves the highest conflict-existence F1 and temporal IoU on both datasets: 0.84 F1/0.77 tIoU on Bellevue and 0.80 F1/0.73 tIoU on NYC DOT, while inspecting only 8.7% and 11.9% of video, respectively. These results support scalable, evidence-grounded urban traffic-safety analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出AgenticConflictLens，一个查询条件驱动的智能体框架，从长时固定摄像头交通视频中高效、可审计地提取安全关键冲突事件。
AI.motivation: 交通摄像头持续记录路况，但冲突、险情、急刹等安全关键事件稀少且短暂，淹没在大量常规视频中。现有视频管线均匀处理、不适应分析员查询，视觉语言方法也缺少针对交通参与者冲突的验证。
AI.method: 智能体化、查询条件化框架：给定自然语言安全查询，交通感知控制器结合结构化交通记忆与专门冲突分析工具，决定搜索位置、检查哪些道路使用者、验证或拒绝哪些证据；采用由粗到细搜索检索候选时间区间并选择性细致验证。
AI.result: 在Bellevue与NYC DOT共96小时标注数据上，冲突存在F1和时序IoU均最高：Bellevue 0.84 F1/0.77 tIoU，NYC DOT 0.80 F1/0.73 tIoU，且仅检查8.7%和11.9%的视频。
AI.conclusion: 输出包含精化时间区间、参与者对、语义区域、轨迹、运动证据、不确定性、拒绝理由及支撑片段的冲突记录，支持可扩展、证据支撑的城市交通安全分析。

title: MISO-BR: An Open Corpus for Misogyny Detection in Brazilian Portuguese
summary: Misogyny is among the most prevalent forms of online hate speech directed at Brazilian users, yet open and auditable resources dedicated to it in Brazilian Portuguese remain scarce. We introduce MISO-BR, an open, documented and versioned corpus of 896 balanced social media texts annotated for binary misogyny, released with its construction protocol and reproducible baselines. The corpus combines lexicon- and target-guided scraping from X with items imported from OLID-BR, a large language model triage stage whose prompt and decoding parameters are released, and manual annotation by three annotators following a written guide. Inter-annotator reliability reaches a Fleiss' kappa of 0.788 over 816 items. Under a single fixed protocol we compare four classical classifiers (Multinomial and Bernoulli Naive Bayes, a linear SVM and a random forest) with fine-tuned BERTimbau Base and Large. The classical models cluster between 0.651 and 0.676 macro-F1 and are precision-oriented but recall-poor. The transformers reach 0.833 macro-F1 and accuracy (Wilson 95% CI for accuracy [0.77, 0.88]), a gap of roughly 16 points, while Base and Large are indistinguishable on the test set despite a 2.6x difference in training cost. We argue that the value of the resource lies less in its headline scores than in the auditability of its pipeline, and we state three limits that users must reckon with: the artificial class balance, whose effect on precision under realistic prevalence we quantify; the association between provenance and label, which the released source field makes measurable; and the selection bias induced by lexicon-guided sampling and automatic triage. The corpus, annotation guide, models and experimental scripts are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文发布 MISO-BR：一个面向巴西葡萄牙语的开放、可审计、带版本管理且类别平衡的厌女言论语料库（896 条文本，二分类标注），并提供构建协议与可复现基线（传统分类器 macro-F1 约 0.65–0.68，BERTimbau 达 0.833）。
AI.motivation: 厌女是巴西用户遭遇的最普遍网络仇恨言论之一，但巴西葡萄牙语领域缺乏开放、可审计的专用资源。
AI.method: 结合词典与目标引导的方式从 X 采集数据，并从 OLID-BR 引入条目；用大模型做分诊筛选（公开 prompt 与解码参数）；三名标注者依据书面指南人工标注，Fleiss' kappa 为 0.788（816 条）。在统一协议下比较四种传统分类器（多项式/伯努利朴素贝叶斯、线性 SVM、随机森林）与微调的 BERTimbau Base/Large。
AI.result: 传统模型 macro-F1 为 0.651–0.676，偏精确率而召回不足；Transformer 达 0.833 macro-F1 与准确率（Wilson 95% CI [0.77, 0.88]），领先约 16 个百分点；Base 与 Large 在测试集上无显著差异，但训练成本相差 2.6 倍。
AI.conclusion: 资源价值不在头部指标而在于流程可审计性；作者明确指出三项局限——人工类别平衡（并量化其对真实患病率下精确率的影响）、来源与标签的关联（通过公开 source 字段可度量）、以及词典引导采样与自动分诊带来的选择偏差。语料、标注指南、模型与实验脚本均公开。

title: Fermat ProbCover: Coverage-Based Active Learning on Fermat Distance Graphs
summary: Active learning aims to reduce annotation cost by selecting the most informative examples for labeling. In the low-budget regime, where uncertainty-based methods often fail, coverage-based active learning methods such as ProbCover have been shown to be effective. However, these methods typically rely on Euclidean distance, which may not adequately capture the underlying geometry of data. In this article, we propose PC-Fermat, a coverage-based active learning method that replaces Euclidean coverage neighborhoods with neighborhoods defined by a Fermat distance, i.e., a data-adaptive distance that reflects the underlying distribution of the data points. To facilitate computation, we construct a weighted Euclidean neighborhood graph and use a truncated shortest-path algorithm to compute the Fermat coverage graph. We also establish sufficient conditions under which this construction exactly preserves the Fermat coverage computed on the complete graph. Finally, we evaluate PC-Fermat on eight classification datasets across varying labeling budgets, with particular emphasis on the very low-budget regime. Our experimental results demonstrate that PC-Fermat outperforms several existing active learning methods on the majority of the datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出 PC-Fermat，用 Fermat 距离替代欧氏距离定义覆盖邻域，实现低预算下的覆盖式主动学习。
AI.motivation: 低预算场景下基于不确定性的主动学习失效，覆盖式方法（如 ProbCover）有效，但其依赖欧氏距离，难以刻画数据的真实几何结构。
AI.method: 用数据自适应的 Fermat 距离（反映数据分布）定义覆盖邻域；构建加权欧氏邻域图并用截断最短路算法计算 Fermat 覆盖图；证明该构造在何种条件下与完全图上的 Fermat 覆盖完全一致。
AI.result: 在 8 个分类数据集、不同标注预算（尤其极低预算）下评估，PC-Fermat 在多数数据集上优于现有多种主动学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 用 Fermat 距离替换欧氏距离可更贴合数据几何，提升低预算主动学习效果，且近似图构造具理论保证。

title: Veritas: A Verifier Generation Harness for Agent Tasks
summary: The effectiveness of a self-improving system relies heavily on the quality of its verifier, which judges the outcome of each improvement round. However, the verifiers of most tasks are written by hand, which is expensive and does not scale to tasks that come without one. We propose Veritas, a harness that generates verifiers automatically. Unlike general-purpose agent harnesses, Veritas adds three mechanisms for verifier generation: an evidence header stating what the verifier will observe, a library of domain rules that tasks leave unstated, and authoring principles, partly refined by a self-improvement loop. We evaluate on six benchmarks: four scored by execution, whose official verifiers we first certify, and two that compare pairs of responses. With the model fixed, the verifiers Veritas generates agree better with the official verdicts than those of seven other harnesses on all four execution-scored benchmarks. On the two pairwise benchmarks they are at or near the best. They also agree better than those of the vendor's own harness for two of three other model families. Its mechanisms also improve 9 of 12 harness-benchmark pairs scored by execution across three harnesses.

AI.tldr: Veritas 是一个自动生成验证器的 harness，通过证据头部、领域规则库和编写原则三种机制提升生成验证器与官方判定的一致性。
AI.motivation: 自改进系统的效果取决于验证器质量，但多数任务的验证器需人工编写，成本高且难以扩展到缺乏验证器的任务。
AI.method: 提出 Veritas harness，在通用 agent harness 基础上加入三项机制：声明验证器将观察内容的证据头部、任务未明说的领域规则库、以及部分通过自改进循环精炼的编写原则；在六个基准上评估（四个按执行打分并先认证官方验证器，两个比较响应对）。
AI.result: 模型固定时，Veritas 生成的验证器在四个执行打分基准上均比七个其他 harness 更贴近官方判定；在两个成对比较基准上处于或接近最佳；对三个其他模型家族中的两个，也优于其厂商自带 harness；其机制在三个 harness 的 12 个执行打分配对中改善了 9 个。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的机制设计可显著提升自动生成验证器的可靠性，具备替代人工编写验证器的潜力。

title: PhyRubric: Rubric-Grounded Diagnostic Evaluation of Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Video Generation
summary: As text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly positioned as world simulators, it is essential to evaluate whether their videos conform to physical commonsense. However, existing benchmarks rely on annotators who rate each video with a single score based on intuition, yielding ratings that are subjective and do not tell which physical principle is violated. We introduce PhyRubric, a rubric-grounded diagnostic framework for evaluating physical commonsense in T2V generation. For each caption, PhyRubric constructs a caption-specific rubric before any video is seen, decomposing the caption into semantic and physical items, and derives scores from item-level verdicts grounded in timestamped evidence. We instantiate this framework as PhyRubric-Bench, which spans 34 categories across five physical domains, and scale it up to PhyRubric-Train with 3,788 videos, on which we fine-tune the open-source PhyRubric-Judge. Empirical results across ten T2V models show that physical commonsense remains far from solved, and that PhyRubric-Judge correlates more closely with human judgments than existing open-source judges while matching the frontier proprietary Gemini 4 Argon. Further analysis provides actionable insights for T2V models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhyRubric，一个基于评分细则（rubric）的T2V物理常识诊断框架：先生成与caption相关的细粒度评分项，再基于带时间戳的证据给出逐项判定得分，并构建数据集与开源评判模型。
AI.motivation: 现有T2V物理常识评测依赖标注者凭直觉给视频打单一总分，评分主观，且无法指出违反了哪条物理原理，难以诊断模型缺陷。
AI.method: PhyRubric在未观看视频前，针对每个caption构建专属rubric，将其分解为语义项与物理项；通过基于时间戳证据的逐项判定得出评分。实例化为PhyRubric-Bench（覆盖五大物理域、34类），并扩展为含3788个视频的PhyRubric-Train，用于微调开源评判模型PhyRubric-Judge。
AI.result: 在十个T2V模型上的实验显示物理常识远未解决；PhyRubric-Judge与人类判断的相关性优于现有开源评判模型，并达到与前沿闭源模型Gemini 4 Argon相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 基于rubric的细粒度证据化评测可提供更客观、可解释的物理常识诊断，并为T2V模型改进提供可操作洞见。

title: HandsOnAid: Building and Evaluating an Offline First-Aid Assistant for Emergency Response Scenarios
summary: Emergencies can occur where there is no phone signal and no ambulance nearby. A small language model on a phone can be helpful in such situations, but its advice needs to be safe and accurate. We built HandsOnAid, a 4-bit Gemma 2B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on FirstAidQA dataset, a corpus of 5,550 first-aid question-answer pairs. We compared seven configurations, including the base, 4-bit and 8-bit fine-tuned models, and versions with a length floor, safety gate, or retrieval. We used a 41-pair question-answer bank with medically reviewed references that followed ANZCOR guidelines, and a strict 0-5 score rubric, with twelve safety overrides. Four frontier LLM judges (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3) blindly scored every answer, with 45 hidden controls used to check judge reliability. Fine-tuning improved the mean score by +1.08 over the base model to 2.34. The best configuration scored 2.51 out of 5 which was the fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval. A medical professional also conducted a blind evaluation of 40 answers across the base, the 4-bit fine-tuned, and the retrieval configurations, and the scores were similar to the LLM judges' average scores. A keyword audit found limited coverage of several details of ANZCOR guidelines in the training corpus, that are required by the rubric, which suggests that missing information in the training data could be a cause of the low scores. On a smartphone device (Pixel 7 Pro) with six CPU threads and no network connection, the 4-bit fine-tuned model produced its first displayable text in 6.86 seconds and a complete answer in 14.88 seconds on average over ten questions.

AI.tldr: HandsOnAid：在手机端部署4-bit Gemma 2B（QLoRA微调）提供急救建议，最佳配置（4-bit微调+检索）仅得2.51/5分，表明小型端侧模型急救建议安全性仍不足。
AI.motivation: 紧急情况下可能没有手机信号、附近也无救护车，手机上运行的小型语言模型可提供帮助，但其建议必须安全准确。因此需要评估端侧小模型在急救问答上的实际表现与安全风险。
AI.method: 构建HandsOnAid：4-bit Gemma 2B，用QLoRA在FirstAidQA（5,550条急救问答对）上微调。对比七种配置（基座、4-bit/8-bit微调、带长度下限、安全门控、检索的变体）。评测使用41对问答库、依据ANZCOR指南的医学审阅参考、严格0–5评分细则及12条安全覆盖规则；由四个前沿LLM评审（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5、DeepSeek V4 Pro、GLM-5.3）盲评，并使用45个隐藏对照检验评审可靠性。另由医学专业人士对40份答案（基座/4-bit微调/检索配置）进行盲评。
AI.result: 微调使平均分比基座模型提升+1.08至2.34；最佳配置为4-bit微调+检索，得2.51/5。医学专家评分与LLM评审均分接近。关键词审计发现训练语料对评分细则要求的若干ANZCOR细节覆盖有限，提示训练数据信息缺失可能是低分原因。在Pixel 7 Pro（6线程、无网络）上，4-bit微调模型的平均首字显示时间6.86秒、完整答案14.88秒（10个问题）。
AI.conclusion: 端侧2B模型可离线低延迟生成急救建议，但绝对质量仍低（约2.5/5），主要瓶颈在于训练数据对关键指南细节的覆盖不足；检索、安全门控等配置有助于提升但尚不足以达到安全可用的水平。

title: SLIC: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning Small LMs for Multi-Turn Analog Circuit Optimization
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 43 pages, 12 figures. Project page: https://hangroup.mit.edu/slic/
summary: Analog integrated circuit (IC) design is a multi-turn, simulator-grounded engineering task that demands iterative reasoning over coupled performance tradeoffs, yet proprietary process design kits (PDKs) make hosted large language model workflows difficult to deploy in practical design settings. We present SLIC (Small LM Iterating on Circuits), a reinforcement fine-tuning framework that trains a 4B-scale, locally deployable language model for closed-loop analog circuit optimization. SLIC pairs structured circuit representations with discretized relative-update actions, domain- and success-gated multiobjective rewards, and Reward-Guided Rollout Steering (RGRS), which turns per-step simulator feedback into signals for both policy learning and online rollout construction in this sparse, highly constrained domain. We further release an open, goal-conditioned benchmark of 41 amplifier topologies with standardized protocols for in-distribution validation, held-out topology evaluation, and cross-technology-node transfer. Trained solely with open source 65 nm CMOS predictive technology models (PTM), SLIC-Random achieves 87.1% in-distribution four-specification Pass@1 within eight turns, surpassing the 763B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Think by 48.5 percentage points. Beyond the training distribution, SLIC-Softmax reaches 72.6% Pass@1 on held-out topologies, and the trained policies consistently transfer across five unseen technology nodes without additional fine-tuning. This transfer extends to a commercial TSMC 65 nm CMOS PDK, where SLIC-Random achieves 49.9% held-out-topology Pass@1, demonstrating practical deployment through local inference without transmitting proprietary data to external LLM services. Performance further scales with test-time simulator interactions, reaching up to 83.2% held-out-topology Pass@1 at a 32-turn budget.

AI.tldr: 提出SLIC框架，用强化微调训练4B规模可本地部署小模型完成闭环模拟电路优化，在41个放大器拓扑基准上超越763B大模型48.5个百分点，并实现跨工艺节点与商业PDK的可迁移部署。
AI.motivation: 模拟IC设计是多轮迭代、依赖仿真器的耦合权衡工程任务，而专有PDK限制了托管式大语言模型工作流在实际设计中的部署。需要本地可运行、闭环优化的模型方案。
AI.method: SLIC（小模型迭代电路）强化微调框架：结构化电路表示 + 离散化相对更新动作；领域与成功门控的多目标奖励；奖励引导的rollout引导机制（RGRS），将每步仿真反馈同时用于策略学习与在线 rollout 构建；并发布含41个放大器拓扑、标准化协议（分布内验证、留出拓扑评估、跨工艺节点迁移）的开源目标条件基准。
AI.result: 仅用开源65nm CMOS PTM训练：SLIC-Random在8轮内分布内四规格Pass@1达87.1%，超763B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Think 48.5个百分点；SLIC-Softmax在留出拓扑上72.6% Pass@1；无需额外微调迁移至五个未见工艺节点，并在商业TSMC 65nm PDK留出拓扑上达49.9% Pass@1；32轮测试时预算下留出拓扑Pass@1升至83.2%。
AI.conclusion: 小规模本地模型经强化微调可在模拟电路设计中超越超大模型，具备跨拓扑、跨工艺节点及商业PDK的泛化与实用部署能力，且性能随测试时仿真交互次数可扩展，避免向外部LLM传输专有数据。

title: Multi-Stage Phase-Aware Self-Supervised Reconstruction for Multi-Echo Gradient-Echo MRI
comment: Submit to a journal; under review
summary: Purpose: To develop a phase-aware self-supervised framework for accelerated high-resolution multi-echo gradient-echo (mGRE) MRI that preserves anatomical detail and complex echo information for quantitative mapping. Methods: We developed multi-stage phase-aware self-supervised reconstruction (MSPR-GRE), integrating progressive k-space expansion with phase estimation and refinement. Sequential unrolled networks reconstruct complex multi-echo images and update echo-dependent phase priors. A relaxation-informed temporal subspace is used for acquisitions with at least four echoes, while shorter echo trains are reconstructed in the image domain. Training uses held-out acquired k-space samples without fully sampled targets. Evaluation included 9.4 T ex vivo mouse-brain data 30um eight-echo and 18um dual-echo) and retrospectively undersampled 7 T AHEAD human-brain data, with supervised ablations. Results:MSPR-GRE reduced artifacts in regions of rapid phase variation and preserved fine mouse-brain anatomy. Across five AHEAD test datasets at R = 4, 8, and 12, it generally improved magnitude-image, T2* map, and QSM metrics, particularly at higher acceleration. At R = 12, fourth-echo magnitude NRMSE was 12.09$\pm$0.60% versus 21.55$\pm$1.12% for SSDU. Ablations indicated benefits of phase refinement, while supervised experiments supported multi-stage phase-aware reconstruction. Conclusion: MSPR-GRE improves accelerated mGRE reconstruction and quantitative-map agreement without fully sampled training targets. Further validation of generalizability and phase-estimation accuracy is needed.

AI.tldr: MSPR-GRE：一种无需全采样标签的相位感知自监督多阶段重建框架，用于加速高分辨多回波GRE MRI，在9.4T小鼠脑与7T人脑数据上优于SSDU，尤其在R=12时效果显著。
AI.motivation: 加速高分辨率mGRE采集时，现有重建方法难以同时保留解剖细节与复杂回波（相位）信息，且缺乏全采样训练标签；相位快速变化区域易产生伪影，影响T2*/QSM定量。
AI.method: 提出多阶段相位感知自监督重建（MSPR-GRE）：渐进式k空间扩展+相位估计与细化，级联展开网络重建复数多回波图像并更新回波相关相位先验；≥4回波用弛豫约束时间子空间，短回波串在图像域重建；用留出已采集k空间样本训练，无需全采样目标。
AI.result: 在9.4T离体鼠脑（30μm八回波、18μm双回波）与回顾欠采样7T AHEAD人脑数据上验证，减少相位快变区伪影、保留细微解剖；R=4/8/12下普遍改善幅值图、T2*图与QSM指标；R=12时第四回波幅值NRMSE为12.09±0.60%（SSDU为21.55±1.12%）；消融显示相位细化有益，监督实验支持多阶段相位感知设计。
AI.conclusion: MSPR-GRE在无全采样训练目标下提升了加速mGRE重建与定量图一致性；泛化性与相位估计准确性仍需进一步验证。

title: Lightweight Deep Learning Framework for Astrocyte-Centric 3D Reconstruction across Normal and Stress-associated Ultrastructural States
comment: Accepted for publication in npj Imaging. 19 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables, including Supplementary Material. Code is available at https://github.com/QuIN-Lab/AstroSeg-vEM
summary: The morphology of astrocytes is closely associated with their ability to support and modulate neural circuit functions; however, its reconstruction from volume electron microscopy (vEM) data remains labor-intensive and computationally resource-intensive, placing substantial barriers on its broader adoption and scalability despite the high spatial resolution of vEM. We present AstroSeg-vEM, a lightweight, astrocyte-centric framework for morphology-preserving astrocyte segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and quantitative morphological analysis in vEM images. AstroSeg-vEM combines transformer-based 2D segmentation with dedicated post-processing methods and operates directly on high-resolution EM sections, making it well suited to anisotropic vEM data and downstream proofreading workflows while preserving the full in-plane resolution of the original EM data. Across four mouse hippocampal datasets representing normal and morphologically defined stress-associated astrocyte ultrastructural states, AstroSeg-vEM demonstrates robust performance and generalization, achieving average Dice and weighted Dice values of 0.92 and 0.95, respectively, on a held-out test dataset. Its lightweight architecture enables efficient, high-fidelity reconstruction on consumer-grade hardware, providing a scalable and accessible platform for large-scale astrocyte ultrastructure analysis and future astrocyte-neuron interaction studies.

AI.tldr: AstroSeg-vEM 是一个轻量、以星形胶质细胞为中心、保持形态的 vEM 分割与三维重建框架，结合 Transformer 二维分割与专用后处理，在高分辨率 EM 切片上直接工作，平均 Dice 0.92/加权 Dice 0.95，可在消费级硬件上高效重建。
AI.motivation: 星形胶质细胞形态与其支持、调控神经环路功能密切相关，但从体电子显微镜（vEM）数据重建其形态极其依赖人工且计算开销大；尽管 vEM 空间分辨率高，这些瓶颈严重限制了其推广与规模化应用。
AI.method: 提出 AstroSeg-vEM 框架：将基于 Transformer 的二维分割与专门设计的后处理方法相结合，直接在高分辨率 EM 切片上操作，保留原始数据的全平面内分辨率，适配各向异性 vEM 数据与下游校对流程；整体为轻量级星形胶质细胞中心架构。
AI.result: 在四个小鼠海马数据集（涵盖正常及形态学定义的压力相关星形胶质细胞超微结构状态）上表现稳健且泛化良好；在留出测试集上平均 Dice 0.92、加权 Dice 0.95；轻量架构使其可在消费级硬件上高效、高保真地完成重建。
AI.conclusion: AstroSeg-vEM 为大规模星形胶质细胞超微结构分析及未来星形胶质细胞—神经元相互作用研究提供了可扩展、易获取的平台。

title: From Bias to Positionality: A critical grammar for Large Language Models
summary: Bias has become a default lens for understanding what machine learning systems do and how we should relate to them. Bias is at root a deviation from a standard; in decision making systems we can supply a standard from outside: a law, a protected attribute, a benchmark, a statistical property. However, even there, biased is often used as a shorthand, without stating what the position taken is - a silent ``relative to''. In a general use of language models, nothing supplies the standard: there is no decision to audit and no counterfactual output, so the shorthand fails. We argue that positionality -- the located, articulated, owned and contestable position from which anything is said -- is the better grammar for the question these models now force: who is speaking, from where? Against the vendors' answer of nowhere and the seductive possibility of everywhere, we argue that when a model is taken as-if speaking, it speaks from somewhere, and this means positionality can describe models, and the way they are believed beyond their warrant, even though they are not accountable speakers. A model's positionality is laminar -- laid down across corpus, tuning, system prompt, application and the live conversation. We separate three sets of factors: the positionality of a model's creators, the behaviour they intend for it, and the behaviour it enacts, and situate current work within this matrix. This lets us highlight what each stratum inherits from the one below, with ruptures and collapses where that inheritance is disavowed. We then return to where models speak from, and discuss the implications for how models are made, read and held accountable.

AI.tldr: 论文主张用"positionality（位置性）"取代"bias"作为理解语言模型"从何言说"的框架，并提出位置性的分层（laminar）模型与三元矩阵分析。
AI.motivation: "Bias"本质是相对某一标准的偏离，在决策系统中该标准可由法律、受保护属性、基准或统计性质从外部提供；但在大语言模型的通用使用中，没有可审计的决策、没有反事实输出，也没有标准来源，因此"bias"沦为隐含"相对于……"的模糊简称。模型同时被厂商宣称"无处不在"或"无处所在"，这两种回答都不成立。
AI.method: 概念/理论分析：提出以"positionality"——可言说、有据可循、被拥有且可争辩的所处位置——作为更合适的语法。论证模型被"当作在言说"时必然从某处言说，故位置性可描述模型及其被过度信任的方式，即使模型并非可问责的言说者。进一步提出位置性是"层积式（laminar）"的，横跨语料、微调、系统提示、应用与实时对话，并区分三组因素：创造者的位置性、其意图行为、实际实施的行为，构成分析矩阵，定位现有工作，揭示各层从下层继承了什么，以及继承被否认时的断裂与塌陷。
AI.result: 给出一个分层位置性框架与"创造者位置性 × 意图行为 × 实施行为"矩阵，用以刻画模型从语料、微调、提示、应用到对话各层的位置继承与断裂，并重新回答"模型从何处言说"的问题。
AI.conclusion: 应以位置性替代bias作为核心分析语法；由此讨论模型如何被制造、被阅读和被问责的启示，强调模型言说的具体所在及其被信任的限度。

title: Deep Personalization: Continuous Context Observation for Local Proactive Agents
summary: As AI agents become increasingly capable, users must still recognize when and how to ask for help, leaving many opportunities for useful support unrealized. Proactive agents hold the promise to close this gap, but effective proactivity requires understanding users' real-time activities and personalizing intervention timing so that assistance is offered when it is likely to be helpful rather than disruptive. We introduce deep personalization, a closed-loop process that connects continuous context observation with continual agent adaptation: an agent observes user activity, selectively retains long-term context, and adapts intervention decisions from implicit feedback. We initiate deep personalization in Coco, a proactive desktop agent, by having a separate Observer Agent that monitors desktop activity, maintains compact long-term user modeling context, and learns when assistance is desirable from implicit signals such as engagement, dismissal, explicit requests, and repeated work patterns. We further develop efficient on-device strategies to enable the Observer Agent to run on local AI compute platforms without streaming raw activity data off-device. For evaluation at scale without collecting sensitive real-user activity, we introduce a data-synthesis pipeline that transforms existing computer-use trajectories into OSWorld-Persona, a benchmark with persona-conditioned intervention labels. On OSWorld-Persona, deep personalization improves macro F1 across three model backbones from 0.12-0.19 under direct prompting to 0.35-0.48 after adaptation, a 2.4-3.0x relative gain. In a week-long user study, we observe that Coco improves its macro-averaged F1 score from 0.199 to 0.515. These results suggest that on-device deep personalization can make proactive agents more timely and increasingly aligned with each user's everyday work.

AI.tldr: 提出"深度个性化"闭环流程与Observer Agent，使桌面主动式智能体Coco能观察用户活动、保留长期上下文并从隐式反馈学习干预时机；构建OSWorld-Persona基准，宏观F1由直接提示的0.12-0.19提升至0.35-0.48，一周用户研究中Coco从0.199升至0.515。
AI.motivation: 用户往往难以自知何时、如何求助，主动式智能体可填补这一空白；但有效主动性需理解用户实时活动并个性化干预时机，做到"有帮助而非打扰"，同时避免将原始活动数据上传带来的隐私问题。
AI.method: 提出deep personalization闭环：持续观察上下文—选择性保留长期记忆—依据隐式反馈（参与、忽略、显式请求、重复工作模式）持续调整干预决策。实现为独立Observer Agent驱动桌面智能体Coco，并设计高效端侧策略使其在本地AI算力运行；另构建数据合成管线，将现有计算机使用轨迹转为带人格条件干预标签的OSWorld-Persona基准用于规模化评测。
AI.result: OSWorld-Persona上，三个模型主干经适配后宏观F1从直接提示的0.12-0.19提升到0.35-0.48（2.4-3.0倍相对增益）；为期一周的用户研究中，Coco的宏观平均F1由0.199提升至0.515。
AI.conclusion: 端侧深度个性化能让主动式智能体更及时、更贴合每位用户的日常工作；隐私保护下的本地闭环适配是可行且有效的主动交互路径。

title: When to Start Denoising? Adaptive Denoising Entry for Generative Video Compression
summary: Generative video compression offers a promising solution for compressing and reconstructing videos under extremely low bitrate constraints, among which the diffusion-based solutions still achieve the best performance by providing the powerful generative latent prior. However, their effectiveness critically depends on when the compressed latent is introduced into the diffusion process, which directly governs the trade-off between reconstruction fidelity and perceptual realism. To address this limitation, we identify denoising start-timestep selection as a key factor governing this trade-off and formulate it as a geometric optimization problem. Based on this formulation, we propose a novel adaptive diffusion entry method for generative video compression (ADE-GVC), the first timestep-aware generative video compression framework, featuring a lightweight predictor that estimates an adaptive denoising start point from the compressed latent. A temporal adapter further extracts compression-aware conditions and injects them into a pretrained video diffusion model, enabling the reconstruction of videos with both high fidelity and realism. More importantly, we observe a strong quantitative relationship between the predicted timesteps and the distortion between the original and compressed latents, providing empirical support for our optimization formulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ADE-GVC achieves the state-of-the-art performance on perceptual metrics and substantially improves reconstruction realism over existing generative video compression methods. Notably, our ADE-GVC achieves an average bitrate savings of 40.99\% (on DISTS) and 95.24\% (on PSNR) compared to the latest open-source baseline GLC-Video.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ADE-GVC，首个时间步感知的生成式视频压缩框架，通过轻量预测器从压缩潜变量自适应估计去噪起始时间步，并配合时间适配器将压缩感知条件注入预训练视频扩散模型，在极低码率下同时提升保真度与真实感。
AI.motivation: 扩散式生成视频压缩虽性能最优，但其效果严重依赖压缩潜变量在扩散过程中被引入的时机（即去噪起始时间步），该时机直接决定重建保真度与感知真实感之间的权衡。现有方法缺乏对该关键因素的显式建模与控制。
AI.method: 1) 将去噪起始时间步选择形式化为几何优化问题；2) 设计轻量预测器，从压缩潜变量估计自适应去噪起始点；3) 引入时间适配器提取压缩感知条件并注入预训练视频扩散模型；4) 观察到预测时间步与原/压缩潜变量失真之间存在强定量关系，为优化建模提供实证支持。
AI.result: 在感知指标上达到SOTA，重建真实感显著优于现有生成式视频压缩方法；相比最新开源基线GLC-Video，在DISTS上平均节省40.99%码率，在PSNR上节省95.24%码率。
AI.conclusion: 时间步感知的自适应扩散入口是提升生成式视频压缩保真度-真实感权衡的有效手段，ADE-GVC为极低码率视频压缩提供了新的SOTA方案。

title: Sckwoky at SHROOM-Visions: Character-Level Hallucination-Span Detection in Image-Conditioned VLMs via Dual-Prompted LoRA Decoders
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Third Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP (UncertaiNLP 2026), Budapest, Hungary. Presented as a poster at the workshop
summary: We present our system for the SHROOM-visions 2026 shared task on character-level hallucination span detection in image-conditioned vision-language model (VLM) responses, evaluated across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. The detector is built on a frozen Gemma-4-12B-it backbone with trainable LoRA adapters (approximately 10.7M parameters). Because the backbone is a causal decoder, hidden states read from a single copy of an answer cannot attend to subsequent tokens; we therefore repeat the candidate answer within one prompt and extract features from its second occurrence, giving every position approximate bidirectional context in a single non-autoregressive pass. A character-level locator combines intermediate hidden states to predict hallucination probabilities, BIO boundaries, and a response-level abstention score, while separate language-specific classifiers assign one of five hallucination types to each predicted span. On the closed test set, our system reaches a macro-averaged character IoU of 0.4404, more than doubling the official baseline (0.1854), and ranks 5th-6th on IoU across the four languages. On the English tuning split, controlled ablations attribute a gain to the repeated answer that is comparable to that of LoRA adaptation (its held-out gain is smaller and concentrated on hallucinated answers), and they show that the detector relies on the image-answer pairing: shuffling images across examples drives IoU down to the level of the predict-nothing floor or below it in every language. In deployments where the same Gemma-4-12B-it model also generates answers, its base weights can be reused, making the approach practical for local question-answering systems that cannot run a separate verifier.

AI.tldr: 提出基于冻结Gemma-4-12B-it+LoRA的字符级幻觉片段检测系统，通过重复答案实现近似双向上下文，SHROOM-visions 2026闭集测试macro字符IoU 0.4404（基线0.1854），四语排名5-6位。
AI.motivation: 图像条件VLM回答中存在字符级幻觉片段，需要在英/法/意/中多语言下精确定位；同时因果解码器单次读取答案时无法看到后续token，缺乏双向上下文，且本地QA系统难以额外部署独立验证器。
AI.method: 在冻结的Gemma-4-12B-it上训练约10.7M参数的LoRA适配器；将候选答案在提示中重复一次，从第二次出现处抽取隐状态，使每个位置在单次非自回归前向中获得近似双向上下文；字符级定位器融合中间层隐状态，同时预测幻觉概率、BIO边界和回答级弃答分数；另有按语言独立的分类器为每个预测片段分配五类幻觉类型之一。
AI.result: 闭集测试macro平均字符IoU为0.4404，超过官方基线0.1854一倍以上，四语言IoU排名5-6。英语调参集消融显示：重复答案带来的增益与LoRA适配相当（留出集增益较小且集中于含幻觉的回答）；打乱图像-答案配对会使各语言IoU降至"全不预测"下限或更低，说明检测器依赖图文配对。
AI.conclusion: 重复答案是一种低成本、近似双向上下文的替代方案，效果可与LoRA微调相比；检测器真正利用了图像信息。若同一Gemma-4-12B-it既生成又验证回答，可复用基础权重，适合无法运行独立验证器的本地问答系统。

title: Leveraging Psychophysical Attentional Distribution for Gaze-Augmented Reward Modeling
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026 Main Track)
summary: Integrating human feedback into language models has gained increasing attention as a means to align model outputs with human preferences, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) serving as a prominent framework for preference-based alignment. Recent studies have incorporated eye-tracking (ET) data as an additional supervisory signal for reward model training, grounding reward learning in human reading behavior. Building on this approach, we extend prior fixation-centric models by leveraging established findings from cognitive psychology on human letter recognition. Specifically, we model visual attention as a spatially graded distribution centered on the current gaze location and incorporate this representation into reward model training. Our results show that the reward model trained with the proposed gaze distribution achieves higher preference prediction accuracy than a baseline model. Moreover, some results from our experiments are qualitatively consistent with established findings on human attention during reading, suggesting that they potentially capture cognitively meaningful aspects of human attention allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文在基于眼动数据的奖励模型训练中，将视觉注意建模为以当前注视点为中心的空间分级分布，并证明该表示能提升偏好预测准确率，且部分结果与阅读认知心理学发现定性一致。
AI.motivation: RLHF是偏好对齐的主要框架，近期研究引入眼动数据作为奖励模型的额外监督信号，但已有的注视点中心模型未充分利用认知心理学关于人类字母识别的成果，注意力被过度简化为单点注视。
AI.method: 基于认知心理学中人类字母识别的研究，将视觉注意建模为以当前注视位置为中心的空间分级分布（而非单点注视），并将该分布表示纳入奖励模型的训练过程。
AI.result: 使用所提注视分布训练的奖励模型在偏好预测准确率上优于基线模型；部分实验结果与阅读中人类注意的既有发现定性一致，表明其可能捕捉到人类注意力分配的认知意义层面。
AI.conclusion: 用空间分级注视分布替代固定注视点表示可提升奖励模型的偏好预测表现，并有望使奖励学习更贴近真实的人类阅读注意力机制。

title: No finite rulebook can certify every safe program: an impossibility theorem for gatekeeping AI agents
summary: An AI assistant writes small programs, and a gatekeeper must decide, from the code alone, whether each one may run. Suppose the rules are fixed: never perform a forbidden action, never let the output depend on a secret, always answer eventually. Can two rulebooks, one listing what is allowed and one listing what is not, both be complete, if every rule must be backed by evidence that a machine can check in finite time? We prove that they cannot. Checkable evidence can only establish what a finite record settles, and ``never'' and ``eventually'' are never settled by a finite record. For prohibitions the failure is one-sided: every violation can be caught by watching, but no safe program can be cleared for good. For confidentiality and responsiveness, neither side can be. We characterise exactly which rules about visible behaviour evidence can confirm, and we show that any sound rulebook of $n$ bits omits a compliant program of about $n$ bits. A time limit makes everything checkable, but only by running the program for essentially the whole limit, so a finite machine is not a feasible one. Finally, we show what a gatekeeper can still guarantee: not a verdict on every program, but a checkable list that contains everything it must allow and nothing it must refuse. Simulations on 2.2 million random programs and on self-referential adversaries show that the obstruction is adversarial rather than typical, and that the one error a longer test never removes is the liveness part of confidentiality.

AI.tldr: 论文证明：若每条规则都必须由机器在有限时间内可检验的证据支撑，则"允许清单"和"禁止清单"两种规则手册都无法同时完备，因为有限记录无法判定"永不"和"最终"这类性质。
AI.motivation: AI助手会编写小程序，守门人需仅凭代码决定其能否运行。作者想探究：在安全（不执行禁止动作）、保密（输出不依赖秘密）、活性（最终必答）等规则下，是否存在由可检验证据支撑、同时又完备的规则手册。
AI.method: 从理论上分析可检验证据的判定能力，刻画哪些关于可见行为的规则可被证据确认；证明任何n比特的可靠规则手册都会遗漏约n比特的合规程序；并论证时间限制虽使一切可检验，但要求几乎跑满时限，故有限机器不可行。辅以220万随机程序与自指对抗样本的仿真。
AI.result: 禁止类规则呈单边失效：每次违规都能被监视捕获，但安全程序无法被永久放行；保密与活性则两侧都无法判定。仿真表明该障碍是对抗性的而非普遍性的，且延长测试也无法消除的唯一错误是保密性中的活性部分。
AI.conclusion: 守门人无法对每个程序给出裁决，但仍可保证一个可检验清单，包含必须允许的一切且不含必须拒绝的一切。

title: PUMA: Probability-Constrained Sequential Interaction for Forensic Localization
summary: Image manipulation localization must jointly exploit semantic structure and noise-sensitive forensic evidence. However, the effects of spatial correspondence, matching quality, and interaction order are often conflated. Existing semantic-forensic fusion methods provide complementary representations, but do not explicitly preserve quality-mismatch information during spatial correspondence or adaptively select the order in which information is propagated across branches. We propose PUMA (Probability-constrained Unbalanced Matching and Aggregation), which combines spatially constrained unbalanced optimal transport with position-wise convex selection between two sequential operators through a shared positional interface. Before normalization, PUMA retains signed transport-mass residuals, constructs row-stochastic cross-branch and within-noise-branch operators, and updates noise features through a gated residual path. PUMA achieves strong localization results on four test sets, with scores on COVERAGE and NIST16 exceeding the published results of the representative methods listed in our comparison. The experiments support the utility of local matching states and adaptive sequential interaction for cross-source localization and several post-processing conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出PUMA框架，用受空间约束的非平衡最优传输和逐位置凸选择来融合语义与噪声取证特征，实现图像篡改定位。
AI.motivation: 现有语义-取证融合方法未在空间对应过程中显式保留质量不匹配信息，也未自适应选择跨分支信息传播的顺序，导致空间对应、匹配质量与交互顺序的影响相互混淆。
AI.method: PUMA由空间约束的非平衡最优传输和共享位置接口下的逐位置凸选择顺序算子构成；在归一化前保留带符号传输质量残差，构建行随机的跨分支算子与噪声分支内算子，并通过门控残差路径更新噪声特征。
AI.result: 在四个测试集上取得较强定位效果，COVERAGE和NIST16分数超过所比较代表性方法的已发表结果；实验验证了局部匹配状态和自适应顺序交互对跨源定位及多种后处理条件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 局部匹配状态显式建模与自适应顺序交互对语义-取证融合的篡改定位是有益且有效的。

title: Visual Similarity in Adult Word Extension and Artificial Word Learning
summary: When two objects share a name, how much does their visual similarity explain, and what do the teaching examples add? First, we reanalyzed trial-level data from a large adult word-extension study (Lewis & Frank, 2018), computing each test image's distance to the examples shown in the space of a frozen self-supervised visual encoder (DINOv2). Distance was associated with extension (log odds -3.23 per standard deviation; 520 people), and an exploratory post hoc analysis suggested that this association persisted within the taught domain after controlling for taxonomic level and teaching condition. Example composition also mattered: after three examples, adults extended a word to 1.1% of superordinate items when the examples were subordinate and to 77.5% when they were superordinate. Second, in an artificial learner using the same encoder, words joining two categories were learned less accurately the farther apart the categories were (84.7%, 65.4%, and 53.0% naming accuracy for near, mid, and far pairs). The encoder's distances correlated with human similarity and confusability measures from three datasets (rho = .501-.795), but this representational alignment did not translate into conclusive evidence that human-derived distances predict learner difficulty, and a second encoder trained on one child's experience reproduced the tier ordering but not the pair-level effect. The secondary human data were analyzed under an internal plan fixed before the confirmatory analyses (not externally preregistered). Visual similarity accounts for part of how generalization is organized in both systems, while the composition of examples contributes what the distance we used does not capture.

AI.tldr: 本文用冻结的DINOv2视觉编码器度量视觉相似度，重新分析成人词义扩展数据并构建人工学习者，考察视觉相似性与教学样例构成如何共同影响"同名"泛化。
AI.motivation: 两个事物共享名称时，视觉相似性能解释多少泛化行为、教学样例又额外贡献什么，此前缺乏在同一表征空间下对成人与人工学习者的系统检验。
AI.method: （1）用DINOv2计算测试图与教学样例的距离，重分析Lewis & Frank (2018) 成人词扩展的试次级数据（520人），控制分类层级与教学条件；（2）用同一编码器构建人工学习者，学习连接两个范畴的词，比较近/中/远类别对的命名准确率；（3）将编码器距离与三个数据集的人类相似性与混淆度指标相关，并用另一儿童经验训练的编码器做复现检验。
AI.result: 距离与扩展显著相关（每标准差 log odds = -3.23）；控制层级与教学条件后关联仍存在。样例构成影响巨大：从属样例后成人仅将词扩展到1.1%的上位项，上位样例后达77.5%。人工学习者准确率随类别距离增加而下降（84.7%、65.4%、53.0%）。编码器距离与人类相似度/混淆度相关（rho = .501–.795），但该表征对齐未能给出人类衍生距离预测学习难度的确证证据；第二个编码器复现了层级排序但未复现配对层面效应。
AI.conclusion: 视觉相似性部分组织了成人与人工系统的泛化，但样例构成贡献了所用距离无法捕捉的信息；表征对齐不等于行为预测，词义泛化需同时考虑相似性与教学输入结构。

title: Sharp Sample Complexity of KL-Regularized Reinforcement Learning
