summary: KL-regularized reinforcement learning, the objective behind maximum-entropy RL and RL from human feedback, is variational inference in the graphical model of "control as inference": the regularized optimal policy is a posterior over trajectories, and the suboptimality of a policy is $β$ times a KL divergence between path measures. However, it is not known how many samples it takes to learn this posterior, even with a generative model. Earlier $1/ε$ guarantees scale with $H^5$ in the effective horizon $H$, and no lower bound for MDPs depends on the temperature $β$. In this work, we show that for a discounted MDP with $K$ state-action pairs, the plug-in estimator finds a policy that is $ε$-optimal from every initial state with $\widetilde{O}(KH^3/(ε\max\{ε,β\}) + KH)$ samples, and that no algorithm, even one that chooses where to sample, can do with fewer when $ε\lesssim \min\{H, H^2/β\}$. For $ε< β$ this is a $1/ε$ rate with the same horizon dependence as unregularized RL. We also find the exact asymptotic constant of the plug-in estimator, a Fisher-weighted variance of the estimated soft Q-function. The estimator is locally asymptotically minimax among methods that sample every pair equally often, and we give the allocation of samples that is optimal among adaptive designs. Simulations on small MDPs match the rates and the constants.

AI.tldr: 本文研究KL正则化强化学习（即控制即推理图模型中的后验学习）在生成式模型下的样本复杂度，给出了插值估计器的上界与匹配的下界，刻画了精确的渐近常数与最优采样分配。
AI.motivation: KL正则化RL（最大熵RL、RLHF的目标）是"控制即推理"图模型中的变分推断，正则化最优策略是轨迹上的后验，策略次优度等于β倍路径测度KL散度。但即使有生成式模型，学习该后验所需样本数未知：已有1/ε保证在有效时域H上按H^5缩放，且MDP的下界均不依赖温度β。
AI.method: 针对有K个状态-动作对的折扣MDP，分析插件式（plug-in）估计器：先估计soft Q函数再导出策略，证明其上界；构造信息论下界（允许自适应采样的算法）；推导插件估计器的精确渐近常数——估计soft Q的Fisher加权方差；分析等量采样方法的局部渐近极小极大性，并给出自适应设计下的最优样本分配。
AI.result: 上界：从每个初始状态出发ε-最优的策略只需Õ(KH^3/(ε max{ε,β}) + KH)样本。下界：当ε≲min{H, H^2/β}时，即使算法可选择采样位置，也无法用更少样本。当ε<β时达到1/ε速率，且时域依赖与无正则RL相同。渐近常数精确为估计soft Q的Fisher加权方差；该估计器在等量采样方法中局部渐近极小极大；给出自适应设计下的最优样本分配。小规模MDP仿真与速率及常数吻合。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了KL正则化RL后验学习的紧样本复杂度：插值估计器达到Õ(KH^3/(ε max{ε,β}) + KH)的匹配上下界，ε<β时具有与无正则RL相同的H依赖，并刻画了精确渐近常数与最优采样分配，填补了温度依赖下界与H^5缩放的空缺。

title: Online-Adaptive Fuzzy Cognitive Maps for Neuro-symbolic Financial Forecasting
summary: We present a neuro-symbolic framework that pairs online-adaptive Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) with long short-term memory (LSTM) networks for financial forecasting. Financial markets exhibit regime shifts and nonlinear dynamics. Existing models often trade off one of these key properties: these models capture temporal patterns but hide causal drivers, or they recover causal graphs that cannot adapt post-training. We close this gap with two frameworks. Framework I constructs an FCM from live dual-source price series and macroeconomic indicators, and adapts its edges online through an error-driven Hebbian rule. We introduce the Asymmetric Additive Residual Fusion method to seamlessly combine the FCM and LSTM predictions under Framework I. Framework II constructs a literature-grounded, LLM-augmented FCM where every edge carries a verifiable citation that gives an auditable map of factor interactions. On NASDAQ Composite data, Framework I matched the performance of the LSTM baseline on state-directional accuracy and outperformed LSTM by 7.6 percentage points on the return-sign accuracy. Framework I outperformed standalone FCM models across both evaluation metrics. The adaptive maps converged to new regimes within 10-15 trading days, and Framework II center-node FCMs scored 68.9% to 85.7% on the state-directional accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出神经符号框架，将在线自适应模糊认知图(FCM)与LSTM结合用于金融预测，兼顾时序建模与因果可解释性。
AI.motivation: 金融市场存在状态切换与非线性动态。现有模型难以兼顾两类关键属性：一类能捕捉时序模式但隐藏因果驱动，另一类可恢复因果图但训练后无法自适应。
AI.method: 提出两个框架：Framework I 从双源价格序列与宏观指标构建FCM，通过误差驱动的Hebbian规则在线更新边权，并提出非对称加性残差融合方法整合FCM与LSTM预测；Framework II 构建文献支撑、LLM增强的FCM，每条边附可验证引用以形成可审计的因子交互图。
AI.result: 在NASDAQ综合指数数据上，Framework I在状态方向准确率上媲美LSTM基线，在收益符号准确率上超出LSTM 7.6个百分点，并在两项指标上均优于独立FCM模型。自适应图在10-15个交易日内收敛到新状态；Framework II 的中心节点FCM状态方向准确率为68.9%–85.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该神经符号框架弥合了时序预测与可解释因果建模之间的鸿沟，实现可在线适应、可审计的金融预测。

title: FlashMotion: Ultra-Fast Long-Term 3D Motion Generation
summary: 3D human motion generation plays a crucial role in game development, extended reality (XR), digital humans, and embodied simulation. Beyond motion generation, practical pipelines include rigging, retargeting, and rendering, making ultra-fast long-term 3D motion generation without compromising quality valuable for real-time interactive applications. Despite promising progress, high-quality long-horizon motion generation under tight inference budgets remains challenging, owing to 2 coupled bottlenecks: (1) generative strategies that require many sampling steps for high-quality 3D motion generation and (2) model architectures with substantial per-step computational and memory costs for long sequences. We present FlashMotion, a co-designed framework for high-quality long-horizon 3D motion generation under a strict inference budget, covering text-to-motion, music-to-dance, and speech-to-gesture tasks. To enhance trajectory-level efficiency, we introduce a 3D motion-space MeanFlow formulation with kinematic and dynamic consistency constraints for few-step generation, together with an Adaptive Soft masking mechanism for temporally coherent motion editing. To improve per-step efficiency, we design a lightweight non-autoregressive BiMamba architecture with condition-guided state selection and AdaIN-based condition fusion mechanism, enhancing cross-modal alignment and generalization to longer motion sequences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FlashMotion achieves overall state-of-the-art performance in both quality and efficiency across text-to-motion, speech-to-gesture, and music-to-dance generation. Code is available at FlashMotion (https://github.com/Sun-Happy-YKX/FlashMotion).

AI.tldr: FlashMotion 是一个协同设计的框架，在严格推理预算下实现高质量长时序 3D 人体运动生成，覆盖文本到动作、音乐到舞蹈、语音到手势三类任务。
AI.motivation: 3D 人体运动生成在游戏、XR、数字人、具身仿真中很关键，实际管线还包括绑定、重定向和渲染，因此实时交互场景需要超快速的长时序生成。当前存在两个耦合瓶颈：(1) 生成策略需大量采样步才能保证高质量；(2) 模型架构在长序列上单步计算与内存开销大。
AI.method: 轨迹层面效率：提出 3D 运动空间的 MeanFlow 形式，配合运动学与动力学一致性约束，实现少步生成；并设计自适应软掩码（Adaptive Soft masking）机制实现时间连贯的运动编辑。单步效率：设计轻量非自回归 BiMamba 架构，含条件引导状态选择与 AdaIN 条件融合机制，提升跨模态对齐及对更长序列的泛化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FlashMotion 在文本到动作、语音到手势、音乐到舞蹈三类任务上，在质量与效率两方面总体达到 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成策略（少步 MeanFlow）与架构（轻量 BiMamba）的协同设计，FlashMotion 有效缓解了长时序 3D 运动生成中的双重效率瓶颈，在严格推理预算下兼顾质量与速度，适用于实时交互应用。代码已开源。

title: Representational Atoms in Neural Networks
summary: Understanding the internal representations of neural networks and characterizing their relationship with human conceptual structure are two critical questions for elucidating model mechanisms. The former reveals how learned knowledge is organized in internal representations, whereas the latter provides a basis for interpreting these representations through human conceptual structure. Here, we formally define fundamental representational units (FRUs) and establish two evaluation criteria: fidelity and stability. We further prove that threshold-activated sparse autoencoders (TSAEs) can identify FRUs with high fidelity and stability under appropriate conditions, and validate this result through large-scale experiments. Further analyses reveal that FRUs with higher stability exhibit greater monosemanticity and can be composed across layers to recover semantic organization corresponding to human conceptual structure. These results provide a unified framework for defining, evaluating and identifying FRUs in neural networks, and establish a foundation for characterizing the relationship between neural network representations and human conceptual structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"基础表征单元"(FRUs)的形式化定义，给出保真度与稳定性两条评价准则，证明阈值激活稀疏自编码器(TSAE)在适当条件下可高保真、高稳定地识别FRUs，并用大规模实验验证；高稳定性FRUs更具单义性且可跨层组合恢复与人类概念结构对应的语义组织。
AI.motivation: 神经网络内部表征的组织方式，以及其与人类概念结构的关系，是理解模型机制的两个关键问题；但缺乏对"基本表征单元"的统一定义与评价标准，导致无法判断现有方法提取的单元是否可信。
AI.method: 形式化定义基础表征单元(FRUs)，建立保真度与稳定性两个评价准则；从理论上证明阈值激活稀疏自编码器(TSAE)在适当条件下能高保真、高稳定地识别FRUs；并通过大规模实验进行验证，进一步分析稳定性与单义性、跨层组合的关系。
AI.result: 理论证明得到实验支持；稳定性更高的FRUs表现出更强的单义性，且可跨层组合，恢复出与人类概念结构相对应的语义组织。
AI.conclusion: 为神经网络中FRUs的定义、评价与识别提供了统一框架，并为刻画神经网络表征与人类概念结构之间的关系奠定基础。

title: Evaluating Compositional Generalization in Transformers: The Role of Composition Equivalence and Module Coverage
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Compositional generalization is an important form of out-of-distribution generalization, defined as the ability to train on some combinations of modules (e.g., functions such as sort, filter) and then generalize to unseen combinations. Despite substantial empirical work evaluating compositional generalization in transformers, findings have been inconsistent because evaluations were often conducted on a limited set of train-test splits, defined in an ad hoc manner. Through a systematic evaluation, we identify two key aspects of the train-test distribution that strongly affect performance: composition equivalence and module coverage. We show that the apparent performance of direct models (trained only on final outputs) results primarily from exploiting composition equivalences, meaning different sequences of modules that reduce to identical end-to-end functions. When benchmarks eliminate these equivalences, performance drops significantly, showing their inability to generalize to compositions of known modules that produce novel end-to-end functions. We further demonstrate that performance degrades monotonically as module coverage shifts increase (when modules appear in different contexts between train and test), affecting both direct and step-by-step models (trained on intermediate and final outputs). These findings have concrete implications for benchmark design: benchmarks that include compositional equivalences can lead to significant overestimation of the generalization abilities of direct models, and benchmarks that include both module coverage violations and compositional equivalences can exacerbate shortcut learning. As a case study, we demonstrate the role of compositional equivalence on the generalization performance of the pre-trained model Llama3-8B on the code-output prediction task in the coding benchmark LiveCodeBench.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了Transformer在组合泛化上的表现，指出训练-测试分布中的“组合等价性”和“模块覆盖”是决定性能的两大关键因素。
AI.motivation: 现有组合泛化研究结论不一致，因评测常基于少量、临时设定的训练-测试划分，缺乏系统分析。
AI.method: 系统性构造多种训练-测试划分，控制“组合等价性”（不同模块序列归约为相同端到端函数）和“模块覆盖偏移”（模块在训练与测试中出现于不同上下文），对比直接模型与分步模型的性能。
AI.result: 直接模型的表面性能主要来自利用组合等价性；消除等价性后性能显著下降，说明其无法泛化到已知模块产生的新端到端函数。模块覆盖偏移增大时，直接与分步模型性能均单调下降。LiveCodeBench上Llama3-8B的代码输出预测也体现了组合等价性的作用。
AI.conclusion: 基准设计应谨慎：含组合等价性会严重高估直接模型的泛化能力；同时含覆盖违规与等价性会加剧捷径学习。

title: Living constitutions: Participatory alignment for sovereign foundation models
summary: In Constitutional AI, a plain-text "constitution" encodes values and gets incorporated into a model via post-training. However, the procedure for creating such a constitution poses significant challenges: who contributes, who decides which norms are included, and to what extent must the process be participatory or democratic? These challenges can be paralyzing. Yet, we argue that taking action is essential: without a deliberate constitution, sovereign models would risk misalignment or default to norms set by frontier model providers. We propose treating the development of a constitution as an evolving, participatory process akin to citizen science, iteratively drafted, tested, and refined. We therefore formulate five desirable principles: iterative, modular, justifiable, positional, and legitimate. We further argue that such a document must remain responsive not only over time but across the people it governs, and propose that provisions be marked as settled, contested, or underdetermined, so that durable disagreement is recorded in the constitution rather than resolved away. Empirically, we show via agent-based modelling that proposed process for maintaining living constitutions is robust against 50% bad actors among citizens - assuming a share of 75% participants with good intent in the deliberative body. This indicates that the proposed process tolerates a substantial share of adversarial participants.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将宪法AI中的"宪法"制定视为持续演进、参与式的公民科学过程，提出五项原则（迭代、模块化、可辩护、立场性、正当性），并主张条款标注为已定/争议/未决，以在宪法中保留持久分歧；智能体建模显示该方法在公民中50%恶意行为者下仍稳健。
AI.motivation: 宪法AI依赖一份纯文本"宪法"来编码价值观，但谁来贡献、谁决定纳入哪些规范、参与或民主程度如何，均存在难题，容易导致决策瘫痪。作者认为必须行动：若无自觉制定的宪法，主权模型可能失调，或默认采用前沿模型提供方设定的规范。
AI.method: 将宪法制定概念化为类似公民科学的演进式参与过程，迭代起草、测试与修订；提出五项理想原则：迭代性、模块化、可辩护性、立场性、正当性；要求宪法随时间和受治人群保持响应性，并将条款标记为已定（settled）、争议（contested）或未决（underdetermined），把持久分歧记录在案而非消解掉；通过智能体建模（agent-based modelling）评估该维护"活的宪法"流程的稳健性。
AI.result: 智能体建模显示，在协商机构中假定75%参与者具有善意的前提下，该流程对公民中50%的恶意行为者仍具稳健性，表明其能容忍相当比例的对抗性参与者。
AI.conclusion: 宪法不应是静态文本，而应是可迭代、模块化、可正当化的活文档，明确记录持久分歧；该参与式维护流程具备对相当比例对抗参与者的鲁棒性，为主权模型建立自觉宪法提供了可行路径。

title: DepthGS: Depth-Guided Gaussian Splatting with Adaptive Regularization for High-Quality Surface Reconstruction
comment: To appear in IEEE Trans. on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
summary: Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as an efficient representation for novel view synthesis, offering fast differentiable rendering and high visual fidelity, and has increasingly been extended to surface reconstruction. However, the relationship between depth information and reconstruction error remains insufficiently explored, limiting the principled design of geometric optimization strategies. To fill the above gap, we propose DepthGS, a depth-guided Gaussian splatting framework. We derive theoretical relations between depth discrepancies and reconstruction error under single-view and multi-view settings, and rigorously establish corresponding upper bounds on reconstruction error. The above analysis informs the design of adaptive regularization strategies in both single-view and multi-view optimization. More specifically, for single-view optimization, we propose a depth-difference-guided adaptive normal regularization strategy that modulates the normal constraint strength using a geometric reliability weight computed from local depth differences. For multi-view optimization, we introduce a cross-view depth consistency regularization strategy that promotes consistency between neighboring-view depth maps and the corresponding depth predictions obtained by transforming the current view's depth predictions into those neighboring views. Extensive experiments on DTU, Mip-NeRF360, and Tanks and Temples demonstrate that DepthGS achieves competitive performance in both surface reconstruction and novel view synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出DepthGS，从理论上建立深度差异与重建误差的关系上界，并据此设计单视图与多视图自适应深度引导正则化，提升3DGS表面重建与视角合成性能。
AI.motivation: 3DGS已扩展到表面重建，但深度信息与重建误差之间的关系缺乏深入研究，导致几何优化策略难以有原则地设计。
AI.method: 推导单视图与多视图下深度差异和重建误差的理论关系及误差上界；单视图采用由局部深度差异计算几何可靠性权重的自适应法向正则化；多视图引入跨视角深度一致性正则化，使邻视图深度图与当前视图深度变换预测保持一致。
AI.result: 在DTU、Mip-NeRF360、Tanks and Temples上实验，表面重建与新视角合成均取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 深度引导的理论分析与自适应正则可有效改善3DGS几何优化，为几何约束设计提供理论依据。

title: Stagewise and interpretable emergence of inside-outside computation in Transformer-based language models
summary: Variability in syntactic structure and parsing ambiguity are fundamental aspects of natural language which modern LLMs have to learn to deal with proficiently. Previous "post-mortem" studies have shown that fully trained Transformers indeed approximate canonical parsing algorithms such as inside-outside, but little is established theoretically about how this is actually learned. Here, we make a first step towards addressing this by studying the learning dynamics in synthetic context-free grammars with variable parse tree topology. The stagewise learning curves are fully interpretable, in the sense that all of the loss stages a) can be computed analytically, and b) can be clearly associated to the representation of a hidden latent tree variable, which allows to lift ambiguity and utilize information from wider contexts. By probing representations, we visualize the emergence of inside-outside computation across depth and during training: while during early stages local (bigram/trigram) information is used and involves only a few initial layers, gradually the Transformer develops an encoder-decoder structure where the most abstract latent information is encoded in the middle, and the latter half of the network is used to progressively refine the final token prediction. This organization of computation is reminiscent of findings in real-world LLMs, and importantly applies here to a synthetic model which allows full analytical control of the data statistics, thus opening the door to theoretical progress.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 Transformer 在可变句法树拓扑的合成上下文无关文法上的学习动态，发现可完全解析的学习曲线阶段，并可视化 inside-outside 计算在深度和训练中的涌现。
AI.motivation: 已有"死后"研究显示训练好的 Transformer 近似 inside-outside 等经典解析算法，但理论上对其如何被学得一无所知；本文希望用可控合成数据推进理论学习。
AI.method: 构造具有可变解析树拓扑的合成上下文无关文法；用解析可计算的方式刻画各阶段损失，并将损失阶段对应到隐藏潜树变量的表示，以消解歧义并利用更广上下文；通过探测表示可视化 inside-outside 计算在深度与训练中的涌现。
AI.result: 学习曲线各阶段损失可解析计算且可清晰对应潜树变量的表示；早期阶段仅用少量初始层和局部（bigram/trigram）信息，随后 Transformer 逐渐形成编码器-解码器结构：最抽象潜信息位于中部，后半网络逐步精炼最终词元预测。
AI.conclusion: 该计算组织与真实 LLM 的现象相似，且发生在一个可对数据统计进行完全解析控制的合成模型中，为理论进展打开了大门。

title: Parallel Broyden Methods for Efficiently Evaluating Nonlinear State Space Models
summary: Nonlinear state space models are typically evaluated sequentially, limiting their ability to exploit modern parallel hardware. Recent work has shown that state space models can be evaluated in parallel by reformulating evaluation as a root-finding problem, which can be solved with a parallel form of Newton's method. However, exact Newton methods require expensive multiplication of dense Jacobian matrices, and quasi-Newton methods based on diagonal approximations, while more scalable, are often slow to converge because they neglect interactions across state dimensions. We introduce a novel quasi-Newton approach based on Broyden's method, which captures coupling terms with diagonal-plus-low-rank approximations to blocks of the Jacobian. We construct the approximations from trajectory secants, avoiding automatic differentiation while retaining the favorable scaling of diagonal approximations and remaining compatible with parallel scan through rank compression. We prove finite-step recovery of the exact trajectory under the compressed scan, and show that convergence is tracked by the compression error and by the block approximation error along the current trajectory error, rather than in spectral norm. Empirically, we show that our method is advantageous when interactions are approximately low rank or when Jacobian evaluation is expensive: on low-rank RNNs, parallel MCMC algorithms, and denoising diffusion models, it converges in fewer iterations than other quasi-Newton methods and is the fastest parallel method when Jacobian evaluation is expensive or state dimensions are large.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Broyden方法的拟牛顿法，用“对角+低秩”近似Jacobian块以捕捉状态维度间的耦合，使非线性状态空间模型可并行求值，并在低秩RNN、并行MCMC与扩散模型上实现更快收敛。
AI.motivation: 非线性状态空间模型通常只能序贯求值，无法利用现代并行硬件。已有的并行化思路是把求值转化为求根问题并用并行牛顿法求解，但精确牛顿法需计算稠密Jacobian矩阵乘法，代价高昂；基于对角近似的拟牛顿法虽可扩展性好，却忽略状态维度间的交互，收敛慢。
AI.method: 提出基于Broyden方法的拟牛顿法，对Jacobian的各个块采用“对角+低秩”（diagonal-plus-low-rank）近似来捕捉耦合项。近似由轨迹割线（trajectory secants）构造，避免自动微分；同时通过对秩的压缩保持与并行扫描（parallel scan）兼容，并维持对角近似的良好扩展性。
AI.result: 理论证明在压缩扫描下可有限步恢复精确轨迹，且收敛由压缩误差与当前轨迹误差方向上的块近似误差追踪，而非谱范数。实验表明：在低秩RNN、并行MCMC算法与去噪扩散模型上，该方法迭代次数少于其他拟牛顿法；当Jacobian计算昂贵或状态维度较大时，是最快的并行方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过“对角+低秩”的Broyden型拟牛顿近似，在保留并行扫描可扩展性的同时捕捉状态维度耦合，显著改善非线性状态空间模型并行求值的收敛速度，尤其适用于交互近似低秩或Jacobian计算昂贵的场景。

title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
summary: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts. We introduce SteerDistill, a quantization-aware distillation method in which a full-precision teacher guides the student to revise failed responses and iteratively refines its guidance using feedback from student execution. This closed-loop teacher steering produces locally verified behavioral corrections. We internalize these corrections by training the student without guidance to match the steered student's predictions at corrected turns and the full-precision teacher's at other turns, enabling unassisted inference. Across five agentic benchmarks and three models, SteerDistill exceeds the strongest quantized baseline by 1.67--2.18 points in average score under W4A16 and stays within one point of BF16. On $τ^2$-Bench, it outperforms QeRL by 1.84 percentage points in success rate using 67% fewer training GPU hours and produces shorter successful trajectories than the quantized baselines.

AI.tldr: SteerDistill：一种量化感知蒸馏方法，让全精度教师模型在闭环中用学生执行反馈迭代修正失败轮次，再把这些局部验证过的纠正内化到无教师引导的学生模型中，实现低比特 LLM 智能体的能力恢复。
AI.motivation: 低比特量化降低 LLM 智能体推理成本，但会损害任务成功率。作者分析失败轨迹发现：量化学生常忽略任务要求或环境状态，产生与全精度参考偏离的环境转移。这类行为偏差难以纠正——离线数据覆盖不到学生的失败上下文，而学生自身 rollout 在这些上下文中几乎给不出正确响应。
AI.method: 提出 SteerDistill：全精度教师引导学生改写失败响应，并利用学生实际执行反馈迭代改进该引导，形成闭环"教师转向"，得到局部验证的行为纠正。随后学生在无引导条件下训练，在纠正轮次上对齐被引导学生的预测、在其他轮次上对齐全精度教师，从而支持无辅助推理。
AI.result: 在 5 个智能体基准、3 个模型上，W4A16 设置下平均分超出最强量化基线 1.67–2.18 分，与 BF16 差距在 1 分以内。在 τ²-Bench 上成功率比 QeRL 高 1.84 个百分点，训练 GPU 时长少 67%，且成功轨迹比量化基线更短。
AI.conclusion: 通过闭环教师转向生成并内化局部验证的行为纠正，可在低成本量化推理下显著缩小与全精度智能体的差距，同时提升训练效率与轨迹简洁性。

title: picoEmergencyNet : Attention-Enhanced Ultra-Small Deep Learning Model for Aerial Image Classification in Emergency Monitoring
comment: 6 pages, Appeared in IJCNN2026 C. Kyrkou, "picoEmergencyNet: Attention-Enhanced Ultra-Small Deep Learning Model for Aerial Image Classification in Emergency Monitoring," 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN), Maastricht, Netherlands, 2026, pp. 1-6
summary: Real-time disaster recognition from aerial imagery requires deep learning models that operate under strict memory, compute, and latency constraints. While recent approaches achieve high accuracy, their computational cost limits deployment on resource-constrained UAV platforms. This work introduces picoEmergencyNet, an ultra-lightweight convolutional neural network designed for aerial image disaster classification. The proposed architecture combines depthwise dilated convolutions with efficient channel attention and channel shuffling to enable multi-scale feature extraction at minimal computational cost. picoEmergencyNet has 23k parameters and 7M FLOPs, requiring only 0.1 MB of model storage. Evaluated on the AIDER and AIDERv2 disaster datasets, it achieves up to 96.1% accuracy, matching or exceeding state-of-the-art lightweight models that are orders of magnitude larger. Deployment experiments on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin show that, without hardware-specific optimizations, picoEmergencyNet achieves 258 FPS on GPU and 46 FPS on CPU with a 7x lower activation memory footprint compared to competing models. These results demonstrate that careful architectural specialization, rather than model scaling, enables highly efficient and accurate TinyML-ready disaster recognition for real-time UAV-based emergency monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出超轻量 CNN picoEmergencyNet（23k 参数、7M FLOPs、0.1MB）用于航拍灾害分类，在 AIDER/AIDERv2 上达 96.1% 精度，Jetson AGX Orin 上 258 FPS（GPU）/46 FPS（CPU），激活内存降低 7 倍。
AI.motivation: 航拍影像实时灾害识别需在 UAV 平台严格的内存、算力与延迟约束下运行；现有高精度模型计算开销大，难以部署于资源受限设备，因此需要在不扩大模型规模的前提下提升效率。
AI.method: 设计超轻量 CNN：结合深度可分离空洞卷积实现多尺度特征提取，并引入高效通道注意力与通道混洗，在极低计算成本下保持表达能力。
AI.result: 模型仅 23k 参数、7M FLOPs、0.1MB 存储；AIDER/AIDERv2 上最高 96.1% 精度，可比肩或超过大数量级的轻量 SOTA；未做硬件特定优化时 GPU 258 FPS、CPU 46 FPS，激活内存比对比模型低 7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 精细的架构专门化而非模型缩放，即可实现高效准确的 TinyML 级灾害识别，适用于实时 UAV 应急监测。

title: The RSI Tax: When Recursive Self-Improvement Is Not Worth the Cost
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to improve an agent using its own task experience. Its practical value depends on whether performance gains justify the full cost of self-improvement and task execution. We evaluate this trade-off on continual task streams, scoring each task before its feedback is used for subsequent updates. We define the \emph{RSI Tax} as the token cost of the self-improvement process and include it alongside task-execution costs in end-to-end evaluation. Across six methods and two language models, a bounded-note baseline matches or exceeds the observed accuracy of Meta-Harness, EvoSkill, and RRSI, with mean total-token savings of 65.6-71.0\%. We decompose the RSI Tax into verification, exploration, and writing costs, and track subsequent use of the associated state or artifact. For these three RSI methods, verification accounts for 74.8--93.6% of the aggregate RSI Tax. A substantial share of the RSI Tax is also associated with states or artifacts that are not used later in the evaluated streams. These results expose a practical limitation of costly RSI procedures: improvements in the deployed agent need not justify the expense of the improvement process. They motivate RSI objectives that jointly optimize the RSI Tax and expected task-execution cost while ensuring continued growth in agent capabilities across the task stream.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"RSI Tax"（自我改进过程的token成本），将验证、探索、写回等自改进开销纳入端到端评估；结果显示简单有界笔记基线在准确率上追平或超越三种RSI方法，并省下65.6–71.0%的总token。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）的实用价值取决于性能提升能否抵消自改进与任务执行的全额成本，但以往评估多只看准确率，忽视改进过程本身的开销。
AI.method: 在持续任务流上评估，每个任务在反馈用于后续更新之前先评分；定义RSI Tax为自我改进的token成本，与任务执行成本一起计入端到端评估；将RSI Tax分解为验证、探索、写回三类，并追踪相应状态/产物的后续复用情况。比较6种方法与2个语言模型。
AI.result: 有界笔记基线在准确率上匹配或超过Meta-Harness、EvoSkill、RRSI，平均总token节省65.6–71.0%；三种RSI方法中验证占RSI Tax的74.8–93.6%；相当一部分RSI Tax花在后续未被使用的状态或产物上。
AI.conclusion: 昂贵RSI流程存在实际局限：部署智能体的提升未必能证明改进过程开销的合理性；需要同时优化RSI Tax与期望任务执行成本、并保证能力持续增长的目标。

title: SafeRoute-MAS: Coverage-Aware and Risk-Calibrated Message Routing for Multi-Agent Scientific Reasoning
summary: We introduce SafeRoute-MAS, a coverage-aware, risk-calibrated procedure that keeps all specialist messages or removes one using only pre-integration information. On a sealed cache of 5,328 committees, its source-compatible operating point gains +1.80 percentage points (95% CI [+1.13, +2.52]) while removing 12.76% of message tokens. We also run 4,580 controlled integrations over a stratified 458-committee sample on a public gpt-oss-120b endpoint. The sample estimate is -0.09 points; design weighting to the original workload gives +0.94 points (95% CI [-1.31, +3.50]) and 18.72% acted-input reduction. A weighted token-matched comparison likewise does not establish a selector advantage (+1.68 points, CI [-1.27, +5.10]). Only 13 of 88 cached non-neutral labels (14.8%) retain direction by repeated-call majority. Expected-corruption UCL is 4.60% after weighting, but only 2 of 11 prespecified marginals pass the support/risk rule. We therefore propose a numerical qualification with Keep-All fallback, applied here retrospectively rather than validated prospectively.

AI.tldr: SafeRoute-MAS 提出一种覆盖感知、风险校准的专家消息筛选流程，但重测后其优势不成立，作者提出带 Keep-All 回退的数值资格判定，且仅为回溯而非前瞻验证。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中冗长的专家消息带来成本与风险，现有选择器缺乏覆盖与风险校准，且缺乏对结论稳健性的检验。
AI.method: 基于预整合信息对专家消息全保留或删除一条；在 5,328 个委员会密封缓存上评估，并在公开 gpt-oss-120b 端点上对 458 个分层委员会样本做 4,580 次受控整合，辅以设计加权与 token 匹配比较。
AI.result: 缓存上报 +1.80 个百分点（95% CI [1.13, 2.52]），省 12.76% token；但真实端点样本估计为 -0.09 点，加权后 +0.94 点（CI [-1.31, 3.50]）、节省 18.72%；token 匹配后优势不显著（+1.68，CI [-1.27, 5.10]）；88 个非中性标签仅 13 个重测保持方向；加权后期望污染 UCL 4.60%，11 个预设边际仅 2 个通过。
AI.conclusion: 选择器的稳健优势未获证实，作者主张采用带 Keep-All 回退的数值资格判定，本研究属回溯应用而非前瞻验证。

title: Predicting Single-Cell Spatial Gene Expression from H&E using Pathology Foundation Models
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI at Scale for Clinical Impact. Project page: https://he2sc-st.github.io/
summary: Predicting gene expression directly from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images offers a scalable and cost-effective approach to deriving spatial molecular insights from routine histology. Pathology foundation models, typically pretrained using tile-level objectives, may not adequately capture the fine-grained cellular features required for single-cell molecular prediction. In this work, we systematically evaluate and establish domain-informed and task-specific strategies for adapting pathology foundation models to single-cell spatial gene expression prediction. Using paired H&E and Xenium 5K data, our approach improves mean gene-wise Pearson correlation by 2.67x over the standard zero-shot baseline and achieves state-of-the-art performance on this task. We demonstrate strong gene-detection performance across the full gene panel (AUROC = 0.800) and importantly identify that predictive performance varies substantially across biological contexts, with our model achieving its highest Pearson correlation for spatially variable genes (r = 0.643). Our findings demonstrate that, despite the challenges of sparse single-cell measurements, H&E-derived representations can recover biologically meaningful spatial expression patterns, highlighting both the opportunities and limitations of morphology-based molecular inference at cellular resolution.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估并提出领域知识与任务特定策略，将病理基础模型适配于从H&E图像预测单细胞空间基因表达，性能显著优于零样本基线。
AI.motivation: H&E图像预测基因表达是从常规组织切片获取空间分子信息的可扩展、低成本途径，但病理基础模型多以tile级目标预训练，难以捕捉单细胞分子预测所需的细粒度细胞特征。
AI.method: 利用配对的H&E与Xenium 5K数据，系统性评估并建立领域知识驱动(task-specific)的适配策略，对病理基础模型进行微调以预测单细胞空间基因表达。
AI.result: 平均基因级Pearson相关较零样本基线提升2.67倍，达到该任务SOTA；全基因panel基因检测AUROC=0.800；空间可变基因表现最佳(r=0.643)；性能随生物背景差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 尽管单细胞测量稀疏，H&E衍生表征仍能恢复具有生物学意义的空间表达模式，揭示了细胞分辨率下基于形态学分子推断的潜力与局限。

title: Dyship: Leveraging Acoustic Features For Speaker Relationship Classification From Dyadic Conversations
summary: We introduce DyShip, a framework for classifying speaker familiarity and kinship from dyadic conversations in the Seamless Interaction corpus. We compare five speech representations: spectrograms, MFCCs, self-supervised WavLM representations, x-vectors, and estimated articulatory movements. Spectral features perform best for familiarity classification, reaching an accuracy of 87.81%, while WavLM achieves the highest kinship accuracy of 85.17%. X-vectors and articulatory features yield weaker results on familiarity classifiaction, but shine for kinship classification, with an AUC of 0.909 for x-vectors. Most classifiers exceed previously reported human and audio language model scores on the same dataset. These findings highlight the potential of conventional acoustic features for relationship inference and motivate further investigation of the conversational cues captured by different representations.

AI.tldr: 提出DyShip框架，从双人对话中分类说话人熟悉度与亲属关系，比较五种语音表示：频谱图、MFCC、WavLM、x-vector和发音动作特征。频谱特征在熟悉度分类最佳（87.81%），WavLM在亲属关系分类最佳（85.17%），x-vector的亲属关系AUC达0.909，多数分类器超过此前人类和音频语言模型得分。
AI.motivation: 研究如何从双人对话语音中推断说话人之间的关系（熟悉度与亲属关系），并探究不同语音表示在此任务上的适用性，弥补关系推断研究中表示选择的对比空白。
AI.method: 基于Seamless Interaction语料库构建DyShip框架，系统比较五种语音表示：频谱图、MFCC、自监督WavLM表示、x-vector和估计的发音动作特征，并训练分类器完成熟悉度和亲属关系两类任务。
AI.result: 熟悉度分类中频谱特征最优（87.81%），亲属关系分类中WavLM最优（85.17%），x-vector与发音特征在熟悉度上较弱但亲属关系表现突出（x-vector AUC=0.909）。多数分类器超过该数据集上已报道的人类基线和音频语言模型得分。
AI.conclusion: 传统声学特征在关系推断中具有显著潜力，不同表示捕捉的对话线索存在差异，值得进一步研究各表示所编码的会话信息。

title: Beyond the Log-Linear Frontier: Pre-Asymptotic Analysis of Finite-Budget Neural Scaling Laws
summary: Classical neural scaling laws model excess risk as a separable power law in model capacity $N$ and dataset size $D$. At finite budgets, however, empirical learning curves and compute-optimal allocations depart from this log-linear frontier. This paper analyzes how spectral and domain heterogeneity govern these finite-scale departures. Along the capacity axis, Mellin--Barnes analysis of covariance resolvents yields a three-term expansion where competing spectral and regularization modes produce finite-scale curvature and logarithmic transitions. Because fitting multiple power laws on narrow pilot grids is ill-conditioned, we eliminate the loss floor via first-order Aitken differencing to obtain a well-conditioned closed-form initializer. Along the data axis, KKT duality reduces $K$-domain mixing to scalar water-filling, yielding finite-budget bottleneck bounds, an online sampling curriculum, and a simplex Hessian metric for cross-domain transfer. Along the iso-compute frontier $C=6ND$, we prove that the optimal allocation exponent drifts in proportion to capacity and data exponent variances, while Schur-complement reduction separates intrinsic drift from frozen-hyperparameter bias. Across 45 operator spectra, Pythia (70M--12B), Chinchilla (245 runs), and RegMix (17 domains), our estimators achieve $5.89\%$ holdout MAPE, cut high-compute allocation regret by up to $76.4\%$, and reduce cross-scale mixture RMSE by $59.4\%$ with zero selection regret.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析有限算力预算下神经标度律偏离可分离幂律的现象，提出基于谱与域异质性的三阶展开、数据轴注水优化与等算力前沿漂移理论，并在45个算符谱及Pythia/Chinchilla/RegMix上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 经典标度律用N与D的可分离幂律建模超额风险，但有限预算下经验学习曲线与算力最优分配偏离该对数线性前沿，需解释并刻画这些有限尺度偏离。
AI.method: 容量轴：对协方差预解式做Mellin–Barnes分析，得三项展开（谱与正则模式竞争产生曲率与对数转折），并用一阶Aitken差分消除损失下限获得良态闭式初始化；数据轴：用KKT对偶将K域混合化为标量注水，给出瓶颈界、在线采样课程及单纯形Hessian度量；等算力前沿C=6ND：证明最优分配指数漂移正比于容量与数据指数方差，并用Schur补分离内在漂移与冻结超参偏差。
AI.result: 在45个算符谱、Pythia(70M–12B)、Chinchilla(245次运行)、RegMix(17域)上，估计器达5.89%留出MAPE，高算力分配遗憾降低最多76.4%，跨尺度混合RMSE降低59.4%且选择遗憾为零。
AI.conclusion: 谱与域异质性可解释有限尺度标度律偏离，所提理论框架与估计器在实际大模型训练数据上验证有效，改进了算力最优分配与跨域混合。

title: When Reasoning looks like Hidden Understanding: How Chain-of-Thought Fosters Anthropomorphism, Perceptions of Epistemic Superiority, and Cognitive Deference
comment: Conference submission to FAccT, 4th November 2026. No Figures
summary: As AI-based products permeate society, specifically systems using generative models, a belief system is emerging about what these products are and what they can and cannot do. One common belief concerns the perception of the form of language as evidence of 'understanding' language. As these generative models reproduce linguistic patterns rather than understand meaning, interpreting these patterns as evidence of understanding is a misattribution. This misconception is extended by the notion that generative models can 'explain their reasoning.' Anecdotally, these misconceptions which mistake the form of language for its meaning are driving cognitive deference to AI systems in a way that displaces human agency. Such mistakes involve attributions of cognitive properties to the system, allowing them to be treated like intentional 'minds'. Importantly, perceived epistemic authority and superiority make that 'mind' worth deferring to. Anthropomorphism in tandem with epistemic authority and superiority, we argue, increases the risk that users generalise from narrow task performance to broader competencies, committing the "fallacy of composition". This paper explores misconceptions of Chain of Thought (CoT) reasoning as sufficient transparent 'explanation'. We explore how anthropomorphism acts as a vehicle for cognitive deference of decision-making and perceptions of epistemic superiority in AI systems. Finally, we explore CoT's ramifications using medicine as an example. Taken together, we conclude that explainability operationalised through CoT is highly problematic and undercuts the very ethical principles it is intended to serve. While CoT may be valuable for improving output accuracy and moderation, we suggest that the practice of asking models to provide user facing reasons for their outputs should be actively discouraged, and AI literacy training should explicitly caution against its use.

AI.tldr: 本文指出人们常将生成式模型复现语言形式误认为"理解"与"可解释推理"，这种误读结合拟人化和感知到的认知权威，导致用户对AI的认知让渡（cognitive deference）；作者主张以Chain of Thought（CoT）实现的"可解释性"存在严重问题，应主动劝阻要求模型给出面向用户的推理理由的做法。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI系统渗透社会，用户逐渐形成关于其能力边界的信念体系。其中一种流行误解是把语言形式的再现当作"理解语言"的证据，并进一步认为模型能"解释其推理"。这类把语言形式误当意义的混淆，据观察正促使用户在决策上让渡人类能动性。作者希望系统剖析这一链路：误解如何经由拟人化与感知到的认知权威/优越性，放大"以偏概全"（fallacy of composition）的风险。
AI.method: 概念性/论证性分析（非实证研究）。作者以CoT推理为案例，论证其被误认为充分透明的"解释"；分析拟人化如何成为决策认知让渡与感知AI认知优越性的载体；并以医学为具体应用场景，探讨CoT带来的现实后果与伦理风险。
AI.result: 作者论证：拟人化叠加感知的认知权威与优越性，会使用户从狭窄任务表现泛化到更广泛能力，犯下"合成谬误"；CoT被误当作充分的透明解释，从而诱发认知让渡；在医学等高 stakes 场景中这一问题尤为严重。核心结论是：以CoT操作化的可解释性高度成问题，反而削弱其本欲服务的伦理原则。
AI.conclusion: CoT在提升输出准确性和内容审核方面可能有价值，但应主动劝阻要求模型为用户提供其输出"理由"的做法；AI素养培训应明确警示对CoT式解释的误用，以防认知让渡与伦理原则被架空。

title: EgoHMP: Achieving Precise Human Motion Prediction in 3D Scenes via Egocentric Cues
summary: The complex interactive dependencies between human behavior and 3D scenes make accurately predicting human intent a major challenge for human motion prediction (HMP). While recent studies use human gaze to infer intent, gaze signals suffer from ambiguity, drift, and a reliance on eye-tracking hardware. Research in cognitive science indicates that egocentric views inherently encode potential interactions, while head motion serves as a crucial precursor in motion planning. Motivated by this, we propose EgoHMP, a novel framework that uses egocentric views and head motions as robust carriers of interaction intent. By translating this intent into an envisioning of future interactions, EgoHMP achieves precise HMP in 3D scenes. EgoHMP first employs a vision-motion alignment encoder to align the visual and motion feature spaces. Based on these aligned features, an egocentric intent predictor with a modality-aware modulation mechanism adaptively suppresses invalid interaction cues to predict an accurate interaction probability map. Furthermore, to enhance the stability and realism of the generated motions, we propose a contact-aware motion decoder. Specifically, inspired by the human cognitive process of planning trajectories prior to action execution, we first predict a global trajectory to serve as a self-prompt, effectively mitigating the optimization conflict in diffusion models. Subsequently, we introduce a multi-stage denoiser, which relieves motion artifacts by incorporating human contact modeling through a multi-stage optimization strategy. Finally, a GCN-based motion decoder is employed to synthesize physically plausible and semantically consistent motions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EgoHMP achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: EgoHMP利用第一人称视角与头部运动作为交互意图的鲁棒载体，将其转化为未来交互的预想，从而在3D场景中实现精准的人体运动预测，取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 人体行为与3D场景的复杂交互依赖使意图预测困难。现有方法借助视线（gaze）推断意图，但视线信号存在歧义、漂移且依赖眼动追踪硬件。认知科学表明第一人称视角天然编码潜在交互信息，头部运动是运动规划的重要前兆，故可作为更稳健的意图载体。
AI.method: 提出EgoHMP框架：1）视觉-运动对齐编码器，对齐视觉与运动特征空间；2）第一人称意图预测器，配以模态感知调制机制，自适应抑制无效交互线索以预测交互概率图；3）接触感知运动解码器——先预测全局轨迹作为自提示以缓解扩散模型优化冲突，再用多阶段去噪器引入人体接触建模以减轻运动伪影，最后由GCN运动解码器合成物理合理且语义一致的运动。
AI.result: 大量实验表明EgoHMP达到最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 以第一人称视角与头部运动替代视线信号作为意图载体是可行且有效的，结合轨迹自提示与接触感知多阶段扩散生成，可显著提升3D场景中人体运动预测的准确性、稳定性与物理合理性。

title: An AI Assistant for Automating Anti-Corruption Expertise of Draft Legislation Based on the TRACE Framework
summary: We present an AI assistant for automating anti-corruption expertise of draft legislation based on the TRACE architecture, designed to screen bills for corruption risks: pinpoint provisions an expert would criticise and name the regulatory defect in each. The pipeline combines a deterministic parsing core, model-guided single-provision qualification, rule-based factor assignment, and external human oversight. To evaluate the assistant, we constructed an open benchmark from the published conclusions of Ukraine's National Agency on Corruption Prevention (NAZK), comprising 132 draft laws with 474 model-extracted findings. A system flag agrees with a finding when it targets a compatible provision and an LLM judge rates the risk as the same (strict) or partly the same (lenient). On 100 draft laws, the pipeline matches 0.28 of the findings within its top ten flags using the local Gemma 4 31B model, 0.30 with Sonnet 5.5, and 0.43-0.46 across all flags (non-blind; the frozen blind baseline achieves 0.21, 95% CI 0.16-0.26). Across all runs, most misses occur on provisions that the system located but qualified as a different risk, and none of the 32 legal-collision findings was matched. On 21 acts held out from tuning, the pipeline outperforms a monolithic prompt containing the full methodology under the strict measure, though not under the lenient one, and Opus 5.5 adds nothing over Sonnet. The reported scores reflect agreement with model-extracted findings rated by an LLM judge whose two access routes agree on 73 of 74 labels, without human expert validation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于TRACE架构的反腐AI助手，自动筛查法律草案中的腐败风险条款；构建NAZK结论开放基准（132部草案、474条发现），召回率0.43-0.46（盲测基线0.21）。
AI.motivation: 法律草案的反腐败鉴定目前依赖专家人工审查，成本高、难规模化；需要自动化工具预先定位可能被专家批评的条款并指出其规范性缺陷。
AI.method: TRACE架构流水线：确定性解析核心 + 模型引导的单条款资格判定 + 基于规则的因素赋值 + 外部人工监督；从NAZK公开结论构建基准，用LLM裁判按strict/lenient两级判定系统标记与官方发现是否一致。
AI.result: 100部草案上，top-10标记命中率Gemma 4 31B为0.28、Sonnet 5.5为0.30，全部标记为0.43-0.46，冻结盲测基线0.21（95%CI 0.16-0.26）；漏检多因定位正确但风险归类不同，32条"法律冲突"类发现全部未命中；21部留出法案上strict指标优于整篇方法论的单一提示，lenient下不然，Opus 5.5较Sonnet无增益。
AI.conclusion: 系统在strict指标上有一定可行性但总体召回有限，尤其在法律冲突类缺陷上失效；结果基于模型抽取发现与LLM裁判，缺乏人类专家验证，需谨慎解读。

title: Adaptive catalyst discovery emerges from composable scientific intelligence
summary: Catalysis underpins chemical manufacturing, yet knowledge for catalyst design remains dispersed across experimental observations, computational data and catalysis subdisciplines. To overcome this challenge, we present Composable Catalytic Intelligence (CatAI), a physics-grounded modular AI framework that learns 1.8 million structure-property relations and organizes them into 30 physicochemical encoders. This reusable intermediate layer enables task-specific models to guide catalyst discovery for targeted reactions and objectives. Across benchmark tasks, CatAI achieves a 7.8% lower task-averaged prediction error than the next-best models. In experimental validation, CatAI identified a new confined-passable pocket catalyst applicable in industrial homogeneous polymer synthesis with 9 times the activity of the commercial benchmark. In parallel, it guided autonomous closed-loop optimization of a highly active Cu-based geminal-atom photocatalyst for C-O coupling reactions surpassing the traditional Ni-based systems. This approach connects property-level data to catalytic objectives, supporting physicochemical knowledge reuse across mechanistically distinct systems through computational screening and iterative model-experiment feedback.

AI.tldr: CatAI是一个物理驱动的模块化AI框架，学习180万条结构-性质关系并组织为30个物理化学编码器，作为可复用的中间层支持任务特定模型进行催化剂发现，在基准任务上预测误差降低7.8%，并经实验验证发现活性达商业基准9倍的新型催化剂。
AI.motivation: 催化剂设计知识分散于实验观测、计算数据和催化各分支学科之中，缺乏统一、可复用的知识组织方式，制约了催化剂发现的效率。
AI.method: 提出可组合催化智能框架CatAI：以物理为基础的模块化AI，学习180万条结构-性质关系，并组织为30个物理化学编码器构成可复用中间层；在此基础上构建任务特定模型，结合计算筛选与模型-实验迭代反馈闭环。
AI.result: 基准任务上任务平均预测误差比次优模型低7.8%；实验发现一种可用于工业均相聚合的新型"限域可穿越口袋"催化剂，活性为商业基准的9倍；并指导Cu基双原子光催化剂用于C-O偶联反应的自主闭环优化，优于传统Ni基体系。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将性质层面数据与催化目标相连接，通过计算筛选与迭代模型-实验反馈，实现物理化学知识在机理不同体系间的复用，支撑跨体系的催化剂发现。

title: The WoW: A Large-Scale World Knowledge Corpus for Full-Lifecycle LLM Training
summary: Existing Chinese educational corpora often suffer from fragmented coverage and a lack of systematic organization. In this paper, we propose WoW (\textbf{Wo}rld Kno\textbf{w}ledge), a large-scale dataset designed for the full-cycle training of foundation models. The construction of this dataset is driven by an Educational Knowledge Graph, which serves as a taxonomic backbone for the systematic collection and completion of missing educational modules across all levels. Compared to previous versions, this iteration provides enhanced systematicity, superior quality, and a larger scale, while incorporating multimodal signals and supporting every stage of model development. Experiments demonstrate that WoW significantly improves model performance across diverse benchmarks. To facilitate community research, we further provide an interactive platform for graph-based data selection and retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出WoW大规模数据集，以教育知识图谱为分类骨架，系统化构建并补全各学段教育模块，覆盖多模态信号与全周期训练，实验证明可显著提升模型表现，并提供图检索交互平台。
AI.motivation: 现有中文教育语料存在覆盖碎片化、缺乏系统化组织的问题，难以支撑基座模型的全周期训练。
AI.method: 以教育知识图谱为taxonomic backbone，系统化收集并补全各层级缺失教育模块；相较早期版本提升系统性、质量与规模，并引入多模态信号，支持模型开发的各个阶段。
AI.result: 在多样化benchmark上，WoW显著提升模型性能；同时提供基于图的交互平台，用于数据选择与检索。
AI.conclusion: WoW为教育领域基座模型全周期训练提供了系统化、高质量、大规模且多模态的数据基础，并通过开放平台促进社区研究。

title: CJRR-Net: A Candidate-Joint Reprojection Ranking for Future-View Selection in Human Pose Estimation
comment: 10pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA 2026)
summary: Multi-camera systems support performance recording, sports and human-movement analysis, where selecting an informative viewpoint is important for reliable human pose estimation. We propose the Candidate-Joint Reprojection Ranking Network (CJRR-Net) for future-view selection among eight calibrated cameras in MPI-INF-3DHP. The model combines current-view pose observations, camera configuration, and candidate-specific geometric features obtained by reprojecting the estimated 3D pose and its uncertainty into each candidate view. CJRR-Net achieves a selected-view 2D mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) of 105.18 pixels, compared with 114.64 pixels for the shared-input MLP and 117.56 pixels for adapted PoseErrNet. It also achieves the lowest mean error among the listed policies in each evaluated occlusion group. A blender rollout illustrates repeated camera selection. These findings support candidate-specific geometry for single-view selection in the evaluated fixed eight-camera setting.

AI.tldr: 提出CJRR-Net，在8台标定相机中选择最适合人体姿态估计的视角，通过将估计的3D姿态及其不确定性重投影到候选视角构建几何特征，选中视角2D MPJPE为105.18像素，优于基线。
AI.motivation: 多相机系统在表演记录、运动与人体动作分析中需要选择信息量高的视角，以保证人体姿态估计的可靠性。
AI.method: CJRR-Net融合当前视角姿态观测、相机配置以及候选视角特定几何特征；几何特征由估计3D姿态及其不确定性重投影到每个候选视角得到，用于MPI-INF-3DHP中8台标定相机的未来视角选择。
AI.result: 选中视角2D MPJPE为105.18像素，优于共享输入MLP（114.64）与适配的PoseErrNet（117.56）；在各评估遮挡组中均为所列策略里平均误差最低。另用blender rollout演示了重复的相机选择过程。
AI.conclusion: 在固定的8相机设定下，候选视角特定几何特征支持单视角选择；但结论限于所评估的固定8相机场景。

title: Semantic Chains: From Reachable Facts to Justified Answers
summary: How can the facts that justify an answer be found from a question and presented as a sequence of connected statements? This paper models a context as a graph of logical facts and takes as given which expressions represent each fact. A parent fact can express a relation among its subfacts, and a preserving edge allows the content of a subfact to be recovered within a full representation of its parent. Suppose a root fact justifies the full answer and a path of preserving edges leads from that root to a fact that designates an object shared by the question and the answer. Under the conditions of the model, a search starting from the objects in the question reaches the root and covers every fact in the selected expansion. The root then admits a text that forms a single link connecting the question to the full answer and justifying it. For chains with several links, the paper gives a complete enumeration of candidate orders within the stated class and specifies when the link texts jointly preserve the justification and support every transition.

AI.tldr: 论文将问题上下文建模为逻辑事实图，研究如何从问题出发找到可证明答案的事实链，并生成把问题与答案连接起来的连贯文本。
AI.motivation: 需要解决"如何从问题中找到支撑答案的事实，并将其组织成连贯的、可证明答案的陈述序列"这一问题。
AI.method: 以图为逻辑事实网络，给定每个事实的表达式；引入"父事实"表达子事实间关系、"保真边"使子事实内容在父事实完整表示中可恢复；从问题中的对象出发搜索到根事实，覆盖所选展开中的每个事实。
AI.result: 在模型条件下，从问题对象出发的搜索可到达根并覆盖展开中全部事实；根事实可生成单一链接文本，连接问题与完整答案并为其提供依据。
AI.conclusion: 对多链情形，论文给出规定类别内候选顺序的完整枚举，并说明各链接文本何时共同保持论证有效性并支撑每次过渡。

title: Sanity Checks for Attention Surgery: Null Models and Matched Interventions for Representation-Motivated Design
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/Basavarajearlybird/SANITY-CHECKS-FOR-ATTENTION-SURGERY_Original (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24096410)
summary: Transformer architectural modifications frequently measure a statistic on internal representations, observe that it is large, remove it architecturally, and report an improvement. Interpreting that sequence requires evaluating whether the statistic exceeds its noise floor, whether it survives a geometric null, and whether the training gain requires the specific direction removed. We formulate these requirements as three reusable checks and apply them to self-attention removal, which deletes the component of an attention head's output aligned with its own value vector. Across nine multi-head pretrained models (5,408 heads, 124M to 6.9B parameters), an earlier-position causal null accounts for 48% to 63% of the head-value cosine alignment, with no monotone scale trend. Under grouped-query attention, this alignment is specific to each head's own key-value group and reverses across groups (+0.24 to +0.27 within-group, -0.11 to -0.19 across-group). Split-half reliability demonstrates that the per-head intervention effect is resolvable in GPT-2 ($r_Δ= 0.80$) but attenuated in Pythia-160M (0.42) and Pythia-410M (0.53), whereas structural self-cosine reliability is near-perfect in all three ($r_{\text{stat}} > 0.99$); which statistic predicts its own intervention is model-dependent. In a pre-registered 3-arm by 8-seed paired factorial at $4.0 \times 10^8$ tokens per run (399,900,672 tokens), a fixed arbitrary rank-one direction does not differ from baseline (+0.0011 nats, $p = 0.197$), while self-directed removal lowers validation loss (-0.0029 nats, Holm-corrected $p = 0.0023$) and outperforms the fixed arbitrary control directly (-0.0040 nats, $p = 0.0018$). At 50.9M scale the training benefit requires the own-value direction rather than a fixed arbitrary one, but a large cosine alignment alone does not establish redundancy in frozen models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出三种可复用的评估检查，用于验证"Transformer中某统计量大→架构移除→性能提升"这一研究范式是否成立，并将其应用于自注意力头value对齐分量的移除研究。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer架构修改研究常用"测量内部统计量→发现其很大→架构上移除→报告改进"的模式，但该序列的合理性需要三个条件验证：统计量是否超过噪声底线、是否在几何零假设下仍显著、训练收益是否依赖于所移除的特定方向。作者希望为这类研究提供可复用的检验框架。
AI.method: 提出三项检验并应用于自注意力移除（删除注意力头输出中与自身value向量对齐的分量）。在9个多头预训练模型（5408个头，124M–6.9B参数）上，构建更早位置因果零假设模型作为几何基线；在分组查询注意力(GQA)下检验对齐的组内特异性；用分半信度评估干预效应的可分辨性；最后进行预注册的3臂×8种子配对析因实验（每run 4.0×10^8 tokens，共399,900,672 tokens），比较固定任意秩一方向、自指向移除与基线。
AI.result: 更早位置因果零假设可解释48%–63%的头-value余弦对齐，且无单调规模趋势；GQA下对齐特定于本head的KV组（组内+0.24~+0.27，组间-0.11~-0.19）；分半信度显示GPT-2中干预效应可分辨（r_Δ=0.80），Pythia-160M(0.42)与Pythia-410M(0.53)中被削弱，而结构自余弦信度近完美(r_stat>0.99)，说明哪个统计量能预测自身干预效应依赖于模型。预注册实验显示固定任意秩一方向与基线无差异(+0.0011 nats, p=0.197)，自指向移除降低验证损失(-0.0029 nats, Holm校正p=0.0023)，并显著优于固定任意对照(-0.0040 nats, p=0.0018)。
AI.conclusion: 在50.9M规模下训练收益确实需要own-value方向而非固定任意方向，但大的余弦对齐本身并不能证明冻结模型中的冗余性。研究强调了架构移除类研究需通过噪声底线、几何零假设与方向特异性三项检验，且统计量与干预效应的关系依模型而异。

title: Nepali-English Code-Mixed Speech Recognition: Data Preparation and Adaptation of a Speech Foundation Model
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables. Code and model checkpoints: https://github.com/AI-Lab-Pvt-Ltd/nepali-codemixed-asr
summary: Nepali speakers regularly mix English words into conversation, but multilingual speech recognisers often struggle with language switches and the writing script used for English words. We study how to adapt SraVaani, a 449M-parameter hybrid TDT-CTC model, using a 172.8-hour corpus covering six Nepali speech domains. Its pretrained tokenizer does not support digits and several common symbols. Rather than replace it or discard these recordings, we generate Nepali and English readings for numbers and use zero-shot ASR output to select a plausible form. Full fine-tuning reduces test word error rate (WER) from 48.6% to 17.1%; a 12-epoch run reaches 16.3%, compared with 16.4% for fine-tuned Whisper large-v3-turbo. Freezing the encoder increases WER to 25.5%, while excluding numeric clips raises WER on numeric test speech from 14.3% to 21.3%. We also evaluate on FLEURS using both its original references and mixed-script alternatives. The comparison shows that transcription conventions explain part, but not all, of the out-of-domain performance loss.

AI.tldr: 将449M参数的SraVaani混合TDT-CTC模型在172.8小时六域尼泊尔语语料上适配微调，WER从48.6%降至16.3%，与微调后的Whisper large-v3-turbo(16.4%)相当。
AI.motivation: 尼泊尔语使用者常在对话中混入英语，形成语码转换与混合书写脚本问题；同时预训练分词器不支持数字与若干常见符号，导致多语种ASR在该场景表现差。作者希望在不替换分词器、不丢弃含数字录音的前提下完成适配。
AI.method: 构建172.8小时、覆盖六个尼泊尔语语音域的数据集；对数字生成尼泊尔语与英语两种读法，用零样本ASR输出选择更合理的形式；对SraVaani(449M，TDT-CTC混合)做全量微调，并做编码器冻结、排除数字片段的消融；另在FLEURS上用原始参考与混合脚本参考两种标注评测。
AI.result: 全量微调使测试WER由48.6%降至17.1%，12轮训练达16.3%，对比微调Whisper large-v3-turbo的16.4%；冻结编码器WER升至25.5%；排除数字片段后数字测试语音WER由14.3%升到21.3%；FLEURS对比表明转写规范只能解释部分而非全部域外性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 该模型经全量微调即可在尼泊尔语混合脚本场景达到与Whisper相当的水平；编码器需参与适配，含数字数据对数字语音识别有实质贡献；域外性能下降部分源于转写惯例差异，但仍有其他因素待解决。

title: Hint, Not Hole: Localization-Robust Video Overlay Removal
summary: Video overlay removal recovers the scene beneath burned-in subtitles, karaoke lyrics, titles, credits, logos and watermarks. Generative video models now fill a known region convincingly, but in practice the region comes from a detector or a segmenter, and it is wrong in both directions: it misses strokes, halos, whole frames and whole objects, and it covers background between characters, around boxes and on genuine scene text. Erasers that treat the mask as a hole, regenerating inside and copying outside, inherit every one of these errors. We present HintErase, which treats localization as a hint, not a hole. The model sees the full, unmasked video together with a hint channel; during training the hint is corrupted the way real localizers fail, while supervision follows the true overlay. The result is a single model that removes overlay the hint missed, keeps background the hint wrongly covered, and is trained to keep genuine scene text even when the hint lands on it. For full-length releases, a streaming pipeline handles interlaced sources, shot cuts, missed and jittering hints, paste-back and audio, with memory independent of the length of the video. This report describes the approach, the pipeline that turns it into full-length deliveries, and qualitative results; video results, with input, hint and output side by side, are on the project page.

AI.tldr: HintErase 把视频叠加元素（字幕、水印等）的定位结果当作"提示"而非"空洞"，用带噪声的提示通道训练，使单一模型能去除检测器漏检的叠加、保留误覆盖的背景与真实场景文字，并配套可处理全片长度的流式流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式视频修复把定位器/分割器给出的掩码当作硬性空洞，只重建内部、复制外部，因此继承了定位错误：既漏检笔画、光晕、整帧和整目标，又误覆盖字符间背景、框周围和真实场景文字。
AI.method: 提出 HintErase：模型同时输入完整未掩码视频和一个提示通道，将定位视为软提示而非空洞。训练时按真实定位器的失败模式破坏提示，但监督信号始终跟随真实的叠加标注；并设计流式流水线，处理隔行源、镜头切换、漏检与抖动提示、回贴和音频，显存与视频长度无关。
AI.result: 报告给出方法、全片交付流水线与定性结果；项目页提供输入、提示、输出并排的视频结果。模型可去除提示漏检的叠加、保留提示误覆盖的背景，并在提示落在真实场景文字上时保留该文字。
AI.conclusion: 将叠加定位从"硬掩码"改为"含噪提示"，是对定位误差更鲁棒的视频叠加去除范式，并可借助流式流水线扩展到全长视频的实用交付。

title: Closing the BF16-FP16 Convergence Speed Gap in RL Post-Training with Stochastic Rounding
summary: BF16 is widely used to pretrain large language models because it has the same dynamic range as FP32 and converges similarly to FP32 training. However, in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where learning rates are typically low, we find that standard mixed-precision BF16 training converges more slowly than FP16 training at the same learning rate. We attribute this gap to weight sticking: when FP32 shadow weights are quantized to BF16 using round-to-nearest, small updates often leave the BF16 weights used for rollout generation and training unchanged. Consequently, several optimizer steps may be needed before updates to the shadow weights are reflected in the BF16 weights. Raising the BF16 learning rate reduces weight sticking and matches FP16's convergence speed, but it also increases the KL divergence from the reference model. We instead apply stochastic rounding when quantizing the FP32 shadow weights to BF16. This approach matches FP16's convergence speed across different models and datasets while reducing the KL divergence relative to BF16 training with a larger learning rate. Unlike FP16, it keeps BF16's wider dynamic range and needs no loss scaling.

AI.tldr: 在RLVR场景中，标准混合精度BF16训练因"权重粘滞"问题收敛慢于FP16；作者提出在FP32影子权重转BF16量化时使用随机舍入，可匹配FP16收敛速度并降低KL散度。
AI.motivation: BF16虽广泛用于预训练，但在低学习率的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中，标准混合精度BF16训练收敛慢于FP16。原因是round-to-nearest量化导致小更新无法反映到BF16权重上（权重粘滞），需多步优化器更新才生效。
AI.method: 分析权重粘滞现象：FP32影子权重经round-to-nearest量化为BF16时，小更新不改变BF16权重。对比方案包括提高BF16学习率（可缓解粘滞但增大与参考模型的KL散度），以及作者主张的方法——在FP32影子权重转BF16时采用随机舍入（stochastic rounding）。
AI.result: 随机舍入方法在多种模型和数据集上匹配FP16的收敛速度，同时相比提高学习率的BF16训练降低了KL散度；且保留BF16更宽动态范围，无需loss scaling（不同于FP16）。
AI.conclusion: 在RLVR的混合精度训练中，采用随机舍入替代round-to-nearest可有效解决BF16权重粘滞问题，兼具FP16的收敛速度与BF16的动态范围优势。

title: Agent Benchmarks Stop Ranking Before They Run Out of Tasks
summary: Data-science and ML-engineering agents are evaluated on benchmarks such as MLE-bench, ALE-Bench, SWE-fficiency and AlgoTune, whose tasks yield a quantity (a Kaggle metric, contest score or speedup). When one stops separating the best models, the usual remedy is a harder version. Re-scoring released runs of eight benchmarks, including SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench for breadth, we find much of this saturation lies in the measurement, not the tasks. Most agent benchmarks reduce a run to one pass/fail bit, which fails in two ways. It is too coarse: neighbouring top-ten agents on SWE-bench Verified differ by less than its tests' errors, and correcting them reorders neighbours no more than deleting a random sixth of each agent's passes. It is capped at the reference: ALE-Bench's top ten, separated by contest score, tie when graded against the median human, although nearly half the runs beat that human. On fixed tasks, a higher bar only moves the problem; graded credit fixes it. We derive a clipped log-ratio score with dated anchors and cost as a separate axis. In a Terminal-Bench re-run, pass/fail-tied models differ over tenfold on the quantity the tests discard.

AI.tldr: 智能体基准的"饱和"很大程度来自测量方式而非任务本身；用二元通过/失败评级过于粗糙且在参照处封顶，改用带日期锚点与成本轴的裁剪对数比评分可修复该问题。
AI.motivation: 当顶尖模型在 MLE-bench、ALE-Bench、SWE-fficiency、AlgoTune 等基准上难以区分时，常规做法是加难任务。作者怀疑饱和其实源于测量方法。
AI.method: 重新评分八个基准的已发布运行（含 SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 以增加广度）；分析二元通过/失败的两大缺陷：过于粗糙（邻近前十模型差异小于测试误差）和封顶于参照（对中位数人类评判时前十并列）；提出裁剪对数比评分，带日期锚点，成本作为独立轴。
AI.result: SWE-bench Verified 邻近前十差异小于测试误差，校正误差后的重排程度不超过随机删除每个智能体六分之一通过样本；ALE-Bench 前十在对抗中位数人类时并列，但近半运行超过该人类；Terminal-Bench 重跑中通过/失败并列的模型在测试所丢弃的数量上相差十倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 在固定任务上提高门槛只是转移问题，分级信用（graded credit）才能解决；应采用裁剪对数比评分、日期锚点并将成本作为独立轴。

title: Effects of Laser Beam Width and Measurement Noise on Tree Diameter Estimation in Laser Scanning
summary: Laser scanning has been utilized for decades to measure tree structure and geometry. Despite continuous advances in sensor technology, uncertainties arising from scanner characteristics and measurement conditions has remained relevant sources of error. In particular, factors such as laser beam diameter can introduce both systematic and random errors in the reconstructed tree geometry. This study investigates the main sources of these errors in mobile laser scanning (MLS) and quantifies their effects on stem curve (stem diameter) estimation. We discovered through simulations and experiments that the heteroscedasticity (difference in variance in ranging and scan angle) in the measurement noise is a key factor along with the beam width of the lidar, which cause the bias of the diameter estimates to depend not only on distance, but also on the tree diameter. We demonstrated that this bias can be reliably predicted and negated for trees with a diameter at the breast height greater than 10 cm using technical specifications of the sensor without any additional calibration. In experiments, the proposed bias compensation method reduced the root-mean-square error of stem diameter estimates to sub-centimeter level on boreal forest test sites. However, for small trees with diameter below 10 cm, the diameter bias becomes sensitive to the diameter of the tree$\unicode{x2013}$an unknown factor$\unicode{x2013}$and other factors, such as different bark and out-of-roundness of the stem, limiting the precision of lidar for measuring geometry of trees and applicability of the presented method.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示移动激光扫描(MLS)中测量噪声的异方差性与激光束宽度共同导致树干直径估计产生随距离和树径变化的偏差，并提出可基于传感器技术参数无需额外标定的偏差补偿方法。
AI.motivation: 激光扫描虽长期用于测量树木结构，但扫描仪特性和测量条件引入的误差（尤其是激光束直径造成的系统与随机误差）仍是重建树木几何的重要误差源，需要量化其影响。
AI.method: 通过仿真与实验，分析MLS中测量噪声异方差性（测距与扫描角方差差异）及激光束宽度对茎曲线（直径）估计的影响，并基于传感器技术规格构建无需标定的偏差预测与补偿方法。
AI.result: 偏差不仅依赖距离还依赖树径；对胸径大于10cm的树木可可靠预测并消除偏差，实验中使北方针叶林样地直径估计的RMSE降至亚厘米级；但树径小于10cm的小树偏差对未知树径、树皮及茎非圆度敏感，限制了精度与方法适用性。
AI.conclusion: 所提偏差补偿方法在胸径大于10cm的树木上有效且无需额外标定，可实现亚厘米级精度；但小树（<10cm）仍受未知树径和其他因素影响，限制激光雷达测量树木几何的精度。

title: ARE-bench: Benchmarking Agents' Research Ability in Real-World Researcher Sessions and Workspaces
summary: Research agents achieve increasingly strong benchmark scores, yet these scores do not necessarily translate into reliable delivery in ongoing research projects. Many research-agent benchmarks emphasize standalone tasks and relatively self-contained workflows in clean or curated workspaces. However, researchers ask agents to complete one step within an ongoing project, where requests depend on earlier session decisions and workspaces contain unfinished files, outdated versions, and failed attempts. We introduce ARE-bench to evaluate whether research agents advance ongoing projects while respecting prior decisions and existing workspace state, grounded in real session context and in-progress workspaces. ARE-bench includes 75 tasks built on agent sessions and full workspaces from recruited researchers' own projects, spanning seven research stages, 33 requirements, and 150 sub-requirements, with 1,173 binary checklist items in total. Each task is anchored at a real user request, preserves its requirements, and summarizes the earlier requests still in effect as background. The complete workspace is replayed to that boundary without cleanup, preserving artifacts from earlier turns. Each checklist is compiled from an intent-aligned rubric and credits any valid solution. Across seven frontier models, the strongest passes every checklist item on only 66.2% of tasks, and Design and Execution rank among the hardest stages for every model. Three models pass about 69% of tasks when only delivery contracts and general norms are checked, but just 28.4% to 40.0% once historical and material or workspace requirements are also checked. Evaluating delivery without these contextual requirements can therefore overestimate research agents and mask differences between them.

AI.tldr: 提出 ARE-bench，用 75 个基于真实研究者会话与未清理工作区的任务，评估研究智能体能否在延续项目中尊重历史决策与工作区现状。
AI.motivation: 现有研究智能体基准多为独立任务与干净工作区，而真实研究场景中请求依赖早前会话决策，工作区含有未完成文件、过时版本和失败尝试，使高分难以转化为可靠交付。
AI.method: 构建 ARE-bench：75 个任务源自真实研究者项目会话与完整工作区，覆盖 7 个研究阶段、33 项要求与 150 项子要求，共 1,173 条二元检查项。每个任务锚定真实用户请求，保留其要求，并将仍生效的早前请求总结为背景；工作区被完整回放至该边界且不做清理，保留此前产物。检查项由与意图对齐的评分标准编译，任何有效解法均可得分。
AI.result: 七个前沿模型中，最强模型仅在 66.2% 的任务上通过全部检查项；Design 与 Execution 对所有模型都是最难阶段。仅检查交付契约与通用规范时，三个模型通过约 69% 的任务，但加入历史与材料/工作区要求后降至 28.4%–40.0%。
AI.conclusion: 忽略上下文要求的评估会高估研究智能体并掩盖模型间差异，需在真实项目延续情境下评估交付可靠性。

title: Massive Activations Confound Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are commonly evaluated by variance explained and ablation damage. We show how massive activations undermine both evaluations, and propose a correction. Massive activations cause up to 99.9% of activation variance to lie along the first principal component (PC1). Because the PC1 component has no unique sparse decomposition, each SAE run rebuilds it from a different set of features. These features dominate importance rankings: an average of 47 of the 50 most important features are unmatched in a separate run, compared with about 27 of a random 50. A dictionary can also report 99.96% of variance explained while leaving 33% of the variance outside PC1 unexplained. We bypass PC1 by training the SAE on activations with PC1 removed, then adding PC1 to the reconstruction. In affected models, the top-50 feature sharing rate rises from 4-39.5% to 73-99.5%. At the same TopK sparsity, the resulting SAE degrades the model up to 44% less and reduces content reconstruction error by up to 33.9%.

AI.tldr: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）常用的两项评估指标——解释方差与消融损伤——会被"巨激活"（massive activations）严重扭曲；本文提出去除PC1再训练的方法进行修正。
AI.motivation: 巨激活使高达99.9%的激活方差集中在第一主成分（PC1）上，而PC1缺乏唯一的稀疏分解，导致每次SAE训练用不同特征重建它，从而使特征重要性排名不稳定，且方差解释率指标虚高。作者希望揭示这一评估缺陷并加以修正。
AI.method: 训练SAE前先从激活中移除PC1，再把PC1加回重建结果，从而绕过PC1、让模型专注于其余可稀疏分解的方差。
AI.result: 诊断方面：两次独立运行中，平均47/50的重要特征无法匹配（随机50个仅约27个匹配）；字典可报告99.96%方差解释，却仍有33%的PC1外方差未被解释。修正后：受影响模型的前50特征共享率由4–39.5%提升至73–99.5%；同等TopK稀疏度下，模型损伤最多降低44%，内容重建误差最多降低33.9%。
AI.conclusion: PC1会同时破坏SAE的方差解释与消融损伤评估；去除PC1后再加回的重建策略能显著提升特征稳定性、降低消融损伤并改善重建质量，是一种简单有效的修正方案。

title: Darmok: Championship Cryptic Crossword Solving via Constraint Tightening and Resilient Orchestration
summary:
We present Darmok, the first automated system to reach superhuman performance on British cryptic crosswords. Unlike American-style crosswords, cryptic clues disguise an unmarked definition and compositional wordplay beneath a misleading surface reading, sparse grids leave nearly half of each word's letters unchecked, and tournament rules rank a grid with even a single wrong or blank square behind all error-free solutions regardless of speed. Competing alongside an elite human field at the 55th Times Crossword Championship in London, Darmok solved all seven championship puzzles error-free and finished faster than every human competitor in every round. It solved the Final puzzle in 6m 52s, a full 3m 13s ahead of the human champion.
  Today's frontier AI models can on average solve a whole puzzle in a single try with comparable accuracy and speed. However, cloud API calls still stall, time out, trigger safety refusals, or get stuck in reasoning loops. To simultaneously achieve tournament-grade accuracy, speed, and reliability, Darmok cross-checks clues across three independent models in rounds; uses verified crossing letters to unlock harder clues; and uses a whole-puzzle model and dictionary lookups to fill any remaining gaps without overwriting confirmed words. This design maintained near-zero-error performance across a five-month daily evaluation period. Under normal benchmark conditions, removing backup models, fallback steps, or elaborate prompt instructions barely changes accuracy, making the architecture appear over-engineered. Yet during both the worst days of daily operation and a severe slowdown of our primary model in the live Championship Final, the backup paths carried the solve, showing that as foundation models master the average case, the central challenge in building complex AI systems shifts to resilience in the worst case.

AI.tldr: Darmok是首个在英国式 cryptic crossword（隐晦填字）上达到超人水平的自动系统：在2024年第55届《泰晤士报》填字锦标赛上与顶尖人类选手同场竞技，七题全部无误完成且每轮均快于所有人类，决赛用6分52秒，领先人类冠军3分13秒。
AI.motivation: 英国式 cryptic crossword 难度高：线索中暗藏无标记的定义与文字游戏，表面语义具有误导性；稀疏网格使近一半字母无交叉校验；赛制要求零错误优先于速度（任一错格/空格即排名垫底）。同时，现有前沿模型虽平均能力已可达，但云端API存在超时、安全拒答、推理死循环等不稳定问题，需在精度、速度与可靠性上同时达到赛事级水平。
AI.method: 多模型分轮交叉校验线索：三个独立模型并行解题并互相核对；利用已验证的交叉字母解锁更难线索；再用整题级模型与词典查询填补剩余空缺，且不覆盖已确认词。整体采用多备份、回退步骤与精细提示指令的冗余架构（benchmark 条件下这些看似"过度设计"）。
AI.result: 锦标赛七题全部零错误完成，每轮均快于所有人类选手；决赛6m52s，领先人类冠军3m13s。五个月每日评测中保持近零错误。消融显示常规条件下移除备份模型、回退步骤或复杂提示对准确率影响甚微；但在日常最差日与决赛中主模型严重变慢时，备份路径实际支撑了求解。
AI.conclusion: 当基础模型已掌握"平均情况"后，构建复杂AI系统的核心挑战正转向"最坏情况的韧性"（resilience in the worst case）；冗余与回退设计在基准测试中显示冗余，在真实极端条件下却是成败关键。

title: Exploring Synchrony for Communication in Modular Neural Networks
summary: One motivation for modular neural networks is to divide computation across components that learn distinct, reusable functions, which could then be recombined to support compositional generalisation. In practice, modular structure alone does not guarantee that such roles develop, and unrestricted communication between modules can undermine any specialisation that does emerge. This raises the question of how modular communication should be organised. The problem can be viewed as an analogue of the perceptual binding problem, where synchrony has been proposed as a mechanism for coordinating distributed representations. We introduce SyncNet, a modular architecture that separates module content from a dynamical phase state: learnt Kuramoto dynamics evolve the phases, while phase alignment determines communication through a shared channel. We evaluate SyncNet on Sort-of-CLEVR for relational reasoning and on SQOOP for systematic generalisation, where lower pair variety demands more recombination at test time. SyncNet gives the best held-out accuracy of the models compared at the three lowest pair varieties, by 5.1 percentage points at the hardest, and is competitive on Sort-of-CLEVR though below the strongest attention baselines. Test-time overrides show that performance depends on phases that evolve: fixed phases cost as much as no addressing at all, and permuting which module holds which region is nearly as damaging. A content-addressed variant trained from scratch nonetheless matches it, so the benefit appears to come from the modular decomposition rather than synchrony itself.

AI.tldr: SyncNet：用Kuramoto相位同步控制模块间通信的架构，在SQOOP系统性泛化上提升5.1个百分点，但优势主要来自模块分解而非同步机制。
AI.motivation: 模块化网络希望各模块学得可复用、可组合的功能以支持组合泛化，但模块结构本身不保证角色分化，且模块间无限制通信会破坏刚刚形成的专化。因此需要研究"模块间通信应如何组织"，并将其类比为知觉绑定问题——同步被认为是协调分布式表征的机制。
AI.method: 提出SyncNet：将模块内容与动力学相位状态分离，用可学习的Kuramoto动力学演化相位，相位对齐程度决定共享通道上的通信路由。在Sort-of-CLEVR（关系推理）和SQOOP（系统性泛化）上评估。
AI.result: 在SQOOP最低三种pair variety中最优，最难设置下高出5.1个百分点；Sort-of-CLEVR上有竞争力但弱于最强注意力基线。测试时干预显示：固定相位等价于无寻址，打乱模块所对应区域几乎同样有害；但从零训练的内容寻址变体表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 性能依赖动态演化的相位，但同步本身并非收益来源，增益主要来自模块化分解。这提示未来工作需更严格地隔离同步机制的作用。

title: Blurring the Block Boundaries: Overlapping Block Denoising for Efficient Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have emerged as effective alternatives to autoregressive models for latency-critical tasks, enabling faster token generation. Recent advances employ block diffusion with self-editing capabilities, where each block refines tokens iteratively before advancing to the next one. Yet each block is only as fast as its slowest token, and the next block cannot start before it. We suggest Blurring the Block Boundaries (B3), a novel method with which two blocks are refined in parallel within a shared forward pass. B3 calibrates itself on the fly, opening the next block only once the model is ready to start generating it. It is a training-free and hyperparameter-free acceleration method which seamlessly integrates within any self-editing block diffusion model. Evaluated on state-of-the-art DLMs across 10 diverse datasets spanning varied tasks and difficulty levels, B3 results in on par generation quality and 11.5-14.5% speedup compared to the base model, pushing the Pareto frontier for latency-quality trade-offs in DLM inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 B3 方法，让两个块在同一前向传播中并行精炼，突破块扩散模型的块串行瓶颈，实现免训练、免调参的加速。
AI.motivation: 块扩散（block diffusion）结合自编辑虽能加速生成，但每个块的速度受限于最慢 token，且必须等当前块完成才能开始下一块，形成串行瓶颈。
AI.method: B3（Blurring the Block Boundaries）在单次前向传播中并行精炼两个块，并通过在线自校准判断模型是否已具备开始生成下一块的条件，从而动态提前开启下一块；方法无需训练、无需超参数，可无缝嵌入任意自编辑块扩散模型。
AI.result: 在 SOTA 扩散语言模型上、跨 10 个不同任务与难度的数据集评测，生成质量相当，相比基座模型实现 11.5–14.5% 的加速，推进了延迟-质量权衡的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: B3 以极低集成成本有效缓解块边界串行约束，是扩散语言模型推理加速的实用方案。

title: Tabular Foundation Models in Financial Predictions
summary: This technical note introduces tabular foundation models (TFMs) to accounting research and evaluates their performance in one common benchmark task: predicting firms' next-year earnings changes. TFMs produce numeric predictions and learn in context, without post-release training or tuning, making them natural and easy to use for forecasting. The TFMs we study are pretrained on synthetic tabular data, so they avoid look-ahead bias from memorizing firms' outcomes. We compare Google Research's TabFM with a fine-tuned open-weight large language model developed in recent accounting research and with several tree-based models. TabFM is more accurate than all comparison models. It is also faster and less computationally intensive than the large language model. Several tree-based specifications produce predictions more quickly than TabFM, so choosing between them involves a trade-off between accuracy and speed. We conclude that TFMs have promise as a new tool for forecasting in accounting and finance. However, our evaluation is based on a single benchmark task, and no class of models is likely to dominate in all settings.

AI.tldr: 该技术说明将表格基础模型(TFMs)引入会计研究，在"预测企业下一年盈余变化"这一基准任务上评估其表现，发现TabFM准确率优于微调大语言模型和多种树模型，且更快、算力需求更低。
AI.motivation: 会计与金融预测任务中，现有模型（微调LLM、树模型）各有局限：LLM训练成本高，且需发布后训练或调参；而TFMs在上下文中学习、无需再训练，且预训练于合成表格数据，可避免因记忆企业历史结果而产生的look-ahead bias，因此值得评估其在会计预测中的适用性。
AI.method: 以"预测企业下一年盈余变化"为单一基准任务，比较Google Research的TabFM与近期会计研究中微调的开放权重大语言模型及若干树模型；TFMs基于合成表格数据预训练，直接生成数值预测、上下文学习，无需发布后训练或调参。
AI.result: TabFM准确率高于所有对比模型；相比大语言模型更快、算力消耗更低；部分树模型规格的预测速度快于TabFM，故二者之间存在准确率与速度的权衡。
AI.conclusion: TFMs有望成为会计与金融预测的新工具，但评估仅基于单一基准任务，且不太可能有某一类模型在所有场景中占优。

title: Benchmarking Vendor-Guided Optimizations on Edge NPUs: From NPU Only to End-to-End Performance. Extended technical report
summary: Edge NPU performance depends not only on hardware capabilities, but also on model transformation and the overall deployment pipeline. We propose a benchmarking methodology that separates these effects by comparing three configurations: Baseline, Vendor Guided NPU Only (VG-NPU), and Vendor Guided End-to-End (VG-E2E), where VG-NPU preserves common model I/O and host-side processing while VG-E2E follows the vendor-native deployment pipeline. We apply this methodology to four edge NPUs and three vision workloads. VG-NPU improves both accuracy and Runtime-call latency in 10 of 12 NPU--workload combinations, whereas VG-E2E reduces System-level latency in all combinations but improves accuracy in only four. Moreover, NPU-level performance rankings do not always match End-to-End rankings, and VG-E2E provides an additional 10.4--70.7\% reduction in System-level latency over VG-NPU. These results demonstrate the importance of evaluating vendor-guided optimization separately at the controlled model-transformation and full deployment levels when comparing heterogeneous commercial Edge NPU platforms in practice.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将模型转换与部署管线效应分离的边缘NPU基准测试方法，通过Baseline、VG-NPU、VG-E2E三种配置比较四款NPU与三个视觉工作负载，发现不同层级优化对精度与延迟影响不同。
AI.motivation: 边缘NPU性能不仅取决于硬件，还受模型转换和整体部署管线影响，现有评测难以区分二者贡献。
AI.method: 设计三配置对比方法：Baseline（原始）、VG-NPU（保留通用模型I/O与主机端处理，仅用厂商指导优化）、VG-E2E（厂商原生端到端部署管线）。在四款商用边缘NPU与三个视觉任务上评测。
AI.result: VG-NPU在12个NPU-工作负载组合中有10个提升精度和Runtime-call延迟；VG-E2E在全部组合降低System-level延迟，但仅4个提升精度；NPU级排名与端到端排名不一致；VG-E2E较VG-NPU额外降低10.4–70.7%系统级延迟。
AI.conclusion: 比较异构商用边缘NPU平台时，应在受控的模型转换层和完整部署层分别评估厂商指导优化。

title: RF3DGS: Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Self-Priors
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Joint first authors: Qiang Wen, Guotao Meng, and Junhong Ruan
summary: 3D reflection removal is crucial in applications demanding high-fidelity visualization, such as museum exhibitions. In this work, we propose Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting (RF3DGS), a novel method for superior reflection removal. RF3DGS exclusively leverages a widely-adopted photometric prior for reflection removal: that the minimum pixel intensity across multi-view images corresponding to the same 3D point strongly correlates with reflection-free information. However, generalizing this principle to a 3D Gaussian Splatting within a multi-view context is non-trivial. To address this, RF3DGS first optimizes a vanilla 3DGS model using a geometric prior to estimate a coarse, reflection-free depth map for each view. Leveraging these depth maps and photometric prior, a 3D warping process aggregates reflection-free information from auxiliary views to construct a clean transmission pseudo-label for a given reference view. This pseudo-label provides a robust self-supervised signal for optimization. We further introduce an Adaptive Twin Rendering (ATR) loss to synergistically utilize this pseudo-label while preserving high-frequency details from the original, reflection-degraded images. By adeptly fusing these internal 3D self-priors with the ATR loss, RF3DGS demonstrates state-of-the-art reflection removal performance across both synthetic and real-world scenarios. Furthermore, we establish the first 3D reflection removal benchmark, based on the Unity rendering engine, for rigorous quantitative evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出RF3DGS，利用多视角光度先验去除3D高斯溅射中的反射，并建立首个基于Unity的3D反射去除基准。
AI.motivation: 博物馆展示等高保真可视化应用需要3D反射去除，但将去反射原理推广到多视角下的3DGS并不简单。
AI.method: 先用几何先验优化普通3DGS估计各视角粗略的无反射深度图；结合深度与光度先验，通过3D扭曲从辅助视图聚合无反射信息，生成干净的透射伪标签作自监督信号；再提出自适应双渲染(ATR)损失，兼顾伪标签与原始退化图像的高频细节。
AI.result: 在合成与真实场景中均达到最先进的反射去除性能，并构建了首个基于Unity渲染引擎的3D反射去除基准用于严格定量评估。
AI.conclusion: 融合内部3D自先验与ATR损失可有效实现3DGS反射去除，配套基准为后续研究提供量化评估平台。

title: When does text encoding matter for language modeling?
summary: UTF-8's role as the de facto encoding standard in language models introduces cross-lingual inequities due to its variable-length design. However, the effect that this encoding choice has on model performance remains largely unexamined. In this work, we investigate how text encoding impacts the performance of byte-level language models, comparing UTF-8 with a wide range of other encoding strategies, including other Unicode-based approaches, language-specific encodings, and our own customized encodings. To facilitate our analysis, we propose Aether: a hybrid encoding scheme that uses script-specific encodings for our target setting while maintaining full Unicode coverage through UTF-8 fallbacks, using this framework to model four orthographically diverse languages. Surprisingly, we find that while languages with information-dense characters (Chinese, Korean) significantly benefit from compressive encodings, languages whose characters carry less information individually (Georgian, Tamil) are largely insensitive to encoding choice. In light of these findings, we argue that text encoding should be a language-specific design decision, rather than a universal default.

AI.tldr: 本文研究文本编码（UTF-8 等）对字节级语言模型性能的影响，提出 Aether 混合编码方案（针对脚本定制编码 + UTF-8 回退），在四种正字法各异的语言上对比多种编码策略，发现编码影响因语言而异，主张编码应作为语言特定设计决策。
AI.motivation: UTF-8 作为语言模型事实上的编码标准，其变长设计导致跨语言不平等；但编码选择对模型性能的实际影响仍缺乏系统考察。
AI.method: 对比 UTF-8、其他 Unicode 编码、语言特定编码与自定义编码在字节级语言模型上的表现；提出 Aether：对目标场景使用脚本特定编码，同时通过 UTF-8 回退保持完整 Unicode 覆盖；在中文、韩文、格鲁吉亚文、泰米尔文四种语言上实验。
AI.result: 信息密度高的字符语言（中文、韩文）从压缩性编码中显著受益；单字符信息量较低的语言（格鲁吉亚文、泰米尔文）对编码选择基本不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 文本编码不应采用通用默认方案，而应作为基于语言特性的设计决策。

title: Discovering Structurally Plausible and Interpretable Cognitive Models with Large Language Models
summary: Computational cognitive modeling has traditionally relied on manual model construction, which is a time-intensive process that requires substantial domain expertise. Although recent LLM-based approaches have begun to automate model generation, they often prioritize predictive accuracy at the expense of structural plausibility and parameter identifiability. We introduce DisCo, an LLM-guided framework that discovers interpretable symbolic cognitive models through evolutionary search with two structural components: a Validator that filters structurally invalid models, and a Cleaner that promotes parameter identifiability by removing redundant parameters. Across three behavioral tasks, DisCo consistently discovers models that achieve performance competitive with task-specific baselines. Ablation analyses show that the Validator is important for recovering psychologically meaningful structure. Without this component, models tend to violate behavioral constraints and show less consistent associations with external cognitive measures. These results suggest that LLM-driven model discovery, when coupled with appropriate structural constraints, can yield cognitively plausible models that go beyond predictive fit.

AI.tldr: 提出 DisCo，用 LLM 引导的进化搜索发现可解释的符号认知模型，并通过 Validator（过滤结构无效模型）与 Cleaner（去除冗余参数以提高参数可识别性）两个组件保证结构合理性。在三个行为任务上性能与任务专用基线相当，消融显示 Validator 对恢复心理意义结构至关重要。
