AI.motivation: 传统计算认知建模依赖人工构建，耗时且需大量领域专业知识；现有 LLM 自动生成方法偏向预测精度，牺牲了结构合理性与参数可识别性。
AI.method: LLM 引导的框架 DisCo，基于进化搜索发现可解释的符号认知模型；包含两个结构组件：Validator 过滤结构上无效的模型，Cleaner 通过移除冗余参数促进参数可识别性。
AI.result: 在三个行为任务上，DisCo 发现的模型性能与任务专用基线相当；消融分析表明 Validator 对恢复具有心理学意义的结构很重要，缺少该组件时模型易违反行为约束，与外部认知测量的关联也更不一致。
AI.conclusion: LLM 驱动的模型发现若结合适当的结���约束，可产生超越预测拟合的、具有认知合理性的模型。

title: Transformers Provably Learn Graph Search: Training Dynamics and the Exponential Power of Depth
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress on complex reasoning tasks, yet the mechanisms by which they acquire reasoning capabilities and the efficiency of their reasoning remain poorly understood. In this paper, we investigate the path-finding problem over directed graphs, a symbolic abstraction of multi-step reasoning. We first characterize the architectural requirements for this task, proving that one-layer transformers require $Ω(N^2)$ size on dense graphs to implement the key DFS child-selection primitive. While a two-layer transformer implements full DFS with $O(N\log(N))$ size. Thus, a second layer is necessary and sufficient for near-linear DFS reasoning. We then extend this expressivity analysis to deeper models: for every $k\geq3$, a $k$-layer transformer implements a bounded-reachability DFS policy with look-ahead horizon $1+2^{k-3}$, establishing an exponential increase in reachability horizon with depth. Finally, going beyond expressivity, given appropriately curated training data, we show that two-layer transformers can provably learn to execute DFS via gradient flow and generalize to unseen graphs. Together, our results provide a mechanistic account of how transformers implement graph search, how depth expands bounded look-ahead, and how such reasoning algorithms can emerge through training.

AI.tldr: 本文以有向图路径寻找为多步推理的符号抽象，从表达能力与可学习性两方面刻画 Transformer 如何实现 DFS 图搜索：一层不足、两层充分，深度带来指数级前瞻视界，且在合适数据下两层 Transformer 可证明地学会 DFS 并泛化。
AI.motivation: LLM 在复杂推理任务上表现优异，但其获得推理能力的机制及推理效率仍不清楚。作者希望用可分析的符号任务（有向图寻路）来机制性地理解 Transformer 内部的推理算法。
AI.method: 理论分析（构造性证明 + 下界证明）：1) 证明一层 Transformer 在稠密图上实现 DFS 子节点选择原语需 Ω(N²) 规模，而两层 Transformer 以 O(N log N) 规模实现完整 DFS；2) 将表达性分析推广到深层：k≥3 层 Transformer 实现前瞻视界为 1+2^{k-3} 的有界可达 DFS 策略；3) 在精心构造的训练数据下，用梯度流分析证明两层 Transformer 可学习执行 DFS 并泛化到未见图。
AI.result: 第二层对近线性 DFS 推理是必要且充分的；深度使可达前瞻视界随层数指数增长；两层模型在梯度流训练下可证明学到 DFS 并泛化到未见图。
AI.conclusion: 给出了 Transformer 实现图搜索、深度扩展有界前瞻、以及此类推理算法如何通过训练涌现的机制性解释。

title: DisasterAgent: An Evidence-Driven Agent for Verifiable Disaster Report Generation From Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Remote sensing disaster assessment is moving from simple damage classification toward comprehensive report-level analysis. In this setting, responders need not only damage descriptions but also verifiable evidence to guide response and recovery. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) and tool-augmented agents offer strong multimodal reasoning and perception, but they struggle to provide the evidence required for high-stakes verification. To address these limitations, we propose DisasterAgent, an evidence-driven agent that uses a Perception-Augmentation-Generation workflow to generate verifiable disaster reports from bitemporal optical imagery. DisasterAgent first invokes a specialized vision expert toolkit in the perception phase to build a Spatiotemporal Perception Graph (STPG), serving as a structured memory to store and organize disaster-induced changes across space and time. Evidence-based Augmentation (EA) then extracts evidence from the STPG, attaching inline citations that form a closed evidence loop from each statement to the supporting visual evidence. Extensive experiments on the DisasterM3 and RSCC benchmarks demonstrate that DisasterAgent consistently outperforms general-domain VLMs, remote sensing-specialized models, and existing remote sensing agents. Notably, compared with the original model, it improves the average score for disaster report generation on DisasterM3 by 13.5\% and ST5-SCS on RSCC by 15.34\%, providing a more accurate and verifiable solution for disaster emergency response. The code will be available at https://github.com/ZhijianLi2003/DisasterAgent.

AI.tldr: 提出 DisasterAgent，一种证据驱动的智能体，通过"感知-增强-生成"流程从双时相光学影像生成可验证的灾害报告。
AI.motivation: 遥感灾害评估正从简单损伤分类转向报告级综合分析，应急响应者不仅需要损伤描述，还需要可验证的证据。现有 VLM 与工具增强智能体虽具多模态推理能力，但难以提供高风险场景所需的可验证证据。
AI.method: DisasterAgent 采用 Perception-Augmentation-Generation 工作流：(1) 感知阶段调用专用视觉专家工具箱构建时空感知图（STPG），作为结构化记忆组织跨时空灾害变化；(2) 基于证据的增强（EA）从 STPG 提取证据并为每条陈述附上行内引用，形成从陈述到视觉证据的闭环。
AI.result: 在 DisasterM3 与 RSCC 基准上持续优于通用 VLM、遥感专用模型及现有遥感智能体；在 DisasterM3 灾害报告生成平均分提升 13.5%，在 RSCC 的 ST5-SCS 上提升 15.34%。
AI.conclusion: DisasterAgent 为灾害应急响应提供了更准确、可验证的报告生成方案，代码将开源。

title: Pterodactyl: Pushing the Limits of Efficient Automated Translation Evaluation
summary: In this paper, we present 1020 Group's submission to the WMT26 shared task on automated quality evaluation. Our system, Pterodactyl, was engineered specifically for subtasks 2 and 3, that is, segment-level quality score prediction and the detection of error-free segments. Pterodactyl is a highly customizable, ultra-low cost system optimized for binary classification in translation triage and data curation. It is based on an LLM-as-a-judge approach, with prompt engineering and model selection guided by ROC analysis. We also developed several variants of Pterodactyl that were specifically adapted for subtasks 3.

AI.tldr: 1020 Group 提交 WMT26 自动质量评估任务的 Pterodactyl 系统，针对子任务2（片段级质量评分预测）和子任务3（无错片段检测），采用 LLM-as-a-judge 加提示工程与基于 ROC 分析的模型选择，打造了可高度定制、超低成本的二元分类系统，并开发了多个专用于子任务3的变体。
AI.motivation: 面向翻译分诊与数据清洗场景，需要一种可定制、成本极低且能有效进行二元判定的质量评估系统，用于片段级质量评分预测与无错片段检测。
AI.method: 基于 LLM-as-a-judge 范式；通过提示工程与 ROC 分析指导模型选择；构建可高度定制的超低成本系统 Pterodactyl，并针对子任务3开发多个适配变体。
AI.result: （摘要未给出具体数值结果）系统针对子任务2与子任务3提交，侧重二元分类，服务于翻译分诊与数据清洗。
AI.conclusion: Pterodactyl 提供了一个低成本、可定制的 LLM 评判方案，适用于片段级质量评分与无错片段检测，并通过子任务3专用变体提升适配性。

title: Investigating Composite Modeling in Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Scientific Design
summary: Scientific design often requires balancing competing objectives that are expensive to evaluate through experiments or simulations. Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) addresses this challenge by using probabilistic models to guide the selection of promising designs. In many applications, tunable inputs map to observable intermediate responses, which are then combined through known functions to compute the final objectives. Prior work on Bayesian optimization of composite functions shows that learning from these intermediate responses, which we call Composite modeling, can substantially improve sampling efficiency in single-objective optimization, compared to methods that condition only on black-box observations of the objective function. The benefits of Composite modeling in MOBO, however, remain understudied. In this work, we study the benefits of Composite modeling in MOBO and investigate the factors driving variation in its gains. We first establish single-objective conditions under which intermediate observations provide no additional predictive information beyond objective values, where composite and black box methods use the same warped Gaussian process prior. Controlled numerical experiments with versions of four MOBO methods across eight synthetic and application-inspired scientific-design benchmarks examine how these conditions relate to optimization gains in the multi-objective setting, where the black box approach models the objective functions with a standard multi-output Gaussian process. Both investigations support the claim that composite modeling tends to help more when the function mapping intermediate responses to final objectives is non-bijective and non-affine.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究复合建模（利用中间响应）在多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）中的收益，并分析驱动收益变化的因素：当中介响应到最终目标的映射非双射且非仿射时，复合建模收益更大。
AI.motivation: 单目标优化中已证明利用中间响应建模可提升采样效率，但复合建模在MOBO中的收益研究不足，其增益来源与变化因素不清楚。
AI.method: 先在理论上建立中间观测不提供额外预测信息的单目标条件（复合与黑箱方法使用同一warped GP先验）；再在8个合成与科学设计基准上，用4种MOBO方法的复合/黑箱版本做受控数值实验。
AI.result: 理论与实验均支持：当中间响应到最终目标的映射非双射且非仿射时，复合建模通常带来更大优化收益。
AI.conclusion: 复合建模在MOBO中的增益取决于映射函数性质，实践中应在中间响应与目标关系复杂（非双射、非仿射）时优先采用复合建模。

title: Towards Reliable VLM Judges: State-Conditional Invariance and Presentation-Aware Diagnostics
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Track on Evaluations and Datasets). 47 pages, 16 figures. Project page: https://xinyuw922-pixel.github.io/Towards-Reliable-VLM-Judge/ ; Code: https://github.com/xinyuw922-pixel/Towards-Reliable-VLM-Judge ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nahco318/Towards-Reliable-VLM-Judges
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for multimodal and embodied tasks, yet aggregate accuracy or consistency alone does not reveal whether a judge changes its verdict for the right reason. We propose State-Conditional Invariance (SCI), a reliability principle requiring a judge to remain stable under semantics-preserving changes in presentation while responding to causal interventions that change the task outcome. We instantiate SCI in GridWM-Judge, a simulator-grounded diagnostic benchmark built from deterministic MiniGrid trajectories with aligned Full, evidence-removal, and counterfactual variants, plus presentation and representation probes. Across five diagnostic tasks, GridWM-Judge tests local perception, action-conditioned transitions, presentation stability, representation exchangeability, and Full-CF causal discrimination. Our diagnostic evaluations reveal heterogeneous failure modes, including sensitivity to evidence presentation and encoding, low activation on successful trajectories, and weak paired counterfactual discrimination. Perception-controlled analyses further indicate that visual grounding and objective recovery are substantial, model-dependent bottlenecks. These results motivate jointly reporting correctness, presentation stability, and causal sensitivity instead of relying on a single score.

AI.tldr: 提出 State-Conditional Invariance (SCI) 可靠性原则及 GridWM-Judge 诊断基准，揭示视觉语言模型作为裁判时对呈现方式敏感、反事实判别弱等异构失效模式。
AI.motivation: VLM 越来越多被用作多模态与具身任务的自动裁判，但仅靠聚合准确率或一致性无法判断裁判是否"因正确理由"改变判定，缺乏能区分"语义保持的呈现变化"与"改变任务结果的因果干预"的可靠性评估手段。
AI.method: 提出 SCI 原则：裁判应在语义保持的呈现变化下保持稳定，同时对改变任务结果的因果干预作出响应。基于确定性 MiniGrid 轨迹构建 GridWM-Judge 基准，包含对齐的 Full、证据移除（evidence-removal）与反事实（counterfactual）变体，以及呈现与表征探针，覆盖五个诊断任务：局部感知、动作条件转移、呈现稳定性、表征可交换性、Full-CF 因果判别。
AI.result: 诊断评估显示异构失效模式：对证据呈现与编码方式的敏感性、在成功轨迹上激活偏低、成对反事实判别能力弱；感知控制分析表明视觉 grounding 与目标恢复是显著且依赖具体模型的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 应联合报告正确性、呈现稳定性与因果敏感性，而非依赖单一评分；SCI 可作为 VLM 裁判可靠性的评估框架。

title: Marrying Capacity and Precision for Efficient 2D Gaussian Image Representation
summary: 2D Gaussian representations provide an explicit and efficient way to represent images, but their rate-distortion performance under limited budgets depends critically on how Gaussian capacity and parameter precision are allocated. Existing methods typically optimize these two resources separately, overlooking content-dependent capacity demands and heterogeneous quantization sensitivity. We present CP-GS, a capacity-precision coupled Gaussian splatting framework for budget-aware 2D Gaussian image representation that jointly optimizes capacity allocation and attribute precision under a shared rate constraint. CP-GS first constructs a content-adaptive Gaussian representation by dynamically reallocating a fixed Gaussian budget from redundant regions to areas with higher representation demand. It then introduces hierarchical distortion-aware representation quantization, using efficient rendering-based calibration to allocate precision across Gaussian attributes and further refine it within heterogeneous attribute groups. Finally, it jointly optimizes Gaussian capacity and attribute precision by constructing candidate representations with different Gaussian counts and precision configurations and selecting operating points according to decoded distortion and actual serialized size. Experiments on DIV2K and Kodak show that CP-GS achieves improved rate-distortion performance over representative 2D Gaussian and implicit neural representations across a range of budgets, while maintaining a fixed overall representation budget and low optimization cost. These results demonstrate the benefit of jointly optimizing spatial capacity and parameter precision for compact Gaussian image representation.

AI.tldr: CP-GS 提出容量-精度耦合的 2D 高斯泼溅框架，在统一码率约束下联合优化高斯数量分配与属性量化精度，提升预算受限下的率失真性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 2D 高斯图像表示分别优化高斯容量（数量）与参数精度，忽略了内容相关的容量需求差异与异质的量化敏感性，导致有限预算下率失真性能不佳。
AI.method: 1）内容自适应高斯表示：在固定高斯预算下，将冗余区域的高斯动态重分配至高表示需求区域；2）分层失真感知量化：基于渲染的高效校准，为各高斯属性分配精度，并在异质属性组内进一步细化；3）容量与精度联合优化：构造不同高斯数量与精度配置的候选表示，依据解码失真与实际序列化大小选择工作点。
AI.result: 在 DIV2K 和 Kodak 数据集上，于多种预算下相比代表性 2D 高斯与隐式神经表示均取得更优率失真性能，同时保持固定总表示预算与低优化成本。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化空间容量与参数精度对紧凑高斯图像表示具有显著收益。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability Needs a Logic of Inference
summary: Neural networks are increasingly studied not merely as predictive systems, but as complex systems whose internal computations are themselves objects of scientific inquiry. Recent progress in mechanistic interpretability (MI) has made it possible to identify neurons, features, circuits, population structures, and dynamical patterns associated with model behavior. As these tools improve, attention is shifting from what can be observed inside a model to how those observations support mechanistic explanations. We examine the parallel efforts of neuroscience and MI to address this question and identify recurring inferential bottlenecks when inferring mechanisms from complex neural systems. We propose five principles and organize them into a recursive logic for a more rigorous procedure of mechanistic inference. These principles provide a framework that supports scientific discovery in two senses: it helps turn local interpretability findings into cumulative knowledge of mechanisms within models, and it makes those mechanisms sufficiently precise to generate testable hypotheses about domains beyond the models. Evidence beyond MI is ultimately required to establish what model mechanisms reveal about the world.

AI.tldr: 本文借鉴神经科学的推断实践，提出用于机制可解释性（MI）的严格机制推断框架。
AI.motivation: MI已能识别神经元、特征、电路、群体结构与动力学模式，但研究重点正从"能观察到什么"转向"这些观察如何支撑机制性解释"，而现有实践存在反复出现的推断瓶颈。
AI.method: 对比神经科学与MI两条研究路径，识别从复杂神经系统中推断机制时的共性推断瓶颈，并提出五项原则，将其组织为递归的机制推断逻辑。
AI.result: 形成一套支持科学发现的框架：一方面把局部的可解释性发现累积为模型内部机制的累积性知识，另一方面使机制足够精确以生成关于模型之外领域的可检验假设。
AI.conclusion: 要确立模型机制对世界的意义，最终仍需MI之外的证据；MI的机制解释须与外部证据结合才算完整。

title: Metamorphic testing of learned AC optimal power flow surrogates reveals representation dependence
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshops on (i) Trustworthy AI Evaluation, (ii) AI Foundations for Power Grids, (iii) Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning, (iv) Sim2Science, and (v) Representations for the Physical Sciences
summary: Evaluating a learned AC optimal power flow (AC-OPF) surrogate on one grid serialization cannot show whether its accuracy depends on that encoding. We test this dependence with thirteen metamorphic relations, each specifying when a transformation is valid and how to compare its outputs. Our audit covers 17 model and pipeline configurations: two released trained checkpoints and 15 random-weight architecture or mechanism controls. Every configuration violates at least six relations, even at reporting tolerances ten times tighter or looser. For GridSFM-Open v1.1, source inspection and intermediate-tensor interventions point to an indexing bug and three noncanonical or numerically unstable preprocessing choices; a repaired checkpoint remains untested. In a separate case500 training experiment, augmentation lowers transformed-view error in three of four models and median discrepancy and constraint-violation P95 in all four. These benefits depend on the training protocol: some relations worsen, and every evaluated prediction remains AC infeasible. A GPU/CPU eigensolver mismatch accounts for most of the large raw-Laplacian-baseline gain. We recommend reporting representation consistency alongside accuracy, feasibility, and cost. These results establish neither deployment readiness nor universal invariance.

AI.tldr: 论文用13条蜕变关系审计17种AC-OPF代理配置，发现所有配置至少违反6条关系，指出GridSFM-Open v1.1存在索引缺陷与预处理问题，并建议将表示一致性纳入评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有对学习型AC-OPF代理的评测仅在单一电网序列化方式上进行，无法判断其精度是否依赖于特定编码，因此需要检验模型对输入表示变换的鲁棒性（表示一致性）。
AI.method: 设计13条蜕变关系（每条规定变换有效条件与输出比较方式），审计17个模型与流水线配置：2个已发布训练检查点与15个随机权重架构/机制对照组；辅以源码检查与中间张量干预定位缺陷；并在case500上开展数据增强训练实验，同时追查拉普拉斯基线的GPU/CPU特征求解器差异。
AI.result: 所有配置至少违反6条关系（即使放宽或收紧报告容差10倍）；GridSFM-Open v1.1定位到索引bug及三项非规范/数值不稳定预处理选择（修复版尚未测试）；case500增强实验在4个模型中3个降低变换视图误差、全部4个降低中位差异与约束违反P95，但部分关系变差且所有预测仍AC不可行；原始拉普拉斯基线的大幅提升主要源于GPU/CPU特征求解器不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 建议在精度、可行性与成本之外同时报告表示一致性；结果既不证明部署就绪，也不证明普遍不变性。

title: Earth Embeddings in Environmental Remote Sensing
summary: Earth observations from satellite platforms have profoundly transformed research and applications across numerous domains. However, uneven observation coverage and frequent data gaps continue to limit their ability to capture Earth's surface dynamics. Moreover, processing multi-modal Earth observations requires substantial computational resources and sophisticated data harmonization frameworks, which may not be readily accessible to many remote sensing practitioners. Earth embeddings have emerged as promising solutions to these challenges. As general-purpose representations converted from multi-source Earth observations, Earth embeddings can support a wide range of downstream tasks with no requirement of task-specific feature design and preprocessing. In this study, we first introduce the theoretical foundations of Earth embeddings. Then, we review several representative Earth embedding products. We next examine the applications of Earth embeddings across six major domains of environmental remote sensing. Finally, we systematically assess the performance of Earth embeddings in four downstream tasks, including hyperspectral image classification, individual tree crown segmentation, crop yield prediction, and aboveground biomass mapping. Our review and case studies suggest that, despite several advantages over conventional Earth observation data, current Earth embeddings do not always outperform remote sensing imagery or hand-crafted features. Earth embeddings should not be viewed as a direct replacement for conventional EO data, but rather as representations that provide stable information across space and time. Remote sensing practitioners may consider evaluating Earth embeddings' suitability for specific tasks and using them strategically, rather than assuming superior performance by default.

AI.tldr: 该文综述地球嵌入（Earth embeddings）的理论基础与代表性产品，并在四个下游任务上评估其性能，指出地球嵌入并非传统对地观测数据的直接替代品，而是提供时空稳定信息的表征。
AI.motivation: 卫星对地观测存在覆盖不均、数据缺测问题，多模态数据的处理又需要大量算力和复杂的数据协调框架，许多遥感从业者难以获取。地球嵌入作为多源观测转换而来的通用表征，可免去任务特定的特征设计与预处理，因而被视为应对上述挑战的潜在方案，但其实际效用尚需系统评估。
AI.method: 先介绍地球嵌入的理论基础，回顾若干代表性地球嵌入产品，梳理其在环境遥感六大领域的应用；随后在四个下游任务上系统评估性能：高光谱影像分类、单木树冠分割、作物产量预测、地上生物量制图。
AI.result: 尽管地球嵌入相较传统对地观测数据具有若干优势，当前的地球嵌入并不总是优于遥感影像或手工特征；在部分任务中其表现与常规数据相当甚至更弱。
AI.conclusion: 地球嵌入不应被视为传统对地观测数据的直接替代，而应作为跨时空提供稳定信息的表征。遥感从业者应针对具体任务评估其适用性并有策略地使用，而非默认其性能优越。

title: The Target Is a Predicate: Predicate-State Grounding for Semantic-Level Video Reasoning Segmentation
summary: In this paper, we introduce Predicate-State Video Reasoning Segmentation (PS-VRS), where a query defines a dynamic predicate $P(o,t)$ over objects and time rather than a fixed object identity. Existing methods typically treat the target as permanently active once identified, leading to over-emission of masks during vacant intervals and failure to handle target switching. To address this, we construct PS-Bench, a large-scale benchmark with 2,077 videos and 16,250 queries annotated with explicit active/vacant predicate states, temporal intervals, and pixel masks. We further propose Predicate-State Grounding (PSG), a State-Bind-Emit pipeline that: (1) predicts [ACTIVE]/[VACANT] state tokens; (2) aligns them to video frames via dense cross-modal similarity; and (3) emits masks via SAM2 only for active states. Experiments show that PSG outperforms existing baselines by +9.32 J&F on PS-Bench and significantly reduces false-positive mask emissions. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicit predicate-state modeling for video reasoning segmentation with dynamic visual witnesses.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Predicate-State Video Reasoning Segmentation (PS-VRS) 任务，要求查询表达对象与时间上的动态谓词 P(o,t) 而非固定对象；构建 PS-Bench 基准并提出 PSG 方法，显式建模激活/空置状态，显著减少空置期误分割。
AI.motivation: 现有视频推理分割方法一旦识别出目标便默认其永久激活，导致目标不在场的空置区间仍持续输出掩码，且无法处理目标切换问题。
AI.method: 构建 PS-Bench：2,077 个视频、16,250 条查询，含显式 active/vacant 状态、时间区间与像素掩码标注。提出 Predicate-State Grounding (PSG)，采用 State-Bind-Emit 流程：(1) 预测 [ACTIVE]/[VACANT] 状态 token；(2) 通过稠密跨模态相似度将状态对齐到视频帧；(3) 仅对激活状态调用 SAM2 输出掩码。
AI.result: PSG 在 PS-Bench 上以 +9.32 J&F 超越现有基线，并显著降低误报掩码输出。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，显式谓词状态建模对具有动态视觉见证的视频推理分割是有效的。

title: Market-Conditioned JEPA: Learning from Unpredictable Market Shocks
summary: Much of the variation in financial time series is driven by market-wide shocks that cannot be predicted from an asset's own history. Per-asset self-supervised learning treats this variation as irreducible noise. Under a latent factor model, we show that conditioning prediction on the realized market factor makes the asset's market exposure necessary for optimal prediction, while reducing the noise against which the asset-specific component is learned. Building on this insight, we introduce Market-Conditioned JEPA (MC-JEPA), a joint-embedding predictive architecture for financial time series. During training, we construct a leave-one-out market condition for each asset from the future target embeddings of other assets and incorporate it through factor loadings derived from the asset's own representation. On 11 years of minute-level Chinese A-share data, MC-JEPA improves over per-asset JEPA across nine targets spanning returns, market exposure, risk, and liquidity, with the strongest and most statistically significant gains in exposure, risk, and liquidity. It achieves the best RankIC on all liquidity targets and on return horizons from two hours to five days, outperforming time-series foundation models and self-supervised baselines, and delivers the best portfolio performance in a historical backtest. Ablations show that the return and exposure gains require the condition to be aligned with the realized market movement. After restoring the volatility scale removed by normalization, the predictor's factor loadings rank stocks by market beta nearly as well as a supervised probe, without labels. A synthetic factor-model study with known parameters shows that conditioning improves the recovery of both market exposure and the asset-specific component.

AI.tldr: 提出Market-Conditioned JEPA（MC-JEPA），将已实现的市场因子作为条件引入逐资产自监督预测，在中国A股分钟级数据上显著提升暴露、风险与流动性预测，并改善组合表现。
AI.motivation: 金融时间序列的变异大部分来自无法由单个资产自身历史预测的市场级冲击，而常见的逐资产自监督学习把这部分变异当作不可约噪声丢弃，限制了表征学习效果。
AI.method: 基于潜在因子模型证明：以已实现市场因子为条件可使资产的market exposure对最优预测变得必要，同时降低学习资产特异成分时的噪声。据此构建MC-JEPA联合嵌入预测架构：训练时为每个资产用其他资产未来目标嵌入构造留一法（leave-one-out）市场条件，并通过由资产自身表征导出的因子载荷注入条件。
AI.result: 在11年中国A股分钟级数据上，MC-JEPA在收益、暴露、风险、流动性等九类目标上优于逐资产JEPA，其中暴露、风险和流动性提升最强且统计显著；在所有流动性目标和2小时至5日收益期限上取得最佳RankIC，优于时间序列基础模型与自监督基线，并在历史回测中取得最佳组合表现。消融显示收益与暴露增益需条件与已实现市场走势对齐；还原归一化去除的波动尺度后，预测器因子载荷无监督排序市场beta的能力接近有监督探针。合成因子模型实验也验证了条件化对市场暴露与资产特异成分恢复的改善。
AI.conclusion: 将市场因子作为预测条件可有效提升金融时序自监督表征，无需标签即可提取有意义的市场暴露信息，并在多类下游任务与实盘回测中验证有效性。

title: Megrez: A Knowledge-Guided Agent for Formal Mathematics over MK Set Theory
summary: General-purpose coding agents equipped with proof-assistant tools have shown strong performance on standalone competition problems, yet cumulative textbook formalization inside a low-resource mathematical library still faces three obstacles: aligning textbook concepts with library declarations, keeping long-horizon search synchronized with live proof states, and integrating locally verified proofs reliably into a growing codebase. We present Megrez, a knowledge-guided formalization agent for Rocq libraries built on Morse--Kelley (MK) set theory. Megrez coordinates a general coding agent through three mechanisms: (1) a source-rebuildable knowledge graph merging formal declarations, compiler references, and curated metadata to support retrieval via Chinese aliases, concept clusters, proof dependencies, and multi-lane full-text ranking; (2) a feedback-driven 1--5 tactic short-burst proving loop paired with a goal-local branch ledger and exponential-interval structured reflection; and (3) a three-check acceptance pipeline (statement fidelity, axiom auditing, and full builds) coupled with a multi-corpus Provider stack and a candidate-bound recoverable batch state machine. Deployment and evaluation on a point-set topology corpus demonstrate effective cross-chapter formalization and scalable premise retrieval.

AI.tldr: Megrez 是一个面向 Rocq（基于 Morse–Kelley 集合论）低资源数学库的知识引导形式化智能体，通过知识图谱、短程战术证明循环与三段式验收流水线，实现教科书逐章形式化。
AI.motivation: 通用编码智能体在单项竞赛题上表现良好，但在低资源数学库中进行累积式教科书形式化时存在三大障碍：教科书概念与库声明的对齐、长程搜索与实时证明状态的同步、局部验证的证明可靠并入不断增长的代码库。
AI.method: 通过三种机制协调通用编码智能体：(1) 可源重建的知识图谱，融合形式声明、编译器引用和人工元数据，支持中文别名、概念簇、证明依赖与多路全文排序检索；(2) 反馈驱动的 1–5 步战术短爆发证明循环，配合目标局部支路账本和指数间隔结构化反思；(3) 三重验收流水线（陈述保真、公理审计、完整构建），结合多语料 Provider 栈与候选绑定的可恢复批处理状态机。
AI.result: 在点集拓扑语料上部署与评估，展示了有效的跨章节形式化能力和可扩展的前提检索性能。
AI.conclusion: Megrez 通过知识引导与工程化流水线，缓解了低资源库中累积式教科书形式化的关键难点，为长期、可维护的数学形式化提供了可行方案。

title: Relaxing Cross-Modal Correspondence for Multimodal Remote Sensing Pretraining
summary: Multimodal remote sensing pretraining commonly relies on exact instance-level correspondence across modalities, implicitly treating strictly paired observations as a prerequisite for learning transferable representations. In this work, we revisit this assumption by relaxing cross-modal correspondence from the instance level to the semantic level. We introduce Semantic Pairing (SemPair), a pairing-relaxed pretraining strategy that replaces exact instance pairs with class-consistent cross-instance pairs. To characterize the effect of correspondence relaxation, we formulate a latent-factor model that separates cross-modal dependence into shared semantic structure and instance-specific correlation, showing that SemPair preserves the former while marginalizing instance-specific cross-modal correlations in expectation. We further introduce Mixed Pairing (MixPair) as a controlled interpolation between semantic and exact pairing to study correspondence granularity along a continuous spectrum. Extensive experiments consistently show that SemPair achieves transfer performance comparable to exact pairing (ExaPair), while MixPair reveals a non-monotonic relationship between downstream transfer and the instance-pairing ratio. These results demonstrate that exact instance correspondence is not a prerequisite for effective multimodal remote sensing pretraining and establish cross-modal correspondence granularity as an important design dimension for transferable multimodal representation learning. More broadly, this finding suggests a practical route toward scaling multimodal pretraining with reduced dependence on costly instance-aligned data.

AI.tldr: 该论文放松跨模态对应关系，从实例级改为语义级，提出SemPair（用类别一致的跨实例配对替代精确实例配对）与MixPair（语义配对与精确配对的连续插值），发现精确实例对应并非多模态遥感预训练的必要前提。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态遥感预训练普遍依赖模态间严格的实例级对应，隐含地把精确配对观测当作学习可迁移表示的前提。作者质疑这一假设，探索能否在缺少实例对齐数据的情况下进行有效预训练，从而降低对昂贵实例对齐数据的依赖、便于扩展。
AI.method: 1）SemPair：将跨模态配对从实例级放松到语义级，用类别一致的跨实例配对替代精确实例配对；2）建立潜因子模型，将跨模态依赖分解为共享语义结构与实例特有关联，理论分析表明SemPair在期望意义上保留前者而边缘化后者；3）MixPair：作为语义配对与精确配对之间的受控插值，用于在连续谱上研究对应粒度的影响。
AI.result: 大量实验一致表明：SemPair的下游迁移性能与精确配对（ExaPair）相当；MixPair揭示下游迁移性能与实例配对比例之间呈非单调关系。
AI.conclusion: 精确实例对应不是有效多模态遥感预训练的必要条件；跨模态对应粒度应被视为可迁移多模态表示学习的重要设计维度。更广泛地，这为在减少对昂贵实例对齐数据依赖的前提下扩展多模态预训练提供了可行路径。

title: Unified Optimization of Traffic Signal and Lane Channelization for an Isolated Intersection Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: Optimizing traffic signal control has been a long-lasting critical issue in traffic engineering, and a number of robust methodologies have emerged to solve the problem so far. On the other hand, the road design for lane channelization is a static problem that is difficult to solve jointly with the real-time traffic signal control. If traffic volume does not vary, it is possible that both problems can be solved in an integrated manner as a single static optimization problem. Recently, researchers have devised a mixed integer linear problem (MILP) to jointly determine the traffic signal and road width designs. However, this joint optimization problem must be solved repeatedly whenever the traffic flow pattern varies. Solving the MILP may also take impractical computing time as the problem size gets larger. We present a robust methodology for solving the joint optimization problem using reinforcement learning (RL) on a real-time basis. Abrupt changes in lane markings with an incompatible signal phase can jeopardize drivers. To sidestep such a dangerous action change, we train a model with human feedback to filter infeasible action transitions in a rule-based manner. We devised a deep Q-network that can accommodate joint actions for traffic signal and lane marking plans. To ensure the implementation of the proposed operation, a variable sign for lane markings is necessary at each stop line of an intersection. The experimental results confirm that the proposed methodology enhances the intersection performance by increasing throughput.

AI.tldr: 利用强化学习（带人类反馈过滤动作）实时联合优化交通信号与车道渠化（车道标记）设计，替代需重复求解的MILP，提升交叉口通行能力。
AI.motivation: 交通信号控制是长期难题，而车道渠化是静态设计问题，难以与实时信号控制联合求解；已有MILP联合优化方法在流量变化时需反复求解、规模增大时计算时间不可行。
AI.method: 提出基于强化学习的联合优化方法：设计可处理信号与车道标记联合动作的深度Q网络（DQN）；采用带人类反馈的训练，以规则方式过滤不可行的动作转移，避免车道标记突变与相位不兼容带来的驾驶风险；实施需在交叉口各停止线设置可变车道标记指示牌。
AI.result: 实验结果确认所提方法通过提升通行量（throughput）改善了交叉口性能。
AI.conclusion: RL可在实时条件下求解信号与车道渠化的联合优化问题，配合规则化动作过滤保证安全可行，为动态车道标记与信号协同控制提供可行方案。

title: DrugCoding: A Scientific Programming Agent for Drug Discovery
summary: Drug discovery involves multiple interconnected research stages, including molecular design, property prediction, and virtual screening. These processes are characterized by complex workflows, interdependent computational tasks, and diverse specialized tools, placing substantial demands on the coordination of scientific models and computational resources. However, existing large language model (LLM)-based scientific agents still face challenges in autonomous planning of complex tasks, adaptive selection of specialized models, and reliable execution of multi-stage scientific computations, limiting their effectiveness in automating complex drug discovery workflows. To address these challenges, we propose DrugCoding, a scientific programming agent system that integrates scientific task planning, adaptive model routing, multi-agent collaboration, and programmatic tool execution. DrugCoding enables autonomous task planning and dynamic model adaptation for complex research objectives. It can flexibly invoke specialized scientific models, autonomously generate and execute code according to task requirements, and leverage multi-agent collaboration to support efficient execution and reliable validation of complex scientific tasks. To evaluate DrugCoding's performance in scientific tool invocation and multi-stage task execution, we conduct multi-turn tool-calling experiments across diverse language models and scientific tool interfaces. Experimental results demonstrate that DrugCoding achieves an average session-level Pass@1 of 97.35% on the full benchmark, outperforming the strongest baseline, Codex, by 9.24%. On the challenging subset, DrugCoding achieves 97.92%, exceeding the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: DrugCoding：面向药物发现 workflow 的科学编程智能体，融合任务规划、自适应模型路由、多智能体协作与程序化工具执行，在工具调用基准上 session 级 Pass@1 达 97.35%，超最强基线 Codex 9.24%。
AI.motivation: 药物发现包含分子设计、性质预测、虚拟筛选等多阶段互联任务，流程复杂、任务相互依赖、专用工具多样，对模型与计算资源协调要求高。现有基于 LLM 的科学智能体在复杂任务自主规划、专用模型自适应选择、多阶段科学计算可靠执行方面仍存在不足，限制了其对药物发现 workflow 的自动化能力。
AI.method: 提出 DrugCoding 科学编程智能体系统，集成四部分：科学任务规划、自适应模型路由（按需动态调用专用科学模型）、多智能体协作、程序化工具执行（依据任务要求自主生成并运行代码）。系统支持面向复杂研究目标的自主规划与动态模型适配，并通过多智能体协作完成任务的执行与结果验证。
AI.result: 在跨多种语言模型与科学工具接口的多轮工具调用实验中，DrugCoding 在全基准上取得平均 session 级 Pass@1 为 97.35%，比最强基线 Codex 高 9.24%；在困难子集上达到 97.92%，同样超过最强基线。
AI.conclusion: DrugCoding 表明将任务规划、模型路由、多智能体协作与程序化执行结合，可显著提升科学工具调用与多阶段任务执行的可靠性，为药物发现 workflow 的自动化提供了有效路径。

title: FastWild-GS: Minutes-Scale In-the-Wild Gaussian Splatting via Compact Per-Image Appearance Adaptation
summary: Internet photos of a scene differ in exposure, illumination and transient objects such as passers-by, so one set of Gaussian colours cannot explain all photos (the in-the-wild setting). Recent in-the-wild Gaussian Splatting methods mostly report hours of per-scene optimization. We present FastWild-GS, which describes each photo by a 128-dimensional Photo Appearance Token and a per-channel transform, a scale and an offset applied to the rendered image (six parameters); a small MLP predicts the colour of each Gaussian from this token and a per-Gaussian feature, replacing the spherical-harmonics colour. The same transform is applied to the renders that score Gaussians for densification and pruning, so appearance differences between photos are not counted as reconstruction error. On PhotoTourism, FastWild-GS trains in 8.8 minutes per scene with the lowest LPIPS among the compared methods, 23x faster than AsymGS, the next best in LPIPS. On NeRF-OSR, it has the best average PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS among the compared methods in 9.7 minutes per scene.

AI.tldr: FastWild-GS 用 128 维 Photo Appearance Token 加每通道 6 参数变换来建模野外照片的外观差异，每场景训练约 9 分钟，在 PhotoTourism 与 NeRF-OSR 上取得最优或最优之一的 LPIPS/PSNR/SSIM。
AI.motivation: 野外（in-the-wild）场景照片在曝光、光照和瞬态物体（如路人）上差异很大，单一组高斯颜色无法解释所有照片；现有野外高斯泼溅方法通常需要每场景数小时的优化，速度太慢。
AI.method: 每张照片用 128 维 Photo Appearance Token 加一组六参数（每通道的缩放与偏移）变换表示；小型 MLP 由该 token 与每高斯特征预测高斯颜色，替代球谐颜色。同一变换也施加于用于致密化与剪枝打分的渲染图，使照片间外观差异不被误判为重建误差。
AI.result: PhotoTourism 上每场景训练 8.8 分钟，LPIPS 为对比方法中最低，比 LPIPS 次优的 AsymGS 快 23 倍；NeRF-OSR 上每场景 9.7 分钟，平均 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 均为对比方法中最佳。
AI.conclusion: 将外观建模（token+仿射变换）与高斯致密化/剪枝的解耦，可在野外场景实现分钟级优化并达到领先的渲染质量。

title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Non-intrusive Model Reduction under Data Scarcity
summary: Many-query analyses, in which a computational model is repeatedly evaluated, play an important role in uncertainty quantification and optimization for engineering design. However, many-query analyses can be prohibitively expensive when considering high-fidelity numerical models, especially those governed by partial differential equations (PDEs). Surrogate modeling replaces costly simulations with cheap approximations, enabling practical uncertainty quantification and design workflows. Machine learning (ML) approaches to surrogate modeling have gained significant traction in the development of surrogate models due to their non-intrusive nature; they do not require access to the underlying simulation code. The Operator Inference (OpInf) approach, in particular, fits reduced operators to state and corresponding time derivative data. However, high-fidelity training data is scarce due to limited computational budgets, and OpInf models trained on such scarce data often exhibit high variance, a critical liability in high-risk engineering design. We propose Multifidelity Operator Inference (MF-OpInf), which reduces this variance by supplementing scarce high-fidelity snapshots with abundant low-fidelity data drawn from coarser discretizations of the same problem. MF-OpInf handles data across varying fidelity levels by utilizing a multifidelity linear regression framework to estimate the reduced operators. Numerical experiments on model PDE problems demonstrate that MF-OpInf predicts PDE solution fields with higher accuracy compared to the high-fidelity-only OpInf with the same computational budget.

AI.tldr: 提出多保真算子推断（MF-OpInf），用低成本低保真数据补充稀缺高保真快照，降低降阶模型方差，提升预测精度。
AI.motivation: 工程设计与不确定性量化中的多次查询分析依赖PDE高保真模型，计算代价极高。代理模型（尤其非侵入式的算子推断OpInf）虽可替代仿真，但高保真训练数据受算力预算限制而稀缺，导致OpInf模型方差大，在高风险设计中不可靠。
AI.method: MF-OpInf：将同一问题粗离散得到的丰富低保真数据与稀缺高保真快照结合；通过多保真线性回归框架，跨不同保真度数据估计降阶算子。
AI.result: 在模型PDE问题上的数值实验表明，在相同计算预算下，MF-OpInf预测PDE解场的精度高于仅用高保真数据的OpInf。
AI.conclusion: 多保真数据融合能有效缓解数据稀缺下方差大的问题，是可推广的OpInf降低方差策略。

title: Benchmarking LLM Next-Step Recommendations with Knowledge Space Theory
summary: Selecting an LLM for next-step recommendation requires benchmarks that reflect the intended educational task and domain. We present a benchmarking method that uses Knowledge Space Theory (KST) as a formal evaluation reference. Given a task catalogue and an existing prerequisite relation, the method derives admissible knowledge states and the complete set of immediate next steps for each state. Recommendations generated by a model under a specified prompt are compared with these reference sets. A sample evaluation study uses 2,400 responses from six models across four mathematics domains, four prompt conditions, and two catalogue orders. Exact-set accuracy was 61.3% with descriptions only, 62.8% when models were asked to reconstruct prerequisites, 96.3% with supplied prerequisite relations, and 98.2% with the complete knowledge space. Performance varied across models and domains, and recommendation sets agreed across the two presentations in 85.25% of pairs. The benchmark supports comparisons of model-prompt combinations against a context-specific reference. Its scores describe structural recommendation accuracy under the evaluated conditions; they do not establish learning benefit or the necessity of using an LLM for selection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以知识空间理论（KST）作为形式化评价基准，用于评测大语言模型在"下一步推荐"任务中的表现：由任务目录与先修关系推导允许知识状态及各状态的完整即时下一步集合，再与模型推荐集比对。2400条回答（6模型×4数学领域×4提示条件×2目录顺序）显示，仅给描述时精确集合准确率61.3%，要求模型重建先修关系时62.8%，提供先修关系时96.3%，提供完整知识空间时98.2%，两种呈现方式一致率85.25%。
AI.motivation: 选择用于下一步推荐的LLM需要能反映目标教育任务与领域的基准。现有评测缺乏形式化、可对齐任务结构的参照，难以判断模型推荐在结构上是否正确。
AI.method: 以KST为评价参照构建基准：给定任务目录与已有先修关系，推导允许知识状态及每个状态的完整即时下一步参考集合；对比指定提示下模型生成的推荐集与参考集；并进行跨模型、领域、提示条件与目录顺序的样本评测。
AI.result: 精确集合准确率：仅描述61.3%；要求重建先修关系62.8%；给定先修关系96.3%；给定完整知识空间98.2%。性能随模型与领域变化；两种目录呈现间推荐集一致率为85.25%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准支持在特定情境参照下比较模型—提示组合，其分数刻画所评测条件下的结构性推荐准确率，但不证明学习收益，也不证明必须使用LLM进行选择。

title: CASCADE: Constraint-Aware SCAffolded DEcomposition for Logical Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted at the 26th IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026). 10 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables
summary: Logical Anomaly Detection (LAD) requires verifying whether all category-specific constraints, such as object counts, pairing relations, and measurement ranges, are satisfied by a query image given only a few normal references. Recent LAD methods based on Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) formulate this as checklist verification, decomposing the decision into independent textual checks. This decomposition, however, is text-only. Every item still reads the same unmodified query image, so the LVLM must extract different forms of visual evidence from one raw image. We identify this text-image mismatch as a constraint-specific perception gap, the source of two failure modes: instance conflation for binding constraints and scale drift for calibration constraints. To diagnose whether these failures stem from insufficient reasoning or insufficient perception, we compare textual reasoning guides and visual perception guides in a training-free setting. Our analysis shows that reasoning over the same image provides little benefit, whereas adapting the visual input to each constraint substantially improves verification accuracy. Based on this finding, we propose CASCADE, a training-free framework that extends checklist decomposition using constraint-specific visual scaffolds. We further introduce CASCADE++, which adapts these scaffolds at the object level by deriving their configurations from the constraint structure and reference distribution. Across MVTec-LOCO and VID-AD, CASCADE++ surpasses the full-shot state of the art by 3.9 AUROC points with only three references, and improves over the strongest VID-AD baseline by 11.4, transferring across multiple LVLM backbones without any training.

AI.tldr: 本文指出LAD中LVLM的"清单式验证"是纯文本分解,每项检查都读取同一张未修改的查询图,造成文本-图像错配的"约束特定感知鸿沟",进而提出免训练的CASCADE/CASCADE++框架,为每个约束构建视觉脚手架。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LVLM的LAD方法将判定分解为独立文本检查,但分解是纯文本的,每一项仍读取同一张原始查询图,LVLM需从一张图中提取不同形式的视觉证据,这一文本-图像错配导致两类失败模式:绑定约束下的实例混淆和校准约束下的尺度漂移。
AI.method: 先在免训练设定下对比文本推理引导与视觉感知引导,以诊断失败源于推理不足还是感知不足;据此提出免训练框架CASCADE,用约束特定的视觉脚手架扩展清单分解;CASCADE++进一步在对象级自适应脚手架,依据约束结构和参考分布推导其配置。
AI.result: 分析表明对同一图像做推理收益甚微,而按约束调整视觉输入可显著提升验证精度。在MVTec-LOCO和VID-AD上,CASCADE++仅用3个参考即超过全样本SOTA 3.9 AUROC,较最强VID-AD基线提升11.4,并可免训练跨多个LVLM骨干迁移。
AI.conclusion: LAD的关键瓶颈在于约束特定的视觉感知而非文本推理,按约束构造视觉脚手架是有效且免训练、可迁移的解决路径。

title: MouldIt: Data Efficiency of Multi-Task Temporal Representation Learning in Injection Moulding
summary: Smart industrial solutions that can address multiple tasks require models that understand the underlying processes. We examine representation learning for modeling the injection moulding process as an example of such solutions. We consider its data efficiency and multi-modal benefit compared to classical machine learning alternatives. To this end, we synthesize a process-informed dataset based on a real reference cycle of an Erlanger Träger part. We then introduce MouldIt, a temporal convolution and attention based variational autoencoder that reconstructs in-mould signals, while classifying parts as acceptable or as one of our synthetic failure modes. We evaluate MouldIt on two tasks, known-class classification and unknown-class detection, across nine dataset sizes in single-modal and multi-modal settings. We compare it with an accept-all baseline and the classical methods k-nearest neighbors, logistic regression, random forests, and principal component analysis, which we adapt to support both tasks. MouldIt outperforms classical methods across both tasks from 4000 cycles in the single-modal setting and from 2000 cycles in the multi-modal setting. It achieves part sorting losses of 6.0 $\pm$ 0.7% and 1.0 $\pm$ 0.3% in the single-modal and multi-modal settings respectively, ranking first across all baselines and a combination of principal component analysis and random forests.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究注塑成型过程的表征学习，提出MouldIt——一种时序卷积与注意力机制结合的变分自编码器，用于模具内信号重建与零件合格/失效分类。在多模态设置下，从2000个周期起超越经典方法，单模态下从4000个周期起超越；分选损失分别为6.0±0.7%和1.0±0.3%，位居第一。
AI.motivation: 智能工业方案需能处理多任务、理解底层工艺过程的模型。作者以注塑成型为案例，探究表征学习相比经典机器学习的数据效率优势及多模态带来的收益。
AI.method: 基于Erlanger Träger零件的真实参考周期合成一个工艺先验数据集；提出MouldIt：由时序卷积与注意力构成的变分自编码器，重建模具内信号并将零件分类为合格或某类合成失效模式。评测涵盖已知类分类与未知类检测两项任务，在单模态与多模态、九种数据规模下与接受全部基线及kNN、逻辑回归、随机森林、PCA（均改造以支持双任务）对比。
AI.result: 单模态设置从4000周期起、多模态设置从2000周期起，MouldIt均优于经典方法；单模态与多模态分选损失分别为6.0±0.7%和1.0±0.3%，在所有基线中排名第一，并优于PCA+随机森林组合。
AI.conclusion: 工艺感知的表征学习在注塑成型任务中兼具数据效率与多模态优势，为多任务智能工业解决方案提供了可行路径。

title: A computational framework for understanding embodied plans
summary: Reasoning about people's plans and goals based on their actions is fundamental to human social interaction and essential for cooperative, embodied artificial intelligence. Formalizing this capacity in naturalistic, embodied settings has been a longstanding challenge. Here, we present GenEA, a novel agent representation capable of reasoning over multi-step, long-horizon embodied plans. At the heart of GenEA lies a multilevel state-space that couples the coarse biomechanics of an articulated body and its interactions with nearby objects by extending the task-and-motion planning framework from robotics with simulation-based intuitive physics. By embedding this state-space in a generative model, GenEA yields a joint probability distribution over goals and embodied plans. Across several experiments spanning the qualitatively distinct domains of object manipulation and navigation, featuring diverse tasks and multiple behavioral measures, we show that GenEA, through simple transformations of this joint distribution, recapitulates how humans reason about embodied plans. Crucially, GenEA consistently outperforms strong alternative models, including plausible heuristics, standard task-and-motion planning, and a state-of-the-art vision-language model. GenEA thereby offers a new perspective on the architecture of human reasoning and social cognition, suggesting that embodied artificial intelligence systems seeking to seamlessly interact with humans should adopt GenEA-like generative models of action planning.

AI.tldr: GenEA 是一种智能体表征，用多层级状态空间耦合身体生物力学与物体交互，并嵌入生成模型得到目标与具身计划的联合分布，在操作与导航实验中再现人类计划推理并超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 从人的行动推断其计划与目标是人类社会互动的基础，也是协作型具身AI的必要能力；但在自然、具身情境中形式化这一能力长期困难。
AI.method: 提出 GenEA：以多层级状态空间将关节身体的粗略生物力学和邻近物体交互耦合，把机器人任务与运动规划框架扩展为带仿真式直觉物理的形式，并将该状态空间嵌入生成模型，得到目标与具身计划的联合概率分布；通过该联合分布的简单变换进行推理。
AI.result: 在物体操作与导航两类性质不同的域、多任务与多行为指标下，GenEA 再现了人类对具身计划的推理，并稳定优于启发式、标准任务与运动规划以及先进视觉语言模型等强基线。
AI.conclusion: GenEA 为人类推理与社会认知架构提供新视角，提示追求与人类无缝交互的具身AI系统应采用类 GenEA 的生成式行动规划模型。

title: Satellite Pretraining Is Not One Thing: A Matched-Pair Study of Generic and Earth-Observation Foundation Models for Scene Classification
comment: Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on Computer Vision for Geospatial Image Analysis (GeoCV) at WACV 2027
summary: Geospatial foundation models are pretrained on satellite and aerial imagery, but whether such an encoder beats a strong generic one for few-label land-use/land-cover mapping remains unclear, as prior comparisons rarely isolate the pretraining data. We study five matched pairs of Earth-observation (EO) and generic encoders sharing objective and architecture (DINO/SatDINO, DINOv3/DINOv3-SAT, MAE/SatMAE, MAE/Scale-MAE, CLIP/RemoteCLIP) within a benchmark of 14 frozen encoders on five RGB scene-classification datasets (0.06-30 m GSD). With native preprocessing, we evaluate k-NN, linear and attentive probes and image retrieval over six low-label splits, using paired per-image significance tests. EO pretraining is not uniformly helpful: on most datasets and metrics, it significantly improves three pairs (SatDINO, Scale-MAE, RemoteCLIP, the latter evaluated only on unseen datasets) and significantly hurts two (linear probe: DINOv3-SAT by up to 22.5 points, SatMAE by up to 8.8), with opposite outcomes even for two MAEs pretrained on the same fMoW-RGB imagery. These effects are robust to patch-token pooling and attentive probing, concentrate on small man-made objects, and are largest with 1-5% labels. Across encoders, the silhouette score of frozen embeddings predicts k-NN accuracy and retrieval mAP almost perfectly (Spearman $ρ\geq 0.96$ on four of five datasets). Pretraining on satellite imagery is thus not a reliable selection criterion; candidate checkpoints must be validated on target data.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过5组"数据来源匹配"的EO/通用编码器配对（共享架构与预训练目标），在14个冻结编码器、5个RGB场景分类数据集、6种低标签划分上进行严格基准测试，发现"卫星预训练"并非可靠优势来源：3对显著有益、2对显著有害（线性探针下最多下降22.5点），且效果在1–5%标签时最大；同时发现冻结嵌入的轮廓系数几乎完美预测k-NN精度与检索mAP。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型（EO基础模型）通常被认为优于通用视觉模型，但以往比较很少控制预训练数据这一变量（架构、目标、数据规模往往同时不同），因此"卫星/航拍预训练本身是否带来增益"这一问题未被清晰回答。作者希望在低标签（few-label）土地利用/地表覆盖制图场景下，隔离预训练数据的影响，检验EO预训练是否值得作为模型选择依据。
AI.method: 构建5组匹配配对，每组内架构与预训练目标相同、仅预训练数据域不同：DINO/SatDINO、DINOv3/DINOv3-SAT、MAE/SatMAE、MAE/Scale-MAE、CLIP/RemoteCLIP。基准含14个冻结编码器、5个RGB场景分类数据集（GSD 0.06–30 m）、6种低标签划分；采用原生预处理，评估k-NN、线性探针、attentive探针与图像检索，并做逐图像配对显著性检验。
AI.result: EO预训练并非普遍有益：多数数据集与指标上，SatDINO、Scale-MAE、RemoteCLIP三对显著提升（RemoteCLIP仅在未见数据集上评估），而DINOv3-SAT（线性探针最多低22.5点）与SatMAE（最多低8.8点）显著变差；即使两个MAE在同一fMoW-RGB影像上预训练，结果也相反。结论对patch-token池化与attentive探针稳健，差异集中在小型人造目标上，并在1–5%标签时最大。跨编码器上，冻结嵌入的轮廓系数几乎完美预测k-NN精度与检索mAP（5个数据集中4个Spearman ρ≥0.96）。
AI.conclusion: "在卫星影像上预训练"不能作为可靠的模型选择准则，EO编码器与通用编码器之间不存在一致优势；候选checkpoint必须在目标任务数据上实际验证（例如用轮廓系数等无标签指标做低成本筛选）后才能选用。

title: CP-MLPs: A Tensor-Rank Theory of Tied and Untied MLP Blocks
summary: Transformer feed-forward blocks combine several design choices: squared activations, gating, and tied versus untied parameter sharing, whose separate contributions to expressivity remain poorly understood. We introduce CP-MLPs, a tensor framework in which each multiplicative unit contributes a rank-1 interaction with three roles: detecting an input feature, reading a value, and writing to the output. Tied gated blocks such as ReLU$^2$ force the detector and value roles to share the same direction; untied gated blocks such as ReGLU and SwiGLU let them differ. We show that this distinction yields exact, degree-wise tensor-rank separations: untied detector-value units are strictly more width-efficient for indefinite quadratic interactions and role-asymmetric monomials, while tied units are structurally matched to symmetric pure-power targets. The width advantage of untying therefore depends on the target structure. Experiments show loss plateaus below the exact-representation width, but these plateaus alone do not establish a positive approximation gap: arbitrarily accurate approximation is governed by border rank. In trained gated MLPs, untied blocks retain an advantage in selected comparisons at matched input-projection budget. Code is available at https://github.com/rarefin/CP-MLPs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CP-MLPs 张量框架，将前馈块的乘法单元分解为“检测、读值、写出”三种角色，揭示 tied 与 untied 门控在张量秩上的精确分离。
AI.motivation: Transformer 前馈块混合了平方激活、门控、参数共享绑定/不绑定等多种设计，但它们各自对表达能力的贡献尚不清楚，缺乏统一理论分析。
AI.method: 引入 CP-MLPs 张量框架，每个乘法单元贡献一个 rank-1 交互并将其对应到检测、读值、写出三角色；比较 tied（如 ReLU²，检测与读值共享方向）与 untied（如 ReGLU、SwiGLU，二者可不同）的秩结构，做逐次数的张量秩分离证明，并结合边界秩与实际训练实验。
AI.result: 证明了 untied 检测-值单元在不定二次交互和角色非对称单项式上严格更宽度高效，而 tied 单元与对称纯幂目标结构性匹配；实验显示损失平台出现在精确表示宽度以下，但仅靠平台不能确立正逼近差距（精确逼近由边界秩决定）；裁剪比较中 untied 块在部分对比下保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 解绑的宽度优势取决于目标结构，而非普遍更优；该框架为理解前馈块设计选择提供精确的理论刻画与实验指引。

title: Topological Dynamics Under Non-Stationary Supervision: Persistent Homology of Neural Network Weight Evolution
summary: We investigate how the persistent topology of neuron- weight point clouds evolves under stable and non-stationary supervision. An identical multilayer perceptron is trained on Fashion-MNIST with correct labels, a fixed random permutation of the training-label vector, or a fresh permutation every epoch. Five paired seeds share initialisation and minibatch order, yielding 15 models trained for 100 epochs. Raw and row-normalised incoming weight clouds are analysed with H0 and H1 Vietoris Rips persistence at 22 checkpoints. Correct-label models reach 89.39% mean true-label test accuracy; fixed-random models fit 67.94% of their assigned training targets without generalising to the original task. Correct-label models have descriptively greater time-averaged normalised fc3 H1 persistence than either random-label condition, but the configured exact comparisons do not reach conventional significance after Holm correction. Early condition classification achieves 60.0% mean balanced accuracy using topology, 66.7% using conventional diagnostics, and 60.0% using both. Thus, no incremental predictive improvement is demonstrated in this setting. The archive contains all 3,300 configured topology cases. Interpretation is limited by five seeds, a single architecture and dataset, 282 capped H1 distance comparisons, and deferred bottleneck analysis.

AI.tldr: 研究在正确/固定随机/每轮新随机三种监督下，MLP神经权重点云的持续拓扑如何演化；正确标签模型描述性地有更大的fc3 H1持续度，但经Holm校正不显著，拓扑对早期识别条件无增量预测增益。
AI.motivation: 探究监督信号的稳定性（正确标签 vs 恒定随机标签 vs 每轮重随机标签）是否在神经权重点云的持续同调（拓扑）结构上留下可分辨的痕迹，并检验拓扑特征能否在训练早期预测训练条件。
AI.method: 同一MLP在Fashion-MNIST上以三种监督训练（正确标签、固定随机置换、每轮新置换），5个配对种子共享初始化与minibatch顺序，共15个模型训练100轮；在22个检查点对原始与行归一化的输入权重点云做H0/H1 Vietoris–Rips持续同调分析，并进行Holm校正的精确比较与基于拓扑/常规诊断的早期条件分类。
AI.result: 正确标签模型真实标签平均测试准确率89.39%；固定随机模型拟合67.94%分配给它的训练目标但未泛化到原任务。正确标签模型的时间平均归一化fc3 H1持续度高于两种随机标签条件，但Holm校正后未达常规显著。早期条件分类平均平衡准确率：仅拓扑60.0%、仅常规诊断66.7%、两者结合60.0%，无增量提升。
AI.conclusion: 在该设定中，持续拓扑特征未能显著区分监督条件，也未在早期条件识别上带来超越常规诊断的预测增益；结论受五种子、单一架构与数据集、282个截断H1距离比较及未完成的瓶颈分析所限。

title: Towards Text-Only Remote Sensing Scene Classification via Semantic Proxy
summary: Remote sensing scene classification (RSSC) is traditionally formulated as a vision-centric problem, where inference relies on rich visual representations extracted from images. In this work, we revisit this assumption by introducing text-only RSSC, a new problem setting that investigates whether remote sensing scenes can be recognized using only textual semantic representations. To enable this study, we propose SeProRS, which reformulates RSSC as a text-only classification task through semantic proxy generation. Specifically, a vision-language model (VLM) is first employed to convert remote sensing images into textual descriptions, termed semantic proxies, which are then encoded by a text embedding model for scene classification. This decoupled pipeline provides a unified and reproducible benchmark for evaluating text-only scene understanding. Furthermore, we investigate representative prompting strategies and proxy generators, and analyze their impact on classification performance, text embedding behavior, cross-generator transferability, and efficiency. Extensive experiments on three well-known RSSC datasets show that semantic proxies can preserve substantial discriminative information, while also revealing inherent limitations of purely text-based scene understanding. This paper does not aim to replace image-based RSSC, but instead establishes a new research direction by quantifying the feasibility and boundaries of semantic proxy-based scene recognition. The proposed benchmark and analysis provide a foundation for future research on efficient and modality-reduced remote sensing scene understanding. The source code and datasets will be accessible at https://github.com/sstary/SSRS.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"纯文本遥感场景分类"(text-only RSSC)新设定，并构建 SeProRS 基准：先用 VLM 将遥感图像转为文本"语义代理"，再用文本嵌入模型做分类，系统分析其可行性与边界。
AI.motivation: 传统遥感场景分类(RSSC)依赖图像视觉特征，属于视觉中心范式。作者想探究：仅凭文本语义表示能否识别遥感场景，从而开辟模态精简、高效的新研究方向。
AI.method: 提出解耦式流水线 SeProRS：VLM 将遥感图像转成文本描述(语义代理)→文本嵌入模型编码→场景分类。并对比多种提示策略与代理生成器，分析其对分类性能、文本嵌入行为、跨生成器迁移性及效率的影响。在三个知名 RSSC 数据集上实验。
AI.result: 语义代理能保留大量判别信息，纯文本分类具有一定可行性；但同时暴露出纯文本场景理解的内在局限。跨生成器迁移性与效率也被量化分析。
AI.conclusion: 论文不以替代图像 RSSC 为目标，而是通过量化语义代理分类的可行性与边界，建立新研究方向并提供统一、可复现的基准，为高效、模态精简的遥感场景理解奠定基础。

title: SepsisFlow: an event-stream foundation model for continuous risk warning and trajectory modelling in ICU sepsis
summary: Sepsis is a leading cause of ICU death with heterogeneous onset and course, yet most warning models predict only whether sepsis will occur, leaving clinicians uncertain of its onset context and early trajectory once an alarm sounds. To answer these questions on one hourly clock from ICU admission, we built SepsisFlow: before onset, it combines a Mamba model pretrained on 2.57 million EHRs with about 1,700 hourly features in gradient-boosted trees to predict 6/12/24-h risk; at onset, it fuses Mamba and tabular encoders via a gated network into continuous patient states defining onset contexts; after onset, it encodes 72-h organ-support and physiological trajectories via an attention bidirectional recurrent network into early courses. For pre-onset warning in MIMIC-IV, SepsisFlow detected more cases than NEWS2, qSOFA, and SIRS at equal alarms, gaining about 8 cases per 100 from hourly updating, while outperforming 16 retrained algorithms and maintaining risk ranking in eICU. At onset, its contexts separated 2% cardiovascular-ICU from 15%-17% other 28-day mortality, and within each context after onset, persistent support carried fivefold higher mortality than de-escalation. SepsisFlow establishes a foundation-model paradigm for continuous risk and trajectory stratification in critical care.

AI.tldr: SepsisFlow是一个统一的小时级框架，用预训练Mamba、梯度提升树和门控/注意力循环网络，在脓毒症发生前、发生时、发生后三阶段分别提供风险预测、起病情境分类和早期病程分层。
AI.motivation: 脓毒症是ICU主要死因，起病与病程高度异质；现有预警模型多只预测"是否会发生"，报警后临床医生仍不知起病情境与早期走向。
AI.method: 以入院为起点的统一小时时钟：起病前用预训练于257万份EHR的Mamba+约1700个逐小时特征输入梯度提升树，预测6/12/24小时风险；起病时用门控网络融合Mamba与表格编码器，得到连续患者状态定义起病情境；起病后用注意力双向循环网络编码72小时器官支持与生理轨迹，刻画早期病程。
AI.result: MIMIC-IV中同等报警量下检出病例多于NEWS2、qSOFA、SIRS，逐小时更新约每100例多检出8例，优于16种重训练算法；eICU中风险排序保持。起病情境区分出2%心血管ICU与15%–17%其他28天死亡率；各情境内持续支持者死亡率约为降阶梯者的5倍。
AI.conclusion: SepsisFlow为重症监护建立了"基础模型"式的连续风险与轨迹分层范式。

title: SeqFold: Timestamp-Addressable Compressed States for User Action Sequence Backbones
summary: Existing sequential user modeling methods mainly focus on improving the backbone encoder or learning task-specific user representations for a single prediction objective. We instead study how to export the multi-layer user states of a frozen long-history backbone as compact, timestamp-addressable representations for downstream training backfill and serving. In this setting, the user state at a given timestamp summarizes the user's actions before that time, so downstream systems need only the state aligned to each target timestamp rather than the full hidden-state timeline. To this end, we present \texttt{SeqFold}, a compressed-state interface that combines learned multi-channel fusion, channel-specific temporal decay, and Lookup-Free Quantization (LFQ) to produce compact discrete codes from frozen backbone states. Task-specific decoders then map these shared codes into flexible embedding spaces for downstream models. To make timestamp-addressable export practical at scale, we further develop a fused streaming implementation that updates the fusion recurrence after every action while materializing states only at target timestamps. On large-scale proprietary datasets, SeqFold reduces per-state representation storage by $3{,}400\times$ while preserving most of the downstream ranking performance of the uncompressed model, showing that SeqFold is an effective interface for reusing long-history sequence backbones in downstream models.

AI.tldr: SeqFold 将冻结长历史骨干网络的多层用户状态压缩为可按时戳寻址的离散码，存储减少 3400 倍且保留大部分排序性能。
AI.motivation: 现有序列用户建模多聚焦骨干编码器改进或面向单一预测任务学习用户表示，缺乏一种可复用、紧凑且能按时间戳对齐导出的用户状态接口，供下游训练回填与在线服务使用。
AI.method: 提出 SeqFold 压缩状态接口：对冻结骨干的多层状态做可学习多通道融合、通道特定时间衰减和 Lookup-Free Quantization（LFQ）生成紧凑离散码；任务特定解码器将共享码映射到灵活嵌入空间；并设计融合流式实现，每条行为后更新融合递推，仅在目标时间戳物化状态。
AI.result: 在大型专有数据集上，每状态表示存储降低 3400 倍，同时保留未压缩模型的大部分下游排序性能。
AI.conclusion: SeqFold 是一种有效接口，可让下游模型复用长历史序列骨干，实现可扩展的时戳寻址状态导出。

title: Spatial-Spectral Coupling as Attention: Scaling Shape Correspondence to High-Resolution Surfaces
summary: Establishing dense correspondence between high-resolution 3D shapes remains challenging due to the spatial--spectral coupling at the core of many functional-map methods, which grows quadratically with mesh resolution. We observe that this coupling is equivalent to a scaled dot-product attention formulation, with learned descriptors serving as queries and keys and spectral basis functions as values. This connection makes efficient attention implementations directly applicable to shape matching and an effective mechanism for scaling spatial-spectral coupling. We show that optimized quadratic attention implementations can scale modern deep functional map pipelines to large mesh sizes, improving both runtime and memory consumption, while sub-quadratic methods introduce errors, particularly for non-isometric shape pairs, where an exact coupling proves most necessary. These insights motivate \textit{Geo-FlashAttention}, which restricts the exact softmax to geometry-selected surface patches and achieves near-linear empirical scaling while preserving correspondence accuracy of exact implementations. Across six standard benchmarks and three functional-map pipelines, rigorous analysis shows that efficient couplings preserve correspondence accuracy. At $60k$ vertices, these insights reduce peak training memory from 106.08 to 5.67\,GiB, with Geo-FlashAttention being $1.5\times$ faster per training step than FlashAttention. This enables end-to-end learning for correspondence problems on large meshes such as cortical surfaces, where high resolution is required to preserve disease-relevant intricacies of the surface geometry. Project page available https://spatial-spectral-attention.github.io/

AI.tldr: 将功能映射中的空间-谱耦合等价为缩放点积注意力，提出Geo-FlashAttention对几何选定的表面块做精确softmax，实现近线性扩展，保持匹配精度的同时大幅降低内存并加速训练。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率3D形状间的稠密对应仍具挑战：功能映射方法核心的空间-谱耦合随网格分辨率二次增长，导致大网格上的时间与内存开销过高，难以端到端学习（如皮层表面）。
AI.method: 观察到空间-谱耦合等价于缩放点积注意力（学习到的描述子为query/key，谱基函数为value），从而可直接套用高效注意力实现；据此提出Geo-FlashAttention：将精确softmax限制在由几何选取的表面块上，实现近线性经验扩展；并与优化的二次注意力及次二次方法对比分析。
AI.result: 在6个标准基准、3个功能映射流水线上验证高效耦合保持匹配精度；60k顶点时峰值训练内存由106.08 GiB降至5.67 GiB；Geo-FlashAttention每训练步比FlashAttention快1.5倍；次二次方法（尤其非等距形状对）会引入误差，而精确耦合最为必要。
AI.conclusion: 空间-谱耦合的注意力视角为形状匹配提供了可扩展机制，Geo-FlashAttention在大网格上兼顾精度与效率，使皮层表面等需要高分辨率的对应问题可端到端学习。

title: Bootstrapped On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language models by distilling teacher predictions on student-generated trajectories, while on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) removes the need for an external teacher by using a reference-conditioned copy of the model as the teacher. Despite its great early improvements, we find that OPSD does not remain consistently effective under continued training and can eventually suffer substantial performance degradation. We study this training behavior and link the degradation to a growing mismatch between the evolving reference-free student and the frozen privileged teacher. In the early stage of OPSD, the privileged teacher remains closely aligned with the student and provides useful guidance for improving the student's generation trajectories. However, as training progresses, the growing distributional mismatch between the privileged teacher and reference-free student can cause the teacher to provide misleading supervision, ultimately degrading student performance. This phenomenon motivates us to first leverage privileged reference supervision to acquire useful knowledge and then transfer it to a fresh student. We introduce Bootstrapped On-Policy Distillation (BOPD), a two-stage framework that first uses OPSD to internalize task-relevant information from reference-conditioned supervision into an intermediate model, and then distills this reference-free intermediate model into a fresh copy of the initial model. Experiments across models show that BOPD improves mathematical reasoning and code generation beyond both the initial models and the constructed OPSD teachers. These results suggest that privileged reference supervision can be more effectively exploited by first transferring its task-relevant signal into a task-adapted model and then distilling from that model without reference conditioning.

AI.tldr: 本文发现on-policy self-distillation (OPSD)在持续训练下会因特权教师与无参考学生分布失配而性能退化，提出两阶段框架BOPD：先用OPSD把参考条件监督内化到中间模型，再将该模型蒸馏给初始模型的新副本，从而稳定提升数学推理与代码生成。
AI.motivation: OPSD无需外部教师即可获得早期显著提升，但持续训练后效果不稳定甚至大幅退化。作者将退化归因于不断演化的无参考学生与冻结的特权教师之间日益增大的分布失配，导致教师给出误导性监督。
AI.method: BOPD两阶段框架：第一阶段用OPSD将参考条件（privileged reference）监督中的任务相关信息内化到中间模型；第二阶段把该无参考的中间模型蒸馏到一个初始模型的全新副本中，避免直接依赖特权教师。
AI.result: 在多个模型上的实验显示，BOPD在数学推理和代码生成任务上均超过初始模型以及所构造的OPSD教师。
AI.conclusion: 特权参考监督更适合先转移到任务适配模型、再从该无参考条件模型蒸馏，而非直接长期使用OPSD；这能更有效利用参考监督信号。

title: Agentic AI Meets Formal Verification in the Era of Agentic Hardware Development
summary: As AI agents become increasingly capable of generating and optimizing hardware circuits, ensuring the correctness of AI-generated designs becomes more important. Meanwhile, advances in AI lower the barriers to developing and applying formal methods, creating new opportunities to automate and improve hardware verification. This invited paper presents an overview of the methodologies and applications of hardware formal methods in the AI era. First, we examine how agentic AI advances hardware formal methods across three levels: specification, proof construction, and reasoning engines. Second, we discuss how formal methods support reliable AI-driven hardware development through RTL generation, debugging, and correctness-preserving optimization. We review representative research alongside our recent contributions, highlighting key technical advances and insights from experimental results. Finally, we discuss future research opportunities toward proof-native hardware development, where formal reasoning could become an integral part of autonomous hardware design.

AI.tldr: 综述性论文，探讨AI时代硬件形式化方法的双向融合：AI代理如何改进形式化验证，形式化方法又如何保障AI驱动的硬件开发，并展望"证明原生"硬件设计。
AI.motivation: AI代理生成与优化硬件电路的能力增强，使设计正确性保障变得关键；同时AI降低了形式化方法的使用门槛，为硬件验证自动化创造新机遇。
AI.method: 受邀综述，构建双向框架：(1)从规约、证明构造、推理引擎三个层次分析代理式AI如何推进硬件形式化方法；(2)讨论形式化方法如何通过RTL生成、调试和保持正确性的优化来支撑可靠的AI驱动硬件开发，并回顾代表性研究与作者近期工作。
AI.result: 归纳了各环节的代表性研究与作者贡献，总结了关键技术进展及实验洞见（摘要未给出具体量化结果）。
AI.conclusion: 指出面向"证明原生硬件开发"的未来方向，即形式化推理成为自主硬件设计的内在组成部分。

title: The BRIDGE dataset: paired brightfield whole-slide images of prostate core-needle biopsies in paraffin, after deparaffinization and H&E staining
summary: Computational approaches are increasingly being explored to streamline histopathology workflows, including label-free methods that aim to reduce reliance on chemical staining. Among these, deep learning-based label-free virtual staining uses images of unstained tissue to computationally generate stained images. Despite growing interest, model development and validation remain constrained by the scarcity of paired, clinically annotated whole-slide imaging datasets. We present BRIDGE, a dataset of prostate core-needle biopsies collected at the Prof. Franciszek Lukaszczyk Oncology Centre in Bydgoszcz, Poland. The dataset comprises 869 glass slides from 169 patients, each digitized sequentially after sectioning, deparaffinization, and hematoxylin and eosin staining, yielding in total 2607 whole-slide images. The dataset supports the development and external validation of label-free virtual staining, virtual unstaining, image-registration and segmentation methods. Each slide is accompanied by a Gleason score, enabling downstream analyses of cancer classification and grading concordance. The stained images can be used independently for color normalization and cross-scanner robustness studies. All images are de-identified, distributed in their native scanner format and will be available through the BioImage Archive.

AI.tldr: BRIDGE 是波兰 Bydgoszcz 肿瘤中心采集的前列腺穿刺活检配对全切片数据集（169 名患者、869 张玻片、2607 张 WSI），支持无标记虚拟染色/去染色、配准、分割及 Gleason 分级研究。
AI.motivation: 深度学习无标记虚拟染色等计算病理方法受限于配对且具临床注释的全切片图像数据集稀缺，模型开发与外部验证困难。
AI.method: 采集前列腺穿刺活检玻片，在切片、脱蜡与 H&E 染色前后依次数字化，获得配对未染色/染色全切片图像；每张玻片附 Gleason 评分，图像去标识化并以原生扫描仪格式提供，通过 BioImage Archive 发布。
AI.result: 构建含 169 名患者、869 张玻片、共 2607 张全切片图像的数据集，支持无标记虚拟染色、虚拟去染色、图像配准与分割方法的开发及外部验证，并可用于癌症分类与分级一致性分析。
AI.conclusion: BRIDGE 为计算病理提供配对、带临床注释的公开基准数据集，染色图像亦可独立用于颜色归一化和跨扫描仪鲁棒性研究。

title: FedVP: Federated Learning across Heterogeneous Models by Pooling Locally Trained Verifiers
summary: Conventional federated learning relies on the shared model backbone to aggregate client updates, limiting collaboration among institutions that deploy large language models (LLMs) from different families and at different scales. We propose Federated Verifier Pool (FEDVP), a new federated learning paradigm that enables heterogeneous clients to collaborate through shared verification rather than parameter aggregation. Each client trains a verifier using local data and responses generated by its chosen LLM backbone. The server pools these independently trained verifiers and combines their judgments to select answers without merging model parameters. This allows both LLM backbones and verifiers to differ in architecture and size, while keeping the LLM backbones frozen and deriving collaborative gains from improved answer selection. We evaluate FEDVP across five public medical question-answering datasets treated as federated clients, using Qwen and LLaMA backbones ranging from 3B to 14B parameters. FEDVP consistently improves performance across all five clients and outperforms the strongest conventional federated baselines by 1.46-5.79 percentage points in mean accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FEDVP（联邦验证器池），一种不依赖参数聚合的异构联邦学习新范式：各客户端用本地数据训练验证器，服务器汇集验证器并以投票方式选择答案，从而让不同家族、不同规模的LLM骨干协作。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦学习依赖共享模型骨干来聚合客户端更新，导致部署不同家族、不同规模LLM的机构无法协作。论文希望在骨干架构与规模各异、且骨干保持冻结的条件下实现协作增益。
AI.method: 各客户端基于本地数据与其选定LLM骨干生成的回答训练一个验证器；服务器将独立训练的验证器汇聚成池，组合其判断来选择最终答案，而不合并任何模型参数。因此LLM骨干与验证器均可在架构和规模上不同，协作收益来自更优的答案选择。
AI.result: 在五个公开医学问答数据集（视为联邦客户端）上评估，骨干采用Qwen与LLaMA（3B至14B参数）。FEDVP在全部五个客户端上均稳定提升性能，平均准确率比最强传统联邦基线高1.46–5.79个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FEDVP表明异构LLM客户端可在不共享参数、不微调骨干的前提下通过验证器共享实现有效联邦协作，为跨机构LLM协作提供了新路径；当前验证限于医学QA任务与3B–14B规模模型。

title: AutoManifold: Agentic Design of Data Visualisation Algorithms via Manifold Embedding
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems). 37 pages, 5 figures. Code: https://github.com/buraksusam/AutoManifold_NeurIPS2026
summary: Manifold embedding for data visualisation is dominated by a small set of hand-designed state-of-the-art (SOTA) algorithms. Their design targets are fixed at development time, resulting in inflexible algorithmic behaviour that cannot be readily steered towards user-specified structural priorities. Hand-designing new embedding algorithms to address user priority requires highly specialised expertise and is time consuming. To address autonomous algorithm design tailored to user preference, we introduce an agentic algorithm generation pipeline AutoManifold. It composes new manifold embedding algorithms from a constrained vocabulary of affinity, cost, and optimisation primitives, supported by multi-agent large-language-model (LLM) orchestration. AutoManifold conditions every stage of its design on user-specified structural preservation preferences, and iteratively refines the algorithm configuration through an LLM-guided, metric-grounded iterative loop. We compare the generated algorithms against the three strongest and most frequently used SOTA methods (t-SNE, UMAP, and PaCMAP) on real-world datasets spanning different difficulty regimes under identical evaluation infrastructure. The results demonstrate that LLM-driven, priority-conditioned algorithm synthesis can move beyond hyperparameter tuning, producing genuinely new algorithms that outperform traditional hand-designed methods in their ability to steer towards user-specified properties without compromising the intrinsic structure in the original data. The code of AutoManifold is available at https://github.com/buraksusam/AutoManifold_NeurIPS2026.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoManifold，一个多智能体LLM驱动的流形嵌入算法自动生成流水线，可根据用户指定的结构保持偏好合成新算法。
AI.motivation: 现有SOTA流形嵌入算法（t-SNE、UMAP、PaCMAP）设计目标在开发时固定，行为不灵活，无法按用户结构优先级调节；手工设计新算法需高度专业知识和大量时间。
AI.method: AutoManifold在受约束的亲和度、代价与优化原语词汇表上组合新嵌入算法，由多智能体LLM编排；每个设计阶段都以用户结构保持偏好为条件，并通过LLM引导、指标驱动的迭代循环精化算法配置。
AI.result: 在与t-SNE、UMAP、PaCMAP相同评测设施下、覆盖不同难度真实数据集的对比中，生成算法在向用户指定属性引导方面优于传统手工方法，且不损害原始数据内在结构。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动、优先级条件化的算法合成可超越超参数调优，产生真正新颖的算法，实现面向用户偏好的流形嵌入自动设计。

title: Region-Wise Logit Fusion and Utility-Gated Refinement for Brain Metastasis Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the Brain Tumor Segmentation Challenge - Metastases (BraTS-METS), held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026
summary: BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1 evaluates segmentation of brain metastases and postoperative resection cavities on heterogeneous multiparametric MRI, requiring detection of small enhancing foci while preserving the geometry and hierarchy of enhancing tumor (ET), tumor core (TC), whole tumor (WT), and resection cavity (RC). We present COMPASS-METS (Component-Aware Multi-Trainer Probability Assembly with Structured Segmentation), which combines three five-fold nnU-Net configurations into aligned regional probability ensembles. A structured-probability anchor applies region-specific component decisions, TC boundary completion, RC filtering, and hierarchy-preserving conversion. Omitted ET candidates are recovered additively using learned component confidence and deterministic multi-trainer support for ET and its TC/WT parents; a final utility gate admits only disconnected candidates with sufficient lesion-existence and geometry-safety probabilities. On the reused 179-case challenge development cohort, COMPASS-METS (Team: MicroBT) achieved Small F1 0.354, lesion-wise DSC 0.712, NSD 0.714, All F1 0.779, and HD95 56.6 mm. Relative to ResEncXL, it improved DSC, NSD, and All F1 and reduced HD95, while Small F1 changed from 0.367 to 0.354. Stagewise analysis attributes the principal geometric gains to structured probability construction and shows that guarded ET refinement recovers most of the associated small-lesion detection loss. These 179-case results remain selection-aware development estimates. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/leonlou921/COMPASS-METS.

AI.tldr: COMPASS-METS 通过多训练器概率集成与结构化概率锚点，改进脑转移瘤与术后腔分割，在保持层级一致性的同时恢复小病灶检测。
AI.motivation: BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1 需在异质多参数 MRI 上同时检测微小强化灶并保持 ET/TC/WT/RC 的几何与层级关系，单一模型难以兼顾。
AI.method: 将三个五折 nnU-Net 配置集成为对齐的区域概率集成；结构化概率锚点执行区域决策、TC 边界补全、RC 过滤与保层级转换；用组件置信度与确定性多训练器支持加性恢复被遗漏 ET，并以效用门控仅接受足够独立的候选。
AI.result: 在 179 例开发集上：Small F1 0.354、病灶级 DSC 0.712、NSD 0.714、All F1 0.779、HD95 56.6mm；相较 ResEncXL 提升 DSC/NSD/All F1 并降低 HD95，Small F1 由 0.367 降至 0.354。分阶段分析显示几何收益主要来自结构化概率构建，门控 ET 精修挽回了大部分小病灶检测损失。
AI.conclusion: 方法在几何与层级指标上优于基线，小病灶检测略有代价但可大部分挽回；结果仍属存在选择偏差的开发集估计，需进一步验证。

title: TRUER: Test-Time Reward Correction Using an Error-Aware Rectifier for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning enables language models to adapt using rewards derived from their own answers. However, majority voting can reinforce incorrect solutions even when correct alternatives are available. Our training audit shows that false positives (incorrect responses receiving positive rewards) dominate reward errors. We focus on a practical regime where ground-truth rewards are difficult to obtain at scale, while a limited labeled source set is available. We introduce TRUER, a framework that uses limited supervision to train a reward rectifier that distinguishes correctness from consensus. To achieve this goal, we train the rectifier with an emphasis on incorrect majorities and correct minorities, targeting cases where consensus and correctness disagree. After that, we freeze the rectifier and use it to correct rewards during subsequent test-time adaptation. By improving reward accuracy and thereby model performance, TRUER consistently outperforms naive TTRL in both metrics across all evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: TRUER：用少量标注数据训练"奖励纠偏器"，纠正多数投票中的假阳性奖励，提升测试时强化学习效果。
AI.motivation: 测试时强化学习依赖自生成答案的奖励，但多数投票会把错误解也强化（假阳性占奖励错误主导），而大规模真值奖励难以获取。
AI.method: 在有限标注源集上训练奖励纠偏器，重点学习"错误多数/正确少数"这类共识与正确性冲突的样本；随后冻结该纠偏器，在后续测试时适配中用于纠正奖励。
AI.result: 纠正后奖励准确性提升，模型性能随之提升；在所有评测配置下，TRUER在两项指标上均稳定优于朴素TTRL。
AI.conclusion: 利用少量监督识别"共识≠正确"即可显著改善测试时奖励质量，是一种可行的TTRL改进方案。

title: Broad-Persistent Advising in Interactive Reinforcement Learning via Latent State Encoding
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, Accepted for oral presentation at the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA 2026)
summary: Deep Interactive Reinforcement Learning (Deep IntRL) accelerates reinforcement learning training by incorporating external advice. However, conventional Deep IntRL uses each piece of advice only in the current step and discards it after a single interaction. Persistent Advising and Broad-Persistent Advising (BPA) extend this process by storing advice in persistent memory and reusing it in similar states through state generalisation based on K-means clustering. This research proposes Encoder BPA, which employs a latent encoder to retrieve and reuse advice. In this framework, a trained encoder is used to map a state sequence into a latent representation at every time step. Advice can be retrieved through latent comparison, together with a top-(k) aggregation and a consistency condition to improve reuse stability. Experimental results show that Encoder BPA improves learning efficiency and advice utilisation at an early stage of training compared with different Deep IntRL approaches, especially in complex and partially observable environments.

AI.tldr: 提出 Encoder BPA，用潜在编码器+top-k 聚合+一致性条件实现持久化建议的检索与复用，提升深度交互式强化学习早期训练效率与建议利用率。
AI.motivation: 传统 Deep IntRL 只在当前步使用建议、交互一次即丢弃，信息浪费严重；BPA 虽用持久记忆和 K-means 聚类做状态泛化复用，但聚类泛化能力有限，难以在复杂、部分可观测环境中稳定复用建议。
AI.method: 训练一个编码器，在每个时间步将状态序列映射为潜在表示；通过潜在空间比较检索建议，并引入 top-k 聚合与一致性条件以提升复用稳定性，替代原有基于 K-means 聚类的状态泛化机制。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比多种 Deep IntRL 方法，Encoder BPA 在训练早期提升了学习效率与建议利用率，在复杂及部分可观测环境中效果尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 以学习到的潜在表示替代聚类泛化，是提升持久化建议复用质量的有效途径，尤其适用于复杂、部分可观测任务；未来可进一步优化编码器训练与检索机制。

title: DroneSegEdit: Adapting Pretrained Generative Editors for UAV Segmentation with Language-Grounded Verification
summary: Recent work has shown that pretrained image generators can support diverse visual tasks. Yet directly applying them to language-guided unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) segmentation exposes a key limitation: a plausible mask may correspond to the wrong instance among small and repeated objects. We call this mismatch between mask rendering and expression-level target selection the Grounding-Rendering Gap. We present DroneSegEdit, which combines RGB proposal rendering with language-grounded, proposal-constrained verification to select supported foreground while retaining rendered geometry. DroneSegEdit adapts the open-weight LongCat-Image-Edit model using task-specific LoRA and fixed color-to-label decoding. For referring segmentation, a Language-Grounded Spatial Verifier (LGSV) reads hierarchical states from the frozen multimodal large language model backbone to derive expression-conditioned spatial evidence, which is mapped back to the rendered proposal without introducing foreground outside it. On RIS-LAD, DroneSegEdit reaches a new state of the art at 52.78 mIoU, 7.16 points above the previous best. It remains competitive overall on UAVid-RIS and VDD-RIS, with its clearest class-wise gains on compact, application-relevant categories, notably vehicles and humans. A separate verifier-free experiment extends the RGB interface to full-scene parsing: a task-specific adapter jointly renders all classes from one task-level instruction without enumerating class names or palette colors.

AI.tldr: 提出DroneSegEdit，将语言引导的无人机分割重构为"渲染+接地验证"，缩小Grounding-Rendering Gap，在RIS-LAD上达52.78 mIoU（SOTA）。
AI.motivation: 预训练图像生成器直接用于语言引导UAV分割时，虽能生成看似合理的掩码，却可能在小而重复的目标中选错实例，即"掩码渲染"与"表达式级目标选择"之间的不匹配（Grounding-Rendering Gap）。
AI.method: 基于LongCat-Image-Edit模型，使用任务专用LoRA与固定颜色到标签解码做RGB候选渲染；再用Language-Grounded Spatial Verifier（LGSV）从冻结的多模态大模型骨干读取分层状态，生成表达式条件化的空间证据，并映射回渲染候选，不引入候选外的前景。另有免验证器的全场景解析实验：用任务级适配器由单条任务指令联合渲染所有类别，无需枚举类名或调色板颜色。
AI.result: RIS-LAD上达52.78 mIoU，比此前最佳高7.16点；在UAVid-RIS与VDD-RIS上整体具竞争力，车辆、行人等紧凑且应用相关类别增益最明显。
AI.conclusion: 以"渲染-验证"解耦框架可有效弥合接地-渲染差距，并可扩展到全场景解析。

title: Weighted-AoI-Driven UAV Trajectory and Reporting for Dynamic CKM Tracking
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, submitted to the WCNC conference
summary: Existing channel knowledge map (CKM) construction assumes quasi-static environments, failing when channels rapidly decorrelate. This paper investigates continuous online dynamic CKM tracking over an airborne 2D plane via a UAV fleet. We formulate a long-term error minimization problem under UAV mobility and reporting constraints. This problem, however, is intractable with unobservable errors for unmeasured cells. To tackle this, we propose a metric-driven scheduling approach featuring the Weighted-Age of Information (W-AoI). W-AoI evaluates cells by combining exact temporal staleness with spatial uncertainty predicted by a 2D U-Net. We prove that top-$K$ W-AoI selection maximizes the one-slot error reduction bound. Guided by this guarantee, we develop a lightweight greedy trajectory policy incorporating continuous along-path sensing. Simulations demonstrate our method reduces steady-state error by 3.8 dB$^2$ and 4.8 dB$^2$ over AoI-only and FIFO baselines, closely approaching an idealized oracle.

AI.tldr: 提出基于加权信息年龄（W-AoI）的无人机集群在线动态信道知识地图（CKM）跟踪调度方法，用2D U-Net预测空间不确定性并结合时间陈旧度，选取Top-K单元以最大化单步误差下降上界，并设计轻量贪心轨迹策略。
AI.motivation: 现有CKM构建假设准静态环境，在信道快速去相关时失效；且未测量单元误差不可观测，长期误差最小化问题难以求解。
AI.method: 在无人机移动与上报约束下建立长期误差最小化问题；提出W-AoI指标，融合精确时间陈旧度与2D U-Net预测的空间不确定性；证明Top-K W-AoI选择可最大化单步误差下降上界；据此设计含连续沿路径感知的轻量贪心轨迹策略。
AI.result: 仿真中稳态误差较仅AoI与FIFO基线分别降低3.8 dB²和4.8 dB²，接近理想oracle性能。
AI.conclusion: W-AoI驱动的调度与贪心轨迹策略能有效实现机载2D平面上连续在线的动态CKM跟踪。
