Shrinkage linear discriminant analysis was evaluated with nested validation in which complete trials were held out from class balancing, hyperparameter selection, and fitting. Both conditions evoked a parietal target-related positivity. The decoded cell was correct in 18 of 48 held-out trials, against 1.9 expected by chance (binomial p < 1e-12), and in three participants individually. Cue format made no detectable difference: complete-target accuracy was 9/24 in both conditions (paired difference 0.0 percentage points, 95% CI [-37, 37]), and held-out AUC was 0.609 for spheres and 0.585 for object cues. Disappearing-stimulus MR P300 selection is therefore feasible under strict trial-level evaluation, but the benefit of object identity, if any, is too small to resolve in a pilot of this size.

AI.tldr: 在头显MR环境中，即使目标线索在闪烁间消失，P300接口仍可严格地在试次级实现目标选择；但为线索赋予稳定的颜色-形状身份相比统一球体并无可检测的增益。
AI.motivation: MR P300接口可直接在用户周围注册可选目标（如轮椅目的地），但线索在闪烁间消失时用户须在无视觉提示下记住目标。作者欲验证此类"消失刺激"范式能否支持目标选择，并考察给每个线索赋予稳定颜色-形状身份能否优于视觉统一的球体线索。
AI.method: 6名健康成人，在头戴MR显示器上完成5x5行/列任务，每种线索条件各4个trial；采集Fz、Cz、Pz三导EEG。采用收缩LDA，并以嵌套验证评估：整trial从类别平衡、超参数选择与拟合中留出。比较"统一球体"与"颜色-形状物体线索"两种条件。
AI.result: 两种条件均诱发顶区目标相关正波。48个留出trial中解码正确的格子为18个，随机期望仅1.9（二项检验p<1e-12），且3名被试单独亦显著。线索格式无可检测差异：完整目标准确率两条件均为9/24（配对差0.0个百分点，95%CI[-37,37]），留出AUC球体0.609、物体线索0.585。
AI.conclusion: 消失刺激的MR P300选择在严格试次级评估下可行；但物体身份带来的收益（若有）过小，在此规模试点中无法分辨，需更大样本进一步验证。

title: Joint Quantization and Dynamic Partitioning for Context-Aware Edge Vision Transformers
summary: Deploying vision transformer models across connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) requires joint management of computation and Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication. Static split-inference methods use fixed partition points and cannot adapt to time-varying link bandwidth, processing load, and concurrent multi-stream traffic. This paper proposes an edge orchestration framework that jointly selects model partition points, per-layer quantization bitwidths, and execution placement across heterogeneous vehicular compute nodes. The joint partitioning and mixed-precision allocation problem is formulated as a Mixed-Integer Linear Program (MILP) that minimizes compute and communication energy subject to end-to-end latency and task-quality constraints. The framework is evaluated on Jetson Orin Nano (8~GB), Jetson Orin NX (16~GB), and Jetson AGX Orin (32~GB) nodes using OPV2V-driven multi-stream workloads with $K \in \{2,4,6,8\}$. Across the evaluated configurations, the proposed formulation reduces V2V communication energy by $33.3$--$36.0\%$ relative to a Uniform INT8 split. At $K=8$, end-to-end task completion latency is reduced by $34.0\%$ on the Orin Nano and $33.1\%$ on the Orin NX relative to the same baseline, while limiting the reduction in 3D detection accuracy to $3.1$--$4.1$ percentage points in $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ relative to FP16 execution.

AI.tldr: 提出面向车联网(V2V)场景的边缘编排框架，联合优化ViT模型分割点、逐层量化位宽与执行放置，以MILP最小化计算与通信能耗，在Jetson平台上实现通信能耗降低33.3–36.0%及端到端时延降低约33–34%。
AI.motivation: 静态分割推理使用固定划分点，无法适应时变链路带宽、处理负载与多流并发流量，导致车联网中ViT部署的能耗与时延效率不足。
AI.method: 构建边缘编排框架，联合选择模型分割点、逐层量化位宽和异构车载计算节点上的执行放置；将该联合分割与混合精度分配问题建模为混合整数线性规划(MILP)，在端到端时延与任务质量约束下最小化计算与通信能耗。在Jetson Orin Nano/NX/AGX Orin上用OPV2V多流负载(K=2,4,6,8)评测。
AI.result: 相比Uniform INT8分割基线，V2V通信能耗降低33.3–36.0%；K=8时端到端完成时延在Orin Nano降低34.0%、Orin NX降低33.1%；相对FP16，3D检测mAP50精度仅下降3.1–4.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 动态联合分割、混合精度量化与放置可有效提升车联网ViT推理的能效与时延，且精度损失可控，验证了MILP编排方法在异构车载节点上的可行性。

title: HiPFuse: Real-Time LiDAR Semantic Segmentation for Robotic Perception on Edge Devices
summary: Real-time robotic perception requires accurate LiDAR semantics under limited resources. Bird's-eye-view (BEV) aggregation is efficient but can mix differently labeled surfaces in columns. We present HiPFuse, a point-BEV fusion framework that exchanges point and height-partitioned BEV features across horizontal scales, combining point-wise detail with 2D spatial context from one LiDAR scan. Fixed height assignments preserve separate vertical aggregation groups, with auxiliary supervision of initial BEV features using targets from the same 3D cells. A dual-scale BEV context module adds broader context from a coarser grid. On SemanticKITTI and MCD, HiPFuse achieves 63.7% and 62.5% mIoU at 14.2 and 22.4 FPS on Jetson AGX Orin, respectively, exceeding the 10 Hz scan rate. Separate training and evaluation show indoor applicability. Replacing only the baseline semantic front end with HiPFuse in fixed robotic systems reduces odometry absolute trajectory error RMSE by 10.6% on average across two outdoor sequences and increases accepted-loop recall by 8.7 percentage points on SemanticKITTI. Qualitative semantic maps show more continuous road labeling. Our code is available at https://github.com/haiyang2022/HiPFuse.

AI.tldr: 提出HiPFuse点-BEV融合框架，通过跨水平尺度的点与高度分层BEV特征交换，实现受限资源下的实时精确LiDAR语义分割。
AI.motivation: 实时机器人感知需在资源受限下获得准确LiDAR语义。BEV聚合高效，但同一柱中不同标签表面会被混合，导致语义混淆。
AI.method: 以固定高度划分保留独立垂直聚合组，并用同一3D单元目标对初始BEV特征做辅助监督；点特征与高度分层BEV特征跨水平尺度交换，融合点级细节与2D空间上下文；双尺度BEV上下文模块用更粗网格补充全局上下文。
AI.result: SemanticKITTI与MCD上分别达63.7%、62.5% mIoU，Jetson AGX Orin上14.2/22.4 FPS，超过10Hz扫描率；仅替换基线语义前端，两个室外序列里程计ATE RMSE平均降10.6%，SemanticKITTI接受回环召回提升8.7个百分点；室外/室内可分别训练评估。
AI.conclusion: HiPFuse在高效BEV聚合基础上缓解垂直混淆，兼顾精度与实时性，并可直接提升下游里程计与回环检测性能。

title: Breakdown of Autoregressive Multi-Step Reasoning Under Concentrated vs. Diffuse Attention Head Dropout
summary: During extended wakefulness, mammalian neocortical networks experience localized periods of transient neuronal silence termed off-states. Here, we examine how analogous spatiotemporally concentrated disruptions affect sequential reasoning in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs). Evaluating 250 paired derivations on the GSM8K benchmark across two 8B models (Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct), we contrast clustered bursts of attention head masking against budget-matched diffuse i.i.d. dropout. Concentrated bursts induce substantial reasoning degradation: at onset parameter $\mathcal{B}=0.10$ (scheduling $\sim 5.7\%$ of vulnerable head-token volume), Qwen3-8B accuracy drops from $91.2\%$ under diffuse noise to $78.8\%$ under burst dropout ($Δ= -12.4$ percentage points [pp], exact McNemar $p = 5.5 \times 10^{-6}$), while LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct drops from $84.0\%$ to $76.8\%$ ($Δ= -7.2$ pp, $p = 0.0198$). Conversely, dispersing the identical cumulative budget uniformly across generation steps via stratified quintile matching yields substantially milder degradation (retaining $91.2\%$ in Qwen and $84.0\%$ in LLaMA). In an exploratory factorial dissociation ($N=100$), single-step dropout density is associated with an acute drop in a single schedule draw ($-10.0$ pp on Qwen, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.0425$), while multi-token continuity exhibits an inconclusive compounding trend ($-7.0$ pp, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.1892$). Error analysis reveals that Qwen failures reflect derivation errors within formatted responses (conditional accuracy drop of $-11.4$ pp), whereas in LLaMA $22.2\%$ of discordant losses lack a final answer format line (conditional gap narrows to $-5.0$ pp). These findings demonstrate that autoregressive reasoning chains are particularly vulnerable to concentrated structural disruptions, providing empirical benchmarks for fault tolerance in transformer architectures.

AI.tldr: 研究模拟神经"off-state"式局部扰动，发现在同等扰动预算下，集中爆发的注意力头屏蔽比弥散随机dropout更严重地破坏LLM的多步推理，说明自回归推理链对"时空集中"的结构性故障特别脆弱。
AI.motivation: 生物神经皮层在长时间清醒时会出现局部、短暂的"off-state"（神经元静默）。作者想探究类似的时空集中式扰动如何影响自回归大模型的多步推理，并区分"集中"与"均匀"故障源的差别。
AI.method: 在GSM8K上用250对配对推导，测试Qwen3-8B与LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct两个8B模型。对比预算匹配的两种干扰：注意力头屏蔽的集中爆发 vs. 弥散i.i.d. dropout；另用分层五分位匹配把累计预算均匀分散到各生成步。还做了探索性因子实验（N=100），分离单步扰动强度与多token连续性两种因素，并做误差分析。
AI.result: 爆发扰动（B=0.10，约5.7%脆弱头-词元体积）使Qwen从91.2%降至78.8%（Δ=−12.4pp，McNemar p=5.5e-6），LLaMA从84.0%降至76.8%（Δ=−7.2pp，p=0.0198）。相同累计预算均匀分散则几乎无损（Qwen保持91.2%，LLaMA保持84.0%）。因子实验中单步密度导致急性下降（Qwen −10.0pp，p_holm=0.0425），多token连续性呈不显著复合趋势（−7.0pp，p_holm=0.1892）。Qwen失败多为格式内推导错误（条件准确率下降−11.4pp），而LLaMA有22.2%的失配样本缺失最终答案格式行（条件差距缩至−5.0pp）。
AI.conclusion: 自回归推理链对集中的结构性扰动高度脆弱，而同等总量但均匀分布的扰动耐受性强；这为Transformer架构容错设计提供了实证基准，也提示类神经off-state的集中故障是LLM可靠性的关键风险。

title: Learning from First Discrepancies with Joint Reset and Pilot Guarantees
summary: A run that stops at its first wrong decision shows the queries and their correct labels up to and including that decision, and nothing after it. We study how many such runs are needed for learning. Each run tests a hypothesis, the pilot, chosen beforehand from a fixed binary class of VC dimension at most $d$, on a fresh record of at most $D$ queries drawn from one unknown distribution that does not depend on the pilot. The terminal information of a record is shown only if the pilot makes no discrepancy, and a bounded loss, fixed in advance, is attached to the position where a hypothesis stops. If the discrepancy probabilities of members of the class have infimum at most $f$ and their risks have infimum at most $r$, one learner uses $\widetilde O((d+1)[D(f+\varepsilon)+r]/\varepsilon^2)$ runs and $\widetilde O(D(1+f/\varepsilon))$ distinct pilots on every history. It returns a member of the class and an interval of width at most $\varepsilon$ containing, with probability at least $1-δ$, both the output's risk and the optimal risk. We also treat unknown ceilings and expected costs. Lower bounds for finite classes show that each order is necessary in the worst case, possibly on different instances, at positive dimension, small accuracy and fixed confidence. The learner enumerates label patterns of the class on displayed queries, possibly in exponential time; the results, under standard measurability conditions, concern statistical resources only. The proof combines a gain computable from stopped displays, exponential weights, a sparse depth-robust graph and a harmonic-mean bound.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"首次错误决策即终止"的查询运行（run）在主动学习中的统计资源需求：每个run用预先固定的pilot假设在独立同分布查询记录上测试，仅在pilot无差异时展示终止信息，并附有界损失。作者给出达到ε精度、1-δ置信的学习器，其run数与pilot数分别具有 Õ((d+1)[D(f+ε)+r]/ε²) 与 Õ(D(1+f/ε)) 的量级，并证明该阶数在有限类下是必要的。
AI.motivation: 经典主动学习模型允许学习器自适应选择查询，而这里考虑的是更受限也更现实的设定：运行在第一个错误决策处停止，之后信息全部丢失，且pilot须事先固定、查询来自与pilot无关的未知分布。作者想厘清在这种"停止式"信息访问模型下，学习需要多少次运行、多少个不同pilot，并刻画其最优阶。
AI.method: 学习器枚举类在展示查询上的标签模式；对pilot使用指数权重法，配合一个可稀疏、深度鲁棒的图来组织查询结构，并利用调和平均界进行风险估计。算法返回类中一个成员及宽度≤ε的区间，以≥1-δ概率同时覆盖输出风险与最优风险；另处理未知上界与期望代价情形。
AI.result: 给出run数 Õ((d+1)[D(f+ε)+r]/ε²) 与不同pilot数 Õ(D(1+f/ε)) 的上界，且在每个历史上均成立；有限类的下界表明各阶在正维数、小精度、固定置信下于最坏情形（可能在不同实例上）是必要的。
AI.conclusion: 在停止式查询访问模型下，论文精确刻画了学习所需的运行数与pilot数的统计阶数，证明其必要性，并在标准可测性条件下仅讨论统计资源（算法可指数时间）。该工作为受限信息获取下的主动学习提供了紧的资源刻画。

title: Few-Step Streaming Video Generation via Condition Shifting
summary: Few-step sampling reduces the cost of streaming video generation. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) supervises few-step generators with a separate fake-score network, which adds training memory and computation and must track the evolving generator. We extend APEX to streaming video by using condition shifting to estimate the velocity field of the generated distribution within the generator. The original text condition selects generation, while a shifted condition selects fake estimation using the same parameters. This removes the independent fake network while retaining S2-Avatar's frozen reference teacher, Self-Replay Forcing, and perceptual regularization. We evaluate APEX on 180-second videos using three backbone evaluations per block and a one-step spatial Refiner, with a 70-case human study and a 320-case StreamAV-Bench comparison. Compared with S2-Avatar, APEX achieves higher video instruction fulfillment on the Progressive track (3.856 versus 3.831) and higher visual aesthetics across both tracks (0.641898 versus 0.632606). Human raters favor APEX most strongly on instruction following, with +30.0% net preference, followed by consistency and video quality at +4.3% each. Motion quality favors S2-Avatar, audiovisual synchronization is predominantly tied, and usability is unchanged. Separate measurements under matched training settings show 4.4% lower peak allocated GPU memory per GPU and 9.2% shorter mean iteration time than DMD.

AI.tldr: APEX 将条件偏移引入流式视频生成，在生成器内部估计生成分布的速度场，从而去掉 DMD 的独立 fake-score 网络，实现少步流式视频采样并降低显存与计算开销。
AI.motivation: 少步采样可降低流式视频生成成本，但 DMD 需要额外的 fake-score 网络，既增加训练显存和计算，又必须持续跟踪演化的生成器；因此在流式视频场景下亟需去除该独立网络。
AI.method: 用条件偏移（condition shifting）在生成器内部估计生成分布的速度场：原始文本条件用于选择生成，偏移条件以同一套参数用于 fake 估计，从而消除独立 fake 网络，同时保留 S2-Avatar 的冻结参考教师、Self-Replay Forcing 与感知正则化。评测在 180 秒视频上进行，每 block 使用三次骨干评估和一个单步空间 Refiner。
AI.result: 相比 S2-Avatar，Progressive 赛道指令遵循更高（3.856 vs 3.831），两赛道视觉美感更高（0.641898 vs 0.632606）；70 例人类研究中指令遵循净偏好 +30.0%，一致性与视频质量各 +4.3%，运动质量略逊、音画同步基本持平、可用性不变。匹配训练设置下，每 GPU 峰值分配显存低 4.4%，平均迭代时间短 9.2%。
AI.conclusion: 条件偏移可在不牺牲教师蒸馏与正则化框架的前提下替代 DMD 的独立 fake 网络，在提升指令遵循与美感的同时显著降低训练开销；运动质量仍是待改进项。

title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making
summary: System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses. Recent evaluations cover diverse tasks but often rely on existing benchmarks, where prior exposure to test material can obscure generalization. Moreover, real-world decision making often involves long contexts, large option spaces, and complex logical dependencies, challenges that existing benchmarks do not adequately capture together. Thus, we introduce MMDM (Massive Multitask Decision Making), a benchmark of 5,448 high-quality questions across 16 task categories, combining newly constructed tasks with source-grounded recompositions and rewrites for single-select, multi-select, and soft-label decision making in fresh contexts. It covers realistic scenarios such as agent state tracking, tool and skill selection, preference judgments, and rubric scoring, with option spaces ranging from 2 to 1,024 and inputs extending to 64,817 tokens. With MMDM, we conduct a comprehensive quantitative evaluation of 28 decision models, showing that many perform well on common knowledge yet struggle with interdependent options, constrained decisions, and multi-select tasks. For example, Perplexity Decider-V1.2 reaches 78.75% Hard Single-select Accuracy on world knowledge, but only 53.95% on option logic and 47.95% on constraint planning, while the best Hard Multi-select Accuracy across all models is 36.81%. These results highlight joint reasoning, constraint-aware selection, and complete multi-select recovery as key priorities for decision model development, with MMDM providing a testbed for measuring this progress.

AI.tldr: 提出MMDM基准（5,448题，16类任务，选项2–1024、输入达64,817 tokens），评测28个决策模型，揭示其在依赖选项、约束决策和多选任务上的显著短板。
AI.motivation: System-1决策模型直接在单次前向中做结构化概率决策，但现有评测多依赖已有基准，模型可能已见过测试材料，难以反映真实泛化；且真实决策常涉及长上下文、大选项空间与复杂逻辑依赖，现有基准未同时覆盖这些挑战。
AI.method: 构建MMDM基准：含16个任务类别、5,448道高质量题，融合新构建任务与基于来源的重组/改写，覆盖单选、多选、软标签决策，涵盖agent状态跟踪、工具与技能选择、偏好判断、评分标准打分等场景；选项空间2–1024，输入长度至64,817 tokens；对28个决策模型进行系统量化评测。
AI.result: 模型在常识类任务表现良好，但在相互依赖选项、约束决策与多选任务上明显吃力：Perplexity Decider-V1.2在世界知识上Hard单选准确率78.75%，选项逻辑仅53.95%，约束规划47.95%；所有模型中最优Hard多选准确率仅36.81%。
AI.conclusion: 联合推理、约束感知选择与多选完整恢复是决策模型发展的关键优先方向，MMDM为衡量此类进展提供了测试平台。

title: Dual-Core Tensor Wheel Decomposition with Structure-Cached Acceleration for Tensor Recovery
summary: Tensor wheel decomposition captures complex correlations in high-dimensional data through interactions between outer-ring factors and a high-order central core. However, updating these components requires the explicit construction and manipulation of large-scale matrices, which limits computational efficiency and incurs particularly high computational and memory costs for the central-core update. To address these limitations, we propose dual-core tensor wheel decomposition (DCTW), which factorizes the central core into two lower-order cores linked by a shared latent bond. Each core is coupled to a different group of outer-ring factors. We further propose a structure-cached acceleration strategy that avoids explicit large-scale matrix multi- plications and caches intermediate tensors generated during tensor network contractions for reuse across block updates. This reuse reduces redundant computation and avoids the explicit construction of large matrices. Complexity analysis and experiments show that the strategy based on structural caching accelerates optimization compared with explicit and implicit up- date schemes while limiting the increase in peak memory as the ranks grow. Experiments on color video completion and robust denoising show that DCTW matches or outperforms representative tensor network methods in reconstruction quality, computational efficiency, and scalability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双核张量轮分解（DCTW），将张量轮的中心核分解为由共享潜键连接的两个低阶核，并结合结构缓存加速策略，实现高效、低内存的大规模张量分解。
AI.motivation: 张量轮分解虽能刻画高维数据的复杂关联，但更新外环因子与高阶中心核需显式构建并操作大规模矩阵，计算与内存开销高，中心核更新尤其昂贵。
AI.method: 1) DCTW：将中心核分解为两个低阶核，通过共享潜键连接，每个核耦合不同的外环因子组；2) 结构缓存加速策略：避免显式大规模矩阵乘法，缓存张量网络收缩产生的中间张量并在块更新间复用，减少冗余计算。
AI.result: 复杂度分析与实验表明，基于结构缓存的策略相比显式与隐式更新方案优化更快，且秩增大时峰值内存增长受限；在彩色视频补全与鲁棒去噪实验中，DCTW在重建质量、计算效率和可扩展性上媲美或优于代表性张量网络方法。
AI.conclusion: DCTW通过双核结构与结构缓存加速，有效缓解了张量轮分解在大规模矩阵操作上的计算与内存瓶颈，在保证重建质量的同时提升了效率与可扩展性。

title: Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing
summary: Self-interested intelligent agents that negotiate with humans should interpret nonverbal expressions and adapt their behavior accordingly. However, generic facial-affect models degrade across individuals and contexts, creating a generalization gap. We introduce an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that incorporates Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition (CLIFER) to personalize valence-arousal perception in real time. Differential feedback converts changes in valence-arousal direction and intensity into adjustments of the agent's target utility. An asynchronous architecture updates CLIFER in the background during live interaction. In a counterbalanced within-subject study in which 66 participants negotiated with a humanoid robot, the CL-enabled agent achieved significantly higher individual utility and elicited higher participant concession rates than the FaceChannel baseline. The CL condition yielded significantly higher mean arousal estimates, alongside a broader output range. Participant utility and Nash distance did not change significantly between conditions. These outcomes support the practical value of coupling continual affective personalization with differential feedback for real-time negotiation.

AI.tldr: 将面部表情识别的持续学习（CLIFER）与差分反馈结合，实现谈判智能体的实时情感个性化，提升个体效用与对方让步率。
AI.motivation: 自利智能体与人类谈判时需理解非语言表情并调整行为，但通用面部情感模型在个体与情境间泛化性差，存在泛化鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出情感自适应谈判策略：用CLIFER在真实交互中实时个性化效价-唤醒感知；差分反馈把效价-唤醒的方向与强度变化转化为智能体目标效用调整；并采用异步架构在后台在线更新模型。66名被试与人形机器人进行平衡化被试内实验，与FaceChannel基线对比。
AI.result: CL智能体个体效用显著更高，被试让步率更高；CL条件平均唤醒估计更高、输出范围更宽；被试效用与Nash距离无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 将持续情感个性化与差分反馈结合对实时谈判具有实用价值。

title: CURRENT: A Recurrent Neural Network for Concurrent Spatial and Temporal Super-Resolution of 4D Flow MRI
summary:
Objective: To improve the spatial and temporal resolution of aortic 4D flow MRI through a unified deep learning framework for post-acquisition super-resolution (SR) of reconstructed velocity vector fields.
  Methods: We propose CURRENT, a recurrent neural network that performs spatial and temporal SR with a single network architecture. Supervised training was conducted using paired low- and high-resolution datasets generated by embedding computational fluid dynamics simulations of aortic flow into in vivo thoracic MRI backgrounds, followed by controlled spatial and temporal downsampling. CURRENT was evaluated for two-fold spatial and temporal SR against 4DFlowNet and for two-fold spatiotemporal SR against sequential spatial and temporal SR pipelines based on 4DFlowNet. Image-based and k-space-based quantitative metrics were considered and conventional interpolation were used as baselines. In addition, the impact of CURRENT's spatiotemporal SR on physics-informed relative pressure estimation was assessed. Finally, the ability of CURRENT to generalize from synthetic training data to in vivo acquisitions was investigated.
  Results: CURRENT achieved superior spatial SR performance and comparable temporal SR performance to dedicated 4DFlowNet models while providing a unified solution for both tasks. Simultaneous spatiotemporal SR using CURRENT yielded more accurate relative pressure estimates than either spatial or temporal SR alone and outperformed sequential 4DFlowNet-based spatial and temporal SR approaches. Furthermore, the proposed model demonstrated promising generalization to in vivo 4D flow MRI data despite being trained exclusively on synthetic datasets.
  Conclusion: CURRENT provides a unified framework for spatial and temporal SR of 4D flow MRI. The proposed approach has the potential to enhance physics-based analysis and broaden the applicability of accelerated 4D flow MRI.

AI.tldr: 提出统一循环神经网络CURRENT，对重建后的主动脉4D flow MRI速度矢量场做时空超分辨率，单一网络同时提升空间与时间分辨率，并在相对压差估计与体内数据泛化上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 主动脉4D flow MRI存在空间与时间分辨率不足的问题，限制了解剖细节呈现和基于物理的分析（如相对压差估计）。现有方法多分别处理空间或时间超分，缺乏统一框架，且序贯处理会累积误差。
AI.method: 提出CURRENT——基于循环神经网络（RNN）的单一架构，实现空间与时间的联合超分辨率。用CFD主动脉流仿真嵌入体内胸部MRI背景，再经可控空间/时间下采样生成配对高/低分辨率数据做监督训练。评估设置：与4DFlowNet对比两倍空间、两倍时间超分；与基于4DFlowNet的序贯时空超分流程对比两倍时空超分；以传统插值为基线，采用图像域与k空间域指标；并考察对物理驱动相对压差估计的影响及从合成数据到体内采集的泛化能力。
AI.result: 空间超分优于4DFlowNet，时间超分与之相当，且一个统一模型兼顾两项任务；联合时空超分得到的相对压差估计比单独空间或时间超分更准确，并优于序贯4DFlowNet方案；仅用合成数据训练，仍对体内4D flow MRI数据展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CURRENT为4D flow MRI的空间与时间超分提供了统一框架，有望增强基于物理的分析并拓展加速4D flow MRI的适用范围。

title: REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a draft model propose multiple tokens for the target model to verify in one pass. The speedup is governed by the expected acceptance length (EAL), yet standard training objectives such as cross-entropy, KL divergence, and total variation focus only on distribution matching or single-step overlap. Recent studies instead propose block-level training objectives, aiming to optimize EAL directly. However, these objectives remain surrogates rather than exact formulations of EAL. For example, some average later acceptance over target-distributed continuations rather than the verification branches selected by accepted tokens, introducing a covariance gap that can reverse the gradient direction. We analyze this gap and derive REAL, a real EAL training loss that uses path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction. In a controlled loss-level comparison with a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and a Domino drafter, REAL outperforms WTV, VSD, DBLast, and the static LK baseline on probabilistic serving acceptance length across 9 task subsets and 5 evaluation seeds. These gains require only a change to the training loss, with no modification to the drafter architecture or inference procedure, demonstrating the practicality of real EAL training. A reference implementation of the REAL loss is available at https://github.com/King-ty/speculators/tree/real-loss.

AI.tldr: 本文针对推测解码中的草稿模型训练，指出现有块级目标只是期望接受长度(EAL)的近似代理，并提出精确的REAL损失（路径权重无偏估计+Rao-Blackwell化降方差），仅改训练损失即在9个子集、5个随机种子上优于WTV、VSD、DBLast与静态LK。
AI.motivation: 推测解码的加速比由期望接受长度(EAL)决定，但交叉熵、KL、总变差等标准训练目标只关注分布匹配或单步重叠；近期的块级目标虽想直接优化EAL，却仍是替代目标——例如把后续接受率在目标分布续写上的平均，而非在已接受token所选出的验证分支上平均，由此引入协方差偏差，甚至可能反转梯度方向。
AI.method: 先分析上述协方差偏差的来源，进而推导REAL：一个真实的EAL训练损失，采用路径权重(path weights)实现无偏估计，并用Rao-Blackwell化降低方差；只需替换训练损失，不改动草稿模型结构与推理流程。
AI.result: 在受控的损失级对比实验中（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B作为目标模型、Domino作为草稿模型），REAL在9个任务子集、5个评估种子上，其概率化服务接受长度均优于WTV、VSD、DBLast与静态LK基线。
AI.conclusion: 精确建模EAL的训练目标可行且实用：仅改损失即可稳定提升接受长度，工程改造成本低，代码已开源。

title: PARDIG: Global Precipitation Estimates Learned from Sparse Satellite Observations
summary: Estimating precipitation at the global scale is vital for Earth system science and disaster response, yet observational coverage and measurement precision remain constrained. Existing solutions provide options that trade off desirable traits such as skill, latency, geographical coverage, temporal coverage, and spatial and temporal resolution. We present PARDIG, an artificial intelligence framework based on a spherical graph-mesh transformer architecture that produces near-real-time global precipitation estimates. PARDIG is trained on dense multi-modal inputs, including atmospheric state analyses and multi-spectral geostationary satellite imagery, to predict sparse, high-precision precipitation measurements from spaceborne radar. At inference, the trained model is applied densely across the globe at $0.1^\circ$ spatial and 15-minute temporal resolution, producing complete near-real-time precipitation fields from 2016 to the present, alongside a historical variant extending the record back to 1999. Evaluation against three independent radar networks (over the US, Europe, and Japan) and against over 36,000 surface stations worldwide shows that PARDIG consistently outperforms IMERG V07 (Final and Early), MSWEP V3, ERA5, and HRES across precipitation thresholds and regions, with the largest improvements at extreme intensities. Case studies of extreme precipitation events demonstrate that PARDIG successfully captures their spatial structure and timing. The improvements also extend to forecasting: WeatherNext 3, a global weather model, produces more skillful precipitation forecasts when trained to predict PARDIG. Both the historical and near-real-time PARDIG datasets are openly available under a CC BY 4.0 license.

AI.tldr: PARDIG是一个基于球面图网格Transformer架构的AI框架，利用多模态输入（大气状态分析+静止卫星多光谱影像）预测稀疏的星载雷达高精度降水，在0.1°/15分钟分辨率上生成2016年至今的全球近实时降水场，并可回溯至1999年，性能全面超越IMERG、MSWEP、ERA5和HRES。
AI.motivation: 全球尺度降水估计对地球系统科学与灾害响应至关重要，但观测覆盖和测量精度受限。现有方案在技巧、延迟、地理覆盖、时间覆盖及时空分辨率等特性间只能权衡取舍，难以兼得。
AI.method: 提出PARDIG框架，采用球面图网格Transformer架构，以密集多模态输入（大气状态分析、多光谱静止卫星影像）为条件，学习预测稀疏的高精度星载雷达降水观测；推理时在全球密集应用，输出0.1°空间、15分钟时间分辨率的完整降水场（2016年至今），并提供回溯至1999年的历史版本。
AI.result: 在美国、欧洲、日本三个独立雷达网络及全球超36000个地面站上评估，PARDIG在各降水阈值和区域上持续优于IMERG V07（Final与Early）、MSWEP V3、ERA5和HRES，极端强度下改进最大；极端降水事件案例显示其能准确捕捉空间结构与时间演变；用于训练WeatherNext 3还可提升全球降水预报技巧。
AI.conclusion: PARDIG同时兼顾技巧、近实时性、全球覆盖、长时序与高时空分辨率，突破了现有降水产品的权衡限制；历史与近实时数据集以CC BY 4.0开放获取，并可作为天气模型训练目标进一步提升预报能力。

title: A Cross-Scenario Survey and Analysis of Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents
summary: Recent work shows that multimodal agents increasingly self-improve without recurring human annotation. However, each self-improvement mechanism is designed and evaluated within a single scenario, leaving its preconditions unverified under cross-scenario transfer. This survey investigates the structural source of asymmetric mechanism transfer across four scenarios: multimodal reasoning, multimodal generation, GUI and Web navigation, and embodied manipulation. We first formalize the self-evolving multimodal agent by four criteria and a differentia of self-reference, and adopt the three-stage self-evolving loop of experience generation, feedback acquisition, and update consolidation as our analytical framework to position the scenarios along ceilings on rollout count and feedback fidelity. Comparing self-evolving with fixed loops within each scenario separates the limitations that the scenario imposes from those inherent in the self-evolving design. We then recast each mechanism as a trade-off that raises a scarce factor by presupposing a task-structural resource, such as output equivalence or checkable outcomes, and judge it portable, conditional, blocked, or redundant across scenarios. We attribute the asymmetry to divergent combinations of scarce factors and resources across opposite transfer directions, and identify the matched-budget measurements that could overturn these still untested verdicts.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统分析多模态自进化智能体机制在跨场景迁移中的结构性不对称，提出以"经验生成—反馈获取—更新巩固"三阶段自进化循环为分析框架，将各机制视作"以任务结构资源换取稀缺要素"的权衡，并判定其可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化机制均在单一场景内设计与评估，其前提条件在跨场景迁移下尚未被验证，机制迁移呈现不对称性且缺乏结构性解释。
AI.method: 覆盖四类场景（多模态推理、多模态生成、GUI与Web导航、具身操作）；用四条准则与自我指涉的判别标准形式化自进化多模态智能体；以三阶段自进化循环定位各场景在 rollout 数量与反馈保真度上的天花板；通过场景内"自进化 vs 固定循环"对比区分场景固有限制与设计内在限制；将机制重构为依赖输出等价性、可检验结果等结构资源的权衡，并判定其可迁移、有条件、受阻或冗余。
AI.result: 发现迁移不对称源于两个迁移方向上"稀缺因素×结构资源"组合的差异，并指出这些判定目前仍未经实验检验。
AI.conclusion: 识别出可推翻现有判定结论的匹配预算测量方案，为自进化多模态智能体的跨场景评估提供统一分析框架与研究议程。

title: Where Do Vision-Language Models Get Left and Right? Position-Code Counterfactuals in Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL and InternVL3
summary: A vision-language model may take left-right direction from the orientation of image content within patches, its vision transformer's (ViT) position code, or token positions and order in its language model (LLM). Ablations show the ViT code is necessary; we test sufficiency by mirroring only a position code. In Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3-2B, mirroring ViT width positions reproduces the flipped-image answer on 84.3-93.2% of CV-Bench left-right questions (Qwen2.5-VL-3B: 87.5%, partly a left fallback). With two options, this also counts disruption; a half-grid shift flips most answers too. With the ViT code intact, LLM-side id and token-order mirrors change few left-right answers in all three series (a weak id test in Qwen2.5-VL). In Qwen2.5-VL-7B the effect sits in the global-attention ViT blocks, mostly the last. On What'sUp, flipping content and token order, not the position code, keeps more on/under than left-right answers at the flipped-image answer. Post hoc analyses qualify these results. On CV-Bench items with located objects, random permutations flip 18.9-31.0 points more answers when reversing the objects' order than when keeping it. On What'sUp, in Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL, the share of the left-right changes made by random permutations that land on the mirror relation is mostly below chance. Counted as returns to the original answer, the What'sUp contrast of support with left-right relations is clear only in InternVL3-2B. Most remaining errors give the same relation whichever object is asked about, suggesting that repair may target relation binding, object localization or use of the reference object.

AI.tldr: 在Qwen2.5-VL、Qwen3-VL和InternVL3三个系列的视觉语言模型中，仅镜像ViT宽度位置编码即可在84.3-93.2%的CV-Bench左右方向问题上复现翻转图像的答案，说明ViT位置编码对左右方向判断是充分的；而LLM侧的位置id或token顺序镜像影响甚微。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型的左右方向判断可能来自图像块内内容朝向、ViT位置编码或LLM的token位置与顺序。作者希望通过消融实验厘清哪一来源是必要且充分的，从而理解模型方向感知的机制。
AI.method: 先做消融证明ViT位置编码是必要的，再通过仅镜像位置编码来检验其充分性：在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-4B、InternVL3-2B等模型上镜像ViT宽度方向位置，并对比LLM侧id镜像、token顺序镜像、半格移位、随机排列等扰动在CV-Bench和What'sUp上的表现，另分析Qwen2.5-VL-7B中效应所在的ViT全局注意力块。
AI.result: 镜像ViT宽度位置即可复现翻转图像答案的比例达84.3-93.2%；半格移位也能翻转多数答案；而LLM侧镜像改变很少。效应集中于全局注意力ViT块，主要是最后一层。What'sUp上翻转内容与token顺序（而非位置编码）更能保持on/under答案。事后分析显示随机排列在按对象逆序时多翻转18.9-31.0个百分点的答案，且随机排列命中镜像关系的比例多低于随机水平。
AI.conclusion: ViT位置编码是模型左右方向判断的主要且充分来源，效应集中在最末全局注意力块。剩余错误多表现为无论询问哪个对象都给出相同关系，提示修复应针对关系绑定、物体定位或参考对象的使用。

title: Bits or permutations? Spending a fixed inference budget on weight precision or on option-order averaging in small local language models
summary: Local language models can save memory by storing weights in fewer bits, and they can reduce sensitivity to the order of answer options by averaging a few reorderings. We ask whether the first makes the second worse, and which is the cheaper way to spend a fixed budget. On Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B with simulated round-to-nearest weight quantization (8, 6, 4 and 3 bits, fp16 reference), read from the logits of the letters A to D on ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag (300 items each), 6 bits lose no accuracy against fp16 (they score +1.8 (+1.0 to +2.5) and +0.9 (+0.3 to +1.5) points higher, which we do not explain), and 8 bits change it by -0.7 (-1.1 to -0.3) and -0.4 (-0.7 to -0.2) points. At 4 bits the answer-slot skew rises from 0.15 to 0.53 (0.6B) and from 0.07 to 0.12 (1.7B); Gaussian noise at the same weight SNR gives 0.15 and 0.37 (two draws) and 0.19 (one draw), so the control is inconclusive on whether rounding adds slot skew beyond equal-power noise. Flip rates rise but stay below an accuracy-matched baseline of independent uniform errors. Averaging four cyclic orders recovers +12.6 points at 4 bits for 0.6B (+5.3 at fp16). We price bits and passes in one machine-independent unit, weight bytes read times passes. In cost-matched pairs, extra orders beat extra bits only when the weights have 6 or more bits, and the decision table reduces to: use 6-bit weights and spend the rest of the budget on up to four orders, one pass each. Everything is simulated on two small models with the simplest quantizer; a title-level search found no earlier study of quantization together with option order.

AI.tldr: 该论文考察权重量化是否会加剧语言模型对答案选项顺序的敏感性，并在固定预算下比较"增加比特"与"增加重排次数"的性价比。结论是：6比特权重量化不损失精度，且应优先使用6比特权重并将剩余预算用于至多四次循环重排（各一遍）。
AI.motivation: 局部语言模型可通过低比特存储权重节省内存，也可通过对少量重排取平均来降低对选项顺序的敏感性。作者追问：前者（量化）是否会让后者（顺序稳健性）变差，以及在固定预算下哪种开销更划算。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-0.6B与Qwen3-1.7B上使用模拟的最近舍入权重量化（8/6/4/3比特，fp16为参照），读取A–D四个字母的logits，在ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、MMLU、HellaSwag各300题上评测。用等信噪比的高斯噪声作为控制组，并以独立均匀误差的精度匹配基线作比较；同时用四项循环重排取平均。将比特与重排次数统一折算为"读取权重字节数×遍数"这一机器无关成本单位，进行成本匹配对比。
AI.result: 6比特相对fp16不降精度（分别高+1.8和+0.9分，作者未解释），8比特则下降0.7和0.4分。4比特时答案槽偏斜从0.15升至0.53（0.6B）、从0.07升至0.12（1.7B）；等权SNR高斯噪声为0.15与0.37（两次抽取）、0.19（一次抽取），控制实验无法判定舍入是否在等功率噪声之外额外引入槽偏斜。翻转率上升但仍低于精度匹配的独立均匀误差基线。4比特下四次循环重排为0.6B挽回+12.6分（fp16下+5.3）。成本匹配对比中，仅当权重量≥6比特时"加重量重排"才优于"加比特"；决策表归结为：用6比特权重，剩余预算用于至多四次单遍重排。
AI.conclusion: 量化与选项顺序稳健性可以共存，且推荐配置为6比特权重＋至多四次单遍循环重排。所有结果均在两个小模型与最简单的量化器上模拟得出，标题级检索未发现此前关于量化与选项顺序结合的研究。

title: Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Aware Framework for Trustworthy Molecular Property Prediction
summary: Molecular property prediction is fundamental to computational chemistry and drug formulation research, yet existing benchmarks remain fragmented across datasets, properties, and evaluation protocols, limiting systematic evaluation of model generalization. We introduce Chem World, a large-scale benchmark integrating 17 public datasets with over 800,000 molecular and chemical-system instances across 10 property tracks, covering single-molecule and multi-component systems, including drug solubility. Chem World provides a unified testbed for evaluating molecular representations and compositional modeling across diverse chemical properties. Building on the benchmark, we propose PACM (Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling), which combines molecular representations with composition-aware modeling and domain-specific physical constraints. Extensive experiments show that molecular language models provide strong and transferable representations, while PACM consistently improves prediction across diverse chemical systems. Chem World and our PACM-powered drug-property prediction Agent support generalizable chemical modeling and offer a foundation for AI-assisted biomedical research and drug formulation development.

AI.tldr: 提出大规模分子性质预测基准Chem World（17个公开数据集、超80万实例、10个性质赛道），并提出物理感知组合建模方法PACM，实验表明分子语言模型表征强且可迁移，PACM在各化学体系上稳定提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有分子性质预测基准在数据集、性质和评测协议上高度碎片化，难以系统评估模型的泛化能力，尤其缺乏对多组分/配方体系（如药物溶解度）的统一测试平台。
AI.method: 构建Chem World基准，整合17个公开数据集、80万余个分子与化学体系实例，覆盖10个性质赛道，兼顾单分子与多组分体系；在其上提出PACM（Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling），将分子表征与组合感知建模、领域物理约束相结合。
AI.result: 大量实验显示分子语言模型可提供强且可迁移的表征；PACM在多种化学体系上均能持续提升预测表现。基于该基准还构建了PACM驱动的药物性质预测Agent。
AI.conclusion: Chem World与PACM为分子表征与组合建模提供统一评测与改进方案，支撑可泛化的化学建模，并为AI辅助生物医学研究与药物制剂开发奠定基础。

title: Obscured Wildfire Flame Detection by Spatio-temporal Analysis of Smoke Patterns Using Frame-wise Transformers
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Published in the 2024 20th International Conference on Distributed Computing in Smart Systems and the Internet of Things (DCOSS-IoT), pp. 58-65
summary: In this paper, we propose a new paradigm in wildfire management for detecting both visible and obscured fire using Deep Learning (DL). The essence of our method is the joint spatial and temporal analysis of RGB videos, embracing the fact that temporal patterns of smoke motions in consecutive video frames can indicate obscured fire flames. This perspective contrasts the traditional approach of independently analyzing images and individual video frames. To this end, we propose a frame-wise transformer architecture that applies an attention mechanism between the consecutive frames while preserving spatial information within frames as opposed to regular attention mechanisms like the non-local block, which combines spatial and temporal information into a single vector. We also optimize the temporal pattern lengths under different spatial resolutions to achieve the highest performance while reducing the computational cost. To investigate the applicability of our method in aerial image processing, we applied it to a curated version of the FLAME2 dataset that includes dual-mode RGB/IR videos. The IR video feed is used to extract ground truth, while the model is trained only on RGB videos to maintain applicability to lowcost commercial drones (which are equipped only with regular cameras) and facilitate processing existing RGB-only datasets. Our proposed method achieves a Segmentation Foreground Dice score of 92.61%, an Object Detection Precision and Recall rate of 93.21% and 91.73%, and clip-level classification accuracy of 98.02%, respectively. We also investigated the efficacy and generalizability of our method through ablation study

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于帧间Transformer的时空联合分析范式，利用连续RGB视频帧中烟雾运动的时间模式来同时检测可见火焰与被遮挡火焰，并在FLAME2双模态数据集上取得高精度分割、检测与分类性能。
AI.motivation: 传统野火检测方法独立分析单张图像或单个视频帧，难以识别被烟雾遮挡的火焰。作者认为连续视频帧中烟雾运动的时间模式可以作为暗火（被遮挡火焰）的指示信号，因此需要一种能联合建模空间与时间信息的新范式。同时，为适配仅配备普通摄像头的低成本商用无人机及现有RGB数据集，模型需仅用RGB训练。
AI.method: 提出帧级（frame-wise）Transformer架构：在连续帧之间施加注意力机制，同时保留帧内空间信息，区别于将时空信息合并为单一向量的非局部块（non-local block）注意力。此外，对不同空间分辨率下的时间模式长度进行优化，以在降低计算成本的同时获得最佳性能。在重新整理的FLAME2数据集上（含RGB/IR双模态视频）进行验证，用IR视频提取Ground Truth，模型仅在RGB视频上训练。
AI.result: 前景分割Dice分数达92.61%；目标检测精确率与召回率分别为93.21%和91.73%；片段的分类准确率为98.02%。并通过消融实验验证了方法的有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 联合时空分析RGB视频、利用烟雾运动时间线索可有效检测可见与被遮挡火灾；帧级Transformer在保持帧内空间信息的同时建模帧间时序，兼具高性能与较低计算成本，且仅依赖RGB即可应用于低成本无人机与现有RGB数据集，具有良好的实用性与泛化性。

title: Geometry-Dependent Approximation and Stability Properties of Shallow ReLU$^k$ Networks on Bounded Euclidean Domains
summary:
On bounded Euclidean domains, we study how hidden-parameter geometry affects shallow ReLU$^k$ networks through results on approximation rates, saturation-type lower bounds, Gram and stiffness matrix spectra, Bernstein and Marcinkiewicz--Zygmund inequalities, discrete least-squares recovery, and inverse approximation.
  Our analysis uses smooth localization and dyadic Fourier estimates. We quantify parameter geometry by the fill distance $h$ and antipodal separation distance $\underline h$. For the prescribed network space $L_n^k$, representative approximation estimates take the form \begin{equation*} \begin{aligned} \inf_{g_n\in L_n^k}\|f-g_n\|_{\mathcal L^2(Ω')}&\lesssim h^r\|f\|_{\mathcal H^r(Ω)},\\ \inf_{g_n\in L_n^k}\|f-g_n\|_{\mathcal L^2(Ω)}&\gtrsim \underline h^{\frac{d+2k+1}{2}}\|f\|_{\mathcal L^2(Ω')}. \end{aligned} \end{equation*} The upper bound exploits target regularity up to the critical order $\frac{d+2k+1}{2}$, while the lower bound applies asymptotically to fixed targets smoother than this order. The upper estimate holds on an interior subdomain $Ω'$, whereas the lower estimate concerns the larger domain $Ω$.
  We also obtain geometry-dependent spectral estimates that quantify conditioning and coefficient stability. Further results establish norm discretization and regularized recovery from function values, and infer target regularity from approximation rates under coefficient or separation conditions. Altogether, these results describe how parameter geometry governs approximation accuracy, the stability of coefficient representations, discrete recovery, and the regularity information contained in convergence rates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究隐藏参数几何（由填充距离 h 与对跖分离距离 ĥ 刻画）如何影响浅层 ReLU^k 网络的逼近速率、饱和型下界、Gram/刚度矩阵谱、Bernstein 与 Marcinkiewicz–Zygmund 不等式、离散最小二乘恢复及逆逼近。
AI.motivation: 浅层 ReLU^k 网络的参数（神经元位置/权重）往往是被隐藏的，其几何分布会显著影响逼近与数值稳定性，但缺乏系统的定量刻画。作者希望建立以参数几何为核心的统一分析框架。
AI.method: 采用光滑局部化与二进 Fourier 估计；以填充距离 h 与对跖分离距离 ĥ 量化参数几何；对给定网络空间 L_n^k 分别给出上界（利用临界阶 (d+2k+1)/2 以内的目标正则性，作用于内子域 Ω′）与渐近下界（针对比临界阶更光滑的固定目标，作用于较大域 Ω）；进一步推导几何相关的谱估计、范数离散化、正则化函数值恢复，以及在系数或分离条件下从收敛速率反推目标正则性。
AI.result: 得到形如 inf‖f−g_n‖_{L²(Ω′)} ≲ h^r‖f‖_{H^r(Ω)} 的上界与 inf‖f−g_n‖_{L²(Ω)} ≳ ĥ^{(d+2k+1)/2}‖f‖_{L²(Ω′)} 的下界；并给出刻画条件数与系数稳定性的几何相关谱估计，以及范数离散化、离散最小二乘恢复和逆逼近结果。
AI.conclusion: 参数几何系统性地支配了浅层 ReLU^k 网络的逼近精度、系数表示稳定性、离散恢复能力以及收敛速率所蕴含的正则性信息，为网络逼近与数值分析提供了统一几何视角。

title: LM-SimBench: A Unified Framework, Dataset, and Benchmark for Large Language Model Training Simulation
summary: Evaluating candidate parallelization strategies through distributed training runs makes strategy selection prohibitively expensive at scale. Performance simulation offers a lower cost alternative, yet controlled comparisons among existing simulators remain difficult because they differ in the training stages they model and the workloads on which they are evaluated. We introduce LM-SimBench, a unified framework, profiling dataset, and benchmark for evaluating LLM training simulators. The framework decomposes simulation into functional stages from model compilation to schedule level aggregation, connecting execution representations and cost estimators to measurable evaluation targets. Following this framework, we profile 23 model settings from 10 dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM families on an Ascend Neural Processing Unit (NPU) cluster. The resulting dataset contains 348 feasible configurations that jointly vary five parallelism dimensions and activation recomputation, with six views spanning configuration, rank, operator, event, and kernel granularity. Evaluations of representative training simulators demonstrate how LM-SimBench supports comparisons of prediction accuracy, assessment of configuration selection, and diagnosis of prediction errors. Matched GPU-NPU experiments validate the cross-platform applicability of the collection and evaluation protocol and demonstrate NPU-guided GPU configuration selection.

AI.tldr: LM-SimBench 提出一个统一框架、性能剖析数据集与基准，用于系统评测大模型训练模拟器，覆盖10个稠密/MoE模型家族、23个设置、348种可行并行配置，并在NPU与GPU上验证跨平台适用性。
AI.motivation: 直接用分布式训练评测并行策略代价过高；性能模拟虽便宜，但现有模拟器建模的训练阶段和评测负载各异，缺乏受控、可比的横向比较手段。
AI.method: 构建统一框架，将模拟分解为从模型编译到调度级聚合的功能阶段，连接执行表示与代价估计器到可测评测目标；在Ascend NPU集群上剖析10个稠密与MoE模型家族的23个设置，得到348个可行配置，联合变化五个并行维度与激活重计算，并提供配置、rank、算子、事件、kernel六个粒度视图。
AI.result: 通过评测代表性模拟器，展示LM-SimBench可支持预测精度比较、配置选择评估与误差诊断；匹配的GPU-NPU实验验证了数据集与评测协议的跨平台适用性，并实现NPU引导的GPU配置选择。
AI.conclusion: LM-SimBench为LLM训练模拟器提供了可复现、细粒度、跨平台的统一评测基准，有助于模拟器的公平对比、配置选择与误差溯源。

title: ZoomGain: Mining Global-to-Zoom Perception Gaps for Fine-Grained Visual Supervision
summary: Fine-grained visual perception requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to locate and interpret subtle evidence within complex scenes. Constructing supervision for this ability is challenging: questions must have correct, unambiguous answers that depend on actual fine-grained visual details rather than coarse cues or language priors. Verifying these properties makes manual annotation labor-intensive and automatic generation difficult for models that themselves struggle with fine-grained perception. Yet the same models can often recognize such details once the region is zoomed in. We exploit this global-to-zoom perception gap and introduce ZoomGain, a data construction pipeline that constructs questions about the full image from visual information gained only by zooming in. It verifies each answer on the zoomed view with multiple models, ensures that each question remains unambiguous in the full image and cannot be answered from language priors, and specifically generates high-quality distractors for multiple-choice questions. With this pipeline and human-only screening (no manual QA editing), we build ZoomGainBench, a 1,000-question bilingual benchmark on which the best of 28 VLMs achieves only 61.08. Failure analysis reveals that models favor a particular type of distractor when answering multiple-choice questions incorrectly. Beyond evaluation, training on just 9K ZoomGain samples substantially improves the visual perception capabilities of our 4B/9B models, enabling them to outperform several hundred-billion-parameter models across various perception benchmarks. The trained 9B model achieves SoTA performance on several benchmarks, such as 90.25 on HR-Bench 4K. These results establish global-to-zoom perception gaps as a practical basis for scaling fine-grained visual supervision for both evaluation and training. Our code is available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/ZoomGain.

AI.tldr: 提出 ZoomGain 数据构建流程，利用"全局-放大"感知差距自动生成细粒度视觉监督数据，构建 ZoomGainBench 基准（28 个 VLM 最高仅 61.08），并用 9K 样本显著提升 4B/9B 模型感知能力。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉感知要求在复杂场景中定位与解读细微证据，但此类监督数据的构建困难：答案需正确无歧义且依赖真实细粒度视觉细节而非粗粒度线索或语言先验；人工标注费时，自动生成又受限于模型自身的细粒度感知短板。
AI.method: 利用模型"放大后即可识别细节"的全局-放大感知差距：在全图视角下提问，但答案信息仅来自放大视图；用多模型在放大视图上验证答案，确保问题在全图下无歧义、无法依赖语言先验作答，并专门生成高质量多选干扰项。仅做人工筛选、不做人工 QA 编辑，构建 1000 题双语基准 ZoomGainBench，并进行训练实验。
AI.result: 28 个 VLM 中最佳仅 61.08；失败分析显示模型答错时偏好某一类干扰项。仅用 9K 样本训练即可显著提升 4B/9B 模型的视觉感知能力，超越多个百亿/千亿参数模型；9B 模型在多个基准上达 SoTA，如 HR-Bench 4K 上 90.25。
AI.conclusion: 全局-放大感知差距可作为规模化细粒度视觉监督的实用基础，同时服务于评测与训练。

title: RB-LDC: Redundancy-Balanced Latent Coding for Noise-Robust Diffusion Latents
summary: Latent diffusion models decode approximately correct latents, making decoder sensitivity to perturbations relevant to image quality. After whitening, forward diffusion corrupts every direction at the same signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), despite unequal decoder sensitivities. We study an invertible linear layer between the encoder and diffusion process that shifts each direction's log-SNR. Its linear minimum mean-square-error (LMMSE) recovery risk has an exact spectral expression for any whitened latent distribution. Under an energy budget and a floor ensuring invertibility, minimizing decoder-sensitivity-weighted LMMSE risk integrated over the diffusion schedule yields a unique optimal allocation. The layer aligns with the decoder's expected pullback metric and equalizes marginal risk reduction across directions, computed by a deterministic spectral solver. At large budgets, the allocation follows a power law in sensitivity whose exponent is determined by the low-SNR tail of the loss weighting: one half for noise prediction and two thirds for data prediction under the cosine schedule, with a crossover on truncated schedules. We instantiate this principle as RB-LDC using Jacobian-based sensitivity estimates. On ImageNet at 256 x 256 resolution with SD-VAE and VA-VAE, trained RB-LDC improves reconstruction from noisy latents over budget-matched isotropic coding in all four metrics and five coding configurations, averaged over 15 SNRs and three pipeline seeds. It reduces average perturbed FID by 17.1 for VA-VAE block-local coding while preserving clean reconstruction. We also report intermediate SNRs where perturbed FID worsens. With a frozen diffusion model, RB-LDC yields lower FID point estimates in all 12 tested combinations of sampling progress and channel SNR under corruption during sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出维度加权线性层RB-LDC，逐方向调整扩散中的log-SNR分配以匹配解码器敏感度，显著改善带噪潜变量的重建与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散白化后各方向同等SNR受损，但解码器对各方向的敏感度并不相等，导致低敏感方向被过度保护、高风险方向保护不足，从而损害图像质量。
AI.method: 在编码器与扩散过程间插入可逆线性层，将各方向log-SNR偏移；LMMSE恢复风险具精确谱表达式，在能量预算与可逆下限约束下最小化按解码器敏感度加权、沿扩散计划积分的风险，得到唯一最优分配——使层对齐解码器的期望拉回度量并按方向均衡边际风险降低，用确定性谱求解器计算；实例化为基于雅可比敏感度估计的RB-LDC。
AI.result: 大预算下分配呈敏感度幂律，指数由低SNR尾部损失权重决定：噪声预测1/2、数据预测余弦计划2/3，截断计划存在交叉。ImageNet 256×256（SD-VAE、VA-VAE）上，15个SNR与3个种子平均，四项指标、五种配置均优于等预算各向同性编码；VA-VAE块局部编码扰动FID平均降17.1，保持干净重建；并报告了扰动FID变差的中间SNR；冻结扩散模型下12种采样进度与信道SNR组合均获更低FID点估计。
AI.conclusion: 按解码器敏感度进行谱最优SNR分配是有理论保证且实用的潜空间编码改进方案，可提升扩散模型对潜变量扰动的鲁棒性。

title: Multimodal Abstention That Preserves Acquired Correct Answers
comment: 28 pages. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/ModeLiberaL/ReFrain
summary: Adding abstention to a task-adapted multimodal model can discard correct answers, including capabilities acquired during adaptation. We formulate abstention repair as maximizing correct abstention on unanswerable questions under a budget on newly lost correct answers. We propose ReFrain (Regression-Free Abstention), which combines a linear probe on first-token logits, threshold calibration on held-out image clusters, and a deterministic veto that replaces rejected outputs with the displayed "none of the above" option while preserving all other responses. "Regression-free" denotes zero loss on the calibration set at the zero-budget target. All abstention methods in our main comparison start from the same answering-SFT checkpoint; we separately track lost correct answers, repaired errors, and retained SFT gains. On Qwen2.5-VL-3B, ReFrain at zero budget retains all 57 SFT-gained answers with no losses and improves correct abstention by 7.30 percentage points. At a 0.5% calibration budget, it reaches 74.05% correct abstention with 8 losses and retains 55 gains; CLIP-UP EmbLoRA reaches 64.65% with 62 losses, 41 repairs, and 40 retained gains. The same probe at its default threshold loses 298 correct answers. With models and thresholds frozen, confirmation on 228 independent question clusters yields 66.05% correct abstention and no losses at the 0.5% point, exceeding EmbLoRA by 32.72 percentage points. Ordinary refusal SFT achieves higher correct abstention at greater regression cost. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/ModeLiberaL/ReFrain.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReFrain（回归无关弃答）方法，在最小化新损失正确答案的预算下最大化不可回答问题上的正确弃答率。
AI.motivation: 给任务适配后的多模态模型加入弃答能力会误伤原本正确的答案，包括适配阶段获得的能力，因此需要一种"不回归"的弃答修复方案。
AI.method: ReFrain 结合三部分：(1) 基于首 token logits 的线性探针；(2) 在留出图像簇上的阈值校准；(3) 确定性否决机制，将被拒输出替换为"以上皆非"选项，其余回答保持不变。所有对比方法均从同一 answering-SFT 检查点出发，分别统计正确答案损失、修复的错误与保留的 SFT 增益。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-VL-3B 上，零预算时保留全部 57 个 SFT 增益答案且零损失，正确弃答提升 7.30 个百分点；0.5% 预算下正确弃答达 74.05%（8 次损失，保留 55 个增益），优于 CLIP-UP EmbLoRA 的 64.65%（62 次损失）；同探针默认阈值则损失 298 个正确答案。228 个独立问题簇上确认达 66.05% 且零损失，超 EmbLoRA 32.72 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ReFrain 能在几乎不损失既有正确能力的前提下显著提升弃答能力，优于普通拒绝式 SFT 与 EmbLoRA，并可复现。

title: Stylization as Geodesic Navigation on Diffusion Manifolds
summary: Facial stylization asks for a delicate transformation: the image should look unmistakably artistic, yet the person should remain unmistakably the same. Existing training-free and instruction-driven methods often fail to expose such control, either drifting away from identity or producing only weak stylization. We introduce Stylus, a training-free framework that treats facial style transfer as navigation on the curved latent manifold of a pretrained diffusion model. Rather than interpolating in flat Euclidean space, \method refines the interpolated content--style point by lowering a ratio-weighted discrete geodesic energy under the pullback metric, made tractable by a rank-one power-iteration approximation of the Jacobian. This principle drives two complementary controls: content--style latent interpolation for smooth semantic fusion, and self-attention query optimization for spatially adaptive style injection. The resulting dual-control mechanism provides continuous, fine-grained control over stylization strength while preserving identity-critical facial structure, all without additional training. Experiments show that Stylus achieves the strongest identity and content preservation at competitive stylization strength.

AI.tldr: Stylus：将人脸风格迁移视为预训练扩散模型曲率潜流形上的测地线导航，无需训练即实现强风格化与高保真身份保持的双重控制。
AI.motivation: 人脸风格化需兼顾"艺术感"与"身份一致"，而现有免训练/指令驱动方法要么身份漂移，要么风格化过弱，缺乏细粒度控制。
AI.method: 将内容-风格潜插值视为在扩散模型潜流形上导航：用拉回度量下的比率加权离散测地线能量精修插值点，并以秩一幂迭代近似雅可比使计算可行；该原理衍生两种互补控制——潜空间内容-风格插值实现平滑语义融合，自注意力查询优化实现空间自适应风格注入。
AI.result: 在竞争性风格化强度下，取得最优的身份与内容保持效果，并提供连续、细粒度的风格强度调控，无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: 以流形几何视角统一内容-风格融合与注意力注入，Stylus为免训练人脸风格迁移提供了可控且保身份的实用方案。

title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 55 pages. Project page: https://codiscovery.ai/contrastive-discovery/
summary: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. When evidence rejects $h$, the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. Across six domains, $89\%$ of the pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts are rejections. On the same evidence, contrast sets resolve $73\%$ of these candidates to a specific alternative. When contrast sets guide search, the agent resolves $67\%$ more questions than pointwise surprisal under the same experiment budget. In a blinded study, $38$ human experts chose the same explanation on $78\%$ of resolved questions and on $82\%$ of questions where the pointwise agent rejected its hypothesis and stopped. Together, these results support explicit competing explanations as a way for discovery agents to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Contrastive Discovery，用互斥且穷尽的竞争解释组成的对比集替代单一假设，使 LLM 智能体能把证据转化为对特定替代解释的判定，而非仅拒绝原假设。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 科学发现智能体对假设做逐点评估，仅检验 h 与 ¬h。当证据拒绝 h 时，智能体只知道某个解释不太可能，却不知道证据支持哪个替代解释，信息利用不充分。
AI.method: 将单一假设替换为对比集（一个科学问题配上一组互斥且穷尽的候选解释）；以实验证据在对比集上引起信念重分布的程度为打分；当信念集中于某一解释时判定问题解决。由于只改变智能体提议与打分的单位，现有智能体可直接复用已收集证据重评估或用其指导搜索。
AI.result: 在六个领域：信念位移最大的逐点候选中 89% 为拒绝；同样证据下对比集将其中 73% 解析为具体替代解释；指导搜索时同等实验预算下解决的问题比逐点 surprisal 多 67%。盲测中 38 位人类专家在 78% 的已解决问题上、以及 82% 的逐点智能体拒绝即停止的问题上选择了相同解释。
AI.conclusion: 显式竞争解释是一种让发现智能体在相同证据与验证预算下解决更多科学问题的有效方式。

title: Universal Approximation Theorem for Metaplectic Neural Operators
summary: We prove universal approximation for metaplectic neural operators on nonempty bounded Lipschitz domains. The nonlocal branches are whole-space metaplectic multipliers with zero extension and restriction, associated with any fixed free symplectic matrix. Assuming a smooth, globally Lipschitz, nonpolynomial activation, we obtain compact-uniform approximation of continuous operators from $C^s$ to $C^r$ and from $H^s$ to $H^r$ in the respective output norms, for arbitrary nonnegative integers $s,r$ and finite input and output channel dimensions. In the Sobolev setting, compact input sets must additionally be uniformly bounded in $L^\infty$. One hidden operator layer with one nonlocal branch suffices. A single scalar symbol atom and finitely many positional features are prescribed by the transform and domain independently of the target operator, compact set and accuracy. The proof combines averaging neural operator theory with an exact chirp-conjugated averaging identity and derivative estimates. The result includes Fourier and fixed nondegenerate fractional Fourier multiplier constructions.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了元波(Metaplectic)神经算子在非空有界Lipschitz区域上的普适逼近定理。非局部分支为带零延拓与限制的整空间元波乘子（关联任意固定自由辛矩阵）。在光滑、全局Lipschitz、非多项式激活下，从C^s到C^r、H^s到H^r可紧凑一致逼近连续算子；Sobolev情形还需输入集在L^∞中一致有界。仅需一层隐藏层、一个非局部分支，且一个标量符号原子与位置特征由变换和区域独立于目标算子预设。证明结合平均神经算子理论与精确chirp共轭平均恒等式及导数估计。
AI.motivation: 已有神经算子（如Fourier神经算子）多为固定乘子形式，理论上缺乏对更一般非局部（元波/辛）结构的普适逼近保证；本文旨在把FNO型构造推广到元波乘子并建立严格逼近保证。
AI.method: 证明基于平均神经算子理论，辅以精确的chirp共轭平均恒等式与导数估计；非局部分支采用整空间元波乘子加零延拓/限制处理边界；激活取光滑、全局Lipschitz非多项式函数；构造仅含一层隐藏层、一个非局部分支的网络，符号原子与位置特征由变换和区域预先固定。
AI.result: 对任意非负整数s,r与有限通道维数，连续算子从C^s→C^r与H^s→H^r均可被紧凑一致逼近（Sobolev情形额外要求输入紧集L^∞一致有界）；所得结果涵盖Fourier乘子及固定非退化分数Fourier乘子构造。
AI.conclusion: 元波神经算子具有与Fourier神经算子相当的普适逼近能力，且网络结构极简（单层单分支）并具域无关的符号原子设计，为非局部辛/元波算子学习提供理论基础。

title: Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents
comment: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (October 2026 cycle); under review
summary: External memory enables LLM agents to improve from experience by distilling trajectories of past tasks into concise lessons for new tasks. However, memory can also lead to memory-induced degradation, where an agent fails on tasks it would solve without memory, often because it follows a lesson that is incorrect, or misapplies or misreads a valid one. This is because lessons are inferred from trajectories labeled only with task success or failure, yet are typically provided without the trajectories they came from, leaving the agent no way to check them. To address this, we introduce WikiTrace, an evidence-linked memory system designed to let agents check each lesson against its original trajectory. Specifically, motivated by the finding that a trajectory often still holds the evidence needed to catch an erroneous lesson, WikiTrace stores each lesson as a concise insight linked to a summary of why its trajectory succeeded or failed and to the raw trajectory itself. Then, on a new task, the agent starts from all insights and, whenever one lacks details needed to act, conflicts with another, or comes from a failed task, descends through its links with terminal tools to fill in missing details or correct the insight before acting. We validate WikiTrace on five agentic benchmarks, showing that it consistently outperforms existing memory approaches and a baseline given the same insights alone, while also reducing memory-induced degradation. Our code is available at https://github.com/yukyeongleee/wikitrace

AI.tldr: 提出WikiTrace，一种证据关联的记忆系统，让智能体在行动前沿链接回溯原始轨迹核查每条经验，从而缓解"记忆诱发的性能退化"，在五个基准上稳定超越现有记忆方法。
AI.motivation: 外部记忆让LLM智能体从过去任务的轨迹中提炼经验教训，但也带来"记忆诱发退化"：智能体会在无记忆时本可解决的任务上失败，原因常是遵循了错误的教训，或误用、误读了一条有效教训。根源在于教训仅由"任务成功/失败"这一粗标签推断而来，却在提供时剥离了来源轨迹，智能体无从核查。
AI.method: WikiTrace的核心是"证据关联"：把每条教训存为简明洞见，并链接到"该轨迹为何成功或失败"的摘要以及原始轨迹本身。在新任务上，智能体从所有洞见出发，当某条洞见缺少行动所需细节、与其他洞见冲突、或来自失败任务时，就用终端工具沿链接向下回溯，补齐缺失信息或纠正该洞见后再行动。
AI.result: 在五个智能体基准上验证，WikiTrace一致优于现有记忆方法和"仅给同样洞见"的基线，同时降低了记忆诱发的性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 让教训可追溯、可核查，是提升智能体记忆可靠性的有效方向；记忆的价值不仅在于精炼，更在于保留与证据的链接。

title: Looking One Step Ahead: An Anticipation-guided Agent for Object State Readout in Videos
summary: Understanding the progress of an activity requires tracking how the objects involved change over time. Object state readout provides this information by describing a target object's states and transitions across video frames. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate detailed visual descriptions, these descriptions may leave the attributes needed to distinguish successive states insufficiently specified. In this paper, we propose look-ahead state readout (LASER), an anticipation-guided agent for object state readout that uses possible next-step changes to determine which attributes to inspect in the present. Given temporally ordered frames and a target object, LASER converts anticipated changes into targeted visual questions and inspects the current frame to establish attribute values. It then checks state readouts and forecasts against independent observations of subsequent frames, refining a state record used to generate the final description. Reusable textual observation skills guide this process and are refined by tracing discrepancies with reference captions to the responsible instructions. Candidate revisions are selected on separate videos based on improved caption quality without increased contradictions with reference facts. Model parameters remain frozen throughout adaptation and inference, and the revised skills remain fixed during evaluation. Experiment results and further analysis on OSCaR and PLM RCap show consistent improvements of LASER over strong baselines and existing approaches, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: LASER：一种前瞻式物体状态读出代理，用"预测下一步变化"引导多模态大模型在当前帧有针对性地检查属性，从而生成更准确的状态描述。
AI.motivation: 理解活动进展需追踪物体的状态变化，但MLLM生成的视觉描述往往属性不足，难以区分相邻状态。
AI.method: 给定有序帧与目标物体，先将预测的变化转化为针对性视觉问题，检查当前帧确定属性值；再用后续帧的独立观察校验状态读出与预测，迭代精炼状态记录并生成描述。可复用的文本观察技能由对照参考描述回溯差异来改进，候选修订在独立视频上按描述质量提升且不增加事实矛盾的标准选择。全过程模型参数冻结，修订后的技能在评估时保持固定。
AI.result: 在OSCaR和PLM RCap上相较强基线和现有方法取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 前瞻引导的状态读出与技能自改进相结合，可在不训练模型的情况下有效提升物体状态描述质量。

title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains. We introduce AutoScaffold, a unified AI-for-AI framework that turns a student's training experience into adaptive scaffolds, with minimal domain-specific information and no human intervention during training. A frozen teacher periodically examines this experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs scaffolds in two forms: (i) strategies shared across a class of tasks and (ii) hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting the content and amount of support as the student learns. The scaffolds are removed at evaluation. We apply the same framework to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation. When evaluated without scaffolds, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform those trained with the corresponding RL baselines in all four domains, with gains of 7.2 points in ALFWorld success and 4.0 points in average QA exact match. On GPU kernel generation, AutoScaffold increases the fraction of tasks with a correct kernel that runs faster than the PyTorch reference by up to 5.0 points. On math, our student surpasses QuestA's reported accuracy using approximately one-third as many student training steps. Analyses show that the teacher identifies a different failure in each task class and shifts its scaffolds from step-by-step workflows to targeted fixes as the student improves, and that its revised scaffolds help the student learn more than keeping the previous scaffold or using no scaffold.

AI.tldr: AutoScaffold 是一个"AI-for-AI"框架，让冻结的教师模型基于学生训练经验自动诊断瓶颈并生成自适应脚手架（策略与提示），评估时移除脚手架，在四个领域均超越相应 RL 基线。
AI.motivation: RLVR 的训练经验很丰富，但结果奖励把每次尝试压缩成单一数字，大部分信息被浪费；而训练时脚手架的设计与调整主要依赖人工且高度领域特化，缺乏通用自动化方法。
AI.method: 冻结教师模型周期性检查学生训练经验，诊断瓶颈，设计两类脚手架：跨任务类别共享的策略（strategies）和针对个别难题的提示（hints），并随学生进步调整支持的内容与数量；训练时注入、评估时移除，几乎不需要领域知识、无人工干预。
AI.result: 无脚手架评估下，四领域均优于对应 RL 基线：ALFWorld 成功率 +7.2 点，QA 平均 EM +4.0 点；GPU kernel 生成中"正确且快于 PyTorch 参考"的比例最高 +5.0 点；数学上用约 1/3 学生训练步数超过 QuestA 报告精度。分析显示教师能为每类任务识别不同失败模式，脚手架从分步流程逐步转向针对性修补。
AI.conclusion: 将学生的训练经验转化为自适应脚手架是提升 RLVR 的有效通用途径；教师自适应修订的脚手架比沿用旧脚手架或无脚手架带来更多学习收益，且脚手架可在评估时完全移除而不损害泛化。

title: Temporal Behavior Trees for Reinforcement Learning: Specifications as Rewards, Curricula, and Diagnostics
summary: Reinforcement learning from formal specifications often separates task definition, reward shaping, curriculum design, and policy diagnostics into different mathematical objects. This fragmentation requires additional conversion steps and discards structure already present in the specification, such as subtask boundaries, ordering constraints, and quantitative measures. We introduce TBTCL (Temporal Behavior Tree Centric Learning), a framework that uses Temporal Behavior Trees (TBTs) as a unified interface for specification-guided reinforcement learning. A single TBT specifies the task, induces dense robustness-based rewards, defines a curriculum, and supports better understanding of learned policies. By adapting TBT syntax and semantics for specification-guided reinforcement learning, we provide a formalism that is more expressive than popular specification languages such as LTL and inherently hierarchical. We present algorithms to automatically extract a curriculum DAG and derive dense, robustness-based rewards directly from TBT semantics. Furthermore, we utilize TBT trace segmentation to build understandable competence profiles and automatically adapt the reward toward bottlenecks. We evaluate TBTCL on six specifications across discrete and continuous domains and show that Temporal Behavior Trees can serve as a specification, a reward, a curriculum, and a diagnostic.

AI.tldr: TBTCL 用时间行为树（TBT）作为规格引导强化学习的统一接口，一棵 TBT 同时充当任务规格、稠密奖励、课程和诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLfFS（基于形式化规格的强化学习）将任务定义、奖励塑形、课程设计和策略诊断视为彼此分离的数学对象，需额外转换步骤，并丢弃了规格中已有的结构（子任务边界、顺序约束、定量度量）。
AI.method: 改造 TBT 的语法与语义以适配规格引导 RL，得到比 LTL 等更富表达力且天然分层的形式化；提出算法从 TBT 语义自动抽取课程 DAG，并直接导出基于鲁棒性的稠密奖励；利用 TBT 轨迹分割构建可理解的能力画像，并自动将奖励向瓶颈调整。
AI.result: 在离散与连续域共六个规格上评估 TBTCL，表明 TBT 可同时作为规格、奖励、课程与诊断使用。
AI.conclusion: 以 TBT 为中心的单一形式化接口可消除任务定义与训练机制间的割裂，保留规格结构并统一奖励、课程与诊断，为规格引导 RL 提供更具表达力和可解释性的框架。

title: When Should Agents Remember? Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon, verifier-rich environments, but current self-improvement mechanisms often write episode-derived lessons directly into memory, making local success an unreliable signal for reusable and safe knowledge. This paper addresses the core question of when an experience-derived behavioral update should be admitted into persistent agent state. We propose Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution (FGSE), a verifier-grounded framework that represents each candidate lesson as a structured hypothesis with an explicit precondition, behavior change, expected effect, and verifier. FGSE applies the hypothesis only in a temporary state, tests it on target-transfer, falsification, and archived-regression probes, and then commits, refines, or rejects it according to measured gain and risk. Across web, app, tool-use, and long-term memory benchmarks, FGSE achieves strong task performance, including 39.8 WebArena success rate, 78.8 AppWorld average completion, and 0.724/0.487 Pass$^1$ on $τ$-Retail/$τ$-Airline, while reducing falsification failures to 5.0%, regression damage to 1.3%, and harmful committed updates to 3.6%. These results suggest that testing memory updates as hypotheses supports more reliable long-term adaptation.

AI.tldr: FGSE将经验教训视为结构化假设，经临时候选态测试后决定提交/修正/拒绝，用验证器门控实现可靠的LLM智能体长期自我进化。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长时程、验证器丰富的环境中运行，但现有自我改进机制常把单次经验直接写入持久记忆，导致局部成功并不代表知识可复用且安全。核心问题是：经验驱动的行为更新何时才应被纳入持久智能体状态。
AI.method: 提出Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution (FGSE)：将每条候选教训表示为含显式前置条件、行为变更、预期效果与验证器的结构化假设；仅在临时状态中应用该假设，并通过目标迁移、证伪和归档回归三类探针进行测试，再依据实测收益与风险决定提交、修正或拒绝。
AI.result: 在web、app、工具使用和长期记忆等基准上表现强劲：WebArena成功率39.8%，AppWorld平均完成率78.8%，τ-Retail/τ-Airline Pass^1为0.724/0.487；同时证伪失败降至5.0%，回归损伤1.3%，有害提交更新3.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆更新作为假设来测试，可支撑更可靠的长期适应，说明验证器门控的提交机制是LLM智能体安全自我进化的有效路径。

title: TAMEing the Open-World Personalization: Towards Open-Set Personalized MLLM Assistant
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Main Track; code and data are available at https://github.com/ronpay/TAME-O
summary: Personalizing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) as intelligent assistants has recently emerged as an active research topic, where an MLLM is expected to go beyond generic, one-size-fits-all replies, and instead generate responses grounded in user-specific objects, entities, and concepts encountered during interactions. Nevertheless, existing studies mainly focus on personalizing MLLMs on a static, predefined set of personalized concepts and require users to manually and frequently extend this set to accommodate newly emerging concepts, which is infeasible in dynamic-world scenarios. To address this limitation, we recast conventional MLLM personalization as an Open-Set problem, and propose TAME-O, the first long-context open-set personalized MLLM assistant. Specifically, TAME-O introduces a training-free, plug-and-play Concept Reconciliation Skill (CR Skill). It enables the assistant to automatically unlock novel concepts during prolonged human-MLLM interactions while preventing confusion with previously unlocked ones, allowing the MLLM to continually grasp more and more concepts and progressively refine the modeling of known ones. Extensive experiments under the open-set personalization setting underscore the efficacy of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TAME-O，首个长上下文开放集个性化多模态大模型助手，通过免训练即插即用的 Concept Reconciliation Skill 使模型在长时间交互中自动解锁新概念，同时避免与已知概念混淆，实现持续概念更新与迭代细化。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化 MLLM 研究聚焦于静态、预定义的个性化概念集合，需用户手动且频繁扩展集合以容纳新出现的概念，这在动态真实世界场景中不可行。
AI.method: 将传统 MLLM 个性化重新表述为开放集问题，并提出 TAME-O。其核心是免训练、即插即用的概念对齐技能（CR Skill），在长时间人机交互中自动解锁新概念，并防止其与已解锁概念混淆，使模型持续掌握更多概念并逐步细化已知概念的建模。
AI.result: 在开放集个性化设置下的大量实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TAME-O 为动态场景下的开放集个性化 MLLM 助手提供了可行方案，摆脱了对预定义概念集合与人工扩展的依赖，具备持续学习与概念细化的能力。

title: BioXArena-Pro: a research-grade benchmark for autonomous biomedical machine learning agents
comment: 51 pages (22 main text, 29 supplementary information), 5 figures, 7 supplementary tables. Code: https://github.com/mbzuai-ai4bio/BioXArena-Pro ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mbzuai-ai4bio/BioXArena-Pro-Public ; Leaderboard: https://mbzuai-ai4bio.github.io/BioXArena-Pro/
summary: Coding agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous builders of biomedical models, but existing benchmarks are small, near saturation or open to leaked information. We present BioXArena-Pro, 64 research-level modelling tasks from eight biomedical domains, each rebuilt from a published study; most hold out whole biological units such as species or cohorts. Across 22 agent configurations, the best scores 55.1 of 100, and the scaffold matters almost as much as the model. We re-ran a published method for every task: where the published recipe applies unchanged, the best agent and the methods tie; on rebuilt tasks the methods trail by 8.2 points, suggesting that agents gain by adapting to new data. Pretrained models (including biological foundation models) matter where the strongest agent uses them: forbidding them decreases its score on those tasks by 9 points. Every task was audited in several AI-assisted rounds and a final human review.

AI.tldr: 提出 BioXArena-Pro：含 8 个生物医学领域、64 个研究级建模任务（多数按物种/队列等生物单元留出）的新基准，22 种智能体配置最高仅得 55.1/100，且框架（scaffold）影响几乎与模型本身相当。
AI.motivation: 现有生物医学编码智能体基准规模小、趋于饱和或存在信息泄漏，难以真实评估智能体的建模能力。
AI.method: 从已发表研究重建 64 个研究级任务，覆盖 8 个生物医学领域，多数任务留出整类生物单元（如物种、队列）；评测 22 种智能体配置；对每个任务复跑原始发表方法作对照；并进行预训练模型消融与多轮 AI 辅助加人工的审核。
AI.result: 最佳配置得 55.1/100；框架与模型影响接近。原方法可直接套用的任务上最佳智能体与原方法持平，重建任务上原方法落后 8.2 分；禁用预训练模型使最强智能体在这些任务上降 9 分。
AI.conclusion: 智能体优势主要来自对新数据的自适应，而非超越成熟方法；生物预训练模型对强智能体有实质增益；该基准提供了抗泄漏、未饱和的研究级评测。

title: CLADE: Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
summary: Retrieval-augmented systems often retrieve passages that are accurate and relevant but state the answer at a coarser level of granularity than the question requires. For example, a question may ask which specific disease a drug treats (familial hyperlipidemia), while the retrieved passage mentions the broader disease family (hyperlipidemia). Prior work on context sufficiency treats such coarse passages simply as insufficient. We argue that they form a distinct case, which we call resolvable insufficiency: text alone cannot settle the fine-grained answer, but the broader category it mentions maps to a short list of candidate answers in a domain ontology. When language models read these coarse, family-only passages, they exhibit a phenomenon we call Clade (Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence): they answer instead of abstaining or searching further. On biomedical questions from PrimeKG, family-only passages reduce abstention by 13.8 points compared to uninformative passages, and the resulting guesses are wrong about half the time. A counterfactual test confirms the cause: replacing an exact disease name with its broader family name lowers abstention by 17.4 points compared to deleting the sentence. Simple fixes like confidence filtering, scaling to a larger model, and explicitly instructing the model to abstain cannot resolve Clade, and this replicates on ecological species interactions in GloBI. Finally, we test whether an ontology can turn coarse passages into exact answers. Given the correct family, an ontology list includes the true answer in 98.5% of cases, but string matching finds that family on the page for only 19.8%. Letting the model choose the family raises this to 30.0% and end-to-end recovery from 10.0% to 26.8%. Overall, our results show when language models should stop guessing and consult an ontology, and highlight which steps of that process remain unsolved.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"可解析不足"（resolvable insufficiency）概念：检索到的段落只给出比问题更粗粒度的类别信息。语言模型在此类情况下会表现出"Clade"现象——不弃答也不继续检索，而是直接猜测。在生物医学问答上，仅有类别级信息的段落使弃答率降低13.8个百分点，猜测约半数错误；用本体论把粗粒度类别映射到候选答案可部分缓解，但关键步骤仍未解决。
AI.motivation: 现有"上下文充分性"研究把粗粒度段落一律当作不充分信息。作者认为这掩盖了一个独立且重要的情况：文本虽不能确定细粒度答案，但其提到的上位类别可在领域本体中映射到短候选列表。同时，作者担心模型在读到这类段落时会错误地"直接作答"，因此需要刻画这一失败模式并提出解决方向。
AI.method: 1）提出"可解析不足"定义与"Clade"现象；2）在PrimeKG生物医学问题上构造"仅家族级"段落，对比无信息段落测量弃答率变化；3）用反事实测试（把精确疾病名替换为上位家族名 vs. 删除句子）确认因果；4）测试置信度过滤、更大模型、显式弃答指令等简单修复；5）在GloBI生态物种互作数据上复现；6）评估用本体论把粗粒度段落还原为精确答案：给定正确家族时本体列表命中真答案的比例、字符串匹配找到家族的比例、模型自选家族及端到端恢复率。
AI.result: PrimeKG上，家族级段落相比无信息段落使弃答率下降13.8个百分点，猜测约一半错误；反事实测试显示，将精确疾病名替换为上位家族名相比删除该句使弃答率降低17.4个百分点。置信度过滤、换更大模型、显式强制弃答指令均无法解决Clade，且在GloBI上复现。本体路线：给定正确家族时，本体候选列表含真答案的比例达98.5%；但字符串匹配在页面上找到该家族仅19.8%；让模型自行选择家族可提升至30.0%，端到端恢复率从10.0%提升到26.8%。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在粗粒度段落前不应直接猜测，而应停下来查询本体；本体列表的覆盖率很高，但"定位家族"这一环节是主要瓶颈，也是端到端恢复率偏低的原因。论文界定了何时应弃答并咨询本体，并指出该流程中哪些步骤仍未解决。

title: CroCoMAE: Cross-modal self-supervised collaborative representation learning for SAR-optical remote sensing data
summary: Remote sensing increasingly captures the Earth's surface through complementary sensors such as SAR and optical, yet ground-truth annotations remain scarce, limiting supervised approaches. Self-supervised learning (SSL) addresses the label scarcity, and cross-modal SSL further exploits the complementarity between co-located sensors, but existing cross-modal frameworks align modalities mostly through global image-level representations or treat them as largely redundant, leaving their fine-grained complementary structure underexploited. We propose CroCoMAE, a cross-modal SSL framework for SAR-optical remote sensing that unifies contrastive learning and masked image modeling within a ViT-based architecture, operating at two complementary levels. At the image level, an intra-modality contrastive loss on the class token yields globally discriminative, augmentation-invariant representations. At the patch level, masked image modeling drives fine-grained per-modality representations, while a cross-modal contrastive objective aligns a shared subspace across SAR and optical patch tokens, leaving the complementary subspace unconstrained to retain modality-specific information. On two SAR-optical benchmarks covering scene classification and semantic segmentation, CroCoMAE improves over uni-modal SSL baselines and outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal frameworks in most configurations, with gains in both single-modality and multi-modal evaluation across varying label regimes and the largest improvements on semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出CroCoMAE，一个统一对比学习与掩码图像建模的SAR-光学跨模态自监督框架，在图像级和patch级两个层面同时建模全局判别性与细粒度互补结构。
AI.motivation: SAR与光学遥感互补但标注稀缺；现有跨模态自监督仅做全局图像级对齐或把模态视为冗余，忽视了细粒度互补结构。
AI.method: 基于ViT架构，图像级用class token的模态内对比损失获得全局判别、增强不变的表示；patch级用掩码图像建模学习各模态细粒度表示，并用跨模态对比目标对齐SAR与光学的共享子空间，同时保留互补子空间不约束以保留模态特有信息。
AI.result: 在场景分类与语义分割两个SAR-光学基准上，优于单模态SSL基线，并在多数配置下超过SOTA跨模态框架；在不同标签规模下的单模态与多模态评测中均有提升，语义分割提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 双层（图像级+patch级）跨模态自监督设计能有效利用SAR-光学互补性，缓解标注稀缺，具有较强泛化与迁移能力。

title: Cognitive Mapping of Learning by Thinking Mechanisms in Large Language Models
comment: Theoretical framework paper; 24 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly exhibit capabilities that resemble human Learning by Thinking (LbT), the acquisition of new insight through internal processes such as explanation and reasoning, without new external input. A systematic account of the cognitive mechanisms behind these capabilities, and of their limits, remains underdeveloped. This paper proposes a Cognitive LbT Framework that maps four mechanisms (Reflective Reasoning, Synthetic Memory Formation, Internal Simulation, and Conceptual Self-Organization) onto computational processes in LLMs. Drawing on representative methods, including chain-of-thought prompting, self-consistency, self-reflection, Tree-of-Thoughts search, Self-Instruct, and self-taught reasoning, the analysis argues that selected methods can functionally approximate aspects of these mechanisms and can improve performance on some tasks without additional labeled examples, although this does not always constitute durable learning in model parameters. For example, Self-Instruct generated approximately 52,000 instructions from 175 seed tasks and reported a 33% absolute improvement on Super-NaturalInstructions (Y. Wang et al., 2023). The same mechanisms also produce characteristic failures, including hallucination diffusion, model collapse, concept drift, and high computational cost. These failures are not isolated technical defects but follow from four structural asymmetries between LLMs and human cognition: the identity of generator and monitor, closed learning loops without external grounding, symbolic rather than sensorimotor simulation, and the cost of inference-time computation. The framework yields testable propositions about when LbT in LLMs should succeed or fail and offers a structured basis for designing more reliable autonomous learning systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个"认知式Learning by Thinking(LbT)框架"，将四种人类认知机制映射到LLM的计算过程，并指出其效能与失败源于LLM与人类认知之间的四种结构性不对称。
AI.motivation: LLM日益展现出类似人类"思考学习"(通过解释和推理等内部过程获得新洞察)的能力，但学界尚缺乏关于这些能力背后认知机制及其局限的系统性解释。
AI.method: 构建Cognitive LbT Framework，将四种机制(反思推理、合成记忆形成、内部模拟、概念自组织)映射到LLM计算过程，并分析代表性方法(chain-of-thought、self-consistency、self-reflection、Tree-of-Thoughts、Self-Instruct、self-taught reasoning)予以支撑。
AI.result: 部分方法可功能性地近似这些机制，在无额外标注样本时提升任务表现(如Self-Instruct从175个种子任务生成约52,000条指令，在Super-NaturalInstructions上提升33个百分点)，但这不总构成模型参数层面的持久学习；同时伴随幻觉扩散、模型崩塌、概念漂移和高计算成本等典型失败。
AI.conclusion: 这些失败并非孤立技术缺陷，而是源于四种结构性不对称(生成者与监控者同一、无外部依据的封闭学习回路、符号而非感觉运动的模拟、推理时计算成本)，该框架据此提出可检验命题，并为设计更可靠的自主学习系统提供结构化基础。

title: Continuous 3D Spatial Transcriptomics Reconstruction via Histology-Informed Implicit Neural Representations
summary: Three-dimensional spatial transcriptomics (3D ST) enables the analysis of gene-expression patterns across tissue depths. However, 3D ST measurements are acquired from discrete 2D tissue sections, which are often sparsely sampled due to high acquisition costs. To address this limitation, we propose a histology-informed multi-task implicit neural representation (HIM-INR) for continuous 3D gene-expression reconstruction from sparse ST observations. HIM-INR jointly reconstructs gene-expression profiles and histological representations using an INR with a shared backbone, leveraging densely sampled histological images as auxiliary spatial supervision. Once trained, HIM-INR predicts gene expression at arbitrary 3D coordinates without requiring histological images. Experiments on two 3D ST datasets demonstrate improved reconstruction over existing methods, particularly as the number of missing ST sections increases.

AI.tldr: 提出HIM-INR，一种结合组织学图像的多任务隐式神经表示，用于从稀疏3D空间转录组切片连续重建基因表达。
AI.motivation: 3D ST由离散2D切片测量获得，采样稀疏（采集成本高），需补全缺失切片间的连续基因表达。
AI.method: 用共享骨干的隐式神经表示（INR）联合重建基因表达与组织学表征，以密集采样的组织学图像作为辅助空间监督进行多任务训练；训练完成后，仅凭3D坐标即可预测任意位置基因表达。
AI.result: 在两个3D ST数据集上优于现有方法，且随缺失切片数量增加优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 组织学信息可作为有效辅助监督提升稀疏3D ST的连续重建质量，且推理阶段无需组织学图像。

title: Margin-Guided Token Credit for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
