summary: In reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, a language model is rewarded for a correct final answer, and GRPO passes that reward to every token of the solution in equal measure. We instead place the credit where the model hesitated, in a method we call MCPO (Margin-Credit Policy Optimization). We measure hesitation by the top-2 margin $M=p_1-p_2$ of the policy's next-token distribution, map it to a score with two fixed thresholds, and spread each solution's advantage over its tokens so that the mean stays unchanged. The margin is read from a forward pass the trainer already performs, so the method needs no extra model evaluation and no batch statistics. We train MiniCPM5-2B-Base with LoRA for 200 steps on 2,048 DAPO-Math problems and evaluate on six competition-math benchmarks. MCPO beats an unmodified GRPO baseline for all five data seeds, by 6.55 points of macro avg@32 on average (95\% CI $[4.1, 9.0]$), and a Qwen3-4B-Base replication improves for all three seeds ($+4.75$). The gain is largest on problems that GRPO solves only some of the time and grows with $k$ in pass@$k$, reaching 13.8 points at pass@32. MCPO models also write two to three times longer answers, and runs that write longer score higher; our experiments do not separate the two effects.

AI.tldr: MCPO：用策略下一 token 分布的 top-2 margin 衡量"犹豫程度"，将 GRPO 的均匀信用分配改为按犹豫程度重分配（均值不变），无需额外前向与批统计，在多数学竞赛基准上稳定超越 GRPO。
AI.motivation: GRPO 在可验证奖励 RL 中把结局奖励平均摊给解答的每个 token，忽视了模型在不同 token 处的确定性差异——真正"犹豫"的决策点才应承担更多信用。
AI.method: 以策略 next-token 分布的 top-2 margin M=p1-p2 作为犹豫度量，用两个固定阈值把 M 映射为分数，再据此把每条解答的 advantage 在 token 间重新分配且保持均值不变；margin 直接取自训练器已有的前向计算，不需要额外模型评估或 batch 统计。实验：MiniCPM5-2B-Base + LoRA，2048 道 DAPO-Math，训练 200 步，6 个竞赛数学基准评测；另做 Qwen3-4B-Base 复现。
AI.result: 对未改动 GRPO 基线，5 个数据种子全部胜出，macro avg@32 平均 +6.55（95% CI [4.1, 9.0]）；Qwen3-4B-Base 复现 3 个种子全部提升（+4.75）。增益集中在 GRPO 偶尔才对的问题上，并随 pass@k 的 k 增大而变大，pass@32 处达 13.8。MCPO 模型输出长度增加 2–3 倍，且同组内回答越长得分越高。
AI.conclusion: token 级信用按预测不确定性重分配是简单有效、开销近乎为零的 GRPO 改进；但长答案与性能提升两个效应未能解耦，存在长度混淆，需进一步剖析。

title: An Energy-Based Perspective on Machine Learning
summary: Energy-based models (EBMs) define a distribution through a scalar energy, $p_θ(x)\propto\exp(-E_θ(x))$, and are usually presented as one model family among many. This tutorial has a broader goal: beyond introducing EBMs, it uses them as a single lens that connects the different aspects of machine learning. Any EBM is specified by three choices, the energy, which determines what the model represents; the inference procedure, which samples from or optimizes the energy; and the learning method, which fits the energy to data. We first develop these components, including sampling, variational inference, and learning by maximum likelihood, noise contrastive estimation, pseudolikelihood, score matching, and adversarial training, and show that the learning methods share one contrastive structure. We then show that discriminative models, generative models such as GANs, normalizing flows, diffusion and autoregressive models, representation learning methods such as contrastive learning, word2vec, BERT, denoising auto-encoders, and diffusion representations, reinforcement learning with EBM policies and world models, inverse reinforcement learning, and planning, as well as inference-time computation with verifiers, are all EBMs that differ in these three choices, mostly in how they handle the partition function and sampling. This view explains existing methods, organizes them into a common framework, and suggests new algorithms by replacing one component while keeping the others, with composition of energies as a principled way to combine learned models at inference time.

AI.tldr: 该教程以能量模型（EBM）为统一视角，将机器学习各领域（判别/生成/表征学习、强化学习、推理时计算）视作在"能量、推断、学习"三个选择上不同的EBM。
AI.motivation: 能量模型通常只被当作众多模型家族之一来介绍。作者希望跳出这一局限，用EBM作为单一透镜，揭示看似不同的机器学习方法之间共享的结构，从而统一理解并催生新算法。
AI.method: 提出EBM由三个组件决定：能量E_θ(x)（表示什么）、推断过程（采样或优化能量）、学习方法（拟合能量到数据）。系统梳理采样、变分推断，以及最大似然、噪声对比估计、伪似然、score matching、对抗训练等学习法，并指出这些学习法共享同一对比式结构。
AI.result: 证明判别模型、GAN、归一化流、扩散与自回归模型、对比学习、word2vec、BERT、去噪自编码器、扩散表征、EBM策略与世界模型、逆强化学习、规划、验证器推理时计算等，均为仅在三个选择（尤其配分函数处理与采样方式）上不同的EBM。
AI.conclusion: 该视角可解释现有方法、将其组织进统一框架，并通过替换某一组件保留其余组件来提出新算法；能量组合则成为推理时组合已学模型的原则性方式。

title: Sim(3)-TurboReg: Robust and Efficient Scale-Aware Registration via Tri-Scale Consistency
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/ivan-zzj/Sim3-TurboReg
summary: Feed-forward 3D foundation models recover geometry at high fidelity, yet inference memory constraints keep them from processing long sequences natively. Current streaming systems work around this limit with sliding-window chunking, which introduces severe monocular scale ambiguity. Resolving this ambiguity requires Sim(3) registration that stays accurate and efficient under outlier contamination. We introduce Sim(3)-TurboReg, which reformulates the compatibility graph construction of TurboReg by replacing absolute distance constraints with a strict Tri-Scale Consistency (TSC) criterion. Our analysis shows that TSC suppresses both mismatching and coordinate-distortion outliers. We integrate the resulting solver into existing streaming systems and obtain high-fidelity, kilometer-scale reconstruction for feed-forward models. On controlled unknown-scale registration at 90% outliers, ours matches RANSAC accuracy with 92.5% lower median latency. In DA3-Streaming on KITTI, ours improves mean ATE RMSE by 22.2% and reduces mean end-to-end time by 16.6%. Code: https://github.com/ivan-zzj/Sim3-TurboReg

AI.tldr: 提出 Sim(3)-TurboReg，用 Tri-Scale Consistency 准则替换 TurboReg 的绝对距离约束，实现高外点下高效准确的 Sim(3) 配准，用于前馈 3D 模型的长序列流式重建。
AI.motivation: 前馈 3D 基础模型受推理显存限制，需用滑动窗口分块流式处理长序列，但这会导致严重的单目尺度歧义；解决该歧义需要在外点污染下仍保持准确高效的 Sim(3) 配准。
AI.method: 将 TurboReg 的兼容图构建中的绝对距离约束替换为严格的 Tri-Scale Consistency (TSC) 准则，理论分析表明 TSC 可同时抑制错误匹配外点与坐标畸变外点；再将求解器集成进已有流式系统。
AI.result: 在 90% 外点的未知尺度配准上，精度与 RANSAC 相当，中位延迟降低 92.5%；在 KITTI 的 DA3-Streaming 上平均 ATE RMSE 提升 22.2%，平均端到端时间减少 16.6%。
AI.conclusion: Sim(3)-TurboReg 使前馈模型可原生支持公里级高保真流式重建，兼顾精度与效率，代码已开源。

title: ScaleBrain: A Scale-Consistent Framework for EEG Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models pre-trained on large unlabeled electroencephalography (EEG) corpora have emerged as a transformative paradigm for Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) applications. Recent EEG foundation models have shown that multi-scale representations derived from fixed-length patches can improve EEG representation learning. Existing frameworks commonly construct temporal scales through feature-level operations. However, these operations leave the correspondence between learned features and scale-specific characteristics of the original EEG signals implicit. Moreover, when the self-supervised objective is not aligned with the multi-scale input representations, information at some temporal scales may receive insufficient supervision during pre-training. In light of this, we propose ScaleBrain, a scale-consistent pre-training framework that explicitly coordinates multi-scale representations of EEG from both the model input and optimization objective sides. Specifically, ScaleBrain introduces multi-scale EEG tokenization to represent the same EEG segment through analysis windows with different temporal spans and shared temporal anchors, and pairs these representations with scale-specific reconstruction to align with the multi-scale input structure and provide supervision across temporal resolutions during self-supervised learning. We further develop an axial spatio-temporal attention mechanism to contextualize the fused multi-scale representation along spatial and temporal dimensions. Extensive evaluations on six public BCI benchmarks against 12 representative baselines show that ScaleBrain achieves the highest mean Balanced Accuracy on five datasets and ranks third on the remaining one, with only 5.0M parameters, demonstrating strong performance and favorable parameter efficiency.

AI.tldr: ScaleBrain是一个尺度一致性的EEG预训练框架，从模型输入和优化目标两端显式协调多尺度表示，仅用5.0M参数在六个BCI基准上取得强劲性能。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG基础模型通过特征级操作构建时间尺度，导致学习特征与原始信号尺度特性之间的对应关系不明确；且当自监督目标与多尺度输入表示不对齐时，某些时间尺度在预训练中监督不足。
AI.method: 提出多尺度EEG分词，用不同时间跨度但共享时间锚点的分析窗表示同一EEG片段；配合尺度特定重建以对齐多尺度输入结构并提供跨时间分辨率监督；并设计轴向时空注意力机制，沿空间和时间维度对融合的多尺度表示进行上下文建模。
AI.result: 在六个公开BCI基准上与12个代表性基线对比，ScaleBrain在五个数据集上取得最高平均平衡准确率，在剩余一个上排名第三，且仅需5.0M参数。
AI.conclusion: ScaleBrain通过输入与目标的尺度一致性设计，在保持参数高效的同时实现了优异的EEG表示学习与BCI性能。

title: SpecValley: Aggregation as Spectral Valley in Dense Heterophilic Graphs
summary: Node classification in heterophilic graphs remains an open problem: aggregating over neighbourhoods can damp precisely the part of the signal that carries the labels. The field has answered with ever more expressive propagation operators, leaving the aggregation step that precedes them fixed by degree normalisation. However, degree normalisation acts as a spectral valley in its own right, attenuating a fixed middle band whose position at lambda equal 1 is set by the normalisation rather than by the data, exactly where the eigenvalues of dense graphs accumulate. We therefore begin with the representations rather than the propagation, in two stages: a learnable aggregation followed by an ordinary spectral filter. The first, SpecValley learns the position, sharpness and flank gains of the valley for every graph. We show formally how the aggregation operator and downstream filter interact. We establish that the response 1 minus lambda of degree normalisation vanishes exactly at that accumulation point. A spectral energy budget shows that what aggregation removes from a band, no linear spectral filter can recover. Crowding alone says nothing about the benefit. That is decided by how much label energy the valley removes, which we measure for every graph. SpecValley achieves strong results across heterophilic benchmarks, and a controlled ablation over aggregation operators and downstream filters attributes the gain to aggregation rather than the filter.

AI.tldr: 论文指出异质图中的节点分类难点源于聚合前的度归一化：它像一条固定在λ=1的“谱谷”，恰好压掉稠密图特征值聚集处承载标签的信号。作者提出先学表示再滤波的两阶段方案 SpecValley，为每张图学习该谱谷的位置、锐度与两翼增益，并给出聚合算子与下游滤波交互的理论分析及“谱能量预算”证明聚合删掉的频段无法被线性滤波恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有异质图方法不断追求更强表达力的传播算子，却把聚合步骤前的度归一化当作固定设定。度归一化本身是一条谱谷，其位置由归一化而非数据决定，恰好位于稠密图特征值累积处，会衰减承载标签的中间频段信号，因此需要从表示端而非传播端入手改进。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：先做可学习的聚合（SpecValley），对每张图学习谱谷的位置、锐度和两侧增益；随后接一个普通谱滤波器。理论上形式化聚合算子与下游滤波器的交互，证明度归一化响应 1−λ 在该特征值聚集点恰为零，并用谱能量预算论证聚合移除的频段信息无法被任何线性谱滤波恢复；再为每张图度量谱谷所移除的标签能量，以判断收益来源。
AI.result: SpecValley 在多个异质图基准上取得较强结果；对聚合算子与下游滤波器做受控消融，表明性能增益来自聚合阶段而非滤波器。
AI.conclusion: 异质图节点分类的关键瓶颈在于聚合阶段的度归一化导致的谱谷，而非传播算子表达力不足；学习聚合的谱谷特性可有效恢复标签信号，且增益可归因于聚合本身。

title: Structured Confidence Perturbation via Fisher Geometry for Adversarial Training
summary: Adversarial training is often plagued by "pseudo-attacks", perturbations that significantly increase the loss value but fail to truly alter the model's confidence structure. To address this, we propose two complementary approaches to directly attack and defend against confidence structure deformation. First, building upon the traditional loss maximization perspective, we introduce a hybrid objective that integrates cross-entropy and KL divergence, encouraging adversarial examples to simultaneously disrupt prediction accuracy and distribution consistency. Second, we geometrically reconstruct adversarial training by generating perturbations that maximize the distribution distance on the confidence manifold. Theoretical analysis shows that the optimal perturbation direction aligns with the principal eigenvectors of the Fisher information matrix. We also propose an efficient algorithm to avoid high-dimensional matrix computations. Experiments on multiple datasets and model architectures demonstrate that our method outperforms existing methods in adversarial robustness and robust transferability, particularly excelling in structural perturbations within high-confidence regions.

AI.tldr: 针对对抗训练中"伪攻击"问题，提出融合交叉熵与KL散度的混合目标，并从置信度流形几何角度重构对抗训练，理论证明最优扰动方向对齐Fisher信息矩阵主特征向量，并给出高效算法。
AI.motivation: 对抗训练常受"伪攻击"困扰：这类扰动虽大幅提升损失值，却未真正改变模型的置信度结构，导致训练信号无效。因此需要直接攻击并防御置信度结构形变。
AI.method: 两条互补路径：(1) 在传统损失最大化基础上引入交叉熵与KL散度的混合目标，使对抗样本同时破坏预测准确性与分布一致性；(2) 在置信度流形上生成最大化分布距离的扰动，几何重构对抗训练。理论分析表明最优扰动方向与Fisher信息矩阵主特征向量对齐，并提出高效算法规避高维矩阵计算。
AI.result: 多数据集、多模型架构实验表明，方法在对抗鲁棒性与鲁棒迁移性上优于现有方法，尤其在高置信度区域的结构性扰动上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模与攻击置信度结构形变，可缓解伪攻击、提升对抗训练的有效性与鲁棒迁移能力，为对抗训练提供几何视角的新思路。

title: Precision on Demand: Escalating Weight Bits at Uncertain Decoding Steps in a Small Local Model
summary: Local decoding usually fixes one weight precision for the whole generation. We study a different allocation: store 8-bit weights, decode with their top 4 bits, and redo a step at 8 bits only when the low-precision output distribution looks uncertain (entropy above a threshold or a small top-two margin). Quantization is simulated, the model is Qwen3-0.6B, and the benchmark is GSM8K. Cost is counted in weight bytes read per token. On 36724 replayed steps the entropy of the low pass ranks argmax flips with AUC 0.93. At a 15% escalation budget it catches 78% of flips and the margin gate 94%, against the 15% expected for a random gate of equal rate (a computed expectation, not a run). In 150 live problems all-high scores 64.0% and all-low 55.3% (McNemar p=0.053). An entropy gate with a 16% escalation rate scores 62.7% at 0.87 of the all-high weight bytes. Its paired difference is -1.3 (-8.0 to +5.3) points to all-high and +7.3 (+0.0 to +14.7) points to all-low (p=0.080), so the live data do not separate the gate from either end. Verified speculation reaches zero KL at similar bytes in the same cost model. A live random control, a thinking-mode phase rule, a second model and live KL were not run.

AI.tldr: 研究一种"按需升级精度"的解码方案：以8位存储权重、用高4位解码，仅当低精度输出分布不确定时以8位重算该步。在Qwen3-0.6B/GSM8K上，熵门控能有效预测argmax翻转，但实机效果尚未与全高或全低精度显著区分。
AI.motivation: 常规局部解码对整个生成过程固定一种权重量化精度，浪费计算与内存带宽。作者希望按步动态分配精度：多数步用低价4位解码，只在结果可能不可靠时升级到8位，从而在更少权重字节下逼近8位精度。
AI.method: 存储8位权重，用高4位解码；以低精度输出分布的熵阈值或top-2 margin作为"不确定性"信号触发升级，将步以8位重算。量化是模拟的，模型为Qwen3-0.6B，基准GSM8K，成本按每token读取的权重字节计。离线回放36724步并计算门控对argmax翻转的AUC与召回；再做150道题的实机实验，与全高/全低精度配对比较（McNemar、自举置信区间）。
AI.result: 低精度熵对argmax翻转的判别AUC为0.93。在15%升级预算下熵门控捕获78%翻转、margin门控94%（随机门控期望仅15%，为计算值而非实测）。150道实机题中全高64.0%、全低55.3%（McNemar p=0.053）。熵门控以16%升级率得分62.7%，权重字节为全高的0.87；与全高的配对差-1.3（-8.0~+5.3）分，与全低的差+7.3（+0.0~+14.7）分（p=0.080），实机数据无法区分门控与两端。另"verified speculation"在同等成本模型下以相近字节达到零KL。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性门控在离线统计上能很好地预测低精度解码的argmax翻转，但在150题的实机上，其性能既未显著优于也未显著差于固定精度两端，证据不足以支持该动态精度方案的实际收益。缺少实机随机对照、thinking模式分段规则、第二个模型以及实机KL测量，结论需进一步验证。

title: DailyWildfireCAN: A Dataset and Benchmark for Next-Day Wildfire Spread Prediction in Canada
summary: Wildfires represent a critical ecological and socio-economic challenge in Canada, where vast boreal forests and a warming climate have amplified the frequency and severity of extreme fire seasons. Predicting next-day wildfire spread can support fire management, but requires capturing complex interactions among weather, fuels, and terrain. Deep learning has emerged as a promising approach to learning these relationships from heterogeneous environmental data, yet its development and evaluation depend on representative datasets. Existing deep learning research on wildfire spread relies predominantly on US-focused datasets, leaving Canadian fire environments underrepresented. To address this gap, we present DailyWildfireCAN, a multi-modal, multi-temporal dataset and benchmark for predicting next-day wildfire spread across Canada. The dataset tracks continuous fire progression over multi-day events at a high spatial and temporal resolution of 90-m and 24-hour, respectively. This resolution preserves fine-scale information relevant to fire-edge geometry, local fuel variations, and terrain effects, supporting research toward improved daily wildfire spread forecasting. DailyWildfireCAN covers 2,440 wildfire events across eight fire seasons 2017-2024 and integrates 33 features across diverse modalities, including topography, meteorology, land cover, vegetation and forest structure, human influence indices, and satellite imagery. We establish a comprehensive benchmark comparing mono-temporal and multi-temporal prediction models, accompanied by a multi-dimensional evaluation framework assessing robustness across wildfire characteristics, geographic regions, and temporal conditions, spatial prediction quality, and sensitivity to reference label variations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DailyWildfireCAN，一个面向加拿大次日野火蔓延预测的多模态、多时相数据集与基准，覆盖2017-2024年8个火季共2440场野火事件，空间分辨率90米、时间分辨率24小时，整合33个跨模态特征，并建立单时相/多时相模型对比的多维评估框架。
AI.motivation: 加拿大野火频发且气候变暖加剧极端火季，次日蔓延预测对消防管理至关重要，但需刻画天气、燃料与地形的复杂交互。现有深度学习研究主要依赖美国数据集，加拿大火环境代表性不足，缺乏相应数据支撑。
AI.method: 构建DailyWildfireCAN数据集：以90米空间分辨率、24小时间隔连续追踪多日火事件演变，保留火线几何、局部燃料差异与地形效应等细尺度信息；整合地形、气象、土地覆盖、植被与林分结构、人类影响指数及卫星影像共33个特征；并设立单时相与多时相模型的统一基准和多维评估体系（考察不同火特征、地理区域、时间条件下的稳健性、空间预测质量及对参考标签变化的敏感性）。
AI.result: 数据集覆盖2440场野火事件、8个火季（2017-2024），含33个多模态特征；基准实验完成单时相与多时相预测模型的对比，并通过多维评估框架量化模型在火情特征、区域、时间条件、空间预测质量及标签敏感性方面的表现。
AI.conclusion: DailyWildfireCAN填补了加拿大野火蔓延预测数据空白，为多模态深度学习研究提供高分辨率数据与标准化基准，推动更可靠的每日野火蔓延预报研究。

title: Generalizing Causal Decision-Making: Markov Equivalence, Transportability and Counterfactuals
summary: Structural causal bandits use causal knowledge to guide exploration when reward mechanisms are unknown. This paper extends the approach to partially known causal structure, information from other environments, and realizable counterfactual actions. First, we develop graphical criteria for minimal intervention sets under Markov equivalence and characterize possibly-optimal minimal intervention sets for maximal ancestral graphs. A search algorithm finds sets that are possibly optimal in at least one graph represented by a partial ancestral graph. Second, we derive target reward bounds from source distributions through partial transportability, accounting for non-manipulable variables. Dominance relations provide further bounds for action pruning and restricted exploration, with a regret guarantee under valid prior bounds. Third, we formulate counterfactual structural causal bandits over actions supported by specified experimental capabilities. Graphical characterizations of minimality and possible optimality yield algorithms that remove equivalent or dominated choices while preserving an optimal action. Experiments with specified structural causal models examine how these reductions and transferred bounds affect learning. Together, these results clarify how causal knowledge and experimental capabilities determine which actions merit exploration and guide learning within the retained action space.

AI.tldr: 本文将结构因果老虎机扩展到部分已知因果结构、跨环境信息迁移与可实现反事实动作三种现实情形，并给出动作约简与迁移界的理论与算法。
AI.motivation: 经典结构因果老虎机假设因果结构完全已知，但实际中因果图往往只部分已知、目标环境数据稀缺、可用干预受实验能力限制，需要明确哪些动作值得探索。
AI.method: (1) 在马尔可夫等价类下给出最小干预集的图准则，并在最大祖先图上刻画可能最优的最小干预集，提出在部分祖先图所代表图中至少一处可能最优的搜索算法；(2) 通过部分可迁移性从源分布推导目标奖励界，考虑不可操纵变量，并利用支配关系进一步界定动作剪枝与受限探索，给出有效先验界下的遗憾保证；(3) 形式化受实验能力约束的反事实结构因果老虎机，给出最小性与可能最优性的图刻画及去除等价/被支配动作且保留最优动作的算法。
AI.result: 在指定结构因果模型实验中考察了这些约简与迁移界对学习的影响，表明它们能有效缩减动作空间并保持最优动作。
AI.conclusion: 因果知识与实验能力共同决定哪些动作值得探索，据此可在保留的动作空间内指导学习，并具备遗憾层面保证。

title: Evaluating LLM-Generated World Models for Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
summary: Formal world models can support planning, verification, and safety reasoning, but constructing them from open-ended natural-language situations is difficult, particularly in multi-agent settings where several formalizations may be plausible. We study whether five LLMs can generate such world models as partially observable stochastic games and whether mechanical validity is sufficient to establish that the resulting model faithfully represents the intended decision problem. We introduce a benchmark of 44 scenarios spanning game, situational, and cultural settings and evaluate generated world models along three dimensions: mechanical validity, reference-relative structural agreement, and semantic criteria. Across three empirical tracks, we analyze 410 first-pass generations. In the reference-backed game track, 134/135 generated world models pass a strict mechanical audit, yet mean permutation-invariant structural F1 is only 0.366, with just 28/134 mechanically valid models exactly matching the authored reference. In the cultural track, explicitly naming the country changes the generated structural representation for most LLMs while producing only small changes in automated semantic scores. These results show that executability is a necessary but insufficient criterion for LLM-generated world models: models that are mechanically valid can still differ substantially in the structure used by downstream neuro-symbolic reasoning and planning.

AI.tldr: 研究5个LLM能否将开放自然语言情境生成为部分可观测随机博弈(POSG)世界模型，发现"机制有效性≠忠实性"：410次生成中机制审计通过率极高，但结构F1仅0.366。
AI.motivation: 形式化世界模型对规划、验证与安全推理有价值，但从开放式多智能体自然语言中构建困难，且存在多种合理形式化；作者质疑"机械可执行性是否足以证明模型忠实反映原决策问题"。
AI.method: 构建含44个场景（博弈、情境、文化）的基准；让5个LLM生成POSG世界模型；沿三维度评估：机械有效性、参考相对的结构一致性、语义标准；共三条实证轨道、分析410个首轮生成。
AI.result: 参考支撑的博弈轨道中134/135通过严格机械审计，但置换不变结构F1均值仅0.366，仅28/134机制有效模型与人工参考完全一致；文化轨道中显式点名国家会改变多数LLM的结构表示，而自动语义分数变化很小。
AI.conclusion: 可执行性是LLM生成世界模型的必要但不充分条件：机制有效的模型仍可能在用于下游神经符号推理与规划的结构上差异显著，需补充结构与语义层面的评估。

title: ViGA-FLAME: Aligning Latent Visual and Geometric Representations for Robust 3D Head Expression Estimation
summary: Estimating 3D head expression from a single image requires mapping visual appearance to underlying facial geometry. We propose ViGA-FLAME, a two-stage framework that aligns semantic visual features with a structured geometric latent space. First, a Parametric-Geometric Variational Autoencoder (PG-VAE) learns a unified representation of canonical head surfaces and FLAME parameters, supporting both detailed surface reconstruction and interpretable parameter recovery. Supervision on geometry and parameters, together with consistency between the two decoding branches, connects surface detail with parametric structure. Second, a trainable Visual-Geometric Adapter (ViGA) maps features from a pretrained semantic visual encoder into this latent space. Asymmetric attention enables ViGA to align semantic image features from the visual encoder with the structured geometric information represented in the PG-VAE latent space, without altering the original visual stream. By grounding image evidence in this latent prior, ViGA-FLAME enables robust 3D head expression estimation across severe facial deformations and large viewing angles, efficiently improving robustness over competing feed-forward methods.

AI.tldr: ViGA-FLAME提出两阶段框架，先将规范头部表面与FLAME参数联合编码为统一潜空间，再用视觉-几何适配器把预训练语义视觉特征映射进该潜空间，实现单图鲁棒3D头部表情估计。
AI.motivation: 单图3D头部表情估计需将视觉外观映射到面部几何，但现有前馈方法在严重面部形变和大视角下鲁棒性不足，且缺乏语义视觉特征与结构化参数几何之间的有效对齐。
AI.method: 第一阶段训练参数-几何变分自编码器（PG-VAE），联合学习规范头部表面与FLAME参数的统一表示，通过几何与参数监督及两条解码分支间一致性约束连接表面细节与参数结构；第二阶段训练视觉-几何适配器（ViGA），利用非对称注意力将冻结的预训练语义视觉编码器特征对齐到PG-VAE潜空间，且不改变原视觉流。
AI.result: 在严重面部形变和大观察角度下实现鲁棒的3D头部表情估计，以高效方式优于竞争的前馈方法。
AI.conclusion: 以结构化几何潜先验作为图像证据的对齐目标，可有效提升单图3D头部表情估计的鲁棒性，并保持可解释的参数恢复能力。

title: Opportunity-Cost Option-Critic: Adaptive Switching Costs for Robust Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deliberation costs are commonly used in hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) to prevent options from collapsing to primitive actions. Existing approaches rely on fixed penalties or duration-based adaptations, both of which are indirect proxies for an option's utility. This paper argues that option persistence should instead depend on the opportunity cost of abandoning the current behavior. We propose the Opportunity-Cost Option-Critic ($OC^2$) framework, which defines a state-dependent deliberation cost using the positive value gap between the active option and its best alternative. This encourages persistence when the current option is clearly preferable and allows rapid switching when a better option emerges. We show that directly learning such costs leads to a degenerate zero-cost solution and introduces an auxiliary objective that aligns the learned cost with the value-gap target. The approach is evaluated in Four Rooms and Pinball domains under stationary, goal-shift, and geometry-shift conditions. In the Pinball goal-shift task, the $OC^2$ framework achieves a 52\% first-ten-episode success rate compared with 18\% for a fixed-cost baseline. The results suggest that opportunity-cost-based persistence improves adaptation in non-stationary environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出机会成本选项-评论家框架（OC²），用当前选项与最佳替代选项之间的正向价值差定义状态依赖的深思成本，从而决定选项是否持续，改善非平稳环境下的适应能力。
AI.motivation: 现有HRL中防止选项退化为原始动作的深思成本多采用固定惩罚或基于时长的自适应，这些都是选项效用的间接替代指标，无法反映放弃当前行为的真实代价。
AI.method: 提出OC²框架，以状态依赖的深思成本度量当前活动选项与最佳替代选项的正向价值差；指出直接学习该成本会导致退化的零成本解，因此引入辅助目标使学习成本对齐价值差目标。
AI.result: 在Four Rooms与Pinball域上，于平稳、目标转移和几何转移条件下评估；Pinball目标转移任务中，OC²前十个episode成功率为52%，固定成本基线为18%。
AI.conclusion: 基于机会成本的持续性机制能提升非平稳环境中的适应能力，说明选项持续应由放弃当前行为的机会成本决定。

title: Re-Search: Dissecting LLM Ideation Through a Two-Player Questioning Game
summary: Research ideation is iterative: researchers refine their ideas step by step based on feedback. Yet existing evaluations obscure this search process, making it difficult to understand how LLMs explore the space of research ideas and what limits their progress. We introduce Re-Search, which adapts the format of Twenty Questions to research ideation: given only the research problem of a published paper, a model must rediscover the paper's core idea by asking yes-or-no questions. Built from 200 ICML 2026 papers, Re-Search tracks how a model's idea evolves as it asks questions and receives binary oracle feedback, isolating ideation from execution. Across six recent LLMs, nearly all progress happens within the first 30 of 100 questions, which largely decide how the game ends; after that, most models plateau. Through controlled interventions on the candidate questions and the hypothesis space, we find that the bottleneck is generation, not judgment: models recognize a good idea or a good question when one is offered, but often cannot produce it on their own. We further analyze the ideation traces and find that models fail by either over-exploiting one direction or over-exploring too many. These findings point to concrete design principles for autoresearch systems: since models can judge candidates they cannot produce, enriching the search with externally sourced ideas and questions may be more effective than improving any single model's generation ability.

AI.tldr: We introduce Re-Search, a Twenty Questions-style benchmark built from 200 ICML 2026 papers that evaluates LLM research ideation as an iterative search process, revealing a generation-not-judgment bottleneck and characteristic failure modes.
AI.motivation: Existing research ideation evaluations produce only a final output, obscuring the iterative search process and limiting understanding of how LLMs explore research idea space and where their progress plateaus.
AI.method: Adapt Twenty Questions: given only the research problem of a published paper, the model asks yes/no questions with binary oracle feedback to rediscover the paper's core idea. Tests six recent LLMs; performs controlled interventions on candidate questions and hypothesis space; analyzes ideation traces.
AI.result: Nearly all progress occurs within the first 30 of 100 questions; afterwards most models plateau. Interventions show the bottleneck is generation, not judgment—models recognize good ideas/questions when offered but rarely produce them. Failures arise from either over-exploiting one direction or over-exploring too many.
AI.conclusion: Design principle for autoresearch systems: since models can judge candidates they cannot generate, enriching search with externally sourced ideas and questions may outperform improving a single model's generation ability.

title: Location Matters: Sparse Latent-Variance Attacks for Face Privacy against Diffusion Personalization
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can learn and reproduce an individual's identity from only a few reference photos, creating risks of unauthorized and misleading content generation. Proactive defenses address this risk by adding adversarial perturbations to facial images before release, thereby disrupting identity acquisition during downstream personalization. However, existing methods typically rely on dense $L_\infty$-bounded perturbations, whose accumulated distortions can become visible around facial structures. Recent methods improve protected-image quality, but often at the cost of reduced protection effectiveness. In this paper, we propose Sparse Encoder Attack on Latent Variance (SEAL), a sparse adversarial protection framework that modifies only 5% of the spatial locations in a facial image. SEAL combines a differentiable top-k masking scheme that jointly optimizes perturbation locations and values with a variance-oriented objective over the frozen VAE encoder's latent distribution to disrupt identity-consistent representations. A saliency-guided dispersion penalty further discourages perturbation concentration in perceptually salient facial regions. Experiments on CelebA-HQ and VGGFace2 show that SEAL achieves the best protected-image quality among the compared methods, exceeding 41 dB PSNR with 0.97 SSIM and at most 0.07 LPIPS, while reducing identity similarity to at most 0.15 after diffusion personalization. These results demonstrate that sparse location optimization enables strong identity protection while preserving high visual quality. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Lvxan/SEAL

AI.tldr: SEAL：一种仅修改人脸图像5%空间位置的稀疏对抗保护框架，通过可微top-k掩码联合优化扰动的位置和值，并针对冻结VAE编码器的隐变量分布设计方差导向目标，实现高视觉质量与强身份保护。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型仅需少量参考照片即可学习并复现个人身份，存在未授权与误导性内容生成的风险。主动防御通过在发布前对人脸图像添加对抗扰动来破坏下游个性化中的身份获取。但现有方法依赖稠密L∞有界扰动，累积失真在面部结构周围可见；近期提升图像质量的方法又往往以牺牲保护效果为代价。
AI.method: 提出SEAL稀疏对抗保护框架，仅修改人脸图像5%的空间位置。方法包含：1）可微top-k掩码机制，联合优化扰动的位置与数值；2）在冻结VAE编码器的隐变量分布上设计方差导向目标，破坏身份一致性表征；3）显著性引导的分散惩罚，抑制扰动集中在感知显著的面部区域。
AI.result: 在CelebA-HQ与VGGFace2上，SEAL在对比方法中取得最佳保护图像质量，PSNR超过41 dB、SSIM达0.97、LPIPS至多0.07；同时经扩散个性化后身份相似度降至至多0.15。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏位置优化能够在保持高视觉质量的同时实现强身份保护，验证了该框架的有效性。

title: Hierarchical Graph Representation Learning with Pooling-Induced Substructures
summary: Hierarchical graph-level tasks that require reasoning over substructures that extend beyond local neighborhoods are posing challenges for standard Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). While graph pooling aims to address this by coarsening graphs into hierarchical representations, existing methods often fail to explicitly preserve the substructures they induce, leading to inconsistent empirical performance. Moreover, evaluating such approaches remains challenging due to the lack of benchmarks with explicit hierarchical structure. We propose Pooled-Substructure-Aware GNNs, an approach to graph pooling that explicitly preserves and processes substructures uncovered by structure-based pooling schemes. We show that this design enhances the expressive power of pooling-based GNNs in the sense of the Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL) test. To enable principled evaluation, we introduce two new synthetic datasets with controllable hierarchical structure and propose a metric to characterize the prevalence of hierarchical patterns in real-world graph-level benchmarks. On tasks with relevant hierarchical structure, our approach outperforms matched pooling baselines, while remaining competitive on structurally simpler benchmarks. Code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/lsbicego/PSA-GNN/.

AI.tldr: 提出Pooled-Substructure-Aware GNNs（PSA-GNN），在结构池化过程中显式保留并处理池化诱导的子结构，从WL角度提升表达能力，并提供两个可控层次结构的合成数据集与一个衡量真实基准层次模式普遍性的指标。
AI.motivation: 标准GNN难以处理需要超越局部邻域推理的层次化图级任务；现有图池化方法在粗化图时往往没有显式保留其诱导的子结构，导致经验表现不稳定；同时缺乏具有明确层次结构的基准用于评估。
AI.method: 设计PSA-GNN：在基于结构的池化方案中显式保留并处理池化所揭示的子结构；理论分析其在Weisfeiler-Lehman测试意义下的表达能力增强；构建两个层次结构可控的合成数据集，并提出刻画真实图级基准中层次模式普遍性的度量指标。
AI.result: 在具有相关层次结构的任务上优于匹配的池化基线，在结构更简单的基准上保持竞争力；理论证明表达能力提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式保留池化子结构是提升池化GNN层次化推理能力的有效设计，配套的合成数据集与指标为层次结构评估提供原则性手段；代码与数据已公开。

title: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
summary: Business process automation runs the same Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) again and again on new inputs. Large Language Model (LLM) agents can follow an SOP written in natural language, but they call an LLM to choose every step of every run, which adds latency and cost at scale. We present ReTrace, which turns an SOP and a few logged agent runs into a reusable workflow in which code, not an LLM, selects the next step. The agent's reasoning, the explanation it writes with each tool call, often states why it took an action; the tool calls alone do not. ReTrace extracts the condition behind each step, merges these conditions across runs into a compact rule document, and generates an executable workflow from it. Only this last stage depends on the platform, so rule documents can be compiled for different orchestration platforms. On $79$ procedures from our production platform, ReTrace workflows reach $93.8\%$ completion, against $96.8\%$ for the agent, at $24\%$ lower cost per task. On $τ^2$-Bench, they reach $75.8\%$ task success (agent: $80.6\%$) and run in $1.3$s instead of $170$s; three rounds of repair on training failures lift $k{=}2$ workflows from $66.7\%$ to $81.2\%$. On eight SOP-Bench procedures, ReTrace without repair trails few-shot generation ($80.6\%$ vs. $83.6\%$), but repair from labeled training failures lifts it to $87.8\%$ at $0.40$s per task, compared to $85.5\%$ in $46.6$s for the agent.

title: AutoThreshold: Joint Confusion-Profile Learning for Adaptive Mask Binarization
summary: A single validation-tuned threshold can become brittle when dense-score distributions shift. We introduce AutoThreshold, a post-hoc policy that predicts the joint mass of positive and negative pixels over score bins. This target directly parameterizes threshold-indexed confusion counts, avoiding products of independently estimated prevalence and class-conditional rates. Softmax normalization and cumulative decoding yield coherent, monotone confusion profiles; a plug-in decoder then selects a threshold for any $F_β$ objective without retraining the head. Across three independently trained Kvasir pipelines transferred to four polyp datasets, Joint exceeds continuous Otsu by $0.0080 \pm 0.0046$ external macro Dice, with positive gains in 3/3 runs. On the reference pipeline, three head seeds achieve $0.6324 \pm 0.0027$, 0.0085 above Otsu; direct-utility Ridge achieves 0.6342, with the paired difference interval spanning zero. The same Joint checkpoints outperform Otsu for $F_{0.5}$, Dice, and $F_2$. On developmental KITTI Road leave-one-corruption-family-out evaluation, Joint improves over scalar regression by 0.0082 [0.0064, 0.0101], while direct utility is 0.0022 higher. These results establish joint confusion prediction as a useful, metric-retargetable inductive bias, without claiming Bayes-optimal $F_β$ decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoThreshold：后处理头预测各分数区间正/负像素联合质量，参数化阈值索引的混淆计数，实现无需重训即可按任意F_β选阈。
AI.motivation: 单一验证集调优的阈值在分数分布漂移时容易失效，且分别估计患病率与类条件率再相乘易引入误差。
AI.method: 学习分数区间内正负像素的联合质量，经softmax归一化与累积解码得到单调混淆曲线，再用插件式解码器按目标F_β选阈值（Joint头）；与连续Otsu、标量回归、直接效用Ridge对比。
AI.result: Kvasir→4个息肉数据集迁移：Joint外部宏Dice比Otsu高0.0080±0.0046（3/3正增益）；参考流程三个种子0.6324±0.0027，高Otsu 0.0085；直接效用Ridge 0.6342，配对区间跨零。F0.5/Dice/F2均优于Otsu。KITTI Road留一腐化族：Joint比标量回归高0.0082 [0.0064,0.0101]，直接效用再高0.0022。
AI.conclusion: 联合混淆预测是有用且可切换指标的先验偏置，但不等同于贝叶斯最优F_β决策。

title: Right for the Wrong Reasons? Evaluating Plausibility and Behavioral Change in Explanation-Guided Learning
comment: Accepted at EXPLAINS 2026 (Best Student Paper Award). Pre-review manuscript
summary: Explanation-Guided Learning (EGL) promises models that are not only accurate but also rely on task-relevant evidence. However, whether improved agreement between model explanations and human-provided rationales also implies a changed decision strategy remains unclear. We study this tension under controlled synthetic shortcut introduction using a constructed shortcut dataset. Inspired by real-world applications, our benchmark covers shortcuts of different kinds, including localized, background-based, and global cues. This allows us to evaluate whether different EGL objectives produce behavioral changesand explanatory changes. Across these axes, we find that the effects of EGL are strongly objective-specific. Rationale-based data augmentation provides the clearest robustness gains when shortcut evidence can be separated from task-relevant foreground information, reaching average accuracy improvements of up to +4.8 percentage points (pp) together with increased foreground reliance. Attribution-constraining objectives primarily improve explanation plausibility, increasing Importance Mass by up to +14 pp on average, but provide weaker and less consistent behavioral correction, with average accuracy gains of at most +1.6 pp. Moreover, neither improved robustness nor improved plausibility reliably implies higher perturbation-based fidelity. Overall, our results show that EGL can be useful, but its success cannot be inferred from rationale agreement alone and should instead be evaluated along complementary behavioral and explanation-level axes. We publicly release all experimental results to enable further analysis (https://right-for-wrong-reasons.dfki.de/).

AI.tldr: 本文通过合成捷径数据集，系统评估不同Explanation-Guided Learning目标对模型行为与解释的影响，发现效果高度依赖目标类型，且解释一致性不能推断真实决策策略改变。
AI.motivation: 解释引导学习（EGL）希望模型既准确又依赖任务相关证据，但"模型解释与人工理由更一致"是否意味着决策策略真正改变尚不明确。作者希望厘清这一张力。
AI.method: 构建含多种捷径（局部化、背景型、全局线索）的合成捷径数据集，在受控条件下引入捷径，比较不同EGL目标（基于理由的数据增强、归因约束等）在行为层面与解释层面的变化。
AI.result: 效果强烈依赖目标：基于理由的数据增强在捷径可与前景信息分离时鲁棒性提升最明显，平均准确率最高+4.8pp且前景依赖增加；归因约束目标主要提升解释合理性，Importance Mass平均最高+14pp，但行为纠正较弱（准确率最多+1.6pp）。且鲁棒性或合理性提升都不能可靠保证更高的扰动保真度。
AI.conclusion: EGL可能有效，但其成功不能仅凭理由一致性推断，应从行为与解释两个互补维度评估。作者公开全部实验结果以支持后续分析。

title: UniFlow-RS: Unified Generative Prediction for Heterogeneous Remote-Sensing Tasks
summary: Remote-sensing foundation models increasingly unify representations across sensing modalities and downstream tasks, yet their prediction mechanisms remain largely task-specific. Separate decoders, prediction heads, and objectives leave prediction fragmented across tasks. This naturally raises a question: can heterogeneous remote-sensing tasks share the prediction process? UniFlow-RS answers this question with a single latent flow-matching predictor shared across tasks. This requires addressing two key challenges: unifying heterogeneous prediction spaces and harmonizing joint optimization across tasks. First, we cast heterogeneous task outputs into structured visual targets in a common latent space, allowing them to be modeled by the same pretrained flow predictor. Task-dependent conditioning further accommodates differences in input configurations. Second, we optimize all tasks with a common Flow Matching objective, eliminating task-specific prediction losses. To mitigate optimization mismatch across tasks and modalities, we introduce Task-Modality Adaptive Timestep Sampling (TMAS), which dynamically allocates training timesteps according to the online learning state of each task-modality group. Using a single shared model, UniFlow-RS handles six tasks and thirteen datasets, surpassing recent task-specific state-of-the-art methods on several benchmarks while remaining competitive on the others. Beyond these benchmarks, the same checkpoint demonstrates strong zero-shot transfer across unseen datasets, task settings, occlusion conditions, and near-infrared false-color imagery, without target-specific adaptation.

AI.tldr: UniFlow-RS 提出用单一 latent flow-matching 预测器统一异构遥感任务，通过将不同任务输出映射到共享隐空间的视觉目标、统一 Flow Matching 目标函数，并引入 Task-Modality Adaptive Timestep Sampling (TMAS)，实现六任务十三数据集的统一预测并展现强零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 遥感基础模型虽在表征上日益统一，但预测机制仍高度任务特定：各任务使用独立解码器、预测头和损失函数，导致预测过程碎片化。作者由此提出核心问题——异构遥感任务能否共享同一预测过程。
AI.method: 1) 将异构任务输出转为公共隐空间中的结构化视觉目标，使同一预训练 flow predictor 可建模，并用任务相关条件化适配不同输入配置；2) 所有任务采用统一的 Flow Matching 目标，去除任务专属预测损失；3) 提出 TMAS，根据各任务-模态组的在线学习状态动态分配训练时间步，缓解跨任务与跨模态的优化失配。
AI.result: 单一共享模型覆盖 6 个任务、13 个数据集，在部分基准上超越近期任务特定 SOTA，其余基准保持竞争力；同一 checkpoint 在未见数据集、任务设置、遮挡条件及近红外假彩色影像上实现强零样本迁移，无需目标特定适配。
AI.conclusion: 统一隐空间建模加统一生成式目标可有效实现遥感多任务预测共享，TMAS 是缓解联合优化失配的关键；该范式具备良好的泛化与零样本迁移潜力。

title: HaiRuo: Forecasting Ocean Eddies as Fields and Objects with a Satellite-Altimetry Foundation Model
summary: Mesoscale eddies carry most of the ocean's kinetic energy and move heat, salt and nutrients across basins, yet where an eddy will be two weeks ahead is still read off ocean models with post-hoc tracking heuristics. We introduce HaiRuo, which forecasts eddies as fields and as objects at once: from 30 days of satellite sea-level maps, one forward pass returns 15 days of sea level and geostrophic velocity, daily eddy masks and the trajectory of every eddy alive today. HaiRuo pairs two components with a clear division of labour: (1) HaiRuo-1B, an open-weight 1.05-billion-parameter foundation model pretrained without labels on 24 years of global satellite-altimetry observations, which supplies the 15-day physical fields and masks (+0.14 field skill and +1.1 mIoU points under the same decoder) and further lowers 15-day centre error by 1.2 km frozen (1.35 km over training from scratch); and (2) XuanJi, a Lagrangian object decoder that samples the evolving forecast in each eddy's co-moving polar frame and refines the 15-day path across three look-ahead rounds, removing 2.5 km on HaiRuo-1B (2.9 km with joint fine-tuning) and 2.5-3.3 km via its object attention across six published backbones. Under one pre-registered global evaluation over the whole ocean, HaiRuo improves on fourteen methods on every endpoint (25.2 vs. 30.6 km 15-day centre error, -18%), holding its margin outside the labelled regions and through both phases of the El Nino-Southern Oscillation (ENSO), while reproducing westward drift, 50-60 deg S eastward reversal and poleward cyclone-anticyclone deflection. Over ten days through one fixed tracker, HaiRuo's forecast field cuts the eddy-centre error of WenHai and XiHe by 37-43% (-2.8 km vs. day 0 while they degrade +4.3-8.7 km), and its object trajectories cut pipeline error by 77-78% globally. Open-weight checkpoints, code and project page: https://github.com/xkqin/HaiRuo

AI.tldr: 提出HaiRuo框架，将中尺度涡旋同时作为"场"和"对象"进行预报：基于24年卫星高度计数据无标签预训练的10.5亿参数基础模型HaiRuo-1B给出15天海表高度/地转流场与涡旋掩膜，XuanJi拉格朗日对象解码器在随动极坐标下迭代精化涡旋轨迹，15天涡心误差25.2 km，优于14种方法约18%。
AI.motivation: 中尺度涡旋承载海洋大部分动能并输运热量、盐分与营养盐，但两周后涡旋位置目前只能依赖海洋模式加事后追踪启发式得到，缺乏端到端、同时兼顾物理场与涡旋个体身份的预报方法。
AI.method: 两部分分工：(1) HaiRuo-1B，10.5亿参数开放权重基础模型，在24年全球卫星高度计观测上无标签预训练，输入30天海平面图，一次前向输出15天海表高度与地转流场、逐日涡旋掩膜；(2) XuanJi，拉格朗日对象解码器，在每个涡旋的随动极坐标框架中采样演化中的预报场，经三轮前瞻迭代精化15天路径，并使用对象注意力。采用预注册的全球统一评测。
AI.result: 15天涡心误差25.2 km，对比最优基线30.6 km降低18%，全部指标端点均优于14种方法；同解码器下物理场技巧+0.14、mIoU +1.1；冻结骨干降低中心误差1.2 km（从头训练1.35 km），对象解码再降2.5 km（联合微调2.9 km），在六个已发表骨干上经对象注意力降2.5–3.3 km。跨过未标注区域与ENSO两个相位仍保持优势，并复现西向漂移、50–60°S东向反转及气旋-反气旋向极偏转。经固定追踪器十天，相比WenHai与XiHe使涡心误差降低37–43%，对象轨迹使流水线误差全球降低77–78%。
AI.conclusion: 将涡旋作为场与对象联合预报的范式显著优于事后追踪启发式与既有预报模型，且具备泛化性与物理合理性；作者开放权重、代码与项目页面，便于复现与推广。

title: TaoMate-R1: Temporal Role Specialization for Streaming Multi-Reference Video Generation
summary: Streaming multi-reference video generation establishes a scene from specified people and objects, then continues it under changing instructions. We introduce TaoMate-R1, a streaming multi-reference generator that organizes adaptation parameters through temporal role specialization. It assigns separate low-rank adapters to scene establishment and continuation on a frozen backbone. Each adapter performs both denoising and context writing for its role; Self Gradient Forcing jointly trains the roles through the history they construct. This allocation contrasts with operation-based specialization, which separates denoising from context writing across all chunks. A fixed-replay gradient analysis characterizes the update directions admitted by the two sharing schemes. On 32 multi-reference cases, we compare the schemes at the same two-adapter budget. Across ten approximately two-minute streams with changing instructions and shared teacher-audio conditioning, TaoMate-R1 reduces the mean boundary luminance jump from 1.96 to 0.613, with higher boundary feature similarity. It also achieves higher mean CLIP and DINO temporal similarity across short interactions, long streams, and public reference compositions. These results support grouping adaptation parameters by scene establishment and continuation for streaming multi-reference generation. Our code and model are released at https://github.com/TaoLiveAIGC/TaoMate-H3.

AI.tldr: TaoMate-R1 是一种流式多参考视频生成器，通过按时间角色专化（场景建立 vs. 延续）来组织低秩适配参数，实现更平滑的流式生成。
AI.motivation: 流式多参考视频生成需要在场景建立后随指令变化持续延续，但如何在冻结主干上合理分配适配参数、兼顾去噪与上下文写入仍是问题；作者质疑按“操作”划分（去噪 vs. 写上下文）的专化方式是否最优。
AI.method: 在冻结主干上为“场景建立”和“延续”各分配独立低秩适配器，每个适配器同时执行去噪与上下文写入；用 Self Gradient Forcing 通过角色构建的历史联合训练；并用固定回放梯度分析刻画两种参数共享方案的更新方向。
AI.result: 在32个多参考案例、同等双适配器预算下比较两种方案；在10段约两分钟、含指令变化与共享教师音频条件的流上，边界亮度跳变均值从1.96降至0.613，边界特征相似度更高；在短交互、长流和公开参考组合上 CLIP 与 DINO 时间相似度均更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将适配参数按“场景建立/延续”分组，是流式多参考视频生成的有效组织方式；代码与模型已开源。

title: Deviation-Aware Pretraining for Cardiovascular Disease Detection from Electrocardiograms
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals are critical for cardiovascular disease (CVD) detection. Most current deep learning models rely on supervised, task-specific training, which limits their ability to generalize across diseases, patient populations, and acquisition settings. This paper presents a self-supervised ECG feature extraction framework that learns from nearly one million unlabeled 12-lead ECG recordings. The framework includes two modules: Deviation Localization Embedding (DLE), which detects waveform-level deviations from normal patterns, and Association Reconstruction Embedding (ARE), which models cross-lead associations through deviation-guided reconstruction to capture abnormal patterns expressed across multiple leads. These modules enable the framework to capture subtle deviation-related patterns and their cross-lead context. The framework achieves up to 6.5% AUROC and 12.8% F1 improvements over prior methods on multiple public datasets, even without additional fine-tuning the pretrained feature extractor. Embedding visualizations show that the learned features support meaningful disease grouping and anomaly identification. The approach reduces the need for labeled data and can support clinicians in diverse healthcare settings. The framework has potential to improve early detection and monitoring of cardiovascular diseases, contributing to more accessible and equitable heart care.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自监督ECG特征提取框架，基于近百万条无标注12导联ECG，通过偏离定位嵌入(DLE)与关联重建嵌入(ARE)两模块学习可泛化特征。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习ECG模型多依赖有监督、任务特定训练，难以跨疾病、人群和采集设置泛化，且依赖大量标注数据。
AI.method: 利用约一百万条无标注12导联ECG进行自监督预训练，包含两模块：DLE检测波形级相对正常模式的偏离；ARE通过偏离引导的重建建模跨导联关联，以捕捉多导联共同表现的异常模式。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上，即使不对预训练特征提取器额外微调，AUROC最高提升6.5%、F1最高提升12.8%；嵌入可视化显示特征支持有意义的疾病聚类与异常识别。
AI.conclusion: 该框架减少对标注数据的依赖，有望辅助临床医生在多样医疗环境中进行心血管疾病早期检测与监测，促进更可及、公平的心脏照护。

title: Causal Time Series Modeling of Supraglacial Lake Evolution in Greenland under Distribution Shift
comment: Accepted as full paper in ICMLA 2025 (Special Session 1: Deep Learning and Applications)
summary: Causal modeling offers a principled foundation for uncovering stable, invariant relationships in time-series data, thereby improving robustness and generalization under distribution shifts. Yet its potential is underutilized in spatiotemporal Earth observation, where models often depend on purely correlational features that fail to transfer across heterogeneous domains. We propose RIC-TSC, a regionally-informed causal time-series classification framework that embeds lag-aware causal discovery directly into sequence modeling, enabling both predictive accuracy and scientific interpretability. Using multi-modal satellite and reanalysis data-including Sentinel-1 microwave backscatter, Sentinel-2 and Landsat-8 optical reflectance, and CARRA meteorological variables-we leverage Joint PCMCI+ (J-PCMCI+) to identify region-specific and invariant predictors of supraglacial lake evolution in Greenland. Causal graphs are estimated globally and per basin, with validated predictors and their time lags supplied to lightweight classifiers. On a balanced benchmark of 1000 manually labeled lakes from two contrasting melt seasons (2018-2019), causal models achieve up to 12.59% higher accuracy than correlation-based baselines under out-of-distribution evaluation. These results show that causal discovery is not only a means of feature selection but also a pathway to generalizable and mechanistically grounded models of dynamic Earth surface processes.

AI.tldr: 提出RIC-TSC框架，将滞后感知的因果发现嵌入序列建模，用于格陵兰冰上湖泊演化的时空分类，在分布外评测下比相关性基线准确率高12.59%。
AI.motivation: 时空地球观测模型多依赖纯相关性特征，在异质域间难以迁移。因果建模能刻画稳定、不变关系，提升分布偏移下的鲁棒性，但在该领域应用不足。
AI.method: 采用多模态卫星与再分析数据（Sentinel-1后向散射、Sentinel-2与Landsat-8光学反射率、CARRA气象变量），以Joint PCMCI+在全局及各流域尺度估计因果图，把验证过的预测因子及其时滞作为输入交给轻量分类器；基于1000个手工标注湖泊（2018–2019两个对比融季）构建均衡基准。
AI.result: 分布外评估中因果模型准确率最高超出基于相关性的基线12.59%。
AI.conclusion: 因果发现不仅是特征选择手段，更是构建可泛化、具机制解释力的地表动态过程模型的途径。

title: From Video Frames to Robot Meta-Frames: A Unified Latent Interface for World Action Models
summary: Pretrained video diffusion models (VDMs) offer a powerful foundation for World Action Models (WAMs), which jointly predict robot actions and future observations. Building such models requires injecting low-dimensional robot signals (e.g. proprioception, actions, and values) into a latent space shaped by natural videos, and a key design choice is the interface through which these signals enter: existing schemes treat it as a formatting detail, spending a separate latent frame on each signal or bolting on dedicated encoders and decoders. We argue that signal injection is instead a distribution-alignment problem: how well a representation matches the prior of the pretrained VDMs during denoising. Using the relative reconstruction error of a frozen VDM denoiser as a probe, we find that conventional spatial encodings sit far off this prior, whereas frequency-domain packing yields latents that the denoiser corrects far less. Motivated by this diagnostic result, we propose MetaWAM, which folds all robot signals into a single unified meta-frame: each signal is assigned to a disjoint frequency-domain channel band and lifted to the spatial latent by an inverse DCT, yielding a decodable interface aligned with the pretrained VDM prior without any added module or architectural change. A fixed band layout together with slot-aware routing lets the same meta-frame support policy, world-model, and value prediction over a shared set of robot variables. On RoboCasa, MetaWAM reaches 68.9% success while collapsing the per-signal frames into one and cutting inference latency by 39%, and attains 85.0% success on three real-world Franka tasks. Code and models are available at https://github.com/showlab/MetaWAM

AI.tldr: MetaWAM：将机器人信号（本体感知、动作、价值）以频域打包进单一"元帧"，使注入表示对齐预训练视频扩散模型先验，无需新增模块即可支持策略/世界模型/价值预测。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频扩散模型（VDM）是World Action Models的良好基础，但需将低维机器人信号注入由自然视频塑造的潜空间。现有方案把注入接口当作格式细节（每信号占一帧潜空间，或额外加编解码器），作者认为这本质是分布对齐问题：注入表示在去噪时与预训练VDM先验的匹配程度。
AI.method: 以冻结VDM去噪器的相对重建误差为探针进行诊断：传统空间编码远离先验，而频域打包的潜变量被去噪器"纠偏"的幅度小得多。据此提出MetaWAM：把所有机器人信号折叠进单一统一元帧，每个信号分配互不重叠的频域通道带，经逆DCT提升到空间潜变量，形成可解码、与VMD先验对齐且无需额外模块或架构改动的接口；固定频带布局加槽位感知路由，使同一元帧可服务于策略、世界模型与价值预测。
AI.result: RoboCasa上成功率68.9%，将逐信号多帧压缩为单帧，推理延迟降低39%；三个真实Franka任务上成功率85.0%。
AI.conclusion: 信号注入应被视为分布对齐问题而非格式细节；频域打包的元帧接口在保持无额外模块的同时，兼顾性能、效率与多任务复用，为WAM设计提供了新的有效范式。

title: Unipolar Neuron Networks Trained by Recirculation for Reward-Based Continual Learning
summary: Unipolar neurons are the predominant type of nerve cell in the octopus and in most other invertebrates. A single neurite (a fiber extending from the cell body) branches into a tree that carries both input and output synapses. The branches send graded local outputs to nearby cells, and one site on the main neurite sends a global output to distant targets. This paper proposes a network of such neurons and a learning rule for it. Each neuron is modeled as a tree of passive segments, whose activations are computed exactly as the steady state of a linear system. The network learns from reward alone, with a rule called recirculation. After each forward pass, a second pass sends requested changes of the outputs back through the same connections. Each synapse then adjusts its weight using only quantities available at its own location. Because the system of each neuron is symmetric, this update closely follows the gradient of the error in the predicted reward. Two mechanisms limit forgetting when tasks are learned in sequence: a task code inhibits a different subset of branches in each task, while consolidation lowers the learning rate of synapses that changed strongly in the recent past. The model is evaluated on a sequence of MNIST and Iris tasks. The network maintains high accuracy with low forgetting, whereas gradient-based training of the same network forgets earlier tasks almost completely.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模拟无脊椎动物单极神经元（树状结构、兼具输入输出突触）的神经网络模型及其局部学习规则"再循环"，仅凭奖励信号即可学习，并结合任务编码与突触巩固抑制遗忘。
AI.motivation: 章鱼等无脊椎动物的主要神经细胞是单极神经元：单个神经突分支成既接收输入又输出突触的树，既有局部分级输出也有全局输出。作者希望为这类神经元构建网络与学习规则，并解决顺序学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.method: 每个神经元建模为由无源片段构成的树，激活值作为线性系统的稳态精确求解。网络仅从奖励学习，采用"再循环"规则：前向传播后，第二遍将请求的输出变化经相同连接回传，每个突触仅用本地可得量调整权重；由于神经元系统对称，该更新近似于预测奖励误差的梯度。两种抗遗忘机制：任务编码在不同任务中抑制不同分支子集；巩固降低近期强变化突触的学习率。
AI.result: 在MNIST与Iris任务序列上评估，网络保持高准确率且遗忘很低；而对同一网络进行梯度训练则几乎完全遗忘先前任务。
AI.conclusion: 受单极神经元启发的局部学习规则可在序列任务中实现低遗忘的持续学习，显著优于标准梯度训练，为生物启发式网络与缓解灾难性遗忘提供了可行方案。

title: What Factors Matter for Collection-Level Counting with Human-AI Collaboration?
summary: Many scientific and policy decisions require estimating the total number of target objects across a large image collection. Exhaustive human labeling is often infeasible, while raw model predictions can be biased, especially under domain shift. Recent human-AI estimation methods combine imperfect model predictions with limited human verification to obtain reliable collection-level estimates. However, existing work provides little guidance on how practitioners should choose among models, estimators, and adaptation strategies for a new deployment. We study these choices within a common human-in-the-loop counting framework across 12 tasks spanning biomedical microscopy, ground-level and aerial wildlife surveys, and overhead imagery of urban structures. Our results show that modern multimodal models provide a strong, training-free starting point for many tasks, while fine-tuned detectors become more advantageous at larger labeling budgets and across repeated deployments. Estimation efficiency improves further when model predictions are used to prioritize which units humans label, rather than sampling uniformly. We also find that each model's ranking quality can be estimated with a small pilot set, yielding practical guidance for selecting strategies on new counting tasks. In a field deployment on aerial pronghorn surveys, a task-specific adaptation of these methods meets the survey's $\pm 5\%$ tolerance after reviewing a median of only $3.2\%$ of collected images.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较了人机协同"计数估计"任务中模型、估计器与主动标注策略的选择，覆盖生物医学显微、野生动物、城市影像等12类任务，并给出可操作的实践指南。
AI.motivation: 许多科学和政策决策需要估计大图像集合中的目标总数，但人工全标注不可行，原始模型预测在域偏移下有偏差；现有的人机估计方法缺乏对从业者"如何在新部署中选择模型、估计器和适配策略"的指导。
AI.method: 在统一的人机在环计数框架下，跨12个任务（生物显微、地面与航拍野生动物调查、城市结构航拍）评测模型选择、估计器与适配策略；比较现代多模态模型与微调检测器，并比较均匀采样与基于模型预测的优先采样策略，用小规模试验集估计各模型的排序质量。
AI.result: 多模态模型在多数任务上提供强且免训练的起点；微调检测器在标注预算更大及重复部署时更占优；用模型预测优先选择人标注单元可提升效率；模型排序质量可用小规模试验集估计；叉角羚航拍调查中，已适配方法仅需中位3.2%图像即达到±5%容差。
AI.conclusion: 人机协同计数应依预算与部署频率选择策略，主动优先采样提升效率，且小试验集可辅助策略选择，方法具有实际部署可行性。

title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
summary: Weight-space programming, introduced in recent MIT work by Takehi et al., enables a frontier LLM agent to read a network's weights and write a repair. Their GPT-6 Astra agent corrected the reasoning loops of Qwen3.5-0.8B without gradients, using 158 agent turns, 89.7 million tokens, and 50 forward-pass requests. Our method, Tree-Ising, casts this repair as a sparse discrete optimization problem over the model's own BF16 weights. Forward statistics define an objective that weakens a loop direction, strengthens a concluding direction, and preserves the layer's output on productive tokens. Within a state-tree representation, where lossless BF16 storage acts as a special case, the admissible edits are sign flips and exponent shifts that preserve all shared group exponents and mantissas. We decompose this objective exactly into independent QUBO (Ising) problems, one per output row, which we solve on a GPU using simulated annealing or quantum-inspired simulated bifurcation. On the agent's two layers, Tree-Ising achieves 54.6% on MATH-500, outperforming the agent's edit (51.7%) under the same evaluation protocol, while the base model scores 7.9% as reported. The simulated bifurcation solver yields a statistically indistinguishable repair at 55.1%. Both solvers outperform the agent edit across all five math benchmarks, with statistically significant improvements on MATH-500 and GSM8K after correcting for multiple comparisons. Our approach modifies 13% to 17% fewer weights and reduces BF16 bit flips by a factor of 2.2 to 2.3. It requires only four forward-pass requests and zero LLM tokens, with the annealing recipe costing about $0.90 in GPU time. On Qwen3.5-2B, with layers and dose selected using only the base model, the same recipe increases greedy GSM8K accuracy from 21.6% to 69.4%. As a proof of concept, we execute an eight-variable repair subproblem using QAOA on an IBM Heron processor.

AI.tldr: 提出 Tree-Ising 方法，将 LLM 权重修复问题转化为对 BF16 权重的高效稀疏离散优化，性能超越前沿 agent 的编辑且成本大幅下降。
AI.motivation: MIT 的 weight-space programming 让前沿 LLM agent 读写网络权重并修复推理回路，但代价极高（158 轮、8970 万 token、50 次前向请求）。作者希望用更高效、更可解释的离散优化方法替代昂贵的 agent 搜索。
AI.method: 将修复建模为模型自身 BF16 权重上的稀疏离散优化。用前向统计定义目标：削弱循环方向、强化结论方向、并在有效 token 上保持层输出。在状态树表示下（无损 BF16 存储为其特例），可容许编辑为符号翻转和指数平移，且保持共享组指数与尾数。将该目标精确分解为按输出行独立的 QUBO（Ising）子问题，在 GPU 上用模拟退火或量子启发式模拟分岔求解；并在 IBM Heron 上用 QAOA 求解 8 变量子问题作为概念验证。
AI.result: 在 agent 修改的两层上，Tree-Ising 达到 MATH-500 54.6%（agent 51.7%，基座 7.9%）；模拟分岔求解器达 55.1%，统计上无差异。两个求解器在全部五个数学基准上均优于 agent 编辑，MATH-500 和 GSM8K 上经多重比较校正后显著。改动权重少 13%–17%，BF16 位翻转减少 2.2–2.3 倍，仅需 4 次前向请求、零 LLM token，退火方案 GPU 成本约 0.90 美元。在 Qwen3.5-2B 上（仅用基座选层和剂量），贪婪 GSM8K 从 21.6% 提升到 69.4%。
AI.conclusion: 权重修复可作为稀疏离散优化高效求解，无需梯度或 LLM agent，成本极低却性能更优，且具备量子硬件求解子问题的可行性。

title: OnlyAct: Extracting Action Representations from Foundation Models for World Models
summary: Video world models promise general-purpose interactive simulators, but their training is limited by action supervision: action labels are scarce, fragmented across incompatible specifications, and do not scale with the unlabeled video pretraining corpus. A common workaround jointly trains an action encoder to compress consecutive frames into a latent action and a decoder to reconstruct the next frame from the previous frame and that latent, forcing the latent to capture only new information. This has two limitations: learning the action space from scratch can limit generalization to unseen domains, and the bottleneck trades expressiveness for separation, with tighter settings losing nuance and looser ones risking scene leakage under domain shifts. We argue for a different starting point: rather than learning actions from scratch, we start from a pretrained foundation model (V-JEPA 2), whose embeddings of a frame pair already carry substantial action information after large-scale, diverse video pretraining. The remaining challenge is to extract the action while discarding the scene. We propose a label-free contrastive adaptation framework that pulls together frame pairs sharing the same motion under a different scene and pushes apart pairs from the same scene with different motion, reshaping the geometry of the pretrained space without imposing a reconstruction bottleneck. We introduce a unified evaluation protocol along three axes (action expressiveness, scene invariance, and action-conditioned video generation quality) across robot manipulation, camera navigation, game, and driving benchmarks, most of which are unseen during adaptation. Compared with annotation-free latent-action methods, our representations are substantially more expressive while matching their scene invariance, and they yield world models that transfer demonstrated actions to new scenes more faithfully.

AI.tldr: 本文从预训练基础模型 V-JEPA 2 出发，用无标签对比适应（拉近同运动异场景帧对、推远同场景异运动帧对）提取动作表征而丢弃场景信息，无需重建瓶颈，在四类基准上比无监督隐动作方法更具表达力且场景不变性相当。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型训练受限于动作监督：动作标签稀缺、规格不统一、无法随无标注视频语料扩展。现有联合训练动作编码器+重建解码器的隐动作方案有两大缺陷：从头学习动作空间泛化性差；重建瓶颈在表达能力与场景/动作分离间难以权衡（过紧丢细节，过松在域偏移下泄漏场景）。
AI.method: 不从头学动作，而是以 V-JEPA 2 为基础——其帧对嵌入经大规模多样视频预训练已含丰富动作信息。提出无标签对比适应框架：将不同场景下相同运动的帧对拉近，将相同场景下不同运动的帧对推远，重塑预训练空间几何，避免引入重建瓶颈。
AI.result: 提出涵盖三个维度的统一评测协议（动作表达力、场景不变性、动作条件视频生成质量），覆盖机器人操作、相机导航、游戏与驾驶基准，其中多数在适应阶段未见。相较无标注隐动作方法，表征表达力显著更强、场景不变性相当，且世界模型能更忠实迁移示范动作到新场景。
AI.conclusion: 以预训练视频基础模型为起点、通过对比几何重塑而非重建瓶颈来提取动作，是无监督动作表征的可扩展且有前景的方向。

title: Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class: A Policed Quality-of-Service Mechanism for Agentic AI Traffic, Evaluated from Simulation to Real-Kernel Adversarial Testing
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 15 tables; submitted to IEEE Access; code and data at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23865136
summary: Software agents built on large language models generate traffic unlike human web traffic, yet routers have no class for it and cannot verify a sender's claim to be an agent. This paper proposes the Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class (VATC), which combines a reserved Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value declaring agent traffic, a router-side classifier that demotes flows contradicting the declaration to a class served after best-effort traffic, and a rate-limited priority queue. VATC was compared with static Differentiated Services (DiffServ), a dedicated class that trusts the marking, and fq_codel, a per-flow fair-queuing scheduler, in two simulators and on a real Linux kernel. VATC matched DiffServ under steady load. In a constructed burst it cut mean agent queuing delay by 98% relative to DiffServ in simulation (assuming an immediate verdict), at a 12% increase in human delay; most of the gain came from the separate class. Under a spoofed flood in the kernel, the rate limit held human latency 11 times below DiffServ's. Without verification, DiffServ and a tightly configured fq_codel gave legitimate agents lower latency than VATC; a live four-feature classifier then demoted all 20 bulk-shaped spoofers and gave agents 0.30 ms, but missed six spoofers that copied the agent pattern. With emulated network delay, a timing feature of the classifier stopped separating agent from human flows. In real agent harnesses on a congested link, router queueing took 13% to 63% of task time, depending on harness and assumed model latency. The traffic was synthetic or sandbox-scale.

AI.tldr: 提出可验证智能体流量类VATC（保留DSCP声明+路由器侧分类器降级+限速优先队列），在仿真与真实内核中评估，突发下大幅降低智能体排队时延，但对伪装与复制模式流量仍有局限。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体产生的流量与人类网页流量不同，而现有路由器既没有对应流量类别，也无法验证发送方是否真的是智能体，因此需要一种既声明又验证的流量分类机制。
AI.method: VATC由三部分组成：保留的DSCP值声明智能体流量；路由器侧分类器将违背声明的流降级到best-effort之后的类别；限速优先队列。与静态DiffServ、信任标记的专用类、fq_codel在两种仿真器和真实Linux内核上对比；另用含时序特征的四特征在线分类器测试伪装场景。
AI.result: 稳态负载下VATC与DiffServ相当；构造突发中（假设即时判定）平均智能体排队时延较DiffServ降低98%，人类时延增加12%，收益主要来自独立类别；内核中伪装洪泛下限速使人类时延低于DiffServ 11倍。但无验证时DiffServ与紧配置的fq_codel对合法智能体更优；在线分类器降级全部20个批量型伪装者（智能体0.30 ms），却漏掉6个复制智能体模式的伪装者；加入仿真网络时延后，时序特征失去区分能力。
AI.conclusion: VATC在有验证时能显著保护智能体时延并抵御粗暴伪装，但分类器易被模仿模式的攻击绕过，时序特征在网络时延下失效，且流量为合成或沙箱规模；真实拥塞链路中路由器排队占任务时间13%–63%，说明该问题确有实际意义但方案尚需更鲁棒的验证手段。

title: Metric-Aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization for Explainable Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfake detectors are commonly evaluated on real/fake classification alone, but real-world applications require explanations of the visual evidence behind each prediction. Joint vision-language models struggle with authenticity assessment, producing "real" narratives for manipulated images. To address this, we propose a decoupled predict-then-explain pipeline as our submission to the ACM Multimedia 2026 Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge, with methods trained and evaluated on the XPlainVerse benchmark. A vision-foundation-model ensemble first classifies the image, then a Qwen3-VL-8B model generates a decision-conditioned explanation of the visual evidence. For fake images, a second Qwen3-VL-8B compresses that text into a short non-expert summary without using the image. We further apply metric-aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to optimize both explainers against the challenge criteria. Under matched conditions, GRPO raises complex BERTScore-F1 from 0.686 to 0.712 and also improves grounding (entity and evidence F1); our submission ranked first on complex BERTScore-F1 and seventh overall.

AI.tldr: 提出解耦的"先预测后解释"pipeline，用于可解释深度伪造检测挑战赛：视觉基础模型集成做真伪分类，Qwen3-VL-8B生成决策条件解释，并用GRPO对齐评测指标，最终复杂BERTScore-F1第一、总排名第七。
AI.motivation: 现有deepfake检测器只评测真/假分类，而实际应用需要解释预测背后的视觉证据；联合视觉-语言模型难以做真实性判断，常对篡改图像给出"真实"的叙述。
AI.method: 解耦为两阶段：1) 视觉基础模型集成先对图像分类；2) Qwen3-VL-8B基于分类决策生成条件化解释；对伪造图像再用第二个Qwen3-VL-8B在不看图像的情况下将解释压缩为简短的非专家摘要；并对两个解释器应用指标对齐的GRPO优化。
AI.result: 在同等条件下，GRPO将复杂BERTScore-F1从0.686提升到0.712，并改善grounding（实体与证据F1）；投稿在复杂BERTScore-F1上排名第一，总分排名第七。
AI.conclusion: 解耦的predict-then-explain架构配合指标对齐的GRPO可有效提升可解释深度伪造检测的忠实性与解释质量，避免联合VLM的真实性判断缺陷。

title: SinkState: On-the-Fly SVD of Recurrent States for Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving
summary: Hybrid models combine softmax attention with linear attention, which compresses history into fixed-size recurrent states to balance model quality and inference efficiency. However, linear attention has not pushed this compression to its limit: we find that the queries, keys, and values of linear layers concentrate in a stable, low-dimensional subspace, a phenomenon we call the linear attention sink, so each state is effectively low-rank, with a rank that varies across states. Yet existing serving systems keep these redundant states dense, reading and rewriting them in full at every decoding step, so their memory traffic grows with the batch size and dominates the decoding cost. Thus SinkState stores each recurrent state in an adaptive low-rank form throughout inference with buffered updates and a local SVD restricted to the top subspace. SinkState further consolidates the remaining components asynchronously on the CPU. On four hybrid models with Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, from 4B to 120B parameters, SinkState reduces the peak memory of recurrent states by up to 2.6x (1.9x on average) and speeds up decoding by up to 1.58x (1.25x on average) over Mamba-SSM and FLA, while maintaining accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文发现线性注意力层的 Q/K/V 集中在稳定低维子空间（"线性注意力汇"），状态有效低秩且秩随状态变化；据此提出 SinkState，在推理全过程以自适应低秩形式存储循环状态，减少内存访问，峰值内存降 2.6x、解码加速 1.58x 且精度不降。
AI.motivation: 混合模型用线性注意力把历史压缩为固定大小的循环状态以平衡质量与效率，但现有服务系统仍以稠密形式保存这些冗余状态，每一步解码都完整读写，内存流量随批大小增长并主导解码开销。
AI.method: 作者观察到线性层 Q/K/V 集中于稳定低维子空间（linear attention sink），使状态实质低秩且各状态秩不同。SinkState 在推理中始终以自适应低秩形式存储每个循环状态，采用缓冲更新和仅限顶部子空间的局部 SVD，并把其余组件异步卸载到 CPU 上整合。
AI.result: 在 4 个含 Mamba-2 与 GDN 层的混合模型（4B–120B）上，相比 Mamba-SSM 与 FLA，循环状态峰值内存最高降低 2.6x（平均 1.9x），解码最高加速 1.58x（平均 1.25x），且保持精度。
AI.conclusion: 利用线性注意力状态的内在低秩性进行自适应低秩存储与更新，可在不损精度的前提下显著降低混合模型推理的内存占用与解码延迟。

title: UGG: Unified Generative Geometry Model
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 31 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://ugg-model.github.io/
summary: Understanding 4D scenes is a core challenge in visual intelligence, requiring models to jointly capture scene geometry, appearance, and dynamics from partial observations. However, existing approaches are subdivided into feedforward models for direct geometric prediction, and generative models for visual synthesis. We introduce UGG, a unified framework for 4D scene understanding that jointly models RGB video and geometric representations such as depth and camera pose. By assigning different noise levels across modalities and time, UGG formulates visual generation and geometric prediction as conditional completion within a single generative model. This flexible formulation enables the model to learn from diverse, heterogeneous datasets with different subsets of geometric and visual annotations. Furthermore, our generative formulation enables inference-time search over multiple plausible scene hypotheses, using geometric evidence extracted from observed RGB frames to improve geometric prediction without ground truth geometry. We demonstrate UGG's effectiveness over non-unified baselines across camera-controlled video generation, depth estimation, and camera pose prediction, including in challenging sparse observation settings. Code and visualizations are available at https://ugg-model.github.io/

AI.tldr: UGG是一个统一4D场景理解框架，将RGB视频与深度、相机位姿等几何表示统一建模在同一生成模型中，通过跨模态/时间的差异化加噪实现条件补全，支持异构数据训练与推理时搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有4D场景理解方法割裂为两类：前馈模型直接预测几何、生成模型专注视觉合成，二者分离，难以联合捕捉几何、外观与动态，且难以利用异构标注数据。
AI.method: 为不同模态和时间步分配不同噪声水平，把视觉生成与几何预测统一表述为单一生成模型中的条件补全问题；该形式允许从仅含部分几何/视觉标注的异构数据集学习；并利用从观测RGB帧提取的几何证据在推理时进行多假设搜索。
AI.result: 在相机可控视频生成、深度估计和相机位姿预测任务上优于非统一基线，尤其在稀疏观测设置下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 统一生成框架可有效融合视觉与几何建模，并借助推理时搜索在无真值几何条件下提升几何预测，为4D场景理解提供新范式。

title: Chain of Physics: Supporting Fault Diagnosis with Engineering-Inspired Large Language Model Reasoning
summary: Fault diagnosis in complex systems requires linking observed changes in physical quantities to the failure mechanisms that produce them. Experienced engineers perform this task by combining sensor information with knowledge of system behavior and fault propagation. Large Language Models (LLMs) can support this process, but their diagnostic reasoning depends on the availability of asset-specific engineering knowledge and on how this knowledge is represented and used during inference. This work introduces Chain of Physics (CoP), an LLM-based fault-diagnosis framework built around a Constrained Knowledge Graph (CKG) generated automatically from asset-specific reference documentation. CoP addresses failure-sensor association from textual engineering knowledge. The CKG stores diagnostic chains connecting failure modes, changes in physical quantities, and monitoring sensors. During inference, semantically similar graph paths are retrieved for each question and used as both information and in-context examples for the reasoning process. Candidate failure modes are extracted from the question and analysed independently through dedicated LLM calls, which generate plausible failure-to-observation chains. A final decision module compares these chains with the available answer choices. CoP is evaluated on the FailureSensorIQ benchmark across four industrial asset classes and three LLMs. Compared with direct prompting and conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), CoP improves diagnostic accuracy across all evaluated models, with gains ranging from 7.8 to 19.6 percentage points and from 11.7 to 18.2 percentage points, respectively. The results show that structured engineering knowledge can improve LLM-based diagnostic reasoning when graph retrieval is combined with in-context examples of fault propagation.

AI.tldr: 提出Chain of Physics (CoP)框架，利用自动构建的约束知识图谱(CKG)增强LLM的工业故障诊断推理，在FailureSensorIQ基准上准确率显著超越直接提示与常规RAG。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统故障诊断需将物理量观测变化与故障机理关联，LLM的推理依赖资产专业知识的可用性及其表示方式，且需解决文本工程知识中"故障—传感器"关联问题。
AI.method: 基于资产参考文档自动生成约束知识图谱，存储故障模式、物理量变化与监测传感器之间的诊断链；推理时检索语义相似的图路径作为信息与上下文示例；从问题提取候选故障模式并逐个独立调用LLM生成"故障—观测"链，最后由决策模块与选项比对。
AI.result: 在FailureSensorIQ基准的四个工业资产类别、三种LLM上评估，相比直接提示提升7.8–19.6个百分点，相比常规RAG提升11.7–18.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将结构化工程知识与图检索结合，并辅以故障传播的上下文示例，可有效提升LLM的故障诊断推理能力。

title: A Lightweight Differentiable Method for Real-Time Skin Rendering and Digitization
comment: 20 pages, 25 figures; includes 6 pages of supplementary material. Accepted to Computers and Graphics
summary: Inverse rendering for skin typically relies on offline path tracing to estimate physical properties, which fail to map directly to the approximate shaders utilized in interactive applications, such as game engines. We bridge this gap by directly estimating subsurface scattering parameters tailored for real-time rendering pipelines. We introduce a differentiable Screen-Space Subsurface Scattering (SSSS) framework that enables the joint optimization of spatially varying base textures and scattering distances. To account for local variations in skin thickness, we estimate these parameters across distinct facial regions, generating a blended profile map ready for production runtime engines. Our pipeline utilizes a low-cost, single-light, single-view capture setup designed for accessible and practical appearance acquisition. Optimization is driven by a masked loss function targeting regions where subsurface scattering effects are dominant. We validate our approach on a real-world dataset of $45$ individuals across the Monk Skin Tone Scale, ensuring demographic generalization. Furthermore, we complement this evaluation with synthetic data, a multi-light setup validating our single-light assumption, and a tilted-view configuration confirming angular consistency. Results demonstrate that our method effectively recovers scattering parameters from lightweight inputs, yielding realistic skin appearance directly compatible with standard real-time shaders.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可微分的屏幕空间次表面散射（SSSS）框架，可直接从低成本单光单视角捕捉中估计适用于实时渲染管线的皮肤散射参数。
AI.motivation: 传统皮肤逆向渲染依赖离线路径追踪估计物理属性，但这些结果无法直接映射到游戏引擎等交互应用中使用的近似着色器，存在估计与部署之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 构建可微分的屏幕空间次表面散射框架，联合优化空间变化的基础纹理与散射距离；为体现皮肤厚度局部差异，按不同面部区域分别估计参数并生成可混合的 profile map 供运行时引擎使用；采用低成本单光单视角捕捉；用聚焦次表面散射主导区域的掩码损失驱动优化。
AI.result: 在覆盖 Monk 肤色量表的 45 人真实数据集上验证了人群泛化性；并以合成数据、多光设置（验证单光假设）和倾斜视角配置（验证角度一致性）作为补充评估，表明能从轻量输入中有效恢复散射参数，获得与标准实时着色器兼容的逼真皮肤外观。
AI.conclusion: 该方法弥合了离线逆向渲染与实时渲染着色器之间的差距，可从轻量采集输入直接得到生产可用的皮肤外观参数。

title: Physics-Constrained Autoencoder for Interpretable Health Representation Learning in Turbofan Engines
summary: Health Indices (HIs) summarize degradation from operational data and support diagnostic and prognostic tasks in Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). Their usefulness depends on capturing degradation and interpreting system condition. Autoencoders learn such representations from unlabelled monitoring data; however, when training is driven only by reconstruction, the physical meaning of latent variables remains undefined, limiting their interpretation and diagnostic value. This work proposes a physics-constrained autoencoder that embeds system knowledge as an inductive bias in the decoder architecture and as a learning bias in the loss function. The decoder contains differentiable physical equations that receive latent variables and operating conditions as inputs, structurally guiding each latent variable to represent a predefined physical quantity and enabling component-level analysis before aggregation into a system-level HI.The methodology is benchmarked on the N-CMAPSS dataset against alternative representations. Reconstruction reaches an $R^2$ of 0.9993 and an MAE of 0.0036, comparable to fully data-driven models. After operating-condition correction, the inferred physical quantities track degradation, and their aggregation produces an HI with a Spearman correlation of 0.9791 with the ground truth, an RMSE of 0.0286, and an MAE of 0.0233. The methodology is further evaluated using a single model trained across four datasets representing distinct degradation scenarios. This model preserves component-level signatures that distinguish compression-side from expansion-side degradation without diagnostic labels.Finally, the proposed framework enables degradation trends to be visualized on component maps, providing a health representation in a form familiar to engine operators and domain experts.

AI.tldr: 提出一种物理约束自编码器，将系统知识作为归纳偏置嵌入解码器结构、并作为学习偏置注入损失函数，使隐变量对应预定义物理量，从而构建可解释、可进行部件级分析的健康指数。
AI.motivation: 现有自编码器仅以重构误差训练，隐变量缺乏物理意义，限制健康指数的可解释性与诊断价值。
AI.method: 解码器中嵌入可微物理方程，以隐变量和工况为输入，结构性地引导各隐变量表示特定物理量；同时在损失函数中加入物理学习偏置。先做部件级物理量分析，再聚合为系统级健康指数，并进行工况修正。
AI.result: 在N-CMAPSS上重构R²=0.9993、MAE=0.0036，与纯数据驱动模型相当；工况修正后HI与真值Spearman相关0.9791、RMSE=0.0286、MAE=0.0233。单一模型跨四种退化场景训练，无诊断标签即可区分压缩侧与膨胀侧退化特征。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了物理可解释的健康表征，并可在部件图谱上可视化退化趋势，便于运维人员与领域专家理解。

title: C$^2$-Routing: Complementary Cropping and Compression for Efficient Vision-Language Inference
summary: Visual Question Answering (VQA) imposes substantial computational overhead on vision-language models (VLMs), motivating model-agnostic input reduction methods that can be readily applied across diverse VLMs, including in black-box settings. Simply enforcing a visual-token cap reduces computation, but it can discard information needed to answer the question. A single reduction strategy also struggles to accommodate different scenarios. Our key observation is that cropping and compression are complementary: cropping highlights small targets and local details, whereas whole-image compression better preserves context for large targets or distributed evidence. Based on this observation, we propose C$^2$-Routing, which adaptively selects cropping or compression according to the input image and question. Since both strategies may still discard key information, we further design a safety gate that uses the predicted joint correctness distribution under original and reduced inputs to guide fallback and protect accuracy. To accommodate consumer GPU resource constraints, all training and evaluation experiments run on RTX 3090 GPUs. To measure gains beyond token capping, we use full-image baselines with the same cap of 1,024 visual tokens. We conduct extensive evaluation on three VLMs and 18 datasets spanning local details, global scenes, scene text, and documents. With the visual budget already capped, C$^2$-Routing further reduces end-to-end FLOPs by 36.53% and visual tokens by 42.36% on average, with a mean relative task-score decrease of only 0.77%.

AI.tldr: 提出C²-Routing，一种模型无关的VQA视觉输入缩减方法，依据图像与问题自适应选择裁剪或压缩，并以安全门控保护精度；在视觉预算已限至1024 token的前提下，进一步平均降低端到端FLOPs 36.53%、视觉token 42.36%，任务分数仅下降0.77%。
AI.motivation: VQA中视觉语言模型计算开销大，需要可跨模型（含黑盒）通用的输入缩减方法。单纯限制视觉token数量虽省算力却会丢失答题所需信息，且单一缩减策略难以适应不同场景。
AI.method: 观察到裁剪与压缩互补：裁剪突出小目标和局部细节，整图压缩更好保留大目标或分布式证据的上下文。据此设计C²-Routing，按输入图像和问题自适应选择裁剪或压缩；并设计安全门控，利用原始与缩减输入下预测的联合正确性分布来指导回退，防止精度受损。实验在RTX 3090上完成，并以同样1024 token上限的全图基线作为对比。
AI.result: 在3个VLM和18个数据集（覆盖局部细节、全局场景、场景文字、文档）上评测：在视觉预算已受限的情况下，C²-Routing进一步平均降低端到端FLOPs 36.53%、视觉token 42.36%，平均相对任务分数仅下降0.77%。
AI.conclusion: 裁剪与压缩的自适应组合结合安全门控，可在模型无关、适配消费级GPU的前提下显著降低VQA计算开销，同时几乎不损失精度。

title: Federated Learning for Cross-Regional Epidemic Forecasting with Asynchronous Outbreaks
summary:
Objective: Epidemic outbreaks are often asynchronous across regions, yet collaborative forecasting is hampered by privacy laws and heterogeneous public health interventions. We developed and evaluated, as a proof of concept, a federated learning (FL) framework for cross-regional COVID-19 forecasting under asynchronous outbreaks among Guangdong, Macau, and Portugal, while maintaining data sovereignty.
  Methods: Using daily case data from WHO and China CDC for the three regions, whose outbreaks were asynchronous and interventions heterogeneous, we trained Long Short-Term Memory networks via FL for short-term forecasting, benchmarked against localized and centralized training using Root Mean Square Error, Mean Absolute Error, and Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error. All experiments used the Flower FL framework with consistent hyperparameters across sites. Publicly available, aggregated case-count data were used so that the centralized benchmark could be computed as a reference.
  Results: The dataset comprised 1,233 daily observations (411 days) of new confirmed COVID-19 cases from November 24, 2021, to January 8, 2023. The earlier Omicron wave in Portugal supplied transmission dynamics that improved forecasts in the later-onset regions of Macau and Guangdong.
